The Huawei logo stands on a Huawei office building in Dongguan in Chinas southern Guangdong province on December 18, 2018. (Photo by Nicolas ASFOURI / AFP)
La tecnológica china ha tenido un 2018 difícil. EEUU, preocupado por el avance chino en el sector tecnológico, intenta convencer a sus aliados para que no utilicen equipos del grupo chino. Australia, Nueva Zelanda, Reino Unido, Francia y Alemania han rechazado los equipos por considerar que hay riesgo de espionaje.
"No hay pruebas de que Huawei amenace la seguridad nacional de cualquier país que sea", dijo Ken Hu en una conferencia de prensa brindada en la sede de la empresa, ubicada en Shenzhen (sur de China).
Huawei ha visto en los últimos meses rechazados sus equipos en Estados Unidos, Australia, Nueva Zelanda, Reino Unido, Francia y Alemania.
"Prohibir a un grupo en particular no va a resolver los problemas de ciberseguridad", añadió.
"Confiamos en la imparcialidad e independencia de los sistemas judiciales de los países involucrados", se limitó a comentar. "Esperamos un desenlace justo de este caso", agregó.
El anuncio de Deutsche Telekom, junto con las noticias de SoftBank de que también podría dejar los equipos Huawei, también podría ser un factor en la fusión pendiente entre T-Mobile y Sprint. Deutsche Telekom es la propietaria mayoritaria de T-Mobile, mientras que Softbank es propietaria de Sprint.
Reuters informó el viernes que el acuerdo entre las dos compañías telefónicas de Estados Unidos podría obtener la aprobación de los reguladores federales que investigan los riesgos de seguridad nacional. Según Reuters, el uso de equipos Huawei ha sido parte de la revisión.

Su kien Act To Bring Your Fresh Out ra mat cong nghe tre hoa cao cap Ultra Hifu 2019 cua TMV Ngoc Dung da dien ra tai Can Tho voi su tham gia hon 500 chi em va cac chuyen gia lam dep.
Khi buoc qua canh cua tuoi 35, luong collagen trong co the phai dep suy giam khien cho lan da mat di do dan hoi, chay xe ro ret va xuat hien nhieu nep nhan. Ultra Hifu duoc biet den la cong nghe tre hoa dan dau xu huong, giai phap toi uu cho nhung chi em dang loay hoay tim kiem phuong phap “noi dai thanh xuan” cho lan da.
Lieu ban co thac mac dieu gi khien phai dep san sang chi ngan do de trai nghiem cong nghe tre hoa nay?
Giai ma do “HOT” cua cong nghe Ultra Hifu
Ultra Hifu phien ban 2019 duoc chuyen giao tu Hoa Ky la thanh tuu trong linh vuc tre hoa da khong phau thuat. Buoc song vo cuc RF tac dong o do sau 3mm kich thich tang sinh Collagen vuc day cau truc, xoa nhan tuc thi, nang do be mat da chung nhao, danh tan mo nong cam va phuc hoi duong vien ham chay xe.
Hon the nua, neu cac phuong phap tre hoa truoc day can di theo lieu trinh voi tu nam den muoi lan thuc hien thi voi Ultra Hifu chi duy nhat mot lan lan da da thay doi dang kinh ngac. Nho uu diem vuot troi nay thoi gian lam dep se duoc rut ngan toi da ma van dam bao do an toan va hieu qua keo dai tu ba den nam nam tuy vao co dia.
Nhung khach hang dau tien trai nghiem cong nghe
Duoc biet, muc gia cho mot lan thuc hien dich vu kha “dat do”, Ultra Hifu vung mat la 10.000$ va vung mat la 5000$. The nhung van khong it phai dep “chiu chi” voi mong muon lay lai lan da tre ra tu nam den muoi tuoi.
La mot trong nhung nguoi dau tien trai nghiem Ultra Hifu, Dao dien/dien vien Viet Trinh chia se: “Trinh da tim ra bi quyet hoan hao cho lan da cua minh khi trai nghiem cong nghe Ultra Hifu. Khong chi xoa nhan, xoa vet chan chim ma cong nghe nay con giup da san chac, cam thon gon hon rat nhieu.”
Khong chi “sung sot” voi ket qua ma cong nghe mang lai, chi Le Thi Lan (Can Tho) cho biet. Toi rat hai long boi: “Nghe den cang da thi so dau, so nguy hiem, nhung voi Ultra Hifu thi toi an tam tuyet doi vi cong nghe nay khong phau thuat, thuc hien rat nhe nhang.”
“Sac dep hanh dong”: Ai dam ngan phu nu gianh lai quyen lam dep?
Nhan sac la quyen nang dac biet, la niem tu hao cua moi mot nguoi phu nu. Chinh vi vay, lam dep la hanh trinh can su dau tu xung dang. Se that tuyet voi neu o do tuoi 30, 40 hay 50 ma ban van co the giu gin duoc lan da sang min, dien mao tre trung.
Ban nghi sao ve cong nghe lam dep “ngan do” nay?

The term district, in the context of China, is used to refer to several unrelated political divisions in both ancient and modern China. In the modern context, district or sub-city (Chinese: 区), formally city-governed district, city-controlled district, or municipal district (Chinese: 市辖区), are subdivisions of a municipality or a prefecture-level city. The rank of a district derives from the rank of its city. Districts of a municipality are prefecture-level; districts of a sub-provincial city are sub-prefecture-level; and districts of a prefecture-level city are county-level. It was also formerly used to refer the obsolete County-controlled districts (also known as district public office). However, if the word district is encountered in the context of ancient Chinese history, then it is a translation for xian, another type of administrative division in China. Before the 1980s, cities in the People's Republic of China
China were administrative divisions containing mostly urban, built-up areas, with very little farmland, except for the immediate suburbs in order to ensure a large supply of food or raw materials. As a result, districts were also mostly urban or suburban in nature. After the 1980s, prefectures began to be replaced with prefecture-level cities. From then on, "cities" in mainland China became just like any other administrative division, containing urban areas, towns, villages, and farmland. These cities are subdivided into districts, counties, autonomous counties, and county-level cities. At the same time, counties and county-level cities began to be replaced with districts, especially after 1990. From then onwards, districts were no longer strictly an urban entities — some districts today are just like counties, with a large towns and townships under them governing rural areas.

County-controlled districts (obsolete)[edit] A county-controlled district sometimes translated as county-governed district; county district or sub-county; (Chinese: 县辖区，区; pinyin: Xiànxiáqǖ, Qǖ) is a sub-county in the People's Republic of China. A branch of a county government, a district public office (Chinese: 区公所; pinyin: Qū gōngsuǒ) is the administrative office in a district, it is not a local government. A county-controlled district was once an important subdivision of a county all over China
China from 1950s to 1990s. It was common for there to be about 5 to 10 districts in a county, then about 3 to 5 towns and townships in a district. After the 1990s, county-controlled districts began to be phased out, and their role were taken over by larger towns or townships created by merging smaller ones. At the end of 2011, there are just 2 county-controlled districts left in China:
District (Zhuolu County, Zhangjiakou, Hebei) Kuiyibage District
District (Poskam County, Kaxgar Prefecture, Xinjiang)

Binh sinh, cho den bay gio da sang ben kia doc cuoc doi, toi van thuong tu cho minh la ke khong den noi phai xau ho voi danh phan cua mot thang dan ong.
Trong mat vo toi, toi la mot nguoi dan ong dich thuc dang de cham soc yeu chieu. Trong mat toi, toi la thang dan ong hon rat nhieu thang dan ong khac. Ve chuyen nay la ca mot linh vuc triet ly sau xa, mot chu de menh mong sau sac ma tiec thay lau nay it ai ban toi. Mac ke chuyen thien ha tho o voi thien phan dan ong, rieng toi, toi tham tu dac ve cai chat dan ong cua minh. Ay the ma bong co mot ngay dep troi, tren mot phien cho vung cao, toi bi choang vang vi tu thay xau ho voi minh khi ngoi nghe trom cau chuyen cua hai nguoi dan ong xa la.
Ben mot chiec ban go moc thech, toi ngoi uong ruou voi mot nguoi ban. Anh nay thao nhieu thu tieng dan toc vi da mot thoi chuyen di thu mua nam rung, thao qua trong cac ban lang xuat sang Trung Quoc. Ban ben canh co hai nguoi dan ong mac quan ao cham vua noc tung bat ruou day vua cham cham nhin vao mat nhau. Ngoi ne ra xa mot chut la mot nguoi phu nu vay ao theu xanh do, khap nguoi deo khong biet bao nhieu vong bac lung lang.
Suot den gan nua tieng dong ho chi thay co mot anh chang noi, khi thi gian du khi thi nghen ngao, co luc lai dam chim trong uu tu nhu bi men ruou nhan chim. Can ruou to tren ban da voi qua nua, bong hai nguoi dan ong om cham lay nhau, nuc len rung ruc. Cai ban op ep chao ngieng lam hai bat ruou do toe ra san. Lang lang nhin hai ga dan ong qua say, nguoi dan ba cui xuong nhat nhung chiec bat dat len ban roi lang lang mo nut cai can nhua cao den hai gang tay, nghieng can rot ruou day tran hai mieng bat. Xong xuoi lai tro ve cho, lang lang nhin bang quo ra rang nui giang ngang truoc mat.
Thay canh la lung, toi thi tham hoi anh ban xem chuyen gi dang xay ra. Thi ra hai ga dan ong nay chinh la “tinh dich” cua nhau, theo cai cach dinh nghia ngu ngoc cua nguoi duoi xuoi chung ta. Mot anh la chong, con mot anh la nguoi yeu cu cua nguoi dan ba dang ngoi day. Nhin ky ra thi co van con kha tre nhung ve tieu tuy va cam chiu lam cho ta nghi rang day da la mot thieu phu nhan sac dang tan.
Chieu toi ngay hom qua ho da xuong den cho. Nhu nhieu doi khac, hai vo chong nay buoc ngua vao mot goc ben quan, an mot bua no ne roi chia tay nhau. Sang hom nay ho lai tim ve quan cu theo le thuong de roi se lai an mot bua truoc khi tuc tac dat ngua di ve. The nhung lan nay, co vo khong ve quan mot minh ma dan theo anh nguoi yeu cu. The la ba nguoi ngoi cung nhau. Hai nguoi dan ong va mot nguoi dan ba.
Anh ban toi ngoi xay mat ra cua nhung cang tai ve phia ban ben de nghe va co ha giong dich cho toi nghe tung cau nhat gung dut quang cua nguoi dan ong dang vua noi vua uong mot cach day buc xuc. Anh ban toi con phai tom tat ca cau chuyen da xay ra truoc khi toi hoi, the nhung van theo kip duoc khuc sau vi anh kia cu noi mot cau lai uong mot hop, roi lai gat gat cai dau nhu dang co vat ra cac y nghi lon xon nam dau do ben trong oc minh.

Nuoi da dieu co mot von ba loi?
Xem bản tiếng việt đầy đủ tại đây : http://60s.com.vn/index/417558/09102007.aspxNuoi da dieu co mot von ba loi?
De nuoi da dieu nhu mot nghe voi mong muon mang lai loi nhuan cao la dieu khong de dang cho nhung ho nong dan it von, thieu thong tin va ky thuat nuoi. Trong chuyen cong tac vao nam 1995, nguyen Bo truong Bo Nong nghiep va Phat trien nong thon Nguyen Cong Tan da dua 100 trung da dieu dau tien giong chau Phi tu Zimbabwe ve Viet Nam. Den nay, da hon muoi nam, xem ra nghe nuoi da dieu van chua du suc thu hut duoc nhieu nguoi... du nuoi da dieu khong phai la qua kho. Mot von ba loi? Phong trao nuoi da dieu o cac tinh phia Nam chi bat dau vao khoang nam 2003 mac du hon muoi nam truoc, nguoi dan cac tinh phia Bac da nuoi da dieu. Trung tam Nghien cuu gia cam Thuy Phuong o Ba Vi, Ha Tay, la noi cung cap con giong cho nhieu trang trai trong ca nuoc. Tuy nhien, de nuoi da dieu nhu mot nghe voi mong muon mang lai loi nhuan cao la dieu khong de dang cho nhung ho nong dan it von, thieu thong tin va ky thuat nuoi. Anh Ha Viet Hung, Giam doc Cong ty co phan san xuat thuong mai Viet Hung co trang trai chuyen nuoi da dieu theo mot mo hinh khep kin o quan Binh Thanh, Tp.HCM, tam su ve nhung ngay dau gian nan tap tanh nuoi da dieu, thoi ma gia mot cap da dieu giong nhap tu chau Phi ve khoang 7.000-8.000 do la My. Nam 1996, Hung chat gop von lieng de phat trien dan da dieu theo mo hinh trang trai, ba nam lien tiep anh deu that bai, thiet hai tren 10 ti dong. Khong bo cuoc, Hung cat cong qua cac nuoc va vung lanh tho nhu Nhat, Trung Quoc, Thai Lan, Dai Loan de hoc kinh nghiem va tim toi ky thuat nuoi. Mat may nam, anh moi phat trien thanh cong dan da dieu theo mo hinh trang trai voi ky thuat nuoi hien dai. Sau do cong ty cua anh bat dau nhan cung cap da dieu giong va chuyen giao cong nghe nuoi cho tren 200 ho rai rac khap ca nuoc. Theo tinh toan cua anh Hung, neu moi viec thuan loi thi nghe nuoi da dieu la mot von ba loi. Nhung roi anh lai gap rui ro.Truoc day trang trai anh nuoi khoang 700 con, tu khi co dich cum gia cam xuat hien, anh khong dam nhap da dieu giong tu cac nuoc khac ve. Hien trang trai cua Hung chi con nuoi khoang 250 con, anh du kien cuoi nam se chuyen co so nuoi da dieu ve quan 9, Tp.HCM. Trong khi do mot so noi tung nhan chuyen giao cong nghe, con giong cua Cong ty Viet Hung tu sau cac con dich cum gia cam cung chung lai, khong phat trien them dan. “Neu khong co quy trinh chan nuoi khep kin theo mo hinh nuoi nhieu con cung mot luc nhu ba ba, da dieu, trun que va ca sau nhu hien nay thi cong ty cua toi kho co the tru vung duoc khi co nhung rui ro nhu dich cum gia cam vua qua”, anh Hung chia se. Anh Le Quang Thuc, nha o quan Tan Binh, Tp.HCM, cung co mot trang trai o Tay Ninh nuoi 80 con da dieu da hon bon nam nay. Anh Thuc cho biet mac du thit da dieu co gia cao, nhung phai nuoi dung ky thuat thi moi dat duoc sieu loi nhuan. De nuoi da dieu giong anh Thuc phai nhap hai may ap trung tu Trung Quoc ve voi gia 48 trieu dong/cai, co kha nang ap duoc khoang 100 trung/lan. Anh Thuc cho biet da bo ra khoang 200 trieu dong de mua da dieu giong va tien dau tu chuong trai khoang 300 trieu. “Hien tai, loi nhuan moi vu tu tien ban da dieu giong, trung va thit la tren duoi 500 trieu dong. Tuy nhien de dat duoc doanh thu nhu vay toi phai nuoi ket hop voi cac con khac nhu heo rung, nai, huou va ca”, anh noi. Nam 2004, nghe ban be noi nuoi da dieu mang lai loi nhuan cao, chi Trieu Thi Minh Trang, chu trang trai Trieu Minh o huyen Nhon Trach, Dong Nai, da bo ra 300 trieu dong de dau tu chuong trai.
Giai doan dau, chi Trang mua 20 con giong loai tam thang tuoi tu trai giong gia cam Thuy Phuong o Ba Vi, Ha Tay ve nuoi, sau do chi mua them 80 con giong loai ba thang tuoi gom con trong va con mai het gan 300 trieu dong nua. Chi Trang lam bai tinh nham va cho biet hang thang tien thuc an cho mot con mat khoang 250.000 dong. Gia da dieu thit luc truoc cao, con ban duoc khoang 14-15 trieu dong/con, sau nay gia ha, chi quyet dinh ban dan va khong dau tu nuoi them. Tuan truoc, chi Trang cho biet kho khan lam chi moi tim duoc nguoi mua het 22 con da dieu cuoi cung voi gia moi con la 5 trieu dong theo dang mua can hoi nguyen con. Tinh toan lai chi lo mat 1 ti dong! “Neu biet truoc lo nhu the nay, toi da chang lao theo nhu the. Phai chi ban dau toi quyet dinh nuoi heo hay bo co le hay hon!”, chi Trang tiec re.
Chi Trang tam su them rang mot so nguoi ban cua chi dang nuoi da dieu o Tri An, Long Thanh, Dong Nai va Tay Ninh cung dang roi vao canh tien thoai luong nan: giong thi da mua, tiep tuc nuoi thi chi phi cao ma ban nua chung thi gia thap, se lo nang. “Truoc day, gia mua thit da dieu tai cac nha hang, sieu thi tai Tp.HCM la 350.000 dong/ki lo gam, tu khi dich cum gia cam bung phat, gia thit da dieu ha xuong con khoang 150.000 dong/ki lo gam, co noi mua noi khong. Mat khac, do khong co ky thuat thuoc da va chua tim duoc thi truong tieu thu nen cac ho nuoi chi con biet ban thit theo kieu can hoi ca con chu khong the tan dung khai thac het cac bo phan khac cua da dieu nhu long, da va xuong”, anh Hung cho biet. Nhoc nhan tim dau ra Ong Thien Sanh Tri, chu trang trai da dieu Thien Lam Nguyen (Ninh Thuan), cho biet cach day bay nam ong da bo ra 1 ti dong de dau tu nuoi da dieu tren mot khu vuc rong 22 hec ta o Ninh Thuan. Tuy nhien, ong lam trang trai da dieu vi muon tan dung manh dat dang co chu cung chua tinh den dau ra. O lua da dieu dau tien, ong Tri lam thit mot con dem bieu cho cac dau bep o khach san, nha hang lon nham… tiep thi san pham. Ong tiep tuc lam the voi con thu hai, roi thu ba… thi nhan duoc don dat hang… 5 ky thit tu mot nha hang. Hon mot nam sau, san pham tieu thu co kha hon nhung van chi la thit nac. “Luc do, toi chang biet lam gi voi mo gan, xuong va da cua da dieu (chiem den 60% trong luong hoi). Ma khong tan dung nhung thu nay thi nuoi da dieu thit chi co nuoc lo”, ong Tri nho lai. Tu day, ong da hinh thanh y tuong ve mot quy trinh chan nuoi, che bien de tieu thu “tron ven” san pham da dieu. Tuy nhien, truoc khi di den dich cuoi cung la mo quan pho va nha hang da dieu hoi thang 8-2006, ong da mat nhieu nam may mo de lam bop, vi, day nit… tu da da dieu. “Khong co so nao nhan thuoc da, cung nhu che tac cac san pham tu loai da rat la nay, toi danh chap nhan san pham lam ra du khong dat yeu cau van khong bat ho boi thuong. Nhung hang lam ra roi lai… ken khach mua, mot phan cung vi gia cao den bac trieu. Ngay ca mon pho da dieu, nguoi ta an khen ngon nhung van che mac”, ong Tri noi. Trong khi chua tim duoc dau ra cho cac san pham “tron goi” tu da dieu, ong Tri van phai chiu lo voi viec ban thit thuong pham. “Cu tinh tron 100 con giong, gia mua thoi diem cach day bay nam khoang 3,5 trieu/con, tien an hang ngay 10.000 dong/con trong it nhat mot nam (thoi gian can thiet de da dieu dat trong luong tren 100 ky), chua tinh chi phi xay dung chuong trai, nhan cong… voi luong thit thuong pham tu mot con da dieu chi toi da 40% thi khong cach gi loi duoc!”, ong Tri cho biet.
Hien nay thit va cac san pham my nghe che tac tu da dieu chua duoc tieu thu nhieu trong nuoc, con xuat khau thi lai chua du nang luc. Ong Tri cho biet, hien nhu cau nhap khau thit da dieu tai chau Au va mot so nuoc nhu Nhat Ban, Han Quoc, Trung Quoc… len toi 3.000 tan/nam. Ban than ong cung da nhan duoc nhung don hang cu the nhung danh chiu vi kha nang chan nuoi va tiem luc tai chinh con gioi han. Hien trang trai cua ong dang nuoi 65 con giong va 100 con thit, cung thuoc loai trang trai “tam co” o Viet Nam, nhung neu so voi cac don hang tu nuoc ngoai thi ong se phai phat trien trang trai cua minh len den hang ngan con. Dieu nay that kho. Thuc hien quy trinh chan nuoi va che bien khep kin nhu trang trai ong Tri, hoac quy mo hon nhu Tong cong ty Khanh Viet (Khatoco) nham toi uu hoa loi nhuan cung la mot thach thuc doi voi cac ho chan nuoi nho le. Voi tong dau tu khoang 300 ti dong, Khatoco da xay dung mot nha may che bien thuc an chan nuoi, cong suat 20 tan/gio; mot nha may che bien thit cong suat 3.000 tan/nam; mot xi nghiep thuoc da va che tac cac san pham thu cong my nghe tu da, long, vo trung; mot xi nghiep san xuat banh xop va bot dinh duong cao cap dung nguyen lieu chinh tu trung da dieu… Theo ong Tri, kho nhat trong che bien la loc da da dieu, vi thuc te lop da nay rat mong, lai nhieu mo nen phai rat “chuyen nghiep” moi co duoc tam da dep. Roi phai to chuc san xuat hang thu cong my nghe, san pham gia dung tu da da dieu… Neu da thuc hien du mot quy trinh khep kin thi loi nhuan tu dau ra da dieu moi la thuc te. “Mot tam da da dieu co the lam duoc 20 soi day nit, gia ban si 750.000 dong/soi. Phan thit co the thu ve 5 trieu dong; xuong co gia 10.000 dong/ky; long da dieu, trung tuoi va ca vo trung sau su dung cung co gia tri thuong mai…”, ong Tri chia se.

KMT city council nominations
Buried deep within the KMT’s website, I found press releases on their city council nominations. The press releases listed how the nominations were determined (by telephone survey or by committee decision). In the case of surveys, the order the nominees are listed seems to be the order of their survey results. Unfortunately, it did not list how much support they got in the telephone surveys or anything about the losers.
(Rant: The KMT’s website is an abomination. Political parties should not make you work hard to find out who their candidates are. Every other party puts this somewhere easily accessible from the front page. The KMT seems to think it is a state secret. Someone should be fired for incompetence.)
I’m updating a table from an earlier post with these two new bits of information. TS=telephone survey; CD=committee decision. Everyone with a number in the win column is a winner; the number reflects the order in which they were listed. When a committee decision was made, I don’t think this number carries any special meaning. Since there is no data listed on losers, I can only be sure about gender for incumbents and nomination winners.

Nhung co gai thoi moi
Nhu H. (cuu sinh vien Truong Kinh te, nay lam nghien cuu thi truong cua Cong ty TNS) duoc ban be ne phuc vi H. la mot nguoi co kha nang ket ban sieu hang. Ban cua co la nhung anh chang kinh day cop, nhung co nang sanh dieu, nhung anh lon tuoi thanh dat trong may cong ty tam co, nhung cau trai cong tu lay dua xe, nhau nhet lam thu vui... “Don gian moi nguoi troi mot khia canh khac nhau, nhu vay toi co the co duoc tat ca nhung thu toi can” - H. noi voi ve kieu hanh.
Con T. Lieu lai co mot loi song nhu Tay. Moi dau dai hoc, Lieu da doi thue nha o rieng, khong muon co su quan ly cua gia dinh nua. Dang di hoc nhung T. Lieu ra suc kiem tien bang nhung cong viec lam them mang tinh thoi vu. Lieu danh thu lao kiem duoc de di du lich cung ban be va mua sam het, xem do nhu la cach tu thuong cho ban than. Lieu noi: “Minh lam chi de co xat voi doi thoi, do la cai minh can. Minh phai song loi song hien dai nhu Tay”.
Luc hut tinh va tien
Moi chi la sinh vien nhung Lan (nha o Phu Nhuan) da to ra gia dan khi triet ly: “Tien khong the mua duoc tinh yeu nhung chac chan no co kha nang to diem cho tinh yeu. Vi thu nghi coi, neu trong ngay sinh nhat cua minh ma khong co lay mot mon qua cua ban trai, du bat ke ly do gi di nua, thi toi tin chac tinh yeu do se khong the ton tai”. Voi Lan, neu khong co tien, thu hoi co ai dam nghi den mot bua toi lang man ben nguoi yeu? Muon ky niem cho nguoi yeu mot cai ca vat hay mot cai vi de chung to khieu tham my cung nhu the hien su quan tam lan nhau, lam the nao neu doc nguoc hau bao ma chang co lay mot xu?

Ibrahimovic len tieng viec ve lai ac milan
Mot thong tin dang de y trong thoi gian gan day la viec AC Milan dang co y muon dua tru cot 1 thoi, Zlatan Ibrahimovic ve lai San Siro. Theo nhu link sopcast thi trong 2 nam khoac ao Rossoneri, tien dao nguoi Thuy Dien da gay ly tuong manh voi 56 ban trong 85 lan ra san, gop cong lon trong chien tich dang quang Serie A 2010-11 cua doi bong nuoc Y.
Moi day, dich than Giam doc Leonardo cua Milan khi duoc hoi ve thuong vu tiem nang cung khang dinh phia Cau Lac Bo ko phu nhan bat ky dieu gi. Phan ung truoc su quan tam cua doi bong cu, Ibrahimovic to ra rat kin tieng. Trong bai phong van voi TMZ, sieu sao 37 tuoi tu choi dua ra cau tra loi ro rang bang tuyen bo ngao nghe: “Luon luon co nhung tin don. Ca the gioi deu muon toi. Khong sao ca.”
Trong nhung nam choi bong o Chau Au, theo lich thi dau bong da thi hien nay Ibrahimovic da kinh qua hang loat Cau Lac Bo lon nhu Ajax, Juventus, Inter Milan, Barcelona, AC Milan, Paris Saint-Germain va Manchester United. Cuoc chinh phuc nhung dinh cao Chau Au cua anh co le da co the keo dai hon nua, neu ko bat ngo dinh chan thuong dau goi nghiem trong hoi nam ngoai.
Cach day 7 thang, Ibrahimovic da quyet dinh chuyen sang My thi dau trong mau ao LA Galaxy. Anh nhanh chong hoa nhap voi MLS va can moc 20 ket qua ghi duoc trong 24 lan ra san.

Tin nong thoi su xa hoi ngay 30/10: Xac minh thong tin thay giao bi to ga tinh hoc sinh lop 10 ;Bac si kham suc khoe tac trach, nguoi tam than cung duoc cap bang lai xe; Bao so 5 giat cap 11, do bo vung bien Quang Ngai - Ninh Thuan; Thuc hu chuyen can bo chinh sach an chan tien cua nhieu ho gia dinh co cong.
Xac minh thong tin thay giao bi to ga tinh hoc sinh lop 10,
Nhung ngay qua, tren mang xa hoi Facebook lan truyen thong tin mot nu sinh lop 10 tai truong THPT Nguyen Du (TT.Ngai Giao, huyen Chau Duc, tinh Ba Ria – Vung Tau) bi mot thay giao trong truong nhan tin quay roi va ga gam, sau do la “di” mon hoc. Sau khi doan bai viet duoc dang tai len mang xa hoi da thu hut rat dong luot binh luan va chia se.
Ngay sau khi doan bai viet tren duoc dang tai vao hom 20/10, nha truong da nam duoc vu viec va tien hanh vao cuoc tim hieu, xac minh. Dong thoi, vu viec cung duoc nha truong bao cao voi so GD&DT tinh Ba Ria – Vung Tau.
“Hien, vu viec da duoc chung toi bao cao voi So cung voi co quan cong an vao cuoc dieu tra. Rieng phia nha truong da giao cho mot Pho Hieu truong xac minh thong tin, thong qua viec sang loc diem cua khoi 10 ve mon hoc do.
Song song voi do, nha truong cung keu goi hoc sinh da dang tai doan noi dung tren, som lien he voi nha truong de cung phoi hop lam ro.
Theo thay Tam, lien quan den bai viet tren co mot so nguoi cung binh luan chi dich danh mot ca nhan thay giao trong truong voi loi le khiem nha.
Xem them: Xac minh thong tin thay giao bi to “ga tinh” nu sinh lop 10 xon xao mang xa hoi
Bac si kham suc khoe tac trach, nguoi tam than cung duoc cap bang lai xe
Noi ve tinh hinh tai nan giao thong trong thoi gian qua, dai bieu Nguyen Thi Thuy (doan Bac Kan) cho rang ngay cang nhieu lai xe duong tinh voi ma tuy, khien khong it nguoi dan chiu cai chet thuong tam, de lai hau qua lau dai cho gia dinh ho.
Tinh hinh tren co nhieu nguyen nhan, trong do co nguyen nhan con nhieu chu the lien doi song van vo can, dung ngoai, chua phai chiu trach nhiem.
Van de tiep theo duoc ba Thuy de cap la viec kham suc khoe o cac doanh nghiep kinh doanh van tai, khi nhieu don vi da bo ngo cac quy dinh cua phap luat trong viec quan ly tai xe.
Ba Thuy tiep tuc chi ra ke ho o khau kham suc khoe: “Cu tri va cac lai xe phan anh co qua nhieu tieu cuc trong cong tac nay, nhieu truong hop khong can den kham, chi can bo tien 200.000 dong va cung cap chieu cao, can nang la co giay chung nhan du suc khoe de lai xe.
Co nhung truong hop den kham, bac si chi hoi va ghi, khong kham, khong xet nghiem. Cach lam tren dan den truong hop bi benh tam than van duoc cap giay phep lai xe nhu o Hoa Binh, Dak Nong”.
Xem them: Bac si kham suc khoe tac trach, nguoi tam than cung duoc cap bang lai xe
Thuc hu chuyen can bo chinh sach an chan tien cua nhieu ho gia dinh co cong
Ngay 30/10, lanh dao UBND xa An Tien (huyen An Lao, TP.Hai Phong) cho biet, UBND xa da ra quyet dinh tam dinh chi cong tac 1 thang tu ngay 21/10 doi voi ong Pham Van Tan – can bo thuoc ban Chinh sach cua xa de lam ro nhung sai pham cua ong nay lien quan den viec an chan tien dieu duong cua cac ho gia dinh co cong.
Truoc do, tu nhieu thang nay, du luan xa An Tien da buc xuc vi thong tin ong Pham Van Tan trong vai nam qua da gia chu ky cua cac ho duoc huong tien chinh sach doi voi nguoi co cong de linh so tien len toi hang tram trieu dong.
“Sau khi bi to cao, qua xac minh ban dau cua chinh quyen, co 9 ho gia dinh co cong bi ong Tan an chan tien dieu duong. Den hien tai, ong Tan da khac phuc hau qua tong cong 16.650.000 dong va da khac phuc xong.
Viec ong nay co lam gia chu ky de linh tien hay khong thi con chua ro. Nhung trong tong so 9 truong hop thi co truong hop den UBND xa kien nghi, sau do UBND xa da doi chung thi thay chu ky la dung”, lanh dao UBND xa An Tien noi.
Xem them: Hai Phong: Dang xac minh viec can bo chinh sach an chan tien cua hang loat ho gia dinh co cong
Bao so 5 giat cap 11, do bo vung bien Quang Ngai - Ninh Thuan
Theo Trung tam Du bao Khi tuong vao thoi diem 16h ngay 30/10, vi tri tam bao so 5 nam ngay tren vung bien cac tinh Quang Ngai-Ninh Thuan. Suc gio manh nhat vung gan tam bao manh cap 9 (75-90km/gio), giat cap 11.
Du bao trong 12 den 24 gio tiep theo, bao di chuyen chu yeu theo huong Tay, moi gio di duoc 15-20km, di vao dat lien cac tinh tu Quang Ngai den Khanh Hoa va suy yeu dan thanh ap thap nhiet doi. Den 4h ngay 31/10, trung tam vung ap thap nhiet doi o vi tri tren dat lien cac tinh Tay Nguyen. Suc gio manh nhat vung gan tam ap thap nhiet doi manh cap 6 (40-50km/gio), giat cap 8.
Do anh huong cua bao so 5, o khu vuc Bac va giua Bien Dong va vung bien phia Tay Bac quan dao Truong Sa co gio manh cap 6-7, vung gan tam bao di qua cap 8, sau tang len cap 9, giat cap 11; bien dong rat manh.
O vung bien ngoai khoi cac tinh tu Quang Ngai den Ninh Thuan (bao gom ca huyen dao Ly Son) co gio manh dan len cap 7, vung gan tam bao di qua cap 8-9, giat cap 11, song bien cao 3-5m, vung gan tam bao 4-7m; bien dong rat manh; o Nam Vinh Bac Bo va vung bien tu Quang Tri den Quang Nam co gio Dong Bac manh cap 6, giat cap 8; bien dong.
Tu trua va chieu 30/10, tren dat lien cac tinh Quang Nam, Ninh Thuan co gio manh dan len cap 6-7, giat cap 9; cac tinh Quang Ngai, Binh Dinh, Phu Yen, Khanh Hoa co gio manh cap 6-7, sau tang len cap 7-8, giat cap 10.

Che tu chon via he Doc hai den kien ruoi cung khiep - Tong hop
Tags: Ha Noi, tien nao cua nay, hoa qua tuoi, via he, tu chon, dau chuoi, doc hai, co gia, loai duong, che, quan, hang, chu, den,
"Tien nao cua nay thoi. 10.000 dong/coc thi lay dau ra hoa qua tuoi, duong mia "xin", hay tham chi do, bot, dau chuoi nguyen chat?", chu mot quan che tu chon, via he thu that.
Khong chiu noi suc hap dan cua nhung coc che ngot lim, mat te nguoi, du mau sac, mui vi giua cai oi a cua mua he, nhieu thuong de co the da biet la chung doc hai, ban thiu, nhung van cu co tu doi minh rang chung ngon, bo, re.
Ben canh nhung thanh phan da ro nguon goc nhu do xanh duoc gui len tu Thai Binh - que cua chi Lan, chu mot quan che via he tren duong Ta Quang Buu (Hai Ba Trung, Ha Noi), con co khong it vi che ma ngay den ca chu quan cung khong biet ro xuat xu cua chung. Chi Lan tung chia se, cac thanh phan khac nhu bot, chuoi kho, vung, dua kho, thach rau cau ...hau het chi deu mua tu cho dau moi phia Nam (Hoang Mai, Ha Noi) voi gia sieu re.
Chang han, chuoi kho thuong co gia 70.000 dong/kg, thach rau cau khong ro nguon goc loai 1kg co gia 50.000 dong, loai nho hon co gia 25.000 dong, dau do co gia 30.000 dong/kg, dau den 25.000-30.000 dong/kg, nep cam co gia 28.000 dong/kg, dua kho khoang 10.000 dong/tui 5 lang, dau chuoi 3.000 dong/lo...
Co khong it vi che ma ngay den ca chu quan cung khong biet ro xuat xu cua chung
Tuy nhien, chi Lan thua nhan, voi cac loai do kho thuong nguoi ta chi dong goi vao cac tui nilon hoac bi binh thuong roi ban cho chi, chu khong he duoc dong goi vao bao bi co in ro nguon goc, xuat xu, thanh phan can than. "Rieng thach thi co chu day, nhung toan tieng Trung Quoc, toi cha dich duoc chu nao. Thay nguoi ta canh bao, minh ban thoi, chu dung an. Nhin mau sac thi bat mat, mui lai thom, co nhieu vi ngon, them vao do gia lai re, cha toi gi minh khong mua ve kinh doanh ca", chi Lan noi.
Xuyen Chi, co sinh vien 20 tuoi, tung la tin do trung thanh cua cac quan che via he o day buc xuc noi: "Mot lan dang cao hung chem gio voi tui ban, em khong nhin coc che thap cam du thu mau cua minh nen da an trung phai mieng hoa qua thoi. Hoa qua nhu vai, dua hau, dua, mit... da re den the roi ma chu quan con do chieu tro. Vai thi ho chang bao gio tach ruot, de ca qua cho ...do ton. Mit, dua - toan hoa qua "nong" thi ho de ngam duong, nghe noi con dung ca chat bao quan de hang tuan lien neu e am nhu the ngam sau, me da vay. Khong biet co phai vi an nhieu thu lan lon, tron trao o do qua khong ma hom do ve em bi dau bung am i may ngay. Em so che via he toi gia luon".
Loai duong khien ruoi, muoi, kien cung khiep dam
Gan day, dan cu mang xon xao truoc phat hien chi can mua 1 lang duong sieu ngot gia 50.000 dong thi chu hang che co the pha ban ca tuan. Loai duong hoa hoc co ten Tangjing do duoc ban pho bien o cac quay hang do kho trong cac cho lon nhu cho Dong Xuan, Hang Buom... Theo tim hieu, chung la nhung hat duong mau trang, nho nhu vien B1, nhung "sieu" ngot. Dang chu y, khi su dung loai duong nay, ruoi, muoi bay xa, kien khong dam ben mang toi gan. Cac nha khoa hoc cho biet, loai duong hoa hoc nay cung co the la duong Cyclamate, khong co trong danh muc cac chat phu gia duoc phep su dung trong thuc pham. An phai loai duong nay co nguy co bi ung thu va tieu duong.
Tu dung do day gau ban cua mot hang che tu chon via he
The nhung, nhieu ban tre van "diec khong so sung" khi thuong thuc mon khoai khau nay hang ngay. Ben canh duong sieu ngot, hau het cac quan che via he deu su dung pham mau va khuyen mai them dau chuoi de danh lua vi giac cua khach. Cac chuyen gia tung khuyen cao, neu an nhieu dau chuoi, gan se tich tru lai chat doc, co the dan toi ung thu, nhung duong nhu nhieu ban tre da bi "nghien" thu gia vi nay.
GS.TS Bui Minh Duc, chuyen gia ve doc hoc dinh duong va an toan thuc pham cho biet: "Dau chuoi doc o cho, nguoi ta da khong dung dung moi, cac san pham tinh khiet cho thuc pham de pha loang vi loai nay cuc ky dat tien va thuong phai nhap ngoai. Vi vay nguoi ta de cho cac chat dan xuat re tien de pha che ra dau chuoi. Dieu nay la chac chan vi voi gia ca beo bot nhu vay thi lay dau ra san pham dat yeu cau ve do tinh khiet. Loai dau nay khong phan ung ngay voi co the ma gan se tich tru lai doc to".
Sieu ban
Mac du ai cung biet do an via he khong the nao sach duoc, nhung ho van chap nhan chung voi muc gia "de chiu" chi 10.000 dong nhu cac loai che dang duoc bay ban tren duong Ta Quang Buu. Khi ngoi "thuong" che o day, cac "thuong de" khong chi "duoc" hit no bui duong, nhat la vao gio cao diem, nhieu phuong tien luu thong tren duong, ma con duoc khuyen mai them hang trieu vi khuan gay benh. Ngay tu khi don hang, da, cac to dung che da duoc bay la liet ra dat, lan bui ban va chang he duoc che day trong khi chu cua hang loi tu trong mot chiec tu gau ban khong kem nha ve sinh cong cong ra hang loat coc, thia cung ban chang kem.
Khong kho de thay, moi quan che nhu vay thuong chi co 1 - 2 chiec khan vua de lau ban, vua de lau coc chen, thia, dia. Cac "thuong de" se duoc khuyen khich dung loai giay lau ma theo tiet lo cua chu mot quan che o day thi no co gia chua day 10.000 dong/bich lon. "Day la loai giay lau do mot co so tu nhan o ngoai thanh Ha Noi san xuat. Chung co mau trang, duoc tay rua ki, tao cam giac sach se cho nguoi su dung, chu thuc ra chung con doc hon giay ve sinh minh mua o nha. Duoc cai, voi loai giay re tien nay, khach co the dung tet ga, thich dung bao nhieu thi dung, chu chung toi khong phai ke ke canh hop giay nua", ba B noi.
Tai quan cua ba B, theo quan sat cua PV, tu 5 gio chieu toi tan khi ho don hang, duy chi co 3 chau nuoc duc ngau duoc tai su dung nhieu lan. Nhan vien cua ba B than tho: "Nha ba ay cach day xa lam, ai hoi dau ma ve xach nuoc lien tuc duoc. Ngoai ra, an che cung sach, chi can trang qua coc, lau kho la duoc, co can phai rua bang nuoc rua bat dau, nen chang can nhieu nuoc lam gi. Khach o day toan nguoi tre tuoi, nen ho de tinh lam. Chang ai de y may viec do dau".

Theo cac chuyen gia, viec uong ruou ran toan tinh khong co kha nang chua benh nam gioi, tham chi con gay mat kha nang sinh san, nhiem doc dan toi tu vong.
Ruou ran chi co tac dung ho tro giam dau
Luong y Tran Van Quang, Hoi Dong y Viet Nam cho biet, ong da tung gap mot benh nhan do uong ruou ngu xa - ruou duoc ngam bang 5 con ran da bi nhiem doc, te bao da bi phan huy, moc, rop nhu da ran.
Theo ong Quang, trong Dong y van dung ran phoi hop voi mot so vi thuoc de dieu tri. Moi loai ran, moi bo phan cua ran lai co mot tac dung khac nhau doi voi tung loai benh.
Doi voi benh dau xuong khop, nguoi ta thuong ngam toan tinh (ngam ca con) hoac phoi hop voi mot vai vi thuoc. Cong nang cua ruou ran la tru phong te thap. Ruou ran chu yeu dung de chua chung dau nhuc xuong co khop (thap khop), ban than bat toai, do mo hoi chan tay.
Do tuoi sinh cao khong nen uong ruou ran.
Con duoc dung cho nguoi co tuoi suc yeu lao dong nhieu, gap thoi tiet thay doi thi thay dau moi co xuong khop. Tuy nhien, ruou chi co tac dung ho tro giam dau, chu khong dieu tri triet de duoc benh. Doi voi nhung nguoi tang nhiet (trong nguoi thuong cam thay nong) khong nen dung.
Trong do tuoi sinh de khong nen uong ruou ran

Topa in kei tungah thu hong gen leuleu a,
"Israel gamsungah mite in zat belin a neih paunak, A pate in leenggah thuk ne a, a tate ha kim, cihna pen bang a cihnopna ahi hiam?
Kei pen a nungta Topa Pasian ka hih mah bangin kong genin-ah: Israel gamsungah hih paunak na zang nawn kei ding uh hi.
Mi khempeuh keima-a hi a, pate ahi a, tate ahi zongin keima-a ahi hi. A mawh mipa bek si ding hi.
"Gentehna-in mi a hoih mahmah, a thuman, a diktat mi khat om hi.
Amah in Israel mite milim biakte biakpihlo a, milim biakna pialo ding, ci-in a kikhamna munah milim biakna sate zong nelo hi. Midangte zi zong luppih dingin zollo a, numei in nin a neih laitakin zong luppihlo hi.
Kuamah khemlo a, kuama na zong sutlo hi. Sum leitawi a lapa in khapna van a apte zong piakik hi. Gilkialte an vakin, puan neilote puan guan hi.
A meet bekbek lunggulhna-in sum leitawi pialo hi. Gamtatsiat ding utlo a, mite thu a manin khensak hi.
Amah in ka thupiakte mangin, ka thukhamte hoihtakin zui hi. Tua bang mi pen mihoih ahih manin nungta ding hi, Topa Pasian in ci hi.
"Tua ciangin gentehna-in hih mihoihpa in tapa khat nei a, tua tapa in mi na gu-in mi that a, a pa gamtat ngeiloh a siateng gamta hi.
Amah in milim biakna pialo ding a kici munah a kipia biakna sate ne a, midangte zite zolin luppih hi.
Mizawng mi cimawhte khemin, mi na sut a, sum leitawi a lapa in khapna-in a piak nate piakik loin kemsuak hi. Milim bia-in a zumhuai-in gamta hi.
A meet lunggulhna-in sum leitawi pia a, a meet zong a kilawm loin tampi tak la hi. Hih bang mipa nungta ding ahi hiam? Nungta hetlo ding hi. Hih bangin a mindaihuaite khempeuh gamta ahih manin tuate hangin amah si ding hi. Ama sihna pen ama mawhna hang ahi hi.
"Gentehna-in hih mihoihlopa in tapa khat hong nei hi. Tua a tapa in a pa gamtat hoihlohna teng mu a, a pa gamtat bangin gamtalo hi.
Israel mite milim biakte biakpihlo a, a kikhamna munah biakna-in a kipia biakna sa zong nelo hi. Midangte zi zollo a, zong luppihlo hi.
Kuamah bawlsialo a, kuama na zong sutlo hi. Sum leitawi a lapa in a khapna van a apte zong piakik hi. Gilkialte an vak a, puan neilote puan guan hi.
Gamtatsiat ding utlo a, a meet bekbek lunggulhna-in sum leitawi pialo hi. Ka thukhamte zui-in ka thupiakte mang hi. Tua ahih manin hih mipa pen nungta ding a, a pa mawhna hangin si hetlo ding hi.
A pa in ahih leh mi na sutin, mite tungah a sia gamta tawntung hi. Tua ahih manin ama mawhna hangin amahmah si hi.
"Ahi zongin, Bang hangin a pa mawhna a tapa in thuaklo ding ahi hiam? nong ci khading uh hi. A tapa a hoih a manin a gamtatna hang ahi hi. Amah in ka thukhamte kemin hoihtakin zui hi. Tua ahih manin pelloin amah nungta ding hi.
A si dingpa pen a mawh mipa ahi hi. Ta in pa mawhna thuaklo ding a, tua mah bangin pa in ta mawhna thuaklo ding hi. Mihoihpa in a hoihna thaman ngah ding a, migilopa in a gitlohna thaman thuak ding hi.
"Migilo khat in a mawh bawlna khawlin ka thukham zui hen la, a hoih a manin gamta leh, tua mipa silo ding a, pelloin nungta ding hi.
Ama mawhnasa khempeuh kimaisak ding a, amah a manin a gamtat manin nungta ding hi.
Migilo khat a si ka muh ciangin a lungdam dingin hong ngaihsun na hi uh hiam? Ka lung dam hetlo hi. Amah hong kisikin a nuntak ding pen keima deih ahi zaw hi.
Ahi zongin mihoih khat in a gamtat hoihnateng khawlin, migilote gamtat bangin a mindaihuai gamtatsiate gamtat ding hong kipan leh, amah nungta paisuak ding ahi hiam? Nungta hetlo ding hi. A hoih ama gamtatnasate kiphawksaklo ding hi. Ama cihtaklohna leh ama mawhna hangin si ding hi.
"Ahi zongin note in, Topa hihna zia manlo hi, na ci uh hi. Israel mite aw, ka thugen hong ngai un. Keima hihna zia a manloin ngaihsun na hi uh hiam? A manlo pen nomau ngaihsutna zia hizaw hi.
Mihoih khat a gamtat hoih khawlin mawhna a bawl ciangin si ding hi. Ama sihna pen a gamtatsiatna hang ahi hi.
Migilo khat a gitlohna panin khawlin a hoih a manin gamta leh ama nuntakna a suahtak ahi hi.
Amah in a gamtatna phawkin a mawh bawlna khawl hi. Tua ahih manin amah si hetlo ding a, nungta paisuak ding hi.
Ahi zongin no Israel mite in, Topa hihna zia manlo hi, na ci uh hi. Israel mite aw, keima hihna zia manlo ahi zenzen hiam? A manlo pen nomau ngaihsutna zia hizaw hi.
"Topa Pasian ahi keimah in note kiangah kong genin-ah: Israel mite aw, na gamtatnasa bang ciatun thu kong khen ding hi. Kisik kikin na gamtatsiatna khempeuh panun khawl un la, na mawhna hangun kisisak kei un.
Na gamtatnasa uh mawhna khempeuh nusia un la, na lungsim uh leh na ngaihsutna uh thaksuaksak un. Bang hangin no Israel mite si nuam na hi uh hiam?
Kuama sih ding ka deih kei hi. Tua ahih manin na mawh gamtatna uh khawlin nungta un, Topa Pasian in ci hi," a hong ci hi.

PHP kai fa zhe bi bu ke shao de wu ge fa zhan yao su

本文为【PHP开发者必不可少的五个发展要素】的拼音翻译版
yu fa jie gou jiao ke shu shang de zhi shi he shi ji de cheng xu she ji shi you qu bie de ， zhen zheng de zhi shi yao zai shi ji de kai fa zhong huo de 。 mei ge php de kai fa ren yuan zai kai shi kai fa web ying yong cheng xu zhi qian ， dou ying gai shu xi xia mian de wu jian shi ：
1. kuang jia
kuang jia ke yi shuo shi php kai fa zhong de yi ge zui chong yao de wen ti 。 yong php kai fa web ying yong cheng xu shi you hen duo fang fa ， you hen duo kai yuan de kuang jia ke yi shi yong ， ke yi bang zhu kuai su de kai fa ， bao chi geng gao de yi zhi xing he you xiao xing 。 qi zhong bi jiao hao de kuang jia bao kuo cakephp ，Symfony he CodeIgniter 。 hen duo kuang jia huan an zhao MVC she ji mo shi ， ru guo ni zai zhe ge mo shi xia gong zuo guo ， na ni yi ding hui hen shu xi 。 guo yi duan shi jian ， ni shen zhi ke yi gen ju zi ji de xu yao lai chuang jian kuang jia 。
2. mo ban yin qing
ru guo nin shi yong de bu shi yi ge kuang jia lai zhi xing yi ge ju ti de she ji mo shi ， na me nin xiang yao shi yong de shi mo ban yin qing 。 bu lun ni shi zi ji chuang jian huo shi shi yong xian you de mo ban ( ru Smarty)， mo ban yin qing dou hui shi ni de luo ji dai ma cong HTML ye mian zhong du li chu lai ( yi ji xiang guan de CSS / js / deng )。 zhe da da de jian hua le ni de dai ma ， shi zheng ge cheng xu de xiu gai bian de kuai su jian dan ， ye shi fei kai fa zhe geng rong yi xiu gai ni de cheng xu 。
3. dai ma chong yong
zheng ru wo xian qian ti guo de ，php shi suo yong yu yan zhong dai ma chong yong xing zui hao de 。 cong duo zhong xiao de wen dang dao zheng ge shu ju ku lei ，php kai fa zhe xu yao de shi hou ke yi sui yi de xuan ze chong yong xian you de dai ma 。 qi shi ， ni ji hu ke yi bu yong bian xie yi xing dai ma jiu neng jian li qi zheng ge ying yong cheng xu 。
4. bu chong xin kai fa xian you de dong xi
hen ming xian de yi jian shi ， zhi you shao shu de php kai fa zhe zhi dao php ben shen you hen duo ke yong zhi chu 。 wang ji xin de tu shu guan ， huo fu duo de dai ma li cheng - xian kan kan PHP shou ce 。 li ru ， ni men you mei you ting guo number_format(), parse_url(), wordwrap() huo bbcode_parse()? kan yi xia zheng ge han shu shen kao ， xuan ze yi ge lei bie ， liu lan yi xia ， nin yi ding hui you suo fa xian 。

Tac chien trong tap tran lon nhat the gioi
Tac chien trong tap tran lon nhat the gioi Tags: Thuy quan Luc chien My, nhat the gioi, tap tran, binh si, lon nhat, hai quan, tac chien, noi dung, do, doan, Hawaii
Cuoc tap tran hai quan lon nhat the gioi RIMPAC 2012 dang dien ra soi noi o Hawaii, voi nhieu noi dung phoi hop giua binh si cac nuoc tham gia. > Chien ham do ve tap tran lon nhat the gioi Tap tran hai quan Vanh dai Thai Binh duong RIMPAC 2012 dien ra tai Honolulu, Hawaii tu ngay 29/6 den 3/8. Trong hinh la hai truc thang AH-1W Super Cobra cua Thuy quan luc chien My tiep can truong huan luyen phia tay de tien hanh dien tap do bo tau san bay hom 7/7, mot noi dung trong cuoc tap tran hai quan quoc te RIMPAC 2012. Cac tho lan cua Hai quan Australia boi duoi tau chien USS Missouri (BB-63) de lam quen va luyen tap cung don vi Lan va Cuu ho 1 cua Hai quan My. RIMPAC 2012 quy mo lon va co nhieu net khac biet so voi nhung nam truoc, khi quy tu den 42 chien ham, hon 200 may bay cung 25.000 binh si den tu 22 quoc gia. Viet Nam co quan sat vien trong cuoc tap tran nay. Cac binh si thuoc tieu doan 2 Canada va tieu doan 1 trung doan 3 thuy quan luc chien My, tap luyen do bo tu truc thang CH-53E Super Stallion. RIMPAC 2012 la lan thu 23 cuoc tap tran hai quan da quoc gia duoc to chuc ke tu khi bat dau vao nam 1971. Chi huy Corporal Jerel Bersolona cua My dang ho tro cac binh si Canada du day xuong mat dat tu truc thang. Thuy quan luc chien Indonesia luyen tap cung binh si Tonga va thuy quan luc chien My tai khu huan luyen Puuloa o bai bien Ewa, Hawaii. Thuy quan luc chien Mexico ngam ban muc tieu cach hon 20 met. Binh si Australia trong cuoc huan luyen vu khi chien thuat o can cu tai vinh Kaneohe. Cac binh si thuoc cong ty Alpha My va binh si New Zealand tap luyen tan cong cac toa nha, mot phan trong noi dung huan luyen hoat dong quan su do thi cua RIMPAC. Cong ty Alpha do tieu doan 1 trung doan 3 thuy quan luc chien cua My dung dau. Binh si Australia tranh thu chop mat tren tau tan cong do bo USS Essex (LHD 2) truoc khi buoc vao cuoc tap luyen voi binh si cua Tonga, Indonesia, My va Canada. An uong de chua di tinh
An uong de chua di tinh Tags: lieu phap an uong, kim anh tu, di tinh, co the, trong ngay, gia vi, chia lam, bai thuoc, dung, nuoc, chao, nau, chua
Di tinh co the chia lam 4 the khac nhau. Ve chua tri, co the bang lieu phap an uong, hoac dung bai thuoc. Theo luong y Vu Quoc Trung, 4 the di tinh bao gom: the thap nhiet ha tru - thich an nhung thuc pham ran nong va thich uong ruou, ty vi nong am thap xuong am thiet, hoac nhap phong sau khi say ruou, am nong trong ngoai, xam nhap buong tinh gay ra di tinh; than hu khong ben - truoc khi ket hon thuong mac chung thu dam, da ket hon roi thi dam duc qua do, ton thuong than, tieu hao khi, gay ra ha nguyen hu, lau ngay dan den di tinh; lao luc ton thuong tam ty - phan nhieu do suy nghi vat va lau ngay, tam ty bi ton thuong, sinh hoat tinh duc thai qua, than mat kha nang tang tru lau ngay gay ra di tinh; am hu hoa vuong dan den di tinh. Mon an - Chao tho ty tu: Tho ty tu (vi thuoc) 30-60g, mot it gao te, duong trang vua du. Rua sach tho ty tu roi gia vun cho vao nuoc sac lay nuoc cot, bo ba, cho gao vao nau chao, khi chin cho duong trang vao, nau them mot chut la duoc. Dung het trong ngay. Dung 10 ngay la mot lieu trinh, neu thay co hieu qua thi dung them 2 lieu trinh nua. - Chao kim anh tu: Kim anh tu 10-15g, mot it gao te (hoac gao nep). Sac (nau) kim anh tu lay nuoc cot, bo ba, roi cho gao te hoac gao nep vao nau chao, nem nem gia vi. Chia lam 2 lan, dung het trong ngay, mot lieu trinh tu 2-3 ngay. Luu y, neu nguoi dang cam sot thi khong duoc dung. Trach ta - Chao so bien: So bien 30g, trung vit muoi 1 qua, gao 100g. Vo gao cho nuoc nau chao, rua sach so bien, doi chao gan chin thi cho vao cung nau chao. Trung muoi boc vo, khi chao chin cho vao chao. Nau them muoi phut nua, nem nem gia vi vua dung. Dung moi buoi sang, dung lien trong nhieu ngay. - Dung thu o 100g, 2 cai trung ga, cung cac gia vi, hanh, gung, ruou. Rua sach thu o sat thanh tung doan dai 4-5 cm. Cho trung ga va thu o vao noi cung mot luong nuoc vua du, nau den soi thi cho cac gia vi vao. Khi trung chin, nuoc dac thi vot thu o ra, boc vo trung, cho vao trong nuoc nau them vai phut nua, nem nem gia vi. Dung trung va nuoc, dung het trong ngay. Hoai son Bai thuoc - Voi than hu khong ben, neu di tinh nhieu lan, than sac met moi, thuong cam thay vang dau hoa mat, u tai, moi lung, thi co the dung bai thuoc gom cac vi: dang sam 15g, hoang ky tuoi 18g, thuc dia 12g, hoai son 10g, phuc linh 12g, mau don bi 8g, kim anh tu (sao tam nuoc muoi loang) 20g, mau le (sac truoc) 20g, long cot (sac truoc) 15g, lien tu 10g, trach ta 8g, cam thao 6g. Cho 3 chen nuoc, sac (nau) con 180 ml, chia 3 lan uong nong trong ngay. - Voi the am hu hoa vuong - neu thuong xuyen vang dau u tai, nong mat, tim dap manh loan nhip, ngu it, ngu thi bi mong tinh, duong vat de bi cuong len, moi lung hoat tinh, thi dung bai gom cac vi thuoc: thien dong 10g, sinh dia 12g, thuc dia 8g, dang sam 8g, sa nhan 4g, hoang bach 12g, tri mau 12g, kim anh tu (sao tam nuoc muoi loang) 30g, khiem thuc 15g, trach ta 10g, nu trinh tu 12g, dan bi 8g, cam thao 7g. Cho 3 chen nuoc, sac con 180 ml, chia 3 lan, dung luc con nong trong ngay. Ngoai viec dung mon an, bai thuoc, thi nguoi bi tinh trang nay can chu y tiet duc, tranh sinh hoat tinh duc qua muc, tang cuong luyen tap the duc... Viet Bao.vn (Theo Thanhnien)

本文为【高中生英国留学可选择的语言考试】的拼音翻译版
yu yan neng li ce shi shi zhong guo xue sheng zhi jie jin ru guo wai yuan xiao de tong xing zheng ， mei ge xue sheng dou bu ke bi mian 。 mu qian ying guo ge da yuan xiao zhao sheng shi zhu yao yi san zhong cheng ji zuo wei shen kao ， ta men fen bie shi shen me ne ？ ta men de ji ben jie gou you shi zen yang de ？ shi he shen me yang de ren qun ？ xia mian jiao yu zhuan jia hou yue jiu lai wei da jia xiang xi jie shao yi xia ju ti qing kuang 。
ya si (IELTS)
IELTS kao shi yong yu ping gu kao sheng yi ying yu wei gong ju cong shi xue xi 、 pei xun huo zai ying yu guo jia sheng huo suo ju bei de yu yan neng li 。 ci kao shi you jian qiao da xue di fang kao shi wei yuan hui 、 ying guo wen hua wei yuan hui he ao da li ya jiao yu guo ji fa zhan zu zhi gong tong guan li 。 kao shi you ting li 、 yue du 、 xie zuo he kou shi si ge bu fen zu cheng 。 suo you ying shi zhe yun cai yong xiang tong de ting li he kou shi mo shi 。 kou shi cai yong kao guan yu kao sheng dang mian dui hua xing shi 。 yue du he xie zuo fen wei liang zhong mo shi ：①ACADEMIC( xue shu lei ) yong yu ping gu ying shi zhe shi fou zhun bei hao zai ying yu huan jing zhong jiu du da xue ben ke huo yan jiu sheng ke cheng 。②GENERAL TRAINING( yi ban pei xun lei ) ce chong ping gu zai guang fan she hui jiao yu huan jing xia de ji ben sheng cun ji neng 。 ben lei xing shi yong qu ying yu guo jia wan cheng zhong deng jiao yu 、 huo qu gong zuo jing li 、 shen jia fei xue li pei xun de ying shi zhe yi ji yi min shen qing zhe 。
hua wei ying yu yu yan ce shi (WELT)
hua wei ying yu yu yan ce shi (Warwick English Language Test， ji WELT) shi yong lai kao cha xue sheng de ying yu yu yan shi yong neng li de zong he xing ce shi 。 ta zui zao you ying guo ding ji ming xiao hua wei da xue chuang ban ， you ying guo kao shi wei yuan hui de zhuan ye yu yan jiao shi she ji ti mu 。 you yu qi she ji de ke xue xing he yan jin xing ， xian zai ta yi cheng wei chu ya si 、 tuo fu kao shi wai ， bei ying guo da xue guang wei ren ke de kao shi zhi yi 。 ying guo ming xiao hua wei da xue ju ban de hua wei ying yu yu yan ce shi (WELT) shou dao ying guo 12 suo ming xiao de ren ke 。 shen qing zhe xie xue xiao de xue sheng ， ru guo mei you shi jian shen jia ya si kao shi ， wan quan ke yi shen jia mei yue yi qi de hua wei ying yu kao shi lai dai ti ya si kao shi 。
tuo fu (TOEFL)
TOEFL(Test of English as a Foreign Language--- zuo wei wai yu de ying yu kao shi ) shi you mei guo jiao yu kao shi fu wu chu (Educational Testing Service) ju ban de wei shen qing qu mei guo huo ru yan jiu sheng yuan xue xi de fei ying yu guo jia xue sheng ti gong de yi zhong ying yu shui ping kao shi 。 mu qian ， zai ying guo de xu duo da xue zhong ， tuo fu cheng ji yu ya si ju you tong deng de xiao li 。 dan dui yu ying guo de yuan xiao lai shuo ， shou xian de huan shi ya si ， yin ci jian yi shen qing ren zui hao zai shen qing yuan xiao shi neng ti gong ya si cheng ji 。
ge yuan xiao zi ji zu zhi de ce shi
1、University of Glamorgon： ru guo xue sheng mei you ya si 、 tuo fu cheng ji ， ke yi zhi jie shen jia xue xiao zi ji de ce shi 。 qi xiao li ke yi deng tong ya si yong yu qian zheng 。
2、University of Middlesex： xue xiao mei nian dou zai guo nei zu zhi ce shi ， fang bian shen qing gai da xue de xue sheng 。
3、Bellerbys College： gai xue yuan you ben ke yu ke ji yan jiu sheng yu ke ke cheng 。 xue sheng ke yi shen jia xue yuan de ce shi ， yong yu qian zheng 。
4、University of Northumbia： nuo sang bi ya da xue shi zui shou zhu mu de xin da xue ， lian xu ji nian dou shou dao jiao yu bu men de jia jiang 。 gai da xue zu zhi de yu yan ce shi ji jiang zai 5 yue jin xing 。【原文】【汉音对照】

Co quan An ninh dieu tra vua de nghi truy to Ho Tran Lap cung cac dong pham ve toi trom cap tai san. Theo ket luan dieu tra hom 24/4, bon chung da cau ket voi mot nguoi My su dung thiet bi vien thong ket noi qua dien thoai di dong, de nhan dien dam tu My ve, gay that thu cho buu dien Viet Nam.
Ho Tran Lap, sinh nam 1955, tru tai pho Nguyen Binh Khiem, Ha Noi, Pho giam doc Cong ty Thuong mai du lich quoc te Hoang Ha. Lap va Wilson Jeffery Dale (ten thuong goi la Jeff) cung mot so nguoi thiet lap mot he thong lien lac quoc te tu My ve Viet Nam. Ngay 24/4/2000, he thong nay bi co quan chuc nang phat hien, Lap cung dong bon bi khoi to.
Ngay 10/12/2000, dang la bi can cua vu an tren, Lap bay vao TP HCM cung Jeff ban mot phi vu lam an khac. Jeff thong bao co mot he thong tai cac cuoc goi tu My ve Viet Nam dac biet, khong can ket noi voi may thue bao co dinh ma chi can simcard cua dien thoai di dong. Chung ban bac va thoa thuan: Jeff chiu toan bo chi phi de mua thiet bi tu My ve Viet Nam lap dat, thanh toan cuoc va tra luong 3.000-5.000 USD/thang cho Lap; Lap to chuc thue dia diem, mua simcard so luong lon
Ngoai Ha Noi, Dao Huu Ke, Pham Vinh Cam va Luong Dinh Chien nhan mua giup Lap voi dieu kien duoc huong 300.000 dong/simcard moi thang. Co trong tay khoang gan 300 simcard (rieng tu Chien la 250 chiec), Lap thue ngoi nha tren duong Nguyen Trong Tuyen, quan Tan Binh, TP HCM, lam "van phong chi nhanh cong ty Hoang Ha". Tai day, Jeff va Lap cung mot so chuyen gia lap dat thiet bi vien thong chuyen tu My ve. Jeff tin rang, voi cong nghe hien dai nay cac chuyen gia vien thong cua Viet Nam khong the phat hien duoc. Khi cong trinh hoan thanh, theo chi dao cua Jeff, Lap thue Dinh Tien Son den bao tri thiet bi voi muc luong 200 USD/thang. Cu moi tuan he thong nay su dung 72 simcard khac nhau de so tien cuoc hang thang cua moi simcard khong qua lon, gay nghi ngo cho buu dien.
Trong 4 thang he thong nay di vao hoat dong (thang 1-4/2001), tu My, Jeff da 12 lan chuyen tien cho Lap, tong cong gan 450.000 USD. Tru tien nha, thue nhan vien, va chi phi khac, so tien con gan 120.000 USD, Lap chuyen lai ve My cho Jeff.
Dau thang 4/2001, he thong bi set danh va Jeff thue ky su tin hoc Christopher Edward Rodrriguez sang Viet Nam sua chua. Chieu 24/4/2001, trong khi dang hi huc khac phuc su co chung bi cong an phat hien, bat qua tang.
Trong vu nay, do Christopher Edward Rodriguez sang Viet Nam sua chua thue ma khong he biet day la viec pham phap, nen anh ta duoc tra ve nuoc sau khi tu nguyen nop 100.000 USD. Con Lap, khi vu viec bi phat hien da bo ra 65.000 USD de tron sang My. Ngay 16/1/2002, Lap ve nuoc va ra dau thu. Con Jeff thi da bo tron khoi noi o tai My, cong an Viet Nam dang nho canh sat nuoc ban truy na ten nay.

English Lam Dik A Pawimawh - Michael Lalmanzuala
Khawvel ram pum huapin LANGUAGE FAMILY a awm a. Chu’ng zinga a lian pahnihnte chu Indo-European leh Sino-Tibetan an ni a. Saptawng kan tih ho leh India ram tawng, Sanskrit, Hindi etc te hi Indo-European Family-a mi an ni a. Chinese, Tibetan leh khawchhak lam tawng tam ber hi Sino-Tibetan Family-a mi an ni.
He thu ka han post chhan ber chu thisen zawmpui mihringin inanna leh inhnaihna tam tak kan nei ang thova Language Family-a awmhote chuan inanna tak an nei a, a danga mite nen chuan inhlatna tak an nei tih kan hriatthiam a tulna hi a ni.
English hmang leh Hindi hmangte chu ‘family’ khat an nih avangin tawng an inzirtawnsakin lamrik (‘pronunciation’/ ’accent’) danah harsatna an nei vak lo va; Chinese hmangin English a zir chuan a thiam chin chinah pawh lamrik danah harsatna a nei thin. Mizote hian Chinese zir ta ila, kan thiam chin chinah, Family khata mi kan nih avangin, lamrik danah harstatna kan nei lo tluk a ni a. English emaw Hindi emaw kan zir chuan Family hrang daih an nih avangin, lamrik danah harsatna kan nei nasa hle thung a ni.
Chuvang chuan English emaw, Hindi emaw lamrik dan dik thiam nana a tangkai ber chu, heng tawng hmangtu, a lamrik dan dik tak hmangte tawng hriat fo hi a ni. Dik tak chuan English lamrik dan dik chu kan lamrik thin dan, a bikin ‘accent’ chu, a in ‘opposite’ a ni deuh ngawt mai. Philosophy te hi a lamrik dan dik, ‘lo’ lai tihsan a nih laiin keini chuan kan tihniam tlat thin; Mechanic pawh ‘cha’ hi a sang lai tur a nih laiin kan tihniam tlat thin, chutiang deuh zel chu a ni mai.
IAS ka zawm khan hun rei tak chhung chu, ka thianten ka tawng an hrethiam lo va, ‘Ha, ha,.... I beg your pardon’ min tihkhum fo maia, a ninawmin a zahthlak viau thin a ni. English hi ka thiam ta viau e, ka tihna ni lovin tun hnu-ah hi chuan thian kawmten an zir vang leh BBC te ngaithla chamchi ka nih avangin hnam dangten ka tawng hriatthiam loh an nei ngai tawh zen zen lo.
He thil pawimawh tak mai kan kalpui dan hi a fuh lo hle a. Delhi, Mubai, Kolkota, Chennai, Bangaluru te-a zir chhuak ngat pawh English lamrik dan dika hmang an la tam lo khawp mai. MPSC Chairman ka nih lai te khan candidate te hnenah he thil ka ngaih pawimawhzia hi ka hrilh fo tawh thin a ni.
He thil pawimawh tak maia min tithuanawptu ber chu kan kalna apianga, ‘Welfare Committee’, ‘Mizo Service’ kan dinzel a; chutianga inhman chu Mizo tawh phawt tan chuan “Compulsory” ti tiha kan ngai tlat zel hi a ni. Biak in pangngaia inkhawm chu, thian inzawnna leh insiamna tha tak a ni a. Chutiang thiante atang chuan tawng leh a lamrik dan dik bakah an hnamzia te kan zir theiin kan hnamzia tehreng pawh kan hriattir ve theihna tha tak a ni. Hnam dang thiana kan neih tlat loh chuan an tawng leh an hnamzia te chu hriat vak ngaihna a awm lo a ni.
Tun thlenga Assembly House, Biak in, Seminar, TV/Radio te-a thusawi leh thupuangtuten English/Hindi tawng tlanglawn tak tak leh mi lar tak takte hming an lam dik lo fote hi chu a zahthlak a. Zirlaite leh mi dang ngaithlatute lam dan leh thil dik lo an “zirtir” thinna-ah phei hi chuan hnam pawi an sawi a ni ti ila kan sawisual tampui lo vang. Tih tak tak tumna leh duhna kan neih hi a hun tawh tak meuh a ni. Kan lam ve dan a ni mai alawm, tih ngawt hi a tha lo va. A lamdan dik leh a nihna dik hria, hnamdang leh keimahni zinga mite ngaihhniam chu kan hlawh lo thei si lo a ni.
Hetiang thila min tithuanawptu a nih bakah kan inhung hrang lutuk hian that lohna dang pawh a nei. Mahni-a kan awm hian midang mitmei ven tur awm loh vang tein kawng tam takah insum tulna hun leh hmuna insum lohna te kan neih phah a. India ram khawpui thenkhata ‘Mizo Service’ kan neihna thin biak in pathum chu, a chhehvel, meizial bung, kuhva chinai etc-a kan tihbawlhhlawh lutuk avanga, a neitu/enkawltuten kan hmanzui an phal tawh loh a ni. Hetiang thil zahthlak tak te hi kan sawi chhuah duh vak loh a nih avangin mi tam takina kan hriat loh a ni.
Mizoram pawnah te ka awm reiin ka zin veivak tam tawh bawk a, hnam dang thian hi ka nei ve nual a. A tlangpui thuin thian rinawm tak tak an ni fur zawk. Chandigarh-a ka thian tha tak phei chuan, a tana engmah tih theih ka nei lo chungin tun kum 30 vel chhung hian thla khatah vawi khat tal chu ‘phone’-in min la rawn be ziah thin. Mamawh ka neih changin min tihsak ziah bawk thin. Kan zia leh kan nihna dik tak kan inhriattawn avangin inhnuai ena inchung en kan awm ngai lo va, ang khatah kan inngai a ni.
Kan mimal zia hre pha si lo, hnam dang chawmhlawma awm kan nih chin chiah hria te hi chuan min ngaihsan vak ngaihna a awm lo va. Chuvang chuan hnam dang ngaihsan nih kan duh chuan an zia te, kan zia te, kan nihna dik tak leh an nihna dik tak kan inhriattawnsak a ngai a. Chutiang a nih loh chuan min phek hmuhhniam lo thei lo si a, chu chu tuna kan nihna hi a ni tlat a ni.
Thliarkar rilru kalsana, Rilru-a thanlen hi kan mamawh tak a nih thu ka sawinawn leh ni rawh se.

Nhieu to ong rung tren cay cao (Anh minh hoa)
Truoc do, vao khoang 12h, ngay 25/6, ong Nguyen Viet Toan (SN 1955), tru tai thon Thuong Loi, xa Quang Loc, huyen Can Loc (Ha Tinh) cung nhom nguoi cung que treo len cay cao lay mat ong, tai mot khu rung thuoc tinh Pu-Li Kham -Xay (Lao), khong may Toan bi ong rung dot, roi xuong dat va tu vong.
Sau khi vu viec xay ra, nhom nguoi di cung da dua thi the ong Toan ve que, de to chuc mai tang.
Nhan duoc tin bao, chieu ngay 26/6, chinh quyen dia phuong xa Quang Loc da den tham hoi, dong vien gia dinh dinh nan nhan.
Duoc biet, gan day nhieu nguoi dan xa Quang Loc, huyen Can Loc va cac xa lan can co phong trao ru nhau sang Lao lay mat ong rung mang ve ban. Tuy nhien, khong it nguoi trong so do tung bi ong dot de lai nhieu di chung nghiem trong tren co the.

Ke cuong sat tren deo Hai Van - Tin phap luat
Ke cuong sat tren deo Hai Van
Ke cuong sat tren deo Hai VanTags: Da Nang, Phu Loc, Loc Hai, Phuong Hoang, Thua Thien - Hue, nhan vien duong sat, Canh Sat Co Dong, Deo Hai Van, cong an xa, nguoi dan ong, da xay ra, Lang Co, ve phia, ga Bấm ngay Subscribe / Đăng Ký xem video hay mới nhất >> Deo Hai Van xua. Nhung duong deo noi tieng nhu: Hai Van, Phuong Hoang, deo Ngang... gan 10 nam truoc da xay ra nhieu vu an cuop cua, giet nguoi ghe ron tren xe khach, xe tai... Deo Hai Van la ranh gioi noi tinh Thua Thien Hue voi TP. Da Nang (truoc day thuoc tinh Quang Nam - Da Nang). Duong deo noi tieng khong chi voi nguoi dan trong nuoc ma ca voi du khach quoc te tren con duong xuyen Viet. Dia danh nay duoc biet den voi ten goi “de nhat hung quan”. Thoat chet tren chuyen xe bi cuop 9 gio sang 16-4-1992, tru so Cong an xa Loc Hai, huyen Phu Loc, tinh Thua Thien - Hue, nam cach cau Lang Co 500m ve phia bac, don vi khach la nguoi dan ong trac tuoi trung nien, dang nguoi nho be, bo mat hot hai. Anh ta noi tung tieng dut quang: “Toi la nan nhan cua mot vu cuop cua giet nguoi vua xay ra tren deo Hai Van”. Anh Le Van Cung - Pho cong an xa Loc Hai - voi lai gan, om bo vai nguoi khach va noi: “Anh den duoc day la tot roi. Anh cu binh tinh ke lai su viec. Chung ta phai som vao cuoc keo hung thu chay thoat”. Nguoi khach tu khai ten Nguyen Van Phung, 35 tuoi, phu xe xe tai BS: 77H-2376, la ke duy nhat con song sot trong so bon nguoi hien dien tren chuyen xe kinh hoang vua bi mot ga qua giang tham sat bang sung ngan. Y gay an vi muon cuop tui tien cua ba chu xe. Vua den hien truong, canh tuong ban dau hien ra khien luc luong CA that kinh: ba xac chet bi ban ha o ba vi tri khac nhau cach deo Hai Van 3km ve phia bac. Xac chet dau tien la mot phu nu trac tuoi 40, nam duoi doc, cach chiec xe tai dang do chung 20m. Xac chet thu hai la mot thanh nien ngoai 30, nam vat qua cua xe, dau cam xuong dat nhung mot ban chan con mac lai dinh cung trong ban dap thang xe. Xac chet thu ba la mot nguoi dan ong tuoi ngoai 30, nam cach chiec xe hon 100m ve phia tren doc. Nhan tin bao, Ban giam doc cong an tinh khan truong dien bao cho Tong cuc Canh sat nhan dan - Bo Noi vu (nay la Bo Cong an) va duoc chi dao: bang moi gia phai bat cho duoc hung thu kip thoi de tran an du luan va giai toa duong deo Hai Van boi sap co chuyen xe cho doan khach quoc te Cong hoa lien bang Duc di qua. Moi chi dao duoc ban hanh, huy dong cac luc luong canh sat hinh su - dieu tra, kinh te, giao thong, bo doi bien phong, Cong an huyen Phu Loc, Cong an xa Loc Hai va dan quan du kich vao cuoc. Dong thoi, Tong cuc Canh sat dien bao cho Cong an tinh Quang Nam phoi hop, de phong hung thu vuot deo dao thoat ve phia nam. Chua day mot tieng sau, cuoc hanh quan truy lung ke cuong sat tren deo Hai Van da thuc su mo man. Truy lung thu pham Duoi su chi huy truc tiep cua dai ta Nguyen Hong Bang - quyen Giam doc Cong an tinh Thua Thien - Hue, toan bo luc luong pha an da co mat o nhung noi can thiet nhat. Thoi diem do, mang DTDD chua phu song den deo Hai Van, ngay ca chiec DTDD cung chua duoc dung pho bien vi gia tri kinh te cao, chi co cac vi lanh dao moi duoc trang bi nen viec tap hop, chi dao, bao cao moi dien bien tinh hinh cua cac thanh vien trong Ban chuyen an deu duoc tinh toan ky cang. Ten cuop co sung, neu bi don den duong cung rat co the han se ban tra lai luc luong truy bat va lieu chet. Song, muc tieu cao nhat van la phai bat song duoc han de lam sang to vu an. Tong cong gan 200 chien si CA, bo doi, dan quan du kich deo bam moi phuong huong kha nghi. Bang su day dan kinh nghiem trong nghiep vu, Ban chuyen an nhan dinh mot cach chinh xac: doi tuong dang lan tron o phia bac deo Hai Van, co kha nang cho dem toi se mo xuong Lang Co de tron thoat bang duong sat. Theo cung cap ban dau cua nguoi phu xe, hung thu nguoi tam thuoc, cao khoang 1,6m, noi giong nua Nam nua Bac, mai toc dom bac, mac ao quan bo doi, khong deo quan ham, di chan dat... Mot to trinh sat mang theo nhung chu cho danh hoi that tinh khon, duoc huan luyen thuan thuc. Tat ca khap khoi mung tham voi y nghi sap sua truc dien voi doi tuong. Nhung truoc mat cac anh la mot bo suoi. Nhung chu khuyen cu nhung nhang, sua vang ve phia truoc. Tinh huong nay duoc bao voi Ban chuyen an. Hung thu da vuot suoi. Chac chan han dang lan mo xuong chan deo. Thieu uy Dinh Nhu Phuong thuoc Phong Canh sat co dong Cong an tinh Thua Thien - Hue duoc phan cong lam To truong cung voi hai chien si Le Hai Nam va Hoang Van Huong tang cuong chot giu ga Lang Co, phoi hop voi Pho cong an xa Loc Hai Le Van Cung boc ky khu vuc duong sat nay. Troi da nga ve chieu, roi bong toi bao trum. Theo chi dao, anh Phuong tranh thu gap can bo, cong nhan vien duong sat de ban bac, ho tro khi can thiet. Gan 21 gio (12 gio sau khi vu an xay ra), con hai doan tau sap tien vao ga, anh Phuong phan cong hai chien si Nam va Huong chot giu cac diem kha nghi gan chan nui, Pho cong an xa Le Van Cung chot giu phia sau ga, con anh linh hoat di chuyen de kip thoi nam bat moi dien bien. Them ga Lang Co van vang lang, cuoc song o mot ga xep that buon te. Chi khi co doan tau dung banh, du thoi gian ngan ngui, voi vang, san ga moi ron len nhung am thanh vui nhon duoc it phut. Tu xa, tieng coi tau hu len tung hoi nhu danh thuc niem vui moi. Tieng banh xe ham thang nghien tren duong ray, tieng hanh khach lao xao xen lan voi tieng moi chao cua nhung nguoi ban hang rong di doc theo cac toa tau... 21 gio, mot doan tau cho hang sap ghe lai. Nhung anh den dau leo let duoc thap len. Anh sang vang vot, nhat nhoa chi du nhin ro nhung mon qua re tien nam tren nhung chiec met cua nguoi ban hang rong. Vai nguoi phu nu sap voi nhung xau banh chung, banh u, nhung qua quyt va nhung bao thuoc la roi sap ngua di ve phia nha ga. Dem nay, ga Lang Co co mot cai gi do khac la hon, tat ca nhu chim ngap trong mot su doi cho hoi hop lan lo au cua nhung nguoi dang am tham giang luoi... Tu mot vi tri cach ga Lang Co chung 50m, noi duong tau chay ngang qua, co mot xom nha an hien sau nhung lum cay ram rap. Co Nguyen Thi Loan (SN 1974) dang bung ro hang qua chuan bi ra ga de ban cho hanh khach tren chuyen tau sap den. Bat thinh linh co Loan phat hien co mot nguoi dan ong dang lom khom sau mot lum cay. Qua anh den dau tren tay, co thay ga mac do bo doi, mang tren vai tui xach, tay ga xach them mot tui cang phong nua. Co thoang nghi chac nguoi nay nhay tau tron ve, sau mot thoang giat minh, co Loan hoi: “Chu don tau di dau?”. Ga dan ong tra loi bang cai giong nua Nam nua Bac, han hoc: “Tao don tau di Da Nang, may hoi lam chi, cut di!”. Thay thai do bat thuong, du ton cua ga dan ong, co Loan voi va buoc di. Chang biet ga co dieu gi buc boi ma thai do kho ua den the. Truoc khi di, co Loan con ngoai lai nhin han ta lan chot. Trong bong toi, co Loan nhin ro han vua xoc lai chiec tui tren vai, mot tay luon vao that lung sua lai vat gi do. Bat giac co Loan nghi den ke cuong sat tren deo Hai Van sang nay ma tat ca nguoi dan va ho hang trong vung nay da duoc nghe can bo CA thong bao, co quyet dinh phai bao ngay voi nhung nguoi huu trach ve viec nay. Di voi vao ga, co tim gap anh Tuong - nhan vien duong sat ga Lang Co. To Canh sat co dong cua thieu uy Dinh Nhu Phuong tiep nhan nguon tin mot cach than trong va nhanh chong phac thao ke hoach tac chien mot cach khan truong. Anh de nghi anh Tuong cam den long di doc theo tuyen duong sat nguoc ve phia nam, noi ga dan ong la mat dang dung, gia vo nhu nhan vien duong sat dang kiem tra duong ray truoc khi tau den. Con Phuong va Cung lang le men theo bong toi, bam sat dang sau yem tro. Tuong buoc ra khoi nha ga nhu ke hoach. Anh di cham rai, cam den long soi vao duong ray, ra soat su co de chuan bi don doan tau di ngang qua. Anh lam viec mot cach tu nhien va binh than. Vai phut sau, anh da cham mat voi ga dan ong la mat: Anh di mo do? Van cai giong nua Nam nua Bac, ga dan ong dap lai: Toi la can bo, di Da Nang mua gao cho don vi dong o Kon Tum. Tuong tien toi, doi dien voi han roi noi voi ve quan tam: Tau sap den roi. Anh cu vao ga cho mot lat. Dung o day lam gi cho moi chan. Truc dien hung thu Ga dan ong lang le buoc vao ga. Doi mat lao lien, sac lem quet tia nhin bon huong. Thinh thoang ga ngo lai phia sau, canh giac truoc moi dong tinh. Quan sat thai do cua ga, thieu uy Phuong cang tin rang ke thu ac dang o can ke. Anh xuat trinh the nganh CA, noi ro nhiem vu cua minh va de nghi ga cho kiem tra giay to. Ga dan ong lung lung dua ra mot giay cong tac da het han vao ngay 30-11-1991 nhung duoc cao sua mot cach vung ve thanh nam 1992, mang ten Do Thanh Dao, SN 1954. Thay giay to cua ga cao sua lem nhem, Phuong yeu cau duoc kiem tra CMND, ga dan ong lon tieng day ve thach thuc: Cac anh khong duoc quyen kiem tra giay to cua toi. Toi khong lam gi pham phap ca. Neu toi bi cham tre chuyen cong tac, cac anh se bi mat viec day! Bang kinh nghiem tich luy duoc tu nhung lan doi dau voi du loai toi pham qua cac don vi ma anh tung phuc vu, Phuong linh cam ga chinh la doi tuong da gay toi ac. Ga dan ong cung vua nhan ra minh da lot vao vong nguy hiem nen dat hai tui xach xuong de ranh tay thu the. Phuong ap sat vao ga o mot cu ly de dang: Anh mang gi trong hai tui xach nay? Tien. Bao nhieu? Muoi bay trieu dong. Phuong lai hoi: Anh mang theo nhieu tien the de lam gi? Toi mang tien ve xuoi mua gao cho don vi. Toi da noi cac anh khong duoc quyen kiem tra vi toi la can bo. Dung ep toi phai phan ung. Khong nao nung, Phuong yeu cau den phong lam viec cua nha ga, ga dan ong tiep tuc lon tieng, chong doi lai nhung yeu cau cua to canh sat co dong. Bat ngo ga cui nguoi xuong, tay phai thoc ra phia sau that lung, noi giau khau K59 (trong co 8 vien dan) va quyet dinh hanh dong... Doi mat khong roi bat cu mot dong tinh nao cua ga dan ong, Phuong da nhanh hon ga mot dong tac. Anh chop manh canh tay phai cua ga, be quat ra sau va tuoc khau sung. Anh ra lenh khong che va cong tay ga dan ong truoc khi han bat ngo khuyu xuong. Tai co quan dieu tra, ga dan ong khai ten Nguyen Thanh Dao (SN 1954, tai Tho Lap, Tho Xuan, Thanh Hoa) co vo va hai con hien dang cu tru tai Da Nang. Ga chinh la thu pham gay ra vu giet nguoi cuop tai san tren duong deo Hai Van ngay 16-4-1992. Nan nhan cua ga gom: anh Nguyen Xuan Hoa - lai xe, Nguyen Xuan Cuong - em ruot anh Hoa, Nguyen Thi Mai - chu hang, tat ca deu thuong tru tai Phu My, Phu Cat, Binh Dinh. Vu an dien bien nhu sau: chiec xe tai BS: 77H-2376 duoc ba Mai hop dong cho gao tu Binh Dinh ra Thanh Hoa mot tuan truoc do. Sau khi ban het gao, ba Mai mua lai 10 tan xi-mang Bim Son. So tien con lai la 14,5 trieu dong. Xe trua 15-4-1992, xe di ngang qua song Hieu Giang de vao thi xa Dong Ha thi gap ten Dao vay xe xin qua giang ve Da Nang. Ba Mai noi voi lai xe dung lai cho ga di nho keo toi. Xe di qua Quang Tri roi TP. Hue, ba Mai da nhieu lan mo tui xach dung tien ra lay mot it tieu vat roi can than cat lai. Ba khong ngo tat ca da lot vao mat cua ke cuop. Den 19 gio cung ngay, xe den thi tran cua huyen Phu Loc thi bi hong. Dao nhieu lan noi voi ba Mai va tai xe la co gang let ve Lang Co de sua xe va ga se tim cho cho ba Mai ban xi-mang voi gia cao, vua duoc loi vua nhe xe de tiep tuc doan duong con lai. Dem do, tat ca cung ngu lai huyen Phu Loc. Sang som hom sau xe tiep tuc di chuyen den Lang Co thi dung lai an sang. Von tinh hao phong, lai do ga gioi thieu la bo doi ve tham nha, ba Mai vui ve cho di nho xe khong lay tien con bao an uong, mua cho ga mot bao thuoc Jet. Khi chi con cach dinh deo Hai Van 3km, chiec xe gam ru, bo cham chap len doc cao, ga ac tam da ra tay cuong sat an nhan cua minh sau khi vua ra lenh cho xe ngung lai vua nha dan vao nguoi lai xe. Bi trung dan, tai xe ru tay lai, co truon nguoi qua cua xe de chay thoat nhung khong con kip nua, chiec xe tap vao vach nui. Ba Mai hoang hot mo cua xe nhay xuong chay ve phia chan deo nhung buoc chan linh quinh, bi han na dan tu phia sau xuyen nguc, ba chay them duoc it buoc nua thi guc chet duoi doc. Em ruot cua lai xe la Nguyen Xuan Cuong co chay thoat len dinh deo nhung cung bi han ban ha. Rieng anh phu xe Nguyen Van Phung do da nhay xuong gan banh xe, de phong xe truot doc, thay ten Dao ha thu nguoi cua minh da nhanh chan bo chay nguoc xuong chan deo. Dao co ban theo nhung anh da may man thoat chet... Nua nam sau do, ngay 14-10-1992 TAND tinh Thua Thien - Hue mo phien toa luu dong tuyen ke sat nhan Nguyen Thanh Dao an tu hinh. Voi ban tinh li lom va biet chac khong con duong khoan dung, ga viet don de nghi som duoc chet de khoi bi am anh toi loi cua minh. Nha vuon 2 tang 85m2, Thiet ke nha vuon dep - Kien Truc
Nha vuon 2 tang 85m2, Thiet ke nha vuon dep - Kien Truc 8/10 792 danh gia Cong ty gop y kien thiet ke Kien truc - Noi that - Xay dung hoat dong chuyen nghiep ve cac cong trinh nha dan dung: biet thu, nha lo pho, nha vuon va can ho chung cu
Mau nha dep Thiet ke nha vuon - Kien truc	Nha vuon 3 tang tai Thanh Tri Thiet ke nha vuon tai Phu Tho Nha vuon 2 tang 85m2 Nha vuon dep o con lang que Viet 8 mau thiet ke nha vuon 2015 Mau biet thu vuon dep 2015 Kien truc nha vuon tai Hue Mau nha vuon 1 tang ly tuong Tong hop mau biet thu vuon 2t Biet thu nha vuon dep ly tuong Biet thu nha vuon dong que Mau thiet ke nha vuon hien dai Thiet ke nha vuon dep 1 tang Mau nha vuon dep o nong thon Tong hop mau nha vuon dep Thiet ke biet thu nha vuon Thiet ke nha vuon tai Thach That Thiet ke nha vuon tai Phu Tho Thiet ke nha vuon dep Thiet ke nha vuon anh Son Thiet ke nha vuon 2 tang Thiet ke nha vuon 1 tang Hoa Binh Nha vuon 2 tang hinh L Thiet ke nha vuon nho 2 tang Biet thu nha vuon 2 tang Khai niem ve nha vuon Trang chu » Thiet ke nha vuon » Nha vuon 2 tang 85m2	Thiet ke nha vuon 2 tang 85m2 tai Long BienTren khu dat 271m2 giap de Song Hong hien trang con la 2 ngoi nha cap 4 1 de o va 1 de con lam ve sinh va bep cua gia dinh anh Quyet. Sau khi cat 41m2 ban gia chu quyet dinh thue KTu van thiet ke nha vuon cao 2 tang dien tich 1 tang khoang 85m2 de phu hop voi khoan dau tu 800 trieu cua gia dinh anh. Gia dinh anh 3o gon 6 nguoi voi 2 bo me tren 70 nam sinh va 2 vo chong, 2 dua con nho duoi 5 nam sinh len anh can co 3 phong ngu, 1 phong khach, 1 phong sinh hoat chung va phong an ket hop voi bep nau khep kin. Cac dien tich phong anh muon co nho toi da de tiet kiem kinh phi xay dung do con lang truong phai ngoi nha phai dep mat va sang trong. Tra phong thuy nam sinh cua anh Pham Minh Quyet do con la sau:– Nam sinh duong lich: 1980– Nam am lich : Canh Than– Ngu hanh(ban menh): Thach luc Moc tuc Cay luu da– Que menh(trach menh): Khon Tho– Huong tot: Tay Bac (Phuoc Duc); Dong Bac (Sinh Khi); Tay Nam (Phuc Vi); Tay (Thien Y)– Huong xau: Bac (Tuyet Menh); Dong (Hoa Hai); Dong Nam (Ngu Quy); Nam (Luc Sat)Thiet ke nha vuon 2 tang dien tich 85m2Khu dat co mat tien nhin ra duong de con la huong tay nam do do co the mo cua 9h ve huong do ben canh do con co the mo 1 cua phia tay bac de nhin ra vuon phia canh nha. Bo cuc mat bang ngoi nha theo hinh chu T voi khoi giua nho ra tao ra khoi cho ngoi nha. Mat bang ngoi nha dep chuan bi xep do con la sau:Tang 1 ngoi nha dep kieu nha vuon co dien tich 84,5m2 voi 2 sanh tiep can boi nha con khoang san phia tay phai. Sanh 9h nhin ra duong de phia truoc voi sanh co mai doc va 3n cong nho ra can nang huong tay nam. Sanh phu phia tay bac nhin ra vuon cung con la loi di 9h tuong lai cua gia dinh. Phong khach rong 27m2 chuan bi xep bo ban ghe go dong ki vao giua trung tam phong tao ra su sang trong, trang nghiem. Phia sau phong khach con la phong ngu cua 2 bo me gia chu rong 15m2 co cua mo nhin sang cau thang va tieu canh nuoc gam thang. Phia cuoi nha con la phong an rong 18m2, bep chuan bi xep nhin ve tay nam – cung phuc vi va dat tai 9h dong chan cung hoa hai. Khu ve sinh dat tai cuoi nha chan cung hoa hai rong 3,5m2. Khu bep duoc dua ve cuoi nha boi yeu cau cua cac cu gia trong nha vi khong muon o sau bep.Tang 2 con la mot noi sinh hoat cua gia dinh nho cua anh Quyet tong hop 2 phong ngu cho 2 vo chong va phong ngu nho cho 2 con nho, phia truoc con la phong sinh hoat chung nho rong 20m2 co cua di ra 3n cong phia truoc. Phong ngu anh Quyet rong 18m2 co ve sinh rieng tong 3,5m2. Phong ngu nho dung chung ve sinh voi phong SHC.Thiet ke nha vuon 2 tang dien tich 85m2 – Mat bangDo nha co mai doc cao len KTu van gop y kien gia chu con lam them 1 nhip cau thang de tan dung phan mai cao con lam tang ap mai de co the chuan bi xep gian tho va phong ngu nho cho khach khi can. Tu tang ap mai co loi ra san sau nha de phoi do.Thiet ke nha vuon 2 tang dien tich 85m2 – Phoi canh gocKien truc ngoi nha vuon mang phong thuc hien viec nam bo voi cac vom cong mem mai, nhin phia truoc ngoi nha tuong hinh chu L do con lang nhin ngang con la hinh chu T. Triet san roi van co the mang thai Tags: bien phap tranh thai, ong dan tinh, ong dan trung, khong phai la, nguoi dan ong, triet san, co the, tinh trung, phu nu, bac si, mang thai, cat, nam, chong, con
Phau thuat noi lai ong dan tinh o BV BInh dan. Anh: Thanh Nien.
Triet san nam va nu khong phai la bien phap tranh thai hieu qua tuyet doi. Gan day co mot phu nu da triet san 3 nam bong dung om nghen, mot phu nu khac cung co bau du ong chong da "that" gan 8 nam nay.
Cat - cot ong dan tinh (Vasectomy) la phuong phap triet san o nam nham ngan chan tinh trung tu noi chung duoc sinh ra (tinh hoan) di tim gap trung. Con cot - cat ong dan trung (Pomeroy) la phuong phap triet san nu nham cat duong di cua trung, khien no khong den buong tu cung - noi trung va tinh trung "hen ho".
Theo bac si Nguyen Thanh Nhu, Truong don vi Nam khoa Benh vien Binh Dan, TP HCM: Co mot so ky thuat de triet san nam nhu cat - cot ong dan tinh; dung clip de kep ong dan tinh; dot hai dau ong dan tinh... Pho bien nhat o Viet Nam hien nay la cat - cot ong dan tinh. Cac bac si se lam mot tieu phau de keo ong dan tinh va cat bo di mot doan chung 1 cm, roi cot hai dau ong lai bang chi. Sau khi cat - cot, nguoi dan ong van phong tinh binh thuong khi giao hop, nhung chi la tinh dich (vi tinh dich nam chu yeu o tui tinh va tuyen tien liet; con tinh trung la o tinh hoan).
Con voi triet san o nu, theo bac si Nguyen Thi Ngoc Suong, Truong khoa Hiem muon Benh vien Phu san Hung Vuong, TP HCM: Co mot so ky thuat nhu cot va cat mot phan ong dan trung; dot dien ong dan trung; dung kep bang kim loai de kep ong dan trung... Trong do, cot - cat ong dan trung la ky thuat duoc ap dung rong rai nhat hien nay.
Cac bac si se lam mot tieu phau de keo voi trung len, cot lai thanh dang cai quai dai do 1,5 - 2 cm, roi buoc goc cua quai lai bang chi, va cat bo quai ngay gan sat cho cot.
Thuong triet san duoc ap dung cho nhung nguoi da co du con, nhat quyet khong muon co them con nua; hoac nguoi phu nu da nhieu lan sinh mo (neu mang thai nua se nguy hiem den tinh mang). Mot so quy ong di triet san vi tuong rang, cu di cot ong dan tinh, roi sau do can thiet, muon mo ra thi mo.
