The expression and potentially clinical significance of heparanase in nasopharyngeal carcinoma--《Journal of Clinical Otorhinolaryngology Head and Neck Surgery》2008年21期
The expression and potentially clinical significance of heparanase in nasopharyngeal carcinoma
ZHU Guochen1 XIAO Dajiang1 WU Sihai1 YUAN Yuan1 WANG Lijun2 L Chunjiang1(1Department of Otolaryngology, the Second People's Hospital of Wuxi, Affiliated with Nanjing Medical University, Wuxi, 214002, China; 2Department of Pathology, the Second People's Hospital of Wuxi, Affiliated with Nanjing Medical University)
Objective:To investigate the expression of heparanase in nasopharyngeal carcinoma and the relationship between the expression of it and clinically pathological features of nasopharyngeal carcinoma. Method:The expression of heparanase protein in 70 cases of nasopharyngeal carcinomas and 10 cases of normal nasopharyngeal tissues was detected by immunohistochemical staining. The date of expression combined clinical features, which included clinical stage, cervical lymph node metastasis rate, the rate of metastasis and recurrence, combination of, the 5-year survival rate, and other analysis, was analyzed.Result: The positive rate of heparanase protein in cancerous tissues was 52.9%(37/70), while it was 0% in normal nasopharyngeal tissues. The positive rates of heparanase protein in patients were 30.0%(6/20) in stage Ⅰ,45.80%(11/24) in stage Ⅱ,70.6%(12/17) in stage Ⅲ,88.9%(8/9) in stage Ⅳ respectively. Heparanase positive tumors were associated with a higher incidence of lymph node metastasis (67.4%, 31/46) than heparanase negative ones (25.0%, 6/24). The rate of distant metastasis and regional recurrence in the heparanase positive group was 48.6% (18/37), but only 15.2%(5/33) in the heparanase negative group. The cumulative survival of patients in the heparanase negative group at 5 years was 78.8%(26/33), but only 24.3%(9/37)in the heparanase positive group. The clinical stage of disease, lymph node metastasis, the rate of distant metastasis and regional recurrence of nasopharyngeal carcinoma were correlated with positive expression of heparanase protein.Conclusion:The expression of HPA was associated with invasion and metastasis and prognosis of nasopharyngeal cancer, and it may be a new target for the anti-treatment of nasopharyngeal cancer.(P0.01), and heparanase expression level inversely correlated with the patient survival (P0.01).Conclusion:Heparanase may play important roles in the invasive infiltration, metastasis, and prognosis in nasopharyngeal carcinoma, clearly indicating that heparanase is a possible target for anticancer drug development.

Chiec huy hieu Bac Ho	Chủ nhật, 16 Tháng mười hai 2007, 17:56 GMT+7	Toi den tham gia dinh Bai, thap cay nhang ngay Tet. Vat ky niem ma toi da tang Bai ngay len duong thoat ly van con day, dang nam tren ban tho anh, ben canh nhung tam huy chuong lap lanh. Chiec huy hieu bang bac anh len mau bieng biec cua thoi gian. No nhu dang tro minh va tham ke lai nhung buon, vui ma no da tung chung kien.
Nam 1961, toi len bay tuoi, nha toi cung ca lang Lai Yen Thuong bi don vao ap chien luoc.
De chuan bi cho viec don dan lap ap, bon My-Diem da khong che, bat bo du doi. Chu Hai Tan, di Sau Son va nhung nguoi nong cot khac da bi bat giam o nha lao tinh. Bac Ba, ba cua Bai cung bi bat.
Cho den khi, viec don dan ca lang Lai Yen Thuong xong, chung moi tha nhung nguoi ay ra. Bac Ba, luc ra tu tro ve nha thi than the da khong con nguyen ven nua. Bon chung da chat mat cua bac Ba mot ban tay. Tu nay, ba con lang Lai Yen Thuong goi bac Ba bang mot cai ten moi, nhu mot bang chung luon nhac nho long cam thu lu giac: Ba Cut.
Hom nha toi duoc do xuong de dua vao trong ap, toi ngoi tren chac ba cay me sau nha, can trai me non ma nuoc mat cu trao ra. Toi da nghe nhieu nguoi noi rang, khi con thu hay cai cay ma xa chu cua no, thi no nho, cu heo hat dan va chet di. Vi the, toi cu dinh ninh, nhung ngay sap toi, khi gia dinh toi phai vao song trong ap chien luoc, thi cay me cua toi cung u ru, heo ua ma kho chet di nhu loi nguoi lon noi. Ca nha chuan bi di. Ma toi giuc toi xuong doi ba lan khong duoc. Cuoi cung, chi Hai doa se bo toi lai de ma chet theo cay me luon, toi moi chiu bo ra khoi chac ba quen thuoc nhu chiec giuong ngu, tut xuong dat. Toi lung thung nhu nguoi mat hon di theo sau chiec xe bo lich kich, cho linh kinh nhung do doan cua gia dinh cung voi chiec ban tho ba toi.
Gia dinh toi bat dau cuoc song am tham trong ap chien luoc. Ma toi lam li it noi han di. Chi Hai toi, thi cung doi tinh net, hay ban gat va thuong it khi ra khoi nha. Toi chi con biet lui thui choi nhung tro choi vun vat chang thu vi ti nao voi Bai. Toi voi Bai than voi nhau tu be ti. Nhung ngay con o xom Cu, hai dua thuong leo chuyen tren nhung canh me xam xap da tay va ngu quen tren nhung chac ba.
Toi va Bai bat dau cap sach den truong “Ap Tan Sinh”. Nhung cung chi duoc bon thang sau, toi bo hoc.
Tu ngay vao truong; cu moi buoi sang, truoc khi vao lop, ca lu con nit chung toi dung thang hang, nghiem trang roi ong ong hat len bai “Suy ton Ngo Tong Thong”. Toi thay chan bai hat ay, vi khong hieu gi ca, nhung cu phai gan co ma hat that to.
Mot hom, trong gio ra choi, Bai keo toi ra sau truong roi hoi nho:
- Nay, may co biet Ngo Tong Thong la ai khong? Toi tra loinhu hoc thuoc long:
- Ngo Tong Thong la chi si cach mang, la nguoi da … da …
- Khong phai! – No het len ngat loi toi mot cach dot ngot va gian du - Ngo Tong Thong la nguoi da giet ba may va chat tay ba tao trong tu, bat ca nha may, nha tao vao ap song kho cuc. May nghe chua?
Toi chup tay no, hot hoang:
- Sao may biet? Ai noi voi may?
- Ba tao noi voi tao hoi toi nay.
Ai chu bac Ba Cut noi la toi tin ngay. Bac Ba la nguoi than tin nhat cua gia dinh toi tu ngay ba toi mat.
Sang hom sau, khong nhu thuong le phai thuc day som de chuan bi di hoc, toi nam li tren giuong trum men kin dau. Tuong toi benh, chi Hai toi gio men so vao tran toi, hoi:
- Em benh phai khong?
- Khong! Toi vung vang.
- Vay sao em khong day di hoc?
Toi tung men ngoi day, nhin chi tran tran roi noi mot cach cuong quyet:
- Em khong them di hoc nua!
Chi toi hoi ngac nhien, ngoi xuong mep giuong, vuot toc toi roi an can hoi lai:
- Em noi cho chi nghe di, sao lai khong them di hoc?
- Tai em khong them hat suy ton Ngo Tong Thong nua!

Ban cung co the chon trang phuc nay khi di du nhung bua tiec nho tren bo bien. Cho trang phuc ngay thuong, ban co the ‘mix’ cung mu rong vanh, mot chiec tui ngoai co va lua chon chiec lac tay to ban bang chat lieu go deu phu hop. Voi phong cach thoai mai, doi sandal day bang co the mac cung voi quan ong rong trong mua he nay, trang phuc nay co uu diem thoai mai va tien loi, ban cung co the ke hop voi chiec ao khong tay don gian hoac mot chiec ao so mi rong thung thinh. 2. Cach chon sandal cao got? Sandal cao got co the phoi do rat linh hoat va thoi trang cho mua he nay. Chung lam tang ve dep goi cam, nu tinh cua ban gai cung voi do la doi chan nhu thon dai hon. Sandal cao got co the su dung o moi thoi diem ke ca ngay va toi. Truoc khi mua mot doi sandal cao got, dieu dau tien ban nen tim kieu dang gi vua phu hop voi phong cach cua minh lai mang den su thoai mai cho doi chan. Sandal cao got mang den voc dang hoan hao hon cho phai dep Cho ban ngay, ban co the phoi hop doi sadal cao got voi mot chiec quan dai cao hay mot chiec quan ong lo deu duoc. Tranh chon doi sandal co got qua cao trong truong hop cong viec cua ban phai di dung nhieu trong ca tuan. Cho buoi toi, ban hay chon mot chiec vay bo va trang suc cung voi mot chiec xac nho. Ban cung khong nen su dung qua nhieu nu trang khi phoi hop cung doi sandal cao got nay. Ban chi can diem xuyet mot vai mon nu trang nhu hoa tai va day chuyen la du de toa sang cung vay va doi sandal cua minh. Cung trong buoi toi, ban muon bien doi chan cua minh tro nen quyen ru hon, hay chon cho minh doi sandal lap lanh kim loai hoac ve dep man ma, sang trong voi chat lieu santin, co day quai dinh da lap lanh. Nhieu cach phoi voi quan ao nu tinh va goi cam voi sandal cao got Cho mot bua tiec khong may trinh trong, ban hay chon mot chiec vay ngot ngao kieu baby doll va doi sandal cao got. Tranh xa su ket hop sexy qua dang thieu tham my, ban co the chon chan vay mini-skirt la du cho bua tiec toi hoang da cua minh roi. 3. Cach chon va phoi do voi sandal? Khristian Inkuan Om Dingdan
G Khankham
Khristian inkuan om ding dan Laisiangthou in ahon sinsak leh a hon hilh dan apan sui in en leng chih ut huai i sa hi. Ei ut thu toh a mawk a om ding leh kikai mai ding na chi lou ahihman in, a hon sinsak dante sau loulou in hiai anuaia bangin i gen ding:-
I. Inkuan Milip Hih Ding: Innkuan sung milip, aneu alian, atek akhangin, inkuan sung mi khat peuhpeuh tung a hih chiat dia thu piaka om huai tuh: 'Khrist laudan siamin ki niamkhiak chiat un' chih ahi. Aneu a lian, atek a khang tung ah kibang vek a hih dia thupiak ahi. Huaiziakin kuapeuh in hiai thupiak tuh i zuih ngeingei ding ua piak ahi. Khristian i hihna ah amasa pen ding tuh- "Khrist laudamsiam," hiai in amah deihna bang a hinna, gamtatna, genna, sakna, banah Amah Khrist deihte deihpih a, a huatte huat pih ding ahi. Aban ah, "kiniamkhiak chiat ding" ahi nawn. Numeite kiniamkhiak zaw deuh ding, naupangte ki niamkhiak zaw deuh ding leng a chi kei a, ki niamkhiak chiat ding a chi zaw hi.
II. Pasal te’n Zite Tung A Ahih Dingte Uh: Inkuansunga zi nei pasal tengin zite tunga hih ding hilh in om hi. Huai tuh nelhsiah theih leh ngaisak lou a om san maimai chi leng ahikei. Mohpuakna leh thuneihna piak a omte tuh:-
1. Pasal tuh zi lutang ahi: Pasalte zite tung a lu ahihdingdan tuh - 'Khrist tuh amah ngei pumpi hondampa hi a, saptuamte lutang ahih mah bangin'. Huai toh kibang geihin pasal tuh zi lutang ahi ding ahi. Zite adingin leng pumpi hondampa ahih ding uh chihna leng ahi pah hi.
2. Pasal ten zite a it ding uh ahi: Pasalte'n zite it ding chih thu haksa abang kei. Ka it mah vele, ka mudah sam a, chih theih ding a bang, himahleh khristian pasal te zi it ding dan tuh hiai banga hilh in i om uhi:- Khrist in saptuamte a it a a sik ua a kipiak bangin leh amau pumpi a it bang mah un a it ding ua, zite lakah leng a han hatlouh ding uh' chih (Eph. 5:25,28; Kol. 3:19) ahi.
3. Vak leh kepna ah: Asiat a phat gen omlou, a hat leh zawngkhal thu leng gen om lou. Pasal zi nei kuapeuh in zite tuh vak ding, kep leh khoi a ngaihna ua leng kep ding khoi ding, bangchi bang in: Khrist in saptuamte a vak a a deihthoh bangin (Eph. 5:29).
4. Midang zite va neih khawmpih ding hilou hi: Khristiante tengteng banah Saptuam Upate ngial tuh zi khat nei ahih ding ahi. Banghang a mizi va neih khawmpih louh ding hiam - 'Pasal chih in amah zi chiat nei henla, a zi kiang ah a tan ding hunhun pia hen. Apumpi tung ah thu anei kei a azi'n thu a nei zaw hi. (1Kor. 7:2-4). Hiai thupiak Laisiangthou a om khristian ten i zahtak ding uh ahi.
5. Pasal in a zi ma kei hen: (1Kor. 7:11) Pasal tengteng tunga thupiak ananung pen lah khauh pen tuh hiai ahi. Paulam bang mah leng bawl theihna om lou, pil leh hai thu, zawn leh hauh thu, hat leh zawngkhal thu, bangmah ziak bawl in leng mak theih louh bilbel ahi mai. Pasal zi nei kuapeuh mah zi tunga mohpuakna tuh mak louh ding ahi mai hi.
III.Zite’n Pasalte Tunga Hih Dingte: Pasal ten zite tunga mohpuakna leh hih ding aneih mah bang un ziten leng pasalte tunga hih ding aneihte uh:
1. Kiniamkhiak/Kingaih niam ding: Zi ahi kha peuhmah in, pasalte sangin pilzaw, teizaw, tha hat zaw, tamloh khe zawhmah le hang leng pasalte simmoh thei vual hilou hi. Simmoh nak sangin kiniam khiak ding, kingaih niam ding chih thupiak ahi. Bang chi tuka ki niamkhiak a, bang chituka kingai niam ding: Toupa kianga na ki niamkhiak bang un, noumau pasalte kiang ah kiniamkhiak un' (Eph. 5:22). Midang pasalte kiang peuh, tangvalte kiang peuh, chi lou in Toupa laka kiniamkhiak mah bang un zite tuh BANGKIM AH a pasalte uh kiang ah kiniamkhiak uhen (Eph. 5:24). Bangkim ah chih ana hi sese zel.
2. Zahtakna leh thumanna ah: Pasalte zahtak leh thuman tuh niamna leh mi phak louhna hilouin, pilna ahi zaw hi. "Zi mah in leng apasal zahtak ding in pilvang hen" (Eph. 5:33). Zite aw noumau pasalte thu thu in om un … Sara in Abraham tuh toupa chi a, a thu thu a a om bang in (1Pet. 3:1-6). Zahtak ding dan leh thuman ding dan leng siamnel tak a hilhna in etzui ding nasan honkawk muh lai hi. Midangte pasalte thu chi lou in noumau pasalte thu thu in chih ahi hon hilh dan.
3. Numei chih in ama pasal chiat nei heh (1Kor. 7:2).
4. Zi in a pasal kiang ah a tan ding hunhun pia hen, amah pumpi tungah thu a nei kei a, a pasal in thu a nei zaw hi. (1Kor. 7:3-4).
5. Zi in a pasal khen kei heh (1Kor. 7:10). Hiai thute ngetna leh ahihtheih liai leh chih leng hilouin zuih ngeingei dia thupiak khauhtak mai ahi. Pasal nei, zi ahi kha Khristian ten i zuih pelmoh ding ua piak ahi.
IV.Tate Mohpuak: Inkuan sung ah taten leng mohpuakna lianpi nei uhi. Huaite tuh:-
1. Toupa ah nu leh pate thu man ding.
2. Nu leh pa zahtak ding (Eph. 6:1-2). Hiai thupiakte gel tom mahmah napi manpha mahmah hi. Nu leh pate apil leh hai thu, a chit leh siam thugen om louin mawl taleh leng a thu uh man a zah tak veve ding ahihna hon theisak hi. Tate peuhmahin nu leh pate thu mang in zahtak leng - ei a dia hoih ding, lei a leng damsawt ding. Nu leh pa thumang lou leh zahtak samlou i tam luat tak ziakin tuailai a si i tam hi.
V. Pate’n Tate Tunga Mohpuakna: Tate an a vak, silh leh ten guan, damlouh hun a kep teng kia hilouin, "Pate aw na tate uh hih thangpai kei unla, Toupa thuzohna ah leh hilhna ah kemzaw un" (Eph. 6:4) chih thupiak pate'n sep ding a hon hilh hi.
Khristian inkuan sung, insung boruak nuam theilou, nupa kal chidam lou, tate toh kal kilemlou chih i tam mahmah uhi. Ahangbel eite'n khristian inkuan om ding dan a thupiak i zuih khak louh ziak ana hi sek hi. Hiai a i gen, Laisiangthou in ahon sinsak dan in, inkuan om thei leng bel, teek nung na ngawn in leng Uain hoih i kem lailai ding ua, kiteen kum lah tam semsem, ngaih mel lah hoih semsem i chi thei sam ding uhi. Tuabang dingin Toupa'n a vualzawlna hon pekim chiat ta hen. Ì

Du tinh de giet nguoi cuop cua
Du tinh de giet nguoi cuop cua Tags: Nam Dinh, Ha Noi, si tinh, giet nguoi, sau khi, nha tro, giet chet, que, Viet, du, cuop, duy
- Sau khi du duoc ke si tinh ve nha, Que de cho nguoi yeu giet chet ke si tinh roi cuop het tai san dem ban.
Pham Thi Que, (sinh nam 1989, deu o xa Dai Thang, Vu Ban, Nam Dinh) va Doan Van Duy la sinh vien Truong Cao dang Cong nghiep Det may Nam Dinh, co mau thuan voi Trieu Quoc Viet, (sinh 1984, o Dong Phu, Nam My, Nam Truc, Nam Dinh).
Thay Viet deo tren nguoi lac, day chuyen va nhan vang nen Duy va Que da ban nhau tim cach dua Viet vao trong roi "xu" Viet. Duy va Que mua ruou ve, pha thuoc ngu vao ruou, cho "con moi" den.
Theo dung ke hoach da dinh, khoang 16h ngay 25/11, Que moi anh Trieu Quoc Viet den nha tro cua minh o duong Nguyen Van Troi, phuong Nang Tinh, TP. Nam Dinh choi. Tai day, Que cho Viet uong ruou co pha thuoc ngu tu truoc. Den 20h cung ngay, Duy gia vo tinh co ghe vao nha tro cua Que choi.
Thay Duy den, Que ru anh Viet bo ra ngo (cach cho tro cua Que 50m) de tam su tiep. Duy o lai nha tro, tim 1 doan tuyp sat da chuan bi, cat giau san o nha tro, den cho Que va anh Viet ngoi tam su, vut lien tiep vao dau anh Viet va bop co anh Viet cho den chet.
Sau khi da giet chet anh Viet, Duy va Que quang xac nan nhan xuong song Dao, thuoc dia phan xa Tan Thanh, Vu Ban, Nam Dinh. Xong xuoi, chung lay di chiec xe may, nhan vang, day chuyen vang, lac vang va chiec dien thoai di dong Nokia cua anh Viet.

Khi khach hang den hang an, nguoi ta se chien so lai cho dam bao do nong va dac san nay duoc dung voi tuong ot, rau bap cai muoi .

Banh hau con goi la la hau chien banh hau la dac san am thuc cuc ky than quen voi nguoi dan noi day. Khi nao can do mat do xuong de chan doan loang xuong	Thứ bảy, 15 Tháng tư 2006, 11:43 GMT+7	Do mat do xuong cho benh nhan tai Vien lao khoa
Hien nay, co hien tuong ai cung so minh bi loang xuong va o at di do do loang xuong. Tuy nhien chung ta can phai nhan thuc duoc rang bat ky phuong phap chan doan nao cung co han che cua no va co the con mang lai su ton kem ve thoi gian, tien bac va mua them su lo lang, so hai...
Tai sao lai can phai do mat do xuong de chan doan LX?
LX la tinh trang benh ly cua he thong xuong duoc dac trung boi su giam khoi luong xuong (tuc la giam mat do chat khoang cua xuong, chu yeu la canxi), ket hop voi su hu bien vi cau truc cua to chuc xuong, lam cho xuong tro nen gion va co nguy co gay xuong. Ve ly thuyet, de chan doan duoc LX phai danh gia duoc dong thoi ca hai yeu to: mat do khoang hoa cua xuong va vi cau truc xuong.
Co nhieu phuong phap de chan doan LX. Dau tien la cac phuong phap danh gia cau truc cua xuong truc tiep (qua sinh thiet xuong), hay gian tiep (dung phuong phap cong huong tu hat nhan de danh gia cau truc xuong trong khong gian ba chieu). Sinh thiet xuong de chan doan LX gay dau don, chi thuc hien duoc o xuong canh chau, nen khong the pho cap duoc. Phuong phap cong huong tu hat nhan rat dat tien nen chua the co ung dung trong lam sang, ma chi moi dung lai trong cac nghien cuu khoa hoc.
Chan doan lam sang thuong muon do LX tien trien mot cach tham lang, khong co trieu chung va chi the hien ra o giai doan muon, khi da co bien chung. Do la dau cot song do lun xep dot song, kem theo giam chieu cao, gu hay gay cac xuong dui, co tay, xuong chau, xuong suon. Cac bien chung nay doi hoi chay chua lau dai, ton kem, voi ty le tu vong cao.
Phuong phap chan doan bang chup Xquang cung chi cho phep chan doan khi mat do xuong da bi mat tu 30-50%. Do vay Xquang khong duoc chi dinh de chan doan xac dinh LX. Cac xet nghiem sinh hoa de danh gia chu chu

10 thoi quen cua nhung gia dinh hanh phuc
10 thoi quen cua nhung gia dinh hanh phuc Tags: thanh vien trong gia dinh, gia dinh hanh phuc, chang han nhu, cac thanh vien, bua an sang, thoi quen, bo me, cu chi, thoi gian, tinh yeu, cuoc song, con, den, ban, noi
1. Bieu lo tinh yeu bang mot loi noi, cu chi cu the: Buoi sang cac gia dinh luon ban ron voi nhung bua an sang, nguoi lo dua con den truong, nguoi chuan bi den co quan… nhung du ban den dau, ban cung khong nen quen mot cau noi, mot cu chi au yem voi moi nguoi trong gia dinh, chang han nhu “Bo me yeu con, chuc con di hoc ngoan ngoan, chieu bo me se don con” hoac “Chuc mot ngay tot lanh”.
Thoi quen nay nhac nho cac thanh vien trong gia dinh rang ho luon duoc yeu thuong, quan tam, mong doi va ho la mot trong nhung thanh vien quan trong cua gia dinh.
2. Chia se nhung muc tieu chung: Muc tieu chung, du nho nhat, chang han di xem phim vao cuoi tuan, hoac ve ngoai vao cuoi thang cung can co su thong nhat giua cac thanh vien trong gia dinh. Moi nguoi deu cam thay minh duoc quan tam, ton trong va do do de dang bay to thai do quan tam va ton trong nhung thanh vien khac.
3. Tho lo khi co van de: Nha tam ly cho rang neu ban giu kin mot dieu phien muon gi do trong long thi su viec tro nen toi te hon rat nhieu. Su tho lo giup cho khong khi bot cang thang va hai nguoi thay gan gui nhau hon. Cach “tho lo” trong nhung gia dinh hanh phuc mang mot y nghia tim su chia se, cam thong hoan toan khong nham muc dich dan vat nhau.
4. Hoa hop khi gap tai uong: Khi mot thanh vien trong gia dinh gap rui ro thi moi thanh vien trong gia dinh cung nhau ngoi lai tim cach giai quyet huu hieu. Neu khong co su chung suc chung long ay tinh trang nguoc lai rat co the xay ra, gia dinh bat dau chia re khi doi dau voi mot thuc tai day kho khan, va nguoi nay se tim cach do loi cho nguoi kia ve bat cu sai trai nao.
5. Cung nhau chia se thu vui: Cung nhau xem mot bo phim hay, cung nhau di uong ca phe buoi toi… la mot co hoi de moi nguoi gan nhau hon, xoa di nhung cam giac nham chan trong cuoc song ngay thuong. Chinh trong nhung luc thu gian ay, nguoi nay co the phat hien ra dieu moi me o nguoi kia.
6. Danh cho tinh yeu lua doi su uu tien: Nhung cap vo chong hanh phuc la nhung cap vo chong biet danh cho nhau nhung thoi gian rieng tu ngoai nhung luc cham soc con cai. Va ho cung hieu rang gia dinh hanh phuc la nen tang vung chac cho su phat trien nhan cach cua con cai.
7. Giao mot so viec cho tre: Luong vao suc khoe ma ban nen giao cho chung mot so viec trong gia dinh chang han nhu gap quan ao, don ban an… nhu vay ban vua tao cho tre thoi quen giup do gia dinh vua lam cho chung cam thay hanh phuc khi gop suc nho cua minh cho cuoc song gia dinh.
8. Thoi gian xem ti vi gioi han: Theo thong ke cua nhung nha tam ly xa hoi hoc My thi nhung gia dinh hanh phuc khong danh thoi gian xem ti vi qua 7 tieng/ngay. Tai sao vay? Don gian neu xem tivi nhieu thi dau con la thoi gian de ma quan tam den nguoi than trong gia dinh.
9. Ca tung truyen thong gia dinh: Neu gia dinh ban co truyen thong tot dep nen thuong xuyen nhac nho cho cac thanh vien nho tuoi trong gia dinh, dieu ay se mang hieu qua tich cuc. Them vao niem hanh phuc co san, tre cam thay gia dinh la mot mai am dac biet, dang tu hao ma chung mong muon gop phan vun dap.
10. Luon tham hoi nhung nguoi ban: Quan he ban be la dieu khong the thieu trong cuoc song. Hay sap xep thoi gian den voi ho trong nhung dip sinh nhat, le tet. Nhung moi quan he than thiet mo rong khong gian tam ly cho ca gia dinh, giup tre tiep can voi xa hoi mot cach tu nhien va binh dang, dong thoi ban cung tu tin va hung thu hon trong viec dieu chinh cuoc song rieng trong gia dinh de cam thay hanh phuc.

Lal Maung Cung Cinzah Thantlang Chin Miphun Ni Tuah Nak Hmun Kong Ah Theihternak — Chin Tlangau
Lal Maung Cung Cinzah Thantlang Chin Miphun Ni Tuah Nak Hmun Kong Ah Theihternak
January 17, 2020 by Salai Ephraim
Chinram Cozah hruai nak in avoi (72) nak Chin Miphun Ni cu budget tampi dih in Thantlang khua ah tuah ding a si.Thantlang khua ah Chinram huap cozah budget tampi he a voikhat nak Chin Miphun Ni tuah ding a si caah Thantlang khua mi le khuate lei zong rak i ngaih ngai ngai cio a si.Asinain Chin Miphun Ni tuah nak ding hmun cu Thantlang khua lai mizapi kal khawh nak hmun kum dang tuah tawn nak Lal Luai certual ah si loin Thantlang khua hlun kuahel lamchak certual thar ah tuah ding anti tikah mizapi an lung a rawk ngai ngai.
Mah certual hi mizapi nih a um zong an thei rih lo i a hmuh zong an hmu rih hna lo ,khual leng ah a si i a kam ah in khat hmanh a um rih lo, lentecelh nak zung nganpi an sak i ai lim deuh rih lo cu lawng cu a um, a kal nak lam a bi i motor pahnih duhpoah kianh nak le saikel he kal nak ah tih a nung, lam thar cawh mi a si, kattaza ai phah lo i a khu ngai ngai ding a si, tar nu tarpa le ngahchia nunau ke in kal khawh nak hmun a si lo, zan puai zoh nak dingah mino caah a tha lo. Thantlang Siang Inn sang caah cun mengkhat hrawng kal hau ding a si.
Ziah Khualai Lal Luai certual ah tuah loin khua leng certual ahcun tuah nan timh tiah biahal nak kan tuah tikah cunglei nih khika khin rak tuah u an kan ti an ti. Thantlang mizapi caah tuah timh mi siloin maw cunglei bawi pawl caah dah tuah nan timh tiah i caih sup cio a si, khua leng certual an tuah ahcun mizapi kan kal kho lai lo, bawi le mirum motor nei le saikel nei lawng an kal kho lai. Mizapi kal kho hna seh ti an duh ahcun khua lai cerual ah kan thial piak hna seh, an duh le khua leng certual phuanh puai le biachim nak cu hlunghlai tein khua leng certual ahcun tuah ve ko hna seh tiah zapi au aw a si.
http://www.worldnewsforchin.com/wp-content/uploads/2020/01/aw-4.mp4
Chin Miphun Ni cu mizapi duh nak in a chuah mi a si bantuk in cunglei bawi pakhat hnih duh nak in kan tuah ding asi lo, miphun dang bawi lian duh nak zoh zong in kan tuah ding a si lo. Chin Miphun Ni cu Chin Miphun caah tuah mi a si caah kan catial mi poah ah ” Chin Miphun Ni ” tiah laica in a cungbik ah lianpi in kan tial hnu ah kan miphun hawi a kan hrawmpi mi caah kawlca le mirang ca in kan tial ding a si.Chin Miphun Ni cu miphun tling kan sinak, ram nei kan sinak, ca le holh nei kan sinak, nunphung sang nei kan sinak, miphun thlithuam tling nei kan sinak, kan lungrual nak, miphun hla, miphunlam le miphun paih kan langhter ni mizapi kan i lomh ni a si. Cu caah mizapi hngakchia in tar tiang chun he zan he an kal khawh na hmun ah tuah ah a tha bik, ai dawh bik, airem bik ko. Nawl neitu hna nih mizapi caah ruah than piak khawh ah a tha hnga.
(A tangah khua leng certual Chin Miphun Ni tuah an timh nak video tawite ka vun thlah chih)

本文为【详解E6的rm、rmvb视频播放能力及高帧率压缩技巧】的拼音翻译版
da jia dou zhi dao E6 de biao cheng zhi chi bo fang neng li wei 320×240×15fps， dan shi wo xiang da duo shu ren dui yu zhe ge 15fps shi hen bu man zu de ，15fps de hua mian you ming xian de tiao zhen gan ， hen bu shu fu ， wo xiang da jia xi wang kan dao geng lian guan de shi pin ba ， na me wo men de xiao 6 de zhi chi neng li dao di you duo da ne ？ jing guo wo de duo ci duo zhong shen shu de chang shi ， da an shi 320×240×15fps， he he ， da jia ken ding yao ma wo le ， shuo le ban tian he mei shuo yi yang 。 bu yao ji ， ting wo man man shuo lai 。
320×240×15fps que shi shi E6 de realplayer de bo fang neng li ji xian le ， dan shi wo men yao jin yi bu li jie zhe ge shen shu de han yi ，320×240 yi wei zhe de shi dan zhen de xiang su dian ge shu ， er 15ps shi mei miao ke yi chu li duo shao zhen zhe yang de hua mian ， shi ji shang yi ban de shi pin chu li dou shi an zhao 8×8 de xiao qu yu jin xing fen kuai chu li de ， dui yu shi pin liu de chu li lai shuo ru guo ni mei shen me zhe fang mian de zhi shi ， ni ke yi jian dan de ren wei qi chu li 8×8 qu kuai de dong zuo shi lian xu de ， er bu shi an zhao zhen lai hua fen de 。 qi yi yi he zai ne ， jian dan de shuo ， jiu shi shi ji shang 320×240×15fps fan yang de shi realplayer mei miao neng gou chu li duo shao ge 8×8 de xiao qu kuai ， jin yi bu shuo jiu shi mei miao chu li duo shao ge dian 。 na me an zhao zhe ge si lu lai shuo ， zhi yao bao zheng wo men xiang yao ya suo de shi pin shen shu man zu （320×240×15）=（ zi ding yi chang × zi ding yi kuan × zi ding yi zhen shu ）， na me ni suo ya suo chu lai de rm huo rmvb jiu ke yi bei xiao 6 de realplayer suo zhi chi 。
jing guo da liang de shi yan ， zhe yi deng shi de dao le yan zheng ， xian zai gei chu ji zhong bi jiao shi yong de ya suo shen shu ：
1. ya suo chao kuan ping dian ying ， jiu shi na ge shen me 2.**：1 de ge shi dian ying ， ke yi cai yong 320×0×24（25）fps de shen shu ya suo ，0 dai biao de shi gao du an bi li zi shi ying ， da yue zai 141 zuo you 。
2. ya suo 16：9 de kuan ping dian ying ， ke yi cai yong 320×180×20fps de fang shi ， ye ke cai yong 272×153×24（25）fps de shen shu ya suo ， hou yi zhong fang shi ya suo zai quan ping shi huan shi ke yi bao zheng bi jiao gao de qing xi du de 。
3. ya suo 4：3 de dian shi ju ， ke yi cai yong 240×180×24（25）fps de fang shi ya suo ， ye ke yi an zhao 320×240×15fps de fang shi ya suo ， zhe liang zhe zhi jian de xuan ze yao kan shi pin yuan le ， dong tai bi jiao xiao de ， yi man su yi dong jing tou huo xiang dui jing tai hua mian wei zhu de ying dang cai yong hou zhe yi zhui qiu zui da de hua mian qing xi du ， fan zhi ze xuan ze di yi zhong wei jia 。
ling wai fa xian ru guo cai yong rmvb dong tai ma lv ya suo de shi hou ke neng hui zao cheng da dong tai fan wei xia de ju bu ma liu guo gao ， zao cheng hua pian tiao zhen ， ke yi shen zhao qi ta de rmvb shi pin ya suo jiao cheng jin xing chu li ， yi da dao zui jia xiao guo 。【原文】【汉音对照】

Con mang cuoc doi cua me Tags: Ba Mu, di bo doi, khong bao gio, chuyen co tich, chi co mot, bo me, me con, ve nha, con mua, cua toi, con gai, cha, len, dau, hai
Tren tay toi co mot bup be va mot cai gio trong do co nhung qua phi lao kho. Toi cu di theo con duong truoc mat. Lau lam, thoi gian nhu vo tan, toi di den het con duong. O do co nhung bac thang bang dat. Toi co suc leo len nhung bac thang do nhung no cao qua. Toi suyt oa khoc thi nhin thay mot re cay tho lo o tren dau toi. Toi du vao re cay roi leo len cac bac thang. Tren mat dat la mot vuon cay to, toa bong rop mat dat. Duoi nen dat nhung la rung duoc quet gon thanh mot dong, sach se. Nang chieu qua vom la thanh nhung qua bong to, nho khac nhau tren mat dat. Toi di quanh nhung goc cay va cam thay muon hat. Roi mot con buon ngu keo den. Toi nam tren dong la va ngu ngon lanh. Trong giac ngu toi mo thay nhung dieu dep de.
Khi toi dang chim trong giac ngu thien than thi toi dau biet rang me toi dang khon kho vi tuong da danh mat toi roi. May bay My ap den, nguoi ta be lu tre bo xuong ham, roi phai di so tan do dac. Bon tre ngoi tum tum lai mot cho. Con toi di lang thang. May bay My cut di, nhung ba me di tim con, me toi khong tim thay toi dau ca.
Toi mo choang tinh vi thay co ai do be toi len. Toi mo mat va nhin thay mot nguoi dan ong mac ao thung den. Ong cuoi voi toi. Toi bao ong rang, trong dong la kia con con bup be va lang qua phi lao nua. Ong be toi quay tro lai lay hai thu do roi di vao nha tho. Mot luc lau sau, co nguoi chay di bao me toi den nha tho don toi. Nhin thay toi, me Oa khoc, roi chay den tum toc toi loi xenh xech:
- Con ranh con khon nan nay, may di dau ma de tao tim dut ca hoi. Sao may khong bi bom no vui di cho roi.
Luc do cha khong co mat o day.
Khi do toi len bon nhung sau toi con co hai dua em trai nua, mot dua len hai va mot dua moi may thang. Noi chung toi dang song khong phai la que cua cha me toi ma la noi ho lam viec. Nhung doi voi toi do lai la noi chon rau, cat ron. Ngay toi ra doi la thoi ky dat nuoc dang thinh vuong, the nhung toi lai duoc cat ron bang luoi liem cat lua. Chuyen the nay, luc me toi len con dau de, duoc cha toi dua den tram xa. Ba tram xa truong kiem do de, kiem y si ke don, kiem y ta tiem chich thuoc khoa cua di an co mai ben xa khac. Cha toi de me toi ngoi o chiec ghe cho roi muon xe di tim ba y si. Me toi quan quai tren ghe, con dau moi luc mot tang. Mot ba di kiem rau lon thay me toi dau du qua ben vao giup do. Sau thay me toi de den noi ma van chua thay ba do va cha toi ve. Ba bao voi me toi:
- Co chiu kho nam day, toi vao tim ba Mu, ngay chua co tram xa ba ay do cho ca lang nay day.
Chua day nam phut sau da thay ba quay lai cung ba Mu. Tren tay ba Mu cam mot chiec liem den si. Ba Mu kham cho me toi thay cai dau toi lap lo cua da ben giuc ba di hai rau lon:
- Chi kiem cho toi may cai tau la chuoi kho, kiem dau duoc cai chau nua chu, khong thi ban toe ra day ve ba tram truong lai mang cho.
The la toi ra doi tren cai o chuoi kho, duoc ba Mu cat ron bang luoi liem. Ba Mu bao: Trong cac vat dung cua nha nong thi chi co luoi liem sach nhat vi chi de cat lua va cat ron tre con. Ca de me tron con vuong xong thi ba tram truong va cha toi moi ve den noi. Ba tram truong trach mang me toi:
- Co loi thoi qua, sao khong cho toi ve. Phan khoa hoc het suc, ai lai cat ron bang liem. Nam lai day theo doi.
Ba Mu nghe the chi tum tim cuoi roi ra ve. Hai ngay sau me toi be toi ve nha vi toi chang bi lam sao ca. Cau chuyen nay duoc ca lang biet, he ai nhin thay mat toi cung ke. Toi duoc nghe co de hang tram lan.
Cang lon len toi cang thay vung que toi o sao ma dep the, lam dieu ky la the. Ngay ay, toi co khai niem ve mua, mot nam doi voi toi chi co hai dip Tet va he.
Tet, ay la khi cam trong vuon nha bac Thao o ben canh nha toi do ruc. Co o bo muong xanh ngat mo mang. Co chen moc ca vao loi di, co che nhung vet chan trau loi lom. Me thay cho toi mot chiec ao trang va dan:
- May di choi dau thi di, den chieu toi la ve. Ngay mai mung mot cho co vao nha ai, cai thu con gai den nha mung mot la dong ca nam, nguoi ta chui cho thi tao danh chet.
Toi phai nho loi me dan. Sang mung mot, me toi de cho toi ngu thoai mai. Bo me sap com cung xong moi goi chung toi day an uong. An xong me chia cho mot it banh keo. Toi goi vao khan mui xoa de danh cho cai Hoa. Nha no co nhieu banh chung hon nha toi nhung lai khong co banh keo, vi bo me no lam ruong. Toi di ra ngo, me toi goi voi theo:
- Nho dung vao nha ai day.
Toi di mot mach ra bo muong. Nuoc dong trong veo chua cay lua, chi co co o bo vung, bo thua xanh noi len troi. Tu cuoi bo muong, noi giap voi lang ben xuat hien mot vai cham nho, roi to dan, roi tieng cuoi, tieng noi, roi mau xanh, mau do cua ao xong phap phoi trong gio, nhung nguoi ho hang di Tet nhau. Trong long toi rao ruc den ky la. Toi muon di cung nhung nguoi ho hang kia de den nhung nha ho hang. Nhung toi chi duoc phep dung dua lung vao goc dua de nhin theo ho.
Mua he, bat dau tu nhung con mua rao. Ngoi duoi mot tau la chuoi to lam nha, ben canh hang rao mac may soi to chuoi lam khung cui, ngat may la mung toi lam mam com. Mot gia dinh nho o tren thien dang. Bong dau may den keo den che khuat mat troi. Mua roi nang hat tren tau la chuoi. Roi con mua trut xuong bat ngo. Toi chay voi vao nha tru mua. Mua cang to thi noi buon cua toi cang lon. Toi khong hieu noi buon cua toi den tu khi nao. Co khi tu mot buoi trua, toi nam trong long me voi su thanh binh nhat, roi toi ngu thiep di. Con mua danh thuc toi day. Me da di lam roi. The la noi buon ap den. Va ngay ca khi toi khong thuc day vao con mua thi tu con mua noi buon ua vao toi. Noi buon deo nang ca cuoc doi.
Con mua tanh bat ngo, nang lai bung len. Sau con mua tat ca bui ban tren la cay duoc goi rua het, chi con lai mau xanh nguyen so cua tung loai, long lanh nhung tia mat cuoi duoi nang. Sau con mua la den chuyen bo toi di bo doi. Bo di vao mua he, mot buoi sang, sau con mua rao vao dem. Ba chi em cung me di tien bo. Noi bo nhap ngu sao ma dong vui the. Rat nhieu co, co ca trong va rat dong thanh nien. Bo co le la gia nhat trong so ho. Me cu khoc con chung toi thi cuoi va la het voi bo va nhung chu ma bo bao la dong doi. Bo di buoi sang, het ca ngay hom ay den dem toi khong co cam giac nho bo, mac du cho den khi ay toi chua bao gio xa bo. Gan sang, cam giac lanh, toi quo tim bo de om lay bo nhu moi khi thi khong thay bo. Toi nho bo da di roi, toi khoc khe khe. Me toi hoi vi sao ma khoc, co dau hay nhuc dau gi khong. Toi chi khoc to hon. Me toi do:
- Noi di vi sao ma khoc roi sang ra me cho di xem dam ma.
Toi chua bao gio duoc di xem dam ma nen toi bao voi me:
- Con nho bo lam!
- The thi im di, khoc gi cho bo may sot ruot, sot gan, khong kheo lai bi giac no ban chet day. Nho chua, bo may chua chet thi dung co khoc, co nhac gi lam bo roi ruot, khong tinh tao ma tranh dan duoc dau. Tao cung chang dam khoc day nay.
Nghe me noi toi so lam, nen moi lan nho bo toi phai chay di tim cai gi choi de khoi khoc.
Mua he, cai ngay dau tien toi den truong troi day nang. Co giao day tren lop, ve nha me day them cho toi. Co giao day de thuoc, me day de nho. Me co nhung cau tho the nay: "O tron nhu qua trung ga; o thi doi mu- O thi them rau. O, a hai chu khac nhau; vi a co cai moc cau ben minh". Toi cu doc theo me the ma thuoc. Nhung den hai chu X va S thi toi khong sao phan biet noi. Me cho toi hai cai tat, mot cai coc, roi bat luc bao:
- Tao chiu roi con ngu dot a, de mai co giao may day cho may.
Mua he, la nhung dem day huyen bi. Nhung dem khong trang troi toi den nhu muc, lu tre bat dom dom bo vao lo cam di choi. Mot thang lon dau teu bao:
- Chung may co den ngoi nha ma khong?
- Co so lam khong?
- Di roi khac biet.
Thang lon di truoc, mot lu be rong ran theo sau. Can nha nam rieng ra mot cho ben canh mot go dat nho. Xung quanh co nhung luong hoa thang tap. Nhung con dom dom lap loe trong co xung quanh nha. Thang lon bao:
- Day thay chua, ma troi luon day xung quanh nha.
Chay di keo ma no duoi day.
The la u te chay. Nhung dua be vap nga bat khoc.
Dua khong nga cung khoc. Noi so hai di ca vao giac ngu. The ma ngoi nha ay ban ngay oi dua vao hai trom hoa.
Mot dem, cach cai ngay bo di bo doi kha lau, buoi toi me giuc chung toi di ngu som. Mot noi so hai mo ho nao do lam giac ngu cua toi chap chon, nhung vi co ngon den dau duoc me van nho bang hat do de o dau giuong ma toi yen tam ngu thiep. Giac ngu keo dai kha lau thi dua em toi dap do den, can nha chim vao bong toi. Toi tinh giac, goi me khong thay me dau. Toi gao khoc, khong thay me dau. Toi lien mo cua, cua bi khoa tu ben ngoai. Hai dua em toi cung thuc giac. Chung toi gao khoc cuong cuong, va cung he mat nhin ra khe cua. Ben ngoai cung toi den nhu muc. Mot luc lau sau, toi nhin thay cong co mot dom lua bang hat do. Toi gao to:
- Cho chau xin ti lua. Chau so toi lam.
Dom lua ngap ngung dinh tien lai phia cua, roi dung lai. Toi nai ni:
- Cho chau xin ti lua di, em chau lam do den roi, chau so toi lam. Me chau di vang.
Dom lua dung yen lang roi tu tu quay ra phia cong di mat. Toi gao khoc them mot luc nua roi met qua vao giuong nam. Khong gian im lang, tieng cau kinh da tat tu lau roi. Toi met moi ngu thiep di. Sang ra me goi day dan do de di lam. Toi ngo ngac nhin me. Khong hieu dem qua me co di vang that hay chi la mot giac mo hai hung. Toi tu di xac minh xem, boi toi van nho co mot ngon den hat do truoc cong nha toi. Nhung hinh nhu moi nguoi co dieu gi muon giau. Ho im lang nhung danh mat sang nhau.
Mua he, nhung cai roi that su quat len da thit toi. Khi toi len bay me giao cho toi mot viec: dun mot am nuoc mua de nguoi cho ca nha uong. Me di lam toi keo chung ban den choi tha dia ba ba, di cho Dong Xuan... Vui khong the nao ta xiet. Nhung cung vi the ma am nuoc soi de nguoi het nhanh chong. Sap den gio me ve toi moi bac bep dun nuoc. Toi dut ra vao bep chay dung dung ma mai nuoc khong soi. O ngoai san thi bon chung cuoi vui qua. Me ve am nuoc con nong khong uong duoc the la toi bi may cai coc beu tran. Mot lan toi do day am nuoc de canh bep dinh dun nhung cuoc choi dang vui, cuon di, nen quen mat. Me ve khen toi ngoan biet nghe loi. Toi im lang va suy nghi. De tranh don cua me thi ban sau toi chi can do day nuoc mua vao am va chang can dun gi ca.
Toi chi tranh duoc mot viec nhu the. Con nhung cuoc di choi cung me toi rat khao khat ma duong nhu chang bao gio duoc toai nguyen. Mot lan thay toi dang tha than choi o duong, me dap xe di qua, dung lai bao:
"Ve lay mu tao cho di choi". Toi suong qua nhay chan sao chay ve. Bong nhien vap phai hon gach nga song xoai ra duong. Me dang vui bong dien tiet dap xe di. Toi chay theo me gao khoc: "Me oi, cho con di voi". Me cang dap nhanh hon. Toi hut hoi nga xuong bai co ven duong. Toi thi gan nam up mat cho den khi me quay ve. Me be mot canh roi that to, quat va the rang: "Chang bao gio tao cho may di dau ca".
Lau lam me quen mat loi the, mot chieu me bao toi don com som an roi cho di choi. Toi suong sun nguoi, vua be mam bat vua hat. Bong: choang. Chao oi! Toi bi vap phai bau cua. Me lai dien tiet len: o nha, khong di dau nua. Toi da het loi van xin me ma me van chi dat hai thang em toi di. Toi gao khoc du doi. Troi ap toi, toi bong thay minh that be nho, co don. Toi nho den bo. Mac dau van nho loi me dan la khong duoc khoc ho bo vi bo chua chet, de bo tinh tao ma tranh dan nhung toi nghi, toi chang con ai thuong nua ngoai bo ra. Toi khoc: "Bo oi ve voi con di, me ghet con lam. Me chi yeu chung no thoi. Chang con ai thuong con ca".
Giong toi khan dac. Met moi qua toi ngoi im lang va mo to mat de nhin. Truoc mat toi la mot nguoi mac ao thung den dang nhin cham cham vao toi.
Roi nguoi do dua tay cho toi:
- Tam hon con bi lac loi mat roi, theo cha ve de cha rua toi loi cho con.
Toi ngoan ngoan dung len va lam lui buoc theo nguoi do voi cai dau rong tuech. Ong dan toi vao mot can phong rong, thap den mang-song sang trang. Ong mo tu rot cho toi mot chen nuoc va lay cho toi may chiec keo, thu keo nay du co dip Tet toi cung chua duoc an bao gio. Ong chia cho toi nhung toi rut tay lai thanh hai nam dam giau chat vao dui. Toi bam chat moi va nhin trung vao mat ong. Thi ra ong khong gia nhu toi tuong, chi gia hon bo mot it thoi. Ong cung nhin thang vao mat toi roi de keo va nuoc xuong ban. Ong nhin vao mat toi mot hoi lau va toi cung cu giuong mat nhin vao ong nhu the. Ong roi mat khoi toi, roi keo ghe ngoi xuong ben canh.
- Nao con cua ta, con hay ke cho ta nghe vi sao con lai gao khoc nhu the?
Toi im lang.
- Ta biet bo con di vang roi nhung bo con van thuong xuyen nghe thay nhung loi con noi day.
- Co that khong ho cha? Nhung bo con van tinh tao de tranh dan cua quan thu chu cha?
- Con noi sao?
- Me con dan, khong duoc nhac den bo, nho bo cung khong duoc khoc, vi bo chua chet, de bo tinh tao ma tranh hon dan mui ten. Nhac nhieu den bo, bo roi ruot len.
- Me con dan the a?
- Dung khong cha?
- The con ke di, vi sao ma con gao khoc du the?
- Vi con rat yeu me con ma me con lai khong yeu con. Me con danh con, khong cho con di choi cung me.
- Khong dung the dau, me rat yeu con, me khong ghet bo con dau. Chac me co ly do nao do. Con oi, cha muon noi voi con dieu nay. Con duoc sinh ra o tren doi nay la mot ket qua dep de nhat trong su sinh san cua muon loai. Boi vay con mang trong minh con mot vu tru rieng. Con da co nhung niem vui, su sung suong phai khong? Vay su kho dau va noi buon cung se tu minh con mang lay. Con co the chia se voi nguoi nay, nguoi khac nhung con hay mang mot chu "nhan" ben minh. Co chu nhan ben minh con se thay cuoc song de dang hon. Con dung oan trach cha me lam gi. Dau sau nay cuoc song cua con co khon kho den nhuong nao. Voi bo con, con hay ngay dem cau nguyen cho ong ay, mong Chua o ben ong, che cho cho ong ay.
- Nhung ma nha con khong co Chua.
- Cha biet, nha con theo doi nhung Chua o trong tim con ay. Con hay tin ong ay se che cho cho con.
Toi va cha noi chuyen voi nhau rat lau. Toi vui len rat nhieu. Toi quen het ca moi buon phien. Toi uong het coc nuoc, an het keo. Cha xoa dau toi:
- Khuya roi day, con ve di keo me cho. Con co so bong toi khong, cha se dua con ve.
- Con khong so dau, con se chay mot mach. O, cha oi, trang kia!
Trang cuoi thang toa xuong dat troi vao luc dem da khuya, van vat da im lim trong giac ngu. Co cay cung da ngu say, anh trang cu vao la, la cau nhau rung nhe. Roi chang dung duoc mo mat ra cuoi long lanh voi trang. Toi chay mot mach ve nha voi tam trang nhu vua duoc tam rua sach se. Me da dong chat cua. Toi goi:
- Me Oi mo cua cho con voi.
Im lang.
- Me oi, mo cua cho con vao ngu voi. - Toi goi to hon.
- Me oi! - Toi gao len.
- May sang chuong lon nha bac Thao ma ngu.
- Me oi, con muon vao nha.
- May ma gao len lan nua tao se danh cho may nhu don day!
Toi lang le ngoi xuong bac them. O kia! Trang cung co bong. Mai ra. nha toi do bong xuong den giua san, bong cay na goc them cung co nhung dom trang chui qua ke la. O, mat troi dem, dung roi. Mat troi dem moc roi. Toi chay ra ngo. Con duong lat da sang bong loang. Bui tre, vai nuoc, cay cau ben nha bac Thao cung do bong xuong them. Trang sang ro tung ngon co cung dang vuon day, dong day khe nga sang nhau. O, thi ra moi vat deu thuc ca, chi co me va con nguoi nam trong bong toi cua ngoi nha moi dang ngu. Toi cam thay dau oc rat tinh tao nhung mi mat thi nang triu. Toi rat muon thuc cung van vat nhung toi cung buon ngu nhu nhung con nguoi o trong cac ngoi nha kia. Theo ban nang toi di ve phia cua nha minh. Canh cua da de ngo cho toi chu khong con cai chat nua. Mot y nghi loang qua dau, thi ra me cung chang ghet minh dau, roi toi ngu thiep di me met.
Mua he, nhung cau chuyen co tich. Sau cai dem duoc cha rua toi, toi co them mot nguoi ban moi - do la cha. Nhung luc roi rai, toi khong con choi tha dia ba ba, choi o an quan hay treo len cay nhan roi nhay xuong ao boi sang bo ben kia nua, ma toi ra nha tho. Toi duoc phep vao gap cha bat cu luc nao. Neu la luc cha roi rai toi voi cha se ngoi tro chuyen. Cha hay ke cho toi nghe nhung cau chuyen co tich. Cha ke chuyen rat co duyen. Truyen ngan le mot dem lam toi dung ca tim. Neu la luc cha ban viec, toi co the vao tu sach cua cha de muon mot quyen nao do toi muon doc. Co dieu phai ngoi do doc khong duoc mang ve nha. Mua he nam toi len tam tuoi toi da doc tron bo co tich Andecxen. Mac du rat mai me doc truyen nhung toi van phai nho ve truoc khi me ve. Co mot ban nhac vao luc 11 gio trua danh thuc noi so hai cua toi... Cai ban nhac do noi len, toi dang o dau cung nhanh chan chay ve nha, rua sach chan tay va ngoi len giuong cho me.
Mot hom toi den cho cha, cha dang chuan bi di dau do.
Cha ru toi di cung:
- Cha sang xu lang ben day, con co di voi cha khong?
Lau lam toi chang duoc di choi o dau ca nen toi thich lam. Toi dong y di cung cha. Cha dat tay toi di tren nhung bo muong, roi di qua nhung bo vung, bo thua. Cho nao loi cha be bong toi qua. Toi cam thay rat yeu quy cha va khong con nho den bo nua. The la bo da di bo doi duoc ba nam roi. Bo khong gui thu ve nha nhung toi tin la bo chua chet, vi me khong khoc. Toi hoi cha:
- Cha oi, cha co con khong?
- Khong co con a.
- Vi sao the?
- Vi cha khong duoc phep co con.
- Ai cam cha?
- Khi nao lon con se hieu.
Duong di kha xa, toi moi nhu chan nhung vi nhung cau chuyen cha ke nen toi khong thay met. Buoi trua ay toi duoc an mot bua co rat thinh soan. Sau do cha nho mot nguoi deo toi ve nha. Me toi rat gian du, bo buoi lam chieu de cho toi ve. Me chuan bi san mot cai roi. Me danh cho toi mot tran rat dau. Vua danh me vua khoc.
- May beu rieu tao roi con oi, may nghe lang xom ho noi gi khong? Tu nay tao cam may khong duoc ra nha tho choi voi cha nua nghe chua? Bo may o dau khong ve ma day may de may mat day the nay.
Me vua khoc vua nhac den bo lam toi bong nhien thot ca tim. Bo lam sao phai khong? Vi me van bao rang khong duoc khoc vi bo chua chet dau. Vay ma me lai khoc. Toi so lam khong dam den choi voi cha nua. Vai tuan sau cha nho nguoi mang den cho toi quyen chuyen co tich Grim. Cha de tang toi han hoi.
Mua he, bo chien thang tro ve. Bo ve nha vao buoi toi, khi ca nha vua an com xong. Be ut, khi bo di bo doi moi chua day mot tuoi thot len. "Co chu bo doi vao nha minh" Me oa khoc. "Anh da ve day a? Anh co bi sao khong?" Bo cuoi ham rang trang tren khuon mat sam den. Me dung nep vao mot ben nguc bo, toi dung ben kia, con hai dua em thi nhin bo ngo ngac. Toi cam vao tay bo nhung do chi la mot tay ao rong. Toi thot len: "Tay bo dau roi? "Bo bo vai me ra xoa tay len dau toi: "Mat roi con a". Me thang thot nan tu vai bo tro xuong xem con den dau. Bo bao: "May ma con tay phai, con lam duoc nhieu viec". Toi den ca nha vui khong the ta duoc.
Ngay hom sau me trong trang thai cuc ky sung suong. Me day som di cho. Toi duoc theo me di. Di qua mot chiec cau nho bang tre, cho duoc hop o mot khu dat rong, duoi goc nhung cay chay gia. Dem hom truoc troi mua rao, de ngay hom sau, troi mang xuong mot thu nang thuy tinh. Nang trong veo khong mot gon bui. Cho ma khong on ao. Nguoi mua, nguoi ban noi khe khang nhu so nang thuy tinh vo oa ra. Me mua ga, mua thit, mua rau... rat nhieu thu. Ve den nha co may bac cung co quan bo me da cho san, moi nguoi xum vao mot tay the la toi khong phai lam gi ca. Toi nho den cha. Toi muon bao cho cha biet bo toi da ve. Cha don toi mung ro lam:
- Lau lam roi con chang den tham ta. Con cao qua roi, chac lon len con se thanh co be xinh dep day.
- Cha oi, bo con da ve roi. Bo con bi mat mot canh tay.
- On Chua, nho Chua che cho cho ong ay.
- Co phai la nho Chua hay do con da khong khoc va nhac den bo nhu loi me dan ho cha?
- Nho ca hai dieu do con a.
- Thoi chao cha con ve day, me khong muon con choi voi cha dau.
- Cha biet, tam biet con.
Sau mua he do, nha toi co mot su chuyen doi. Nha toi khong o mien que do nua ma chuyen len thanh pho. Me toi thuyet phuc bo:

Nguoi phuong Dong coi chuyen phong the la mot trong bon dao lon nhat o doi - Dao sinh. Nhieu dieu cam ky ve chuyen phong the cua nguoi phuong Dong chu yeu la dua theo lich trang va su van chuyen cua hanh tinh...
Boi suc manh to lon cua mat trang trong vu tru: dai duong bao la ma thuy trieu len xuong con phu thuoc vao mat trang, huong chi la con nguoi chi co ba lit mau tuan hoan trong co the! Cac loai dong vat hoat dong tinh duc theo lich trang, hoa la co cay cung hung phan theo lich trang...
Theo The Gioi Phu Nu, nguoi phuong Dong ky chuyen sinh hoat phong the vao cac ngay va cac truong hop sau:
- Ngay mong 1, ngay 14, ngay 29 va 30 am lich.
- Khi dat troi co giong to, sam set, van vu.
- Khi tam than bat an.
- Khi dang benh hoac duong benh.
- Khi lao dong nang nhoc hoac moi di xa ve.
- Khi say ruou.

Tags: phat trien nhanh chong, te bao nao, toc do phat, ung thu, hoat dong, hoc hoi, cua cac, thoi gian,
Cac te bao ung thu da "nhai" cach hoat dong cua te bao nao de sinh ton
Cac te bao ung thu co le da "hoc hoi" hoat dong cua cac te bao nao de duy tri toc do phat trien nhanh chong trong mot thoi gian dai.
Mot nghien cuu cua vien han lam khoa hoc My se duoc cong bo vao ngay 16/9 cho thay mot loai protein co kha nang keo dai thoi gian song cua cac te bao nao, co ten goi la DCD, hien dien trong 10% cac te bao ung thu vu phat trien manh.
Loai protein nay cung dong vai tro quan trong trong chung cachexia, mot can benh lam thoai hoa co bap va sut can o rat nhieu benh nhan ung thu vu.
Truoc do, mot nhom cac nha khoa hoc Anh cung da tim ra 2 loai te bao duy nhat trong co the san xuat DCD la te bao than kinh va tuyen tuy. Trong ca 2 truong hop , DCD deu lam tang suc song cua cac te bao nay bang cach tao lop bao ve va tang kha nang sinh san.
Phan ung tang cuong kha nang song cua DCD duoc kich hoat khi mot tin hieu hoa hoc dac biet duoc truyen den cac receptor tren be mat te bao.
Cac nha khoa hoc dang tim hieu cach thuc tac dong den cac receptor de kich hoat DCD hoat dong. Neu nghien cuu thanh cong, no se duoc ung dung trong viec chua benh ung thu vu, ngan chan te bao ung thu lan rong. Phuong phap nay cung se giup do cac benh nhan mac hoi chung Alzheimer vi DCD se ngan ngua viec cac te bao nao cua ho chet di qua nhanh.

Su that ve tac dung cua thuoc trinh nu hoang cung Crila Nguoi dan dang bi lua
Su that ve tac dung cua thuoc trinh nu hoang cung Crila Nguoi dan dang bi lua Tags: u xo tu cung, cong ty co phan, ban ra thi truong, tuyen tien liet, bo y te, co tac dung, nguoi phu nu, trinh nu, hoang cung, nu hoang, dieu tri, ung thu, phi dai, thuoc
Theo danh gia cua Bo Y te, thuoc trinh nu hoang cung - Crila chi co tac dung cai thien benh phi dai tuyen tien liet cua nam gioi nhung khi Crila ban ra thi truong da duoc quang cao la thuoc tieu u xo tu cung, dieu tri ung thu...
Uong thuoc - tieu u
Mot ban doc da goi dien cho biet rang da bi lua khi mua thuoc trinh nu hoang cung Crila ve uong de tieu u xo tu cung. Uong thuoc lien 3 thang voi so tien 1,2 trieu dong, nguoi phu nu nay da rat bat ngo khi kiem tra lai bang sieu am khoi u nay da to len gap doi. Khong con cach nao khac, nguoi phu nu do da phai vao vien de mo cat bo khoi u.
"Khi nghe quang cao thuoc trinh nu hoang cung Crila co tac dung tieu u rat tot, dac biet la u xo tu cung, toi da mua ve uong theo chi dan 8 vien/ngay. Mac du trong thoi gian uong thuoc, toi bi nong khap nguoi, nhung cu nghi se tieu duoc u xo tu cung khong phai mo la toi lai co uong. Khong ngo ket qua u chang tieu ma tien van mat(?!)" - nguoi phu nu noi.
Theo loi ke cua nguoi phu nu nay, hau het phu nu khi vao Benh vien Phu san mo cat u xo tu cung deu da tung uong Crila.
De tim hieu ro hon ve van de nay, chung toi da hoi chuyen mot so phu nu den kham tai phong kham phu khoa cua Benh vien Phu san T.U voi can benh u xo tu cung, ho deu cho biet da uong Crila nhung van nhan duoc loi khuyen cua bac si la nen di mo.
Quang cao de ban thuoc
Con sot thuoc trinh nu hoang cung bat dau tu cuoi nam 2005 khi san pham vien nang Crila ra doi.
De quang ba cho ten thuoc bi truyen nay, Cong ty co phan duoc lieu T.U2 da quang cao tren cac phuong tien thong tin dai chung voi rat nhieu tac dung: Dieu tri benh phi dai tuyen tien liet, u xo tu cung, ho tro cho cac benh nhan ung thu, ho tro dieu tri kich thich he mien dich, tang suc de khang co the de chong lai su san sinh cua te bao ung thu va di can sau phau thuat... Rat nhieu nguoi bi mac cac benh u xo tu cung, ung thu... da coi Crila nhu mot than duoc. Da co luc tai cac nha thuoc cua Ha Noi "chay" thuoc Crila vi so nguoi su dung qua lon.
Tac dung that su cua Crila den dau? Chung toi da tim thay cau tra loi tai Bo Y te. Trong bien ban danh gia ve tac dung cua Crila cua Hoi dong khoa hoc - Bo Y te ket luan: "Crila khong co tac dung lam nho u xo tuyen tien liet ma chi co kha nang cai thien benh phi dai tuyen tien liet o nam gioi, cai thien tinh trang di tieu tien ban dem cua benh nhan phi dai tuyen tien liet".
Voi ket luan nay co the hieu la Crila khong dieu tri khoi han duoc benh phi dai tuyen tien liet. Ngay sau khi co ket luan cua Hoi dong khoa hoc - Bo Y te, Crila da duoc Cuc Quan ly duoc cap phep san xuat va luu hanh tren thi truong. Tren nhan thuoc dan o ngoai chai Crila, Cong ty co phan duoc lieu T.U2 ghi ro o phan chi dinh la: Dieu tri phi dai lanh tinh tuyen tien liet. The nhung tren thuc te, Crila da duoc "bien hoa" thanh mot loai thuoc ky dieu co the tieu cac loai u, ke ca ung thu.
Theo tim hieu cua chung toi, mot dai dien cua Cong ty co phan duoc lieu T.U2 da tung thong bao rang, Crila da duoc nghien cuu thu nghiem lam sang tren benh nhan u xo tu cung tai Benh vien Phu san T.U voi ket qua gan 70% benh nhan da tieu u. Va dang tiep tuc nghien cuu thu nghiem lam sang tren benh nhan ung thu ve tac dung dieu tri benh ung thu. Tuy nhien, nhung nghien cuu nay cua Cong ty co phan duoc lieu T.U2 khong duoc mot hoi dong khoa hoc nao cua Bo Y te cong nhan.
Phai chang Cong ty co phan duoc lieu T.U2 co tinh dua ra nhung thong tin nay de "loe" nguoi benh mua thuoc. Con sot Crila van con dang rat nong, chi tiec la co quan quan ly, cap phep cho Crila luu hanh van khong hay biet viec Cong ty co phan duoc lieu T.U2 dang vi pham quang cao qua muc.

Canh sat giao thong tram 19.1 xu phat khong minh bach
Canh sat giao thong tram 19.1 xu phat khong minh bach Tags: Bac Binh Minh, Bao Thanh Nien, TP Ho Chi Minh, Le Hong Phong, Nguyen Le Uyen Thao, canh sat giao thong, giay phep lai xe, khong minh bach, Tinh Vinh Long, bo canh sat, giay dang ky, xu phat, can bo, cong an, tram
Don thu neu ro: “Vao luc 16h ngay 27/1/2004, toi co lai chiec xe oto rieng (hieu BMW, bien so 52T - 8585) cho doan thuong nhan Sai Gon den hop tac lam an voi tinh Can Tho. Khi xe den khu vuc ben pha Can Tho (Bac Binh Minh) thi bi mot can bo canh sat giao thong (CSGT) Tram 19.1 (Cong an Vinh Long) ten la Dat chan xe va sau do lap bien ban giu xe toi vi cho rang toi khong dem theo cac loai giay to xe. Thuc te toi co mang theo So chung nhan kiem dinh xe so A0396624, Giay chung nhan bao hiem xe co gioi so 031405, chi thieu Giay dang ky xe oto (so hieu 10218404) va Giay phep lai xe (so hieu M366353) vi toi de quen o nha.
Trong khi ong Dat lap bien ban giu xe, toi co nan ni xin muon lai chia khoa xe lay So kiem dinh va Giay bao hiem (co mang theo xe) de trinh nhung ong Dat van khong cho, van ghi bien ban toi khong mang theo ca 4 loai giay to neu tren. Den 14h ngay 28/1, toi mang du Giay dang ky xe va Giay phep lai xe den Tram 19.1 de trinh, cho xu ly va nhan lai xe. Tai day, ong Pho tram ten Bay rat quau quo, hong hach yeu cau toi nop 850.000 dong va ky vao bien ban nop phat ma khong giao cho toi bat cu bien nhan nao, dong thoi ong Bay cung ra lenh bam lo Giay phep lai xe cua toi va thu hoi luon bien ban vi pham lap hom 27/1 ma khong giao cho toi giu lai mot ban theo quy dinh. Sau do ong moi giao giay to xe va tra lai xe cho toi.
Duoc biet, theo quy dinh ve “Xu phat vi pham hanh chinh doi voi nguoi dieu khien oto vi pham cac quy dinh cua Luat giao thong duong bo” thi doi voi nguoi dieu khien xe oto khong mang theo 4 loai giay to (Giay dang ky xe, Giay phep lai xe, Giay chung nhan kiem dinh, Giay bao hiem) se bi phat tien tu 100.000 dong den 200.000 dong va khong kem theo quy dinh giu lai xe. The nhung khong hieu sao Tram 19.1 ap dung dieu luat nao ma lai phat toi den 850.000 dong va giam xe toi 1 ngay dem, mac du toi da het loi giai thich, nan ni, nguoc lai ong Bay con to ve thach do, de doa, khong che tinh than toi - dieu ma toi chua he thay xay ra o bat cu can bo, chien si cong an tinh nao khac.

Bua sang la bua an quan trong nhat trong ngay? "Chan ly" nay thuc ra duoc sang tac boi nhung nha ban ngu coc an sang
Khoa hoc dinh duong van chua co cau tra loi cho viec lieu ban co nen an sang hay khong.
Bua sang la bua an quan trong nhat trong ngay, chung ta van thuong cong nhan dieu do nhu mot chan ly. Roi den mot cau ngan ngu van hay duoc trich dan: Hay an sang nhu mot vi vua, an trua nhu mot hoang tu va an toi nhu mot ke hanh khat.
Tat ca da duoc ghim vao dau chung ta ke tu khi con be, rang bo bua sang co the anh huong toi suc khoe. Cac loi ich cua bua an sang duoc liet ke bao gom: tang cuong su trao doi chat, giam cam giac doi trong suot ca ngay, cung cap cho ban cac chat dinh duong quan trong va giup ban tap trung.
Nhung co mot su that thu vi rang, truoc khi y tuong nay xuat hien, bua sang von la mot bua an khong may quan trong. Moi nguoi da an sang kha tuy tien, khong co mot mon do an sang dien hinh nao, va ong ba chung ta don gian la chi an bat cu thu gi ho co hoac thuc an thua tu bua toi hom truoc.
Cau noi "Bua sang la bua an quan trong nhat trong ngay" thuc ra da duoc sang tac boi James Caleb Jackson va John Harvey Kellogg, hai tin do sang lap Giao hoi Co doc Phuc lam de ban ngu coc an sang, thu thuc pham ma ho phat minh ra vao the ky 19.
Lan dau tien no xuat hien la tren tap chi Good Health duoc dieu hanh boi Kellogg. Sau do nganh cong nghiep thit xong khoi tiep tuc nhay vao phong trao. Ho lai thuyet phuc moi nguoi ve tam quan trong cua viec an protein vao buoi sang. Ma thit xong khoi thi khong phai mot nguon protein tot.
Cau noi "Bua sang la bua an quan trong nhat trong ngay" thuc ra da duoc sang tac boi James Caleb Jackson va John Harvey Kellogg de ban ngu coc an sang, thu thuc pham ma ho phat minh ra.
Biet lich su la vay, nhung gio chung ta phai tu hoi: Lieu bua sang co thuc su quan trong khong va no quan trong nhu the nao?
Mac du chung ta thuong muon co mot cau tra loi dut khoat cho moi van de, nhat la trong linh vuc dinh duong, nhung dap an cau hoi do lai tuy thuoc vao tung nguoi, hay chinh ban than ban.
Mot phan cua van de, do la nhung nghien cuu ma chung ta co the dua vao de tra loi ve moi lien quan giua bua sang va beo phi hien nay deu la nghien cuu doan the.
Dua vao loai nghien cuu nay, chung ta co the thay duoc moi lien he giua bua sang va hieu qua duy tri can nang hoac cac thong so suc khoe khac, nhung chung khong khang dinh duoc quan he nhan qua, co dung la bua sang da giup ich hay khong?
Nhung nghien cuu dang nay co the bi nhiem thien kien, khi nhung nguoi an sang khoe manh hon khong phai vi ban than bua sang cua ho, ma la vi ho quan tam den suc khoe cua chinh minh tren moi khia canh nen moi nghe theo loi khuyen an sang.
Trong vai nam gan day, mot so nha nghien cuu da co gang tra loi dut khoat cau hoi: "An sang co giup giam can hay khong?". Va de lam duoc dieu do, ho khong chi dua vao nghien cuu doan the, ma phai lam cac thu nghiem ngau nhien co kiem soat.
Va ho da tim thay dieu gi?

Trong mot nghien cuu keo dai 16 tuan duoc thuc hien vao nam 2014, co 309 nguoi truong thanh tham gia la nhung nguoi beo phi, ho duoc chon ngau nhien vao hai nhom: khong an sang va an sang.
Cac nha khoa hoc ket luan an sang khong co tac dung giam can doi voi nhung nguoi truong thanh, nhung nguoi dang bi beo phi va muon giam can.
Ket luan nay tiep tuc duoc lap lai o mot so nghien cuu nho hon sau do, cho thay bo bua sang khong dan den viec tieu thu nhieu calo hon trong cac bua an tiep theo, va tham chi khong co bua sang co the khien tong luong calo nap vao cua ca ngay giam xuong.
Vay thi chung ta nen bo bua sang u?
Nhu thuong le, khong co cau tra loi dut khoat cho thac mac nay. Nhung co hai dieu ma ban nen biet:
1. Chat luong bua sang cua ban quan trong hon nhieu so voi hanh dong an sang. Ban phai biet loai thuc pham nao thuc su tot cho bua sang cua ban, va nhung thuc pham do la ca nhan hoa cho ban than ban.

Vietnam Airlines huy 48 chuyen bay vi bao so 6 Tags: Vietnam Airlines, Ha Noi, TP HCM, Da Nang, Tay Nguyen, Nam Trung Bo, chuyen bay, So 6, hom qua, bao, 30/9, tau, huy, 48
TPCN - Hom qua, 30/9, Vietnam Airlines (VNA) chinh thuc thong bao huy 48 chuyen bay toi cac khu vuc mien Trung, Nam Trung bo va Tay Nguyen trong 2 ngay 30/9 va 1/10 nham tranh bao so 6.
Cu the: Ngay 1/10, huy 31 chuyen, trong do tap trung vao cac chuyen bay tu Ha Noi, Tp Ho Chi Minh di Da Nang va tu Da Nang toi cac diem Hue, Cam Ranh, Quy Nhon, Buon Me Thuot, Playcu va Da Lat.
Ngoai ra mot so chuyen bay tu Ha Noi di Tp Ho Chi Minh va nguoc lai, tu dem 30/9 den trua 1/10 cung se phai huy bo do anh huong cua bao. Cac chuyen tren truc bay nay co the se duoc khoi phuc lai tuy theo muc do dien bien phuc tap cua con bao.
Trong khi do, tren cac duong bay quoc te, VNA van khai thac on dinh theo lich bay thuong le.
Pacific Airlines hom qua, 30/9, cung huy 4 chuyen bay noi dia (trong do 2 chuyen tu Ha Noi, TP HCM di Da Nang; 2 chuyen giua Ha Noi va TP HCM). 2 chuyen quoc te TP HCM- Dai Bac, TP HCM- Cao Hung cung bi huy. Hom nay, 1/10, 6 chuyen noi dia khac cung se bi huy.
Tong Cong ty duong sat VN cung vua cho biet, trong cac ngay 30/9, 1 va 2/10, nganh duong sat huy 3 doi tau SE1/2, TN1/2, TN7/8 xuat phat tu Ha Noi va TP HCM. Hien, 67 hanh khach mua ve tau TN1 da duoc ga Ha Noi hoan lai tien.
180 hanh khach mua ve tau SE1, 16 hanh khach mua ve tau TN7 va doi tau TN1/2 cung se duoc ga Ha Noi hoan ve hoac doi sang chuyen tau phu hop khac do truong tau sap xep, bo tri (khong phai doi ve, khong thu tien chenh lech).
Duoc biet, cac tau khac da xuat phat co lenh phai dung tai nhung ga an toan tranh di vao vung anh huong bao so 6. Du kien cac doi tau bi huy, hoan se tro lai hoat dong binh thuong vao ngay 3/10. Dinh Thang

Hut mo khong phau thuat cho ca Nam gioi
De giam can day, hieu trai nhung ma cha phai thuc hanh mot hut mo bung che khoang tong tang na, ban chi can thiet lap mot so phan thoi quen mot gian duoi day.
ton hot, thai ro thuc pham
vin nghien cuu dinh duong Nhat Ban cho rang that pham dang can nho se bieu cam giac luong thuc hap giau hon chap de truong mieng.vi cam, dom giam tau tiem qua ban cho nen cham chi hot ro bon top ra, hut mo cavi-lipo xue dat dang tiem trai cao hon hoi huong giam bu.
Trang mieng phang mot mieng so-co-la den
cam co do lua banh quy, banh ngot ngao, hang hat boi xap con bon ngot ngao muc tao tuan mot manh so-co-la xui hut mo cavi-lipo. giau dang vai lan dau ban chu thay thoa man lam song dan dan con buon muc tau ban se giam dan va ban se rat mung cung quyet toan muc toi.
tien danh rang sau bua toi
lam rang sau bua toi khien ban gio co cam giac mang chen dem, hut mo cavi-lipo giup ban van han che viec chen but beng dem lam ban tang ton hot nhanh chong.
dung tich hat tuong an but
khong cho nen tang tru cac tui hap nang, banh keo kiet, hat tuong ngot trong suot nha, hut mo bung vay luc ban xoi giau hat bo ngot ngao, than se cut chia va doi hoa thanh nang cay va chong beo. chap ne co the se tang cuong tich luy chong mam va gay map xuy – de tang can.
cha su dung lu uong trong suot bua ngon
gia du ban dop va uong voi ta, nhut nhat do se khien ban nghen le hon, nuot cung sit hon va le co nhien, hut mo ban cung tong co hon, chi uong truoc va sau bua an. Day la bi quyet giam boc ban can neu nghe.
chu bo bua
giau nguoi nghi rang, ta lot nhin tong thoi than the se khong lam het tiep thu, ket trai giam hot se cao hon. phai ban thang tinh nhin top, quang quat bua thi than se bi thieu dinh duong bong dung ngop khien ban de bi he loi mau, ngat, chong mat hut mo cavi-lipo… luc do chang nhung ban khong the giup co the tieu xai tiem mo mang doi nhung dang hoi ra nhung hinh huong chang noi den suc khoe.
hay nghen, giam tau ma phai bao dam de suc khoe bieu toi. nhoi khuyen cua cac cham gia la ban can neu nhu top du bua de cung cap duong chong bieu than the, hut mo bung dac bat la bua hap sang quan yeu trong ngay. Nguoi nuoc ngoai Viet kieu duoc cap bang lai xe tai VN
Nguoi nuoc ngoai Viet kieu duoc cap bang lai xe tai VN Tags: Ha Noi, Ong Le Ba Dat, So Giao thong cong chinh, phuong tien co gioi, giay phep lai xe, nguoi nuoc ngoai, bang lai xe, duoc cap bang, nguoi Viet Nam, quoc te, co quan, quan ly, viet kieu, xin
Ong Le Ba Dat, To truong nghiep vu quan ly phuong tien co gioi thuoc So Giao thong cong chinh Ha Noi cho biet quy dinh nay chieu nay. Theo do bat cu ai co giay phep lai xe cua nuoc ngoai hoac quoc te deu de dang xin cap bang lai cua Viet Nam ma khong can phai hoc lai ky thuat va thi sat hach.
- Giay phep lai xe (GPLX) nhu the nao thi duoc coi la du tieu chuan bang lai quoc te?
- Day la giay phep dieu khien oto va xe 2 banh gan may do co quan co tham quyen cua nuoc ngoai cap. O mot so nuoc, nhung nguoi da co bang lai xe thi co the xin cap bang lai quoc te de su dung tai mot vai nuoc khac. Viet Nam chua tham gia vao cam ket quoc te nao ve giay phep dieu khien phuong tien co gioi, nen nguoi co bang lai xe nuoc ngoai, bang quoc te muon dieu khien oto, xe may 70cc tro len o Viet Nam phai xin cap doi giay phep.
- Thu tuc cap doi giay phep the nao?
- Co quan cap doi la phong quan ly phuong tien co gioi thuoc so giao thong cong chinh noi ho luu tru.
Voi nguoi nuoc ngoai (gom ca nguoi Viet co quoc tich nuoc ngoai), dau tien ho phai toi so giao thong cong chinh nhan don xin doi GPLX. Don duoc dan anh co dau xac nhan cua co quan ngoai giao nuoc do tai Viet Nam hoac cua co quan, don vi, doanh nghiep dang quan ly nguoi do. Don duoc nop cung ho so gom ban photo GPXL nuoc ngoai hoac quoc te cung ban dich co cong chung (cong chung Viet Nam hoac chung thuc cua co quan ngoai giao, co quan quan ly nguoi nuoc ngoai do), ban photo ho chieu, visa. Phong quan ly phuong tien co gioi khi tiep nhan ho so se kiem tra doi chieu voi ban goc cac giay to tren.
Voi nguoi Viet Nam (gom nguoi o nuoc ngoai ngan han, van con ho khau trong nuoc, va nguoi da bi xoa ho khau) thi ngoai cac giay to tren con phai co giay chung nhan suc khoe cua benh vien da khoa cap huyen tro len.
Viec cap doi GPLX chi duoc xet khi GPLX quoc te do con gia tri su dung. Giay phep moi do Viet Nam cap co thoi han su dung phu hop voi han su dung cua GPLX nuoc ngoai nhung khong vuot qua giay phep cung loai cua Viet Nam, khong vuot qua thoi han nguoi nuoc ngoai hoac nguoi Viet Nam luu tru tai Viet Nam. GPLX moi tuong ung voi nhung hang giay phep ma nguoi xin cap da duoc cap o nuoc ngoai. Vi du, GPLX nuoc ngoai co ca hang oto, xe may thi bang lai duoc doi cung co hang tuong ung. PublicationsIdentification of two novel mutations, c.232T>C and c.2006A>T, in SLC26A4 in a Chinese family associated with enlarged vestibular aqueduct
Identification of two novel mutations, c.232T>C and c.2006A>T, in SLC26A4 in a Chinese family associated with enlarged vestibular aqueduct,10.1016/j.i
It is known that enlarged vestibular aqueduct syndrome is closely related to the SLC26A4 mutation. Up to date, more than 200 of SLC26A4 mutations have been described, and novel mutations are being continually identified in different countries and ethnic groups. In this study, two novel variations were identified in a Chinese family associated with enlarged vestibular aqueduct. The two novel substitutions, c.232T>C and c.2006A>T, were detected in exon 3 and exon 17 of the pendrin encoding gene, respectively. The T/C transversion at 232 nucleotide caused p.Y78H mutation while the A/T transversion at 2006 nucleotide caused p.D669V mutation.

- Hoc van de hoc lam nguoi. Hoc Van de biet doi, hieu doi, yeu doi va cac trach nhiem voi doi. Du an “Hoc Van tu cuoc song” mua ba – chu de “Co thu tren bau cua” khong ngoai muc dich do.
Thay Do Duc Anh, giao vien mon Van truong THPT Bui Thi Xuan, chu nhiem du an “Hoc van tu cuoc song” da khang dinh nhu vay tai buoi tong ket du an.
Ban chu nhiem du an nhan hoa tu Ban giam hieu nha truong.
Sang 15-5, tai Hoi truong Nha Thieu nhi TP.HCM, thay va tro truong THPT Bui Thi Xuan (quan 1) da to chuc buoi bao cao du an “Hoc van tu cuoc song” voi chu de “Co thu tren bau cua”. Dong thoi, day cung la buoi ra mat cuon sach “Co thu tren bau cua” do giao vien va hoc sinh cung thuc hien.
La nguoi sang lap, chu nhiem du an, thay Do Duc Anh, cho biet, “Co thu tren bau cua” la hinh thuc “thu khong dan tem”. Chinh cac em se tim hieu va viet nen nhung la thu tay gui den nguoi ma em cam thay an tuong va nguong mo. Mot buc thu nhung goi gon trong do la tinh yeu, su cam men doi voi nhung nguoi than yeu, nguoi truyen cam hung va ca nhung nguoi chi biet ma khong quen.
Mot phu huynh xuc dong khi doc buc thu do mot hoc tro viet rieng cho dua con trai khuyet tat cua minh.
Nhan vat trong nhung buc thu la nhung nguoi phi thuong nhung luon nghi minh la binh thuong. Do la nhung chu canh sat phong chay chua chay hi sinh tham lang, la ong ngoai ban keo bong gon luu giu ky uc tuoi tho, la “nguoi hung” bac bao ve moi sang dua hoc tro qua duong, hay voi co tong giam thi kinh yeu…Va dac biet tat ca deu bat ngo truoc la thu ngoai cua va khong the khong to mo doc, roi mim cuoi va thay hanh phuc vi nhung gi minh lam cung da truyen duoc cam hung cho moi nguoi..
La mot nguoi dong hanh voi du an tu nhung ngay dau tien, em Le Ba Quoc Huy, hoc sinh cua truong cho biet, “Co thu tren bau cua” da dem den cho em nhung trai nghiem thu vi ve cuoc song.
Du an Hoc van tu cuoc song voi chu de "Co thu tren bau cua" da khien hoc tro truong thanh hon nhieu.
“Voi viec buoc chan ra ben ngoai tim hieu cuoc song, tiep xuc voi nhung con nguoi o cac hoan canh song khac nhau, o ho co diem chung du cuoc song co kho khan nhung ho van luon vuon len voi mot nghi luc phi thuong. Chinh ho la tam guong de em co the hoc tap”.
Con doi voi Tan Phat, chinh viec hoc van qua du an da khien em tu mot nguoi rat ghet hoc van, tro nen yeu mon Van. “Chinh viec di thuc te, tiep xuc voi nhan vat ma minh yeu quy da nuoi cam xuc trong em, khien em viet van hay hon, cam xuc hon. Va em da danh tat ca tinh cam cua minh de viet thu tay cho ong Ngoai keo ngot. Dieu nay em chua tung lam trong 11 nam qua”.
Doc nhung dong chu Tan Phat viet tang cho ong Ngoai da cho thay dieu do: “Keo ngoai la so zach, ma con re nua, cho toi bay gio, con cung con ghien an. Con con nho rat ro hinh anh ong ngoai yeu doi, yeu nghe, bon bon tren chiec xe lam keo, dau xe tai cac ngoi truong de ban. Chac la ca Sai Gon nay, dua hoc tro nao cung lon len bang cay keo bong gon het tron do ngoai”.
Hay xuc dong nhu buc thu cua em Tran Dinh Nhu viet danh rieng cho bac bao ve truong chuyen Le Hong Phong. “Du troi co nang gat hay mua to, bac van tan tuy voi cong viec, cu dung gio bac lai co mat o cong giu an ninh trat tu. Cong viec du vat va nhung bac van tham lang, tan tuy voi nghe. Va moi lan nhu the, chau lai thuong bac. “Ong Ba vui tinh” la cai ten ma chung chau hay goi moi khi nhac den Bac day….”
Duoc thuc hien tu thang 9-2017, den thoi diem nay, du an da nhan duoc hang tram thu viet tay cua hoc sinh bay to tinh cam, su yeu thuong doi voi nhung nguoi khong he quen biet. Sau khi tap hop va lua chon, Ban chu nhiem du an da chon ra 50 buc thu tay voi nhung cung bac tinh cam khac nhau de in thanh quyen sach voi nhan de “Co thu tren bau cua”.
Voi nhung loi de tua het suc de thuong nhu "Ngai ve si hoc duong", "Tho danh giay va bay yeu tinh", "Su phu de men" hay "Nhung sieu nhan duoi ong cong", "Hoa huong duong khong can mat troi", ... 50 buc thu viet tay la 50 not tram lang giua dong doi hoi ha. No la mon qua danh cho nhung nguoi phi thuong nhung luon nghi minh la nguoi binh thuong va danh cho tat ca chung ta.
