ChickVD: a sequence variation database for the chicken genome Wang, Jing | He, Ximiao | Ruan, Jue | Dai, Mingtao | Chen, Jie | Zhang, Yong | Hu, Yafeng | Ye, Chen | Li, Shengting | Cong, Lijuan | Fang, Lin | Liu, Bin | Li, Songgang | Wang, Jian | Burt, David W. | Wong, Gane Ka-Shu | Yu, Jun | Yang, Huanming | Wang, Jun
Nucleic Acids Research 2004;33(Database Issue):D438-D441.
Working in parallel with the efforts to sequence the chicken (Gallus gallus) genome, the Beijing Genomics Institute led an international team of scientists from China, USA, UK, Sweden, The Netherlands and Germany to map extensive DNA sequence variation throughout the chicken genome by sampling DNA from domestic breeds. Using the Red Jungle Fowl genome sequence as a reference, we identified 3.1 million non-redundant DNA sequence variants. To facilitate the application of our data to avian genetics and to provide a foundation for functional and evolutionary studies, we created the ‘Chicken Variation Database’ (ChickVD). A graphical MapView shows variants mapped onto the chicken genome in the context of gene annotations and other features, including genetic markers, trait loci, cDNAs, chicken orthologs of human disease genes and raw sequence traces. ChickVD also stores information on quantitative trait loci using data from collaborating institutions and public resources. Our data can be queried by search engine and homology-based BLAST searches. ChickVD is publicly accessible at http://chicken.genomics.org.cn.

SOIL MICROBIAL BIOMASS AND ITS ECOLOGICAL EFFECTS

The role of microorganisms in cycling of nutrients and degradation of organic matter in soils is critical in modern sustainable farming practices. The role of microorganisms in the turnover of carbon, nitrogen, phosphorus and sulfur compounds in soil has been a focus of several studies of productivity. Studies of soil microbial biomass in recent years, especially the effects of planting rotation, fertilizer application and heavy metal on soil microbial biomass are reviewed in this papper and the ecological effects of soil microbial biomass are also discussed.

Buoi chieu hang ngay, hang tram tre nho o lang Da Phuc va lang Thuy Khue duoc bo me dan di boi o ao lang truoc dinh chua Thay, xa Sai Son (Quoc Oai, Ha Noi).
» Di san "di pham" tien vua nuc tieng Ha thanh
» Da tim ra nan nhan trong "dong xuong cot" o chua Thay?
Ao lang Da Phuc, xa Sai Son (Quoc Oai, Ha Noi) truoc san dinh chua Thay hang ngay vao nhung buoi chieu co hang tram thanh thieu nien ra boi tam.
Dien tich rong, the dua nui, nhung hang cay cao rop bong mat xung quanh da bien noi day tro thanh dia diem ly tuong de giai nhiet vao mua he.
O day, tre em duoc phu huynh dan di tam mat, lua tuoi dao dong tu 5-15 tuoi. Cac em nho duoi 10 tuoi duoc bo me sam ao phao day du. Chi Bich Ngoc, nguoi lang Da Phuc cho biet: "Mua he, cac chau khong phai di hoc, chieu nao toi cung cho chau ra day tam, tap boi. Nam nay, con trai toi 8 tuoi nhung da tam ao lang nhieu mua he. Toi cho chau tam vua de chau duoc hoc boi tu ve, vua de ren luyen de co suc khoe tot. Dien tich ao lang duoi chan nui chua Thay rat rong nen nuoc trong va sach. Vi the, nguoi dan o day rat yen tam".
Khong chi cac be trai ma co rat nhieu be gai cung duoc bo me dan di tam mat. Vi duoc tiep xuc voi nuoc tu nho nen tat ca deu manh dan va tu tin duoi nuoc.
Anh Nguyen Lam (36 tuoi) chia se: "Ao lang truoc dinh va chua Thay duoc lam tu thoi nha Ly nen cung khong tinh het duoc bao nhieu doi da sinh hoat o day. O giua ao lang co mot mai dinh duoc dung len, cac cu noi do la noi to chuc mua roi nuoc nghe thuat. Toi chi nho tu khi con rat nho, toi da duoc bo va ong noi dan ra day tam mat. Den nay khi co gia dinh, toi van thuong xuyen dua cac chau ra tam va hoc boi. Cac chau rat thich dua nghich duoi nuoc. Sau moi mua he, thay cac chau boi rat tot va khoe hon, toi rat vui".
Cac bac phu huynh dung theo doi con tre tam.
Cach do khong xa, tre em o thon Ngoc Than, xa Ngoc My, cung tam ao lang hang ngay.
Cac em tu tin dua nghich duoi nuoc.

Nhung nha ve sinh o ben xe, truong dai hoc, la noi “li tuong” de cac doi tuong dong gioi, gai bao “chao hang” bang cach ghi so dien thoai len nhung vach tuong toilet. “Dung o Sa Dec, Dong Thap, di cong chuyen tren Sai Gon roi minh de lai so dien thoai trong…nha ve sinh. Dung chi muon vui ve, khong phai lam tien dau, an tam di …”. Do la cau chuyen trich ngang ma chung toi co duoc khi lien lac vao so dien thoai 0123323… duoc ghi lai trong toilet cua tram xe bus Ben Thanh, quan 1, TP. HCM. Nhung nha ve sinh o ben xe la noi “li tuong” de cac doi tuong dong gioi, gai bao “chao hang” bang cach ghi so dien thoai len nhung vach tuong toilet. Chung toi tim cach lien lac voi nhung so dien thoai nay va khong it nhung cau chuyen bi hai he lo dang sau nhung con so duoc viet chang chit tren nhung buc tuong. “Minh la gay kin” Chung toi lien he voi chu thue bao 0122642… duoc ghi nghech ngoac trong nha ve sinh ben xe kem dong chu phu de, mang day tinh “quang cao”: “Minh la gay kin, lien he…”. Bat chuyen lam quen chung vai phut, Son (ten chu thue bao) da chu dong noi den “chuyen ay” voi nhung cau tu noi da ga. “Em da trang, mat tron, cao met bay muoi, so do 3 vong chuan, “chuyen do” thi khoi che, bao dam anh phe”, Son quyen ru. Son con cho biet, anh da tung co nhieu lan “giao dich” thanh cong thong qua lien lac bang dien thoai duoc ghi lai tai nha ve sinh. Nhung khach hang tim den voi Son la nhung nguoi dong gioi co nhu cau tinh duc. Moi dem tiep khach nhu vay, Son cung kiem duoc cho minh tu 300.000 den 500.000 dong, co khi len den 1 trieu dong tuy khach sop. Dang sau nhung canh cua nhu the nay ...la nhung loi chao moi day benh hoan. Dung o Sa Dec, Dong Thap, mot nguoi da de lai so dien thoai trong toilet cua ben xe bus Ben Thanh thi khong co muc dich lam tien ma chi de mua vui. 27 tuoi, nha lam vuon, the nhung “Dung van rat co don”. Bat chuyen qua dien thoai, Dung co chat giong chat phac, nhung cung rat “thang than” trong “chuyen ay”: “Do mot lan di cong chuyen tren Sai Gon, Dung co de lai so dien thoai trong nha ve sinh de tim ban. Muon Dung lam “chuyen ay” khong, Dung chi muon vui ve, khong phai lam tien dau, dia chi cua Dung ne…”. Qua trao doi, chung toi biet them Dung ghi lai so dien thoai ay o nhieu noi nhu trong nha ve sinh, tren may buc tuong… mong tim duoc ban. Da 27 tuoi nhung anh khong muon co vo vi chi thich con trai. Gia dinh van chua biet anh dong tinh, chi biet la “hoi yeu” hon nhung ban cung trang lua. Moi lan di xa, Dung tim cach ghi lai so dien thoai lien lac tim ban nam de tranh nguoi trong xom biet anh la dong tinh. Nhieu “cong tu” Sai Gon tim den anh an ai roi cung cho tien nhung anh khong lay. “Neu lam vay, khac gi minh la trai bao, Dung khong thich vay”, Dung chia se. Khong nhung the, tren cac buc tuong cua nha ve sinh nu cung khong he thieu nhung dong chu nhu tren. Ha Anh, quan Go Vap, ke lai: “Moi lan co nhu cau su dung nha ve sinh o ben xe mien Dong la toi lai so. Chi co khoang 5-6 nha ve sinh nu thoi, nhung hau nhu tren canh cua va buc tuong nao cung co vai cau ga tinh, rat do ban va vo van hoa”. Tham chi, quan sat o cac nha ve sinh nam cua Dai hoc K. tai quan 1, TP.HCM, chung toi cung thay khong thieu nhung loi ga gam duoc ghi bang but bi tren cac canh cua. Tro dua cua ke choi ban Da phan, cac so dien thoai duoc ghi nhech nhac o nhung noi cong cong, dac biet la nhung cho kin nhu nha ve sinh ben xe, noi co nhieu nguoi ra vao. Cac so dien thoai nay duoc ghi voi nhung loi chao moi cua nguoi dong gioi, gai mai dam, va khong it nguoi bi hai boi tro ban cua ke xau. Cac doi tuong thuong chon cac tu diem nha ve sinh o khu vuc ben xe, ga tau de viet bay len tuong nha ve sinh. Khi hoi thue bao co so 01676277… “Co phai ban la nguoi da ghi so dien thoai minh len tren nha ve sinh khong?” Chung toi nhan duoc mot trang chui rua khong ngung tu co gai co so dien thoai duoc ghi tren toilet cong cong. Binh tinh giai thich mot hoi, co gai moi chiu noi ro cho chung toi ve viec da bi lam phien trong thoi gian qua nhu the nao. Co cho biet: “Gan day minh hay bi quay ray boi nhung so dien thoai la, noi loi nham nho, lam toi rat buc boi. Khi thi “di choi khong cung”? Khi thi “bao nhieu mot dem”? Lam toi bi khung hoang tinh than nghiem trong. Khong biet ai da choi cai tro doc ac nhu vay”. Dong canh ngo voi co gai ke tren, nhung Hoai lai co so phan bi tham hon. So dien thoai cua anh duoc ghi day ray o cac nha ve sinh ben xe voi loi chao moi cac gay. Hoai bi lam phien trong mot thoi gian dai, luc nao cung co so la “hoi tham” lam Hoai kho chiu. Hoai cho biet: “Dem nao toi cung bi lam phien boi nhung so dien thoai la voi nhung tin nhan rat khung khiep. Te hon, khong may la ban gai toi vo tinh doc duoc tin nhan tu so dien thoai la vua gui den, lam co ay con nghi ngo gioi tinh cua toi, gian toi ca thang roi chia tay. Bao hai toi bi don la gay, ca truong deu biet”. “Sim so dep nen minh khong the bo duoc, voi lai co nhieu moi quan he trong danh ba, bo sim thi rat tiec ma tiep tuc tinh trang nay thi co nuoc chet! Chi biet la chan cuoc goi nhung khong biet o dau so dien thoai la cu goi den hoai. Tinh hinh nay chac minh phai doi sim that qua”, Hoai chia se. Khong it nhung so dien thoai tren la tro choi ban cua ke xau giau mat Te hon nua la truong hop cua chi Mai Thi Q.T. (quan 9), ten va so dien thoai cua chi bi mot ke xau nao do ghi len tuong cua ben xe, ga tau va rat nhieu nha ve sinh cong cong khac. Chi ke lai: “Nua dem, dang nam ngu voi chong thi chuong dien thoai reo, bat may len thi duoc nghe mot giong nam ga tinh va hoi gia ca. Toi hoang hot bao lai voi nguoi ta la nham so, nhung ca dem ay lai co gan 10 cuoc dien thoai khac tuong tu. Chong toi ban dau trach moc toi rat nhieu, nhung roi anh cung hieu ra la co nguoi hai toi”. Chi T. dang giu mot cuong vi quan trong trong mot doanh nghiep, viec canh tranh dan den ganh ghet ma bi tra thu la kho tranh khoi. Nhung, viec thay so dien thoai se lam mat di nhieu moi khach hang, nen khi co ai goi den ga tinh, chi buoc phai hoi xem ho co so dien thoai cua chi tu dau roi thue nguoi den do cao va tay xoa cac so dien thoai. Cuoi cung, chi cung khong tranh khoi nhung cuoc goi rat mat van hoa va buoc phai doi sim khac. Mot nhan vien quet don nha ve sinh tai mot ben xe o TP.HCM cho biet: “Nhung buc tuong da duoc quet voi nhieu lan nhung nhu “bat coc bo dia”, so dien thoai lai duoc ghi len tuong ngay khi con chua rao son”. Qua so dien thoai chao hang, nhung cuoc mua ban dam van am tham dien ra ngay cang tinh vi, chuyen nghiep. Nhung tro dua vo nghia du vo tinh hay co y cung da gian tiep gay anh huong lon den cuoc song cua nguoi bi hai. Truoc thuc trang tren: “Co quan chuc nang can som dieu tra lam ro de tra lai cuoc song rieng tu cho chung toi noi rieng va trat tu xa hoi noi chung”, Hoai, nguoi bi hai da kien nghi. ‘Luoi cau tinh duc’ cua phu nu
Xem bản tiếng việt đầy đủ tại đây : http://60s.com.vn/index/1103296/27012008.aspx‘Luoi cau tinh duc’ cua phu nu"Luoi cau tinh duc" la thuat ngu duoc mot so chuyen gia ve gioi tinh dat cho hien tuong "ma luc" trong "chuyen ay" cua phu nu. Hieu duoc dieu nay, moi nguoi chung ta se bao ve duoc suc khoe tinh duc va hanh phuc gia dinh.<?xml:namespace prefix = o ns = "urn:schemas-microsoft-com:office:office" />
Ho quan quyt lay nhau may ngay lien tren giuong ngu va khong ra khoi nha. Nhung khong the nao hieu noi co dieu gi bi an o con nguoi nay: Anh ta khong dep trai, khong co hoc van cao, nhung bu lai co mot co the luc luong va lam cho Nhung suyt nua thi mat ca ly tri do duoc thoa man den tot do.
Tuy nhien, ngay ca trong nhung phut khoai cam nhat voi Binh, Nhung van nho den Thanh. May ngay sau, Binh goi dien cho Nhung va de nghi duoc gap de noi chuyen. Binh quyet dinh de nghi cuoi Nhung lam vo. Nhung chua dong y ngay voi ly do “can phai co mot thoi gian de suy nghi”. Tat nhien, Nhung van rat yeu Thanh nhung lieu co the tu choi nhung xuc cam tinh duc “than tien” doi voi Binh duoc khong? Va nen lam nhu the nao?
Quy ong nao co nguy co mac “luoi cau tinh duc”
Ro rang, o day da dien ra cai ma cac chuyen gia tam ly hoc goi la “su phu thuoc tinh duc”.
Thuc ra, trong cuoc song thuong co su phu thuoc tinh yeu nhieu hon va da so phu nu ung ho quan diem nay. Boi le, moi mot nguoi phu nu deu co mo uoc gap duoc mot “hoang tu” cua chinh minh. Va khi ho vua nhin thay mot con nguoi phan nao giong voi khuon mau ly tuong do, ho gan nhu bi cuon hut vao nguoi do.
Nguyen nhan su phu thuoc cua phu nu vao nguoi dan ong truoc het la do ban chat tam ly. Con nguoi dan ong phu thuoc vao phu nu truoc het la khia canh sinh ly. O nguoi dan ong, khac voi phu nu, uoc mo chu yeu trong cuoc doi cua ho khong phai la gap duoc mot “cong chua” cua rieng minh ma la lam the nao co duoc ham muon khong bao gio can trong “chuyen ay”. Chinh vi do uoc mo nay ma dan ong thuong bi mac vao cai goi la “luoi cau tinh duc”.
Trong nhom nhung nguoi dan ong co nguy co bi mac vao cai bay nay sau tuoi 30 la nhung nguoi dan ong co kha nang duc tinh o muc do trung binh.
Khi con tre, nguoi dan ong thuong khoe manh hon ve mat the luc va ham luong testosteron trong mau cung cao hon nen ho tu tin va khong phai lo lang qua ve “chuyen ay”.
Nhung khi da dung tuoi, nguoi dan ong do moi nhan ra duoc su non kem cua minh trong “chuyen ay”, ma bieu hien cu the la kha nang cuong cung cung kem hon va cac xuc cam tinh duc cung yeu hon.
O nhung nguoi dan ong do, thoi gian mot lan “sinh hoat” toi da chi co 5 phut va doi khi ho bi “xuat binh” som. Di nhien, ho hoan toan khong co kha nang “lap lai chien cong” lan thu hai, ngay sau khi ket thuc lan 1. Nang luc qua yeu trong “chuyen ay” thuong dan ho den trang thai tram cam, tham chi la roi loan than kinh.
Hay tuong tuong xem su the se the nao, neu mot nguoi dan ong kieu do gap duoc mot nguoi phu nu co kha nang dem lai cho anh ta cam giac la mot “sieu nhan” trong “chuyen ay”?
That ra, loai phu nu nay ho khong bat buoc anh ta phai lap nhieu “chien cong” trong mot “tran chien”. Them nua, phu nu loai nay hoan toan khong co su cuon hut manh me tu ve hinh ben ngoai, ho khong qua thong minh ma cung khong co trinh do hoc van cao, nhung ho co kha nang lam cho nguoi dan ong cam nhan duoc toan bo su dieu ky cua “chuyen ay” va lam cho dan ong quen het tat ca nhung nguoi phu nu khac. Bi quyet do dau?

Chi Pheo la tac pham dien hinh cua van hoc hien thuc phe phan 1930 - 1945, Vo nhat la tac pham dien hinh cua van hoc cach mang Viet Nam giai doan sau 1945. Moi tac pham deu co nhung dac sac nghe thuat rieng, tuy nhien, hai truyen ngan nay deu co mot diem chung, do la cach ket truyen deu rat dang chu y ve gia tri nghe thuat. So phan cua nguoi Viet Nam trong xa hoi thuc dan phong kien truoc cach mang thang Tam bi ban cung hoa, luu manh hoa. Chi Pheo tu mot chang thanh nien khoe manh, co nhan cach, bi Ba Kien bien thanh mot con vat nguoi, mot cong cu thuc hien nhung am muu tham doc. + Chi Pheo da dam chet Ba Kien va tu ket lieu su song cua minh. Tuong nhu day la mot cach giai quyet mau thuan xa hoi. Khong con Ba Kien, khong con Chi Pheo, xa hoi se het bi kich. Nhung khong, voi ket truyen nay, Nam Cao cho thay tuong lai: mot Chi Pheo con sap ra doi va lai lap lai vong doi cua Chi Pheo bo. Ba Kien da chet, nhung con do con trai han – Ly Cuong. Va rat co the, Ly Cuong lai bien Chi Pheo con thanh mot thang luu manh nhu cach bo han da lam voi Chi Pheo. + Ket thuc nay do do cho thay tu tuong nghe thuat sau sac cua nha van Nam Cao ve cuoc doi. Xa hoi muon tot dep hon, cong bang hon, khong the hanh dong mot cach manh dong nhu Chi Pheo tung lam voi Ba Kien. Can hanh dong mot cach quyet liet, dut diem de quet sach nhung Ba Kien, Ly Cuong ra khoi xa hoi. Nguoi dan lang Vu Dai can biet xoa bo nhung dinh kien xa hoi, don nhan su hoan luong cua nhung con nguoi nhu Chi Pheo, thi moi co the co duoc mot xa hoi tot dep hon. (2 diem) - Ket thuc truyen ngan Vo nhat Kim Lan viet: “Trong oc Trang van thay dam nguoi doi va la co do bay phap phoi”. + Ket thuc nay the hien cam quan hien thuc cach mang cua nha van Kim Lan. Cai doi khat da khien cho nhung so phan con nguoi tro nen vo cung re rung. Lay vo von la mot viec trong dai cua mot doi nguoi dan ong, tuc ngu tong ket: tau trau, cuoi vo, lam nha. Lay vo he trong la the, vay ma trong con bi cuc ay, nguoi ta co the “nhat” duoc vo. Qua that, hien thuc cuoc song ay da ha thap nhan pham cua con nguoi. + Mac du the, con nguoi khong tro nen bi luy, lui tan, ma ngay trong nhung hoan canh ay, su song van dang tung ngay, tung gio hoi sinh. Trang lay duoc vo, cam thay vui mung vi hanh phuc trong to am ngheo doi cua minh. + Trang khong nghi den cai chet, su lui tan dang bua vay cuoc song cua anh va gia dinh anh. Anh nghi den hinh anh “dam nguoi doi va la co do bay phap phoi”. + La co la bieu tuong cua To quoc, cua Dang, cua Cach mang. Dam nguoi doi chinh la hinh anh cua quan chung nhan dan ta bi ban cung hoa den cuc diem truoc cuoc Cach mang thang Tam. Hinh anh nay cho thay tu tuong nghe thuat cua nha van Kim Lan. Cuoc song lui tan ay dang hoi sinh. Hinh anh ay chinh la hinh anh thu nho ve Cuoc Cach mang vi dai cua dan toc thang Tam 1945 da dua lich su dan toc ta buoc sang mot trang moi. Con nguoi Viet Nam se thoat khoi kiep song no le, se vung len lam chu cuoc doi, se lay lai pham gia, danh du, chu khong phai la nhung kiep nguoi re mat, bot beo nua. (2 diem) Ket bai: - Moi nha van co mot tu tuong nghe thuat rieng, tuy nhien no deu cho thay mot cam quan hien thuc sau sac cua Nam Cao va Kim Lan. Khong can noi nhieu, dien dat dai dong ma chi can bang nhung ket thuc truyen ngan gon, cac nha van da gui gam vao do nhung tu tuong vo cung sau sac ve cuoc doi, ve so phan con nguoi trong nhung thoi diem bi thuong cua dan toc. Tai nang nghe thuat cua Nam Cao va Kim Lan da duoc the hien ro rang qua nhung cach ket thuc truyen do. (0,5 diem) Cau 3B Yeu cau chung: Phan tich duoc nhung dac sac trong hinh anh cua thien nhien tao vat cua doan tho va tam trang cua nhan vat tru tinh . Y thu nhat : gioi thieu tac gia Huy Can , mot trong nhung nha tho tieu bieu va bai tho Trang Giang tieu bieu cho hon tho Huy Can trong Lua Thieng . Doan trich la buc tranh thien nhien Trang Giang va tam trang cua nhan vat tru tinh khi doi dien voi tao vat trong vu tru Trang Giang (0,5d) Y thu hai : Cam nhan chung ve bai tho Trang Giang (1d) • Trang Giang , mac du duoc goi tu tu hinh anh song Hong nhung do la hinh anh cua khong gian vu tru qua hinh anh mot dong Trang Giang, cung voi “noi buon duoi day hon nhan the” , “ noi sau van ky “ chat chua trong Lua Thieng cua Huy Can . Dong thoi Trang Giang cung la “nang buon song nui” cua nha tho truoc hien thuc dat nuoc bi ngoai xam (0,75d) • Trang Giang la su ket hop hai hoa giua ve dep co dien voi mot hon tho moi – Huy Can (0,25d) Y thu ba : Trang Giang , mot cai nhin toan canh va noi buon cua con nguoi khi doi dien voi cai vo cung vo tan cua vu tru (1,5d) • Bon dong tho thu nhat co the coi la buc tranh toan canh cua Trang Giang duoc nhan manh boi su tuong phan giua cai menh mong cua song nuoc Trang Giang voi su be nho cua tao vat + Cai menh mang cua Trang Giang duoc mo ra ngay tu cau tho dau tien, mot cau tho day song , tu chu mo dau “ song” cho toi chu cuoi cung “ diep diep” , ‘Vua la noi buon diep diep , vua la song gon diep diep . + Hai chu Trang Giang buong xuong giua cau tho cang tao am huong menh mang cua song nuoc , goi mot “dong song lon , mot dai giang “ + Them vao mot chu “buon” , dong Trang Giang da tro thanh dong song tam trang (0,5d) Tao vat tu “con thuyen” den canh cui , deu lam noi bat su be nho huu han cua tao vat trong su tuong phan voi cai menh mang cua Trang Giang . Giong nhu mot thu phap “lay diem de noi dien” , hinh anh tao vat cang lam noi bat cai vo cung vo tan cua Trang Giang , cua vu tru + Hinh anh con thuyen co chuyen dong ma khong co tieng dong goi su tinh lang goi mot noi buon mang mac . Con thuyen voi noi sau tram nga cang lam noi bat mot “Trang Giang buon “ . Nhung chu “song song”, “tram nga “ con lam cho Trang Giang tro nen ron ngop + Hinh anh canh cui kho goi ta nho toi cau tho cua Do Phu ‘ Vo bien lac moc tieu tieu ha / Bat tan Truong Giang con con lai ’ . Nhung cau tho Do Phu gan voi cam hung nghe thuat , con o cau tho cua Huy Can canh cui gan lien voi cam hung lang mang ,mot noi buon mang mac truoc canh song nuoc menh mang. Thu phap dao trat tu “ Cui mot canh kho”,dac biet su tuong phan ve so luong “mot canh” va “ may dong” nham nhan manh cai be nho cua tao vat .(1d) Y thu tu : Tao vat tren dong Trang Giang va noi niem co don le loi cua nhan vat tru tinh (1,5d) • Mot Trang Giang trong trai diu hiu va tam trang bo vo cua nhan vat tru tinh (1d) + Tao vat Trang Giang tu “ con nho” , “gio diu hiu”, nhung am thanh cho chieu tu dang xa goi ve deu lam noi bat mot khong gian khong chi yen tinh ma con vo cung trong trai + Nhung chu “ lo tho” chi su thua thot , “diu hiu” chi su chuyen dong nhe nhang day hu thuc tao an tuong ve su trong trai + Tac gia su dung thu phap lay “dong” de noi “tinh” , lay tieng cho tu dang xa vong ve mot cach mo ho “dau “ de lam noi bat cai yen tinh den vo cung cua Trang Giang • Khong gian Trang Giang duoc mo ra theo chieu cao , chieu sau, chieu dai, chieu rong cot de lam noi bat cai co lieu cua ben song . Cac tu chi chieu khong gian “xuong “, “len” chi thuoc do khong gian dai rong con de lam noi bat noi co don cua con nguoi. “ben co lieu” cung la ben long cua thi nhan . Nhung chu “ Sau chot vot” vua chi chieu cao cua bau troi lai vua chi cai tham tham trong noi niem cua nhan vat tru tinh(0,5d) Y thu nam (0,5d) : Nhan xet tong quat ve buc tranh thien nhien va tam trang cua nhan vat tru tinh • Thien nhien dep ma buon . Jack Ma lam gi tiep theo sau khi nghi huu som o tuoi 55?
Jack Ma vua chinh thuc tu chuc Chu tich Alibaba hom 10/9 sau hai thap ky xay dung va dieu hanh. Ong se lam gi tiep theo la cau hoi cua khong it nguoi.
Jack Ma tu chuc Chu tich Alibaba ngay 10/9
Jack Ma nghi huu khi moi 55 tuoi va muon danh toan bo thoi gian con lai cho tu thien. Ong lap quy Jack Ma nam 2014, lay cam hung tu quy Bill & Melinda Gates. Duncan Clark, tac gia cuon sach “Alibaba: Ngoi nha Jack Ma xay dung” noi rang ty phu luon the hien su quan tam toi thien nguyen, moi truong, trao quyen cho phu nu, giao duc va phat trien.
Tai su kien cong ty vao thang 9/2018, ong Ma phat bieu: “Truoc khi 70 tuoi, toi co the lam dieu gi do trong cac linh vuc khac, chang han giao duc”.
Ong Ma thong bao ke hoach tu chuc mot nam truoc. Sau khi tu bo Ban quan tri cap cao, ong se tiep tuc dinh hinh tuong lai cua cong ty thong qua Alibaba Partnership, mot nhom gom 36 lanh dao de ra muc tieu, tam nhin va gia tri. Ong dang nam 6,22% co phan Alibaba. CEO Daniel Zhang se dam nhan chuc vu Chu tich ma ong de lai.
Jack Ma la doanh nhan noi tieng nhat Trung Quoc voi tai san gan 40 ty USD. Xuat than la giao vien day tieng Anh, ong thuong noi ve dam me doi voi giao duc. Ngay ma ong chon chinh thuc tu chuc, 10/9, chinh la ngay nha giao tai Trung Quoc. Do cung chinh la sinh nhat tuoi 55 cua ong.
Ong lien he toi nghe nghiep truoc day de giai thich ly do ve sao lai tu chuc. “Giao vien luon muon hoc sinh vuot qua ho, vi the trach nhiem cua toi va cong ty la de lop tre tai nang hon nam vai tro lanh dao”.
Nam 2018, ong tung noi ve thach thuc cua giao duc tuong lai tai Dien dan kinh te the gioi. Ong canh bao “neu khong thay doi cach day hoc, 30 nam toi chung ta se gap rac roi”. Ong cho rang cach day hoc dua tren kien thuc hien nay se lam cho bon tre that bai, khong bao gio canh tranh duoc voi may moc. Tre em nen duoc day “ky nang mem” nhu suy nghi doc lap, gia tri va lam viec nhom.
Nam 2017, quy cua ong Ma cam ket danh 45 trieu USD trong 10 nam de kham pha va boi duong nhan tai dao tao tai nong thon Trung Quoc. Ong cung huong toi cac thi truong dang phat trien khac ngoai que nha.
Bieu tuong cong nghe “chia se tam nhin va kinh nghiem kinh doanh tai cac khu vuc nhu chau Phi”, noi ong treo giai doanh nhan 10 trieu USD. Ong con gay quy cho cac sang kien bao ve dong vat hoang da va phat trien quan he hoa hao voi cac lanh dao chau Phi.
Jack Ma va Alibaba to chuc hoi thao 2 nam/lan tai Trung Quoc ve phu nu va doanh nhan tu nam 2015. Su kien thu hut nhieu ten tuoi lon nhu Arianna Huffington va Vera Wang. Hoi thao nam nay con co tin nhan video cua ca sy Rihanna.
Ong cho biet phu nu luon dong vai tro khong the thieu trong Alibaba ke tu khi thanh lap 20 nam truoc. Binh dang gioi la mot trong cac van de quan trong nhat trong the ky 21 va “neu muon doanh nghiep thanh cong, bo nhiem du lanh dao nu la vo cung can thiet”. Thuc te, gan mot nua doi ngu lanh dao cap cao tai Alibaba la nu.
Thang 11/2018, Jack Ma duoc chinh phu Trung Quoc vinh danh la 1 trong 100 nguoi co nhung “dong gop noi bat” cho chuyen doi kinh te nuoc nay 4 thap ky qua. Ong Ma nghi viec tai Alibaba khi con tuong doi tre. Truoc day, ong tung tho lo muon nghi huu som hon Bill Gates, nguoi tu chuc Chu tich Microsoft o tuoi 58 nam 2014.

Le hoi dang bi lam hong
Le hoi dang bi lam hongTags: To Hoai, ban to chuc, bi lam hong, khach thap phuong, le hoi, chung ta, nguoi ta, truyen thong, tai sao, van hoa, den, hang, lo, thanh, noi
Co quan noi toi cong tac la mot co quan it nguoi, thanh ra cong viec cap tren phai lo, bon toi nhin qua cung biet. Chang han mot trong nhung noi lo ma cac Sep tet nhat den phai lo la lam sao co tien to chuc cho anh em mot dip du xuan di cac le hoi. Toi von thich tham thu cac di san tu lau. Nay co dip thi san sang. Ngoai the nghiem ban than, toi cham chu doc them su phan anh tren bao chi. Nhung, phai noi ngay, cang tham gia cang thay… ngan ngai. Van de toi muon de nghi moi nguoi cung suy nghi hom nay la tai sao le hoi lai dien bien nhu no dang xay ra, tai sao dan da chung ta da lam hong le hoi di trong khi van bi cuon theo no va co ve nhu khong the thoat khoi no. NHIN TU TAM LY NGUOI ÐI HOI Su sai lac cua muc dich Mot trong nhung dinh huong tam ly cua dan ta sau chien tranh la xu the quay ve truyen thong, tim cach giai thich chien thang tu truyen thong va muon tim hieu lai truyen thong. Bao Lao dong ngay 19-2-2003 khi hoi tai sao nguoi ta di hoi, dua ra con so 3% noi di de biet, 1% di theo phong trao, 5% di de thu gian con con so di ve niem tin tin nguong la 91%. Toi khong tin o nhung cau tra loi do voi nghia nhung nguoi tra loi da noi dung y nghi cua ho. Theo su quan sat cua toi thi dang sau cai vo tro ve truyen thong la mot mang tam linh phuc tap va rac roi hon. Nhu cau cua nguoi tham gia le hoi thuc chat la gi ? Trong mot cong trinh nghien cuu duoc su bao tro cua Vien Harvard Yenching mang ten Su bien doi cua ton giao va tin nguong o VN hien nay (in 2006), ngay trong phan dan luan, nguoi ta da doc duoc mot nhan xet dai y noi trong xa hoi hien dai, su hoi sinh cua ton giao ke ca hinh thuc so khai nhu cac le hoi cac cuoc hanh huong cau cung… chinh la mot cach phan ung cua con nguoi truoc nhung thay doi lon lao ma nen kinh te thi truong mang lai. “Co cau nen moi co cung.” Nhu cau noi o day truoc tien la tren phuong dien tinh than. Vao nhung ngay xuan trong moi con nguoi chung ta thuc day ca mot dinh huong tam linh. Muon tim toi phan sau kin trong chinh minh va chung quanh. Muon hieu qua khu. Muon tu cat nghia. Tro ve coi nguon… Co ket voi cong dong thong qua cac bieu hien tho cung… Can bang doi song tam linh… Vua sang tao vua huong thu van hoa… Nhung luan diem ca tung le hoi da duoc cac nha nghien cuu van hoa o ta neu kha day du va nhieu nguoi chia se. Nhung do moi chi la mot phan su thuc. Gan nhu trong long moi nguoi di hoi Viet Nam xua nay, mot muc dich kep da duoc dat ra - dong thoi voi viec hanh huong van hoa, ta dat vao day kha nang nhung nguyen vong ca nhan nhu la cau may va cau loi. Tam ly cau may von la ban duong cua nhung con nguoi boi roi truoc doi song. The gioi luon luon ham chua nhung bat trac. Cuoc song con nhieu bong toi, nguoi ta danh mat ca niem tu tin, thuong xuyen moi nguoi cam thay minh chi la vat hy sinh cua so phan. Cuoc truy duoi van may khong biet co hua hen ket qua gi khong, nhung co lam van hon. Nhung luc luong sieu nhien va ca nhung ngau nhien bat chot thanh cho bau viu cho nhung ao tuong. Boi su bat trac cung dang bao trum trong viec lam an, nen khia canh cau may cung da co mat trong viec cau tai cau loi. Thuc te la bao nguoi tu te vi khong biet tro trao lieu linh lam can van that bat, nguoc lai lam bay van duoc, gioi muu mo xao quyet tu khac giau len dung dung. Trong nhung luc lang lai doi dien voi minh, nhung ke thanh dat bang con duong gian doi khong khoi hoang so. Cung mot luc nay sinh hai tam trang. Mot mat lo bi trung phat, phai di tim than thanh de hoi lo. Mat khac tiep tuc phieu luu vao con duong toi loi, mong rang cai van may hom qua nay lai gap lai. Cau cung chinh la mot dip nuoi duong nhung tham vong ngau duc muon tim vao cho tam toi cua dam dong de duoc nuoi duong va an tam song tiep. Thuc chat cua cau cung cua hanh huong la the. Cung voi tham vong dua da vui choi, no lam nen bo mat chinh cua cac le hoi thoi gian qua. Dua nhau tim co hoi xa lang Hay thu den voi mot so hoi co tieng la thieng. Vao nhung thang truoc va sau Tet am lich nguoi dong nhu hoi, nguoi chat nhu nem, vao den roi, co khi dung hang tieng dong ho hai tay moi roi voi mam le dang bung, ma van khong le noi doi chan den ben ban tho. Nhung ai di le ma lam the? Dan buon, tat nhien roi. Nhung thoi buoi nay, quoc doanh khong chiu kem tu nhan ve lam an, thi lam sao lai chiu kem tu nhan ve le bai - nghe noi o nhieu cong ty, anh em xum lai chuan bi vang huong de “sep” danh xe di lam le. Ngoai viec tim ve cong dong, dam dong, de cung co them su tu tin, long ham song, - di hoi tuc la trong mot khoanh khac ngan ngui nhung thu vi, nguoi ta cam thay nhu duoc vuot ra khoi su thong kho cua doi song thuong nhat, de tha ho song thoa thich, song theo y muon. Cac nha nghien cuu van hoa da tong ket : Le hoi vua hoan lac vua co tinh chat le nghi. Le hoi hoa giai nhung dieu trai nguoc. Le hoi lien ket nhung gi ma dong ngay thang co xu huong muon tach roi — nghiem trang va leu long, ton giao va pham tuc, tan pha va phuc hoi. Trong khi di tim cai thieng lieng, nhieu khi le hoi chang khac gi mot cuoc truy hoan phong dang. Leu long, tan pha, pham tuc, xa lang… Cai khia canh thu hai o day lai dang duoc chung ta day di qua tron. Thuc ra loi den voi le hoi nhu the von co tu xua. Tro lai voi mot cuon sach duoc viet o Sai gon truoc 1975 mang ten Hoi he dinh dam, toi thay tac gia Toan Anh ghi ro ba dac diem cua hoi he nguoi Viet la tinh luyen ai, tinh chien dau va tinh do bac. Dich ra tu vung hien dai, tuc cac le hoi do thuong cho phep con nguoi buong tha trong cac hanh dong dam tuc va thuong dien lai bao luc von co trong hoan canh su da man con ngu tri. Con do bac la tu Han Viet de chi co bac cung nhu bao quat chung cac te nan xa hoi khac. Trong mot so bao Ngay nay ra nam 1938, toi con doc mot bai viet cua Tu Ly mang ten Hoi Lim... hoi liec, trong do ke chuyen bon cong tu Ha thanh ve Hoi Lim thuong do tro cot nha. Va mot nguoi nhu nha van To Hoai cung thu thuc voi bon toi la chinh lang ong xua nay dau co hoi, chi toan di xem nho thien ha. Kha nhat co hoi lang Dong thi cung la dip de cac ho tranh chap, trai gai di hoi de khoe khoang may thu mot moi hoc doi va nhung cau choai choai trang trao “chim” gai hoac danh nhau. Gio day, khi ma hang quan karaoke moc len nhu nam o cac pho phuong va cac loai bia om, com om nhan nhan khap noi den do bao chi phai len tieng thi con ai phai cho den le hoi moi thuc hien cuoc song ngoai vong cam doan nhu con nguoi trung the ky. Vay ma nguoi ta van di hoi, tai sao? Di de “xa hoi”, du ngoan, ngam canh. Va nhat la di de duoc song trong hoi, kho so ve hoi, va tro ve, nhin vao mat nhung nguoi hang xom voi chut tu hao nho nho la minh da di hoi. Tom lai, di de cam thay, minh da song giong nhu tat ca moi nguoi, de khoi cam thay lac long, y gia sau xa la the. NHIN TU PHIA ÐIA PHUONG TO CHUC Bung phat vo toi va Cai nhu cau cua khach thap phuong chung ta nhu tren vua ta, nhanh chong duoc dan va nha chuc trach cac dia phuong chap nhan va dap ung, ngay tu khau so luong Khong phai den ngay nay ma tu hai chuc nam truoc, da co nhieu tieng phan nan, ma loi phan nan dau tien dang de y la: Sao nhieu le hoi the? Theo tri nho cua mot nguoi noi tieng la “cuong ky” (noi nom na la gioi nho) nhu nha van To Hoai, nhung nam tu 1945 ve truoc, o vung Buoi que ong, day khong phai la viec lam dan deu. Cung bai thi lang nao cung co. Nhung hoi thi khong chac. Chi co mot so lang nhu the nao do moi co hoi va hoi o day mo ra, khong chi danh cho dan so tai ma con cho dan lang khac den xem. Dieu ma nhung nguoi co cai nhin nghiem tuc ve le hoi lo lang, cang ngay cang thay co ly. Le hoi hom nay dang thanh mot tro thanh mon thoi thuong! Mot hien tuong tuong nhu hoan toan co sac thai truyen thong lai dang ton tai theo quy luat cua thi truong, ma tren net lon nguoi ta co the phac ra mot loat bieu hien. Co su chin ep, tuc thuc day nhung noi khong co le hoi cung co bia ra le hoi. Co le hoi chi manh nha be nho bi day len thanh le hoi hoanh trang ve tam voc ma lai “hang ma” ve chat luong. Roi la co su canh tranh dua da. Co tin o vung giap ranh Ha Nam va Ha Tay co mot ngoi den goi la den Thanh Ca. Ben Ha Nam thay ben Ha Tay dong khach, nen tu nam 1999 lien cho xay mot ngoi den tuong tu voi cac loai hoanh phi cau doi tuong tu va goi la den trinh Thanh Ca de tranh khach. Giai quyet mai khong xong. Noi dung van hoa nhot nhat pha tap Muon la mot chuyen con lam duoc hay khong la mot chuyen khac. Trinh do to chuc cac le hoi hien nay khong theo kip nhan thuc cua cong dong, toan lap di lap lai, hon tap, tam thuong. Chua chien duoc sang sua nhieu. Nhung dang le phai nghiem tuc nghien cuu de trung tu cho ra khong khi co kinh thi nguoi ta lai chi lo to lai mot it chu nho lam dang, va thuong la to sai. Cac buc tuong bi boi xanh boi do khien cong trinh sac so mot cach kho coi. Phan hoi ma cac Ban to chuc buoc khach thap phuong phai xem cung khong kha hon. Mot hai chiec thuyen rong dat trong cai ao can khong sao goi duoc ve tru tinh can thiet. Cac dieu mua o cac dia phuong khac nhau ma qua giong nhau, hinh nhu quanh quan hoc cua nhau ca. Nhung dieu mua don so va tho thien. Nhung dieu nhac pha tap. Nhung chi tiet trang tri lo lang va cau tha, nhung mat bang chat choi lung cung, xau xi… Su thuc dien ra to cao chung ta co mot van hoa le hoi kha ngheo nan. Tiep tuc cau chuyen To Hoai ke ve le hoi xua va nay. Vung ong xua nay nhieu hoi, nhung toan hoi “nhat nhu nuoc oc” – chu cua To Hoai trong nguyen van. Lang moi nam vao dam mot lan, nhung cung so sai tam bo, co nam mat trom ao thanh “phai lay vat co duoi nheo trum len ngai lam ao khoac cho thanh”. Xua nhung ganh cheo duoc moi ve dam cung toan la phuong kiet xac, may bac kep vua hat xong chay voi vao hau truong, rep roi la ta tu mieng go lam cho cam co deo sau lung. Nay viec lang do may anh can bo di khap thien ha ve khoi xuong thi cung chang kha hon.Toan tho te di thue o cac lang ben canh. Con ong chu te thi chu Nho be lam doi khong biet, den thanh hoang lang ten gi cung khong biet not. Truoc la phuc vu sau la kiem an Tam ly cau loi ma chung ta da noi o phan dan di hoi cung dang chi phoi ca nhung nguoi lam le hoi don khach cau cung. Boi ho cung chi nhu chung ta. Ban dau ho cung say nguoi vi nhung muc dich cao ca. Nhung roi cuoc song hang ngay chi phoi, ho cung sa da vao canh buon than ban thanh, nhan danh su thieng lieng cua le hoi de lam chuyen lua loc. Dan ba di ban vang huong, xoi banh, hoa qua, cac thu hang cung va khong quen nhung thu lam no bung nguoi di tho cung. Dan ong di trong xe, di giu trat tu, nguoi nao co dang nho nha va kheo hoc lom mot chut con kiem ca viet so. Viec cho tre con di kiem tien cung khong thieu. Tan buoi hoc ve - day la noi nhung dua chua tien bo hoc - chung sap ngua chay ra truoc cua den. Do nghe chang can gi, chi co cai mieng kheo noi, voi lai doi tay bung be chac chan, la tha ho dat khach. Lan ay toi theo vo di le Ba chua Kho. Vua xuong xe da co nguoi bam theo, mieng thao thao nhung la de em sua le cho bac, de em dan bac di viet so. Leo deo theo mai den luc vao den cong den ma chung toi khong nhan dat hang, ho quay lai chui, nhung la do ngu voi lai phi ca loi chao cua ho. “Tuong con ca qua, hoa con tep ranh !”. Ho khai quat ve chung toi nhu vay. Dan sao Ban to chuc vay Hai chu thuong mai hoa von khong co loi. Nhung hay nhin vao cach hieu ve thuong mai hoa hien nay. Ben canh viec ban voi gia “cat co” cac mat hang cung, le; “chat chem” o cac bai trong giu xe, nguoi ta khong quen dui voi cho dam khach thap phuong truoc khi ra ve, mot so thu hang ky niem loai rom. Thoi thi lay troi lay phat, cac bac di le de cau loi thi cung phai chia loi voi chung em moi ben mot ti, cho hop voi le cong bang! Lai da thay co nhung truong hop, su vu loi tien sat den dieu gia doi, chang han bien mot ngoi den von thuoc dam tu thanh den tho anh hung dan toc, hoac sua sang to diem mot diem du lich vua phat hien thanh mot noi co y nghia lich su. Vay la ca cac ban to chuc dia phuong cung theo tinh than vu loi ma lam viec. Dan lang lo ban hang. Hang giang ra tu xa den gan (den muc mot bai bao viet ve le hoi no da truong len cai dau de khai quat: “Chua hay cho?” Con ban to chuc thi sao? Viec quan ly mot dam dong hang tram hang van nguoi la mot chuyen phuc tap. Song khong ai nhan la minh khong biet, ma chi bao nhau cu de tu nhien, the nao cung xong(!) Nam nao cung rut kinh nghiem ma chang nam nao thay trat tu ve sinh nhuc nhich. Thanh cong cua mot le hoi, sau het hinh nhu trong vao muc “cong duc” thu duoc nhieu hay it, va su thuc nguoi ta da nghi ve no nhieu hon moi chuyen khac. NGUON CON TU ÐAU CHUNG TA LAI CO NHUNG LE HOI NHU VAY Trong nhung ly do can tim hieu de giai thich su mat thieng, dong thoi la tinh trang lam hong le hoi toi muon nhan manh mot la that ra le hoi hom nay dang mang rat nhieu net no von co trong lich su cong dong va hai la xa hoi nao le hoi vay. Mo hinh xa hoi thu nho Tren cac mat bao, nhung hang tit kieu nhu: Tham hai le hoi. Buon lo le hoi. Co bac “ap dao” van hoa le hoi. Phai chang le hoi dang dan chung ta lac duong… van xuat hien thuong xuyen. Dac biet co nhieu bai viet, nhieu binh luan noi ve noi so cua nguoi di hoi thoi nay. Tai sao lai co tinh trang nhu vay? Cau tra loi chung nhat trong truong hop nay chi co the la su giong nhau giua le hoi va doi song . Voi nhung dam dong hon don, le hoi thuc da la dien hinh cua tinh trang tu phat ban nang cua doi song nguoi Viet. No dang mat thieng vi bao nhieu phuong dien khac nhau cua doi song dang bi ha hoi . Tai sao, het hoi nay den hoi khac, chung ta dua da nhau de di bang duoc? Vi biet bao viec hang ngay ta lam dau co hieu vi sao ma lam, dung ra la chi nham mat dua chan theo nhau ma song, yen tam lam vi co bao nhieu nguoi dang lam nhu minh. Tren manh dat muon doi ngheo kho la dong bang Bac bo nay, mot khong khi mua ban xoay xoa kiem chac dang len vao moi mat doi song. Tham chi, mot to bao da khai quat: Nay la thoi toan dan vao cau ca nuoc danh qua. Lam sao le hoi co the nam ngoai cai xu huong noi chung do? Phai chang, cai su buon than ban thanh o day chi la tiep tuc cac vu mua quan ban chuc mua bang ban hoc vi ngoai doi. Nguoi ta giam dap len dong tien. Nguoi ta nhet tien vao bat cu cho nao duoc cho la thieng lieng. Tai sao cho nao cung thay keu ve nhung Ban to chuc chi co trinh do lang xa, nhung lai nhat quyet dung ra to chuc cho hang chuc ngan nguoi. Thuc te, chi lo to chuc mot it bai giu xe va giu trat tu cung khong xong ? PHAI THAY ÐOI TU QUAN NIEM Mot buoc giat lui Trong bai tap van Chien binh khi da ve gia, in trong Tuyen tap cua minh, nha van Nguyen Khai ve ra mot buc tranh doi lap. Buoc vao khang chien chong Phap, thi xa Hung Yen co mot cuoc tu bo lon, do la tu bo moi thoi me tin von da tham can co de. Boi but o chua Chuong, bo. Xin the o den Mau, cung bo. Ruoc Niem, ruoc Du cua hoi Mau vao thang ba ta cung bo luon. Con gio day nguoi ta dua nhau le bai. Va la nhat la may ong can bo cu nha minh cung tham gia vao viec te le mot cach hao hung. Mot nhan vat nhu the, co su an nhap tuyet voi voi dam dong chung quanh. Truong hop ma Nguyen Khai vua mieu ta o tren (cung nhu nhieu chuyen tuong tu da duoc nhac toi day do tren mat bao) cho thay mot la van de nhuc nhoi cua nong thon ta hien nay, su tro lai cua nhung tap quan me tin di doan, ma co mot thoi chung ta tuong da tuyet diet. Trong khi suy nghi ve hien tuong nay, va nhung hien tuong “lai gao tuong tu, co nguoi chi do thua cho kinh te thi truong. Nhung co le, nen tim nguyen nhan o ngay trong qua khu may chuc nam qua: co phai la trong khi mai miet voi nhung cong viec lon lao, moi chung ta cung nhu ca que huong lang xom chung ta chua de cho cai moi ngam sau vao minh cho nen khi co dip thuan loi, lap tuc cai cu bot phat tro lai?! …va mot de nghi truoc khi quy hoach lai Dang co nhung no luc muon quan ly le hoi mot cach chat che hon, tham chi tinh toi viec quy hoach lai le hoi. Viec nay truoc tien dat ra voi cac nha lam chinh sach van hoa mot viec ma chung ta hoac bo qua hoac chi lam mot cach dai boi, do la nghien cuu lai ve le hoi. Nhung toi cho rang cai truoc tien can thiet la xa hoi phai tim den mot quan niem dung truoc khi hanh dong.The nao la truyen thong? Co phai cu nham mat khoi phuc lai qua khu mot cach tuy tien vo beo vat tep? Hay la can gan duc khoi trong, dam tu bo nhung “truyen thong” lac hau de tim den mot truyen thong lanh manh phu hop voi nhu cau cua xa hoi hien dai? Bi quyet lam no nguc cua Duong Quy Phi | Lam dep
Xem bản Tiếng Việt có dấu Bi quyet lam no nguc cua Duong Quy Phi
Từ khóa liên quan đến bài viết: Bí quyết làm nở ngực của Dương Quý PhiThan duoc, tu hoa, nui doi, tieu hoa, doi nui, san day, tac dung, tranh thai, bo mau, canh du, phu nu, cai thien vong, an du, kich thuoc vong, ngoc hoan, suon lon, nghien cuu, got vo, cung nga, viec massage Theo su sach, vao doi Duong, phu nu duoc cho la dep, hap dan thi phai tron tria, va Duong Quy Phi da tro thanh hinh mau ly tuong cua ve dep sung suc do. That ngac nhien, bi quyet cua nang lai vo cung gian di, chi la qua du du ma thoi.
"Than duoc" cho vong mot ly tuong
Chuyen rang sau khi vao cung, Ngoc Hoan luon thuong nho que nha. Ngay kia, nang den vuon thuong uyen ngam hoa, nhin thay hoa Mau Don, Nguyet Quy no ro, nghi rang minh bi nhot trong cung, uong phi thanh xuan, khong kim long duoc, buong loi than tho: "Hoa a, hoa a! Nguoi moi nam moi tuoi deu co luc no, con ta den khi nao moi co duoc ngay ay?".
Loi chua dut, le da tuong roi, nang vua so vao hoa, hoa chot thu minh, la xanh cuon lai. Nao ngo, nang so phai la loai hoa trinh nu (cay xau ho). Luc nay, co mot cung nga nhin thay, nguoi cung nga do di dau cung noi cho nguoi khac nghe viec ay. Tu do, moi nguoi goi Duong Ngoc Hoan la "tu hoa" (y noi la nguoi dep den noi hoa cung phai xau ho).
Han la nang rat dep du de xieu long tu quan vuong, chinh khach den thi nhan, dan thuong. Va de giu duoc ve ngoai my mieu ay, theo cac ghi chep lich su, Duong Quy Phi thuong an san day va du du sau nhung ngay kinh nguyet.
Tai sao lai la san day va du du? Va tai sao lai la sau ky kinh nguyet?
Doi voi san phu sau sinh, san day va du du la hai vi giup lam doi dao nguon sua cho em be moi chao doi. Con doi voi mot phu nu binh thuong, san day va du du rat giau lecithin va protein, vua bo sung dinh duong cho co the, bo mau, vua co the kich thich bai tiet oestrogen, giup kich thuoc vong mot duoc tang len.
San day von noi tieng vi dac tinh mat bo cua minh, con du du cung khong kem phan dac luc vi rat giau dinh duong. Chat papain trong du du co kha nang “tieu hoa” protein, carbohydrate va chat beo; cac enzyme co trong du du rat huu ich, kich thich su tiet noi tiet to nu, tang kich co cua vong mot. Tuy nhien an du du song khong phai la cach an tot ma chinh mon du du ham moi la phuong thuoc bo duong nhat cho kich thuoc vong mot.
Dau vay, neu chi an du du chin thi se khong thay co tac dung no nang ro ret boi chat enzyme trong du du xanh moi chinh la tac nhan cai thien khu vuc “doi nui”. Emzyme ay co trong nhua du du - chat dich mau trang tu trong qua tiet ra khi cat, co nhieu nhat trong trai du du xanh va rat it trong du du chin.
Neu muon cai thien vong mot bang du du thi nen an du du xanh. Ngoai ra, du du con co chat lam phan huy protein, day nhanh qua trinh hap thu protein trong co the, neu an ket hop voi cac loai thit, cong dung se duoc phat huy cao do.
Thoi xua, cac nghien cuu khoa hoc va cac bang chung khoa hoc chua duoc chi ra ro ret nhu bay gio, the nhung Duong Quy Phi da biet lam dep bang do an thuc uong theo cach che bien cuc ky moc mac. Moi ngay, Duong Quy Phi deu uong canh du du.
Tuy nhien, khong han du du ma da la… du, sau khi tam xong, nang con sai mot no ty massage nguc cho minh. Viec massage sau khi tam co the kich thich luu thong mau vung nguc. Ngoai ra, de vong mot them goi cam, my nhan ho Duong con goi nu y si den cham cuu, giup nguc hap thu tot hon cac chat dinh duong trong thuc pham va phat trien can doi.
Cac nha y khoa Trung Quoc ngay nay khang dinh, bi quyet cua Duong Quy Phi la mot trong nhung giai phap tang kich thuoc vong mot kha hieu qua ma cach lam lai don gian. Neu kien tri ap dung bi quyet nay, cac chi em ngay nay cung se cai thien duoc vong mot cua minh.
Tac dung tranh thai, bo mau
Mot nghien cuu co lien quan thi ket luan, viec tieu thu du du chin o muc do binh thuong khong gay hai doi voi chuot co thai; nhung du du xanh hoac gan chin (loai con chua nhieu nhua) co the khong an toan cho thai nghen.
Khong chi tot o qua, nhieu bo phan cua cay du du con duoc dung lam thuc an va thuoc chua nhieu benh, nhu benh tim, chung mat ngu, hay hoi hop, dau lung moi goi, viem da day man tinh... Neu ban bi chung it ngu, hay hoi hop, hay lay du du chin, chuoi, cu ca rot moi thu 100 g; xay trong nuoc dua non nao. Them mat ong cho du ngot, uong cach ngay.
Trong 100 g du du co 74-80 mg vitamin C va 500-1.250 IU caroten. Du du con co cac vitamin B1, B2, cac acid gay men va khoang chat nhu kali, canxi, magie, sat va kem.
An du du thuong xuyen co tac dung bo mau, giup hoi phuc gan o nguoi bi sot ret. Do co nhieu sinh to C va caroten nen du du co tac dung chong oxy hoa, tang suc de khang cho co the.
Mot thong tin dang quan tam khac la o An Do, Srilanka va Malaysia, nguoi ta dung la, hat va qua du du xanh de pha thai. Cac cong trinh nghien cuu cho thay tac dung ngua thai co duoc la do chat nhua papain, co nhieu trong qua xanh, la, hat du du. Qua du du da chin it nhua thi khong con tac dung do nua. Mot so nha khoa hoc cho rang, tac dung tren la do nhua du du da pha huy progesterol la tro thai to. Khi vao co the, tac dung cua nhua se tang manh 25 lan so voi khi o ngoai.
Nhung ai quan tam toi cac mon an voi du du, phu nu sau sinh hoac chua co y dinh sinh no ngay, co the tham khao cac cong thuc da duoc ghi chep lai nhu sau voi tan suat 1-2 lan/tuan de tang co nguc trong vai thang.
Du du ham nam tuyet: 15g nam tuyet, ½ qua du du xanh, mot vien duong phen va hanh nhan. Tat ca cac nguyen lieu tren cung ninh trong khoang 20 phut. An mon nay 2 lan/tuan giup da luon min mang, dac biet mang lai su mem mai va san chac cho vong mot dong thoi con giup ngan ngua nep nhan.
Du du ham mong va dau tuong: Du du, mong gio, dau tuong, gung… ninh nhu voi nhau trong khoang hai gio, khong nhung tot cho rieng ba bau ma con cho nhung phu nu muon cai thien "nui doi" cua minh.
Canh du du xanh ham suon lon: Du du xanh got vo, nao sach hot, cat khuc. Suon lon cung chat khuc, dung nuoc soi chan so qua de khu mui tanh. Cho du du va suon lon vao noi ham chung cho den khi nhu.
Ga ham du du: Du du got vo, thai mieng vuong. Ga thai mieng. Xao ga cung gung cho thom, sau do cho nuoc thich hop vao dun, them du du ninh den khi nhu, nem gia vi. Mon nay co the thay mon canh hay dung de an sang…

Study on the susceptibility tests of antibiotics and obtain axenic culture of Nannochloropsis ocutala--《Ecologic Science》2006年06期
《Ecologic Science》 2006-06
Study on the susceptibility tests of antibiotics and obtain axenic culture of Nannochloropsis ocutala
LIU Xiao-juan, DUAN Shun-shan(Institute of Hydrobiology, Jinan University, Guangzhou 510632, China)
Effects of 5 antibiotics (chloramphenicol, penicillin, streptomycin, kanamycin sulfate, gentamycini sulfate) at different concentrations on the growth of Nannochloropsis ocutala were studied. Results showed that at 50 μg·mL-1, growth of N. ocutala was significantly inhibited by chloramphenicol, the highest inhibition was 85.30%, Ic50 of 2 d and 4 d was 293.64 μg·mL-1 and 67.69 μg·mL-1, respectively. Followed by penicillin, gentamycini sulfate, and kanamycin sulfate, the inhibition rate of 4 d was 8.95%, 7.62% and 3.84%, respectively. And 2 d Ic50 of gentamycini sulfate was 316.40 μg·mL-1. Growth of N. ocutala was not inhibited significantly by streptomycin, the inhibition rate was only 3%. According to susceptibility tests of antibiotics, a strategy of serial antibiotic treatments to obtain axenic culture was carried out: 50 μg·mL-1 penicillin,50 μg·mL-1 gentamycini sulfate,100 μg·mL-1 kanamycin sulphate, 50 μg·mL-1 streptomycin.

All fiber thulium-doped fiber laser pumped Q-switched Ho:YAP laser
Ting Yu; Xisheng Ye; Zhongguo Yang; Xiaolong Chen; Wenbin Xia; Jiayang Zhang; Wei Zhang; Jianyu Chen; Jiliang Si; Weibiao Chen
Proc. SPIE 10173, All fiber thulium-doped fiber laser pumped Q-switched Ho:YAP laser, 101731M (12 May 2017); doi: 10.1117/12.2268326
The high power infrared 2μm lasers have been extensively investigated for a number of commercial, scientific and engineering applications, such as remote chemical sensing, medical diagnostics, eye-safe laser radar, and environmental monitoring. Furthermore, high-power 2μm lasers are effective pump sources of optical parametrical oscillators and optical parametrical amplifications to generate mid-infrared 3-5μm laser. In recent years, Ho:YAlO3(Ho:YAP) crystal has drawn great attention as a promising efficient laser material for its long emission wavelength at 2118nm. An acoustic-optical Q-switched Ho:YAP laser pumped by an all fiber thulium-doped fiber laser is demonstrated. The all fiber thulium-doped fiber laser can emit 80W output power, and the output laser wavelength is 1915nm. By using this 1915nm laser to end pump the AO Q-switched Ho:YAP laser system, 2118nm laser with 30W average power and 45ns pulse width at 20kHz repetition rates was obtained.

Thu tuong moi day da dong y giam dien tich dat trong 5 khu cong nghiep tai Long An de lam khu dan cu.
Dat Xanh dinh lum xum, cu lua lich su dat Long An
Nong dat Long An, 2 chu tich huyen duyet phan lo trai luat
Loan bay lua ban dat, ‘ngoi no’ tranh chap o Long An
Ngay lap tuc, hang loat doanh nghiep tu y phan lo, ban nen du chua duoc tinh cap phep hay xac dinh vi tri duoc chuyen doi.
Thong tin nay duoc UBND tinh Long An cho biet tai buoi hop bao dien ra chieu 23/5 de tra loi cac noi dung lien quan den dau tu, xay dung, kinh doanh bat dong san tai cac khu cong nghiep (KCN).
Chua co chu truong dau tu khu dan cu o KCN
Ong Mai Van Nhieu, Chanh van phong - nguoi phat ngon cua UBND tinh Long An cho biet, thoi gian gan day, tinh nay ghi nhan nhieu thong tin phan anh cua bao chi lien quan den mot so du an bat dong san tren dia ban tinh.
Qua xac minh, nhieu du an bat dong san quang cao tren mang co thong tin khong that. Khi giam dien tich cac KCN de xay dung khu dan cu thi tinh hinh phan lo ban nen tai nhung khu vuc nay dien bien phuc tap.
Thong tin ro hon ve van de nay, ong Nguyen Minh Hung, Quyen Giam doc So Xay dung Long An cho biet, tren dia ban tinh hien co 5 KCN da duoc Thu tuong Chinh phu dong y giam dien tich.
Nhieu doanh nghiep o Long An ngang nhien phan lo, ban nen du chua duoc cap phep.
Cu the, KCN Duc Hoa I – Hanh Phuc tu hon 274ha giam xuong con hon 257,6ha; KCN Duc Hoa III – Anh Hong tu hon 55,2ha xuong con hon 44,8ha; KCN Duc Hoa III – Hong Dat tu 99,4ha xuong con 29,4ha; KCN Duc Hoa III – Viet Hoa tu hon 83,2ha xuong con hon 44,4ha; KCN Cau Tram tu hon 77,8ha xuong con hon 69,9ha.
Trong 5 KCN duoc Thu tuong Chinh phu dong y giam dien tich tren thi moi co KCN Duc Hoa III - Hong Dat duoc UBND tinh cho chu truong dau tu khu dan cu tai vi tri giam dien tich KCN voi dien tich khoang 70ha.
Con KCN Duc Hoa I – Hanh Phuc, KCN Duc Hoa III – Anh Hong va KCN Duc Hoa III – Viet Hoa chua co quyet dinh chu truong dau tu cua UBND tinh, chua lap quy hoach chi tiet 1/500. Do vay, cac du an trong KCN nay chua dau tu xay dung co so ha tang cung nhu chua chuyen nhuong quyen su dung dat.
Van ngang nhien phan lo ban nen
Tren thuc te, tai KCN Duc Hoa III – Hong Dat, KCN Cau Tram va KCN Duc Hoa III - Viet Hoa, nhieu doanh nghiep lai ngang nhien phan lo, ban nen du chua duoc cap phep.
Cu the, tai KCN Duc Hoa III – Hong Dat, thang 11/2016 UBND tinh Long An chap thuan cho Cong ty co phan Hong Dat – Long An lam chu dau tu khu dan cu. Sau do, doanh nghiep nay da thi cong ha tang ky thuat, song chua dau tu xay dung ha tang xa hoi nhu truong hoc, cho, he thong xu ly nuoc thai… va chua thuc hien cac thu tuc ve dau tu xay dung.
Mac du vay, chu dau tu da chuyen nhuong 2.500 lo cho khach hang theo hinh thuc ky hop dong nguyen tac va hien tai da co 65 ho dan xay nha o. Do do, ngay 18/3, Cong ty Hong Dat – Long An da bi Thanh tra So Xay dung tinh xu phat ve hanh vi xay dung ha tang ky thuat khu dan cu khong co giay phep xay dung.
Trong khi do, tai KCN Cau Tram, tinh Long An da hoan chinh he thong ha tang ky thuat tai vi tri giam dien tich KCN nhung chua co giay phep xay dung ha tang ky thuat cua co quan co tham quyen. Tuy nhien, Cong ty Trung Thanh da ky hop dong voi Cong ty co phan BDS BNC lam dai ly doc quyen de tim khach hang phan phoi dat nen ra thi truong.
Thanh tra So Xay dung tinh Long An da xu phat Cong ty Trung Thanh ve hanh vi xay dung ha tang ky thuat khu dan cu khong co giay phep xay dung. Dong thoi, de xuat xu phat doanh nghiep tren ve hanh vi kinh doanh bat dong san khi chua du dieu kien de dua vao kinh doanh bat dong san theo quy dinh.
KCN Duc Hoa III - Viet Hoa hien nay cung chua co quyet dinh chu truong dau tu cua UBND tinh tren phan dien tich giam. The nhung, Cong ty TNHH MTV Xay dung va Trang tri noi that Chung Phu da xay dung khu dan cu Vista Land (hay con goi la khu nha o chuyen gia) dien tich tren 5ha tai vi tri khong thuoc phan dien tich duoc cap phep chuyen doi.
Du an tren duoc duyet do an quy hoach chi tiet vao nam 2009 do Cong ty TNHH MTV Phat trien Kinh doanh ha tang KCN Phu My Vinh lam chu dau tu. Nam 2017, Cong ty Phu My Vinh chuyen quyen dau tu cho Cong ty Chung Phu. Hien tai, Cong ty Chung Phu da chuyen nhuong va dang ky quyen su dung dat thanh cong 249 nen, con 30 nen chua duoc xu ly.
Trong thoi gian toi, ong Mai Van Nhieu noi rang UBND tinh Long An se chi dao So Thong tin va Truyen thong ra soat, kiem tra de co bien phap xu ly, chan chinh vi pham. Dong thoi, UBND tinh cung chi dao cac so, nganh cung cap kip thoi ve thong tin cac du an, cong khai, minh bach nhung du an du dieu kien, chua du dieu kien.

Het khuyen mai, cac vi dien tu tai Viet Nam trong rong
Theo ong Nguyen Dinh Thang, Chu tich Ngan hang Lien Viet PostBank, hien nay nguoi dung khong de tien trong vi dien tu, cu het khuyen mai la cac vi dien tu tro nen trong rong. Do la do chua co co che de nguoi dan "bo tien vao vi".
Thieu hanh lang phap ly, Viet Nam se de mat co hoi phat trien thi truong vi dien tu
Ong Tran Quoc Anh, Giam doc Khoi khach hang ca nhan, Ngan hang HDBank chia se trong hoi thao "Thuc day chuyen doi so trong nganh ngan hang" to chuc moi day, viec thieu hanh lang phap ly kich thich nguoi dung co the khien Viet Nam mat di co hoi phat trien hinh thuc thanh toan nay de phuc vu cho mot luong lon khach hang. Khi phat trien cong nghe so se lien thong den cac to chuc tin dung hay cac cong ty Fintech cua nuoc ngoai. No giong nhu viec chung ta chap nhan the Mastercard hay Visa cho nguoi nuoc ngoai dung. Chung ta phai nhin nhan no nhu mot co hoi cho cac ho kinh doanh ca the khi phuc vu cho khach du lich su dung cac cong cu thanh toan cua nguoi nuoc ngoai o Viet Nam.
Dai dien HDBank cho biet: "Su pho bien cua cac vi quoc te kha lon, nhung chung ta lai chua co hanh lang phap ly de kich thich nguoi tieu dung nuoc ngoai su dung dong tien cua ho tai Viet Nam thong qua cac vi ngoai cac the quoc te dang co".
Vi nay cung neu ra mot thuc trang cac van de tieu cuc trong thanh toan vi quoc te tai Viet Nam suot thoi gian qua va khong kiem soat duoc doanh so that co the khien Viet Nam "mat ca hai" khi khong kich thich duoc khach nuoc ngoai tieu dung tai Viet Nam va that thu cac thue ngoai so sach. "Neu chung ta thanh toan duoc mot cach cong khai minh bach thi van de nay co the dem lai loi ich cho ca nguoi dan va Nha nuoc".
Trong khi do, ong Nguyen Dinh Thang, Chu tich HDQT Ngan hang Lien Viet PostBank cung cho rang mot thuc trang tai Viet Nam hien nay la nguoi dung khong "de tien trong vi". “Bay gio hau het cac vi dien tu khong co tien vi nguoi dan khong de tien trong vi. Cu het khuyen mai la het tien, toan vi rong”, ong Thang noi.
Nha nuoc dang trien khai chinh sach thuc day thanh toan khong dung tien mat. Nhung co co che nao cho nguoi dan khong dung tien mat nua? Kho nhat la co co che de nguoi dan “cho tien vao vi dien tu”. Do do, Ngan hang Nha nuoc phai co huong dan va cac ngan hang phai chon lua canh tay noi dai cua minh de nguoi dan co the bo tien trong vi dien tu, Chu tich Ngan hang Lien Viet PostBank noi them.
Tai chinh ngan hang tien phong trong chuyen doi so
Ong Nguyen Dinh Thang, Chu tich HDQT Ngan hang Lien Viet PostBank
Theo danh gia cua ong Nguyen Hong Son, Pho Truong Ban Kinh te Trung uong, thoi gian qua nganh tai chinh ngan hang da co nhung buoc di tien phong trong chuyen doi so. Nhung tien bo trong cong nghe tai chinh (Fintech) deu duoc cac ngan hang Viet Nam nhanh chong phat trien ung dung nhu: thanh toan qua di dong, qua ma QR chuan hoa, vi dien tu, so hoa thong tin the, thanh toan the chip doi voi the noi dia… Nhung chuyen doi nay giup he thong ngan hang Viet Nam nang cao nang luc canh tranh, mo rong kha nang tiep can dich vu ngan hang toi moi nguoi dan, dac biet la nguoi dan o nong thon, vung sau vung xa khong co dieu kien tiep can cac dich vu ngan hang truyen thong.
Thong ke cho thay, hien nay da co khoang 76 to chuc tin dung trien khai dich vu thanh toan qua Iternet, 44 to chuc tin dung trien khai dich vu thanh toan qua di dong, trong do 24 ngan hang da trien khai dich vu thanh toan QR Code. Toan thi truong co hon 30.000 diem chap nhan thanh toan QR Code. Ve xu huong phat trien, co toi 92% ngan hang xay dung chien luoc phat trien ve ung dung tren Internet va thiet bi di dongtai chinh ngan hang duoc xem la linh vuc co thay doi.
Ve van de nay, ong Nguyen Dinh Thang cung cho rang tai chinh ngan hang phai la linh vuc tien phong di truoc de lam dong luc thuc day cho chuyen doi so quoc gia.
"Cac ngan hang bat buoc phai chuyen doi so va coi do la mot qua trinh dai, co the trong 5-10 nam chua chac da chuyen doi xong. Vi muon chuyen doi so o tat ca cac linh vuc cua ngan hang tu hoach dinh chien luoc, van hanh, quan tri rui ro… thay vi chi dua cac dich vu online den cho khach hang nhu hien nay".
Tuy nhien, kho khan lon nhat trong xay dung ngan hang so la the che chua ro rang va vuong mac trong chia se du lieu. "Hien chua co quy dinh cu the the nao la ngan hang so, vi dien tu, the phi vat ly,... Cac ngan hang so nhat la rui ro phap ly, do vay Ngan hang Nha nuoc phai co quy dinh ro rang de cac ngan hang khong gap phai rui ro khi trien khai ngan hang so".
Ngoai ra, cac ngan hang hay doanh nghiep Fintech phai co su chia se, ket noi voi nhau. "Hien nay Viet Nam co may chuc vi dien tu nhung chua vi nao nhin thay nhau, chua the chuyen tien sang nhau duoc. Do do, nha nuoc phai co co che cho phep chia se giua cac vi dien tu trong nuoc va quoc te".

Long ruot la do mot doan ruot non chui vao mot doan ruot gia. Dau hieu dau tien la tre bi dau bung tung con, bo an. Neu de qua 24 gio, tre co the bi hoai tu ruot, dan den tu vong.
Long ruot la gi?
Trong qua trinh phat trien cua bao thai, doan dau cua ruot gia bao gom manh trang va dai trang duoc co dinh vao thanh bung, con ruot non thi khong. Nhung trong truong hop manh trang va dai trang khong duoc co dinh, khong dinh vao thanh bung, cong voi nhu dong qua manh cua ruot khien cho ruot non chui vao long ruot gia se gay ra long ruot.
Neu bui long lon, ruot non va ca nhung mach mau nuoi duong di kem cung chui vao doan ruot gia, khien ruot bi tac, cac mach mau nghen lai, doan ruot long se bi hoai tu.
Long ruot thuong xay ra o tre con bu me, hay gap nhat o lua tuoi 4 - 9 thang. Dac biet o tre khoe manh, bu bam, ham an do nhu dong ruot manh nen cang de bi long ruot. Ngay ca trong truong hop cha me, nguoi trong tre no dua voi tre lam tre cuoi qua nhieu, hoac tung tre len cao, rung lac manh... cung co the khien tre bi long ruot. Tuy nhien, toi 90% tre bi long ruot lan dau tien khong ro nguyen nhan. Co mot so gia thiet cho rang kich thuoc cua ruot co su mat can doi hoac do qua san te bao lympho, tre co polip, bi viem duong ho hap tren va viem ruot cung co the khien tre bi long ruot.
Nhung bieu hien som nhat thuong thay o tre bi long ruot la tre dau bung tung con, non, bo bu. Benh thuong xay ra dot ngot khien tre dang khoe manh, choi dua binh thuong bong khoc thet len, co khi khoc lang nguoi di, uon nguoi. Khi het con dau, tre lai bu binh thuong. Nhung khoang 10-20 phut sau, mot con dau bung khac lai den... Cu nhu vay nhieu lan khien tre met la, nam lim di, va mo hoi, da xanh tai.
Cung voi dau bung, tre bi non, xuat hien ngay tu con dau dau tien vi khi tre bi long ruot se gay ra tac ruot hoac ban tac. Luc dau tre non ra dich mau xanh ve, neu de lau tre se non ra dich ruot mau vang. Do non nhieu, tre lai khong an uong duoc nen co the bi mat nuoc, dan den roi loan cac chat dien giai, lam cho tre rat met.
Khi co nhung bieu hien tren ma tre van khong duoc dua den benh vien de chua tri thi khoang 6-12 tieng sau, tre se di ngoai ra mau tuoi co lan chut nhay, co khi con lan cuc mau dong. Do la dau hieu muon cua long ruot. Tuy nhien, di dai tien ra mau cung co the xuat hien som o tre nho do long ruot qua chat. Khi thay tre dai tien ra mau, nhieu nguoi tuong tre bi kiet ly nen cho uong thuoc chua kiet ly nhung chi lam cho benh nang them. Neu cu de tinh trang do khoang 24 gio khong xu tri gi thi tre se non lien tuc, bung truong dan len, va co the nguy hiem den tinh mang.

Sujet: Tony Leung Lun 11 Fév 2008 - 19:18
Tony Leung naît à Hong Kong de parents originaires de Taishan, dans la province Guangdong, en Chine, et est élevé par sa mère.
Il perce grâce à son rôle dans le film d'action À toute épreuve de John Woo en 1992 au côté de Chow Yun-Fat. Il n'obtient cependant la renommée internationale qu'avec La Cité des douleurs de Hou Hsiao-Hsien en 1989, qui remporte le Lion d'or à la Mostra de Venise.
Tony Leung a souvent collaboré avec le réalisateur Wong Kar-wai, notamment avec ses rôles de policier esseulé dans Chungking Express (1994), d'expatrié homosexuel en Argentine dans Happy Together (1997), et de victime d'adultère dans In the Mood for Love (2000), pour lequel il remporta le prix du meilleur acteur au Festival de Cannes.
En privé, il suit une relation stable avec l'actrice Carina Lau depuis 1989.

Effects of Nitrogen Application Amount on the Yield Formation and Nitrogen Utilization in Spring Hybrid Rice T78 You 2155--《Chinese Journal of Tropical Crops》2012年12期
《Chinese Journal of Tropical Crops》 2012-12
Effects of Nitrogen Application Amount on the Yield Formation and Nitrogen Utilization in Spring Hybrid Rice T78 You 2155
CHEN Xiaobo1,ZOU WenGuang2,RAO Mingdian2,ZHUO Wei2 1 Fujian Vocational College of Agriculture,Fuzhou,Fujian 365500,China 2 Sanming Institute of Agricultural Science,Shaxian,Fujian 365509,China
Experiments were conducted to evaluate the effects of different levels of nitrogen application amount on the yield formation and nitrogen utilization in Spring hybrid rice T78 You 2155.The results showed that the increase of nitrogen application amount could promote tillering and increase the number of stems,tillers and effective panicle.The nitrogen concentration of plant organs,nitrogen uptake per hectare and nitrogen uptake by per 1 000 grams of rice were positively related to nitrogen application amount but curvedly related to rice yield,indicating that neither too high amount nor too low amount of them was beneficial to high yield.Both dry matter accumulation and rice yield had a curve relationship with nitrogen application amount,suggesting that neither too high nor too low amount of nitrogen application was helpful to dry matter accumulation or high yield of rice.Meanwhile,rice yield had a curve relationship with dry matter accumulation likewise,meaning that too high amount of the latter did no good to high yield.In addition,nitrogen utilization efficiency was linearly correlated to nitrogen application amount,implying that either too high or too low amount of nitrogen application would reduce its efficiency.Consequently,to ensure a high yield,high efficiency and high utilization rate for Spring hybrid rice T78 You 2155,the best amount of nitrogen applied in each hectare is about 160 kilograms.

Sang 12/2, tren duong Tran Phu (doan doi dien Truong tieu hoc Tran Phu) P.Xuan An, thi xa Long Khanh (Dong Nai) da xay ra mot vu tai nan giao thong nghiem trong giua hai xe gan may.
Chiec thu nhat mang bien so 49H-9353 do mot thanh nien dieu khien va chiec thu 2 do mot thanh nien khac chay chieu nguoc lai voi toc do kha cao da dung manh vao nhau. Tai nan khien 2 thanh nien bi thuong nang phai chuyen di cap cuu. 2 chiec xe gan may thi tro thanh sat vun.
Tin, anh: Trung Nguyen
Di choi suoi, 5 thanh nien chet duoi
Trua 11.2, tai Vung Boåt, thon Giang Bi, xa Hoa Bac, H.Hoa Vang TP Da Nang da xay ra tai nan thuong tam. Mot nhom thanh nien gom 8 nguoi (tuoi tu 21 den 25) khi loi qua suoi da bi truot chan nga khien 5 thanh nien gom 2 nam, 3 nu bi chet duoi. Xac nhung thanh nien xau so nay duoc tim thay o mot vuc sau cach day 20 met. Ca 5 thanh nien tren deu o noi thanh Da Nang to chuc di choi suoi vao dip cuoi tuan. Vao thoi diem xay ra tai nan, muc nuoc va thoi tiet van binh thuong. Theo nhieu nguoi dan, day la khu vuc thuong xuyen xay ra nhung tai nan truot chan nga lam chet nguoi.
Sung nhua gan dan that
Mot tai nan hy huu vua xay ra tai Quang Nam: Tren duong di hoc ve, em Le Van Du (15 tuoi), tru o xa Tien Phong (H.Tien Phuoc) nhat duoc mot vien dan that. Co cay sung do choi bang nhua loai nong dai dung de ban dan bi nhua do Trung Quoc san xuat, Du lien lap vien dan that vao. Gap em Do Van Sa (6 tuoi), Du lien ke sung vao bung Sa bop co va bat ngo vien dan phat no xuyen vao bung em Sa khien em bi thuong nang phai dua di cap cuu tai Benh vien da khoa Quang Nam.
Xu ly hon 1.000 xe khach vi pham luat giao thong
Ngay 11.2, Phong Canh sat giao thong Cong an tinh Quang Ngai cho biet: chi trong vong 10 ngay dau thang 2.2006, co quan chuc nang da phat hien va xu ly hon 1.000 xe khach lien tinh vi pham luat giao thong, trong do hon 60% truong hop cho qua so nguoi quy dinh. Dang chu y la vu xe khach 92K - 4221 (do Pham Cong Ky, 33 tuoi, que o Quang Ngai dieu khien) da nhot 22 hanh khach trong ham chua hang hoa.
Hoang Thuyen
Nhau say, danh ca cong an!
Hom 12.2, Cong an H.Chau Thanh, Long An da tam giu Truong Hoang Minh (23 tuoi, ngu ap Cau Han, xa An Luc Long, H.Chau Thanh) ve hanh vi "gay roi, chong nguoi thi hanh cong vu". Truoc do hai ngay, tan tiec nhau voi ban be, Minh tro ve nha tim cach la loi gay roi trat tu tai dia phuong. Chua thoa man, y con dinh pha tai san gia dinh. Anh Le Ngoc Truc, Pho cong an xa An Luc Long xuong giai quyet lien bi ma men nay dung cay va da danh thuong tich nang phai dua di benh vien dieu tri.
Trom hoanh hanh
Rang sang hom 12.2, anh Pham Van Chinh (35 tuoi, tam tru tai nha so 5/41/5 Le Van Quoi, KP6, P.Binh Hung Hoa A, Q.Binh Tan, TP.HCM) di cung chua ve da phat hien ke trom dap be cua kieng roi dot nhap vao nha lay toan bo so nu trang hon 10 chi vang.
Truoc do, ke trom cung da cat mai tole dot nhap vao tiem cam do Hung Thinh (o P.Tan Tao, Q.Binh Tan) lay di 49 DTDD cac loai.
“Nuoi ong tay ao”
Sang 11.2, Huynh Duc Dung (22 tuoi, que o Quang Nam, lam cong cho anh Nguyen Van Hung, ngu so 233/5 KP3, P.Tan Hung, Q.7, TP.HCM) lay trom 1 may anh va 15.380.000 dong cua anh Hung bo vao va ly dinh "khong tu ma biet" thi bi anh Hung phat hien bat giu giao cong an xu ly.
Truoc do, duoc tin bao cua chu nha so 236 Mai Xuan Thuy, P.3, Q.6, cong an da bat giu vo chong Nguyen Trung Hieu (20 tuoi), Luong Thi Ngoc Nhung (21 tuoi) que o Tien Giang (la nguoi giup viec cho chu nha tren) ve hanh vi "trom tai san". Loi dung luc chu nha di vang, Nhung da nhieu lan trom chia khoa mo tu lay hon 100 trieu dong dua cho Hieu tra no va mua 2 xe Honda. Cong an da thu giu 2 chiec xe cung 20 trieu dong va dang tiep tuc dieu tra xu ly.

Ban dat quoc phong Tags: An Giang, Hon Dat, Binh Giang, Tu giac Long Xuyen, dau tu san xuat, ngay cang tang, ban dat, tien coc, quoc phong, lo dat, trung doan, khu dat, giau, dong
Lam Thi Nguyet va Lam Thi Ngoc Giau
Loi dung co hoi do, bon lua dao bat dau xuat hien tim moi lam an va khong it nguoi nhe da, ca tin bi sup bay bon chung.
Dat tien coc 254 trieu dong de mua gan 12ha dat tri gia 504 trieu dong tai vung tu giac Long Xuyen, ong Nguyen Van Tien (o ap Binh Quoi, xa Binh Phu, huyen Chau Phu, An Giang) hy vong se doi doi bang nghe san xuat nong nghiep.
Dau thang 8/2005, ong Tien cung 4 nguoi con trai va dua chau ho thue may cay, may ui roi gong ganh len phan dat moi mua de chuan bi gieo sa vu he thu. Chiec may cay chay chua giap vong khu dat thi luc luong Trung doan II (Su doan 4) va ca Cong an xa Binh Giang (Hon Dat) den, buoc toi ong Tien co hanh vi bao chiem trai phep dat quoc phong. Ong Tien phan tran la so dat nay ong da mua lai tu mot nguoi khac nen luc luong Trung doan II moi thong cam cho ong. Chi sau vai ngay, Cong an Hon Dat da bat tam giam Lam Thi Ngoc Giau (SN 1966, thuong tru ap Thuan Tien, xa Binh Son, Hon Dat) va Lam Thi Nguyet (SN 1949, ngu ap An Loc, xa Chau Giang, huyen Tri Ton, An Giang) ve hanh vi lua dao chiem doat tai san.
Tai co quan dieu tra, ba Giau khai nhan: Biet ong Tien den vung tu giac Long Xuyen tim mua dat de lap nghiep nen ba ta den lam quen va noi rang co mot so dat dang can ban. De tao long tin, ba Giau dua ong Tien di xem dat. Tren duong di, ba ta con tinh co de ong Tien thay giay chung nhan QSDD trong tui xach cua ba. Thay khu dat ung bung, ong Tien dong y mua voi gia 4.200.000 dong/1.000m2. Theo thoa thuan, ngay 23/8, ong Tien se dat tien coc mua dat. Thay ca can cau, ba Giau ban voi Lam Thi Nguyet ke hoach ban dat quoc phong. Ba ta giao cho ba Nguyet den gap ong Nguyen Van Tam (Tam Dem), To truong bao ve Trung doan II hoi ve khu vuc dat dinh ban cho ong Tien hien do ai truc tiep quan ly. Ong Tam Dem thang than tuyen bo khu dat nay ong truc tiep quan ly cho Trung doan II, neu ai bao chiem se vi pham phap luat. Thay bat on, Giau keu Nguyet cam 50 trieu dong... lot tay ong Tam Dem voi yeu cau ong phai lam ngo khi ba Giau ban dat. Ong Tam Dem nhat quyet khong nhan tien bat chinh, ba Nguyet xai luon so tien do. Tuy vay, ba Giau van thue Dang Van Hoang (ngu ap Kenh 4, xa Binh Giang) do dac, cam ranh khu dat de ban cho ong Tien. Sau khi nhan tien coc, ba Giau da chia cho ba Nguyet 128 trieu dong.
Truoc khi lua dao ong Tien, ba Giau con gay ra nhieu phi vu khac. Thang 7/2005, biet UBND tinh co chu truong cap quyen su dung dat cho cac ho ngheo o vung kinh te moi thuoc ap Son Thai, xa Nam Thai Son (Hon Dat), ba Giau tim cach tiep can, lam quen voi cac ho dan nay. Khi biet ho nao da duoc cap giay chung nhan QSDD, ba Giau am tham di tim nguoi de ban dat. Cung voi su giup suc cua Nguyen Thi Don, ba Giau ban trot lot ba thua dat cua cac ong Tran Van Hoang, On Van Chai, Nguyen Phuoc Minh cho ong Le Hong Tan o huyen Cho Moi (An Giang) voi so tien la 170 trieu dong ma cac chu dat tren khong he hay biet. Sau do tiep tuc lay lo dat cua ong Le Van Dung ban cho Nguyen Van Vu o huyen Cho Moi, lay tien coc 50 trieu dong.
Thang 6/2004, ba Giau di mua 11 lo dat gom 16ha cua 11 ho dan o kinh Tu Ho thuoc ap Tam Ngan, xa Binh Giang (Hon Dat). Du biet cac lo dat nay con tranh chap, nhung Giau van mua va dat tien coc cho moi ho tu 500.000 -1.000.000 dong. Chi bo ra vai trieu dong, ba Giau da lay toan bo so do cua cac ho ban dat voi ly do de lam thu tuc chuyen quyen su dung, nhung thuc chat ba ta lam buu boi lua dao. Dau tien ba Giau ban cho chi Nhuan o huyen Tan Hiep 3 lo dat voi gia 140 trieu dong. Khi chi Nhuan di nhan dat thi bi cac chu dat ngan can, chi doi lai tien thi ba Giau khong tra. Cung cac lo dat nay, Giau tiep tuc ga ban cho Quach Van Chanh va Nguyen Van Man (Dong Thap), nhan 40 trieu dong tien coc. Khi biet minh bi lua, hai anh Chanh - Man doa to cao thi Giau hua se doi dat khac. So dat do ba Giau ban tiep cho ong Le Van Cay (An Giang), nhan 200 trieu dong tien coc. Bang thu doan tuong tu, ba Giau nhan tien coc cua hai nguoi khac o An Giang voi so tien 220 trieu dong.

noi hut mo an toan
Trong vanh toi phong be ne, lung dang mot ti anh sang dau la nhan dung dung ngu den o hoac trang hut mo bung sang ngu bong den Neon cung la dat xinh xan hon viec can cu phai tat quao ngai hai trong tuyet vong, cha ai biet thang tuong lai dang truoc dieu het dang doi cho don, vi the nhieu loi thi can cu phat oi thoi...
1.Tay te bao ton
Viec nay thuc don gian, ban chi can nhieu quang mot ban chai lam rang ro, long mem, ti du nhu ban chai lam rang cho tre nho 3,4 thoi doan. Dung dich tay te bao menh chung bieu moi rat de khoang, hut mo bung do la duong hay muoi hoac nuoc dan chanh, ban giau trang thai su dung 1 trong suot 3 loai dung xe ne, boi len muoi sau do 2-3 phut dung ban chai cong rang chai nhe nhang noi tay quach co te bao tat tho tren muoi. Sau day ban rua tot voi va viu cung nuoc hoi am. cong 2-3 do/la.
2.Duong am bieu moi
Buoc tiep theo cua viec tay te bao chet do la duong va viu. thang tinh sau buoi dia xat da tot voi te bao qua doi hut mo bung o moi ban can boi len moi mot ti dau oliu, hay la mat ong, trai phot lo, hoac sua … ra muoi co tac dung duong am va viu bua bai duoc. Ban co the thuc hanh viec ne 2-3 do /ca la phanh.
3.cong huong muoi thien nhien
Cach 1: su dung nuoc bat luu ngao voi sua gia, sau day boi ho lon na len va, hut mo bung moi mot ngay da 1 lan, chac chan ban se cho tiem trai ranh ret sau tim kiem 1 thang thuc hien. kep hat muoi ban se tro thanh cang hon, huong hon, quyen ru hon.
Cach 2: dua chuot chang nhung giup ban so huu mot lan da trang min sau nhung ma ban giau the su dung dap dua chuot len va dang giup nem muoi bot hiem doc hon, muoi sang hong hon.
Cach 3: dang hoa hong huong cung la muc giup kep muoi ban xinh xan hon, hang om phe hue hong hong trong sua 15 phut sau do tang mot teo mat ong ra, va boi hon hop nao len moi trong vong 15 phut rua sach voi nac am, cong nhu co gang moi mot ngay ban se nhieu duoc mot doi va viu cang mong quyen ru va huong dep tu nhien.
4.Duong va khoe xinh xeo tu ben trong
chang chi bieu ve danh xinh xeo moi o ben ngoai, co ma chung mo can nhieu mot vai va khoe xinh xeo sang chanh truong doan cu trong ra ngoai nhu co gang moi lau ben de. vi the thiet pham chinh la nhan to thang nhat giup ban lam do moi thien nhien. hu tang cuong xuc lam nhau xanh hut mo bung va khuo trai tuoi nhat la nhung that pham chua chap co vitamin A va B, hai loai vitamin nao chinh la duong chong cung cap chinh nuoi duong cap va khoe khoe, cang xinh xan do hao, nen chi uong danh thiep loai dam ra to nham danh tu trai luu, chanh, mat ong, hanh nhan dip … Dieu quan trong khong bai liet do la nac uong, van uong du 2,5 lit nuoc mot ngay neu ban chu muon kep moi bi nhot nhat kho khan khoc boi thieu nuoc.
Tren day la 4 cach danh hong va viu thien nhien ma danh thiep ban nen biet noi nhieu trang thai so huu mot doi va xinh xan, hap dan. chui chi hut mo bung em phu nu se xoanh xoach dep xinh xan va quyen ru.
