Từ khóa liên quan đến bài viết: Cách làm của tuổi trẻphap luat, trien khai, da dang, dia phuong, doi tuong, sinh hoat, to chuc, dieu kien, trien khai thuc, quy dinh, giao duc, pho bien, lien quan, kinh phi, thao luan De da dang cac hinh thuc pho bien, giao duc phap luat va phong chong TNXH cho gioi tre, thoi gian qua, Tinh Doan da chi dao cac co so trien khai thuc hien Ngay phap luat nham nang cao y thuc chap hanh luat phap trong thanh thieu nien. Sau gan mot nam trien khai, cach lam nay da to ra co tac dung tich cuc trong viec nang cao hieu biet va y thuc chap hanh phap luat cua thanh thieu nien.
Ngay sau khi nhan duoc van ban chi dao so 4464/UBND ngay 23-10-2010 cua UBND tinh, ke hoach so 25/KH-HDPBPL ngay 8-12-2010 cua Hoi dong PHCTPBGDPL tinh ve trien khai thuc hien Ngay phap luat, Ban Thuong vu Tinh Doan da xay dung Huong dan so 06 HD/TD-QN ngay 29-3-2011 ve viec to chuc trien khai mo hinh Ngay phap luat; dong thoi chi dao 100% co so doan trong tinh to chuc dinh ky vao ngay 25 hang thang, rieng khoi doan trong truong hoc to chuc vao ngay 15 hang thang.
DVTN TP Ha Long tuyen truyen phong chong HIV/AIDS va TNXH cho ngu dan sinh song tren Vinh Ha Long.
Thuc hien su chi dao cua Tinh Doan, thoi gian qua cac co so doan trong tinh da tich cuc trien khai mo hinh Ngay phap luat tai dia phuong, don vi minh voi cac noi dung, hinh thuc da dang, phu hop voi trinh do nhan thuc, nep sinh hoat cua tung doi tuong thanh thieu nien va dieu kien dac thu cua moi dia phuong, don vi. Mot so co so gap kho khan ve kinh phi de to chuc cac buoi hoc tap trung da linh hoat to chuc bang cach van dong DVTN tu tim hieu hay nghien cuu thong qua cac phuong tien thong tin dai chung, sach, bao; dong thoi long ghep viec pho bien van ban phap luat voi sinh hoat chi doan, sinh hoat cua cac cau lac bo Tuoi tre voi phap luat... Doi voi cac don vi co dieu kien ve kinh phi thi to chuc cac buoi toa dam, giao luu, de giup DVTN trao doi, thao luan ve noi dung cac quy dinh cua phap luat. Nhieu co so da da dang hoa cac hinh thuc tim hieu phap luat trong thanh thieu nien, gom thi viet, thi san khau hoa bang hinh thuc ke chuyen vu an, thi rung chuong vang… Nhieu co so doan con manh dan dung ra dam nhan to chuc Ngay phap luat tai dia phuong; moi bao cao vien, tuyen truyen vien phap luat toi pho bien, nang cao nhan thuc phap luat cho DVTN va nhan dan tren dia ban...
Voi nhung cach lam nhu tren, chi trong mot thoi gian ngan trien khai thuc hien mo hinh Ngay phap luat, da thu hut duoc su huong ung tham gia cua dong dao doan vien, thanh thieu nien, tao khong khi soi noi, tich cuc tim hieu phap luat trong DVTN. Noi dung cac buoi sinh hoat Ngay phap luat tap trung vao tuyen truyen pho bien, giao duc cac van ban quy pham phap luat moi ban hanh; cac quy dinh phap luat ve che do, chinh sach; cac van ban huong dan, chi dao co lien quan toi cac doi tuong DVTN. Doan Thanh nien cac co so da to chuc tuyen truyen sau rong toi cac doi tuong thanh thieu nien nhung van ban luat co ban va co lien quan truc tiep den thanh nien nhu: Bo luat Hinh su; Bo luat Dan su; Luat Thanh nien; Luat Hon nhan va gia dinh; Luat Binh dang gioi; Luat Phong, chong bao luc gia dinh; Luat Dat dai; phap luat ve an toan giao thong, ve linh vuc hanh chinh, ve phong chong ma tuy, mai dam, HIV/AIDS... Doan TN cac dia phuong con tap trung tuyen truyen, van dong DVTN tich cuc tham gia vao cong tac giai phong mat bang, giai quyet khieu nai to cao; tuyen truyen cac quy dinh phap luat ve nhung hanh vi vi pham hanh chinh va tham quyen, trinh tu, thu tuc vi pham hanh chinh, hinh su, an toan giao thong; cac quyen va nghia vu cua cong dan; kinh nghiem phong chong TNXH... Qua do da co tac dong tich cuc, gop phan nang cao hieu biet ve phap luat va y thuc chap hanh phap luat cua gioi tre. Thong qua chuong trinh da gop phan khong nho trong viec kiem che, tung buoc giam thieu tinh trang thanh thieu nien vi pham phap luat va mac cac TNXH. Khong nhung vay, qua chuong trinh con gop phan tung buoc hinh thanh trong DVTN loi song lanh manh, chap hanh tot cac quy dinh cua hien phap va phap luat.
Mac du moi duoc trien khai khong lau, nhung den nay co the khang dinh mo hinh Ngay phap luat da gop phan lam phong phu hon noi dung va hinh thuc tuyen truyen, pho bien, giao duc phap luat va phong chong TNXH trong thanh thieu nhi o cac dia phuong trong tinh. Dong thoi, tao them mot kenh tuyen truyen pho bien, giao duc phap luat moi trong thanh thieu nien hien nay.

Tam tak chuan kan hre thawi ve hlawm ngeiin a rinawm a, tunlai hian Khawvel puma Rabi lian tak takte chuan 'Zamarei Khasidi' (Dati hla sa tu zaithiamte) kan tih hote chu an do hle a, heng hote hian an zaina hmunah hmeichhia leh mipa te hma a zai pawh pawi ti lovin vawi tam tak Rabi lian ten hetianga ti tawh lo tura thu an pek hnuah pawh ngai pawimawh duh lovin an tihluih zel avangin 'Israel mi thianghlim fate sual kawng zawh tir tute an ni,' tiin, an inlamlet loh chuan Olam Haba a chanvo nei ve lo tur hial hialin an chungthu an rel hlawm a, hetah hian engvangin nge heng Dati hla satute chungchang chauh hi an do bik kan tih chuan, Dati hla nilo chu sawi loha leng leh thianglo hulhual a hriatsa anih avang leh, heng Dati hla sa tute hian Dati hla an sak avang chuan thlarau lama mi chak lo te te te leh he a Halakha hre ve lo ten Dati hla te chu P-thian chawimawina hla alawm an lo tih palh theih mai thin avangin, Torah dana 'Mitdel hmaah a tlukna tur thil i dah tur ani lo' tih Mitsvah chu chu an bawhchhiat avangin an do em em ani.
Mishna Brura buah ( סימן תקס' ג' ) ah chuan heti hian Sefardi Halakha siamtu Rabi Yosef Karo leh Ashkenaz Halakha siamtu Harama te chuan tihian an lo ziak a; "Hla sakna tura Rimawi tum theih tin reng te leh Hla chi ang reng reng te, hlimpui theih tura zai ri tichhuak thei ang reng rengte chu thiang lo ani a, tin, Lal te pawhin an din pah leh mut pah pawhin leh, Zu inna hmun ang reng rengah te pawh chuan thiang lo a ni a, heng hla leh rimawi ang chi reng rengte hi Khurban (Temple chhiat) avangin ngaihthlak a thiang lo ani. 'Bashir lo ishtu yain' tih anih angin Wine in chung leh lek phei chuan zai thiang ani lova, Amaherawhchu, monu leh mopa inah chuan sak thiang a ni a, Mitsvah thilah chuan. Tin, chutiangin, mi chuan a ka chu thu ho sawi nan leh fiamthu thawh nan he khawvela a awm chhung hian a a hmang tur a ni lo bawk." Tiin, Juda zawng zawngte hman tur Halakha chu khauh takin Halakha siam tute chuan an lo titlu ta ani.
He Halakha chungchang hi in zirchian ve duh chuan a bu hi han keu ula, heti lai Halakha hi a hrilhfiah tu hrang hrangte chuan an sawi khauh hlawm khawp bawk tih in hmu thei ang.
Keini Benei Menashe te hi kan hre theuhin zai ngaina hnam kan ni a, amaherawhchu, Juda te zawng zawng zawm tura Halakha siam tuten an lo siam tawh hnu lemah hian, hman ni lawka inhmuchhuak vete hian kan hnam dan alawm, zai ngaina hnam kan ni a, P-thian hla, Lengzem hla Ram ngaih hla tih vel chu Tingtang leh Khuang tein 'Menashe kan ni alawm kan hlim ang chu' kan la ti tlang tlang dawn zawk? Nge , he Halakha dan pawna indah hian 'Out Jewish Law' pawl kan din ve rup zawk mai dawn em ni ang?
A dik, kan lo chin tawh thin a ni, sima kailawn thar kai a har, mahse, Lalpa kawng chu chovin bumboh mahse, ka duhnate hnawlin ama duh zawnga nung tur zawk kan lo ni.
Kar tluanin zai chak em emin Lalpa hmingin insum teuh mah ila, zai theih ni Shabat lo thlen hunah zawng Shulkhan Shabat ah hrawk bawk khi phuk khawpa zaiah kan khek mai tur lah ni.

Gia nhap WTO se la mot loi ich lon doi voi Viet Nam
Gia nhap WTO se la mot loi ich lon doi voi Viet Nam Tags: Viet Nam, Hoa Ky, Pho Wall, The Wall Street Journal, bai binh luan, doi voi, gia nhap, thoa thuan, thuong mai, loi ich, han ngach, WTO, my, lon, hang
Loi vao tru so WTO tai Geneva, Thuy Sy
Hom nay (17/5), to Thoi bao Pho Wall (The Wall Street Journal) cua My da co bai binh luan voi tua de "Next stop, WTO" nhan su kien Viet Nam va My dat duoc thoa thuan song phuong ve viec Viet Nam gia nhap WTO. Chung toi xin gioi thieu ban luoc dich bai viet nay"
"My da tro thanh quoc gia cuoi cung dat duoc thoa thuan thuong mai song phuong voi Viet Nam, tro ngai chinh trong qua trinh dam phan de Viet Nam gia nhap To chuc Thuong mai The gioi (WTO).
Hom Chu nhat vua qua, Dai dien thuong mai Hoa Ky Rob Portman thong bao mot thoa thuan co tinh nguyen tac ve viec mo cua thi truong song phuong giua hai nuoc. Mac du chi tiet ve thoa thuan nay hien con chua duoc cong bo, ban thoa thuan co the mo duong cho viec Viet Nam tro thanh mot thanh vien cua WTO va khi do phia Hoa Ky se phai bai bo han ngach doi voi hang det may xuat khau cua Viet Nam vao nuoc nay.
Doi lai, phia Viet Nam cung da dong y se do bo mot so hang rao thuong mai doi voi hang hoa va dich vu cung nhu mo cua thi truong o mot so linh vuc co loi nhuan cao cho cac nha dau tu nuoc ngoai nhu vien thong, nang luong va dich vu tai chinh.
Thoa thuan tren co the duoc ky vao thang toi, khi cac quan chuc thuong mai My den Ha Noi tham du hoi nghi APEC. Tong thong My Bush se tham du hoi nghi thuong dinh APEC vao thang 11. Day se la mot buoc tien lon trong viec binh thuong hoa quan he giua hai nuoc.
Lanh dao Dang cua Viet Nam hieu rang dat nuoc minh can hoi nhap WTO. Hang hoa gia re tu cac nuoc lang gieng, dac biet la Trung Quoc va An Do, dang gay suc ep canh tranh rat lon doi voi cac doanh nghiep Viet Nam. Van nan tham nhung van dang lan tran.
Tuy nhien, qua trinh tu do hoa thi truong o Viet Nam da bat dau co nhung ket qua kha quan. So lieu thong ke cho thay, toc do tang truong GDP dang o muc cao va on dinh, nam sau cao hon nam truoc. Theo Quy Tien te Quoc te (IMF), nam ngoai, toc do tang truong kinh te cua Viet Nam la 8,5%. Nam 2005, dau tu truc tiep nuoc ngoai vao Viet Nam uoc tinh da dat 3,3 ty Dola, tang 15,3% so voi nam 2004. Viec keu goi dau tu van dang dien ra manh me va Bill Gates cung da den tham Viet Nam vao dau thang 5 nay.
Tuy nhien, nhung yeu cau cua phia Hoa Ky van het suc cung ran doi voi Viet Nam. Viet Nam da dong y cham dut ho tro xuat khau khi gia nhap WTO, tham chi chap nhan mot che tai trong do neu Viet Nam khong thuc thi cac cam ket cua minh trong vong 12 thang ke tu khi gia nhap WTO, phia My se ap han ngach tro lai doi voi hang det may cua Viet Nam xuat khau sang nuoc nay.
Trao doi qua dien thoai, Karan Bhatia, mot nha dam phan chinh cua phia My noi: Su that la chung toi da tri hoan [dam phan voi Viet Nam] de co the dat duoc mot thoa thuan tot nhat. Tuy nhien, Hoi dong Quoc gia cua Cac to chuc det may Hoa Ky van phan nan rang thoa thuan nay la mot chien thang cua Viet Nam va nhung nguoi phai ganh chiu la cac cong nhan trong nganh det may Hoa Ky.
Co the viec Viet Nam chap nhan nhung dieu kien ngat ngheo nhu vay khien cho nguoi ta bat ngo, nhung theo ba Virginia Foote, Chu tich Hoi dong Thuong mai Viet - My, doi voi nganh det may cua Viet Nam thi viec khong bi ap han ngach va tham chi la khong co tro cap thi van con tot hon tinh trang hien nay.
Duoi che do han ngach, phan lon hang det may xuat khau cua Viet Nam phai co han ngach hoac visa do Chinh phu cap, mot thu tuc thuong dan den cac khoan phi phai tra them cung nhu co hoi cho viec dua va nhan hoi lo. Viec bai bo han ngach thuc su giup loai bo mot phien phuc lon.
Gia nhap WTO se la mot loi ich lon doi voi nen kinh te Viet Nam. Bang cach thuc thi nhung tieu chuan quoc te cho thuong mai va dau tu va mo cua thi truong doi voi hang hoa va dich vu nuoc ngoai, Viet Nam se phat trien mot moi truong kinh doanh minh bach, de du bao hon va se thu hut duoc nhieu dau tu nuoc ngoai hon."

Vo nhot chong vao long sat o Thanh Hoa Pho bien cai nghien bang cui
Tags: cai nghien bang cui sat, nhot nguoi bi nghien vao de cai nghien, vo nhot chong trong cui sat,
Co quan chuc nang Thanh Hoa chia se: “O Thanh Hoa cach day khoang 15 nam viec cai nghien bang cui sat tuong doi pho bien. Co nhung noi tro thanh "phong trao" khi nguoi nha nhot nguoi bi nghien vao de cai nghien...
Ong Nam bi nhot suot hon 3 nam qua.
Lien quan den vu vo nhot chong vao long sat o Thanh Hoa gay xon xao, trao doi voi Bao Giao thong, Trung ta Le Nhu Anh, Truong Cong an huyen Tho Xuan cho biet: “Chung toi van dang phoi hop voi Vien Kiem sat tien hanh dieu tra, chua cong bo duoc. Chung toi cung da moi nhung nguoi lien quan len de lay loi khai. Moi lan duoc moi len ong Nam van chap hanh va khai bao voi co quan Cong an day du cac thong tin. Trong qua trinh lam viec, ong Nam khong co bieu hien gi bat thuong”.
Cung trao doi voi nguon tin tren, dai ta Khuong Duy Oanh, Pho giam doc Cong an tinh Thanh Hoa cho hay: “Su viec nay dang giao cho co quan Cong an huyen dieu tra. Qua trinh dieu tra phat hien nhieu thong tin moi, bat ngo nhung cu the nhu the nao phai cho ket luan dieu tra moi cong bo”.
Cung quan diem nay, Truong Cong an huyen Tho Xuan noi: “Nhung thong tin moi, ro hon phai co can cu moi dam ket luan”.
O mot goc do khac, co quan chuc nang Thanh Hoa cung chia se: O Thanh Hoa cach day khoang 15 nam viec cai nghien bang cui sat tuong doi pho bien. Co nhung noi tro thanh "phong trao" khi nguoi nha nhot nguoi bi nghien vao de cai nghien. Con rieng doi voi truong hop ong Nam, co quan Cong an dang xac minh, xem xet danh gia khach quan, khi nao co ket luan chinh thuc se thong tin rong rai.
Ong Nam sau khi duoc giai cuu ra ngoai.
Truoc do, nhu Dan Viet da dua tin, du luan tai Thanh Hoa dang xon xao viec ba Pham Thi Nghia cung con nhot chong la ong Le Van Nam (SN 1967, xa Xuan Thien, huyen Tho Xuan) trong long sat suot mot thoi gian dai, khong cho ra ngoai tiep xuc voi ai, khong cho nguoi than tham gap ma khong noi ro ly do cu the.
Hang ngay, ong van duoc vo con cho an uong tuong doi day du va moi bua kem theo mot coc bia. Nhieu lan, anh em ben noi da yeu cau ba Nghia mo “chuong cop” cho ong Nam ra ngoai nhung deu bi ba nay chui boi, khuoc tu va khoa cua nha bo di. Mai toi ngay 6.1 vua qua, luc luong chuc nang moi giai cuu thanh cong va tra lai cuoc song tu do cho ong.
Ba Nghia cho xem nhung chai nhua duoc cho la do dap da ma ong Nam tung su dung.
Trao doi tren bao Nguoi dua tin, ba Pham Thi Nghia (vo ong Nam) thua nhan, viec ba dua ong Nam vao “chuong cop” nhot suot hon 3 nam qua la dung su that. Nhung, ba van giu ly do ong Nam bi nghien ma tuy (heroin va ma tuy da) nen phai nhot. Va vi nghi chong bi nghien nen ba Nghia da khong ong cho ra ngoai chiu tang me va du dam cuoi con gai.

Chi den khi anh trai ong Nam co don trinh bao chinh quyen moi biet su viec va da den dong vien gia dinh mo cua cho ong Nam ra ngoai. Bac Ho va Dai tuong Nguyen Chi Thanh tai Dai hoi Dang bo quan doi 1960 - anh tu lieu
Luc nay, de quoc My da dua quan chien dau My va quan doi cac nuoc chu hau o at vao truc tiep tham chien, xam luoc mien Nam. Day la thoi diem buoc ngoat cua cuoc chien tranh. Dong chi Nguyen Chi Thanh va lanh dao Trung uong Cuc da nhan ro: o vao giai doan cuoi cua "Chien tranh dac biet", neu ta chi phat trien chien tranh du kich, chi danh dich o quy mo nho thi khong the gianh thang loi quyet dinh duoc. Boi vay, cung voi viec xay dung va phat trien luc luong vu trang ba thu quan, xay dung luc luong cach mang cua quan chung, chung ta phai coi trong xay dung cac qua dam chu luc, va dong chi Nguyen Chi Thanh da cung voi Bo chi huy Mien chi dao mo cac chien dich Binh Gia, Ba Gia, Dong Xoai va hang loat tran tien cong danh bai tung chien doan nguy, cung voi viec pha ra hang ngan "ap chien luoc", lam pha san hoan toan chien luoc "Chien tranh dac biet" cua My - nguy.
Quan doi nhan dan Viet Nam ngay cang lon manh - Anh: Tu lieu
Quan doi My o at vao xam luoc mien Nam, cung luc de quoc My tien hanh chien tranh leo thang, dung khong quan va hai quan danh pha ac liet mien Bac Viet Nam. Hanh dong phieu luu va da man nay khien nhan loai tren toan the gioi sung sot va lo ngai cho nhan dan Viet Nam. Dai tuong Nguyen Chi Thanh la nguoi phat hien som viec chuyen chien luoc cua My. Phat kien do da duoc Bo Chinh tri chap nhan va de ra quyet sach moi. Luc do, anh Thanh da phan tich: My vao mien Nam trong the thua, the bi dong ve chien luoc; My co ca mot kho vu khi khong lo nhung lai vap phai mot nui mau thuan; My la ti phu ve dola, nhung quan va dan ta lai la ti phu ve chu nghia anh hung cach mang; ta co duong loi chien tranh cach mang, co chien thuat dung, ta se bat quan My phai danh theo cach danh cua ta, nen ta nhat dinh thang.
Thuc hien tu tuong chi dao cua Bo Chinh tri va Chu tich Ho Chi Minh, dong chi Nguyen Chi Thanh cung Trung uong Cuc va Bo chi huy Mien chi dao va to chuc quan va dan mien Nam phat huy tu tuong chien luoc tien cong trong tinh hinh nhiem vu moi, danh thang quan My ngay tu nhung tran dau. Cac tran thang: Nui Thanh, Van Tuong, Bau Bang, Nha do - Bong Trang, Play-me va thung lung Ia-drang, cuoc hanh quan At-ten-bo-ro va nhat la danh bai cuoc hanh quan tong luc de "tim diet" mang ten Gian-xon-xi-ti da lam nuc long nhan dan ca nuoc; da truc tiep xay dung va cung co niem tin va quyet tam danh My va thang My cua toan dan toc. Va, tu thuc te chien dau, su sang tao cua cac don vi, cac dia phuong, dong chi Nguyen Chi Thanh da tong ket thanh phuong cham chi dao tac chien, dong thoi cung la khau hieu hanh dong cach mang noi tieng, nhanh chong di vao long nguoi, lan toa thanh cao trao cach mang tren khap chien truong nhu "Nam that lung dich ma danh", "Tim My ma danh, tim nguy ma diet", lap cac "Vanh dai diet My", thi dua phan dau tro thanh "Dung si diet My", "Dung si diet xe tang"... Tuu trung nhat do la tu tuong chi dao "o gan va danh gan". Thuc hien tu tuong nay, chung ta da that su chong duoc y do "phan tuyen" cua My - nguy, da han che den muc toi da (co tran da vo hieu hoa) hoa luc phi phao cua dich. Ta thang quan doi My, va sau nay thang quan nguy Sai Gon o giai doan "Viet Nam hoa chien tranh" cung tu cai tu tuong "o gan va danh gan" nay.
Luon sau sat thuc te, nam bat nhanh nhay moi van de, dong chi Nguyen Chi Thanh da phan tich va khai quat rat sau sac cuc dien cuoc chien, nhat la sau chien thang lon cua ta danh bai cuoc hanh quan Gian-xon-xi-ti cua My o mien Dong Nam Bo. Bai viet Nam bai hoc phan cong chien luoc mua kho mang but danh Truong Son cua dong chi da ngay lap tuc tro thanh tac pham co gia tri. No la vu khi tu tuong cho toan Dang, toan quan va toan dan quyet danh va quyet thang quan My xam luoc. No gay an tuong manh me va niem tin cho be ban nam chau. No lam cho quan thu sung sot va lung tung hoang mang. Va no da gop phan cung Bo Chinh tri va Quan uy Trung uong ha quyet tam chien luoc chuan bi cho cuoc Tong tien cong Mau Than - 1968 de thuc hien tu tuong chi dao chien luoc cua Ho Chu tich "Danh cho My cut" mot cach tin cay.
Suy cho cung, tu tuong "o gan, danh gan" vua la tu tuong chien thuat lai vua la tu tuong chien luoc. Day la diem thu nhat noi troi trong tu duy cua Dai tuong Nguyen Chi Thanh. Diem noi troi thu hai la chinh anh da de ra bien phap co hieu qua de mo mat tran Tay Nguyen (ke ca viec de xuat lam sao co luong thuc, mot yeu to vo cung quan trong, tien quyet cho viec thuc hien chu truong lon nay; ke ca viec anh de xuat cong tac can bo truoc khi trien khai thuc hien chu truong mo mat tran Tay Nguyen). Toi nho, suot thoi chong Phap va nhung nam dau chong My, rung nui Tay Nguyen con heo hut lam, luc luong cua ta o day con mong manh lam. Can bo vo Nam hay ra Bac deu phai hoac la di lan theo ven bien, hoac la leo deo loi suoi doc day nui Truong Son; dan va gao chi co the gui tren vai thi co gang lam cung chi du an de danh du kich. Thuc te cuoc chien tranh chong My da khang dinh mot hien thuc mang tinh quy luat va chan ly la: Chung ta co mo duoc mat tran Tay Nguyen thi moi mo duoc tuyen duong van tai chien luoc bang co gioi, moi dua duoc luc luong lon nguoi va cua vao mien Nam de thuc hien "Ca nuoc danh giac My, giai phong mien Nam". Mat tran Tay Nguyen mo duoc cung dong thoi thu hut duoc luc luong dich de tao dieu kien cho chien truong Nam Bo, mot chien truong "trong diem cua trong diem" phat trien. Thuc te da chung minh tu tuong chi dao nay la rat dung dan va sac sao.
Mua he nam 1967, khi ra Ha Noi bao cao Bo Chinh tri tinh hinh chien truong va cung voi Bo Chinh tri, voi Ho Chu tich thiet ke va hoach dinh cuoc Tong tien cong Mau Than sap toi, anh Nguyen Chi Thanh da dot ngot tu tran. Day la mot dau thuong vo han, mot ton that vo cung lon cua cach mang Viet Nam, cua chien si va dong bao ca nuoc. Doi voi Trung uong Cuc, Bo chi huy Mien va Quan giai phong mien Nam thi day la mot ton that khong gi bu dap noi. Anh dot ngot ra di, nhung pham chat cach mang, tai nang thao luoc va dao duc loi song cua anh mai mai la tam guong cao ca, sang ngoi, la nguon co vu lon lao doi voi tat ca chung ta.
Toi duoc biet, dong chi Nguyen Chi Thanh tham gia cach mang tu nam 1934, vao Dang Cong san Dong Duong nam 1937. Tu 1937-1938, dong chi lam Bi thu Tinh uy Thua Thien. Hoi nghi toan quoc lan thu 8 cua Dang o Tan Trao, thang 8.1945, da cu dong chi la Uy vien Trung uong chinh thuc va Trung uong chi dinh dong chi lam Bi thu Xu uy Trung ky. Dong chi da bi de quoc Phap bat ba lan, giam o cac nha lao Hue, Lao Bao, Buon Ma Thuot. Bi giam cam, tra tan nhung dong chi luon giu vung khi tiet nguoi cong san, to chuc va lanh dao cuoc dau tranh chong che do ha khac cua nha tu de quoc va tim cach vuot nguc thang loi lai tiep tuc hoat dong, khoi day phong trao cach mang. Dong chi Nguyen Chi Thanh la nguoi cong san kien dinh, trung thanh, gian kho khong son long, kho khan khong lui buoc. Dong chi la nguoi rat gioi ve to chuc va van dong quan chung thuc hien cac chu truong cua Dang. Nhan ro va tin tuong vao suc manh cua nhan dan, dong chi phat huy duoc y chi cach mang, tinh than sang tao cua quan chung de tien hanh chien tranh cach mang, xay dung cac luc luong vu trang nhan dan, phat trien kinh te va van hoa.
Ngay dau khang chien, dai dat hep mien Trung nhanh chong bi thuc dan Phap chiem dong. Quan va dan ta thieu thon moi duong: thieu vu khi, luong thuc, thieu can cu dia an toan trong khi cac don vi vu trang con non tre, nhieu be nguy khon. Luc do, dong chi Nguyen Chi Thanh dua ra nhan dinh moi: Mat dat nhung chua mat nuoc; kien quyet bam dan, xay dung co so, phat trien chien tranh du kich trong vung dich kiem soat se xoay chuyen duoc tinh the. Binh - Tri - Thien tro thanh mot mat tran soi dong va cuc ky anh dung, da gop phan chan dung am muu chia cat chien luoc va mo rong chien tranh ra Thanh-Nghe-Tinh cua thuc dan Phap. Thoi do, dong bao va dong chi o vung nay da noi: "Anh Thanh la linh hon cua cuoc chien dau cua Binh-Tri-Thien khoi lua!".
Nam 1950, dong chi duoc Dang dieu vao quan doi va duoc giao nhiem vu lam Chu nhiem Tong cuc Chinh tri va Pho bi thu Quan uy. Ngay lap tuc va thuong xuyen lien tuc, dong chi Nguyen Chi Thanh giao duc cho can bo chien si ta tham nhuan chi dao cua Chu tich Ho Chi Minh: Quan doi ta la quan doi nhan dan, tu nhan dan ma ra, vi nhan dan ma phuc vu. Dong chi da to chuc thuc hien su lanh dao co hieu luc cua Dang doi voi quan doi, thuc hien duong loi quan su cua Dang, tao ra mot buoc phat trien moi ve suc manh chien dau cua cac luc luong vu trang nhan dan, dap ung yeu cau cua cuoc khang chien, lien tuc mo cac chien dich lon, tu chien dich Bien Gioi 1950 den chien dich Dien Bien Phu. Chap hanh chi thi cua Ho Chu tich va Bo Chinh tri, dong chi Nguyen Chi Thanh da tap trung vao tang cuong ban chat cach mang cua quan doi nhan dan. Tap trung xay dung che do lanh dao tap the cua Dang trong cac cap, tu Tong quan uy den chi bo dai doi, lam cho cong tac tu tuong vuot len tren pham vi cua cong tac dong vien va tac dong tam ly thong thuong cua con nguoi theo ban nang, phat trien thanh cong tac giao duc chu nghia Mac Le-nin, duong loi, chinh sach cua Dang va Nha nuoc, muc tieu chien dau cua quan doi. Voi viec thiet lap va xay dung he thong to chuc cong tac Dang - cong tac chinh tri trong quan doi, dong chi da lam ro cac moi quan he giua quan doi voi Dang, voi Nha nuoc, voi nhan dan, voi bau ban quoc te, trong do moi lien he giua quan doi voi Dang la moi lien he ban chat chi phoi cac moi quan he khac. Cham lo giao duc chinh tri, tu tuong quan su cua Dang the hien trong chien luoc, chien dich va chien thuat; trong giai quyet moi quan he giua chinh tri va quan su, giua tien tuyen va hau phuong, giua con nguoi va vu khi, giua lanh dao va chi huy, giua dao duc va tai nang cua can bo... da tao ra buoc ngoat ve xay dung chinh tri lam co so nang cao suc manh chien dau cua quan doi nhan dan.
Voi trong trach la Chu nhiem Tong cuc Chinh tri, dong chi Nguyen Chi Thanh da chi dao sat sao va truc tiep chu tri viec tong ket cong tac Dang - cong tac chinh tri, xac dinh ro vi tri, chuc nang, nguyen tac tien hanh cong tac chinh tri; phe phan quan diem ha thap va thu hep chuc nang cong tac nay. Dong chi Nguyen Chi Thanh va nguoi ke nhiem la dong chi Song Hao (sau nay la Le Quang Dao) da gop phan quan trong cung voi Quan uy Trung uong xay dung doi ngu can bo cua Dang trong quan doi ngay cang truong thanh, lam nong cot trong hai cuoc khang chien vi dai cua dan toc, dung vung truoc moi thu thach chinh tri phuc tap. Thuong xuyen cham lo vun dap pham chat "Bo doi Cu Ho" - "Trung voi nuoc, trung voi Dang, hieu voi dan, san sang chien dau hy sinh vi doc lap tu do cua To quoc, vi chu nghia xa hoi. Nhiem vu nao cung hoan thanh, kho khan nao cung vuot qua, ke thu nao cung danh thang" la ban chat va truyen thong tot dep cua quan doi ta do Dang va Ho Chu tich day cong giao duc, ren luyen. Dai tuong Nguyen Chi Thanh la nguoi khong ngung cham lo tang cuong ban chat cach mang cua quan doi nhan dan va chinh dong chi la mot vi tuong tieu bieu cho ban chat va truyen thong tot dep cua quan doi ta.
Giai doan buoc vao "Ke hoach 5 nam" xay dung CNXH o mien Bac, duoc Dang phan cong phu trach mat tran nong nghiep, dong chi da xan quan loi ruong xem xet viec canh tac, khao sat nhung kho khan, tim hieu nhung noi san xuat kha, lang nghe y kien cac nha khoa hoc, xac dinh phuong huong phat trien san xuat, pha "xieng ba sao" cung voi viec tham canh tang nang suat, phat dong phong trao thi dua voi Dai Phong... tuy chi moi mot thoi gian ngan nhung dong chi da de lai nhieu bai hoc kinh nghiem quy va nhung an tuong tot dep cho can bo va dong bao tren mat tran kinh te hang dau nay.
Chu tich Ho Chi Minh chi ro suc manh cua cach mang la suc manh cua toan dan, trong do cong - nong la luc luong co ban. Tham nhuan tu tuong do, dong chi Nguyen Chi Thanh cham lo tang cuong doan ket dan toc. La nguoi hoat dong cach mang khap ca Bac - Trung - Nam, dong chi cang cham lo xay dung khoi doan ket Bac - Nam, doan ket quan dan, cung co lien minh cong - nong, manh dan boi duong va de bat can bo xuat than cong nong va cac dan toc it nguoi, cac dia phuong, dong thoi coi trong tri thuc cach mang. Song o dau dong chi cung la hat nhan, la trung tam doan ket.
Thuc hien loi day cua Ho Chu tich "Dao duc la goc; kien quyet chong chu nghia ca nhan", dong chi Nguyen Chi Thanh la nguoi dau tien "no sung" va kien tri dau tranh chong chu nghia ca nhan trong quan doi. Loi noi cua dong chi luon co suc thuyet phuc vi ban than dong chi song trong sang, gian di, khiem ton, doan ket chan thanh. Phe binh va tu phe binh thoa dang nhung nghiem tuc, khong "be xe to", khong "di hoa vi quy". Dong chi la mot mau muc ve: loi noi di doi voi viec lam, ly luan lien he voi thuc tien, dao duc di doi voi tai nang, chinh tri va quan su song toan. Cuoc doi hoat dong cach mang cua dong chi Dai tuong Nguyen Chi Thanh ke tu buoi ban dau den khi o nhung cuong vi lanh dao cao nhat, luc nao dong chi cung xong xao tham nhap vao cuoc song cua dong bao va chien si, lan lon voi phong trao, tim ra quy luat phat trien tao ra buoc ngoat moi cho cach mang, tu toi ren minh trong dau tranh cach mang, Dai tuong Nguyen Chi Thanh da tro thanh nha chinh tri - quan su loi lac cua Dang, quan doi va dan toc ta. Nhu can bo va ba con tren mat tran nong nghiep goi anh la "Dai tuong Nhan dan". Anh To Huu viet: "Sang trong nhu ngoc mot con nguoi". Con dong chi Vien truong Vien nghien cuu Ho Chi Minh va cac lanh tu cua Dang da viet rang: "Sau Bac Ho vi dai, mot trong nhung nguoi cong san lanh dao co duc tai, co tam huyet, khi phach, co suc hap dan, loi cuon manh me voi quan chung, do la dong chi Nguyen Chi Thanh!".
Cuoc doi hoat dong cach mang, song va lam viec theo guong Chu tich Ho Chi Minh vi dai, hoc va thuc hanh duoc nhieu loi day cua Bac, Dai tuong Nguyen Chi Thanh la hinh anh tieu bieu cua "Anh bo doi Cu Ho" voi day du hinh tuong cao dep, tam voc va y nghia sau xa cua danh hieu cao quy do. Anh la mot trong nhung can bo lanh dao loi lac cua Cach mang Viet Nam, cua Dang ta, Nha nuoc ta, cua Quan doi ta; Anh la nguoi con uu tu cua dan toc Viet Nam trong thoi dai Ho Chi Minh quang vinh!
Ha Noi, thang 12/2006,

Cang Sai Gon muon xoa so con tau anh hung
Cang Sai Gon muon xoa so con tau anh hung Tags: Cang Sai Gon, Thai Lan, Hai Phong, Tau CSG, Sai Gon, thanh tich xuat sac, con tau, anh hung, cong ty, xoa so, luu giu, tro ve, 240, VN, nguoi
Tau CSG 240 neo dau tai Cang Sai Gon.
Nhung ngay gan day, tren mot to bao thong tin ve viec Cang Sai Gon (CSG) se ban dau gia mot so phuong tien. Dieu dang noi la mot trong so cac phuong tien bi thanh ly co tau lai dat CSG 240 - con tau duoc Nha nuoc phong tang danh hieu Anh hung Lao dong vao nam 1985. Con tau dac biet
Tau CSG 240 duoc san xuat tai My, xuat xuong nam 1943. Truoc 30/4/1975, tau co chuc nang chinh la lai dat cac tau co tai trong lon ra vao CSG. Sau giai phong, tau CSG 240 thuoc quyen khai thac va su dung cua Xi nghiep Thuy doi (truc thuoc CSG), nay la Cong ty Lai dat Tau bien.
Co nhung thoi khac dac biet khien con tau CSG 240 tro nen noi tieng. Vai ngay truoc khi Sai Gon giai phong, tau Oscela (ten cu cua CSG 240) thuc hien chuyen hanh trinh tu Sai Gon di Thai Lan. Tren tau co 12 thanh vien, trong do co 4 nguoi VN, con lai la nguoi Philippines, Han Quoc. Khi tau den Thai Lan thi nghe tin Sai Gon giai phong. Mot so nguoi muon giu tau lai Thai Lan nhung anh em thuyen vien VN da “dau tranh” quyet liet de mang tau tro ve VN. Nhieu the he can bo, thuyen vien tung phuc vu tren tau CSG 240 sau giai phong, deu khong giau ve tu hao khi noi ve con tau.
May truong Nguyen Van Sanh, mot trong nhung nguoi gan bo voi tau CSG 240, ke ve nhung dot “cong tac dac biet” cua tau CSG 240 cach day hon 20 nam voi giong day xuc dong: “Co lan nhan lenh keo sa lan 3.000 tan tiep te cho bo doi Truong Sa, nhieu anh em trong so 21 thanh vien thuy thu doan khong tin minh co ngay tro ve. Nhung roi vuot qua bao hiem nguy, gian kho, anh em da dua tau den dich binh yen, hoan thanh xuat sac nhiem vu duoc giao”.
Sau chuyen di Truong Sa, tau CSG 240 tiep tuc thuc hien nhieu nhiem vu quan trong tai vung bien gioi Tay Nam. Voi nhung thanh tich dac biet tren cung nhieu dong gop khac, nam 1985, tau CSG 240 vinh du duoc Nha nuoc phong tang danh hieu Anh hung Lao dong.
Thanh ly con tau: Nhung ly le chua thuyet phuc
Mot can bo hien con lam viec tren tau CSG 240 khang dinh: Neu duoc dai tu, tau van chay duoc tu 5 den 7 nam. Nhung dieu ong va dong doi mong muon la cong ty khong nen

Xoa bop de dieu tri chung liet van dong
Xoa bop de dieu tri chung liet van dong Tags: lieu phap xoa bop, ngon tay cai, tu duoi len, xuong banh che, su dieu khien, benh nhan, tinh trang, dieu tri, chung liet, nhe nhang, sau do, 3, mat, vai, khop
Viec xoa bop, bam huyet giup phuc hoi van dong.
Liet van dong la tinh trang giam hoac mat van dong cua co do mat su dieu khien cua than kinh chi phoi. Tinh trang nay keo dai se dan toi cung khop, teo co, roi loan dinh duong, suy giam su luu thong huyet dich vung chi liet. Lieu phap xoa bop se giup tang tuan hoan tai cho, hoi phuc cac day than kinh va han che cac bieu hien tren.
Viec xoa bop nen duoc tien hanh boi nhung ky thuat vien duoc dao tao co ban. Tuy nhien, nguoi nha benh nhan cung nen biet mot so phuong phap don gian de ap dung ho tro cho qua trinh dieu tri (lam 1-2 lan/ngay). Cac dong tac xoa bop thuong dung bao gom:
- Xoa xat: Dung phan goc gan ban tay va mo ngon tay ut (hoac mo ngon tay cai) van dong truot tren da theo chieu thang, chieu ngang (xat), hoac chieu xoay tron (xoa). Truoc khi xoa xat, nen boi bot tan (talc) de lam tron, tranh gay ton thuong da.
- Day: Dung phan goc gan ban tay va mo ngon tay ut (hoac mo ngon tay cai) an nhe len da, tu tu di dong theo duong tron. Luc an phai dong deu tai cac thoi diem. Khi day, da nguoi benh va tay nguoi day luon luon dinh sat nhau.
- Lan: Cac ngon tay hoi khum lai. Van dong khop co tay nhe nhang sao cho phan mu ban tay, mo ngon ut, cac khop ban va ngon tay lan nhe nhang tren da cua benh nhan voi mot luc ep nhat dinh.
- Bop: Dung ngon tay cai va cac ngon con lai chum nhu gong kim de bop va hoi keo thit len. Suc bop manh hay nhe tuy tung vung co day hay mong (hinh 4).
- Bam huyet: Dung dau ngon tay cai bam vao huyet voi muc tang dan, cho toi khi benh nhan cam thay tuc nang thi giu yen trong khoang 1 phut. Khi bam, dot 1 va dot 2 ngon cai vuong goc voi nhau.
Sau day la cac buoc xoa bop cho nguoi liet van dong:
1. Chi tren
- Benh nhan nam nghieng sang ben tay lanh hoac ngoi thang tren ghe. Nguoi xoa bop dung dang sau, xoa vung vai cho nong len, day vung vai 3 lan, lan vung vai 3 lan, sau do bop vung vai phia truoc, phia sau 3 lan.
- Dung tay trai nang canh tay liet cua nguoi benh, tay phai xat doc mat trong, ngoai, truoc, sau canh tay (tu duoi len tren) 3 lan. Day tu co tay toi ba vai mat truoc va sau 5 lan. Lan doc tu co tay toi ba vai truoc sau 3 lan. Bop tu tren xuong duoi truoc sau 3 lan. Sau do dung ngon tay cai day mat gan tay va mat mu ban tay liet, miet doc ke ngon tay.
- Bam cac huyet kien tinh (diem giua bo tren vai), kien ngung (o ngay duoi mom cung vai), khuc tri (diem tan cung ngoai nep gap khuyu), hop coc (nam o ke giua xuong dot ban ngon cai va ngon tro).
- Mot tay giu co dinh vai nguoi benh, tay kia nam vao phan canh tay benh nhan, van dong khop vai benh nhan nhe nhang theo cac chieu cua khop. Sau do, dung mot tay co dinh canh tay benh nhan, tay kia nam cang tay benh nhan de van dong khop khuyu. Tiep theo la co dinh cang tay benh nhan de van dong khop co tay va cac khop ban ngon voi cach tuong tu. Nen lam nhe nhang, tranh van dong qua tam, gay ton thuong day chang quanh khop.
2. Chi duoi
- Benh nhan nam ngua, tay trai nguoi xoa bop nam chac co chan, tay phai thao tac theo cac buoc: xat doc mat truoc, sau, trong, ngoai tu co chan toi dui, moi mat 3 lan; day mat trong, truoc, ngoai theo chieu tu duoi len, moi mat 3 lan; lan mat trong, truoc, ngoai theo chieu tu duoi len, moi mat 3 lan; bop doc tu duoi len ca 4 mat, moi mat 3 lan.
- Bam cac huyet luong khau (tu goc tren ben ngoai cua xuong banh che do thang len 3 cm), tuc tam ly (tu goc duoi ben ngoai cua xuong banh che do thang xuong 4,5 cm), duong lang tuyen (tu dau duoi xuong banh che do xuong 3 cm roi do ngang ra ngoai 1,5 cm).
- Mot tay giu cang chan benh nhan, tay kia nam dau goi benh nhan, nhe nhang nang chan cho cang chan gap vao dui, dui gap vao bung, lam khoang 5-10 lan. Sau do, mot tay giu got benh nhan, tay kia nam ngon chan benh nhan, quay co chan 2-3 lan, day nguoc ban chan ve phia cang chan 2-3 cai.

Anh T.N. (thi tran Lai Thieu, huyen Thuan An, Binh Duong), tung 2 lan len cai nghien tai Trung tam (1996-1997 va 1998-2000), to cao: “Truoc moi nguoi, lanh dao Trung tam bao gio cung ca tung day la truong phuc hoi nhan pham tot nhat. Nhung thuc chat ho lai doi xu voi con nguoi rat tan te”. Ngay dau tien vao Trung tam, can bo quan giao day T.N. va mot so nguoi vao phong cach ly. Moi nguoi bi lot truong. Vo Van Rai (nguoi tham gia danh chet hoc vien Nguyen Huu Thuan, da bi khoi to) hoi tung nguoi: “May vao day toi gi?”. Tra loi: “Da, em choi ma tuy”, nguoi khac: “Em la gai mai dam”, “Toi tron nghia vu”... Ke theo la nhung tran roi dien, day dien, gay sat boc nhua vao nguc, bung, lung... Hoc vien ai cung mau me day minh. Anh N. phan doi thi bi nhan vien bao ve Khuat Quang Pha (chau ong Khuat Quang Hung, Giam doc Trung tam) tong vao phong biet giam, dung cum, day dien treo mot chan N. len xa nha hon 4 gio lien. Tran don nay, Pha tuyen bo: "De tra thu thang gia vi dam len tieng, phan doi nhan vien bao ve danh dap hoc vien”. Bao ve Trung tam con muon tay mot so hoc vien cu danh dan mat nhung nguoi moi vao trai.
Danh dap, hanh ha chi em phu nu (thuoc dien 05 - gai mai dam) da man nhat la Nguyen Quang Thuong (ke tham gia danh chet Nguyen Huu Thuan, da bi khoi to). Anh T. ke: “Thuong y the co o du lam o tinh nen khong coi ai ra gi. Nhieu lan Thuong dung roi dien danh dap chi em, lam ho mau me day minh ma van khong tha. Chua het, thay co nao ngon mat, Thuong tim cach cho len phuc vu nuoc noi, dam bop cho minh. Dem thi ep ho lam no le tinh duc cho y. Hau qua, co hoc vien co thai, duoc dua ra khoi trai”. Co lan, thay Thuong danh chi em, mot hoc vien ten Duong ra can da bi hung than nay chem xe lung, mau rong rong...
Su kien tan bao nhat den nay van la noi kinh hoang truyen mieng cho nhung hoc vien nu o day la vu hanh ha chi Thuy nam 1997. Chan giay, Pha da lien tuc vao nguoi Thuy, cho den khi chi bat tinh, phia duoi tran mau vi bang huyet, phai dua di cap cuu...
Ai bao che cho toi ac?
Cau tra loi tu phia hoc vien: Dut khoat co su bao che, boi trong Trung tam toan la nguoi nha cua giam doc, pho giam doc. Cu the, Giam doc Hung co den 4 anh em ho hang (Pha la chau, Hien lai xe - em; Phi - em cot cheo; Phuoc - con trai, cung tham gia danh Nguyen Huu Thuan). Ut Rai, mot trong hai hung than o Trung tam, la cau cua Pho Giam doc Oanh. Cac hoc vien khac cho biet, Thuan chi la nan nhan thu 4 o day. Truoc do, da xay ra 3 cai chet tuc tuoi cua cac hoc vien la anh Nguyen Van Sa, chi No, anh Luong Que Ngoc, nhung tat ca roi vao quen lang...
Ong Nguyen Minh Duoc, Giam doc So LDTB&XH Binh Phuoc, khang dinh: “Khong co su bao che cho cap duoi gay toi ac”. Neu dung vay thi sao co nhung su viec dau long neu tren. Pho phong Canh sat Dieu tra Binh Phuoc, ong Le Huu Hanh cung bien minh : “Dua tren quyet dinh cua Trung tam va ket qua giam dinh phap y cua tinh nen da ra quyet dinh khong khoi to vu an hinh su ve cai chet cua Nguyen Huu Thuan”. Tai sao lai dua tren quyet dinh cua Trung tam, khi ma nhiem vu cua canh sat dieu tra lam lam ro xem Trung tam co bao che toi ac khong. Va tai

Dashi Station (simplified Chinese: 大石站) is a station of Line 3 of the Guangzhou Metro. It started operations in 28 December 2006. It is located at the underground of New Moon Pearl Garden (simplified Chinese: 新月明珠花园) in Dashi Subdistrict (simplified Chinese: 大石街道), Panyu District, which is near Xinguang Express Way (simplified Chinese: 新光快速公路).[1][2]

Dated Aizawl, the 9th November, 2017: Vawiin ni 9th November, 2017 (Nilaini) chawhnu Dar 1:00 khan MZP hruaitute leh MJA memberte chuan MZP Conference Hall, MZP Pisapui-ah inkawmkhawmna leh Thingpui in hona hun an hmang a, he hun hi Tv. Michael lalramsanga, Tresurer MZP Chuan a kai hruaiin, Tv. Lalnunmawia Pautu, General Secretary MZP leh Pu C. Lalhmachhuana, General secretary MJA ten Pawl aiawhin in hmelhriattirna hun an nei a. Pawl aiawh in Vanlalrema Vantawl, President MJA leh Tv. L. Ramdinliana Renthlei, President MZP ten thu an sawi a ni.
He huna thusawitu Pu Vanlarema Vantawl, President MJA chuan, “MZP ten heti ang inkawmna hun tha in siam chu lawm ka tiin chunzawm zel tlak a ni. MZP chu miten Political Platform ang ah an ngai chu thalo ka tiin pawi ka ti hle a. Mite sawi dan leh ngaihdanah MZP chu buai lova, zirlaite leh ram leh hnam tan in thil tih ropui tak tak te chu chhunzawm a, Zofate innghahna in nihna hre reng a huai tak leh rim tak a thawk zel turin ka chah duh che u a ni.” a ti a.
Pu Vanlalrema Vantawl chuan,”MZP hruaitute chu zirlai hruaitu in nih angin zirna chungchang ngai pawimawh a, dan anga hma in lak zel hi ka duh a, lehkha thiam in nihna hria a, fing tak leh fimkhur taka hma la turin ka ngen che u a, phai lama Mizo zirlai awm te pawh Zofate ti hming hliau leh hnamdang te hmuh sit a awm lo turin leh zonun zemawi tak lanchhuah tir tura fuih turin MZP hruaitu leh Member kal khawm te ka sawm in ka ngen nghal bawk a ni.” a ti bawk
He huna thusawitu dang Tv. L. Ramdinliana Renthlei MZP President chuan,”Ram leh hnam leh zirlaite tana kan thawhpui chanchinbu mite vawiin niah kan sawmna ngai pawimawh a inkawmkhawmna hun tha min neihpui hi MZP chu kan lawm hle a, kan kal zelna tura min finchhuah turin MJA member zawng zawng te ka sawm che u a ni. MZP chu zirlai pawl kan nih angin zirna chungchang kan ngai pawimawh dawn a, Mizoram zirna in hma a sawn theih nan theihtawp kan chhuah dawn a ni. Zirtirtu indaih lohna chhan ber chu zirtirtu tlem vang ni lo in, zirtirtu awmsa semrual loh vang niin kan hria a, zirtirtu semrual a nih theih nan hma kan la dawn a ni.”a ti a.
L. Ramdinliana Renthlei chuan,”Chakma Bangladesh atanga dan lova lo lut chungchangah hian MZP in hma kan lo la tawh thin a, dan lova foreigner lo lut chungchangah hian hma kan la chhunzawm zel dawn a ni. Mizoram chhungah hian dan lo a khawdin tamtak sorkarin a pawm loh a awm a, dan lova khawdin tam zawk hi Chakma khua an ni a, heng khaw din ah hian Chakma foreigner te inbengbelin khua leh tui nih an tum thin a ni. Dan lova Chakma khawdin tamtak hi nuaibo a nih theih nan MZP chuan hmalak kan tum a. Kan hmalakna turah hian MJA member ten min thlawp tlata min finchhuah turin kan sawm che u a ni.”a ti a.
L. Ramdinliana Renthlei chuan Tuikuk chungchang sawiin, Chakma chungchang ringawt kan sawi a, Tuikuk chungchang hi kan lo theihnghilh ang tih ka hlau a, Tuikuk te hi anmahni duhthu ngei a Mizoram chhuahsan tute an ni a, Mizorama lo cheng tawh thin te hi chu Mizoramah lo kir se kan ti em em thin a. Tuikuk Mizorama lo kir duh lo te chu Mizoram electoral roll atanga paih hi MZP chuan kan duhdan a la ni reng a, Mizoram chhung eng election-ah pawh MLA a ni emaw MP a ni emaw Mizoram state pawn atanga vote an thlak hi kan rem ti ngai dawn lo a ni, a ti bawk.
Vawiin MZP hruaitute leh MJA memberte inkawmkhawmna ah hian in pawh tlang takin vei zawngte sawi hona hun hman a ni a, member thahnem takin thu an sawi a ni.

Cuoi va meu voi Vietnam Idol
Cuoi va meu voi Vietnam IdolTags: Vietnam Idol, NS Tuan Khanh, NS Ha Dung, Siu Black, Tuan Khanh, Ha Dung, Than tuong am nhac, Sao Mai diem hen, ban giam khao, chu khong phai, co the noi, nhu the nao, thi sinh, cuoc thi, chung toi, ban
Ca si SiuBlack, nhac si Tuan Khanh va Ha Dung (tu trai qua) tai buoi giao luu - Anh: T.T.D
+ Em thay day la mot cuoc thi rat hap dan, cac ban thi sinh rat co phong cach, bieu dien rat co lua. Cac anh chi da thay bong dang than tuong am nhac cua Viet Nam xuat hien chua? (Trang Hoa, 24 tuoi, greentallboy_vn1982@)
- Ca si Siu Black: Se co mot than tuong am nhac, nhung day moi chi la man mo dau cua cuoc thi, chua the danh gia chinh xac ve mot than tuong am nhac va than tuong do se duoc tim thay o cuoi cuoc thi. Khong chi BGK ma chinh cac ban cung se tim duoc than tuong am nhac cua minh.
+ Chao anh Tuan Khanh, luc xem Viet Nam Idol em rat an tuong ve anh Xuan Linh (mot nguoi co chat giong theo em la rat phong khoang va thu hut) va chi Thao Trang (rat giong mot diva). Khong biet anh co cung suy nghi voi em khong? (Minh Ngoc, 20 tuoi, lalax_vuive@ )
- NS Tuan Khanh: De noi ngay la toi thich ai cung khong kho nhung lam vay that khong cong bang voi nhung nguoi khac dang no luc het minh. Tuy vay, phai nhin nhan la Xuan Linh va Thao Trang ro rang da gay duoc (cho toi luc nay) nhung an tuong ma nhieu khan gia thien ve phong cach tu do, phong khoang... deu yeu men. Mong rang cac ban ay se con di xa hon nua, du la khong trong cuoc thi nay.
+ Em thay mot so thi sinh co giong hat rat tot, chi co phong cach chua dinh hinh ro, sao BGK khong tao cho cac ban ay mot co hoi, neu co nguoi noi BGK qua khat khe, BGK nghi nhu the nao? (Vu Cao Anh Phi, 20 tuoi, chip_can9451@ )
- NS Tuan Khanh: That ra giua nhung thi sinh co nhung tiem nang khac nhau, dieu khac biet la chat luong trinh bay cua ho o thoi diem do cung nhu la do chenh cua cung nhung tiem nang khac. Su lua chon mang tinh khac nghiet la dieu bat buoc phai lam. Di nhien, nhan lay mot dieu phan nan la cai khong the thieu cua chuyen lam giam khao.
+ Rat vui vi moi thi sinh co mot dac diem rieng cung nhu BGK co loi nhan xet chinh xac va di dom. Xin hoi, neu nhung ban em rat dam me ca hat nhung lai nhut nhat thi nen co loi khuyen gi de ho tu tin hon de co the tham gia nhung chuong trinh nhu Idol VN 2007? (le uyen thanh nga`, 22 tuoi, tomato912002)
Ca si SiuBlack: thi sinh nen tu tin khi hat...- Anh: T.T.D
- Ca si Siu Black: Khi da xac dinh minh di thi thi minh khong nen nhut nhat, va neu da co su dam me thi moi su e ngai hay nen de lai phia sau, va nen tu tin dung hat truoc BGK va nhieu nguoi nhu vay. Ban co the dung hat mot minh, xem nhu khong co ai, vi du nhu la nham mat chang han!
+ Toi nay, em vua coi vong piano xong, 10/10 thi sinh deu duoc giam khao khen, danh gia cao (hay co le che cung khong loai duoc ho, nen khen de dong vien)... mong rang BGK co the dinh huong cho khan gia chon duoc Idol dich thuc, vi du sao BGK cung co chuyen mon sau hon... (nguyen ho nam long, 21 tuoi, namlong3286@ )
- NS Tuan Khanh: Khong chi 10, ma ca 30 nguoi vao den vong nay, that su la nhung nguoi da co gang het minh. Chung toi chi con cong viec ghi nhan ve nhung no luc tiep theo cua ho, khuyen khich ho lam tot hon, goi mo giup cho ho.
Hon nua, do la nhung nguoi ma chung toi da chon tu hang ngan nguoi khac, tham chi phai chap nhan nhung ap luc nang ne tu cong chung, thi sinh... nen dong vien ho, toi nghi la dieu thiet nhat hien nay. Tuy vay, neu ho dung o lai vi mot ly do nao do, chung toi cung khong kiem loi phe binh dau.
+ Co the nhung thi sinh thi "het minh" den noi khong biet minh dang the hien tren tivi truoc rat nhieu khan gia, ho the hien khong may la lich su va hoi "qua dang","tu nhien chu nghia" chu khong phai la tu tin, BGK co nghi vay khong? (nguyen quoc dat, 27 tuoi, nguyenquocdat80)
- Ca si Siu Black: Toi khong nghi rang cac thi sinh ay the hien qua dang, vi ho da co nhung dam me, su tu tin. Ho da dam lam nhung dieu ma nguoi khac khong the lam. Ho da het minh the hien, co the ho dang run, nhung ho da lam het minh va toi ung ho thi sinh day. Chinh ban than ban hay tu tin va hay lam dieu ma nguoi ta lam duoc, cung nhu ban co the lam duoc.
+ Toi dang song o My va cung theo doi Idol o day. Theo nhu toi duoc biet thi BGK duoc chon vao 3 vai, 1 nha san xuat, 1 ca si, va 1 nha phe binh sau sac ve chuyen mon. Moi GK sau khi thi sinh trinh bay deu dua ra quan niem va y kien cua rieng minh, nhung trong nhung dot phat song VN Idol thi toi thay rang BGK lai khong lam nhu vay. Co the cho toi biet nguyen nhan vi sao? (MonKat, 22 tuoi, monkatdebears@ )
Nhac si Ha Dung: Chung toi khong du trinh do de chon " Than tuong VIET NAM". Chung toi chi tim kiem "Than tuong am nhac" ma thoi - Anh: T.T.D
- NS Ha Dung: Chuong trinh VN Idol duoc thuc hien theo ban quyen cua Pop Idol chu khong phai la American Idol. Khi chuong trinh duoc san xuat tai VN, chung ta phai lam sao cho phu hop voi van hoa cua nguoi Viet. Khan gia co the thay, BGK da dua ra nhung y kien trai chieu nhau, yeu to gay soc khong nhieu vi chung toi muon thi sinh nhin thay nhung cai duoc va chua duoc cua minh, tu do rut ra kinh nghiem de tien bo hon.
+ Kinh thua cac anh chi Giam khao. Vi toi khong duoc xem chuong trinh "Than tuong am nhac" ngay tu dau nen toi khong biet muc dich cua cuoc thi nay la gi, xem cac chuong trinh sau thay cung "vui vui". Chuong trinh nay tim kiem giong ca hay, co tinh nghe thuat, hay tim nhung "anh he" ca nhac (vi toi thay vao den vong ban ket roi ma cac giong ca da so cung khong co gi dac sac lam)? Rat mong duoc cac anh chi giai thich ho. Xin cam on va chuc cac anh chi nhieu suc khoe. (Nguyen Hien Long, 32 tuoi, asuvkstn@ )
- NS Tuan Khanh: Co vai dieu ma toi muon moi ban theo doi them chuong trinh Than tuong am nhac: xem nhieu hon de vui nhieu hon voi cac tinh cach da dang cua the he tre, chia se va nhin nhan su tu do trong suy nghi cua ho, hon la nhin thay ho nhu nhung "anh he". Chung ta co the cung vui va cam on nhung nguoi da den, mang den cho chung ta nhung gio phut dang yeu trong cuoc doi.
Con den vong trong, toi nghi rang cu theo doi them, dan dan ban se nhan ra duoc tiem nang va suc bieu dien cua cac thi sinh. Cuoc thi nay con keo dai den thang 9, toi nghi neu binh luan ve chuyen cac thi sinh khong co gi dac sac co khi la hoi voi.
+ Em thay co nhung thi sinh chi hat duoc hai ba cau thi da nghe "duoc roi cam on em". Co khi nao anh chi nghi moi bat dau nhu vay chua du thoi gian cho thi sinh the hien het minh khong, gay tam ly cho thi sinh khi chon bai? (Nguyen Nhac San San, 18 tuoi, nuhoangsonca7)
- Ca si Siu Black: Cung co the rang thi sinh do da the hien day du chat giong ma BGK muon nghe, va co the danh gia duoc thi sinh do hat nhu the nao. Chi can mot cau hat thi da co the biet duoc thi sinh do di tiep hay khong, chu khong phai de ho khong co du thoi gian de the hien het bai. Va duong nhien co mot so bai, ho tu tin khi hat het bai va BGK phai nghe hang tram, hang ngan giong hat, neu nhu vay thi khong du thoi gian cho thi sinh khac.
+ Su lua chon cua ban giam khao dua tren nhung tieu chi nao? (Lai Hoang Tien Dat, 16 tuoi, whitehero2512@ )
- NS Ha Dung: O moi vong thi deu co tieu chi chon lua rieng cua vong thi do va tieu chuan chinh van la giong hat. Co the ke mot so tieu chuan de chon lua: o vong loai chung toi dat biet chu y den nhung thi sinh co tinh cach nhat trong giong hat, phong cach trinh dien, phuc trang, sac voc. Phong thieu mau thieu sat o phu nu mang thai Tags: gay thieu mau, Thieu Sat, phu nu, mang thai, chat sat, tinh trang, thuc pham, sinh, con, bu, phong, viec
Thieu mau, thieu sat do dau?
Tai buoi noi chuyen chuyen de “Thieu mau thieu sat va acid folic o phu nu”, do Trung tam Truyen thong - Giao duc suc khoe TP.HCM to chuc, bac si Tran Thi Minh Hanh (Trung tam Dinh duong TP.HCM) cho biet, theo thong ke cua To chuc Y te the gioi (WHO), hien co den 1/3 dan so tren the gioi bi tinh trang thieu mau, tap trung nhieu nhat o phu nu mang thai (voi 50% luong thai phu tren the gioi bi thieu mau, phan lon la o cac nuoc dang phat trien); ke do la tre nho duoi 5 tuoi va lua tuoi hoc sinh. Nguyen nhan gay thieu mau la do co the san xuat te bao hong cau khong du do thieu sat; te bao hong cau bi pha huy; mat mau o phu nu tuoi sinh de, hoac do nhiem giun san lam thieu sat; do thieu cac chat dinh duong de tao mau nhu: acid folic, vitamin B12, vitamin A; do di truyen (benh thalassemia); nhung yeu to lien quan den sinh san (sinh nhieu lan, khong cho con bu...).
Co the co nhieu nguyen nhan gay thieu mau xay ra dong thoi tren mot nguoi. Con thieu sat la tinh trang co the khong the huy dong sat tu nguon du tru, anh huong den viec cung cap sat cho cac mo va giai doan nang se gay thieu mau. Thieu sat thuong la do hau qua cua che do an uong khong du chat sat, do co the tang nhu cau su dung chat sat nhu trong luc mang thai hay cho con bu...
Phong ngua ra sao?
Can da dang hoa bua an, nen chon thuc pham giau chat sat va thuc pham giup hap thu tot chat sat. Sat co nhieu trong gan, thit, ca, trung, dau, rau xanh. Nen biet rang, sat tu nguon thuc pham dong vat se hap thu vao co the tot hon la sat co tu nguon thuc pham thuc vat. Neu bua an co dung kem thuc pham len men (dua chua, dua gia...), hoac dung cac loai trai cay giau vitamin C (cam, buoi, so ri, thom...) de trang mieng, thi se giup viec hap thu chat sat tot hon.
Can luu y, nhung thuc pham uc che viec hap thu chat sat gom: tanin (co trong nuoc tra, ca phe, coca va mot so loai rau co vi chat); phan vo cua cac hat ngu coc... Vi the khong nen uong tra dac, ca phe hay coca sau bua an vi se lam giam su hap thu chat sat.
Chat sat va acid folic rat quan trong doi voi phu nu mang thai, cho con bu va tre nho. Sat khong nhung tham gia vao viec van chuyen oxy den nao, ma con truc tiep tham gia vao su phat trien chuc nang cua nao bo. Thieu sat se lam luong Hemoglolin giam, kha nang cung cap oxy cho cac co quan bi han che, do do, hoat dong the luc va tri oc se bi giam. Thai phu bi thieu sat se tang nguy co sinh non hay tre sinh ra se co luong sat du tru kem... Con thieu hut acid folic la nguyen nhan gay di tat ong than kinh trong qua trinh phat

Tags: Cuc Duong, Ha Noi, duong thuy noi dia, giao thong duong thuy, canh sat giao thong, cac cong ty, cuu ho, xu ly, vi pham, an chan, de an, tuyen duong, dong, nop, tau,
Canh sat giao thong duong thuy kiem tra phuong tien. Anh: CAND
Nhieu tau, thuyen chay tren tuyen duong thuy noi dia song Hong phai nop le phi cho cac cong ty cuu ho . Neu khong, khi mac can se bi chet gia toi vai chuc trieu dong.
Theo Cuc truong Cuc Canh sat giao thong Nguyen Quoc Tuan, nhieu cong ty loi dung viec duoc phep kinh doanh cuu ho, tu y gap tung chu tau thuyen, ep ky cac hop dong nop mot khoan tien nhat dinh. Nhung nguoi co tinh khong nop, neu bi mac can thi bi chet gia cuu ho, chi phi truc can co khi len toi vai chuc trieu dong. Do vay, mot so chu phuong tien du biet phai nop tien deu dan cho nhung cong ty nay la phi ly, nhung danh "ngam bo hon lam ngot".
Theo thong ke cua co quan cong an, moi cong ty tu ap dat mot muc phi bat cac chu phuong tien phai nop: Cong ty Thuong Phong thu 150.000 dong mot luot tau thuyen qua lai, Cong ty Bien Dong va Cong ty Hoa Nam thu 100.000 dong mot luot, Cong ty Thang Long thu 70.000 dong mot luot. Tong so tien chu phuong tien phai nop cho cac cong ty nay khi di tu Viet Tri ve Ha Noi la 450.000 dong. Lanh dao Doan quan ly duong song so 1 (Phu Tho) cho rang, cac doanh nghiep nay thuc chat muon danh nghia cuu ho, cuu nan de "an chan" cac chu phuong tien.
Theo ong Tuan, tinh hinh mat trat tu an toan giao thong duong thuy dien bien phuc tap nhat tren tuyen duong thuy noi dia song Hong la doan tu Viet Tri ve den Ha Noi. Tuyen duong thuy nay dai 75,5 km, qua 55 xa cua 10 huyen, thuoc 4 tinh, thanh pho: Phu Tho, Vinh Phuc, Ha Tay va Ha Noi. Noi com nhat la nhung noi thuong xuyen xay ra tinh trang tau mac can can duoc cuu ho do co nhieu diem khan can, dong thoi co nhieu tau trong tai lon tren 200 tan chay qua.
Khong chi "lam luat" cac chu phuong tien, mot so cong ty nay con tranh gianh quyen loi, dia ban cuu ho dan den xay ra khong it vu viec do mau. Dien hinh nhu vu nhom cua Xuyen "Rau" thuoc Cong ty Thuong Phong danh nhau voi nhom cua Toan "Cut" cua Cong ty Bien Dong va Hoa Nam. Ngay 10/3/2006, Xuyen "Rau" da mang ca vu khi "nong" ra doi dau voi doi thu. Nhieu nguoi bi thuong trong vai lan xo sat...
Theo y kien chung cua Cuc Canh sat giao thong duong thuy va Cuc Duong song, trong thoi gian dai, cac cong ty cuu ho dua vao la "bua" giay phep kinh doanh de "hoanh hanh".
Xu ly hinh su nhung ca nhan co tinh vi pham
Truoc thuc trang tren, thieu tuong Pham Van Duc, Tong cuc pho Tong cuc Canh sat da co y kien chi dao: "Cuc CSGT duong thuy can phoi hop voi cong an cac dia phuong va Cuc Duong song dieu tra, co bien phap xu ly nghiem, dut diem tinh trang lon xon trong cong tac cuu ho, cuu nan tren cac tuyen giao thong duong thuy noi dia, trong thoi gian som nhat. Neu cac cong ty tren co bieu hien vi pham phap luat thi can dieu tra, bat giu va xu ly nghiem, tham chi xu ly hinh su.
Cuc truong Canh sat giao thong duong thuy cung cho biet, da cung voi Cuc Duong song dua ra ke hoach phoi hop lien nganh nham chan chinh, giai quyet dut diem tinh trang lon xon tren. Theo do, luc luong chuc nang can tang cuong tuan tra, kiem soat, xu ly nghiem khac moi vi pham ve dieu kien hoat dong cua nhung don vi kinh doanh dich vu cuu ho, cung nhung vi pham ve trat tu giao thong duong thuy noi dia...
Dong thoi, tien hanh cac bien phap nghiep vu de xac minh, thu thap tai lieu ve cac hanh vi pham phap hinh su cua cac to chuc, ca nhan kinh doanh dich vu cuu ho duong thuy de xu ly nghiem theo phap luat.

Nghe An Mot gia dinh khon kho vi co 8 nguoi dien
Nghe An Mot gia dinh khon kho vi co 8 nguoi dien Tags: Nghe An, Thanh Chuong, Nguyen Quang Nam, Thanh An, mot gia dinh, khoang 10 nam, Ong Nam, dua con, nguoi dien, lan luot, khon kho, 8 nguoi, benh, ba, nha
Khoang 10 nam tro lai day, gia dinh ong Nguyen Quang Nam o xom 5 Thanh An, Thanh Chuong, Nghe An lan luot tung nguoi bi phat benh dien.
Gia dinh ong Nam
Can benh quai ac ay da day gia dinh ong den tan cung noi thong kho va bat hanh.
Can nha la rach nat nam duoi chan nui Cao. Vua buoc den cong chung toi giat minh boi tieng gao ru man dai, tieng khoc thet cua con tre va tieng keu cuu cua phu nu.
“Thang Dong nguoi con thu hai cua cu Nam dang len con. Thang nay da len con thi khong biet troi dat la chi nua, gap nguoi la dap, la chem. No dang danh dap vo do. Vo no dung la kho het cho noi”.
Nguoi ban noi voi chung toi va chay vao loi nguoi dan ong toc tot nhu nguoi rung mat may lem luoc, mat van len nhung tia man dai dang tum toc vo dam da tui bui.
Chi vo duoc dip chay ban song, ban chet ra cong, hai dua con dung nep vao goc nha mat cat khong con hot mau.
Chung toi nhin sang tup leu ben canh thay mot ong lao gay nhom chong gay dung lieu xieu noi bac them, khuon mat xo day nhung nep nhan, nuoc mat nhoe nhoet.
Do la ong Nam. Ke ben ong la mot nguoi dan ba con tre dang ngua mat len troi cuoi ngo nghe, duoi chan chi la dua be khoang 6-7 thang tuoi nam chong cho tren dat.
Nhin vao trong nha thay tuong vach lo loi tu be, do dac trong nha chang co thu gi. Tren manh chieu rach noi xo bep mot nguoi dan ba dau toc ru ruoi nam co quap, mieng lam nham nhung ngon ngu cua nguoi dien.
Tiep xuc voi ong Nam, ong theu thao cau duoc, cau mat, noi chuyen no lai xo sang chuyen kia. Ong Nam- nguoi binh thuong nhat trong nha nay cung da tro nen lan than.
Ong Nguyen Quang Nam sinh nam 1937 trong mot gia dinh nong dan ngheo. Nam 1961 vao bo doi, nam 1966 vi ly do suc khoe ong duoc xuat ngu.
Cung nam do ong ket duyen voi ba Tran Thi Thanh nguoi o lang ben. Hai vo chong duoc bo me dung cho tup leu tranh duoi chan nui Cao. Va 5 dua con cua ho lan luot ra doi.
Sau khi sinh dua con ut Nguyen Quang Tao nam 1977, ba Thanh dot nhien do benh nam liet giuong va khi khoi benh thi ba bi dien. Nam 1997, Nguyen Quang Dong (1969) nguoi con thu hai lay vo, sinh con dot nhien qua mot tran sot cung bi chung dien luc dau nhe, nhung ngay mot nang them va roi lan luot nguoi con gai thu 3 Nguyen Thi Hong (1972); nguoi con thu tu Nguyen Thi Mao (1975); con trai ut Nguyen Quang Tao (1977) cung bi nhu anh trai cua minh. Nguyen Thi Phuong (1969), nguoi con gai dau cua ong Nam khong bi dien da di lay chong nhung chi cung bi do tinh.
Trong gia dinh ay chi co ong Nam va nguoi con dau Dau Thi Ty la binh thuong. Ong Nam cung da tung dua nhung dua con di benh vien huyen de kham.
Cac bac si chan doan cac con ong bi tam than. Nhung, do nha qua ngheo, ong khong the dua cac con di tuyen tren de chua tri. Moi ganh nang gia dinh deu trut len doi vai gay cua nguoi me do tinh va nguoi con dau.
Dai gia dinh ay hau nhu thieu an ca nam, khoai san cung khong du tat ca deu trong cay vao su cuu mang cua ba con xom lang. Nhung khi khong con gi ho vat la, hay cho bat cu cai gi vao mieng de an.
Tat benh , doi kho den cung cuc nhung mot ke nao do da lam cho Nguyen Thi Hong co bau, sinh ra mot dua con gai nay da 7 thang tuoi. Nhieu khi Hong be con bo vao rung.
Ba Nguyen Thi Kham, hang xom nha ong Nam roi nuoc mat noi: “Gia dinh do dung la tan kho, toi nghi ca tinh Nghe An nay khong co gia dinh nao kho hon the. Chi co nhung ban tay, nhung tam long nhan ai cua cong dong chia ra dung luc may ra moi cuu duoc gia dinh bat hanh ay” .

Ⅰ. yue du li jie fang fa
yue du li jie shi zong he du zhe ge fang mian zhi shi de guo cheng 。 yao xiang kuai jie ， zhun que de li jie suo yue du de yu pian ， wo men yao qing ju bei shen me yang de neng li ， li jie de guo cheng ， yue du de ceng ci ， yue du de mu de ， yue du ji neng deng 。
xue hui yue du yi wei zhe wo men ju bei yi xia de neng li :
li jie zuo zhe de si xiang he guan dian 。
kan chu wen zhang de xu shi huo tui lun guo cheng 。
kan chu bing si kao suo du wen zhang de xi jie ， huo de xiang xi de xin xi 。
ba yi huo de de xin xi bao zai da nao zhong yi bian sui shi shi yong 。
kan chu zuo zhe de zhu yao yi tu he wen zhang de ji tiao 。
cong you guan zi liao zhong ji qu you yong de dong xi 。
dui fei chong yao qing jie huo xin xi yi dai er guo 。
gen ju yue du mu de he cai liao de nan yi cheng du tiao zheng yue du su du he fang fa 。
gen ju zuo zhe de miao shu de chu zi ji de jie lun 。
zhang wo ci de duo zhong han yi de zhi shi 。
ling wai ， wo men ye xiang zai ci qiang tiao zhi chu ： wo men bu neng mang mu de ying yong kuai du “ ji qiao ”， er ying gai gen ju bu tong qing kuang tiao zheng yue du su du 。 ru ： dui chang jing ， ren wu xing ge ， ren wu xin li ke hua yao xi du 。 qi zhong zui chong yao de yi dian jiu shi yao zhi dao zai shen me shi hou kuai du ， shen me shi hou man du 。 yao ti gao yue du su du ， zheng que de yue du fang fa shi wen ti de guan jian 。
1. ni shi fou shan yu yue du wei le zheng que de ping jia zi ji de yue du neng li ， wo men ke yi dui zhao jian yan yi xia zi ji zai yue du shi shi fou you yi xia ying xiang yue du xiao lv de xing wei ， dan di 2，3 tiao ， de zai ni bu zhu yi shi ， bie ren guan cha ni 。
ni shi fou du de fei chang man ， fei chang zai xi ， bu xiang xin zi ji neng quan bu li jie suo du de dong xi 。
yue du shi ni de zui chun he she tou shi fou zai dong 。
zai yue du shi ni de tou shi fou sui zhe suo du wen zi de fu hao de wei zhi er zuo you yi dong 。
ni shi fou jing chang hui du ， ji ， du guo de dong xi you chong xin du yi bian ， shen zhi ji bian 。
ni shi fou du shen me yang de ti cai dou shi yi yang de su du 。
ni shi fou you hen duo dan ci bu ren shi ， huo bu zhi dao ta zai ci chu de han yi 。
ru guo dui shang shu de wen ti hui da shi ken ding de ， na ni que shi xu yao ti gao yue du ji neng 。 ru guo zhi you yi liang xiang de hui
da shi ken ding de ， na ni jiu xu yao zhen dui zhe yi liang zhong bu liang xi guan xun zhao you xiao de jie jue fang fa ， yi bang zhu ni ti gao yue du neng li 。
2. kuo da ci hui liang
you xian de ci hui liang bi ran ying xiang ni de yue du neng li ti gao 。 sheng ci de han yi zhi you zai shang xia wen zhong cai neng wan quan zhan xian chu lai ， bing yi yu bei ji zhu 、 li jie 、 zhang wo 。 huan ju hua shuo ， shi shang xia wen gei yi ge ci yi te ding de han yi ， er zhe ge te ding de han yi wang wang shi zi dian wu fa ti gong de 。
bu shao jiao shi gu li xue sheng bei ju zi 、 duan luo 、 zheng pian wen zhang ， dou shi chu yu tong yi mu de ， ji ： yao xue sheng zai shang xia wen zhong li jie bing zhang wo ci hui he duan yu 。
II． yue du de mu de
yue du yi ban ying gai da dao xia lie mu de
le jie zuo zhe yao biao da de zhu yao si xiang ；
le jie wen zhang de zhu yao nei rong he ci yao nei rong ， bing neng ba ta men qu fen kai lai ；
le jie bing ji zhu wen zhang zhong zui chong yao de nei rong ；
le jie wen zhang jie gou yi ji shi jian fa sheng de shi jian 、 kong jian shun xu ；
le jie zuo zhe de guan dian 、 yi tu 、 xie zuo feng ge ji qi pian jian deng ；
yong zi ji de yue li he zhi shi dui wen zhang jin xing fen xi 、 ping jia ， de chu zi ji de ti hui ；
zai du wan yi pian wen zhang zhi hou ， xiang yi xiang shang shu suo lie chu de liu xiang yue du mu de ， kan kan ni neng da dao na ji xiang mu de 。
III． yue du ji neng he fang fa
1． ji neng
yue du bu shi yi ge bei dong de guo cheng ， er shi yi ge ji ji zhu dong de guo cheng ， ta xu yao da liang de nao li huo dong ， zhe jiu shi shuo ， yi pian wen zhang de yi yi bu zai yu cai liao de ben shen ， er shi wo men yu cai liao bu duan jiao liu huo dong de jie guo 。 wo men ba xin zhi shi he jiu zhi shi lian xi qi lai ， yi bian wan zheng de li jie wen zhang de yi yi ， zhe zhong yin shen yi yi de nao li huo dong bu jin jin shi dui ci hui yi yi de jie ma ， er shi dui wen zhang de quan mian li jie 。
yue du shi yi ge pan duan 、 tui li 、 gui na 、 zong jie de guo cheng 。 wo men xu yao ba fen san yu wen zhang zhong de ge zhong xin xi lian xi qi lai ， jing guo bi yao de pan duan 、 tui li 、 de chu zi ji dui wen zhang de ren shi 。

Phong trao nhay mua hien dai o TP HCM
Xem bản tiếng việt đầy đủ tại đây : http://thethao60s.com/index/1254818/22032008.aspxPhong trao nhay mua hien dai o TP HCM
Den mot vai nha van hoa tai TP.HCM vao bat ky ngay nao trong tuan deu co the cam nhan duoc su soi dong cua cac lop hoc nhay mua hien dai. Rat de dang de nhan ra noi hoc nhay mua hien dai boi so luong hoc vien dong duc va khong gian am nhac nhon nhip xung quanh. Co nhom cac ban lac nguoi say me theo tung tieng nhac, co nhom lai dang tro chuyen rom ra khi ban ve mot buoc nhay moi duoc day.
Nhay mua hien dai la mot trao luu da hinh thanh va phat trien tai nuoc ta vao nhung nam 1975 cua thap ky truoc. Khi ma ca si nguoi da den Michael Jackson tro thanh mot hien tuong tren khap the gioi va moi nguoi say dam cung cac buoc nhay dieu luyen thi mon nhay mua hien dai tro nen thoi thuong tai nuoc ta thoi bay gio. Vao thoi gian gan day khi phong trao hiphop vao Viet Nam thi nhay mua hien dai phat trien manh me hon voi viec nhieu nhom nhay duoc thanh lap de phuc vu cho nhu cau minh hoa cua ca si, nhieu lop hoc duoc mo ra …Hien nay, phong trao hoc nhay mua hien dai tai TP.HCM van dien ra rat soi dong voi nhieu lop hoc duoc mo ra vao dau thang, nua thang va cuoi thang tai mot so nha van hoa nhu: Nha Van Hoa Thanh Nien, Cung Van Hoa Lao Dong TP.HCM, Nha Van Hoa Phu Nu hay cac Trung tam van hoa quan. Theo chuong trinh giang day duoc gioi thieu tai cac nha van hoa thi nhay mua hien dai khong phan ra rach roi day chuyen sau vao khieu vu, breakdance, rap, techno, valse hay hiphop ma chi day chung chung nhung buoc nhay can ban con muon hoc len chuyen sau thi phai dang ky them. Mot so giao vien dung lop tai cac nha van hoa nay cho biet cac ban tre chi den hoc khoang vai thang de biet mot so dong tac can ban, con hoc chuyen sau thi chi co ban nao dam me that su hoac muon di theo con duong chuyen nghiep moi deo duoi den cung.NS.Huy Cuong, quan ly nhom nhac N9 noi: “Mot so ban trong nhom truoc kia cung co hoc qua mot so lop can ban tai nha van hoa truoc khi hoc chuyen sau ve nhay hien dai tai anh Khoi cua vu doan The Friend. Doi voi nhom nhac muon choi chuyen nghiep ngoai giong ca tot thi nhung buoc nhay cung rat quan trong”. Hay ban Binh- thanh vien cua mot nhom nhay nghiep du chuyen di nhay thue cho cac noi co nhu cau cho biet: “Nhom chung toi den bay gio cung chua co ten chinh thuc. Ai keu di nhay thi den nhay. Chung toi nhay chi vi niem dam me chu khong coi do la cong viec chinh cua minh”.
Phong trao nhay mua hien dai o TP.HCM co luc len luc xuong nhung luc nay tinh hinh da di vao on dinh tot. Sau mot thoi gian viec hoc nhay mua hien dai tro thanh mot trao luu thoi thuong thi gan day cac ban tre van tham gia vi nhieu ly do khac nhau. Thay Vu Bang, dung lop tai nha van hoa Thanh Nien, chu nhiem cau lac bo Khieu vu tai day cho biet: “Nhieu ban tre den voi lop nhay hien dai nhieu hon so voi mon aerobic vi nhay hien dai co phan don gian hon, lai khong phai ton nhieu phi ve dung cu cung nhu trang phuc. Cac ban chi can an mac binh thuong va mang giay the thao la co the tap duoc. Nhay mua hien dai cung co the cho ban mot co the ran chac khong thua kem gi tap cac mon the thao khac. Theo tim hieu cua rieng toi thi den 80% cac ban den tham gia hoc deu co ly do la the thao”. Ban Ngoc Mai, sinh vien truong DH Kinh Te TP.HCM cho biet: “Phai len giang duong ca ngay toi hau nhu khong co thoi gian ren luyen the thao nen khi nghe ban be cho biet Nha Van Hoa Thanh Nien co lop tap nhay hien dai lien dang ky ngay”. Con ban Anh Tuan, sinh vien truong DH KHXH & NV van noi: “Toi hoc nhay mua hien dai khong phai chi vi muon chay theo thoi thuong ma thuc chat day con la cach ren luyen them cho khoe nguoi”. yong ping guo iPhone 4S de ren dou zhi dao ，iPhone 4S cai yong de IPS ping mu ying yong le ying ping ji shu ， dan shi ye you hen duo ren bing bu zhi dao ying ping ji shu shi shen me yi si ？ shen zhi wang shang you yao chuan cheng ，iPhone 4S de ping mu biao mian you yi ceng jian ying de shu zhi du mo ， neng gou fang zhi ping mu hua shang ， bao hu ping mu 。 shi ji shang zhe zhong shuo fa shi bu zheng que de 。 xian zai shi mian shang huan you yi zhong ying ping ， jiu shi mo tuo luo la Droid RAZR cai yong de kang ning bo li （ ye cheng da xing xing bo li ）， zhe shi yi zhong zhen zheng yi yi shang de zhi di jian ying de ping mu ， neng fang zhi ping mu hua shang 。 qu bie yu iPhone 4S de ying ping ji shu ， kang ning bo li shi ying yong zai xian shi ping wai mian de yi ceng bao hu bo li ping 。 xiang mo tuo luo la DEFY deng hen duo san fang shou ji yi ji HTC de zhong duo ji xing zhong dou cai yong le zhe zhong bo li bao hu ping 。 na me zhe liang zhong ping mu dao di you shen me qu bie ne ？ ge zi dou you shen me te dian ne ， jin tian bi zhe jiu wei da jia zuo yi ge xiang xi de jiang jie 。
iPhone 4S de ying ping ji shu shi zen me hui shi ？
ping guo iPhone 4S de ying ping shi ji shang jiu shi IPS cai yong de ying ping ji shu ， shi xiang dui yu VA lei ruan ping er yan de 。 ying ping zhi suo yi ying （ ji chu mo wu shui wen ）， bing bu shi zai ye jing ping wai mian fu jia le shu zhi bao hu mo ， er shi you ye jing ping de fen zi jie gou suo jue ding de 。 ying ping ji shu chuang xin xing de cai yong le shui ping pai lie de ye jing fen zi jie gou ， zai shou dao wai jie ya li shi ， ying ping de fen zi fu yuan su du bi chui zhi pai lie de fen zi kuai 10 bei 。 yin ci ， zai shou dao chu mo shi ke yi ji ben bao chi yuan yang bu bian 。 bu jin ru ci ， zai yao huang dian bo shi ， ying ping ye jing ye bu hui chu xian dou dong 、 can ying de wen ti ， xian shi xiao guo bu bian 。
IPS ying ping ye jing fen zi cai yong shui ping pai lie fang shi
IPS mian ban zui da de te dian jiu shi ta de liang ji dou zai tong yi ge mian shang ， er bu xiang qi ta ye jing mo shi de dian ji shi zai shang xia liang mian ， li ti pai lie 。 gai ji shu ba ye jing fen zi de pai lie fang shi jin xing le you hua ， cai qu shui ping pai lie fang shi ， dang yu dao wai jie ya li shi ， fen zi jie gou xiang xia shao wei xia xian ， dan shi zheng ti fen zi huan cheng shui ping zhuang 。 zai yu dao wai li shi ， ying ping ye jing fen zi jie gou jian gu xing he wen ding xing yuan yuan you yu ruan ping ！ suo yi bu hui chan sheng hua mian shi zhen he ying xiang hua mian se cai ， ke yi zui da cheng du de bao hu hua mian xiao guo bu bei sun hai 。 ci wai huan you yi zhong S-IPS mian ban shu yu IPS de gai liang xing 。
IPS ying ping gong zuo yuan li
IPS ying ping neng gou chu se de biao xian dong tai gao qing hua mian ， te bie shi he yun dong tu xiang chong xian ， wu can ying he tuo yi ， shi guan kan shu zi gao qing ying xiang ， te bie shi kuai su yun dong hua mian ， ru bi sai 、 jing su you xi he dong zuo dian ying de li xiang zai ti 。 you yu IPS ying ping du te de shui ping fen zi jie gou ， shi qi zai chu mo shi wu shui wen 、 an ying he shan guang xian xiang ， fei chang wen ding ， yin er ji wei shi he yu ju you chu mo gong neng de dian shi he gong gong xian shi she bei 。

tong guo yi shang jiang jie ， xiang xin da jia yi jing ming bai ，iPhone 4S de ying ping bing fei ping mu zhi di jian ying ， ye bu ju bei fang gua hua de te xing 。 er shi dui yu dong tai hua mian xian shi yi ji chu kong cao zuo de yi zhong you hua she ji 。 zhe zhong ping mu de te dian shi ： xiang ying su du kuai 、 ke shi jiao du kuan 、 se cai huan yuan zhen shi 、 dong tai tu xiang bian xian chu se 。 shi mu qian chu kong ping mu zhong zui xian jin de ji shu zhi yi 。 xia mian wei da jia jie shao liang kuan cai yong ying ping ji shu de shou ji ， yi gong da jia shen kao 。
