Khong the so sanh virus corona moi ngang voi SARS: Day la nhung diem khac nhau co ban giua hai dich benh
Dot bung phat virus corona moi o Vu Han cho den luc nay chua duoc coi la dai dich giong nhu SARS.
Dich benh viem phoi la do chung virus corona moi bung phat o Trung Quoc da giet chet 56 nguoi va lay nhiem cho hon 2.000 nguoi thuoc 12 quoc gia tren the gioi.
Virus gay ra cac trieu chung nhu sot, ho, kho tho, co kha nang da nhay tu dong vat sang nguoi tai mot khu cho hai san am uot co ten la Huan Nam, thuoc thanh pho Vu Han. Cho hai san Huan Nam duoc mo ta la mot khu vuc "ban thiu va lon xon" voi hon 1.000 gian hang. Ngoai hai san, cho con ban ca ga, soc, tho, doi va cac dong vat hoang da khac.
No co dieu kien ve sinh cuc ky kem, nhoi nhet hang ngan con nguoi voi dong vat song va dong vat da giet mo. Va tat ca tro thanh mot co hoi vang giup nhung con virus tren dong vat, duoc goi la zoonoses, nhay sang, tien hoa va lay nhiem tren nguoi.
Dot bung phat nay da gay ra cam giac deja vu cho mot so nguoi, khien ho nho den dot bung phat hoi chung ho hap cap tinh nang (SARS) bat dau vao thang 11 nam 2002. Do cung la mot loai virus thuoc nhom corona, va SARS cung da nhay sang nguoi tu dong vat duoc bay ban o cac khu cho am uot.
Bung phat o tinh Quang Dong, Trung Quoc, SARS da nhanh chong lay nhiem 8.098 trong vong 8 thang, va giet chet 774 nguoi trong so do. Benh nhan nhiem virus SARS cung co cac trieu chung bao gom sot, dau dau va sau do la mot benh viem phoi gay suy ho hap co the giet chet ho.
Cac chuyen gia goi SARS la "dai dich dau tien cua the ky 21" boi no da lan rong ra toi 29 quoc gia. Truoc thang 7 nam 2003, chua tung co mot dich benh nao tuong tu no xay ra tren nguoi, SARS gay ra noi kinh hoang boi nhung cai chet do viem phoi lay lan thuc su la lam.
Tuy nhien, so voi nhung gi chung ta da biet ve SARS va chung kien su nguy hiem cua no, viec noi chung virus corona moi o Vu Han se tao ra mot dai dich SARS tiep theo co the chi la kich ban bi thoi phong. Mac du hai chung virus cung co chung mot nguon goc, nhung muc do nguy hiem cua chung thuc su khac nhau.
Chung virus corona moi lan nay chua nguy hiem bang SARS, Scott Gottlieb, mot cuu uy vien tai Cuc Quan ly Thuc pham va Duoc pham Hoa Ky cho biet. Tuy nhien, no co ve de lay lan hon, do do, dich benh corona moi dang lan nhanh hon.
Eric Toner, mot nha khoa hoc cao cap tai Dai hoc John Hopkins da dua ra mot danh gia tuong tu: "Mot an tuong ban dau ban dau la no nhe hon dang ke so voi SARS", ong noi. "Dieu do khien chung ta co the an tam. The nhung mat khac, no co the de lay truyen hon SARS, it nhat la trong cong dong".
Vay, chung virus corona moi o Vu Han con dieu gi giong va khong giong so voi virus SARS cach day 17 nam, hay cung tim hieu:
Ca benh dau tien nhiem virus corona o Vu Han duoc xac nhan vao ngay 31 thang 12 nam 2019. Vu Han la mot thanh pho o tinh Ho Bac, Trung Quoc voi quy mo dan so len toi 11 trieu nguoi.
Trong khi do, virus SARS bung phat dau tien o Quang Dong, mot tinh phia dong nam Trung Quoc, gan voi Hong Kong.
Theo To chuc Y te The gioi (WHO), 50% nhung nguoi nhiem virus SARS la nhung nguoi tren 65 tuoi. Nua con lai thuoc cac do tuoi da dang khac nhau.
Cho den nay, cac chuyen gia y te o Trung Quoc cung bao cao do tuoi trung binh cua nhung nguoi tu vong vi virus corona moi o Vu Han la 75 tuoi. Nhieu nguoi trong so do da mac san cac benh man tinh nhu cao huyet ap, tieu duong, Parkinson khien he mien dich cua ho bi suy giam.
Adrian Hyzler, giam doc y te tai Healix International cho biet tre em, nguoi gia, phu nu mang thai va nhung nguoi bi suy giam mien dich la nhung doi tuong de bi bien chung nang va tu vong nhat khi nhiem phai virus corona moi.
Theo bao cao cua WHO, SARS da khong lay lan nhanh bang virus corona moi o Vu Han trong 3 tuan dau tien.
Phai mat toi 4 thang de SARS lan rong va lay nhiem toi 1.000 nguoi. Trong khi do, virus corona moi o Vu Han chi mat 25 ngay de lay cho gan 1.400 nguoi.
"Mot nguoi nhiem benh co the lay nhiem lap tuc cho 10, 20, 30 nguoi", Hyzler noi ve chung virus corona moi. "Vi vay, do la ly do tai sao no de lay lan hon va tro thanh mot van de lon hon".
Tuy nhien, SARS nguy hiem hon nhieu so voi chung corona moi bay gio. Ty le tu vong ma SARS gay ra la 9,6%. Ty le tu vong do virus Vu Han bay gio chi khoang 3%.
Mot ly do khien virus SARS lay lan rong ra nhieu quoc gia tren the gioi, do la ban dau, chinh quyen Trung Quoc da co gang che giau thong tin dich benh va khong bao cao voi To chuc Y te The gioi.
Chinh phu Trung Quoc da khong thong bao cho WHO biet ve tinh hinh dich SARS, cho den ngay 14/2/2003. Theo to nhat bao Sydney Herald, cac bac si o Bac Kinh da nhan duoc yeu cau giau benh nhan SARS khoi cac cuoc kiem tra cua WHO.
Trong giai doan dau khi dich benh moi bung phat, chinh phu Trung Quoc cung da che giau tinh hinh dich benh voi chinh nguoi dan cua minh, khien cac no luc kiem soat dich trien khai muon va gia tang co hoi cho dich benh lay lan.
Liu Heng, mot co van cho chinh phu Trung Quoc noi voi to Reuters rang, lan nay, chinh phu da phat di tuyen bo ngay khi dich benh bung phat.
"Chung toi da lam tron trach nhiem hon nhieu… Chung toi da tap trung hon nhieu trong viec ngan chan dich benh", ong ay noi.
Cac nha khoa hoc Trung Quoc cung da bat tay nhanh chong vao viec nghien cuu chung virus moi, va chia se nhung thong tin ho biet duoc voi cac nha nghien cuu tren toan the gioi.
Jeremy Farrar, mot nha khoa hoc nguoi Anh tung nghien cuu ve virus SARS cho biet: Toc do ma virus moi o Vu Han duoc xac dinh la chung corona la mot minh chung cho thay Trung Quoc da rut duoc kinh nghiem tu dot bung phat dich SARS va lan nay ho da phoi hop chat che hon voi WHO.
Chung virus corona moi o Vu Han duoc giai trinh tu bo gen chi trong vong chua day nua thang. Trong khi do, nam 2003, cac nha khoa hoc phai mat toi 4 thang de lam duoc viec do.
Bang cach chia se thong tin ve bo gen virus, cac nha khoa hoc o khap moi noi tren the gioi deu co the lam viec cung nhau de phan tich su lay lan cua dich benh, cung nhu theo doi su bien doi cua chung virus neu no xay ra.
Phan tich ma di truyen cung cho phep cac nha khoa hoc xac dinh chung virus da lay tu loai dong vat nao sang nguoi.
Trong truong hop cua SARS, virus nay co le da lay tu doi sang nguoi. Nhung con doi de lai nuoc bot va phan cua chung, lay nhiem virus cho cac vat chu trung gian khac, vat chu trung gian nay se truyen benh cho con nguoi.
"Doi va chim duoc coi la nhung loai dong vat chua virus co kha nang tao ra nhung dot bung phat dai dich", Bart Haagmans, nha virus hoc tai Trung tam Y te Erasmus o Rotterdam, Ha Lan cho biet.
SARS da nhay tu vat chu dau tien la doi, sang mot loai dong vat co vu giong chon duoc goi la nhung con cay co deo mat na, sau do lay sang con nguoi.
Theo mot nhom cac nha khoa hoc dang la bien tap vien tai Tap chi Virus Y te, thu pham lan truyen chung virus corona moi o Vu Han co the la ran ho mang Trung Quoc. Tuy nhien, thong tin nay van chua duoc xac nhan.
Mot phan tich di truyen cua chung virus o Vu Han cho thay no gan giong voi virus lay nhiem ran.
Duoi day la 5 chung virus co kha nang xuat phat tu doi va cac so lieu lan luot la: nam duoc phat hien, so truong hop lay nhiem tren nguoi duoc bao cao, so ca benh tu vong, ty le tu vong va so nuoc bao cao benh nhan duong tinh.
Truoc day, cac nha nghien cuu da truy tim nguon goc cua SARS de xac dinh virus ban dau thuoc ve quan the doi mong ngua song o tinh Van Nam, Trung Quoc. Nhung con doi nay song trong mot hang dong, cach mot ngoi lang gan do 1,1 km.
Mot dong thai duoc cho la khac biet lon giua dot bung phat dich SARS va dich benh do chung corona hien tai gay ra, do la lan nay Trung Quoc da nhanh chong phong toa cac thanh pho.
Thanh pho Vu Han, noi dich benh bung phat da duoc phong toa tu 10 gio sang thu Nam (23/1) theo gio dia phuong. Chinh quyen thanh pho da ra lenh tam dung tat ca cac phuong tien giao thong cong cong bao gom xe bus, tau va pha. Khong mot phuong tien nao duoc phep doi khoi thanh pho va san bay cung bi phong toa.
Ngay truoc nua dem ngay thu Nam, thanh pho Hoang Cuong cung da bi phong toa. Den ngay hom sau, them 10 thanh pho khac duoc lenh tam dong cua.
Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus, Tong giam doc To chuc Y te the gioi cho biet, nhung no luc phong toa thanh pho se giup Trung Quoc kiem soat su lay lan cua virus va giam thieu kha nang dich benh lan rong ra ben ngoai bien gioi nuoc nay.
"Nhung gi ho dang lam la mot bien phap rat, rat manh me, voi cam ket day du", Ghebreyesus noi trong cuoc hop bao cua WHO. Lenh phong toa thanh pho hien dang anh huong toi hang chuc trieu nguoi dan Trung Quoc ngay trong dip Tet Nguyen Dan.
Tro lai dich SARS nam 2003, phai mat toi 4 thang de Trung Quoc thiet lap duoc bien phap kiem dich dau tien.
Anthony Fauci, mot chuyen gia tai Vien Y te Quoc gia Hoa Ky cho biet Trung Quoc lan nay da lam tot hon rat nhieu, so voi dich SARS 17 nam truoc.
Nhung ca SARS va chung virus corona moi o Vu Han deu khong co vac-xin.
"Neu Vu Han that thu, kich ban tot nhat la vac-xin se duoc dieu che trong vong 3 quy, tham chi con lau hon", Vincent Munster, mot nha virus hoc tai Phong thi nghiem Rocky Mountain cho biet.
Mot so cong ty bao gom Moderna, Novavax va Innovio da cho biet ho dang co ke hoach phat trien vac-xn so bo. Nhung cong viec nay khong the thuc hien mot som mot chieu. Nhieu loai vac-xin, chang han nhu Ebola da phai mat 20 nam nghien cuu moi cho ket qua. Khong cong ty nao co the dam chac moc thoi gian phat hanh vac-xin cho chung corona moi vao luc nay.
Cuoi cung, dot bung phat virus corona moi o Vu Han cho den luc nay chua duoc coi la dai dich giong nhu SARS.
To chuc Y te The gioi ngay hom kia cho biet ho khong cong nhan dot bung phat corona moi la mot Tinh trang khan cap quoc te ve y te cong dong (PHEIC).
PHEIC chinh la mot sang kien duoc WHO dua ra sau dich SARS, de doi pho voi cac dai dich tuong tu mang tinh toan cau.

Tags: ty le tu vong, nguoi lon tuoi, ngay cang tang, con dong kinh, dan so, bi dong, anh huong, trung, benh,
Dong kinh anh huong khoang 1% dan so nhung nguoi lon tuoi. So nguoi mac phai se ngay cang tang khi tuoi tho con nguoi tang cao va dan so ngay mot gia di. Ty le tu vong o nguoi trung tuoi bi dong kinh cung cao.
>> Nguoi lon tuoi mac benh dong kinh ngay cang nhieu
>> Benh dong kinh o nguoi lon tuoi
Nhieu nguoi lon tuoi bi dong kinh cung co nhung benh ly khac di kem nhu benh thoai hoa ve than kinh, benh mach mau nao hay ung thu.
Mot so nguyen nhan khien nguoi trung tuoi bi dong kinh thuong do:
Benh mach mau nao chiem khoang 44% cac truong hop va la nguyen nhan hang dau gay dong kinh o nguoi lon tuoi.
Nhung nguyen nhan tiep theo la sa sut tri tue, u nao, chan thuong dau va ruou hay thuoc la.
Cac con dong kinh gay ra chan thuong co the, lam mat su tu tin va lam giam su doc lap cua benh nhan, do vay nguoi lon tuoi thuong phai duoc nhap vien hay san soc o nhung trung tam dac biet.
Da so con dong kinh moi xay ra o nguoi lon tuoi la con dong kinh cuc bo, co the co hay khong co toan the hoa thu phat.
Thuoc chong dong kinh van la phuong thuc dieu tri chinh. Tuy nhien, dung thuoc chong dong kinh ly tuong o nguoi lon tuoi la thuoc duoc hap thu day du va su dao thai khong bi anh huong boi suy than.

Tian Wang Bu Xin Wan (Tian Wang Bu Xin Dan, Emperor’s Teapills) translates as “emperor of heaven’s special pill to tonify the heart” is a classic formula that is used to used to nourish the blood, calm the mind, clear heat and resolve disharmony between the heart and kidney. Symptoms may include anxiety, restlessness, palpitations, dryness, and insomnia. This formula is used to treat insomnia, palpitations, mental lassitude, amnesia, dry throat and mouth, excessive dreaming, nocturnal seminal emission, constipation, and oral ulceration.*
With proper use, expect results within 3 to 5 weeks of daily use.
Caution: Do not use if you have a fever or are diabetic.

Cuoc chien cua Tong thong Brazil voi The New York Times - Tim hieu
Tags: The New York Times, Larry Rohter, Luiz Lula, su chu y, dac phai vien, khong bao gio, tong thong, chinh quyen, bai viet, da Silva, quyet dinh, cuoc chien, Brazil, nguoi, bao,
Nguoi lao dong Brazil xuong duong chao don thang loi cua ong Lula da Silva nam 2002
Ngay 9/5, duoi tieu de Thoi quen che chen cua Tong thong Brazil tro thanh moi quan ngai quoc gia, bai viet cua dac phai vien Larry Rohter cua to The New York Times da gay duoc su chu y rat lon doi voi doc gia toan cau. Dap lai bai viet tren, chinh quyen cua Tong thong Luiz Lula da Silva da ra lenh truc xuat Larry Rohter "phai roi Brazil trong vong 8 ngay". Quyet dinh nay lam day len mot cuoc chien thuc su - giua bao gioi va chinh quyen Brazil.
Bai viet tren The New York Times
Trong bai viet, Larry Rohter mo dau bang nhan dinh: "Ong Lula da Silva khong bao gio muon che giau thu vui nang ly - cho du la bia, ruou cachaa (mot loai ruou nhe Brazil co duong). Ong tong thong thi vui nhu the, song nhieu nguoi Brazil dang bat dau quan ngai - thu me che chen cua ong se anh huong den viec dieu hanh dat nuoc".
Va Larry cao buoc: "Thoi gian gan day, chinh quyen cua ong da Silva lien tuc vap phai khung hoang - tu nhung xi-cang-dan tham nhung den that bai trong cac chuong trinh xa hoi. Ban than tong thong thuong xuyen tranh ne cong luan, de trong trach lai cho ban co van cua minh ganh vac. Dieu do khien nhieu nguoi du doan: su tranh ne va tinh thu dong cua ong la do tac dong cua ruou. Mac du co rat nhieu chinh tri gia, ky gia ban tan, ngay mot nhieu, ve thu vui danh chen cua tong thong, nhung it ai dam noi len su that. Ong Leonel Brizola, lanh dao dang Lao dong dan chu canh ta la truong hop ngoai le. Ong nay tung la ban dong hanh cua tong thong trong chien dich tranh cu 1998 nhung bay gio lo ngai - tong thong dang huy hoai nhung neuron than kinh trong bo nao ong ay".
"Khi toi ung cu chuc pho tong thong cua Lula, ong ay da uong rat nhieu", Larry dan lai loi Brizola phat bieu. "Toi da khuyen cao ong ay nhung ong ay tra loi - Khong, chang co gi nguy hai ca, toi luon kiem soat duoc ma".
Ong Lula da Silva, 58 tuoi, la vi Tong thong Brazil dau tien xuat than tu giai cap cong nhan. Ong la mau dan ong rat boc dong. Mac du co gang "tu giu minh" la tranh hut thuoc la truoc cong chung, khong tan tinh cac nu dien vien xinh dep giua dam dong hoac tranh xa cac mon an nhieu chat beo - dang lam ong ngay cang tro nen tron tria ke tu khi nham chuc thang 1.2003, nhung bat ke luc nao co the, bao chi Brazil van dua tong thong len bao voi guong mat do gay, doi mat lo do, va mot ly ruou khong the thieu duoc tren tay. Do la hinh anh thuong thay trong cac bua tiec thit nuong, uong ruou tha gian ong to chuc o dinh tong thong.
Dau nam nay, khi chinh phu duyet chi 56 trieu USD mua chuyen co moi cho tong thong, lap tuc cay but binh luan Claudio Humberto vi von: "Chuyen co thiet ke cho Tong thong Hoa Ky la Air Force One, chuyen co cua ong Silva at han phai la Pirassununga 51". Cai ten kho nho, nhung o Brazil, nguoi ta phat am rat tron tru vi do la ten cua mot loai ruou noi tieng.
Mot "loi de nghi khiem nha khac" nham vao thoi quen danh chen cua ong Silva la goi chuong trinh khuyen khich cac bac tai su dung ethanol thay nhien lieu bang mot cai ten "Power of Alcohol" - Suc manh cua ruou.
Ong Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva (anh) sinh nam 1945 trong mot gia dinh ngheo o Dong bac Brazil. Gia dinh ong di cu den Rio de Janeiro khi ong moi len 7 tuoi, tai day, ong phai lam nghe danh giay kiem song va phai ket thuc con duong hoc van khi moi hoc lop 6 (co tin dua la ong chi hoc den lop 5).
Nam 14 tuoi, ong lam nghe tien va sau do co nhieu nam dan dat cac lien doan lao dong trong nhung thap nien 60 va 70 - thoi gian ong da tao dung duoc ten tuoi bang nhung ky nang chinh tri, tro thanh nha lanh dao soi noi nhat cua lien doan lao dong o cac khu cong nghiep ngoai o Sao Paulo va la nguoi kien tao nen hau het cac cuoc bieu tinh cua cong nhan nganh thep chong lai che do doc tai. Sau do, ong tien them mot buoc la thanh lap dang Cong nhan canh ta. Sau 3 lan tranh cu that bai, trong do co lan nam 1998 ma theo loi ong Brizona - da phai lien tuc muon ruou giai sau, ong tro thanh tong thong canh ta dau tien cua Brazil trong 4 thap nien, danh bai cac doi thu doi lap trong cuoc tong tuyen cu nam 2002 voi so phieu cach biet. Niem vui mung ong chien thang bung no tren khap dat nuoc Brazil. Nhung nguoi ung ho hy vong nguoi dan ong rat gan gui voi ho, thuong duoc goi la Lula, se dem lai cho nguoi dan Brazil cuoc song tot dep hon.
Trong nhung ngay dau nham chuc, ong Lula the se cham dut nan doi trong nhiem ky cua minh va se tan cong quyet liet vao nan tham nhung, nhung sai pham ve kinh te, phat trien giao duc va tao them viec lam cho nguoi lao dong. Tuy nhien, ong cung som canh bao la kho co the thuc hien het nhung gi da hua trong nhiem ky 4 nam dau tien.
Ban tin dot xuat hang cua AP va duoc to The New York Times dang tai vao sang thu hai vua qua cho biet: van phong cua tong thong "phan bac mot cach gian du" bai viet cong kich thoi nghien ruou cua ong Lula da Silva.
"Day la dieu bi oi. Tong thong Lula la mot con nguoi rat tot", Pho tong thong Jose Alencar phat bieu. "Tat ca nguoi dan Brazil deu phan no truoc bai viet nay”. Phat ngon vien Phu tong thong cho biet: "Chung toi khong xem day la mot bai bao co gia tri ma day la mot cach vu khong, lam ton hai den tong thong".
Sau do, chinh quyen ong Lula da Silva tuyen bo tam huy visa cua phai vien Larry Rohter vi da viet bai cong kich thoi uong ruou cua tong thong. Luc nay Rohter khong co mat o Brazil, song lenh van dinh "phai roi khoi Brazil trong vong 8 ngay". Quyet dinh truc xuat Rohter da gay nen su chu y rat lon cua du luan quoc te ma da phan la chong doi. Phat ngon vien cua chinh quyen - ong Luis Gushiken - nguoi rat quen thuoc voi cac phai vien nuoc ngoai, cho biet chinh quyen phai co nhiem vu tu bao ve minh truoc nhung su cong kich nhu vay va khong the chap nhan "nhung hanh vi boi nho va xuyen tac su that". Nhan dinh ve van de tren, Ngoai truong Brazil - Celso Amorim cung cho biet: "Chung toi khong bao gio chong lai ai phe phan ve chinh sach doi ngoai, doi noi cua Brazil. Nhung bai viet nay la mot cai gi khac, danh vao danh du quoc gia thong qua nguoi dung dau chinh quyen bang nhung cau chuyen hoan toan bia dat va phi bang".
Trong khi do, to The New York Times cho biet ho se co nhung bien phap thich dang de bao ve phai vien cua minh, trong do co viec chong lai quyet dinh tuoc visa cua Rohter mot cach thieu co so. Nhung cau hoi ve van de "tu do bao chi" o Brazil cung duoc to bao dat ra. Washington cung cho rang quyet dinh truc xuat tren da di trai voi truyen thong tu do bao chi cua Brazil. Tu Zurich, Thuy Si, Bo truong Tu phap Brazil - Marcio Thomaz Bastos, cho biet: "Toi hoan toan khong biet quyet dinh tren la cua tong thong hay cac bo truong vi toi khong duoc thao luan truoc khi dua ra quyet dinh".
Ai thua ?
Sang hom qua, 15.5, hang AP cho biet chinh quyen Brazil da quyet dinh khong tuoc visa cua phai vien The New York Times sau khi de bung no qua nhieu tranh cai trong suot mot tuan qua. Quyet dinh tren duoc dua ra sau khi luat su cua Larry Rohter viet mot la thu gui chinh quyen Brazil, noi rang bai bao viet hoan toan khong co y xuc pham tong thong. Chinh quyen cua ong Lula da Silva cho biet ho xem la thu tren nhu mot loi xin loi va la mot hanh dong rut lai cau chuyen "lo" loan tai hom chu nhat, "ket toi" thoi nghien ruou cua tong thong la moi quan ngai quoc gia.
La thu cua luat su Rohter dai 4 trang, khong he an chua mot loi xin loi nao nhung noi rang phai vien "khong bao gio co y dinh xuc pham danh du tong thong" va them rang "Rohter co mot su kinh trong vo van doi voi the che Brazil" va "rat lay lam tiec vi da xay ra cuoc chien vi bai viet cua minh".
Trong phat bieu cua minh, The New York Times lap lai khong he co chuyen sai trat trong bai viet cua Rohter nhung "rat hai long" truoc quyet dinh khong tuoc visa cua chinh quyen Brazil.

Chan dung va muu do cua giam doc giet nguoiTags: Da Nang, Nguyen Hong Phu, Tran Nam Hoang, Binh Hung Hoa B, TP HCM, Hoa Hiep Bac, hanh vi pham toi, the len may bay, giay to tuy than, Quan Lien Chieu, Cuop tai san, Cong An Phuong, Binh Hung Hoa, hung thu, xac dinh, den Bấm ngay Subscribe / Đăng Ký xem video hay mới nhất >> Nhung ngay trong trai giam, Phu van to ra rat binh tinh. Han binh than cho rang hanh vi pham toi cua han se phai tra gia bang an tu va ngong nghenh nghi toi ngay thu an xong se “lam lai cuoc doi va song theo y thich”. Lam an thua lo, lam vao canh no nan, Nguyen Hong Phu (SN 1988), giam doc Cong ty TNHH MTV Phu Quy Lam (co tru o tai to 9, phuong Hoa Hiep Bac, quan Lien Chieu, Da Nang) da muu tinh ti mi viec dan du mot “doi tac” tu TP HCM ra Da Nang de giet va cuop tai san. Nguyen Hong Phu khong ngo tu mau the len may bay roi rot lai hien truong, Co quan Cong an da nhanh chong xac dinh nhan than bi hai va sau 14 gio truy xet da buoc ke thu ac phai cui dau nhan toi... Khoang 6h15 sang 5.3, mot thanh nien dung xe may truoc nha Truong Cong an xa Hoa Phu roi voi va goi: “Anh Minh oi, co nguoi bi giet”. Anh Le Van Minh buoc ra thi thay nguoi den bao tin la anh Ngo Ngoc Tuan, mot nguoi quen o thon Hoa Phat. Khong doi anh Le Van Minh hoi, anh Tuan da ke mot mach: “Toi cung Cao Kim Luc chay xe may vao dap Ho Cau de don keo la tram. Khi den doan duong be tong gan nga re vao trai chan nuoi heo Trung Son thi thay co mot nguoi nam chet ben duong, tren nguoi day mau...”. Nghe vay anh Le Van Minh voi lay xe phong theo Tuan den hien truong, dong thoi dien bao ve Cong an huyen Hoa Vang... Chan dung hung thu Nguyen Hong Phuc Xac chet noi hoang vang Xac dinh day la vu an nghiem trong, Cong an Da Nang nhanh chong trien khai cac bien phap pha an. Hung thu ra tay tan doc, de lai 32 vet dam tren thi the nan nhan. Tai hien truong, luc luong Cong an phat hien 2 con dao Thai Lan can go vay mau, mot doi dep le la co lon con moi, mot DTDD da hong do tham uot cung mot so tien loai 5.000d va 50.000d. Dac biet, trong tui ao nan nhan co mau the len may bay ghi ten Tran Nam Hoang, dap chuyen bay cua Vietnam Airlines 19h30 ngay 4.3 tu TP HCM di Da Nang. Ngoai ra, tren nguoi nan nhan khong con giay to, tu trang gi khac. Hang tram nguoi dan nghe tin ve vu viec da keo den xem deu nhan dinh nan nhan khong phai la nguoi dia phuong. Nguoi bi giet chac chan den tu noi khac va nhieu kha nang chinh la anh Hoang. Luc luong dieu tra da to chuc nhieu mui de xac minh nhan than bi hai. Day la yeu to quan trong de xac dinh moi lien he giua bi hai voi hung thu cung nhu phan tich nguyen nhan, dong co gay an... 8h ngay 5.3, Cang Hang khong Da Nang xac nhan: Theo thong tin tren CMND khi lam thu tuc dang ky, hanh khach Tran Nam Hoang, sinh nam 1977, tru khu pho 3, phuong Binh Hung Hoa B, quan Binh Tan, TP HCM. Duoc su ho tro nhiet tinh cua Cong an phuong Binh Hung Hoa B, hon 30 phut sau, Phong PC45 Cong an Da Nang da lien he truc tiep qua dien thoai voi chi Nguyen Thi Hoa - vo cua Hoang. De tranh gay soc cho chi Hoa, mot DTV day dan kinh nghiem cua Phong PC45 chi thong tin can xac minh nhan than mot thanh nien vua bi TNGT o Da Nang, nghi la anh Hoang. Theo mo ta cua chi Hoa, voc dang, ao quan tren nguoi cua anh Hoang trung khop voi nguoi bi giet. Tiep tuc do hoi, cac DTV duoc chi Hoa thong tin anh Tran Nam Hoang la Giam doc Cong ty TNHH MTV Hoang Thinh Phat, kinh doanh buon ban may moc, thiet bi san xuat do go. Truoc khi di Da Nang, anh Hoang co bao voi vo la ra de mua 18 may san xuat van ghep thanh duoc rao ban tren mang voi gia 600 trieu dong. Nam “tay hom chia khoa”, truoc khi anh Hoang di, chi Hoa chi dua cho chong 3,5 trieu dong va can dan den Da Nang xem hang xong, neu quyet dinh mua thi dien thoai ve de chi chuyen tien ra... Bang linh cam cua nguoi vo, duong nhu chi Hoa da thay dieu gi do bat thuong xay ra voi chong minh. Nhung voi su tran an, dong vien cua cac dong chi Cong an phuong Binh Hung Hoa B, chi tiep tuc cung cap cho Phong PC45 Cong an Da Nang nhieu thong tin ve cac quan he cua anh Hoang tai Da Nang. Chi Hoa nho may ngay truoc, “doi tac” o Da Nang co gui vao hop Email cua Cong ty Hoang Thinh Phat thu chao hang. Noi dung thu lien duoc chi Hoa chuyen tiep vao Email cua mot DTV. Trong thu co dinh kem hinh anh nha xuong, may moc thiet bi san xuat go va ten tuoi, so CMND cua 2 chu xuong o Da Nang co may moc can thanh ly la Pham Quang Trung (ho khau thuong tru tinh Gia Lai) va Tran Van Lam (thuong tru xa Dai Hong, huyen Dai Loc, Quang Nam). Qua xac minh nhanh, Cong an Quang Nam va Cong an Gia Lai deu tra loi o dia phuong khong he co ai co ten cung so CMND nhu the. Tuy nhien, qua dieu tra, Co quan Cong an xac dinh Email duoc gui di tu mot diem Internet o quan Lien Chieu. Nhu vay, nhan dinh hung thu la nguoi dia phuong cang co them co so. Cac to dieu tra kien tri tien hanh khoanh vung, sang loc cac doi tuong hinh su trong khu vuc... Thuong ta Tran Muu - Truong phong PC45, mot can bo day dan kinh nghiem va luon co niem tin rang toi ac se bi trung phat. Anh nhan dinh hung thu rat ma manh. Han khong de lai dau van tay tren 2 con dao, va chac chan co tinh lay di cac giay to tuy than de co quan dieu tra khong xac dinh duoc tung tich nan nhan, khien viec dieu tra di vao kho khan, be tac. O mot noi nao do, co le han dang nhon nho voi y nghi mot xac chet giua vung rung nui khong xac dinh duoc tung tich thi Cong an cung de danh bo tay. Co the dieu do dung mot phan. Nhung thien bat dung gian. Hung thu khong ngo tu mau the len may bay con sot lai, luc luong Cong an nhanh chong lien lac duoc voi gia dinh nan nhan. Dong thoi, den 11h ngay 5-3, Co quan dieu tra da xac dinh duoc 2 so dien thoai di dong o Da Nang gan day da lien lac voi so may cua Tran Nam Hoang. Trong do, so goi vao may anh Hoang ngay sau thoi diem anh xuong san bay la sim rac, so dien thoai con lai 090544... co chu thue bao la Nguyen Hong Phu. Trung hop thay, ten chu thue bao cung trung voi dia chi mail da ket noi voi hop Email cua Cong ty Hoang Thinh Phat. Noi o cua doi tuong nghi van lap tuc duoc cac trinh sat giam sat. Theo thong tin dieu tra, Nguyen Hong Phu la Giam doc Cong ty TNHH MTV Phu Quy Lam, kinh doanh che bien go. Den 12h15, luc luong Cong an vao nha Nguyen Hong Phu tai to 9 phuong Hoa Hiep Bac, quan Lien Chieu. Luc nay, Phu dang ung dung nam ngu trua. Thuong ta Tran Muu cho biet, khi duoc moi ve tru so Cong an phuong - noi doi tuong cu tru lam viec, Phu lon tieng hoi: “Toi lam gi ma moi toi”. Phat hien tren ban tay phai cua Phu co 2 vet dut sac canh vua duoc khau lai, can bo dieu tra nhan dinh nhung vet thuong nay co lien quan den viec su dung dao gay an quyet dinh “phu dau” de tran ap. Tuy nhien, Nguyen Hong Phu diem nhien giai thich luc 7 gio sang cung ngay, Phu van hanh may cua tai xuong cua minh va bi luoi cua cat dut. Phu khai da den Tram y te phuong Hoa Hiep Bac de khau vet thuong. Tuy nhien qua tim hieu, nguoi than cua Phu deu khong nghe han noi gi ve tai nan nay. Lam viec voi co quan Cong an, y ta o day xac nhan luc 8 gio cung ngay, Phu co den nho khau vet thuong. Nhung voi kinh nghiem trong nghe, y ta nay khang dinh vet thuong tren tay Phu co truoc khi den tram xa it nhat 5 gio vi ke vet thuong mau da dong va kho cung. Tat ca cac dieu do cang khang dinh Nguyen Hong Phu lien quan den vu an mang. Tu cac bang chung va lap luan sac ben, den 20h15 cung ngay, doi tuong moi thua nhan la hung thu giet anh Tran Nam Hoang de cuop tai san. Chan dung tay giam doc giet nguoi Phu chua co vo, la anh ca trong mot gia dinh co 4 anh em. Nam 2008, Phu mo doanh nghiep san xuat, che bien do go. Do lam an thua lo, no nan gan 2 ty dong khong co kha nang chi tra, Phu len mang rao ban may moc trong nha xuong. Anh Tran Nam Hoang tinh co doc duoc thong tin tren mang va lien he voi Phu muon mua. Tu do Phu nay sinh y dinh lua anh Hoang ra Da Nang de cuop tai san. Phu di den mot so co so san xuat moc trong vung de chup hinh cac may moc ma anh Hoang can mua nhung Phu khong co roi gui qua email cho anh Hoang, bao do la may moc ma cau va bac Phu la Pham Quang Trung va Tran Van Lam muon ban, hen anh Hoang ra Da Nang. Truoc khi thuc hien hanh vi pham toi, Phu ra cho mua mot doi dep le lon hon nhieu so voi kich co chan minh voi y do sau khi gay an, vut bo lai hien truong de danh lac huong dieu tra. Phu cung mua 2 con dao Thai Lan, sau do dung nilon boc phan can de khi su dung khong luu lai dau van tay. Khoang 21 gio ngay 4.3, khi anh Hoang xuong may bay, Phu su dung xe may cua ban gai den don va dua anh Hoang di uong nuoc va an toi. Sau do, Phu cho anh Hoang ve khu vuc xa Hoa Phu de xem hang. Du truoc khi ra Da Nang, anh Hoang da duoc vo dan phai can than, toi ngu o khach san. Nhung truoc su nhiet tinh cua Phu, anh Hoang khong may may nghi ngo ngoi sau xe de Phu cho hang chuc km den noi hoang vang. Den gan dap Ho Cau, Phu dung lai, bao muon di ve sinh. Loi dung dem toi va anh Hoang khong de phong, Phu 2 tay 2 dao dam toi tap hang chuc phat khien anh Hoang guc tai cho. Sau khi ra tay sat hai nan nhan da man, Phu thao va huy lop nilon boc can dao. Tiep do, han luc tim va lay di giay to tuy than va tai san anh Hoang mang theo, bao gom gan 3,4 trieu dong, 1 may anh, tui sach dung 1 bo quan ao va cac loai hop dong, giay to tuy than. Nhung tang vay tren, Phu mang ve nha cat giau trong tu chen va tren tran la thong nha bep trong luc ca nha deu ngu nen khong hay biet gi. Den khi Phu duoc dua ve nha de kiem tra, thu giu tang vat, cha me Nguyen Hong Phu moi bat ngo va sang sot truoc toi ac kinh hoang do Phu gay ra. Truoc co quan dieu tra, Phu khai bao ranh mach, ro rang va khong he an nan hoi cai. Dieu Phu cam thay that vong nhat sau khi gay an la anh Hoang chi mang theo it tien, thay vi xap xi 600 trieu dong nhu suy nghi cua Phu. Nhung ngay qua trong trai giam, Phu van to ra rat binh tinh. Han binh than cho rang hanh vi pham toi cua han se phai tra gia bang an tu va ngong nghenh nghi toi ngay thu an xong se “lam lai cuoc doi va song theo y thich”. Co le khong con thuoc chua doi voi ke tan ac vo luong nay. Chi sau 14 gio nhan duoc thong tin, Cong an Da Nang da nhanh chong pha an. Ngay 12.3 vua qua, cac don vi tham gia pha an da duoc chu tich UBND thanh pho Da Nang tang thuong 100 trieu dong. Truoc do, Ban Giam doc Cong an thanh pho cung da thuong nong 10 trieu dong. Nhung noi nhu Dai ta Nguyen Van Son - Giam doc Cong an Da Nang - phan thuong lon nhat qua viec dieu tra, lam ro vu an nay chinh la cung co them niem tin cua nguoi dan Da Nang doi voi luc luong Cong an. Ei-hmuarnak A Thuptu Zung Rian Sang Tuantu Pawl Dantat Ding
Cozah zung a tanglei ah a cangmi ei-hmuarnak pawl cu tha tein dot-hlat in, cu ei-hmuarnak ahri tlaitu zung rian sang tuan pawl cu dan kan tat hna lai tiah Ei-hmuar donak Kawmasin (Anti-Corruption Commission) Chair U Aung Kyi nih a chim tiah DVB sin in kan theih.
May 20 ah tuahmi Rampumpi Hluttaw Meeting ah, Anti-corruption Commission nih an chuahmi cathluan kongah Hluttaw nih an i ceihmi kong he pehtlai in tu bantuk in Chairperson U Aung Ko nih a chim.
“Kawlram chungah ei-hmuarnak tete an zor khawh lonak a ruang cu, cozah zung chung ah a cangmi (internal corruption) asi timi cu a fiang. Zung rian tuantu a niam deuh lei in a sang deuhmi lei ah i thuhpiaknak a um bantuk in, zung rian tuantu a niammi sin ah a cangmi ei-hmuarnak pawl cu a cunglei nih an chek hna i an hmuh hna tikah, an ei-hmuarnak cu an thuhpiak hna, cun a nem deuhmi case ah an chiahpiak hna timi cu Anti-corruption Commission nih kan hmuh” tiah a chim.
Ei-hmuarnak hi nunphung bantuk asi cangnak Kawl ram ah ei-hmuarnak kan donh tikah hin, sualnak a ngeimi tiza cuai lawngin asi kho lo, cun kanmah Anti-corruption Commission lawngin hlawh kan tlinh kho lai lo tiah a chim chap.
Mah kongah upadi sernak, uknak le biaceihnak (legislative, executive and judicial) lei ah tuanvo ngeitu vialte lungrual tein hmun khat ah kan tuan lawngah hlawhtlinnak kan hmu lai tiah U Aung Kyi nih cun a chim.

Ba Minh, Hai Kim, Nguyen Thi Nguyet, Nguyen Van Chi... da dong gop tat ca nhung gi co the ma to quoc can, du ho phai hy sinh tat ca ma khong muu cau dieu gi cho ban than, gia dinh.
Sau khi ky cuoi cung duoc dang tai, ngoai nhung y kien ung ho, ton vinh cac nhan vat tinh bao anh hung ra con co mot so y kien khac nhau tu nhieu phia. Chung toi hieu, do la nhung phan hoi tat yeu khi nhung bi mat, nhung thong tin it ai ngo toi duoc cong bo.
Nhung moi mot dan toc deu co nhung giay phut buon dau va giay phut vinh quang cua lich su. Song du dung o goc do nao, song o chan troi nao thi To Quoc cung luon la dieu thieng lieng nhat trong sau tham moi con nguoi. Do la ly do ma nhung the he truoc day da khong ngai ngan hien dang ca cuoc doi chi de co duoc 4 chu "Doc lap, Tu do", la ly do ma Ba Minh san sang lan loi trong nguy hiem de phuc vu dat nuoc, du khi ay ong chua tung la Dang vien.

Trong luoi tinh bao A3, TS moi chi de cap duoc vai anh hung: H3, H4, T2, Nguyen Van Chi, Dinh Thi Nu. Nhung may ai hay, de dam bao an toan cho 1 con nguoi, 1 gia dinh con co ca gan chuc con nguoi khac truc tiep tham gia. Ho la nhung anh chi giao lien, nhung chien si lam cong viec hau can hay don gian la nhung nguoi vo tinh c o the "cam thay chuyen".
Trong so ho, gio co the nguoi con nguoi mat. Co nguoi tham chi chua bao gio duoc vinh danh, don gian vi ho luon chon cho minh mot con duong tham lang: song tham lang, chien dau tham lang, va doi khi chet di cung tham lang. Vi the, chien thang 30/4 khong phai la chien thang cua mot anh hung, do la chien thang cua ca dan toc - mot dan toc chua bao gio chiu lam no le cho ngoai bang.
Da qua thoi ky phai nhac den hai tu ’’chien tranh’’, nhung nhung su that lich su, nhung chung nhan lich su o bat ky quoc gia nao cung luon duoc ton trong.
Co the trong loat bai viet ’’Nguoi giu bi mat o Bo Tong tham muu VNCH’’, cac tac gia chua co dieu kien tim toi het tu lieu, gap go het cac nhan chung tu nhieu chieu. Nhung su gop y chan thanh cua doc gia trong tung ky bao da giup TS mo ra them nhieu huong tiep can doc dao hon.
TS xin chan thanh cam on doc gia da cung chia se va dong cam voi nhung suy nghi nay. Va, cung voi hang trieu doc gia trong va ngoai nuoc, TS xin tran trong danh tat ca tam long tri an cua minh toi nhung anh hung co ten va khong ten cua tinh bao quan doi Viet Nam, cua nhan dan Viet Nam. Loat phong su sap toi se la mot phan rat nho de TS the hien long biet on do doi voi nhung nguoi anh hung nhu vay!

Zo Minam Ni silh leh teendan (Chin National Day Dress Code) ~ Khup Khan Thang
“Numei in pasal’ puan khat peuh-peuh zang lo ding a, pasal in zong numei’ puan silh lo ding hi; bang hang hiam cih leh hih bang a hihte peuhmah Topa na Pasian uh tungah a kihhuai ahi hi.” Thu-hilh kikna 22:5.
“A woman shall not wear anything that pertains to a man, nor shall a man put on a woman’s garment, for all who do so are an abomination to the Lord your God.” Deuteronomy 22:5. KJV
Nungkum Zo Minam Ni (Chin National Day) ih bawlkhit ciang in kei muhkhak thu tawh kizui in hih lai paragraph khat kong suak sak hi.
Ih Zomi Nam Ni ih bawl ciangin, avai hawm ih Zomi maakaipi te tung kong gennop in ah; Tuhun ciang, ih Zomi Nam Ni ih bawl ciangin, mivom mikaang lengla zong ih nei thei aa leh ih naupang a tamzaw te’n thupi lapi gen na dingah eipau sang’ mikaangpau nop asa zaw, atelzaw vive hita uh ahih manin, Chin National Day or Zomi Nam Ni hong bangci piankhiat hiam cih ciangbeek English tawh zong ih gen kul ta ding in ka ngaisun hi. Tua ban ah taangthu gen himawk ii hih ciang in, upmawh sansat ahilo, thumaan la-maan, teltak aa ih gen ding zong kisam ta hi.
Tukum Zo Minam Ni ciangin, mipi in ih zuih ding ka deih mahmah in, a tung aa, Laisiangtho mun sung aa, Mawsi (Moses) in, a mipi te tungah Jehovah Pasian tung pan a ngah. thukham khun te zuih dingin a genkhiat/hilh ahihi.
Tua ahih ciang in, Pasal puan ahih Puanlaisan peuh mah Numei in silhlo ding, leh kawngnuai siah ah teeng lo ding. Tua mah bang in Pasal te in zong Numei’ Puandum leh Khephiau peuhmah silh lo ding, liang pan bat or vat’ lo ding. Nhieu cao oc da va dang moc len giua khu trung tam TP.HCM - Anh: N.C.T.
That la ly tuong neu noi do TP.HCM van giu duoc cai hon cua Sai Gon xua voi luong dan cu vua phai, khong ngap nuoc, khong un tac giao thong, gia dat dung voi gia tri cua no...
"De giai duoc bai toan nay khong qua kho, van con kip va hoan toan kha thi", trao doi voi TT, kien truc su Nguyen Ngoc Dung - Hoi Kien truc su TP.HCM - noi nhu vay. Ong cho biet:
- Hau nhu tat ca cac thanh pho o chau Au, My va mot so nuoc chau A khi co luong di dan vao thanh thi qua lon thi cac nha quan ly lap tuc ngung phat trien o noi thanh. Ho xay dung cac thanh pho moi la cac khu do thi ve tinh de keo giam dan so, giai quyet duoc hang loat van de di kem nhu giao thong, o nhiem, chat luong cuoc song... Xung quanh Tokyo hien co tam TP moi, moi TP co mot chuc nang khac nhau; Han Quoc dang chuan bi di doi khu trung tam hien dat tai Seoul ve mot TP co o mien trung rong khoang 4.000ha.
+ Nhung tai TP.HCM, hang loat nha cao tang da, dang va sap moc len pha het canh quan?
- TP cu duoc qui hoach rat ngan nap. Cu nhin tren ban do thi thay khu vuc Q.1, Q.3, du nhung con duong nay khong lon nhung duoc qui hoach rat dang hoang. The nhung thoi gian qua, khu trung tam TP da bi pha tuong doi nhieu, nang ne nhat la su xuat hien hang loat cao oc nhom - kinh vo cam. Ma da xay cao oc len phai mo duong, lam lai he thong cong, con cay xanh thi chet dan; ket xe, ngap nuoc, o nhiem moi truong... Dat Sai Gon khong thieu. Vi co gi choi bo qui hoach 300 nam cua hon ngoc Vien Dong? Vi co gi phai dap di nhung biet thu ngan nap de xay chen cao oc, khu thuong mai?... Toi tin nhung nguoi yeu Sai Gon se co tieng noi de giu lai nhung gi Sai Gon xua con sot lai.
+ Vua qua co mot so y kien de xuat di doi khu trung tam TP qua Thu Thiem hoac Cu Chi. Day co phai la y kien dang luu y nham dan bot dan ra ngoai khu trung tam?
Vi sao moi nguoi do don ve trung tam TP?
Vi sao khu trung tam ngap nuoc, ket xe, mat do dan cu qua cao? Vi TP chua co cac khu do thi ve tinh, co chang thi chat luong dich vu nhu giao duc, y te, giao thong... con kem, khong dap ung nhu cau huong thu cua nguoi dan nen moi nguoi cu do don ve trung tam.
Bien phap can co lau dai van la xay dung cac khu do thi ve tinh ma TP dang trien khai nhu khu do thi tay - bac 600ha o Cu Chi, khu do thi khoa hoc - cong nghe o Q.9, khu do thi Nam Sai Gon o Q.7 - Nha Be... deu dang duoc TP keu goi dau tu.
Muon nha dau tu den thi phai co he thong giao thong thuan loi nen TP cung dang yeu cau hoan chinh duong vanh dai 2 tu nga tu An Suong, huyen Binh Chanh noi den duong Nguyen Van Linh, Q.7, qua Q.2, Q.Thu Duc den duong xuyen A roi nhap ve nga tu An Suong. Tu day se noi vao cac khu do thi ve tinh va cac duong truc huong tam nhu duong Tan Son Nhat - Binh Loi, duong bac - nam, quoc lo 50....
Rieng khu trung tam TP 930ha bao gom Q.1, mot phan Q.3 va mot phan Q.4, co chuc nang trung tam thuong mai, tai chinh, dich vu nhung chuc nang chinh la trung tam hanh chinh.
Ong Nguyen Huu Tin (pho chu tich UBND TP.HCM)
- Neu quan niem trung tam TP la trung tam hanh chinh voi qua nhieu so, ban nganh tap trung o mot khu vuc nhu hien nay thi tot hon het la di doi ra cac TP ve tinh, o huyen Cu Chi hoac quan Thu Duc. Tru so UBND TP hien nay nen su dung lam bao tang lich su, mo cua de nguoi dan va khach tham quan vao tham.
+ Cach day rat lau ong da nhieu lan noi ve su can thiet xay dung cac khu do thi ve tinh xung quanh khu trung tam TP?
- Muoi nam truoc, toi da co y kien cho rang TP can 16 do thi ve tinh. Rat tiec y kien nay da bi bo qua. Den gio toi van cho rang suy nghi cua minh khong sai. TP minh hien nay thieu tram trong cac phan khu chuc nang la cac do thi ve tinh.
Do thi ve tinh khong phai la nhung do thi noi dai nhu hien nay ma co chuc nang khac nhau, duoc xay dung trong vong 10-15 nam va lam cuon chieu. Vi du o Q.9 co the xay dung hai TP dac thu la "TP khoa hoc cong nghe" va "TP dai hoc", dan so o day co the khoang 1 trieu nguoi, da so la giao su, sinh vien va nhung nguoi hoat dong chuyen ve linh vuc khoa hoc cong nghe...
Nhu vay se tranh duoc hinh thuc "con thoi" nhu hien nay la o mot noi, lam viec mot noi. Cu Chi se la "TP sach" vi o tren cao, thuong nguon song Sai Gon, song Dong Nai, noi day se duoc tap trung phat trien nganh cong nghe phan mem, vi tinh, may mac... khong gay o nhiem. Con o phia nam Sai Gon thi hinh thanh "TP cang" (do co he thong cang) va "TP cong nghiep nang"...
Moi do thi se duoc bao quanh mot rung cay, do thi nay noi ket voi do thi khac bang mot vanh dai xanh (rung cay). Vanh dai xanh la dat du tru va tuong lai la de phat trien mang luoi giao thong vung. Thu Thiem se la mot down town (trung tam tai chinh, thuong mai quoc te) cua TP, khong co chuc nang o.
+ Nhung bai toan kinh te luon nan giai. Ong co the gop mot giai phap kha thi?
- Trung Quoc giong minh nhung ho lam duoc, le nao minh "bo tay"? Cach lam cua ho rat khoa hoc. Dau tien la ho thanh lap cac cong ty nha nuoc chuyen dau tu cac do thi ve tinh. Nha nuoc cap von ban dau cho cac cong ty nay, khong bang tien ma bang dat (giao dat). Cong ty tien hanh lam so do, roi di the chap ngan hang vay von lay tien mua mot phan dat cua nguoi dan de xay chung cu tai dinh cu.
Vi du khi xay xong 1.000 can ho thi hoan doi cho dan, nhung chi hoan doi mot nua gia tri dat, nua con lai de cho dan gop von vao co phan cua cong ty. Khi da co dat sach thi cong ty len mang quang cao do thi de nha dau tu mua dat lam theo qui hoach xay dung nhung cong trinh cu the. Dat ruong khi do se tang gia hang tram lan, cong ty thu loi lon, tra tien co tuc cho nguoi dan va nop lai tien cho ngan sach de TP dau tu xay dung san bay, ben cang... (TP se khong phai di vay von ODA nhu hien nay).
Con lam nhu hien nay thi tien lai sinh loi tu dat deu nam trong tui ca nhan, cong ty dia oc ban dat tren giay..., nguoi dan va chinh quyen TP deu khong duoc gi. Toi nghi bai toan kinh te khong qua kho, chi so khong ai chiu lam.

Euro 2008 từ A đến Z (phần đầu) - tin euro 2008 #562
Gan mot thang tranh trai soi noi, ngay hoi bong da chau Au da de lai nhung an tuong dam net. Duoi day la nhung gi dang nho nhat cua giai dau, duoc sap xep theo trat tu trong bang chu cai.
Khi Arshavin ngoi ngoai hai tran dau vong bang vi an treo gio tu vong loai, tuyen Nga tham bai 1-4 duoi tay Tay Ban Nha va choi chat vat o tran tiep theo gap Hy Lap. Co anh tro lai tu cuoi vong bang, Nga nhu "lot xac" tro thanh mot doi bong khac han, manh me, uyen chuyen, day cam hung va mang ve dep cua mot doi choi tong luc, nhat la tran thang Ha Lan 3-1 tai tu ket. Tu cho gan nhu vo danh, chi sau hai tran dau bung no tai Euro 2008, Arshavin da buoc chan vao hang ngu nhung ngoi sao sang gia cua chau luc. Arshavin (so 10) toa sang ruc ro ngay lan dau buoc ra san khau lon. Anh: Reuters.
O tuoi 69, Aragones khong he la "lao gia lam cam" nhu cach ma bao gioi Madrid van dung de gay suc ep, buoc HLV nay tu bo quyet dinh gat Raul khoi DTQG. Khi khong co Raul, nghia la khong con ai qua khac biet so voi phan con lai, Tay Ban Nha tro thanh mot tap the dung nghia va tranh duoc nhung rac roi khong dang co trong hau truong. Ben canh do, nhung quyet sach dung dan ve chien thuat, nhan su, chang han nhu rut Torres giua tran gap Nga hay thay ca Fabregas va Torres o thoi diem cang thang nhat cua tran chung ket, Aragones chinh la nhan to quan trong giup Tay Ban Nha len ngoi vo dich.
Ballack la mot trong so hiem hoi nhung sieu sao duoc ky vong choi dung voi dang cap, nhung Euro 2008 van la mot ky niem buon voi ca nhan tien ve nguoi Duc. Suc voc va nhung cong hien khong met moi cua ngoi sao 31 tuoi nay chi co the giup doi nha di den tran chung ket, noi minh anh khong du suc khoa lap het nhung diem yeu cua "Co xe tang" truoc mot Tay Ban Nha dong deu va toan dien hon. Trong lan thu tu gop mat o mot tran chung ket lon (3 lan truoc la chung ket Champions League 2002 & 2008, World Cup 2002), Ballack van chi la "ke ve nhi" vi dai ma thoi.
Cung nam trong sot it thu mon hang dau the gioi, nhung Casillas va Cech lai nem trai cam xuc trai nguoc tai Euro 2008. Nguoi dau tien van giu duoc phong do dinh cao nhu khi "giu den" cho Real Madrid. Chinh su on dinh, kha nang phan doan va phan xa xuat than cua anh da gop phan quan trong giup Tay Ban Nha di den ngoi cao nhat. Nguoc lai, thu thanh cua Chelsea mac sai sot nghiem trong, gian tiep khien CH Czech thua tran then chot va bi loai. Anh de bong nay ra sau qua tat cua Altintop, tao dieu kien cho Nihat ap vao go hoa 2-2 - mot buoc quan trong giup Tho Nhi Ky thang nguoc 3-2.
Bi kich (Drama) la tu duoc rat nhieu cau thu, HLV thot len sau cac tran dau tai Euro 2008. 18 trong so 77 ban thang tai giai lan nay duoc ghi trong vong 5 phut cuoi. Khong ai hieu ro y nghia "Bi kich" nay hon Tho Nhi Ky. Ho tao nen "Bi kich" cho Thuy Si, CH Czech (vong bang) roi Croatia (tu ket) bang nhung ban thang quyet dinh o cac phut 90, 89 va 120. Nhung den ban ket, chinh thay tro Terim - luc ay duoc xem la "chuyen gia nguoc dong cua Euro 2008" - lai nem trai dang khi de tuyen Duc an dinh thang loi 3-2 bang pha lap cong cua Lahm o phut da chinh thuc cuoi cung.
"Vua nguoc dong" Tho Nhi Ky cung nem mui "bi kich" vao phut chot tran ban ket gap Duc. Anh: AP.
Euro 2008 la giai dau lon dau tien ke tu nam 1994 khong co su tham du cua tuyen Anh (England). Voi nhieu fan xu suong mu, viec phai xem ngay hoi bong da chau luc qua TV do doi nha khong qua duoc vong loai co the la mot cuc hinh. Tuy nhien, trong mat HLV truong Capello cung cac cong su trong ban huan luyen "Tam su", nhung gi dien ra tren dat Ao - Thuy Sy he vua qua chua han la vo bo, boi day la dip tot de ho nhan ra nhung mat han che cua tuyen Anh so voi mat bang bong da chau Au va khac phuc truoc khi buoc vao vong loai World Cup 2010.
Tho Nhi Ky chi la mot tap the cac tuyen thu co trinh do vao loai trung binh yeu o chau Au va khong duoc danh gia cao truoc them Euro 2008. Nhung bang tai thao luoc va nhung quyet dinh dung dan ve loi choi, chien thuat, con nguoi, HLV Fatih Terim da nang tam tap the ay thanh mot doi bong manh. Tho Nhi Ky khien tat ca phai sung sot khi lam nen 3 cuoc nguoc dong kho tin de co mat tai ban ket, noi ho choi kien cuong, lam dai gia Duc toat mo hoi va chi chiu mat suat du tran chung ket boi ban thua vao phut chot.
"The he vang" (Golden Generation) la tu ma gioi chuyen mon va nhieu CDV dung de noi ve tuyen Bo Dao Nha du Euro 2008. Voi mot ngoi sao choi sang la Cristiano Ronaldo cung dan cau thu tre trung, tai nang lai duoc dan dat boi HLV bac thay Scolari, "Brazil cua chau Au" duoc ky vong hoan thien chu ky vinh quang bang chuc vo dich tren dat Ao - Thuy Sy (sau khi da vao tu ket Euro 1996, ban ket Euro 2000 va chung ket Euro 2004). Nhung su ky vong ay da dat nham cho. Bo Dao Nha chi choi dung dang cap o 2 tran dau vong bang va bi nguoi Duc "bat bai", ha 3-2 o tu ket.
O mot chung muc nao do, Hy Lap (Greece) cung gay that vong chang kem. Den Euro 2008 voi tu cach DKVD, con nguyen dan tru cot va HLV Rehhagel tung len ngoi o Bo Dao Nha cach day 4 nam, nhung doi tuyen "xu so cac vi than" lai trinh dien mot bo mat bac nhuoc yeu duoi den kho tin. Ho het hy vong di tiep sau hai tran dau, trang tay trong ca 3 tran vong bang, ghi 1 ban va thung luoi den 5 va tro thanh doi do nhat trong so cac doi vo dich bao ve ngoi bau o ky Euro tiep theo.
Ba ban thang vao luoi tuyen Nga o loat tran dau vong bang giup David Villa tro thanh cau thu thu 7 lap Hat-trick trong khuong kho mot vong chung ket Euro. Truoc tien dao nguoi Tay Ban Nha la nhung Kluivert (Ha Lan), Conceicao (Bo Dao Nha), Van Basten (Ha Lan), Platini (Phap - 2 lan), Allofs, Muller (Duc). Cu hat-trick dang nho ay cung giup Villa thang tien den danh hieu Vua pha luoi Euro 2008 (voi 4 ban, ban con lai duoc ghi trong tran thang Thuy Dien 2-1).
David Villa (trai) la cau thu duy nhat lap hat-trick tai Euro 2008. Anh: Getty Images.
Chan thuong (Injuries) la con ac mong voi nhieu doi bong du Euro 2008. Italy khon kho vi mat Cannavaro it ngay truoc tran ra quan. Phap thi khong the su dung thu quan Vieira lay mot phut, con Ribery duoc cang khoi san khi doi nha can anh nhat trong tran quyet tu voi Italy. Villa mat co hoi du tran chung ket vi bi cang co dui sau khi cu sut phat truc tiep sai tu the o ban ket. Ngoai ra, cung co vai truong hop mat co hoi du Euro 2008 vi nhung chan thuong lang nhach. Daniel Pudil, tuyen thu Czech, bi gay tay trong khi an mung chuc VDQG cung Slavia Prague. Ovidiu Petre, tuyen thu Romania, thi dinh chan thuong o lung vi cu va cham voi mot phong vien anh khi dang du tran dau bong ...chuyen cung ban be.

Ngo Duc Minh (Minh "sut") luc bi bat. Xuat than trong mot gia dinh co cong voi cach mang, nhan than tot, tung la Cong an cua TP Hai Phong, nhung Ngo Duc Minh tuc Minh “sut” lai tro thanh mot trum giang ho khet tieng o Hai Phong va duoc ba trum Dung Ha coi nhu mot dan anh dang kinh. Dam tang cua ba trum tai Hai Phong sau cai chet tham duoi tay Hai “Banh” von duoc giang ho khap ca nuoc truyen tai nhau ve do hoanh trang cung chinh do Minh “sut” dung ra chi dao to chuc, coi nhu mot “nen huong” thap cho co em giang ho khet tieng cua han ta. Nguoi chi dao dam tang hoanh trang cua ba trum Dan giang ho khap ca nuoc dac biet la dan giang ho Hai Phong coi dem ngay 1-10-2000 la mot dem “lich su”, khi ba trum Dung Ha , dan chi cua gioi giang ho Hai Phong da chet tuc tuoi o TP HCM, duoi tay dan em cua Hai “Banh”. Giang ho Hai "Banh". Dem dinh menh kho quen ay duoc gioi giang ho van truyen tai nhau: ba trum Dung Ha co hen voi dan anh cua thi la Ngo Duc Minh (tuc Minh “sut”) – mot giang ho cung khet tieng khong kem o Hai Phong. Khi dang mai me ban tinh chuyen lam an voi Minh “sut” truoc cua can nha so 17, duong Bui Thi Xuan, phuong Ben Thanh, Q.1, TP HCM, Dung Ha da bi Hung “phi nhon” va Truong “xoan”, hai ten dan em than tin cua Hai “Banh” ket lieu mang song. Ba trum ngang doc tung hoanh khap noi giang ho khien bao dan em vua ne vua so da phai chet dau don trong mot phut thieu de phong nhung ke thu ben canh. Sau khi Dung Ha chet chi hon tieng dong ho, tat ca cac giang ho Hai Phong tu nhung ke co sung co mo den nhung ten giang ho nhi chua tung mot lan gap ba trum Dung Ha deu khoc nhu mua va chuan bi “nghi le trang trong” nhat co the de don thi hai “ba chua”cua dan anh chi dat Cang. Den nay, dam tang Dung Ha o Hai Phong van la dam tang co mot khong hai ve ca muc do hoanh trang, cong phu lan so nguoi tham du. Khong mot dan anh, dan chi giang ho mien Bac nao dam vang mat trong dam tang do. Dan em Dung Ha tham du dam tang vua dau don vi mat di “nu tuong”, nhung trong bung van tham man nguyen vi dam tang cua Dung Ha that xung tam oai phong cua ba trum luc con song. Ke dung sau to chuc dam tang gay chan dong cho Dung Ha chinh la Minh “sut” – dan anh than thiet cua ba trum nay. Sau khi Dung Ha chet, Minh “sut” da cho dan em dua xac ba trum nay vao nha, cho dan em tam goi, suc nuoc hoa thom phuc, mac quan ao moi tinh tuom roi moi thay cung den kham liem cho Dung Ha dang hoang. Ngay trong dem, Minh “sut” da bat dan em lay ve bang duoc chiec quan tai bang kem lam ao quan cho “em gai”. Minh “sut” chung to han la mot ke chiu choi, vung tien khong tiec tay va cu xu co nghia co tinh khi thue han mot chiec may bay de cho xac Dung Ha ve Hai Phong. Tai san bay Cat Bi – Hai Phong, tat ca dan em Dung Ha da co mat de don linh cuu dan chi. Khi tham du dam tang Dung Ha, giang ho mien Bac deu nga mu truoc do chiu choi cua Minh “sut” cung nhu tai to chuc cua on gtrum nay. Han qua xung dang la “dan anh” cua ba trum doan menh. Duoi tai to chuc cua Minh “sut” va bang so tien khong nho, dan em Dung Ha da lam cho ba trum mot dam tang khong kem gi dam tang cua cac “bo gia mafia” the gioi. Dung Ha trong phong hoi cung. Rat nhieu nha su, thay cung duoc moi den dam tang de cau sieu cho Dung Ha. Quan tai cua Dung Ha duoc dap hoa ruc ro. Doc con pho Trang Trinh vao noi to chuc dam tang tai nha Dung Ha, nhung dan em khap gioi giang ho Hai Phong deu duoc tuyen chon ky cang dung thanh hai hang doc, va deu mac dong phuc comple den, giay den, kinh den. Ben canh linh cuu cua Dung Ha cung co dan em dung canh, guong mat nghiem trang, lanh lung. Nhung ten nay coi viec duoc dung canh cho “chi” an giac ngan thu la vinh du lon trong cuoc doi, duoc coi nhu bo mat cua giang ho Hai Phong dai dien don tiep khach den vieng dan chi Dung Ha. Nhung ten duoc tuyen chon deu la nhung ke co mat mui sang sua nhat trong gioi giang ho dat Cang. Nhung nguoi den tham du dam tang cung duoc “Ban to chuc” dam tang yeu cau mac comple den voi nam gioi va ao vay den voi nu gioi. Truoc gio dua ba trum ve noi an nghi cuoi cung, Minh “sut” da chi dao dan em Dung Ha dung chan cac con pho doc tuyen duong tu pho Trang Trinh den nghia trang Ninh Hai o ngoai o thanh pho. Khong mot o to, xe may nao duoc phep di vao con duong nay. Nhung ten dan em cua Dung Ha (duong nhien la mac comple den, di giay den, deo kinh den) dung canh giu o cac giao lo, khien khong mot nguoi dan thuong nao dam buoc vao. Mot doan xe hoi mau den lang cong xep dai ca cay so tren pho cham cham di sau xe quan. Phia sau la doan nguoi dai kin pho. Khong hiem nguoi dan dat Cang da gac lai cong viec ca buoi sang hom do de tan muc so thi dam tang Dung Ha. Khoi phai noi, giang ho dat Cang da man nguyen the nao voi viec to chuc dam tang cho Dung Ha hoanh trang den vay. Sau dam tang, danh tieng cua Minh “sut” voi dan anh chi dat Cang cang lung lay. Nhieu dan em cua Dung Ha da the voi “dai ca” Minh “sut” se song chet voi han de to long biet on “nghia cu” cua han voi “chi ca” Dung Ha. Trum ma tuy khet tieng xuat than con nha lanh Sau dam tang Dung Ha, Minh “sut” khong chi la cai ten duoc gioi giang ho ban tan ma con tro thanh tieu diem cua bao chi. Ngay sau do, han da bi Bo Cong an bat giu cung voi dong bon trong duong day ma tuy xuyen quoc gia khong lo cua han. Minh “sut” la con trai cua mot gia dinh co cong voi cach mang, bo la quan chuc. Xuat than gia dinh tu te, co giao duc han hoi nhung Minh “sut” khong chiu song mot cuoc doi tu te de bao hieu cha me. Sau khi tot nghiep PTTH, Minh “sut” duoc tam tuyen vao luc luong Cong an roi di hoc lop so cap. Khi ra truong, han duoc dieu ve lam tai Cong an quan Le Chan. Nganh Cong an co ve khong phu hop voi mot ke ngo nguoc, ham choi hon ham lam nhu Minh “sut”. La nguoi trong nganh, mac quan phuc nganh Cong an, nhung Minh “sut” khong chiu tuan thu ky luat va menh lenh cap tren. Sau rat nhieu vi pham co he thong, han da bi duoi khoi nganh Cong an kem theo khong it tai tieng. Gia dinh co the o Hai Phong nen Minh “sut” coi chuyen bi duoi khoi nganh Cong an khong co gi la tai hoa. Sau do it lau, han xin duoc mot chan tai Cong ty Van tai bien Hai Phong, noi han co nguoi nha dang cong tac. Lam nganh van tai bien khi do la noi hai ra tien, la cho lam mo uoc cua nhieu nguoi nhung Minh “sut” khong biet quy trong cong viec do. Vao dau nam 1980, han bi Cong an Hai Phong bat vi toi trom cap tai san. Minh “sut” chinh thuc bi luu manh hoa khi ra khoi tu. Tu thoi diem nay, han chuyen luon sang nghe buon lau va som khang dinh vai ve cua minh vao hang dai gia buon lau dat Cang. Sau khi lay vo sinh con, Minh “sut” van ngua quen duong cu nen gia dinh han rat chan nan, bat luc, danh pho mac moi chuyen cho troi tinh. Minh “sut” giau trong thay tu khi la trum buon lau. Nhung Hai Phong khong phai vung dat de lam an yen on khi ma dat Cang luon tap trung nhung tay anh chi mau mat giang ho thuong xuyen gay kho de. Minh “sut” co tien nhung khong co tieng trong gioi anh chi dat Cang. Han khong canh tranh duoc voi nhung trum buon lau da co tham nien o Hai Phong luc ay nen nhanh chong bi yeu the trong viec tranh gianh dat lam an trong gioi buon hang lau. Luc Minh “sut” dang kho khan trong viec tim cho dua trong gioi giang ho Hai Phong de cung co vi tri, thi Dung Ha da tro thanh mot dan chi co so ma o dat Cang. Neu Minh “sut” can the thi Dung Ha can tien de nuoi dam dan em lau nhau. Ca hai tim toi nhau va tro thanh mot cap bai trung o dat Cang. Nhung nam 1980, Minh “sut” tuy chua giau nhung da noi tieng chiu choi khong kem gi so voi do chiu choi khi to chuc dam tang cho Dung Ha. Von ban tinh giang ho nen ba trum Dung Ha rat quy tinh cach nay cua Minh “sut”. Dung Ha coi Minh “sut” nhu anh trai. Gia dinh Dung Ha coi Minh “sut” nhu nguoi nha. Chi em cua Dung Ha cung than thiet voi han. Da co ca tien va the, Minh “sut” thoa suc tung hoanh trong linh vuc buon ban hang lau. Nhung dung luc viec buon hang dien tu lau dang o thoi hoang kim thi Minh “sut” bi bat. Dau nhung nam 1990, Minh “sut” moi duoc tha tu do. Ra khoi tu lan thu hai, nhan thay thoi the da thay doi nen ong trum buon lau Minh “sut” da quyet dinh chuyen huong sang buon ban ma tuy. Minh “sut” gap Ngo Xuan Phuong sau khi ra tu. Luc do, Ngo Xuan Phuong da la mot trum ma tuy co tieng. Ngo Xuan Phuong la nguoi Hai Phong nhung sang dinh cu tai Nhat Ban tu nam 1989. O Nhat, Ngo Xuan Phuong luon nam trong so den cua canh sat Nhat voi nhung vu trom cap tai san lien tuc. Sau nay, Phuong khong an manh nua ma quyet dinh bat ca lon. Han moc noi voi cac dau nau o Campuchia va Lao lap duong day buon ban ma tuy xuyen quoc gia. Duong day cua bon chung chuyen ma tuy tu Campuchia va Lao sang Nhat sau do tiep tuc di sang My, Anh, Uc. Canh sat quoc te da kien tri vay bat bang nhom cua Ngo Xuan Phuong nhung ten cao gia nhieu lan thoat hiem vi qua ranh manh. Ngo Xuan Phuong gap Minh “sut” trong mot chuyen ve Viet Nam tim dia diem lam an. Nhu ca gap nuoc, Phuong va Minh “sut” lap tuc bat tay, thanh cap bai trung moi trong duong day buon ban, van chuyen ma tuy xuyen bien gioi. Minh “sut” o Viet Nam co trach nhiem tap hop “hang”, sau do van chuyen bang duong tau bien cho Phuong. Nguon hang cua Minh “sut” lay khong gi khac ngoai Dung Ha va mot ong trum ma tuy noi tieng thoi do nay da bi xu ban la Vu Xuan Truong. Trong so cac mat xich cua duong day van chuyen do Minh”sut” va Ngo Xuan Phuong thiet lap, co mot doi tuong la Trinh Van Lap (que o Hai Phong). Trinh Van Lap cung la con nha danh gia, duoc bo me nuoi an hoc day du. Bo Trinh Van Lap tung la thuyen truong tau vien duong ma thoi do chang nghe nao giau co nhu nghe di tau vien duong. Trinh Van Lap duoc bo me cho di du hoc nuoc ngoai roi ve lam viec tai Cong ty Van tai Bien Viet Nam. Lap quen voi Minh “sut” cung chinh nho moi quan he nghe nghiep nay. Trinh Van Lap la nguoi co tuong lai, su nghiep, vo dep con xinh. Lap tung co tien de mo cong ty kinh doanh tau bien. Nhung long tham con nguoi la khong day. Khi duoc Minh “sut” de nghi lam an bat chinh, Trinh Van Lap da gat dau. Han mua ca may cai tau bien tri gia ca tram nghin USD. Minh “sut” lay tau bien cua Lap chuyen hang hoa binh thuong de che mat cho so ma tuy cat giau tren tau. So di Trinh Van Lap dong y lam chuyen nguy hiem nay vi thu lao Minh “sut” tra cho han rat hau hinh. Chua duoc huong loi la bao, Trinh Van Lap bi bat khi duong day bai lo va bi tuyen an tu hinh. Sau do han duoc Chu tich nuoc an xa xuong chung than. Nhung cai gia ma Lap phai tra vo cung dat do. Dau don voi dua con nghich tu pham toi tay troi, cha han da do benh sau khi han bi tuyen an va qua doi. Ngoai Trinh Van Lap, Minh “sut” con nhieu thu doan khac de tuon ma tuy sang Nhat cho Ngo Xuan Phuong nhu qua duong hang khong, duong tau bien. Cong viec lam an cua bon chung trot lot trong gan 10 nam troi. Theo cao trang, sau gan 9 nam, Minh “sut” va Ngo Xuan Phuong da mua ban 103 banh heroin, 50kg can xa, 15kg ma tuy tong hop. Moi chuyen van chuyen hang, Ngo Xuan Phuong con tien the gui them it thuoc lac (khoang 6000 vien) ve cho dong bon trong nuoc tieu thu o cac vu truong. Khi cong viec lam an phat dat, Minh “sut” chuyen vao Mien Nam sinh song. Han thiet lap duong day ma tuy tu Lao va Campuchia ve Viet Nam, chuyen ra cac cang bien roi dua xuong tau, sau do chuyen sang Nhat. Co nhung truong hop Minh “sut” su dung ngay cac tiep vien hang khong. Nhung phi vu cua Ngo Xuan Phuong va Minh “sut” dien ra nhieu nam troi ma khong mot co quan dieu tra nao phat hien ra, cho den thoi diem cuoi nam 2000, dau nam 2001. Doan ket cua “dan anh” Dung Ha Trung binh moi banh heroin, Minh “sut” va Ngo Xuan Phuong ban lai duoc 8000 USD. Loi nhuan duoc chia song phang cho ca hai ten, chua ke den nhung khoan rau ria cho canh dan em. Khoi phai noi, Minh “sut” kiem duoc bao nhieu tien sau nhung vu van chuyen ma tuy quoc te co bu do. Nhung tien kiem vao cua truoc di cua sau, boi kiem duoc bao nhieu tien tu ma tuy thi Minh “sut” lai nuong bay nhieu vao bai bac. Han cung chung kien nhung ong trum ma tuy quanh minh lan luot bi dua ra phap truong nen bat dau toan tinh viec tim mot cho kiem an khac. Khi vao TP HCM, Dung Ha coi Minh “sut” la cho dua lon. Cho “huynh muoi” than tinh, Minh “sut” da giup do Dung Ha rat nhieu trong nhung ngay dau moi vao TP HCM, con chua khang dinh duoc so ma o phia Nam voi nhung giang ho ky cuu tu sau giai phong. Nhung voi tieng tam cua minh, sau mot thoi gian, Dung Ha da tro thanh doi thu dang gom cua trum giang ho Nam Cam. Chung kien Nam Cam xung ba giang ho phia Nam nhieu nam, Minh “sut” da xui Dung Ha am muu thuc hien cuoc lat do, chiem lay lanh dia bao ke cac song bac o TP HCM. Dung Ha da quen voi quyen luc trong gioi giang ho, nen ngang nhien thach thuc voi ong trum Nam Cam. Dieu nay da khien Nam Cam nong mat va buoc phai nho toi su can thiep cua Hai “Banh”. Nhu da biet, Hai “Banh” da ket lieu mang song cua Dung Ha bang mot phat sung do hai ten dan em than tin ma han cu di giet Dung Ha. Sau cai chet cua Dung Ha, Minh “sut” vua an han vua so. Han an han vi da gian tiep day Dung Ha vao cho chet. Phan vi an han, phan vi tinh nghia anh em voi Dung Ha, Minh “sut” da to chuc cho Dung Ha mot dam tang hoanh trang chua tung thay trong gioi giang ho. Dong thai nay cua Minh “sut” da khien cho dan em Dung Ha o Hai Phong ton Minh “sut” len lam dai ca. Nhung Minh “sut” thi khong du thong minh de biet nguy hiem dang can ke han. Sau khi Dung Ha bi giet chet ngay truoc mat, Minh “sut” so het hon het via. Ca ngay han chi quanh quan trong nha, chang dam lang thang o cac song bac nhu truoc. Han so se tro thanh nan nhan tiep theo cua Nam Cam vi cai toi dam ca gan xui Dung Ha quay pha Nam Cam. Nhung Minh “sut” cung khong tron duoc lau. Nam 2002, khi tap doan toi pham Nam Cam bi tieu diet cung la luc duong day ma tuy xuyen quoc gia cua Minh “sut” va Ngo Xuan Phuong bi bai lo. Truoc toa, Minh “sut” cung phai thua nhan ban than han khong nho da buon ban bao nhieu banh heroin va van chuyen bao nhieu lan vi viec buon ban dien ra trong thoi gian nhieu nam. Den luc nay, biet khong tranh khoi toi chet voi ngan ay toi trang, Minh “sut” da ngoan ngoan khai nhan het toi cua minh, khong quen khai them cac moi lam an khac cua han, khien cho duong day cua Minh “sut” va mot so duong day khac bi vo. Nho lay cong chuoc toi kip thoi, Minh “sut” da thoat khoi ban an tu hinh ma han da 10 phan thi nam den 9 phan chet. Hien gio, trum ma tuy Minh “sut” dang thu an tai trai giam Thu Duc voi an tu chung than. Han se con boc lich dai dai, voi chuoi tien an tien su da tung pham phai truoc day. AbstractBackground and Purpose—We sought to determine whether folic acid supplementation can independently reduce the risk of first stroke associated with elevated total cholesterol levels in a subanalysis using data from the CSPPT (China Stroke Primary Prevention Trial), a double-blind, randomized controlled trial.Methods—A total of 20 702 hypertensive adults without a history of major cardiovascular disease were randomly assigned to a double-blind daily treatment of an enalapril 10-mg and a folic acid 0.8-mg tablet or an enalapril 10-mg tablet alone. The primary outcome was first stroke.Results—The median treatment duration was 4.5 years. For participants not receiving folic acid treatment (enalapril-only group), high total cholesterol (≥200 mg/dL) was an independent predictor of first stroke when compared with low total cholesterol (<200 mg/dL; 4.0% versus 2.6%; hazard ratio, 1.52; 95% confidence interval, 1.18–1.97; P=0.001). Folic acid supplementation significantly reduced the risk of first stroke among participants with high total cholesterol (4.0% in the enalapril-only group versus 2.7% in the enalapril–folic acid group; hazard ratio, 0.69; 95% confidence interval, 0.56–0.84; P<0.001; number needed to treat, 78; 95% confidence interval, 52–158), independent of baseline folate levels and other important covariates. By contrast, among participants with low total cholesterol, the risk of stroke was 2.6% in the enalapril-only group versus 2.5% in the enalapril–folic acid group (hazard ratio, 1.00; 95% confidence interval, 0.75–1.30; P=0.982). The effect was greater among participants with elevated total cholesterol (P for interaction=0.024).Conclusions—Elevated total cholesterol levels may modify the benefits of folic acid therapy on first stroke. Folic acid supplementation reduced the risk of first stroke associated with elevated total cholesterol by 31% among hypertensive adults without a history of major cardiovascular diseases.Clinical Trial Registration—URL: http://www.clinicaltrials.gov. >> Nhan doc bai The nao la “loi hua” cua bo truong?
Bo truong Bo Cong nghiep Hoang Trung Hai tra loi chat van cac dai bieu Quoc hoi. Anh : Thong Nhat. Anh: TTXVN.
Dien hinh do la nhieu van de Ban Dan nguyen cho do la loi hua voi QH, cu tri, nhung cac vi Bo truong lai cho do khong phai la loi hua, nghia la khong co trach nhiem phai thuc hien loi noi truoc toan dan. Do la noi de cho... co noi, noi de cho toan dan biet toi van la mot Bo truong, nhung khong co trach nhiem giai quyet nhung loi hua do. Neu gay gat qua thi toi "se ket hop voi bo nay, anh khac" se ban bac va... se tra loi sau?
Cho den nay, chung ta chua co mot van ban phap luat nao quy dinh the nao la loi noi cua Bo truong tro thanh loi hua, roi thuc hien loi hua do nhu the nao. Day la tran tro cua toan dan, dang ra khong can thiet, nhung vi cac vi hua nhieu qua ma chang lam duoc bao nhieu nen nguoi ta lai yeu cau den... luat! Qua day the hien su yeu kem rat ro ve tinh than trach nhiem.
Cu nhin lanh dao cac nuoc, khi xay ra van de - co the van de do chua bao gio cac vi hua - nhung thuoc lanh vuc minh quan ly, ngay lap tuc ho tu chiu trach nhiem, hinh thuc tu nhan trach nhiem la tu chuc. Chung ta, mot so linh vuc co nhieu van de nhu giao duc, giao thong, y te... xay ra qua nhieu van de. Ky hop nao cung nghe cac vi dung dau nganh "xin hua, xin nhan trach nhiem..." nhung dau roi cung vao do. Loi noi... gio cu thoi bay!
Lam gi de nhung loi noi do gio... thoi khong bay? Co che nao co the truy duoc do la loi hua cua anh, neu anh hua ma khong thuc hien, giai quyet duoc thi anh phai chiu hinh thuc trach nhiem nao? Day la nhung cau hoi chung ta buoc phai tra loi duoc truoc khi vao thuc chat cac buoi chat van tren QH. Neu khong co co che giam sat, nhung buoi chat van tra loi tren QH thuc chat cung chi la... dien dan. Khi ket thuc dien dan, moi thu van van hanh theo loi cu!
Neu chung ta chua co co che giam sat, cac vi dau nganh van “xin - se", thi truoc khi chat van, cu phat lai bang nhung van de ma cac vi da hua ky hop truoc chua thay giai quyet, tiep tuc giai quyet triet de bang chinh nhung... loi hua tai ky hop nay. Co the day la bien phap... truy hieu qua, de cac vi hieu dung the nao la "loi hua". Khi nhan ra dung van de, chung toi tin cac vi bo truong se rat han che hua va chi bat tay hanh dong thoi!
Nguoi dan can Bo truong noi di doi voi lam la du!
Voi tu cach la mot cong dan, la mot cu tri, bay lau nay toi van tin rang viec cac vi Bo truong cua chung ta moi lan dung truoc Quoc hoi tra loi chat van cua cac dai bieu, ve mot van de nao do va dua ra mot phuong an la Bo se ket hop voi cac ban nganh A; B; C... de giai quyet van de duoc dat ra, thi do chinh la loi hua cua Bo truong doi voi dai bieu, voi nhan dan.
The nhung, that bat ngo… la khong it Bo truong lai noi: “do khong phai la loi hua”. Thuc tinh, toi khong biet khi cac vi khong thua nhan nhung loi noi do cua minh truoc Quoc hoi la loi hua… thi cac vi coi do la gi? Khong le cac vi coi do chi la loi loi noi bong dua, hoac do la do cac Bo truong bi dai bieu chat “du” qua thanh ra noi nham, noi lan man, noi dai cho qua…!!???
Den day thi ro rang la nhung cu tri nhu chung toi khong the yen tam ve chat luong cua cac ki hop quoc hoi nua! Boi mot dieu, nhung van de cu tri chung toi buc xuc deu da duoc cac dai bieu dem ra ban thao, chat van, xin y kien cua Bo truong... truoc quoc hoi, nhung cuoi cung lai nhan duoc nhung cau tra loi, nhung phuong an mang tinh nua voi tu Bo truong… va do khong la loi hua cua Bo truong voi cu tri chung toi. Khi cac can bo da khong xem do la nhung loi hua, thi cu tri chung toi biet chac mot dieu la trong qua trinh thuc hien no, cac vi Bo truong se tro nen vo trach nhiem, va cuoi cung thi nhung nguyen vong cua cu tri se mai khong duoc thuc hien theo dung nguyen vong cua minh.
Vay nen, la cu tri, chung toi thay khong can nua nhung loi noi von khong phai la loi hua. Va ngay ca nhung loi duoc cac vi Bo truong nhan do la nhung loi hua, song tren thuc te cac vi lai tho o, vo trach nhiem voi no… thi chung toi cung khong can not. Boi do khong khac nhung loi noi “suong” vo nghia. Va cuoi cung la chung toi lai cang khong can viec Quoi hoi dua ra va luan ban xem the nao la loi hua va the nao la loi noi… dieu do co ve du thua.
Va cuoi cung la dieu chung toi can o cac vi Bo truong, do la loi noi (khong can la loi hua!) phai di doi voi hanh dong.
Gia nhu Bo truong dung hua!
Co mot dieu ma cu tri khong thich chut nao o Bo truong la khi tra loi chat van, Bo truong khong di thang vao van de ma cu “vong vo tam quoc” mai den khi het thoi gian ma van chua noi duoc van de cot loi cu tri quan tam. Cu tri het suc ngan ngam khi phai chung kien cai diep khuc lap di lap lai khong biet bao nhieu lan cua cac Bo truong. Bo truong nay noi “chung toi se tiep thu y kien va se trinh chinh phu giai quyet”, Bo truong khac cung noi “chung toi nhan thay khuyet diem va se sua chua”...
Trach nhiem chi co moi Bo truong ma noi la “chung toi”, cu y nhu bo truong muon loi ca bo vao ban hop. The nhung, nhung cai “tiep thu”, “nhan khuyet diem”, “se sua chua” hau nhu khong thay Bo truong nao thuc hien. Nhung cu tri thi cu dinh ninh rang nhung tam tu cua minh da den duoc tai Bo truong va xem nhung cai “se sua chua”, “tiep thu” do nhu mot “loi hua”.
Roi thoi gian troi qua, ky hop moi lai den nhung cu tri khong thay Bo truong thuc hien “loi hua” cua minh. Cu tri gian lam, muon lam ra le vi sao Bo truong da hua ma khong chiu thuc hien? Den khi co nguoi chuyen loi nhan cua cu tri den Bo truong thi Bo truong tra loi mot cach vo tu “chung toi co hua bao gio dau”. Ma da khong hua thi khong thuc hien va cung chang co trach nhiem gi ca!
Bo truong thi co nam bay cach giai bay, co chin muoi duong thao lui, chi thiet cho cu tri chan chat thuc bung nen ca tin vao nhung “loi hua” suong cua Bo truong truoc nghi truong de roi ngam ngui nhan ra “minh bi lua”. Bi nguoi khac lua thi duoc chu de Bo truong lua thi tuc lam. Bo truong la nguoi quan ly toi cao mot nganh, co quyen “ho mua hoan vu” nhung lai la cong boc cua dan. Bo truong tot la phai lo lang den ke an dan, lo cho dan nhu con cua minh (quan chi phu mau).
Quyen cua Bo truong thi to that nhung trach nhiem cung rat lon. Bo truong phai co trach nhiem ve nhung sai pham cua bo minh. Trach nhiem o day khong chi la trach nhiem ganh vac ma con la mot hanh dong co van hoa noi chung. The ma cu tri co thay Bo truong nao chiu trach nhiem that su dau.
Cac Bo truong noi den trach nhiem thi nhieu lam nhung thu hoi co may Bo truong phai chiu trach nhiem? Su co tau E2 nam 2004 o Lang Co (Hue) co lam Bo truong Bo Giao thong van tai nghi viec? Chi hang tram du an dang do theo kieu “nem tien qua cua so” co lam Bo truong bo Ke hoach dau tu tu chuc? Khong! Cac vi khong tu chuc ma con vung ngoi hon bao gio het. Nguoi dan co cam tuong la sau moi “su co” o moi bo la de cung co them dia vi cua Bo truong va lam cho bo ay them “noi tieng” vi duoc du luan chu y.
Du luan dat cau hoi la tai sao khong sa thai nhung Bo truong ben ngoai khoac lac ma trong bung khong mot chut vi dan? Phai chang ta thieu nguoi, thieu nang luc? Khong! Thieu nguoi thi khong. Thieu nang luc lai cang khong. Vay thi ha co gi chung ta giu lai nhung ke sau mot hai dan hai nuoc? Cu tri chung toi rat dau long truoc thuc trang dat nuoc lam an tri tre. Ay the ma co vi Bo truong noi chung ta se tien kip Thai Lan trong vong 20 nam toi. Chua chac dau! Nguoi ta co ngoi cho minh duoi kip nguoi ta, ma cu cach lam an kieu nay thi su tut hau con xa lam. Vi the ma dat nuoc can mot xung luc de phat trien thi Luat dau tu ra doi lai kim ham mot cach nang ne.
Chung ta quen lam theo kieu “vua da bong vua thoi coi” thi se co luc tren san chi con co ta da bong ma thoi. Ma la thay, da voi nguoi ngoai co thang co thua cung lay lam hanh dien chu nguoi trong nha da hoai voi nhau con vui noi gi? Van de se khong the noi dut neu cu noi ra mai the nay, vi the toi xin neu may kien nghi sau cung la hop tinh voi long cu tri ca nuoc ca.
1. Trong tra loi chat van, QH phai xem xet bo nao gay nhieu buc xuc o cu tri thi cho bo do duoc tra loi nhieu thoi gian hon. Cac bo co it buc xuc cua cu tri co the tra loi chat van it hon. QH phai quan tam de cac bo truong co nhieu van de tra loi chat van truoc. Truong hop y kien nhieu qua, co the keo dai ky hop mot thang ruoi so voi hien tai la mot thang.
2. Khong chap nhan Bo truong tra loi DB quoc hoi bang van ban. QH cho DB chat van truc tiep Bo truong cho den khi het y kien thi thoi.
3. QH qui dinh dau la “loi hua” va dau la loi “cua mieng” cua cac Bo truong de tien viec giam sat, xu ly.
4. QH ban hanh qui dinh khung phap ly che tai Bo truong khong thuc hien qua nua “loi hua” cua Bo truong.
5. Tuyen truyen muc dich, ly tuong phuc vu nhan dan vao hang ngu lanh dao cot can.
Cac vi Bo truong neu da noi thi phai lam
Voi nguoi dan, viec dinh nghia "The nao la loi hua cua Bo truong" khong quan trong. Dieu quan trong la cac vi Bo truong da noi gi va hanh dong gi de giai quyet nhung van de con ton tai, chu khong phai la nhung loi noi ay phai dap ung nhung tieu chuan nao de duoc liet vao hang loi hua bat buoc phai thuc hien.
Chang han Bo truong bo A noi: bo se co gang khac phuc van de X Y Z trong thoi gian toi. Ve hinh thuc, day co the khong phai la loi hua nhung neu qua mot thoi gian dai sau do van de khong duoc giai quyet, van con nhung buc xuc thi chac chan nguoi dan se mat long tin vao bo, vao dang. Hau qua cua loi noi cua nguoi lanh dao khong duoc thuc hien hoac thuc hien khong den noi den chon, lam nua voi chang he lien quan den nhung tieu chuan ve loi hua ban dau ca.
Mac khac, mot yeu cau rat quan trong cua hau het cu tri la cac Bo truong can tranh phat bieu chung chung, khong di vao trong tam cua cac van de. Doi hoi luc nao cung phai chi tiet, ro rang va co can cu. Neu dap ung duoc yeu cau nay thi chang can dua ra cac tieu chuan ma tu ban than moi loi noi nhu vay se tro thanh nhung loi hua. Xin duoc nhac lai cai dan can chinh la: xin cac vi Bo truong neu da noi thi phai lam.
Van de la y thuc trach nhiem
Da khong it lan cu tri thac mac ve viec nhieu thanh vien Chinh phu hua truoc Quoc hoi va cu tri ca nuoc se giai quyet cac van de Quoc hoi va cu tri yeu cau nhung da... that hua. Hy vong that nhieu o ky hop lan nay voi nhieu su doi moi cua Quoc hoi, nhat la viec xac dinh trach nhiem ca nhan cac thanh vien Chinh phu. The nhung, hy vong roi lai that vong.
Da co nhung vi "tu lenh" nhanh chong tim cach thoai thac trach nhiem cua minh va cua nganh bang cach ... "chiet tu". Theo loi ong Le Quang Binh, da co nhung bo truong cho rang, o ky hop truoc loi hua cua ho khong phai la... loi hua. The thi no la cai gi day? Cung theo loi ong Binh, khi tra loi truoc Quoc hoi, rat it bo truong noi ro rang "toi xin hua voi Quoc hoi..." ma pho bien cac bo truong chi noi "chung toi xin tiep thu va toi day se phoi hop voi..."hoac "chung toi xin tiep thu va toi day se bao cao Chinh phu de khac phuc".
Nhu vay qua bong trach nhiem da duoc chuyen sang chan Chinh phu. O day chung toi hieu rang, voi cach tra loi "pho bien" nhu tren, cac vi bo truong da rat chu dong ne tranh trach nhiem cua minh. Chac chan khong phai ngau nhien ma cac vi Bo truong khong "xin hua" truoc Quoc hoi va cu tri ca nuoc nhung viec can phai lam. Chinh vi vay, o cac lan tra loi chat van cua cac thanh vien Chinh phu, chu tich doan can chi ro trach nhiem cu the cua nhung nguoi dung dau cac nganh va yeu cau nhung vi do phai hua, cao hon la noi ro thoi gian thuc hien loi hua cua minh de Quoc hoi va cu tri giam sat.
Tu thuc te tren day, thiet nghi Quoc hoi can som trien khai viec bo phieu tin nhiem cac thanh vien Chinh phu. Viec nay se giup cho ho y thuc ro hon ve trach nhiem cua minh doi voi dat nuoc. Ban hanh nhung qui dinh ve viec thuc hien loi hua cua cac thanh vien Chinh phu la dieu can lam, tuy nhien, truoc het va rat quan trong, cac thanh vien Chinh phu phai nhan thuc duoc trach nhiem cua minh ma tu giac, chu dong thuc hien nhung van de ton tai cua nganh minh phu trach chu khong phai doi den khi Quoc hoi "truy hoi" hoac khi bi "tai hoi" thi cho rang minh khong hua.
Nha nuoc ta la nha nuoc cua dan, do dan va vi dan. Cac thanh vien Chinh phu phai la "cong boc", la "nguoi day to trung thanh cua nhan dan" nhu loi Bac day.

De tre co chieu cao ly tuong Tags: su dau tu, su tang truong, chieu cao, giai doan, truong thanh, day thi, dinh duong, thuc an, tre, tuoi, nam, den, nguoi
Do chieu cao cho tre o Trung tam Dinh duong TP.HCM. Anh: H.THUY
Theo bac si Dao Thi Yen Thuy, Trung tam Dinh duong TP.HCM, chieu cao chiu anh huong cua rat nhieu yeu to:
Tuoi nao chieu cao phat trien nhanh?
Co 3 giai doan quyet dinh ve chieu cao:
- Giai doan day thi: Tre gai 10-6 tuoi, tre trai 12-18 tuoi la thoi gian day thi.
Cach tinh chieu cao cua tre luc truong thanh
Phu huynh ai cung muon biet truoc chieu cao cua con cai minh khi truong thanh. Ngay nay, cac nha khoa hoc giup cac bac phu huynh lam dieu ay de dang. Chieu cao luc truong thanh cua tre thuong duoc cac nha chuyen mon du doan bang cac cong thuc sau:
An gi de tang chieu cao?
Protein (chat dam): Rat quan trong doi voi tre dang tang truong. La thanh phan men tieu hoa, noi tiet, khang the... Tre khong du protein se ngung tang truong, sut can, he tieu hoa kem, de mac benh, anh huong den tang chieu cao.
Lysin: La axit amin thiet yeu. De bi pha huy trong qua trinh che bien, nau nuong. Tre thieu lysin dan toi khong tong hop duoc protein gay gay, teo co, nhao co, bieng an. Thuc an nhieu lysin: thit, ca, trung, sua, cac loai dau, dau nanh.
Canxi: Giup xuong phat trien vung chac va tang chieu cao. Nhu cau canxi thay doi theo tuoi, trung binh tre 6 thang-18 tuoi can khoang 400-700 mg/ngay. Thuc an co nhieu canxi: sua, cua, oc, tom, tep, ca nguyen xuong, dau hu, cac loai rau.
Vitamin D: Giup hap thu canxi tot hon. Hon nua, vitamin D giup tang tong hop chat protein. Co the nhan mot it vitamin D tu thuc an (sua, bo, pho mai, trung, gan ga, dau gan ca thu...) va tien chat vitamin D nam duoi da. Tiep xuc anh nang truc tiep se giup da tong hop vitamin D voi thoi gian tu 15-30 phut/ngay.
Tien si - bac si Tran Thi Minh Hanh, Trung tam Dinh duong TP.HCM: 25 nam, cao them 2 cm
So lieu ve hang so sinh hoc nguoi VN nam 1975 cho thay nguoi truong thanh vao thoi diem nay da co chieu cao 160 cm doi voi nam va 150 cm doi voi nu. The nhung den nam 2000, nghia la khoang 25 nam sau, chieu cao trung binh cua nguoi VN truong thanh chi tang len khoang 2 cm, nghia la 162,3 cm (nam) va 152,3 (nu). So voi nguoi Nhat Ban truong thanh cung nhom tuoi thi nguoi VN thap hon khang 10 cm doi voi nam va 6 cm doi voi nu, trong khi truoc day nguoi Nhat van duoc coi la dan toc thap be. Chinh vi vay, da den luc chung ta nghi den van de lam the nao nang cao tam voc cua nguoi VN.
