Cong nghe lua dao - Tin Tong hop
Cong nghe lua dao
Tags: phuong tien thong tin, bang duong buu dien, thu dien tu, bi vach tran, lua dao, khoan tien, tai khoan, nhan vien, bi lua, truoc day, hien, nhan, chuyen, trieu, biet,
Biet lam sao duoc, tham tien va danh tieng la cho yeu bao doi cua nhan loai
Tuy nhien, moi khi the gioi co nhung bien co lon nhu song than, chien tranh, khung bo, chung lai ro len va trong hang ngan buc thu gui di chi it cung co mot hai nguoi bi mac lua.
Ngay truoc vi phan lon cac thu lua dao nay xuat phat tu Nigeria nen chung duoc goi la lua dao 419 kieu Nigeria (419 la dieu khoan Luat hinh su Nigeria lien quan den toi lua dao). Nguoi viet bai nay tung nhan vai chuc la thu noi dung dai khai noi rang nguoi viet thu la ke toan truong mot cong ty hay nhan vien mot ngan hang, co mot khoan tien may chuc trieu USD (thuong la so le) do mot co duyen nao do (thuong la tien do mot quan chuc tham o gui, nay bi tai nan mat dot ngot khong ai linh ra duoc).
Sau mot man dao dau bang loi van tieng Anh sai ngu phap, day loi chinh ta, tac gia buc thu se nho ban dung ra nhan giup, don gian chi bang cach cung cap cho ho ten va so tai khoan ngan hang. Doi lai, nguoi viet thu se hau ta mot khoan hoa hong chung 10-15%. Da so nguoi nhan thu khong de gi bi lua nhung cung co mot hai nguoi to mo muon thu tra loi xem sao. Ho lap luan co mat gi ma so, biet dau loc troi cho huong bon, nam trieu dola thi sao!
Sau khi cung cap thong tin, ban se lien tuc nhan tiep cac thu khac, khi thi bao tien da sap chuyen roi, khi thi yeu cau gui them giay co tieu de co quan… Cuoi cung se den la thu cho biet moi chuyen da xong, chi con thieu phi chuyen tien chi… 5.000 USD. Thu se thuc hoi ban gui khoan tien nho nhoi nay de huong tron khoan hoa hong may trieu kia. Neu ai dai tha moi hong bat bong, xem nhu cu lua dao da thanh cong.
Co rat nhieu bien the cua loai lua dao nay nhung tuu trung chung danh vao long tham cua con nguoi va tam ly “co mat gi dau ma so”. Den khi da say sua voi nhung khoan tien khong lo, dan qua sau vao cuoc choi, nhieu nguoi nhanh nhau gui nam, muoi ngan dola cho bon lua dao. Chac chung ta con nho vu tay dola nhuom den cung do may nguoi Nigeria vao thuc hien o TP.HCM may nam truoc. Mot bien the tho thien nhu vay ma cung lua duoc, ke cung la. Theo so lieu tren bao chi My, hang nam nguoi My bi lua khoang vai tram trieu dola cho cac la thu tren troi roi xuong nhu vay. Co nguon tin phong doan tren toan the gioi, moi nam nguoi dan khap noi bi lua chung 1 ti USD.
Voi Internet, thu lua dao cang co dieu kien de hoanh hanh. Tuy nhien, cung nho Internet, nguoi can than mot chut se tim ra thong tin vach tran cac dang lua dao qua thu. Vi du, neu ong Muoi chiu kho go vao cum tu “Major Fadi Bassem” vao trang Google, ong se thay buc thu lua dao cua nguoi tu xung la nhan vien Hang Seng Bank da bi vach mat tu lau tren rat nhieu trang web.
Sau chien tranh Iraq, hang loat thu tu xung la luat su cua mot quan chuc chinh quyen Iraq thoi Saddam Hussein, nho chuong trinh doi dau lay luong thuc, da “thu ven” mot khoan tien may chuc trieu USD giau o mot tai khoan bi mat. Nay quan chuc nay muon chuyen khoan tien ay di vi chinh quyen Iraq sap dieu tra den noi. Tay luat su muon muon tai khoan de trung chuyen va hua den bu bang khoan hoa hong vai trieu USD. Mot dang khac la thu cua vo mot quan chuc lo chuyen mua vu khi cho Iraq, co tai khoan rieng de tien giao dich va qua mat thanh tra quoc te. Nay chong thi chet, tien trong tai khoan chua kip tra nen muon nho nguoi hao hiep giup chuyen gium.
Mot bien the khac la thu gia danh mot linh My, cho biet tinh co phat hien noi cat 25 trieu USD cua Saddam Hussein va doan sau cung nhu dang thu Nigeria co dien. Loi dung noi dau cua cac ba me co con la linh My tu tran tai Iraq, bon lua dao con gia danh la nhan vien cac to chuc quoc te, co quen voi con ho tai Iraq. Khamliankhup – Gen. Secretary Zomi Council, Pu K. Guite – Adviser ZRO leh Pu K. Moi – Gen. Secretary ZEPADA GHQ te Delhi tuolpi ah hing lenglut uhi. Welcome Speech: Pu BL Shoute: Pu BL Shoute, Chairman ZEPADA DWG in lamkaite leh meeting hing peikhawmte vaidawnna tomkim in nei hi. A ma’n agenna ah Zomi sungah organisation tuom tuom um nanleh ZEPADA in initiative akilahna zieh gen hi. Hun kibichil ahiban ah ZEPADA in lamkaite ki thuopi tawntugn ahiman a initiative kilatou mai ahidan den hi. Lamkaite pulahna anei zaw in constructive interaction nei aki ut zieha tam meeting ki hankhawm ahidan zong gen hi. Lamkaite sacrifice ana bawl bang ua Delhi Zomite’n zong gam leh nam a dia pan theina mun teng a pang dia sacrifice bawl dinga mansa a um apoimaw dan gen in chouna zong bawl hi.
Tua zaw in Pu Thangzalun leh Upa Chinsum puina toh mipi’n We Shall Over Come Some Day chi kisa duup duup hi.
Speech: Pu LB Sona, Chairman Zomi Council: Zomi Council Chairman in a thu patna ah – Pastor te a mai akiguol dim diam amu zieh in biahna toh kisai vate lou hinanleh Pastor, Upa te’n pan alah uh pen siemmaw tan ding hilou in a bawl ding ua lawm bawl ahi uh chi’n gen hi. Pastor leh Upa te’n nampi vai asai biehna toh akikalna umlou ahiban ah Nampi dinga guolzawlna tuntu ahi dan uh gen masa hi.
Zomi Council ana kiphukhietna san ahileh unau kal a ki theilounate suh vengna ding a ana kiphutkhia ahidan gen a, akiphu chillai in tribe 4 – PTC, STC, VPC leh TCU mai hinanleh a nuo in UZO in hing zom a, tuochi’n MTC, TPO leh Kom Union in zom tou in, a nukhia pen ah Gangte Tribe Council hi in gen hi.
Zomi Council toh kisai a genbe jelna ah nam khat mai lunglutna toh na kisem hilou in nam 8 tah toh lung kituoh a nna kisem ahidan zong gen hi. Tam nam 8 te apat delegate 5 chiet Zomi Council sunga vaihawm a toukhawm ahi ban uah, mi tam zieh a member/delegate tam tuom hilou, tam leh tawm in thu pawlou aki bang a ki pang chiet ahi chi hi.
Zomi Council nna sepkhiet tamlou agenna ah Lamka buoi lai in Govt of India apat rehabilitation fund Rs. 4.60 lakhs bang ki kaidoh thei chi hi. Tuaban ah Peace Accord neina ding in asuh a tungah ki dieng le ahiman in Oct. 1, 1998 in I gam ah lemna tung thei hi chi hi. June 5, 1995 ni a Pu Chidambaram in Moreh Trade ahonna ah zong Zomi lamkaite va diang suh ua, tuamun ah Behiang Trade Centre bawlna ding toh kisai a zong memo vakhia uh hi’n gen hi. Memo aki khiet ni apat Manipur govt in nasatah a hing na dou dal ahi man in masawn theilou in um a, hinanleh tuni chiengin No Objection chi tan chieng tung thei ta hi chi’n gen hi.
Zomi Council pen lemna dei ahi dungjui in tangvalte kal hi in gan leh nam toh kisai apoimaw bang jel in singpi bel khai a dieng le zing ahidan uh zong gen. Tripartite Talk um theina dinga Delhi bang ZC lamkaite’n hing pha mun mama ahidan uh atalat ban ah, a ma mimal nna toh kisai a Delhi khatvei zong tu nai a tuon lou, hinanleh pawlpi thu toh kisai a tung deu zing ahidan zong Chairman in gen hi.
Political Autonomy not below UT chi 2005 a Memo ana khe ngeita uh ahidan gen. Tuapen Pu Gandhi method non violence zanga deljui tou peh hinanleh Manipur din mun et in strategy khel ngai chi’n tua ang peisan uh gen hi. Tutung a aki mupi uh Union Minister te kungah Delhi level in Expert Group hing hing bawlsah un chi’a ngetna bawl uh ahidan zong gen hi.
A thu khupsitna dingin Delhi a lamkaite zieh a Inlam lamkaite mun poimaw tah tah a lutthei ka hi uh chi in, pan theina chiet a pang dingin hanthawn thu toh a thugen jou hi.
Speech: Pu L. Khamliankhup, Gen. Secy. Zomi Council: Tuni’n ZC ah tribe 9 i um ua, a danger mama khat a um hi. Tunia bang ding a Kuki nomenclature collapse e? Zomi I ki chi chiet nai nai ua, tribe recognition ah I um uhi. Ni danglai Kuki a I um lai un, siki Kuki, makhai Kuki chi ana um sah zieh ua Kuki collapse ahi chi’n gen hi. Tuni’n Zomi sungah Tribe 9 a um, hinanleh equality and mutual respect I mansuo ni ni chieng un Zomi zong collapse thei ding hi. Tunia tribe 9te tua I pei bang a I pei uleh I hat ding ua, hinanleh unequality a um nini pen I hat sih ding uhi. Tam unity um pen a siet le zong a thuo ding ei teng, a hoi le zong a jal joutu ding te I hi. Memtality ill treatment ki chi I society sunga a um lou ding ahi.
Zomi te I lawchinna dingua poimaw pen ahileh Pasian I buon ngai ahi. Na Zomi Leader te’n mipite backup pen poimaw zing kahi man un, lawchinna ding toh kisai mipite mawpuohna ah ki nga thupi mama hi. Chitahna leh kukalna um lou in lawchinna um khollou hi. Tunia nam 9 kigawm khawmte I lawchinna ding un unity chipen i mansuo lou ding uh ahi.
Speech: Pu K. Guite, Adviser ZRO
1940 chilai vel in Zomi kilawikhawmna Zomi American Baptish Falam ah a zang ua, political term in zang sih ma uleh zong Zomi ihi chi ana puong uhi, tuaban ah Pu T Gougin leh Pu Thangkhangin ten Zomi min hng phawnghal kia ua, hinanleh hing sip ding deng jel ahiman in tua hun sungin Zomi min hing ke ngiem hileh kilawm hi. Hinanleh 1993 in ZRO chi kipan kia hi. Vangsiet huai tah in Christian level in Zomi min in I ki gawm thei kei ua, vangtah huai mama hi. Tua mabangin ZNC hing kipan kia in grass root level ah ahu hat mama in hing kipan kia hi. Lamka a root neijou lou ahiman in ZNC pen Thanlon lah vel a ki pansan ua, Lamka a root nei joulou ahi dungjui in hing dai suh kia hi. A hat semna ding deina toh tribe level in hing kibawl kia hi. Mimal in ZRO support lou bangin ana um taleh chin mimal a bawl khiel nahi. Tribe member teng in sasin salung ne a membership lah ahiman in nang zong tel kha nahi.
ZRO kipat tungin Pu Gougin lawi in ZNC ma zangtou mai un chin hing gen kha ngei uhi. Hinanleh a min daai sa chi ngaidan a um zia in ZRO chi’n ana ki phuon hi. Hing pei hoi tou jel, hinanleh pei hoi bang napi’n, Manipur political situation ahoilou zieh in ut leh utlou in thau tawi hing ngaita hi. Thau tellou a ngal apat Delhi attention ki draw joulou ding ahi chi philosophy ki nei hi. Democratic movement ana kibawlsa te kha pressure group consistency um thei lou ahizieh in Centre attention ngah na ding a poimaw thau ma hi a aki mu zieh in thau hing kitawi hi. Ana tawi masa ten suh chimit sawm ahi ahizieh un 1997 in buoina tung hi.
Ut leh dah a hamham in contribution neuchik le neilou I lah a um tam mama nalai ahihman in pilvan huai mama kasa hi. PLA leh Army te kal ah tehtua in a ki um a, I taina lam lam a hing kiman ding chi ahita man in akin thei pen a SoO I zong kei leh hi thei nawnlou chi ahizieh in kum 2002 apat pan kila hi. SoO suoi hing kikai a, mi tamtak in I thei siem kei ua, himanleh a hih ten ka thei siem mahmah uhi.
Govt in SoO I bawl chiengin dei khat nei uh ahi chi ang thei ta ua, tua te zong dei nei a um ahi uh chi theihna nei ta uhi. Tutan chieng a I lawchinna apat et in India in Zomi te recognition hing neita uhi. Bang ziek a thautawi I chi leh Zomi te political survival na di’a I bawl uh ahiman in tu chiengin Charter of Demand hing submit un chi ki hi ta hi.
SoO bawl lai in Mnp integrity suke lou ding, India dan nuai a um ding chi ahilai in mi tamtah in bawl khiel hing sa uhi, hinanleh hihkhiel bangma um lou hi.
ZRO in sum ki dong khe teng teng 100 lah a 99 kha Zomi te a pat mah ahi man in Zomi te hin theina ding bang ahei khat I bawl uh poimaw ahi kachi pen lamkai te’n a’ng pompi thei vanglah uhi.
Bangtan hiam khat I sacrifise kei leh Manipur leh India solkal ki lungkim sah jou lou ding chi ahiman in, sacrifice bawl lei I mu dingte toh koi lienzaw chite tanpha kim ditdet a ki ngaisun ahi.
Zomi Council tungtawn in ZRO dei leh tup hing ki express out ahi. Autonomous Tribal State pen nget phot ding chi ahi. Tam thu toh kisai a sim thei teng leh a giel thei teng in guntah in ana sui jui thei leh uchin ahoi ding.
ZRO nasepna apulang a na muh dan hoikei mah leh a sunglam ah pen hoi deu a pei ding deng ahi. Tu masang pen Manipur singtangmite dinmun et in tom chik ki sip ding deng hi, tuahun sungin mipite apat gen leh sah tam mama hi. Lung himawh pah kei leng, atawpna ah tua I buoipi pen in hon gawm tham na ding ahi. Manipur context ah ei maimai a hi thei nailou ding ahi chi thei ahiman in common platform nei poimaw kisa a, ei ngaidan mi tampin ang theipi ta uhi.
Zomi sungah, 100% Zomi ki um nailou mai thei, 100% Zomi hita leng ki lawching dingin ka gingta. Sapte’n Silence is Golden achi dan un na sepzaw lou leh zong moral support ana pia inla, ana sip ding deng lechin na sem anahi dia. Zomi itna ziah a lamkaite gen sia sia chi bang I um ua, tua bang I bawl kha leh ki ngaituah huai mama hi. Zomi ka it ngal leh bang ahia ka pan theina chi ki ngaitua hoi zaw ding hi.
ZRO in local politics mai hilou international politics zong ki sai tham ahi.
Sum leh pai dong toh kisai a phun, SoO hita bang ziek a sum dong nalai chia tuatan chiang ngaitua thei chang chang officer ihileh I kingaitua uh ngai in teh. INTERACTION Dohna: Bang ziak a Zomi Political Autonomy akipat a Autonomous Tribal State chi ahi a, anihna ah bang ziak a I nomenclature ki loukha nawn lou?

Tags: nguoi dan ong, khong phai la, cuoc hon nhan, say nang, ban than, phu nu, mot nguoi, tinh cam, rung dong, minh, chong, dieu, con, yeu,
Da bao gio ban roi vao hoan canh co chong roi nhung van say nang hay rung dong truoc mot nguoi dan ong khac trong khi ban than van rat yeu chong. Day khong phai la dieu hiem gap, rat nhieu phu nu deu thua nhan minh da tung rung dong hay say nang mot anh chang khac ngoai chong.
Phu nu roi vao con “say nang” thuong mang cam giac mac cam va toi loi - Anh: minh hoa.
Phu nu roi vao con “say nang” thuong mang cam giac mac cam va toi loi, va su thuc loi cung mot phan do ho da tao co hoi cho nguoi dan ong khac chen vao hanh phuc gia dinh minh.
Theo cac chuyen gia tam ly, vao khoang 7 - 10 nam sau ket hon, cac cuoc hon nhan thuong co dau hieu nguoi dan thanh thoi quen. Day cung la luc nguoi phu nu khong can danh thoi gian qua nhieu cham soc con nho, co thoi gian cham chut cho ban than nhieu hon thi cung la khoang thoi gian de xay ra “khung hoang hon nhan” nhat.
Luc nay phu nu rat de gap phai nhung con “say nang” neu ban than khong du tinh tao va sang suot.
Cac chuyen gia tam ly cho rang, khi cam thay yeu duong, nho nhung mot nguoi dan ong ngoai chong minh, do la “ngoai tinh tu tuong”. Va tu “ngoai tinh tu tuong” dan toi “ngoai tinh thuc te” la soi chi rat mong manh, nhat la khi nguoi dan ong do cung co cam xuc nam nu voi ban.
Vay nen phu nu can cham dut dieu do ngay trong tu tuong cua minh cang som cang tot bang nhung hanh dong sau:
Dap tat su lung linh tu tao
Thuong thi ly do de ban bi “say nang” chinh la ban cam thay nguoi ay co ve gi do thu hut hon so voi nguoi chong hien tai cua ban. Ho co ve gi do khien ban muon chinh phuc, muon gui gam con tim. Ban thich thu va cam men truoc nhung tinh cach cua nguoi ay, trong khi chong ban khong he co dieu do.
Chua tiep xuc nhieu nen ban se cam thay hao huc va mong cho. Nhung hay tin la mot thoi gian sau, ban se cam thay nguoi ay chang co ve gi thu vi nhu ban tuong, tham chi con nham chan va khien ban that vong.
Vi sao u? Do la do ban da qua ky vong vao hinh tuong do chinh ban ve ra, trong khi han ta chang dac sac nhu ban nghi. Do vay, khi say nang, hay co muong tuong va chiu kho phan tich, ban se thay nguoi ay khong bang mot goc chong cua minh, hay co gang tim kiem nhung nhuoc diem cua nguoi do, cang nhieu cang tot.
Pha tan su nham lan cam xuc
Su say nang co lien quan mat thiet den su lang man. Thuong thi nhung khoanh khac nhe nhang va co phan diu ngot thuong khien dau oc ban mu mi di va tim cung dap nhanh hon. Dieu nay khong the co doi voi nguoi chong vi ca hai da qua quen nhau.
Ban thich ngoai hinh, anh mat, giong noi, tai le, su am hieu, hay bat ky mot tinh tinh nao khac cua nguoi ay… Do khong phai tinh yeu. Do la su nguong mo. Va ban biet day, se den mot luc nao do ban chan tat ca nhung dieu ban da tung thich, chi vi ban cam thay no khong con thu vi.
Thay vi ton sung nguoi ma ban dang say nang, hay co chung to truoc mat ho rang ban co cai toi lon hon va niem kieu hanh cung lon hon. Dieu nay se khien doi tuong se “lui mot buoc” sao cho hoa hop voi cach tro chuyen voi ban va tu do ban cung se thay rang ho khong con khien ban bi say nang nua, boi ho nhat nhoa trong mat ban dan.
Nghi toi nhung diem xau cua ho
Trong chung ta khong mot ai co the hoan hao 100% ca. Chung ta deu co nhung yeu diem cua ban than, ke ca nguoi ban dang yeu "chet me chet met". Chinh vi vay de tranh nhung con "say nang" khong dang co thi cach tot nhat do la ban nen nghi den nhung khuyet diem cua ho.
Voi cach nay tuy hoi tieu cuc nhung no co the giup ban vo cung huu hieu. Ban chi nen nghi den nhung khuyet diem nho thoi va khong nen lam xau ho truoc mat nguoi khac.
Cat dut lien lac
Nen cat dut toan bo lien lac voi doi tuong kia cang som cang tot. Anh ta co tim ra ban hay khong do la viec cua anh ta, con viec ban co “tiep tay” cho anh ta hay khong lai hoan toan o ban.
Neu anh ta cung la nguoi da co gia dinh, thi viec anh ta vua muon co gia dinh, vua muon co tinh yeu ngoai thi ban than anh ta la nguoi kem tu trong, khong dang hoang. Tai sao minh phai vao hua de lam nguoi tinh cua mot nguoi khong dung dan chu? Mot nguoi dan ong neu that su tran trong ban thi se khong xen vao cuoc song cua ban va lam cho ban kho xu nhu vay.
Can nhac hau qua
Dung truoc cam xuc say nang hay yeu long voi doi tuong khong phai chong minh, ban nen can nhac den hau qua cua van de. Neu minh tien sau vao thu tinh cam ay, minh se co duoc nhung gi va se mat di nhung gi.
Chay theo thu tinh cam thoang qua de duoc song voi nhung cam xuc cua ban than minh, de co mot cuoc tinh vung trom khong co tuong lai voi doi phuong. Va cung dong nghia voi viec ban se mat di hanh phuc minh dang co, mat di mot nguoi chong, tan vo cuoc hon nhan hien tai. Lieu co dang de danh doi?
Thu tinh cam thoang qua ay, lieu co the keo dai den bao lau, cam xuc cua ban voi nguoi dan ong kia co the duy tri den bao gio, ban co nghi sau nguoi dan ong do ban se lai say nang va rung dong truoc mot nguoi dan ong khac.
Neu the ban cu chay theo cam xuc cua ban than mai sao? Lieu viec chieu chuong ban than chay theo nhung thu tinh cam nhat thoi ay co nen khong. Ban se duoc gi sau tat ca hay chi con lai mot tam hon khong on dinh, mot trai tim khong the kiem soat va rat co the ban se roi vao trang thai bao hoa tinh cam.
Tat ca nhung dieu do co dang de danh doi, co dang de ban vut bo di cuoc hon nhan hanh phuc dang co.
Luon nhac nho ban than, gia dinh la tren het
Hay luon nhac nho ban than gia dinh la tren het, gia dinh la so 1 se giup ban tranh khoi nhung con say nang va ham muon don nhan mot thu tinh cam moi me day cam do voi nguoi dan ong khac. Khi ban y thuc va luon nhan thuc duoc tam quan trong cua gia dinh, ban se tu biet ban than minh nen dung lai o dau.
Ban se hieu thu tinh cam ban dang rung dong chi la thu tinh cam thoang qua, no khong mang lai dieu gi tot dep, no chi khien cuoc song cua ban bi dao lon va pha vo nhung dieu y nghia ban da vun dap va gin giu bay lau nay.
Danh thoi gian nhieu hon cho con cai
Mot nguoi phu nu khi say nang co the khong con cam giac thiet tha voi chong nhung voi con thi lai khong nhu the. Voi phu nu, con cai chinh la dieu quan trong nhat doi voi ho. Vi vay hay danh nhieu thoi gian o ben cac con hon.
Khi noi chuyen va day do cac con hay nhin thang vao mat con, dieu nay co y nghia rat nhieu vi ban se cam thay moi thu phu du ben ngoai khong the sanh duoc voi cuoc song binh yen ma minh dang co.
Ban se khong the day con ve long trung thuc neu ban than dang doi tra. Ban cung se khong muon con minh lon len bi lua doi boi chinh nguoi ban doi cua minh, phai vay khong?
Tim kiem nhung niem vui khac
Hay tu tim cho minh mot niem vui, hoac khoi phuc mot so thich ma ban co tu thoi con son roi. Thong thuong phu nu sau giai doan nuoi con nho va co gang xay dung to am thi quen mat ban than.
Khi khoi phuc lai so thich cua minh, ban se thay ban than vui ve hon, thay cuoc song cong bang hon, khong con nham chan toan trach nhiem nua, vi vay ban se co it thoi gian ranh ma nghi den doi tuong kia.
Hen ho rieng voi chong
Hay co nhung buoi ho hen rieng voi chong, hay tap nhin thang vao mat chong va noi voi anh ve nhung chuyen ben ngoai con cai, com ao gao tien. Hay nghi rang neu ban co the cho nguoi ngoai nhung co hoi lam dieu do thi tai sao khong the cho chong ban co hoi, anh ay la nguoi da o ben va cung ban vuot qua bao nhieu kho khan co ma.
Hay nghi den nhung luc ban than om dau, luc xau xi cau gat, anh ay la nguoi ben ban chu chang phai ai khac. Hay tran trong nhung dieu do thay vi dua ra nhung yeu cau ve nguoi yeu ly tuong va lang man. Hon nhan khong the vuot qua nhung yeu cau khat khe nhu vay khi mot trong hai nguoi khong toan tam toan y.

Ong Duc, nha o quan 6, dang len mot can nha ba tam. Vua dip may, sang thu bay vao Metro quan 6 ong gap chuong trinh ban dai ha gia hang ton kho. Co ca may chuc mat hang, tu ao quan, hang gia dung, dien lanh, dien may, den thiet bi dien cac loai... Can cu vao bang gia truoc va sau khi ha gia, qua la co nhieu mat hang re that. Cu the nhu mot chiec lo nuong gia tu hon 200.000 dong nay chi con 100.000 dong, mot chiec may lanh hieu Tobo gia tu hon 5 trieu dong nay chi con hon 3 trieu dong...
Canh bao hang ton kho
The nhung, kem theo do la mot tam bang canh bao: Hang ton kho ban giam gia, khong duoc doi, tra lai, de nghi khach hang chon lua ky truoc khi mua.
Ong Duc chu y den may mat hang cong tac, cau dao dien, o cam cac loai. Sau khi goi dien ve nha hoi y kien nha thau, ong ""hot"" mot luc gan mot phan ba chiec xe day cac loai thiet bi dien ve trang bi cho ngoi nha dang xay cua minh. Ve mat hon ho, ong cho biet: Gia re hon khoang 50%.
Trong thuc te, khong phai luc nao, mat hang nao ban o Metro cung re hon so voi gia thi truong. Cu the nhu hom chu nhat vua qua, ong Thuan, chu mot xuong moc o Binh Chanh, nghe noi hang Metro re va phong phu hon ben ngoai nhieu, nen ong di ""ke"" mot nguoi ban co the hoi vien vao day de tim mua may mon do nghe.
Di suot mot buoi sang, khi ve, ong mang ve duoc mot chiec may cua tay hieu Boss va mot chiec khoan Dai Loan, nhung khong phai mua o Metro ma la mua o mot cua hang tren duong Trinh Hoai Duc, gan cho Kim Bien. Ong Thuan cho biet: Gia nhieu loai dung cu cam tay o Metro mac hon ben ngoai. Nhu chiec cua tay nay (loai co the dung de cat da) o Metro ban 1.340.000 dong, nhung o cua hang Kim Minh (nha phan phoi cua Boss) ban chi l.280.000 dong, lai duoc tang them mot chai dau xit gi set.
Khi duoc hoi, co hay dung the hoi vien de vao Metro mua hang ve kinh doanh, ong chu cua hieu Kim Minh cho biet: ""Khong he, toi chi vao de mua may loai thuc pham ve nha xai con hang cua ho ban cao gia hon toi thi toi mua lam gi"".
Kinh nghiem mua hang re
Theo nhan xet cua ba Tien, chu mot cua hang tap hoa tren duong Luy Ban Bich thi hien nay gia nhieu loai hang hoa ban ra o Metro van chua re hon gia ma ba lay moi truc tiep tu nha cung cap, cac moi si Cho Lon, cho Kim Bien...; ma chi re hon gia ban le ben ngoai nen Metro chi thu hut nhung nguoi co the hoi vien vao mua sam cho nhu cau gia dinh, co quan. Voi nhung doi tuong nhu ba thi the Metro chua giup ich gi nhieu cho nhu cau kinh doanh cua ba. Hon nua, mua hang o Metro lai phai tra tien lien chu khong the goi dau nhu mua hang tu cac nguon khac nen ba cung khong may man ma.
Nhung nhung nguoi co kinh nghiem mua hang o Metro cho biet: Phan lon nhung mat hang co the mua di ban lai duoc la cac mat hang ""nong" dang trong chuong trinh khuyen mai, duoc in o to Metro post. Nhung muon mua hang gia re hon nha cung cap, phan phoi ve ban lai, phai co kinh nghiem. Khong co kinh nghiem thi du co the hoi vien, co Metro post thuong xuyen cung khong an thua gi.
Anh Son, ban hang dien gia dung tai cho Ben Thanh, cho biet: Anh cung duoc cung cap Metro post thuong xuyen, nhung chua khi nao anh gap duoc hang re de mua ve ban.
Chi Kim Vui, chu mot sap banh keo tai cho Binh Tay, cho rang, ""canh me"" de co the mua duoc hang re ve ban la khong de. Co nhieu lan chi thay o to Metro post co may mat hang banh keo khuyen mai gia re hon khi lay moi ben ngoai. Nhung chay toi thi het hang?
Thuc ra, chuyen khong co gi kho khan. Theo chi L., cung la chu sap ban banh keo tai cho Binh Tay, ke: ""Cach day may thang, mot nguoi den gioi thieu la nhan vien cua Metro, xin so dien thoai cua chi roi hua, khi nao co hang re len quay, se goi dien bao cho chi biet"". Doi lai cu moi lan mua duoc hang re, chi boi duong cho anh ta mot it tien, khoang vai chuc ngan dong.
Cung bang cach nay, cach day gan mot thang, chi H., ban my pham o cho Kim Bien, ""hot"" duoc lo hang gan ca tram thung xa bong Dove, trong dot hang ""nong" khuyen mai ban mot thung tang kem mot may chup hinh: Chi cho biet. ""Mua mot thung chi co 99.000 dong khong can mang ve toi sap, chi can mang ra cong Metro ban cung da loi moi thung gan 20.000 dong.
Mot nhan vien ban hang trong Metro cho biet, viec nha ban le co duoc thong tin som de co khi vao ""hot"" nguyen ca lo hang khuyen mai la chuyen binh thuong. Boi vi mua lau thanh quen, ho co duoc moi lien he voi mot so nhan vien trong kho, khi co hang ""nong" la thong tin ngay. Vi vay nhieu khi chung toi buoc phai gioi han so luong mua. Cu the nhu dot xa bong Dove vua qua, khi thay co nhieu nguoi mua so luong lon, chung toi buoc phai thong bao la moi nguoi chi duoc mua toi da la 5 thung.

Dong tai nghe khong day AirPods cua Apple, dac biet la mau AirPods Pro co kha nhieu dieu thu vi de chung ta kham pha. AirPods co nhung thao tac dieu khien truc tiep tren tai nghe giup cho qua trinh su dung tro nen thuan tien va chuyen nghiep hon.
AirPods Pro se co gia cao hon AirPods thuong (AirPods 2) mot chut voi thiet ke in-ear dan am thanh vao sau trong ong tai nguoi dung hon, cach ly am thanh ben ngoai, thay vi kieu earbuds chi bam trong vanh tai. Va tat nhien AirPods Pro cung co nhieu thao tac dieu khien hon.
Luu y ben canh thao tac dieu khien truc tiep tren tai nghe thi nguoi dung con co the dieu chinh tren iPhone khi da ket noi. Nhung ben duoi day la phan tong hop nhung thao tac dieu khien truc tiep tren AirPods.

Khai mac Dai hoi Dang toan quoc lan thu XI
Khai mac Dai hoi Dang toan quoc lan thu XI Tags: Viet Nam, Quang Tung, Nguyen Minh Triet, Ha Noi, Nguyen Tan Dung, Truong Tan Sang, chien luoc phat trien kinh te, Trung tam Hoi nghi Quoc gia, ban chap hanh trung uong, dai hoi dai bieu, xa hoi chu nghia, xay dung dat nuoc, bo chinh tri, ban bi thu, duoc tang cuong, khai mac, xi
– Sang 12/1, Dai hoi Dai bieu toan quoc lan thu XI cua Dang chinh thuc khai mac tai Trung tam Hoi nghi Quoc gia My Dinh, Ha Noi voi 1.377 Dai bieu. Dong chi Nguyen Tan Dung - Uy vien Bo Chinh tri, Thu tuong Chinh phu dieu hanh phien khai mac Dai hoi.
Theo chuong trinh, trong thoi gian tu 12/1 den 19/1, Dai hoi se thao luan va thong qua Cuong linh xay dung dat nuoc trong thoi ky qua do len chu nghia xa hoi (bo sung, phat trien nam 2011); Chien luoc phat trien kinh te xa hoi giai doan 2011-2020; Bao cao Chinh tri cua Ban chap hanh Trung uong khoa X; Bao cao tong ket viec thi hanh Dieu le Dang va de xuat bo sung, sua doi Dieu le Dang.
Dong chi Nguyen Minh Triet - Uy vien Bo Chinh tri, Chu tich nuoc tuyen bo khai mac Dai hoi (Anh: Quang Tung).
Dai hoi se bau Ban chap hanh Trung uong du kien khoang 200 nguoi, trong do co 175 uy vien chinh thuc va 25 uy vien du khuyet. Ket qua bau Bo Chinh tri, Tong bi thu, Ban bi thu, Uy ban Kiem tra trung uong se duoc cong bo sang 19/1.
Phat bieu khai mac Dai hoi, Chu tich nuoc Nguyen Minh Triet neu ro, "Khi dat nuoc, dan toc va Dang ta buoc vao thap nien thu 2 cua the ky XXI voi nhieu co hoi lon va thach thuc moi, Dai hoi dai bieu toan quoc lan thu XI cua Dang Cong san Viet Nam khai mac trong the tai Ha Noi - Thu do van hien va Anh hung vua ky niem 1000 nam tuoi".
Dong chi Nguyen Minh Triet nhan manh, Dai hoi Dai bieu toan quoc lan thu XI cua Dang dien ra trong mot thoi diem co y nghia rat quan trong. Su nghiep doi moi toan dien dat nuoc da trai qua 25 nam. Cuong linh xay dung dat nuoc trong thoi ky qua do len chu nghia xa hoi da duoc thuc hien 20 nam.
Dong chi Nong Duc Manh - TBT Ban chap hanh Trung uong Dang CS Viet Nam doc bao cao tai Dai hoi (Anh: Quang Tung).
5 nam qua (2006-2010) trong boi canh tinh hinh quoc te va trong nuoc co nhieu kho khan, thach thuc gay gat, dac biet la anh huong bat loi cua cuoc khung hoang tai chinh, suy thoai kinh te toan cau, toan Dang, toan dan ta da no luc phan dau dat duoc nhung thanh tuu quan trong, dang tu hao.
Ket qua trong 5 nam thuc hien nghi quyet Dai hoi X da gop phan quan trong vao viec thuc hien thang loi Chien luoc phat trien kinh te - xa hoi 10 nam (2001-2010) va 20 nam thuc hien Cuong linh xay dung dat nuoc trong thoi ky qua do len chu nghia xa hoi.
Trong 25 nam doi moi, Dang ta da khong ngung mo rong va tang cuong quan he voi cac dang cong san va cong nhan, dang canh ta, dang cam quyen va cac dang khac o 115 nuoc khap cac chau luc tren the gioi. Den nay, Dai hoi da nhan duoc 121 dien mung tu 103 dang va 14 to chuc cua 69 nuoc tren the gioi, bao gom tu cac dang cong san cam quyen va dang cam quyen o cac nuoc lang gieng va cac nuoc ban be truyen thong; tu cac nuoc chau A va Chau Dai Duong; tu cac nuoc chau Au; tu cac nuoc chau My; tu cac nuoc Trung Dong - chau Phi va cac to chuc tren the gioi...
Nhung thanh tuu dat duoc trong 20 nam qua la to lon va co y nghia lich su.
Chung ta da thuc hien thanh cong chang duong dau cua cong cuoc doi moi, dua dat nuoc ra khoi tinh trang kem phat trien, bo mat dat nuoc va doi song nhan dan co nhieu thay doi tich cuc, suc manh quoc gia ve moi mat duoc tang cuong, doc lap, tu chu va che do xa hoi chu nghia duoc giu vung, vi the va uy tin cua Viet Nam tren truong quoc te duoc nang cao, tao tien de de nuoc ta tiep tuc phat trien manh me va ben vung hon trong giai doan moi. Tuy nhien, nuoc ta van dang dung truoc nhieu thach thuc lon, dan xen nhau va dien bien phuc tap, khong the xem thuong.
"Trong nhung nam toi, tinh hinh quoc te se tiep tuc co nhieu dien bien nhanh chong, phuc tap va kho luong voi nhung tac dong to lon va sau rong vua tao ra thoi co, vua dat ra nhung thach thuc ngay cang gay gat doi voi tat ca cac quoc gia, nhat la cac nuoc cham phat trien, hoac dang phat trien, trong do co Viet Nam cua chung ta" - Dong chi Nguyen Minh Triet noi.
Trong boi canh do, Dai hoi Dai bieu toan quoc lan thuc XI cua Dang co trach nhiem lich su to lon truoc toan dan toc. Chung ta can nhin thang vao su that, noi dung su that, de cao tinh than tu phe binh nghiem tuc, de kiem diem, danh gia khach quan, toan dien nhung thanh tuu va yeu kem, khuyet diem, dong thoi rut ra nhung bai hoc kinh nghiem qua viec thuc hien nghi quyet Dai hoi X cua Dang, thuc hien nhiem vu phat trien kinh te xa hoi 5 nam (2006-2010), tong ket chien luoc phat trien kinh te - xa hoi 10 nam (2001-2010) va 20 nam thuc hien Cuong linh xay dung dat nuoc trong thoi ky qua do len chu nghia xa hoi.
Tren co so do, Dai hoi quyet dinh viec bo sung, phat trien Cuong linh nam 1991; xac dinh Chien luoc phat trien kinh te xa hoi 10 nam (2011-2020); de ra phuong huong, muc tieu, nhiem vu 5 nam (2011-2015).
Ve xay dung Dang, Dai hoi co trong trach kiem diem sau sac, toan dien cong tac xay dung Dang va su lanh dao cua Ban chap hanh Trung uong Dang khoa X, xac dinh phuong huong, nhiem vu xay dung Dang trong thoi ly moi; bo sung mot so diem trong Dieu le Dang; bau BCH Trung uong Dang khoa XI gom nhung dong chi thuc su tieu bieu ve pham chat chinh tri, dao duc cach mang, nang luc lanh dao, ban linh va tri tue du suc dap ung yeu cau ngay cang cao cua su nghiep doi moi, du suc lanh dao toan Dang, toan dan, hoan thanh nhung nhiem vu to lon, nang ne trong nhung nam toi.
"Chung ta nguyen lam het suc minh, phat huy cao do tri tue, y thuc trach nhiem va su doan ket, thong nhat cao de hoan thanh tot nhat nhung nhiem vu cua Dai hoi" - Dong chi Nguyen Minh Triet ket luan.
Sau phat bieu khai mac Dai hoi cua dong chi Nguyen Minh Triet, dong chi Nong Duc Manh doc bao cao cua Ban Chap hanh Trung uong Dang khoa X ve cac van kien Dai hoi XI cua Dang: “Nam nam qua, thuc hien Nghi quyet Dai hoi X cua Dang, toan Dang, toan dan ta da no luc phan dau vuot qua kho khan, thach thuc, dat duoc nhung thanh tuu quan trong trong viec thuc hien cac muc tieu, nhiem vu Dai hoi X de ra. Nen kinh te cua chung ta, co ban giu vung on dinh kinh te vi mo, duy tri toc do tang truong kha, cac nganh deu co nhung buoc phat trien, tiem luc va quy mo nen kinh te tang len; giao duc va dao tao, khoa hoc cong nghe, van hoa va cac linh vuc xa hoi co tien bo; bao ve tai nguyen, moi truong duoc chu trong hon; doi song cac tang lop nhan dan duoc cai thien; chinh tri - xa hoi on dinh; quoc phong, an ninh duoc tang cuong; doc lap chu quyen, thong nhat, toan ven lanh tho duoc giu vung; hoat dong doi ngoai, hoi nhap quoc te duoc mo rong, vi the, uy tin quoc te cua nuoc ta duoc nang cao; phat huy dan chu co tien bo, khoi dai doan ket dan toc duoc cung co; xay dung Nha nuoc phap quyen xa hoi chu nghia duoc day manh, hieu luc, hieu qua hoat dong duoc nang len; cong tac xay dung, chinh don Dang duoc tang cuong, dat mot so ket qua tich cuc. Cuoc van dong “Hoc tap va lam theo tam guong dao duc Ho Chi Minh” dat duoc mot so ket qua buoc dau. Da so can bo, dang vien va nhan dan phan khoi, tin tuong vao Dang, Nha nuoc, vao cong cuoc doi moi va trien vong phat trien cua dat nuoc”.
Dong chi Truong Tan Sang - Uy vien Bo Chinh tri, Thuong truc Ban Bi thu doc bao cao tai Dai hoi (Anh: Quang Tung).
Muoi nam thuc hien Chien luoc phat trien kinh te - xa hoi 2001 – 2010, chung ta da dat duoc nhung thanh tuu to lon, rat quan trong, nhieu muc tieu chu yeu cua Chien luoc 2001 – 2010 da duoc thuc hien. Kinh te tang truong nhanh, dat toc do binh quan 7,2%/nam. Co cau kinh te chuyen dich tich cuc. The che kinh te thi truong dinh huong xa hoi chu nghia tiep tuc duoc hoan thien. Tong san pham trong nuoc (GDP) nam 2010 theo gia thuc te gap 3,4 lan so voi nam 2000; GDP binh quan dau nguoi nam 2010 dat 1.168 USD. Cac linh vuc van hoa, xa hoi dat thanh tuu quan trong tren nhieu mat, chinh tri - xa hoi on dinh; quoc phong an ninh duoc tang cuong. Cong tac doi ngoai va hoi nhap quoc te duoc day manh.
Sau hon 20 nam thuc hien Cuong linh, chung ta da gianh duoc nhung thanh tuu to lon, co y nghia lich su. Dat nuoc thuc hien thanh cong buoc dau cong cuoc doi moi, ra khoi tinh trang kem phat trien; doi song nhan dan duoc cai thien ro ret. He thong chinh tri va khoi dai doan ket dan toc duoc cung co, tang cuong. Doc lap, chu quyen, thong nhat, toan ven lanh tho va che do xa hoi chu nghia duoc giu vung, vi the va uy tin cua Viet Nam tren truong quoc te duoc nang cao. Suc manh tong hop cua dat nuoc da tang len rat nhieu, tao tien de de nuoc ta tiep tuc phat trien manh me hon theo con duong xa hoi chu nghia".

Mask R-CNN Explained | Papers With Code
**Mask R-CNN** extends [Faster R-CNN](http://paperswithcode.com/method/faster-r-cnn) to solve instance segmentation tasks. It achieves this by adding a branch for predicting an object mask in parallel with the existing branch for bounding box recognition. In principle, Mask R-CNN is an intuitive extension of Faster R-CNN, but constructing the mask branch properly is critical for good results. Most importantly, Faster R-CNN was not designed for pixel-to-pixel alignment between network inputs and outputs. This is evident in how [RoIPool](http://paperswithcode.com/method/roi-pooling), the *de facto* core operation for attending to instances, performs coarse spatial quantization for feature extraction. To fix the misalignment, Mask R-CNN utilises a simple, quantization-free layer, called [RoIAlign](http://paperswithcode.com/method/roi-align), that faithfully preserves exact spatial locations. Secondly, Mask R-CNN *decouples* mask and class prediction: it predicts a binary mask for each class independently, without competition among classes, and relies on the network's RoI classification branch to predict the category. In contrast, an [FCN](http://paperswithcode.com/method/fcn) usually perform per-pixel multi-class categorization, which couples segmentation and classification.

Vua ra tu gai mai dam kiem them vai tro ma mi
Tags: ngua quen duong cu, gai mai dam, vai tro, Ma mi, xuan, tu, kiem, dong,
Vua ra tu, Xuan tiep tuc “ngua quen duong cu” va kiem them vai tro “ma mi”.
Xet thay ban an so tham da tuyen doi voi bi cao Nguyen Thi Thanh Xuan (32 tuoi, tru tai xa Van Tien, huyen Yen Lac, Vinh Phuc) la dung toi, dung phap luat nhung do bi cao nhan thuc phap luat con kem, hoan canh gia dinh kho khan nen tai phien phuc tham ngay 6/7, TAND thanh pho Ha Noi da quyet dinh giam 3 thang tu xuong con 12 thang tu ve toi “Moi gioi mai dam”.
Cung giong nhu phien so tham, tai phien phuc tham Xuan da thanh khan khai nhan hanh vi pham toi va tha thiet xin HDXX xin giam nhe hinh phat cho minh - tin tuc dang tai tren bao Cong ly.
Bi cao Nguyen Thanh Xuan tai phien toa - Anh: bao Cong ly
Theo bao Nguoi dua tin, Xuan da tung hanh nghe ban dam va tung phai vao trung tam giao duc lao dong xa hoi mot thoi gian, song khi duoc tro lai cong dong Xuan van khong the doat tuyet nghe cu.
Sau mot thoi gian duoc tai hoa nhap cong dong, dau thang 12/2015, Xuan thue tro tai khu vuc Cau Xay (xa Tan Dan, huyen Soc Son).
De kiem song, Xuan mo mot quan nuoc nho. Nhin be ngoai nhung tuong thieu phu da “cai ta quy chinh”, quay tro lai con duong lam an luong thien nhung thuc chat, an sau quan tra da, Xuan bi mat “moc noi” voi khach hang co nhu cau mua dam.
Boi cung co kinh nghiem trong nghe va nam bat duoc tam ly cua nhieu nguoi co nhu cau mua dam, ngay khi ra tu, Xuan da ket noi lai voi Nguyen Thi Tam (SN 1985, dong nghiep cu) va thoa thuan sau moi lan moi gioi voi gia 300.000 dong/luot, doi tuong se cat lai 50.000 dong tien cong.
Chieu 16/12/2015, khi dang ban quan nuoc, nhan duoc dien thoai “dat hang” cua cua nam khach quen, Xuan lap tuc thong bao cho dong nghiep, roi vay taxi den don Tam de cung den mot nha nghi o huyen Me Linh ban dam.
Xuan cung dong nghiep “hi hung” chia nhau 700.000 duoc “tam ung” truoc tu khach quen, roi doi nao doi ay hai hai phong nghi khac nhau de “hanh lac”.
The nhung khi cac doi tuong tren dang “may mua” thi bi luc luong cong an bat ngo ap vao phat hien, bat qua tang.

Gianh lai nguoi yeu trong mot tuan
Tags: nguoi ay, nguoi yeu, tinh cam, tinh dich, lai nguoi, trong mot, thu, gianh, tuan, khien, nghi,
Chuyen tinh cam cua ban dang tien trien suon se. Bong mot ngay, nhan vat thu 3 xen vao khien nguoi yeu cua ban bi “say nang”.
Ban se phai lam gi de “gianh lai nguoi yeu” trong mot tuan?
“Nguoi thu 3” nhu mot thu thach tinh cam cua hai ban. Neu ban qua ich ki, chi nghi cho ban than ma khong hieu cho nguoi yeu, chuyen tinh cam den day coi nhu ket thuc. Kheo leo canh tranh voi “tinh dich”
de gianh lai nguoi yeu, ban se ghi diem trong mat “ay” va khien tinh dich phai ne. Dieu ban can la su kien nhan, mot ke hoach ti mi trong 7 ngay va biet hoan thanh dung du dinh dat ra.
Sau day la “ke hoach 7 ngay” danh cho ban.
Ngay thu nhat: Tao su khac biet
Hay nghi lai xem, ban dang thua doi thu o diem nao, tai sao chi trong mot thoi gian ngan ma doi thu co the khien nguoi ay xieu long. Do ban dao nay luoi nhac, khong chiu cham chut ngoai hinh va hoi vo tam? Chiu kho quan sat de co gang thay doi. Cham chut ngoai hinh dep hon truoc, co mui huong de chiu cang hay. Nguoi ay se nhin lai ban va bat dau cam thay do du va nuoi tiec khi lo “xieu long” nguoi la day.
Ngay thu hai: Tung hoa mu
Du cho ban co buon, co that vong den dau, cung khong nen the hien ngoai mat. Hay chung to ban hoan toan manh me, ban linh, dau cho nguoi ta khong o canh ben. Truoc mat nguoi ay, hay diem tinh va tro chuyen binh thuong, khien nguoi ay phai suy nghi va cam thay tiec nuoi, thay vi luc nao cung u sau u ru tao ve chan chuong. Ban co the quan tam nhung dong thoi lanh lung, co the vui ve nhung roi diem nhien hoi hot. Nguoi ay khong biet ban nghi gi, va bat dau cam thay nuoi tiec quang thoi gian da qua.
Ngay thu ba: Quan sat am tham, khoi goi ki niem
Nhin nguoi ay tu xa, ban cang kin ke thi nguoi ay cang “danh hoi” duoc va tran trong su tham lang do hon. Co the mot con gio nhe cung nhac cho nguoi ay nho rang hai ban tung di dao tren duong, hoac mot buoi hen ho o quan tra sua voi “nguoi moi” cung khien nguoi ay cam thay khong thu vi bang di voi ban. Khi nguoi ta bat dau nho den ban va chu dong hoi han, dung qua nhiet tinh, cung khong duoc ho hung. Giu thai do binh thuong va giao quyen quyet dinh cho nguoi ta. Thi thoang bo vao hoc ban nguoi ay nhung do vat co kha nang goi nho ki niem cung la mot cach hay.
Ngay thu tu: Lam lo va di choi cung ban be
Hay danh ngay nay cho ban be va tam quen di ai do. Hay thu trai nghiem cam giac “mot ngay khong co em (anh)”. Biet dau ban se nhan ra nhieu gia tri dich thuc va biet minh can gi. Ngay nay hay de nguoi ta tu do thoai mai, ban khong nhan tin, khong quan sat, khong hoi han quan tam gi ca.
Ngay thu nam: Than thien voi tinh dich
Hay to ra minh la nguoi hoan toan “quan tu” va biet cach cu xu. The nao tinh dich cung se bat dau cam thay ne so ban, va bat dau nghi tot ve ban. Khi tinh dich cam thay thua kem ban, han (hoac co ay) se tu ti hon. Biet dau doi thu va ca nguoi ay deu bat dau suy nghi lai, khi ho cam thay co loi voi ban. Con rieng ban, du co buon, co yeu den the nao, thi cung tam dep bo cam xuc ca nhan de tro nen manh me va tot bung. Neu ban la nguoi xung dang hon, chac chan ban se “gianh duoc nguoi yeu” mot cach chan chinh.
Ngay thu sau: Ru di choi
Ru nang di choi rieng nhu mot cach ham nong lai tinh cam va cho nang quyet dinh lai. Buoi di choi nay phai that tuyet voi, lang man va chu dao, chu khong duoc giong thoi hai ban con quen nhau. Neu nguoi ay tu choi loi moi, hay ton trong dieu do va dung niu keo (dam bao it lau sau nguoi ta se goi dien chap nhan di cung ban). Khi nguoi ay quyet dinh di, co nghia la nguoi ta van con tinh cam voi ban va khong hoan toan hanh phuc khi ben canh nguoi moi.
Ngay cuoi cung: Thanh that
Hay cung “ba mat mot loi” de giai quyet triet de viec nay. Hoi rang nguoi ay chon ai, lieu nguoi ta co that su hanh phuc khong. Ban chia se rang ban van con tinh cam va muon ca hai nhu luc dau. Ben canh do, van hoa nha voi “tinh dich”. Neu nguoi ay chon ban, ban da thanh cong. Neu nguoi ay van chon tinh dich, hay ton trong quyet dinh nay vi ban khong du tot de nguoi ay quay lai, hoac ban van con dieu gi do thua doi thu, trong truong hop do, hay vui ve chuc mung ho, va doi cho.
Voi phuong phap nay thi chua can den mot tuan, co khi chi vai ngay, nguoi do lai quay ve voi ban. Quan trong la tinh yeu va long kien nhan cua ban du lon de thu hut duoc nguoi ay.

-Tu cung: trung gian
-Duong kinh truoc sau: 72mm
-Cau truc co tu cung: mat do khong deu, thanh truoc eo co Echo kem 27mm, thanh truoc day co Echo kem 42mm, thanh sau co Echo kem 25mm

Rung cam Krong Trai dang bi tan pha - Tin xa hoi
Tags: Krong Trai, Phu Yen, Son Hoa, bi tan pha, ban quan ly, rung cam, giang huong, xoa so, cay con, bi xoa, bat luc, quy, uom, dan, lam,
Theo dieu tra nam 1990, lam phan cua khu rung nay la 22.990 ha, trong do rung tu nhien chiem hon 70%. He dong thuc vat o day kha phong phu, ngoai cac loai go quy nhu giang huong, cam lai, trac day, ca te, gu mat, con co 50 loai thu rung, 182 loai chim cung nhieu loai dong vat bo sat. Trong do co 22 loai thu quy hiem nhu bo tot min, bo ban teng, ca toong, huou vang... va dac biet la 6 loai chim co ten trong Sach do Viet Nam.
Con bay gio, ong Vo Xuan Thoi, Truong Ban quan ly rung cam Krong Trai cho biet, 2/3 lam phan da tro thanh dat san xuat nong nghiep cua dan. Cac loai go quy nhu giang huong, ca te, cam, trac... chi con cay con, cay co thu hau bi chat het. Dong vat thi chi con rat it ca sau va bo rung. Trung binh moi nam, Krong Trai bi mat hon 700 ha rung tu nhien. Rieng 4 thang gan day, Ban quan ly rung cam da phat hien 88 vu pha rung, gan 40 ha rung bi xoa so. Ngoai ra con 50 vu dot rung voi tong dien tich 30 ha.
"Quy che rung cam la khong co nhieu cu dan, nhung Krong Trai lai tiep giap voi 3 xa Ea Charang, Krongpa va Suoi bac voi khoang 6.000 dan, chu yeu la dan toc Ede va Cham H"roi nen rat kho quan ly", ong Vo Xuan Thoi phan nan. Hon nua, rung Krong Trai co quoc lo 25 di qua va noi lien vung duyen hai Nam Trung bo voi Tay Nguyen, nen lam tac khai thac go va van chuyen rat de dang.
Vuon quy khat nuoc
Giang huong von la loai cay dac trung cua rung cam Krong Trai. Khi rung nay bi thu hep dan, rung go quy gia gan nhu bi xoa so. Nam 1998, Ban quan ly rung va Trung tam ky thuat lam nghiep Phu Yen da uom thu giang huong, nhung deu that bai.
Den thang 11/2001, lan dau tien nhung hat giang huong gieo uom nay mam, tong cong tren 52.000 cay con. Anh em kiem lam dang mo tuong den 10-15 nam sau, khu rung cam Krong Trai se bat ngan mau xanh cua loai cay quy nay. Tuy nhien: "Hon mot thang nay, moi ngay chung toi phai bo ra 100.000 dong de thue tai nuoc vao cho vuon uom. Han han keo dai the nay, cay giang huong giong kho cam cu noi trong 1-2 thang nua neu thieu nuoc. Vay ma phai den dau thang 9 moi bat dau mua mua o vung nay", ong Thoi noi.
Ban quan ly rung gan nhu bat luc
Ban quan ly rung Krong Trai chi co 12 nguoi ma phai trong den 22.000 ha rung. Trong khi do, lam tac thi qua hung hang, co lan chung doa dot luon tru so ban vi dam thu go lau cua chung. Ve phia chinh quyen dia phuong, du da co mot so bien phap ve quan ly, bao ve rung, nhung co le "con sot dat ray" da khien cho nguoi dan bat chap phap luat.
Gan day nhat, ngay 23/4, ong Truong Phuoc Cuong, Chu tich UBND huyen Son Hoa chi dao co quan chuc nang tap trung xac minh, dieu tra de hoan tat ho so, som dua nhung doi tuong pha rung ra xet xu; dong thoi co bien phap ngan chan doi tuong chat pha dot rung, khong cho trong cay luong thuc tren dat rung bi xam chiem trai phep. Tuy the, hien nay tinh hinh pha rung o Krong Trai van trong tinh trang kho kiem soat.
(Theo Cong An Nhan Dan, Dai Doan Ket)

Data: 22 maj 2019 - 04:17:01
Trong thoi diem nay tren thi phan co kha nhieu loai ton voi chat luong, mau ma da dang. Tuy vay mat hang cua moi Doanh Nghiep se co mot the manh rieng phuc vu nhu yeu khong giong nhau cua nguoi tieu dung. Cung diem mat 4 loai ton duoc danh gia va tham dinh tot nhat thi truong Hien gio.
Ton hoa cuong Bluescope Zacs
Ton BlueScope Zacs duoc san xuat boi tap doan bluescope steel vietnam Voi kinh nghiem san xuat ton hon 100 nam. Cong nghe tien tien duoc chuyen nhuong ban giao tu Uc va lien doanh 50: 50 voi Nippon Steel & Sumitomo Metal Corporation cua Nhat nen ton Zacs co chat luong vuot troi voi gia ton lanh zacs cuc ky doi dau tren thi truong.
Voi lop ma AZ100 to chat chong an mon gap nhieu lan so voi ton thong thuong. Cong nghe tien tien Eco- Cool giup mai nha phan xa tot anh nang mat troi giup mai nha giam 5 do C. Cong nghe tien tien G- Tech tao van hoa cuong ong anh giup dong san pham ton lop co dac thu tham my cao, dep va sang nhu ngoi. Tap doan BlueScope tu tin bao hanh chong phai mau 5 nam va an thung 10 nam.
Ton Zacs Hoa Cuong voi van hoa cuong ong anh dep nhu ngoi. Nay ton Hoa Cuong co Bo mau phong thuy: Hoa dai phat, moc khoi sinh, thuy truong ton, kim phuc loc, tho binh an. Va So mau Phuc Loc Tho: Vang goi phuc, duong khai loc, ngoc khoi tho.
Ton Zacs mai nha ban dep nhu ngoi, ben nhu ton va gia ton lanh zac re nhat tren thi truong
Hoa Sen tu truoc den luc nay Duoc biet den nhu mot tap doan dung vi tri so 1 nganh ton. Dong san pham cua Hoa Sen co nhieu uu the nhu: do chong an mon cao, chong phai mau ben va che do bao hanh tuong doi tot. Ton Hoa Sen de tiep can voi 500 chi nhanh tren toan quoc nguoi mua thuan tien mua ton Hoa Sen. Mac du the do su pho bien do Luc bay gio ton Hoa Sen bi lam gia khong it nen quy khach can than trong luc mua.
Ton Dong A tang truong can dam va manh me tai nhung tinh huong phia nam chiem duoc cam tinh cua khach hang nho cong nghe hien dai. Voi lop ma AZ150 chong an mon cao ton Dong A tu tin bao hanh chong phai mau va an thung len den 10 nam.
Ton Nam Kim va cac loai ton bluescope cung chiem thi phan kha lon tai thi phan Nuoc Ta. Luc Nay ton Nam Kim dang dan minh chung va khang dinh chat luong san pham: kha nang chong an mon, chong phai mau,… Voi cong nghe tien tien hien dai ton Nam Kim bao hanh chong an mon gi thung 10 nam.

Co nhieu su lien quan thu vi giua cac hinh tuong cua Nhan dinh so voi Cao dinh trong Cuu Dinh nha Nguyen.
Trong Cuu Dinh nha Nguyen, Nhan dinh nang 2.515kg, duoc dat ben trai Nhan dinh, ung voi kham tho vua Minh Mang trong The Mieu.
Chinh giua cua Nhan dinh la chu "Nhan dinh", thuy hieu cua vua Minh Mang.
Hang tren, phia trai cua chu Nhan dinh la hinh tuong "Ngo dong", nghia la cay ngo dong, loai cay duoc trong kha nhieu o kinh thanh Hue.
Hinh tuong "Ky nam" la go ky nam, loai tram huong pham chat cao nhat, het suc quy hiem.
"Noa" la cay lua nep, giong lua deo va thom song hanh cung lua te tren cac ruong lua Viet Nam.
"Nam tran" la cay bon bon, loai cay cho qua tung tro thanh nguon thuc pham cuu song chua Nguyen Anh khi phai an nau trong rung de tranh su truy lung cua quan Tay Son.
"Lien hoa" la hoa sen, loai hoa tuong trung cho su cao quy bat chap nghich canh, dong thoi cung la mot loai hoa cua dao Phat.
"Khong tuoc" la chim cong, loai chim co bo long ruc ro duoc menh danh la nu hoang cua cac loai chim.
Hang giua: Ben trai chu "Nhan dinh" la "Nam Hai", nghia la vung bien phia Nam nuoc Viet.
"Pho Loi ha" la song Pho Loi, con song do vua Minh Mang cho dao nam 1835, noi song Huong voi cua bien Thuan An, co vai tro giao thong va thuy loi quan trong voi kinh thanh Hue xua.
"Nguyet" la mat trang.
"Huong giang" la song Huong, dong song bieu tuong chay qua kinh thanh Hue.
"Ngu Binh son" la nui Ngu Binh, co hinh dang nhu buc binh phong, cung voi song Huong tao thanh canh quan dac trung cua Hue: Song Huong nui Ngu.
Hang duoi: Ben trai chu "Nhan dinh" la "Nhan ngu", mot cach goi ca voi, loai ca thieng phu tro nguoi di bien theo quan niem cua nguoi dan mien bien Viet Nam.
"Cuu" la cay he, mot loai cay gia vi gan gui voi hanh.
"Lau thuyen" la thuyen lau, loai thuyen nhieu tang thuong duoc dung cho nha vua, nguoi hoang toc va cac quan dai than, binh si ho gia di lai tren song Huong.
"Luan xa phao" la sung dai bac dat tren xe, phien ban co dong, thuong co kich thuoc nho cua sung dai bac.
"Bao" la con bao, loai vat ho meo chi dung duoi con ho ve do "ho bao" trong rung ram Viet Nam.
"Dai mao" la con doi moi, loai rua bien co mai dep, thit ngon, la san vat quy thuong duoc dung tien vua.

Ngoai truong Nga Sergei Lavrov cho biet viec Moscow phat trien ten lua la vi My khong dap ung de xuat cua nuoc nay ve han che trien khai ten lua tam ngan va tam trung o chau Au.
Phat bieu tai hoi nghi khong pho bien vu khi o Moscow, Ngoai truong Nga Sergei Lavrov cho biet quyet dinh phat trien vu khi truoc day bi cam boi mot thoa thuan khong con ton tai, chi la phan ung truoc cac dong thai cua Washington, Sputnik cho biet.
Truoc do, Tong thong Vladimir Putin da de xuat cam trien khai ten lua tam ngan va tam trung o chau Au va cac khu vuc khac. Tuy nhien, NATO da phot lo de xuat nay va noi rang no khong dang tin cay.
Hiep uoc cac luc luong hat nhan tam trung (INF) duoc ky ket giua My va Lien Xo vao nam 1987, da bi cham dut vao ngay 2/8, khi Washington tuyen bo rut khoi thoa thuan, sau khi My dinh chi cac nghia vu cua INF 6 thang truoc.
Ca Washington va Moscow nhieu lan cao buoc nhau vi pham INF, trong do cam phat trien va trien khai cac loai ten lua co tam ban tu 500-5.500 km.
Ten lua hanh trinh Iskander-K cua Nga, vu khi duoc cho la nguyen nhan dan den su sup do cua Hiep uoc INF. Anh: Military Today.
Bo truong Lavrov cho biet My tuyen bo rang cac cuoc dam phan ve Hiep uoc cat giam vu khi tien cong chien luoc (START) moi chi co the tien hanh neu co su tham gia cua Trung Quoc. Hiep uoc START II duoc ky ket giua My va Nga vao nam 2010, la hiep uoc cat giam vu khi duy nhat con lai giua hai nuoc.
START II se het hieu luc vao nam 2021, nhung Washington van chua cong bo ke hoach gia han. Thay vao do, My muon keo Trung Quoc vao cuoc dam phan de ky mot thoa thuan 3 ben. Tuy nhien, Bac Kinh da tu choi de xuat nay.
Tra loi cau hoi cua phong vien ve phan ung cua Moscow truoc tuyen bo “NATO dang chet nao” cua Tong thong Phap Emmanuel Macron, Ngoai truong Lavrov, cho biet voi tu cach la lanh dao mot quoc gia thanh vien NATO, tong thong Macron co du kha nang de danh gia tinh trang cua lien minh.
“Do la loi ich cua chung toi, vi chinh sach doi ngoai cua chung toi la phat trien, hop tac binh dang va cung co loi voi NATO va se khong mat nhieu thoi gian de lam dieu nay ngay khi NATO tro nen tot dep hon”., Ngoai truong Lavrov noi.

Tinh toi thoi diem hien tai, scandal Burning Sun va loat chatroom tinh duc co lien quan toi Seungri, Jung Joon Young va hoi ban than chinh la be boi gay chan dong nhat trong nam 2019. Trong lich su Kbiz, chua co vu tai tieng nao co suc cong pha du doi nhu vu viec nay khi ma no keo theo hang chuc ngoi sao hang dau cua lan song Hallyu vao cuoc. Day con duoc xem la cuoc thanh trung cua lang giai tri xu kim chi boi no da khien nhieu nghe si chinh thuc tuyen bo giai nghe.
Cac nhan vat chinh trong vu viec da thua nhan mot so toi danh trong so hang loat cao buoc lien quan toi ho. Seungri phai doi mat voi tong cong 9 cao buoc bao gom ca xui giuc mai dam, moi gioi mai dam, danh bac phi phap. Hien cuu thanh vien BIGBANG da thua nhan viec thanh lap, dang ky kinh doanh club nguoi lon Monkey Museum duoi dang mot nha hang, hanh vi phat tan anh sex cua nan nhan nu trong chatroom tinh duc gom 8 nguoi va hanh vi danh bac phi phap.
Ve phan Jung Joon Young, cuu nghe si da thua nhan hanh vi phat tan va quay len clip canh quan he tinh duc voi nhieu co gai. Hoi cuoi thang 3, anh da bi bat vao trai giam theo lenh cua toa an. Cuu thanh vien FT. Island - Choi Jong Hoon cung da thua nhan hanh vi quay len clip sex cua nan nhan nu sau mot thoi gian quanh co choi toi. Truoc suc ep tu cong chung, ca 3 nghe si noi tren deu da tuyen bo giai nghe.
Jung Joon Young, Choi Jong Hoon noi got Seungri tuyen bo giai nghe trong nam nay
Vu be boi con gay anh huong toi hang loat cai ten quyen luc khac. Truyen thong Han da cong khai 2 nhom chat truy lac cua Jung Joon Young va Seungri, mot nhom gom 8 thanh vien con nhom kia gom 10 thanh vien toan my nam. De dang nhan ra nhieu guong mat bi neu dich danh den tu cac cong ty giai tri hang dau Kbiz nhu Kangin (cuu thanh vien Super Junior), Jung Jinwoon (2AM), Roy Kim, Eddy Kim, Yong Junhyung (cuu thanh vien Highlight)…
Trong so cac nhan vat bi neu dich danh, "hoang tu son ca" Roy Kim, Eddy Kim da thua nhan hanh vi phat tan noi dung dam duc con Yong Junhyung thua nhan da xem nhung video trai phep duoc chia se trong nhom chat cua cuu nghe si ho Jung. Sau on ao, Yong Junhyung tuyen bo roi Highlight va rut lui khoi lang giai tri.
Nam than Lee Jong Hyun khien du luan bat binh khi thoi gian dau van duoc cong ty chu quan giu lai trong doi hinh CNBLUE bat chap viec anh da thua nhan cung nguoi ban than Jung Joon Young xem clip va binh pham ve phu nu mot cach benh hoan. Tuy nhien, anh cung da phai roi nhom trong thoi gian gan day.
Tham chi, nhieu nghe si dinh dam "nam khong cung dinh dan" chi vi co it nhieu moi quan he voi cac nhan vat chinh trong nhom chat tinh duc, bao gom Jennie (BLACKPINK), Jihyo (TWICE), Sehun (EXO), Moon Chae Won, Choi Tae Joon, Goo Hara, Lee Hong Ki…
My nhan sinh nam 1997 uat uc toi muc khoc ngay giua san bay sau khi vuong phai tin don vo can cu
Trong boi canh be boi nhom chat tinh duc co lien quan toi Seungri van chua lang xuong, du luan xu Han lai "day song" truoc thong tin ve mot nhan vat ten la Ko do to Hankook Ilbo dang tai. Ong Ko da moi gioi mai dam tu nam 2017 bang cach thue nhung dien vien tan binh de mua vui cho cac ong chu tap doan va khach hang la nguoi noi tieng.
Dang chu y hon ca do chinh la su xuat hien cua nam idol noi tieng (goi tat la C) trong danh sach khach hang mua dam thuong xuyen trong duong day nay. Theo mot vai thong tin it oi duoc he lo, mot vai thanh vien cua nhom nhac ma B hoat dong da tung bi dinh vao scandal gay tranh cai trong qua khu.
2. Hang loat be boi ma tuy phu den showbiz Han, day mo re ma moc noi het trong cung gioi nghe si
Nhieu cai ten dinh dam Kbiz vuong scandal su dung chat cam trong nam qua khien du luan khong khoi bang hoang. Khong it nguoi trong so ho so huu guong mat hien lanh, tung chiem duoc long tin noi nguoi ham mo. Truong hop gay tiec nuoi nhat co le la nam ca si kiem nha san xuat tai nang B.I (cuu thanh vien iKON). Thang 6 nam nay, B.I da chinh thuc roi nhom iKON sau vu be boi dinh liu toi ma tuy tong hop LSD. Duoc biet, nam idol nay da trao doi voi ke cung cap ma tuy Han Seo Hee - ban gai cu cua T.O.P (BIGBANG).
Tai nang tre B.I chinh thuc roi iKON trong nam nay. Co nguon tin cho rang, anh bi Yang Hyun Suk ep roi khoi nhom
My nam dinh dam mot thoi Park Yoochun cung chinh thuc giai nghe trong nam nay sau be boi dung chat cam. Xet nghiem cua Vien Phap y Quoc gia Han Quoc da tim thay Philopon (mot dang chat cua Methamphetamine - ma tuy da) tren nguoi idol dinh dam mot thoi. Ban dau du con mo han hop bao choi toi, nhung Yoochun da phai thua nhan hau nhu tat ca cac cao buoc lien quan den viec su dung ma tuy trong phien tham van hom 29/4. Tai phien xet xu hoi thang 7, cuu thanh vien JYJ nhan muc an 2 nam tu treo va neu vi pham them bat cu toi danh nao trong thoi gian thu thach se phai ngoi tu 10 thang.
Nam tai tu Han "ngao da" vi choi thuoc
Chua dung lai o do, mot nam dien vien dinh dam ho Yang tiep tuc noi dai danh sach nhung ngoi sao vuong thi phi dung chat cam trong nam 2019. Anh la nhan vat chinh trong doan clip ghi lai canh 1 nam dien vien co bieu hien "ngao da" ngay tren duong pho gay xon xao du luan hoi dau nam nay. Theo du kien it oi duoc cong khai, Yang la mot sao lon ben mang dien anh. Dua vao day, cong chung da dua mot so cai ten nhu Yang Se Jong, Yang Dong Gun, Yang Hyun Min, Yang Joo Ho… vao dien nghi van.
3. Hanh vi tron thue cua loat sao bi phanh phui
Nam nay, hang chuc nghe si ten tuoi tai Han Quoc bi to tron thue. Ben canh nhung cai ten bi chi dich danh gom Seungri, Yang Hyun Suk, van con rat nhieu nghe si khac da duoc giau ten. Truoc nhieu bang chung khong the choi cai, Seungri da thua nhan viec thanh lap va dang ky kinh doanh club nguoi lon Monkey Museum duoi dang mot nha hang voi CEO Yoo In Suk de tron thue. Trong khi do, Cuc thue quoc gia da yeu cau YG va Yang Hyun Suk nop phat 6 ty won (tuong duong 120 ty dong) tien thue bo sung.
YG va Yang Hyun Suk phai nop phat 120 ty dong tien thue bo sung
Hoi dau nam nay, co quan Dich vu Thue Quoc Gia Han Quoc dua ra thong bao ve dot can quet moi ve thue. Theo do, co toi 20 nguoi noi tieng dinh phot tron thue. Trong so 20 nguoi noi tieng nay bao gom cac nhan vat noi tieng trong linh vuc giai tri, CEO cua cong ty giai tri va cac van dong vien chuyen nghiep. Danh tinh cu the cua 20 nhan vat khien dan tinh vo cung to mo.
B. "Ong lon" bi reo goi nhieu nhat trong nam 2019: YG Entertainment
Khong ai co the phu nhan nhung dong gop to lon cua YG trong qua trinh phat trien lan song Kpop ra khap the gioi. Hien "ong lon" nay dang doi mat voi mot nam dai khung hoang khi ma hang loat "con ga de trung vang" dinh phot. Ngay ca cuu chu tich Yang Hyun Suk cung khong thoat khoi vong xoay thi phi. Nhieu nguoi con du doan YG se som roi khoi Big 3 sau loat be boi chan dong.
Ben canh nhung tai tieng cua Seungri, B.I, Yang Hyun Suk, nhieu cai ten quyen luc khac cua YG bao gom G-Dragon, Daesung, Lee Seung Hoon (WINNER) cung lan luot gap han. Ngay giua tam bao scandal cua Seungri, G-Dragon bi to nhan dac cach trong quan ngu. Phia don vi cua nam ca si da nhanh chong len tieng phu nhan nhung du luan van khong ngung chi trich anh.
Chi vai thang truoc day, tin tuc thanh vien Daesung (BIGBANG) so huu toa nha lien quan toi cac hoat dong kinh doanh giai tri bat hop phap, trong do co mai dam duoc lan truyen tren khap cac mat bao. Nam ca si len tieng khang dinh khong he biet den su ton tai cua nhung hoat dong kinh doanh phi phap dien ra trong toa nha nay. Tuy nhien, nhieu nhan chung dong loat dung len to Daesung noi doi. Cac chu so huu co so kinh doanh trai phep deu xac nhan da tung hop voi dai dien cua Daesung va noi ro ve cac hoat dong cua ho ben trong toa nha.
Trong thoi diem B.I tro thanh tam diem chi trich vi be boi dung chat cam, thanh vien Lee Seung Hoon (WINNER) cung bat ngo bi loi vao cuoc. Dispatch tung bang chung ve viec Lee Seung Hoon cung co dinh liu den scandal ma tuy cua B.I (cuu thanh vien iKON) tuy nhien chi dung lai o viec co quen biet, nhan tin voi Han Seo Hee de hoi ve B.I va thu xep cuoc gap mat giua co nang voi dai dien phia YG nham giai quyet van de. Hang loat be boi khien nam 2019 thuc su tro thanh mot nam dang quen doi voi YG.
Lee Seung Hoon cung bi keo vao lum xum cua B.I
C. Qua nhieu nghe si ra di, khien cong chung bang hoang
Tu dau nam 2019 den nay, cong chung phai chung kien nhieu su ra di dang tiec cua cac nghe si xu Han, bao gom nhieu guong mat co ten tuoi nhu cuu thanh vien f(x) Sulli, nu dien vien "Mat trang om mat troi" Jeon Mi Seon, nu ca si Maeng Yuna, nam ca si nhac trot Jin Hyuong, nu ca si Woo Hye Mi - nguoi tung lot vao Top 4 cuoc thi "The Voice Han Quoc 2012". Trong do, su ra di cua Sulli va Jeon Mi Seon deu co lien quan toi can benh tram cam - luoi hai tu than khien nhieu ngoi sao mat di sinh mang.
Cai chet cua Sulli va Jeon Mi Seon co lien quan toi tram cam
Cai chet cua Sulli khien ca lang giai tri xu Han chim trong bau khong khi tang thuong trong nhung ngay gan day. Nhieu nghe si tuyen bo dong bang hoat dong de bay to su tiec thuong. Truyen thong va nguoi ham mo tren toan the gioi khong khoi bang hoang truoc su ra di dot ngot cua mot trong nhung nu than sac dep Kpop. Den thoi diem nay, co the noi rang, chinh su cay nghiet cua mot bo phan netizen xu Han la tac nhan chinh day Sulli den bo vuc tuyet vong.
Ben canh su ra di cua nhieu nguoi noi tieng, cong chung con soc nang truoc cai chet cua cha Samuel. Trong boi canh vuong tranh chap voi cong ty quan ly cu, Samuel bat ngo phai don nhan tin du ve cha ruot. Theo tin tuc tu to Bakersfieldnow vao ngay 17/7, cha anh chang da bi giet hai da man bang dao tai nha rieng. Su nghiep khong thuan loi, mat cha o tuoi 17 – do la chuoi bi kich cua chang hoang tu lai chi tinh rieng trong nam nay.
Chung kien hinh anh chang trai 17 tuoi guc khoc trong dam tang nguoi cha dang kinh, nguoi ham mo khong the cam duoc nhung giot nuoc mat
D. Be boi hon nhan chan dong chau A: Song Song va Goo Hye Sun - Ahn Jae Hyun
Song Joong Ki va Song Hye Kyo
Song Song va Goo Hye Sun - Ahn Jae Hyun tung la hai trong nhung cap doi dep nhat lang giai tri chau A. Chung kien tinh cam ma ho danh cho nhau, cong chung con tuong rang hai cap doi se song den "dau bac rang long", vay nhung, Song Song, Goo Hye Sun – Ahn Jae Hyun lai lan luot tan vo trong nam nay.
Song Song vuong tin don ran nut ngay tu hoi dau nam nay nhung cap doi lien tuc phu nhan giup nguoi ham mo "tho phao nhe nhom". Tuy nhien, vao thang 6, Song Joong Ki tuyen bo ly hon voi Song Hye Kyo, chinh thuc dat dau cham het cho cau chuyen tinh yeu dep giua hai ngoi sao dinh dam.
Sau tuyen bo ly hon, phia Song Joong Ki lien tuc dua ra nhung thong bao an y loi thuoc ve phia my nhan ho Song. Tham chi, theo mot nguon tin than can thi phia nam tai tu "Hau due mat troi" da canh bao vo cu: "Neu co ay tiet lo hay co y lan truyen, bia dat gi ve van de ly hon, Song Joong Ki co the se cong khai moi thu". Nhung dong thai la nay khien cong chung cho rang giua Song Song da xuat hien mot cuoc chien ngam tu lau.
Anh trai Song Joong Ki "do them dau vao lua" khi thang tay xoa hinh anh gia dinh xem phim ung ho em dau cu
Ve phan Goo Hye Sun - Ahn Jae Hyun, ho chia tay theo cai cach con on ao, chan dong hon ca Song Song. Cap doi vang mot thoi dau to nhau vo cung quyet liet va cho den nay, cuoc chien nay van chua co dau hieu ket thuc. Qua nhung loi chia se tu hang xom, thanh vien thuoc e-kip san xuat "Newlywed Diary", cong chung "nga ngua" khi phat hien ra rang Goo Hye Sun - Ahn Jae Hyun von khong he hanh phuc nhu ve be ngoai.
Hang xom tiet lo Goo Hye Sun – Ahn Jae Hyun khong hanh phuc
Tham chi, theo loi cua nhan vien thuoc e-kip san xuat "Newlywed Diary", co han mot can phong cho cap doi mot thoi cai nhau trong qua trinh quay show. O thoi diem hien tai, nhieu nguoi cho rang, hai ngoi sao da can tinh voi nhau va chac chan khong the tro thanh ban be sau khi hoan tat viec ly hon.
E. Nhung diem sang giup cong chung hy vong vao tuong lai tuoi sang hon cho Kbiz
BTS va BLACKPINK: Niem hi vong cua Kpop
Nam 2019 thuc su la mot cot moc dang so voi nguoi ham mo nhung van con nhieu dau hieu lac quan de cong chung co the tin tuong vao nhung dieu tot dep hon se den voi lang giai tri Han Quoc trong tuong lai. Trong boi canh khung hoang, YG van con 4 nang chien binh BLACKPINK. Mang tren minh su menh gong ganh ca de che YG vuot qua nhung ngay thang den toi, BLACKPINK da khong lam cho "ong lon" nay phai that vong.
Trong khoang thoi gian nhom tro lai lang nhac, co phieu nha YG lien tuc co dau hieu hoi phuc. Theo Touring Data thong ke, doanh thu tour dien "In Your Area" tai 10 quoc gia va vung lanh tho tren khap the gioi cua nhom uoc dat khoang 26,49 trieu USD (tuong duong 616 ty dong).
Ve phia cac nhom nam, BTS van la cai ten dan dau. Ho khong chi chinh phuc thanh cong nhung bang xep hang quan trong nhat trong he thong Billboard ma con so huu hang loat concert chay ve tai chau A va Au My. Co the noi, thanh cong vang doi cua BTS tai thi truong Au My da mo ra nhieu co hoi cho cac nghe si Kpop tai manh dat mau mo nay. Tiep noi BTS, nhom nhac nha SM SuperM cung da lam nen lich su khi leo thang len vi tri so 1 bang xep hang Billboard 200 voi album vua moi ra mat.
BTS hien van duoc xem la ong vua cua Kpop
Phim Han lam nen lich su
Mang dien anh xu kim chi cung dat duoc thanh tich khung, gay chan dong toan cau trong nam vua qua. Sieu pham "Ky sinh trung" cua dao dien Bong Joon Ho la bo phim dau tien cua lich su dien anh Han Quoc doat giai Canh Co Vang tai Lien hoan phim Cannes 2019.
Doan lam phim "Ky sinh trung" lam nen lich su
Antifan luon la ke thu "khong doi troi chung" doi voi sao Han. Chinh nhung binh luan cay nghiet cua netizen Han la mot trong cac nguyen nhan chinh khien nhieu nghe si tai quoc gia nay tu ket lieu mang song. Duoc biet, da co it nhat 9 thanh vien cua Quoc hoi Han Quoc dong y tien hanh xem xet dao luat chong lai binh luan ac y.
Dao luat Sulli
Voi ten goi la "Dao luat Sulli", du luat moi nay nham dua ra nhung quy dinh nghiem ngat chong lai nhung binh luan ac y, dac biet den tu nhung ca nhan an danh tren mang internet. Mot tieu ban se duoc thanh lap de xem xet cac chi tiet va dieu khoan trong "Dao luat Sulli" vao khoang dau thang 12, tuong niem 49 ngay mat cua Sulli va du kien se duoc to chuc tai Hoi truong Tuong niem Hien phap cua Quoc hoi Han Quoc. Nguoi ham mo hy vong rang, su ra doi cua "dao luat Sulli" se cham dut tinh trang nhieu nghe si tu tu vi khong chiu noi ap luc du luan trong suot nhieu nam qua.

Tat tan tat ve trang diem
Tat tan tat ve trang diem Tags: Nam Trung, kem duong da, tren be mat, duoc su dung, ke long may, san pham, trang diem, lan da, tu nhien, sau khi, lua chon, dang, dung, lam, mau
Trong ky thuat trang diem, lan da dep luon la yeu to quyet dinh thanh cong. Nhung van de can phai hieu ro la ban khong the dung tat ca cac san pham phan de tao nen mot lan da tuyet voi khi chinh lan da cua ban lai khong dep. Hieu ro va cham soc tot cho lan da cua chinh minh la yeu to quan trong dau tien de co duoc su chuyen nghiep trong nghe thuat trang diem.
Co tat ca 5 loai da:
Da dau: La loai da de gap cac van de ve mun, mau chay phan nen nhung lai tre lau hon so voi cac loai da khac. Chinh vi vay nen loai da nay can phai duoc tay trang va rua rat sach ca truoc va sau khi trang diem. Cach tot nhat la su dung nhung san pham nhe nhang tay het lop dau tren be mat, lam thong thoang lo chan long nhung khong gay kho rat lam ton thuong da. Va hien nhien la voi da dau, phan thieu hut can bo sung de giup cho da mem va min la nuoc chu khong phai kem.
Da kho: Thuong de lai nep nhan sau khi duoc thoa va dam phan, boi be mat da von di da thieu chat tao nen do am tu nhien. De co duoc mot lan da dep sau khi trang diem, ban phai lam theo dung nhung buoc sau:
- Dung tay trang dang dau, de loai bo my pham trang diem.
- Chon san pham rua mat dang kem rua da.
- Tranh su dung nuoc qua nong khi rua. Sau khi rua mat xong, vo hoac rua lai mot lan nua voi nuoc lanh.
- Su chon lua hoan hao cho da kho la kem duong da loai dac chu khong phai dang long nhu lotion.
- Hay de kem duong da tham that sau vao da bang cach thoa va massage kem duong truoc khi trang diem khoang 10 phut.
Da hon hop: Can cham soc that ky boi cau truc da la su ket hop giua hai loai da kho va da dau. Ban can thuc hien hai cach cham soc da cung mot luc. Dung sua rua mat dang foam cho buoi sang va dang cream cho buoi toi. Khi thoa kem duong da, nho dung khan giay am, tham len vung da dau nham lay di luong kem duong du thua va dieu hoa do am cho da.
Da thuong: La loai da hoan hao va can bang nhat. Chinh vi ly do do, ban chi can tay trang va rua mat bang nhung san pham thong thuong, nhe nhang tay sach nhung bui ban tren be mat va lop trang diem cu. Sau cung la san pham duong da dang lotion de nuoi duong va bao ve lan da khoi tac hai cua moi truong va thoi tiet.
Da nhay cam: Be mat da cuc min va co khuynh huong de bi noi man do hon tat ca cac loai khac. Voi loai da nay, ban can su dung san pham my pham sieu nhe trong cong doan tay rua. Nhung san pham nay co cong thuc chong di ung dac biet danh rieng cho da nhay cam, khong chua nhung chat de gay kich ung nhu huong lieu hay mot so hop chat sinh hoc khac.
Co rat nhieu phu nu tranh khong su dung kem nen vi ho so mat di ve tu nhien, so minh giong nhu mang mot chiec mat na sau khi trang diem. Thuc ra, de lua chon mot san pham kem nen phu hop nham che giau nhung khuyet diem khong he kho. Chia khoa cua su thanh cong tuy thuoc vao hai bi quyet co ban: thu nhat, hay chon cho minh mot cong thuc san pham hop voi loai da cua ban; thu hai la lua chon do sang toi cua kem nen hop voi mau da cua ban.
Cong thuc san pham:
1- Make-up base: Day la loai san pham co thanh phan nhu kem duong da nhung duoc them vao do nhung hat phan mau cuc nhuyen. Chung giup cho lan da mem, muot nhung van che giau di phan nao nhung khuyet diem tren da va chuan hoa lai mau da cua ban. San pham nay thich hop cho da thuong va lan da co it khiem khuyet, be mat da min mang.
2. Kem nen dang dung dich (liquid foundation): Day la san pham kem nen thong dung va da tac dung nhat trong tat ca cac loai kem nen boi chung de dang tao nen do min va che phu rat tu nhien. San pham nay thich hop voi tat ca cac loai da ngoai tru da kho. Neu da dau, hay chon loai san pham khong chua dau (oil-free).
3. Kem nen dang kem (Cream foundation): San pham co cong thuc nhu liquid foundation nhung duoc bo sung them kem duong da thich hop voi da kho.
4. Kem nen dang nen (compact foundation): Day la san pham dang tong hop co chua phan phu ben trong. Duoc su dung bang bong phan, thich hop voi da kho.
5. Kem nen dang thoi (stick foundation): San pham nay duoc goi la dai dien cho su chinh thong cua kem nen. Hieu qua che phu rat cao boi chung rat day. Duoc su dung cho da co be mat cuc xau hay co seo. Su dung bang cach cham truc tiep len vung da co khuyet diem can che phu, sau do tan deu nhe nhang voi bong mut.
Lua chon sang toi: Dung san pham thu, tan mot it phan nen len vung da co khuyet diem (tan nhang, vet nam hoac seo...), ban co the dung ngon tay hoac bong mut, tan that deu. Sau khi hoan thien, vung da da duoc tan phan khong thay doi ma chi mat di khuyet diem, day la san pham hop voi ban ve do che phu.
Quet len quai ham, phan tiep xuc anh sang gan nhat voi co (hinh ben). Chon mau diep nhat voi hai vung da noi tren de dam bao do tu nhien tuyet doi. Che khuyet diem
Che khuyet diem la san pham giup ban khac phuc nhanh nhat nhung nhuoc diem tren da nhu nhung khoang toi, seo, nhung vet man do. Duoi day la nhung dieu can thiet nhat trong ky thuat che khuyet diem:
Dom va mun: Cham san pham mot cach chinh xac len diem can che, sau khi phan da kho, dung bong tam lam mo di vung phan o xung quanh va phu mot chut phan bot len.
Quang tham duoi mat: Dung san pham che phu co chua kem hay dang dung dich, che quang tham roi dung ngon deo nhan xoa deu khong de lai ranh gioi.
Voi nhung vung bi quang do nhu canh mui, khoe moi... Nen su dung san pham co do che phu cao va co dang nilon de tan san pham.
Doi voi cac chuyen gia trang diem, phan phu la thanh phan khong the thieu. Phan phu giup cho lan da sau khi duoc trang diem ky bang kem nen va che khuyet diem tro nen that su hoan thien. Co 4 ly do ma ban khong the phu nhan khi su dung phan phu:
- Phan phu van co the dem lai cho lan da cua ban ve rang ro du ban co dung phan nen hay khong.
- Chung giup phan nen nam em tren da va ben hon rat nhieu.
- Phan phu loai bo hoan toan dau tren da cua ban va lam nhung vung bi bong tren da mat di.
- Phan phu che giau rat tot cho lan da co lo chan long lon.
Chon sao cho dung?
Co hai loai phan phu: Phan phu dang bot dem lai hieu qua tot nhat va lau nhat cho trang diem. Cach su dung phan bot hieu qua nhat la dung cay co ban lon va mem quet len da mot lop phan, sau do ru sach co roi nhe nhang phui lai tren toan bo guong mat lan nua de lay di phan thua.
Phan phu dang nen thuan loi cho viec chinh trang khuon mat voi mieng bong mem nho. Luu y, nen giat thuong xuyen bong phan, tranh de luong dau tham trong bong phan bi hut xuong phan trong hop va lam phan bi chai cung.
Phan phu cung mau voi da se dem lai cho lan da ve dep tu nhien. De lua chon chinh xac, thuc hien nhung thao tac nhu da lam trong viec lua chon kem nen.
That sai lam neu ban van cho rang cach su dung co phan ma nhu dieu khac tren khuon mat se lam cho guong mat ban nho lai va cang mong. Voi hai cach duoi day, ban se ngay lap tuc co duoc hieu qua nhu y muon:
- Phan ma dang bot: Chi lay mot luong vua du bam tren be mat long cua co ma. Bat dau bang cach dat phan ma len diem cao nhat cua go ma. Sau do mim cuoi va quet co tu dinh ngoai cua go ma (phia gan mui) nhe nhang keo huong ve phia thai duong. Dung co tan deu phan ma hong ve huong chan toc.
- Ma hong dang kem: Day la san pham ma hong thoi trang nhat hien nay boi no mang lai ve ung hong va tran day suc song cho khuon mat. De co the su dung duoc hieu qua nhat san pham nay, ban chi nen dung ngon tay hoac co nilon ban lon. Tan ma hong dang kem ngay tren lop phan nen hoac truc tiep tren da truoc khi phu phan bot.
Mau phan ma se giup ban phan nao khac phuc duoc nhuoc diem tren khuon mat:
Hong phan: Lam guong mat day dan hon.
Hong da: Lam guong mat tre trung, tu nhien va muot ma.
Cam dat: Giup co mat trong san chac.
Cam hong: Che giau su met moi tot nhat.
Nau da: Dem lai ve dep khoe manh cho lan da.
Nau dong: La mau da duoc ua chuong nhat trong 2 nam nay vi no tao nen su nong bong va cuong nhiet nhu J.Lo va Beyonce...
Voi nhung mau phan ma qua noi bat nhu: hong canh sen, hong cam chuong, do trai bo quan... nen hoi y kien chuyen gia trang diem truoc khi su dung.
Cach tot nhat de co duoc mot doi moi tu nhien va goi cam la thoa son bang co long. Cay co se giup ban de dang tao duong net gon gang cho doi moi, nhung quan trong hon ca van la lop son duoc dan that mong va min, dieu ma ban khong the nao lam duoc khi thoa son truc tiep bang cay hay bang ngon tay nhu mot so phu nu van thuong lam.
Chi vien moi la giai phap tot nhat cho nhung nguoi co doi moi khong ro net hoac can phai khac phuc nhuoc diem ve tao hinh. Chi vien moi thuong duoc su dung truoc khi thoa son moi va cung mau voi son moi de tao nen duoc hieu qua tot nhat. Luu y: Khi muon thu nho hoac noi rong vien moi, ban nen su dung chi sam hon son moi 1 tong mau va dung them bot qua, 1, 5 mm so voi duong moi that.
Buoc co ban de tao hieu qua cho son moi:
1. Dam bao rang moi cua ban luon duoc mem mai va min mang de thoa son bang cach su dung son duong moi.
2. Phu len mot lop phan nen mong bang bong mut nham che bot di nhung nep gap li ti tren be mat cua da moi.
3. Quet phan bot len tren lop nen vua danh se giup son moi giu duoc lau hon rat nhieu.
4. Cang moi bang cach cuoi ho rang. Day la cach huu hieu nhat de ban co the thoa son moi vao het toan bo cac goc canh can thiet. Dung chi dinh hinh doi moi roi thoa son bang co long.
5. Ban se giu duoc son moi lau hon nua bang cach tham di lop son thua khong bam vao da moi voi khan giay xop va min.
Ban se them son bong len tren cung khi muon doi moi nhin cang mong va uot at hon. Son bong moi co the thoa truc tiep len moi khong can dung son moi, khi moi ban chi can them ve rang ro va cang mong.
Vung mat
Long may: Trong cong viec trang diem cho vung mat, long may that su quan trong de mang lai an tuong cho doi mat boi long may quyet dinh su can bang cua khuon mat ban.
Long may tu nhien: Chai long may bang co co hinh nhu chien luoc theo huong di len. Rang luoc se sap xep nhung soi long may gon gang va tu nhien, lam cho doi mat tro nen sang hon, to hon. Dung mascara dang trong suot, chuot len long may de tao do bong va giu yen nhung soi long may.
Ve long may: De tao kieu cho long may, ban nen su dung bot mau hay chi ke long may. Voi bot mau, ban hay to long may bang co long that nhe nhang. Boi neu nhu qua manh tay, bot mau se bet vao da, von cuc. Ve long may bang bot se tao nen cai nhin tu nhien nhung van tao nen duoc hinh dang long may khac so voi long may tu nhien ma ban muon co.
Voi chi ke long may, ban hay chuot chung that sac de co the ve duoc nhung duong net thanh manh va gon gang. Dung an manh tay khi su dung chi ke long may boi nhu vay se lam mat di ve muot ma tu nhien, long may se tro thanh hai duong xam de - pho... Ve tung net ngan, mem mai theo huong cua chan may. Sau khi hoan thien, ban co the dung bong tam lam mem mai duong chi bang cach nhe nhang chui luot qua tren nhung soi long de lay di lop chi thua von cuc.
