Xom nguoi Viet o Phnom Penh - Phong su tong hop
Tags: Phnom Penh, Ong Muoi, Viet Nam, nguoi dan ong, nguoi phu nu, nguoi cao tuoi, hoan toan khong, Nguoi Viet, nhung nguoi, o day, khong co, di lam, co ten, xom, con,
Theo loi ke cua mot so nguoi cao tuoi o day thi xom duoc hinh thanh boi nhung nguoi Viet ngheo da chon chon nay lam noi ta tuc. Xom hoan toan khong co ten, khong co so nha.
Xom ngheo cua nguoi Viet o Phnom Penh
Xom nguoi Viet thuoc quan ngoai thanh Mieng Chay nam ben bo song Basac (mot nhanh cua dong song Me Kong). Ngay canh xom la cay cau co ten la Chba Om Pau bac qua song va dan vao khu vuc trung tam Phnom Penh.
Tuy nhien, voi nhung nguoi Viet trong xom thi cay cau ay lai co ten la cau Sai Gon. Mot bac xe om nguoi Viet giai thich don gian: “Thi tu Phnom Penh phai qua cau ay moi di den Sai Gon- Viet Nam duoc”.
Nguoi dan duong cho chung toi tham xom nguoi Viet chinh la ong Vo Van Muoi- Truong Chi hoi Viet kieu quan Mieng Chay. Ong Muoi que o Binh Thuan- lang bat sang Campuchia sinh song da duoc gan 20 nam.
Ngay truoc, ong cung song o khu xom nay. Sau may dua con ong truong thanh co cong viec on dinh nen ong Muoi da doi duoc nha, lai con co thoi gian de di lam viec cho Hoi.
Duong den xom chi la mot con hem nho, sinh lay. Buoc vao xom, an tuong dau tien cua chung toi la nhung ngoi nha mai ton lo nho, dap va bang du thu vat lieu tam bo. Nhung dua tre nhem nhuoc, to mo nhin khach la. Gan do, vai phu nu tay bong con ngoi noi chuyen phiem voi nhau.
Ben trong mot can nha nao do vang ra tieng hat cai luong… Khung canh giong nhu o mot xom ngheo mien Tay Viet Nam. Ong Muoi bao: “Da so nhung nguoi dan o day deu la nguoi mien Tay.
Khu vuc nay da duoc chinh quyen quy hoach lam cong vien tu nhieu nam nhung chua thuc hien. Nhung nguoi dan Campuchia o gan da lan dat, xay phong tro de cho thue. Nguoi Viet chon noi nay de thue vi gan trung tam TP lai co gia re”.
Chung toi ghe vao nha ong Phan Van Sanh. Can nha chung hai chuc thuoc vuong dung bang ton cu, vach che bang giay cac tong, trong nha chi co cai ban da cu cung mot chiec giuong chat day quan ao. Ong Sanh da di lam, chi con may nguoi phu nu o nha.
Ca nha ong Sanh qua day da hon chuc nam va song bang nghe lam tho thu cong, cong viec thu nhap cung chung ba chuc ngan ria (tuong duong khoang 1,2 trieu dong Viet Nam) nhung vi con phai nuoi me, vo va 2 dua con nen van phai chap nhan song o xom ngheo nay.
Cach day may nam con gai ong lay chong, them con re di lam tuong chung gia dinh se hon, nao ngo chua day 1 nam, nguoi con re bi tai nan chet, ong Sanh lai phai nuoi them ca dua chau ngoai.
Hien ca nha song bang thu nhap do minh ong ganh. Co con gai o nha cung me va ba noi, vua trong con vua mo them cai quan coc truoc cua nha ban cho hang xom, ngay thu nhap cung chi chung muoi ngan dong. Quan coc nho nhoi, vai hop keo re tien, vai bich banh, may chai nuoc ngot…., tong cong von chi chung tram ngan dong tien Viet.
“Kho lam chu oi! Ba con ai cung ngheo, lay dau ma mua nen khong dam sam, ban cho vui thoi chu a” - Ba me ong Sanh than tho. Ba theo con qua day hon 20 nam nhung chua ve que lan nao, que cha dat to gio ra sao ba cung khong biet. “Nho lam nhung ngheo qua, sao ve chu oi”- Ba rung rung nuoc mat.
Thay co nguoi den, may nguoi phu nu gan do cung to mo gop chuyen. Mot phu nu ten Nu- que o Long Xuyen bao: “O day nha ai cung hoan canh het do chu. Nhu tui qua day voi chong da bay nam ma van chua ve que. Ma mat cung khong dam ve, chi gui chut tien ve nho anh chi thap nen nhang”.
Mot nguoi phu nu khac cung chen vao: “Thi tui co kha gi hon dau. Qua day gan hai chuc nam, bong con ve tham que co lan mot ma qua day tra gop may nam nay chua xong, gio thang con moi 15 tuoi da phai cho di lam phu ba no”.
Chung toi toi mot can nha sat bo song, noi 5 nguoi dan ong o tran dang ngoi nhau. Chi co dia ca kho, mot it hoa qua got san cung can ruou 5 lit da voi gan nua: “Ua sao gio nay chua di lam ma lai ngoi day?” - Ong Muoi len tieng.
Nguoi dan ong co guong mat khac kho, ngoi quay mat ve phia cua than: “E am qua chu Muoi oi! Hang ban khong duoc, hom qua lai bi canh sat dep, nam nha nghi may hom xem sao da”.
Nguoi dan ong vua len tieng ten la Binh, nguoi Dong Thap- qua Campuchia da da hon 5 nam va lam nghe ban trai cay dao truoc cac khu du lich tai trung tam Phnom Penh. Khi truoc, viec quan ly o day con long leo nen hang ban cung duoc.
Hai nam nay chinh quyen da xiet chat dan viec buon ban nen nguoi ban dao e am dan, muon doi nghe thi khong du von.
Nam 2004, mot vu chay lon xay ra o khu xom ngheo da thieu sach tai san cua nhung nguoi Viet noi day. Nho su can thiep cua Hoi Viet kieu, chinh quyen Campuchia da to chuc cuu tro, sau do con cap dat, phat vat lieu xay dung cho nhung ho bi chay nha.
Tuy nhien, viec nay cung khong the giup cho nhung nguoi ngheo noi day nang cap cuoc song cua minh. Nhieu ho ban dat, ban vat lieu xay dung voi gia re de quay lai xom, thue nha o tiep. Ly do duy nhat ma ho dua ra la cho o moi chua co dien chua co nuoc, lai kha xa trung tam nen tim viec lam rat kho.
Xom ngheo nhung tinh nguoi khong ngheo. May nam nay, nho co hoat dong cua Hoi, su gan bo, tinh than doan ket cua nhung nguoi Viet noi day manh len rat nhieu. Khong chi giup nhau trong cuoc song ma ba con da biet gan bo, nuong tua nhau cung vuot qua kho khan.
Nhung ba con gap hoan nan da tim den Hoi, coi Hoi nhu la mot diem tua ve tinh than. Ong Muoi dua ra danh sach nhung ho kho khan duoc Hoi van dong tro cap: Ong Nguyen Van Oc benh mat, Hoi van dong giup do va chi phi dam ma; Vu Huynh Van Vu, Hoi van dong duoc 125 ngan ria cho vo con; Co Nguyen Thi Le bi lua sang Campuchia, Hoi cung van dong duoc 125 ngan ria va giup dua ve Viet Nam...
“Chung toi da to chuc duoc cac lop hoc tieng Viet cho con em Viet kieu. Chinh quyen Campuchia cung da cap dat xay truong va mot so dia phuong o Viet Nam da giup do ve kinh phi nen sang nam, o day se co them truong day tieng Viet”- Ong Muoi tu hao noi.

Xiangqi Puzzle Five Moves Kill
Give your brain a workout the fun way
Xiangqi Puzzles Five Moves Kill
Authored by Ping Loong Wong
Train your tactical ability and exercise your calculation skills by solving Xiangqi puzzles.
The puzzles from author’s earlier books Xiangqi Puzzles One Move Kill, Two Moves Kill, Three Moves Kill and Four Moves Kill are consider easy level puzzles.
"XIANGQI Puzzles Five Moves Kill" is a book where readers are prompted to find a checkmate or stalemate in five moves. The book consists of 280 medium level puzzles. These puzzles are for those players that were getting the easy problems pretty easy but are still struggling with the hard problems.Each puzzle is uniquely designed with positions that players are likely to encounter on the board. The main variations of the solutions to the puzzles are presented at the end of the book. The simple variations of the solution are not shown, the readers are expected to work it out by his own.
Solving puzzles is one of the most effective ways to improve your Xiangqi's skill. For the beginners, simply learning the killing ideas and enjoying the examples will help develop their tactical skills.
This book can be studied by itself or used as a supplement to the author's earlier works: "Xiangqi For Absolute Beginners. Teach Yourself Xiangqi Step by Step".

Theo chu nhiem Bo mon Tai Mui Hong, Dai hoc Y duoc TP HCM, Nguyen Van Duc nhung ca tu vong vi cat amidan phan nhieu la do bac si hoac nhan vien y te chu quan, bat can va khong thuc hien dung quy trinh.
Nhan xet nay duoc giao su Duc phat bieu trong Hoi thao "Cat Amidan ngay nay" to chuc tai Benh vien An Sinh ngay 3/11.
Mot hinh anh benh nhan bi bien chung sau khi cat amidan. Anh: BS Tran Duy Te.
Theo giao su Duc, cat amidan la mot phau thuat don gian nhung tai bien lon co the dan den tu vong. "Du chua co thong ke day du, nhung ngay tai cac benh vien hang dau nhu Benh vien Tai Mui Hong trung uong, Benh vien Xanhpon Ha Noi, Benh vien Cho Ray... deu co benh nhan tu vong do cat amidan. Dieu nay chung minh rang, nguyen nhan khong phu thuoc vao tay nghe bac si ma no phu thuoc vao quy trinh thuc hien", giao su Duc cho biet.
Du ky thuat cat amidan co thay doi theo thoi gian nhung quy trinh thuc hien la khong thay doi. Do la: cac xet nghiem truoc khi mo, dac biet la ve huyet ap, mau, tim mach va lao phoi; trong qua trinh thuc hien va cham soc sau phau thuat.
Theo giao su Duc, nho vao su tien bo cua ky thuat xet nghiem va phuong phap cat, hien nay co xu huong bac si lan benh vien deu khong con coi trong viec cham soc sau phau thuat. Nhieu noi, bac si ap dung phuong phap cat amidan cho ve trong ngay. "Dieu nay la het suc nguy hiem", ong Duc nhan xet.
Benh nhan cat amidan thuong tu vong vi 2 ly do: mot la chay mau nhung khong duoc xu ly kip thoi, hai la do thuoc gay te, gay me nhu nham thuoc, thuoc qua lieu hoac benh nhan bi phan ung voi thuoc. Ngoai ra, cung co the do benh nhan co mang benh san trong nguoi nhu tim mach, lao phoi... nhung cac xet nghiem thuong quy khong phat hien duoc. Chi sau khi phau thuat benh moi boc phat lam benh nhan bi tu vong hoac bien chung.

Tuong Phat sac duc duoi goc nhin cua giao su Mat tong nuoc ngoai
Tuong Phat sac duc duoi goc nhin cua giao su Mat tong nuoc ngoai Tags: Tay Tang, Kim Cang, An Do, Thai Lan, Tuong Phat, Viet Nam
Mot vi giao su nguoi Duc chuyen nghien cuu ve Phat giao Tay Tang trao doi voi phong vien ve buc tuong Phat “la” gay du luan tai Thai Lan, Viet Nam trong thoi gian qua va nguon goc cua no. >> Tuong Phat "la" pham sac gioi va bi... "nem da" >> Su that ve co gai khoa than trong buc tuong "sac duc" Truoc nhung du luan ve buc tuong Phat "la" mang nhieu mau sac sac duc gay tranh cai trong thoi gian qua, phong vien da trao doi qua email voi giao su nghien cuu ton giao chuyen ve Phat giao Tay Tang va An Do thuoc Dai hoc Marburg (Duc), ba Adelheid Herrmann-Pfandt, ve buc tuong nay. Vi nu giao su, tien si co 35 nam nghien cuu va co nhieu cong trinh ve Mat tong nhan xet buc tuong trong anh la hinh tuong “yab-yum” (cha - me) pho bien trong tong phai Mat tong cua Phat giao song ba cung chi ra nhung net khac biet kho thay goi y tac gia cua buc tuong co the la nguoi phuong Tay. - Xin giao su giai thich ve hinh tuong “yab-yum” trong Mat tong? - Yab-yum la tu Tay Tang va co nghia don gian la cha - me. Day la tu thuong dung mieu ta Duc Phat va cac vi Phat khac trong tu the hop nhat. Tieng Phan cua tu yab-yum la yuganaddha nghia la “gan ket”, yuga co lien he voi yoga, tu tieng Phan chi “cai ach” va la cach tu tap tinh than noi tieng cua An Do, von cung duoc dao Phat su dung, voi muc dich ren luyen tam tri nhu mot cai ach dieu khien bo, ngua keo cay hoac keo xe. Do do, tu yuganaddha lam sang to thuc te rang yab-yum bieu tuong cho mot cach tu tap ton giao KHONG huong den muc dich phong dang tinh duc hoac cac kieu tuong tu ma bao gom mot phuong phap hanh thien dac biet. Phuong phap nay khac voi cac hinh thuc khac cua cap do yoga boi no su dung cac nang luong quan trong vuot ra ngoai ban nang gioi tinh. Nghe co ve vo ly khi mot hinh tuong the hien tu the sac duc dai dien cho mot cach tu tap ton giao nham muc tieu ren luyen tam tri. Tuy nhien, co hai ly do khien hinh tuong nay duoc chon: Thu nhat: Yab-yum khong co nghia la tu tap mot loai hinh dac biet cua ban nang tinh duc cua chinh ban nhu mot nguoi thuc hanh song la tao ra viec su dung co kiem soat cac nang luong ma - trong cach khong kiem soat - von da co tac dung voi hoat dong tinh duc thong thuong. Nghia la no giong nhu lay nuoc tu mot thac nuoc va dan no di qua mot ong nuoc de su dung trong nha hoac cap nuoc cho cac canh dong. Tuy nhien, dieu nay khong co nghia la cach thuc hanh Kim Cang thua thuong duoc tien hanh voi mot doi tac, no chu yeu la cach tu tap mot minh. Ngay nay, hau het moi nguoi tren the gioi tu tap hinh thuc thien nay la cac nha su hoac ni co, nhung nguoi duoc cho la khong pha vo sac gioi, mot so nguoi tu tap la nguoi trong gia dinh va ngay ca nhung nguoi nay cung khong tap trung vao ban nang tinh duc hon nhung nguoi khac. Thu hai: mot trong nhung ly do quan trong cho viec su dung bieu tuong sac duc la thien dinh Kim Cang thua, giong moi hinh thuc khac ton giao bi truyen tren the gioi, huong den su trai nghiem bi an ben trong cua su hop nhat, cua su nhat the. Cac ton giao huu than goi day la su hop nhat giua than thanh va con nguoi, nhung ton giao khac, nhu An Do giao la su hop nhat giua linh hon ca nhan (atman) voi linh hon vu tru (brahman) trong khi Phat giao Kim Cang thua noi ve su hop nhat giua tri tue va hu vo hoac tri tue va tu bi, vi du nhu khia canh thu dong va chu dong cua viec tu tap ton giao. Boi hoat dong tinh duc ro rang mang lai hinh thuc phi ton giao manh liet nhat cua su hop nhat ma con nguoi co the trai nghiem, “nhung nguoi khai sinh” Phat giao Kim Cang thua thay rang day la bieu tuong thich hop nhat ve nhung gi xay ra trong su hop nhat bi an cua tinh than. Day co le la ly do sau xa nhat cho viec phat trien y tuong va tao ra hinh tuong Duc Phat trong tu the tinh duc. Buc tuong Phat “la” gay du luan tai Thai Lan, Viet Nam trong thoi gian qua. - Lieu buc tuong co the duoc chap nhan trong Phat giao? - Dieu nay phu thuoc vao viec ban theo tong phai Phat giao nao. Khi Phat giao Kim Cang thua bat dau su dung bieu tuong sac duc o An Do, nhieu phat tu cung phan ung giong voi cach nhung nguoi o nuoc ban duong nhu da phan ung voi buc tuong do. Tuy nhien, hay nhin vao nguoi Tay Tang, nhung nguoi da tro thanh nguoi thua ke chu dao cua Phat giao Kim Cang thua An Do va cua nhung cach tu tap dac biet do, sau khi Phat giao suy tan o An Do vao khoang nam 1.200 sau Cong nguyen: thuc te rang Tay Tang la khu vuc bi dan an duy nhat tren the gioi khong thanh lap mot to chuc khung bo, theo y kien cua toi, co mot ly do va do la dao duc Phat giao, von day ho cach the hien long trac an ngay ca voi nhung ke lam viec ac va ngan can ho giet nguoi khac bua bai... Xet den viec nay, ban co the thay hinh thuc Phat giao huong den nhung hinh anh sac duc cua Duc Phat khong nhat thiet la hinh thuc suy doi. Co mot giai doan ngan trong Phat giao Tay Tang vao the ky thu 10 va 11, khi mot so nguoi o Tay Tang tin rang viec tu tap voi hinh tuong sac duc se cho phep ho nuong chieu ban nang tinh duc mot cach bua bai va tham gia vao moi hinh thuc truy hoan suy doi. Tuy nhien, mot vi quoc vuong mo dao cai tri phia tay Tay Tang vao luc do da moi dai su Atisha (A De Sa, 982 - 1.054), mot dai su Phat hoc noi tieng nguoi An Do, giup ong giai quyet van de nay. Atisha den va day cac phat tu Tay Tang cach hieu nhung hinh anh do nhu la bieu tuong cua nhung gi xay ra trong viec hanh thien Kim Cang thua cua ban than va bieu tuong nay khong xui giuc cac nha su hoac ni co pha vo sac gioi ma mang lai phuong phap su dung nang luong khong lo an giau trong nang luong tinh duc (theo tu nhien von cung manh me o cac nha su va ni co nhu bat ky ai) de dat den muc dich giac ngo nhanh hon. Tu do tro di, Phat giao Kim Cang thua o Tay Tang chu yeu tu tap trong cac ngoi chua va am, va tham chi nhung nguoi tu tap yoga o Tay Tang, von khong bi cam doan sac duc, cung thuong song an dat tai nhung ngon nui. Di nhien, trong lich su Phat giao Kim Cang thua, co mot so nguoi tu tap nghiem tuc da trai nghiem cach tu tap voi mot doi tac that su, o An Do va Nepal cung nhu tai Tay Tang hay bat ky noi dau. Chi can ban khong phai la nguoi tuan theo sac gioi, Phat giao Kim Cang thua xem dieu nay la co the, it nhat ve ly thuyet, de dat duoc ket qua tinh than cung muc do hoac tham chi tot hon bang cach tap chung mot cap. Do khong phai la trai nghiem mot moi quan he nhat dinh ve su tuong dong giua tinh yeu lang man va ton giao, giua su bi an va hop nhat tinh duc ma theo mot cach nao do bao gom trong kien thuc thieng lieng cua moi ton giao. Song theo cac dai su Phat giao Tay Tang noi, su nguy hiem cua viec nga tu cam hung ton giao cua mot nguoi tu tap Kim Cang thua xuong ban nang khao khat thoa man sac duc bam sinh cua moi nguoi trong chung ta la qua lon voi hau het moi nguoi. Khi toi bat dau nghien cuu Phat giao Kim Cang thua hon 35 nam truoc, khi con la mot sinh vien tre, toi som co cam giac rang vi su kho khan dac biet cua viec phat trien dinh tinh de tranh cu nga nay, viec tu tap Kim Cang thua theo cap thuc te co le tro thanh hinh thuc cao nhat co the hinh dung ve su kho hanh. Do do, ngay ca khi thoi nay co mot so it nguoi tu tap Kim Cang thua co theo duoi viec tu tap hai nguoi, day la thoi quen khong duoc khuyen khich boi cac dai su Phat giao Tay Tang hang dau. Cach day vai nam, khi Dat Lai Lat Ma hien thoi (nguoi, voi tu cach la phat tu Tay Tang, tu tap hang ngay voi cac hinh anh giong nhu hinh anh ban gui cho toi) duoc hoi lieu co dai su Tay Tang nao du tieu chuan de giang day ve cach tu tap Kim Cang thua hai nguoi, ong chi don gian noi: "Khong!”. - Vay cac hinh anh do xuat xu tu dau, thua giao su? - Xuat xu cua nhung hinh anh do la Phat Giao Kim Cang thua An Do. Nhung hinh anh loai nay o An Do co tu khoang the ky thu 11 song y tuong ve no it nhat co tu the ky thu 7 hoac thu 8. Khi Phat giao Kim Cang thua du nhap vao Tay Tang tu An Do vao the ky thu 8 va thu 9 va mot lan nua vao the ky thu 10 va 12, hinh tuong nay da duoc mang theo. No duoc phat trien hoan hao trong nhieu the ky o Tay Tang va gan nhu co mat tai khap noi tren cac bich hoa va tuong tai cac den chua Tay Tang. Buc anh ban gui cho toi dut khoat la Phat giao Tay Tang va co le duoc tac o mot nuoc chau A co su anh huong van hoa Phat giao Tay Tang (Nepal, Bhutan, vung Himalaya o An Do) hoac o phuong Tay. Ngay nay, ban co the tim thay mot so phat tu phuong Tay hoc cach ve va tac nhung buc tuong nghe thuat Phat giao Tay Tang kinh dien. Tuy nhien, co ba dieu khac la ve buc tuong dong nay: 1) Nguoi nu co ve nhu lon hon so voi cac hinh anh Tay Tang ma toi su dung trong cac nghien cuu cua minh. 2) Hinh dang nguc trai cua nguoi nu kha khac thuong, thong thuong ban se thay no nho hon va it nhon hon. 3) Tu the kiet gia cua vi Phat cung kha bat thuong, thong thuong cac ngon cai cua nhan vat nay chum lai trong cac hinh anh kiet gia cua Phat giao Tay Tang. Ba chi tiet do co the goi y rang nhan vat khong phai duoc tac boi mot nghe si Tay Tang hoac Nepal, nhung nguoi von quen thuoc voi hinh thuc nay, ma la mot nguoi phuong Tay, nguoi co le co xu huong binh dang nam nu va co the khong muon mieu ta mot nguoi nu nho hon nhieu so voi vi Phat. Song day chi la y kien rieng cua toi va co the khong dung, boi toi khong chuyen ve cac phong cach nghe thuat ma chi ve hinh tuong. - Day don gian la mot loai hinh nghe thuat hay la mot truong phai Phat giao? - Khi thuong duoc goi, duoc xem la mot phai thuoc Phat giao Dai thua boi nhung nguoi khai sinh An Do cung nhu nhung nguoi thua ke Tay Tang. Phat hoc phuong Dong va phuong Tay thuong biet ve ba giai doan trong lich su Phat giao: Phat giao nguyen thuy (tu Tieu thua - Hinayana, thuong tranh dung vi no mang tinh che bai), Dai thua - Mahayana, va Mat tong. Phat tu Tay Tang tu tap Dai thua va Mat tong. Nhieu nha su Phat giao Tay Tang va ni co danh nhieu nam hoc chuyen sau ve kinh van va luan thuyet Dai thua truoc khi bat dau hoc Kim Cang thua Cac dai su Kim Cang thua Tay Tang khuyen ban khong nen tu tap Kim Cang thua truoc khi co du dinh tinh danh cho no. Viec gia tang cac nang luong tinh duc trong co the khong chi de ho khong hanh dong ra ngoai khuon kho nhu nhung nguoi luyen ai thong thuong ma de chuyen hoa, kiem soat va “tinh than hoa” chung la chuyen het suc nhay cam, mot so nguoi tham chi xem no nguy hiem, giong nhu thac nuoc trong vi du ma toi da noi tren. Nen viec thuc hanh ren luyen tinh than, phat trien long trac an duoi moi tinh huong co the va on dinh tam tri la dieu quan trong de bat dau con duong nay. Voi ten goi “Shington” va “Tendai”, Kim Cang thua hoac Mat tong cung duoc tu tap o Nhat, du nguoi Nhat chua bao gio chap nhan hoan toan bieu tuong sac duc va do do khong gioi thieu no trong hinh thuc nghe thuat Phat giao bi truyen. Do do, qua thuc ban co the noi thuat mieu ta yab-yum la mot loai hinh nghe thuat, loai hinh dac biet mo ta cac y tuong ton giao trong hinh thuc nghe thuat. - Loai hinh nay co pho bien o cac noi khac tren the gioi? - Cac hinh anh yab-yum duoc su dung bat ky noi dau co nguoi theo Phat giao Tay Tang, o Tay Tang va khu vuc xung quanh (Nepal, Bhutan, Bac An Do, Trung Quoc, Mong Co…) hoac o phuong Tay. Dac biet, khi nguoi Trung Quoc chiem dong Tay Tang va khoang 100.000 nguoi Tay Tang, gom ca Dat Lai Lat Ma roi khoi noi day nhu nhung nguoi ti nan va mang truong phai Phat giao cua ho den bat ky noi dau ho dat chan den. Cac cong dong Phat giao Tay Tang lon nho duoc thanh lap hau nhu o moi nuoc phuong Tay duoi su anh huong cua cac dai su Phat giao Tay Tang luu vong, tham chi o nhung noi nhu Brazil hoac Chile. Toi doan tong cong phai co it nhat vai trieu nguoi phuong Tay cai sang Phat giao Tay Tang. Ly do chu yeu cua ho khong phai la hy vong co cac cuoc phieu luu tinh duc trong hinh thuc dac biet nay ma la, mot mat vi tu tuong tu do ton giao ma nhieu dai su Tay Tang dau tranh, va mat khac, la co hoi co duoc cach tap luyen bai ban mot trong nhung con duong tinh than tien bo nhat trong lich su ton giao. Toi noi voi tu cach mot nguoi khong theo dao Phat, tuy nhien la nguoi nhan thuc duoc thuc te rang ca hai dieu nay da dan bien mat khoi cac giao hoi Thien Chua giao o phuong Tay trong mot thoi gian dai. Toi khong nen tranh ne thuc te rang cung co mot phong trao nhat dinh cua nhung nguoi o phuong Tay, nhung nguoi, theo y kien cua toi, hieu nham muc dich ton giao cua Kim Cang thua va su dung no nhu cach thuc hanh tinh duc duoi moi hinh thuc ma ho khoac lac la “thuoc ve ton giao”. Tam gac cong viec ban ron qua mot ben, moi buoi sang ong co mat tai tram chan doan xet nghiem va dieu tri thuoc Chi cuc Thu y TP HCM (151 Ly Thuong Kiet, quan 11) vao luc 8 gio de tu minh xem xet viec chan doan cho chu cho cung dang bi mot can benh noi khoa kha nang. Con ong T. (o Thanh Da), duoc menh danh la nguoi nuoi cho nhieu nhat o TP HCM, co lan di cong tac xa nhung nhan duoc dien thoai o nha bao co mot con cho bi benh nang, ong lap tuc tam gac cong viec lai voi vang mua ve may bay tro ve de xem benh tinh cua chu cho cung the nao. Hang thang, ong deu co che do kham suc khoe cho chung, voi moi giong cho khac nhau ong deu co cach cham soc cu the. Dan cho cua ong ngay cang mot dong hon, nhung ong kien quyet khong ban bot mot con nao ca. Cung vi me cho, ong Phuong (quan 6) quyet dinh mo mot sieu thi cho meo mang ten Pet Mart Phuong Anh de thoa man thu cham soc va suu tap cac giong cho meo cua khach o khap noi, va de truyen lai nhung kinh nghiem cham soc loai dong vat bon chan ma ong yeu thich cho nhieu nguoi biet.

Hoc sinh danh nhau chi vi bi cho la nhin deu Tags: Pham Thanh Dam, Ha Noi, Cuc Canh, trat tu xa hoi, quan ly hanh chinh, danh hoi dong, xu huong tang, gay xon xao, hoc sinh, chi vi, bao luc, danh nhau, hoc duong, cho la, truong
"Bao luc hoc duong co xu huong tang, ly do chi vi ghen tuc, tham chi bi cho la nhin deu", thieu tuong Pham Thanh Dam, Cuc truong Cuc Canh sat Quan ly hanh chinh ve trat tu xa hoi nhan dinh.
> Clip nu sinh Ha Noi bi danh hoi dong gay xon xao
Ngay 28/7 tai hoi thao giai phap phong ngua tu xa va ngan chan tinh trang hoc sinh danh nhau to chuc o Ha Noi, thieu tuong Pham Thanh Dam cho biet, ty le hoc sinh, sinh vien, thanh thieu nien pham toi va vi pham phap luat chiem 1/4 tong so vu pham phap hinh su xay ra tren ca nuoc (trung binh 10.000 vu moi nam). Khong chi nam gioi ma nu gioi cung pham toi roi quay clip dua len mang Internet.
Nam 2009-2010 da xay ra 7 vu hoc sinh danh nhau co su dung hung khi dan den chet nguoi. Hoc sinh khong chi bao luc trong truong ma con cau ket voi thanh thieu nien da bo hoc danh hoc sinh khac hoac to chuc danh hoi dong. Tham gia danh nhau phan lon la hoc sinh cuoi cap.
"Bao luc trong hoc duong khong giam ma co xu huong tang. Nhung vu an su dung vu khi ngay cang nhieu voi vu khi gay thuong tich nang. Ly do chi vi mau thuan, vi ghen tuc, tham chi chi vi cho rang bi nhin deu", ong Dam cho biet.
Thu truong Bo Giao duc va Dao tao Tran Quang Quy cung cap thong tin, tu dau nam hoc 2009 den nay, toan quoc da xay ra gan 1.600 vu hoc sinh danh nhau, hon 700 em da bi duoi hoc, gan 1.000 hoc sinh bi khien trach, 1.500 hoc sinh bi canh cao. "Ben canh tinh hieu thang cua tuoi moi lon thi viec quan tam, day do cua nha truong va gia dinh khong tot cung la yeu to khien cac em mac loi", ong Quy noi.

Thoi gian u benh sui mao ga la bao nhieu lau	Thứ ba, 05 Tháng tám 2008, 19:28 GMT+7	Sui mao ga la mot trong nhung benh lay truyen qua duong tinh duc.
Trong thoi gian u benh sui mao ga (chua co bieu hien gi) neu em di xet nghiem thi co the biet chinh xac minh co mac benh khong? (Le Thi Luyen) Tra loi: Sui mao ga la mot trong nhung benh lay truyen qua duong tinh duc. Bieu hien la nhung nu sui nho giong nhu mao ga, hoa lo o am ho, am dao, co tu cung, mieng, hong hoac duong vat, doi khi xung quanh lo hau mon. Do la nhung u lanh tinh cua te bao do virus HPV, lay truyen chu yeu qua giao hop. Thoi gian u benh tu vai tuan den vai thang. Sui mao ga phat trien nhanh khi co thai. Viec moc nhieu sui mao ga trong khi co thai thi co the anh huong den con khi sinh de. Bieu hien sui mao ga nhu the nao? Do la nhung mun moc thanh cuc nho, khong dau, hong hoac hoi nau, be mat xu xi, hinh thu nhu hoa lo, doi khi thay ngua. O phu nu thuong moc o mep hoac ben trong am dao, xung quanh hau mon. O nam gioi thuong moc o duong vat, cung co the o biu hoac xung quanh hau mon. Benh co kha nang lay truyen cao cho ban tinh neu khong duoc dieu tri kip thoi. Sui mao ga nguy hiem vi lam tang nguy co ung thu co tu cung - mot loai ung thu gay ra boi virus HPV (rat nhieu nghien cuu cho thay tinh trang nhiem HPV trong 99,8% truong hop ung thu co tu cung). Can phai nhan manh rang nhiem HPV xay ra truoc khi xuat hien cac ton thuong loan san va sau do la cac ton thuong ung thu co tu cung. O nam gioi, benh cung co the gay ung thu duong vat neu khong duoc dieu tri. Hau het sui mao ga nho va it thuong tu mat di, co the khong can chua tri gi, nhung mat nhieu thoi gian. Nhung truong hop nang, nhieu thi phai chua o benh vien co chuyen khoa da lieu. Viec dieu tri sui mao ga chu yeu nham pha huy ton thuong sui chu khong the tieu diet duoc virus. Tuy theo vi tri va do rong cua ton thuong ma co the lua chon mot trong nhung cach dieu tri sau: Cham dung dich trichloactic acid: Dung mot que nho hoac mot cai tam bong, cham rat can than mot it dung dich trichloactic acid len nhung not sui cho den khi sui nay trang ra. Khi co thai cung co the dung thuoc nay, nhung khong duoc cham vao co tu cung, lo nieu dao hoac phia trong hau mon. Hoac boi dung dich podophyllotoxine 20-25% theo cach tren cho den khi sui mao ga tro thanh mau nau. Chu y: podophyllotoxine thuong chi dung cho nhung ton thuong nho o am ho. Cham moi tuan mot lan va phai rua sach thuoc sau 1-3 gio (de lau qua se gay loet da). Khong duoc dung thuoc nay trong khi co thai, khong boi thuoc vao trong am dao, co tu cung, lo nieu dao, mieng hoac phia trong hau mon. Sau khi ton thuong da khoi, van can cham nhac lai vung ton thuong sau mot tuan va can nhac lai nhu vay vai lan. Trong khi dung thuoc, neu thay phan ung tai cho manh thi co the dung cach quang lau hon roi moi chua tiep. Doi voi nhung ton thuong rong hoac o nhieu noi phai dieu tri bang ap lanh hoac dot bang laser. Nguy co cua sui mao ga la ung thu co tu cung nen nhung phu nu co sui mao ga phai lam xet nghiem soi te bao am dao hang nam de phat hien som nhung thay doi co the dan den benh nay. Phu nu da co quan he tinh duc can lam xet nghiem nay hai nam mot lan. Day la cach duy nhat de loai tru som ung thu co tu cung o nguoi co sui mao ga. Chu y: Khi chua tri, nen boi thuoc mo xung quanh cho sui de bao ve vung da lanh. Thuoc chua sui mao ga thuong gay loet, dau trong thoi gian ngan o noi bi ton thuong. Can giu vet loet cho sach va kho, khong quan he tinh duc trong thoi gian dieu tri. Su dung bao cao su trong quan he tinh duc cho den khi khong con sui mao ga, sau khi dieu tri khoi van phai dung bao cao su it nhat 6 thang. Neu ban cam thay minh co nguy co bi mac benh nay nen di kham ngay de phat hien benh kip thoi. Ngoai ra, nen song lanh manh de tranh mac phai nhung can benh nay!

Nhat sap co DTDD 3G cho tre em - Tin Tong hop
Tags: FOMA SA800i, DTDD 3G, NTT DoCoMo, Nhat Ban, tung ra thi truong, cho tre em, so dien thoai, dang ky, dich vu, dong, dau, vi, sap, bao,
Tao ra nhung mau dien thoai thu vi va hap dan danh rieng cho nhoc ti dang la mot trong nhung de tai "hot" cua gioi san xuat DTDD. Khong chiu thua kem Firefly, ga khong lo NTT DoCoMo cua Nhat Ban vua tung ra thi truong FOMA SA800i, "con de"... 3G dau tien than thien voi tre em.
Chua het, DoCoMo con thanh lap nguyen mot Hoi dong co van gom toan cac chuyen gia hang dau ve cac van de lien quan den tre em. Hoi dong nay co trach nhiem tu van va dua ra loi khuyen cho hang trong viec phat trien nhung san pham va dich vu phuc vu cac thuong de nhi.
Nhin luot qua, FOMA SA800i co mot hinh thuc du de lam chet lang bat cu nhoc ti nao: sac so, sinh dong va cuc ky bat mat. Cau hinh don gian, rat de su dung, kieu dang co nhieu duong cong mem mai, mo phong ken tam de nhan manh chuc nang bao ve, nang niu nguoi su dung nhi.
Co the noi, bao ve an toan cho tre chinh la muc tieu va cung la uu tien hang dau cua FOMA SA800i cung cac dich vu di kem. "Con de" nay duoc trang bi mot coi bao dong voi am luong len toi 100 decibel, kich hoat rat nhanh trong truong hop khan cap. Mot khi tre nhan coi, may se tu dong ket noi voi 3 so dien thoai dang ky san tu truoc. Quy trinh ket noi va bao dong nay chi cham dut khi ca ba so dien thoai dang ky deu da nhac may tra loi ma thoi.
Ngoai ra, cac bac phu huynh cung co the dang ky su dung dich vu dinh vi "imadoco search" cua NTT. Khi do, dien thoai cua ho se tu dong nhan duoc cac tin nhan thong bao vi tri hien tai cua dua tre voi tan suat deu dan. Khi dien thoai cua tre bi tat dot ngot, phu huynh cung se nhan duoc bao dong va thong tin cu the ve dia diem tre dang dung.
Luong truoc ban tinh to mo va hay tay may nghich ngom cua tre, pin dien thoai da duoc bao ve bang mot loai oc vit dac biet ma chi co mot cong cu dac biet moi tha long duoc chung. Nhu vay, kha nang dien thoai bi tat ngom vi mat pin da duoc NTT giam thieu den muc toi da.
Khi ban cai dat dien thoai o che do "Tre em", menu va chi dan tren man hinh se chuyen tu tieng Trung Quoc phuc tap sang van tu Nhat don gian hon. Cac bac phu huynh cung co the dung mat khau de ngan khong cho tre thay doi cai dat bao mat va mang cua may.
Mot chuc nang rat phu hop voi nguoi dung nhi la goi truc tiep. Khi nhan vao phim tat tren than may, 5 so dien thoai da dang ky truoc se hien len tren man hinh, cho phep tre goi hoac gui email mot cach de dang.
FOMA SA800i cung tuong thich voi "i-mode", mot dich vu cho phep chan truy cap vao nhung dia chi site khong phu hop voi lua tuoi.

Day la mot phan trong du an "nha tu thong minh" duoc de xuat de tao ra su chuan bi tot nhat cho cac pham nhan de bat kip voi nhung su phat trien cong nghe sau khi thi hanh an xong.
Theo SCMP, co quan chuc nang quan ly he thong nha tu o Hong Kong dang nghien cuu ke hoach cung cap cho moi pham nhan mot may tinh bang de ho co the gui email cho ban be va gia dinh o ngoai.
Y tuong cua Co quan Dich vu Chinh huan Hong Kong cung cho phep cac tu nhan co the su dung cac thiet bi dien tu khac de phuc vu muc dich hoc tap, giai tri nhu la phuong tien de chuan bi cho mot cuoc song bi cong nghe lan at.
Day la mot phan trong du an "nha tu thong minh" voi muc tieu hien dai hoa cac co so giam giu va chinh huan o Hong Kong. Y tuong da nhan duoc su ung ho cua cac nhom hoat dong vi quyen loi cua tu nhan va mot so nghi si. Ho cho rang viec nay co the giup do cac pham nhan tai hoa nhap cong dong.
Pham nhan trong gio hoat dong the chat tai mot nha tu o Hong Kong. Anh: SCMP.
"Chung ta trung phat cac pham nhan bang cach lay di su tu do cua ho. Tuy nhien, chung ta nen duy tri cac quyen co ban cua con nguoi, nhu giao tiep va hoc tap, de nhan pham cua nhung nguoi tu khong bi anh huong", ong Richard Tsoi, nguoi dieu hanh mot nhom hoat dong xa hoi vi quyen loi cua pham nhan, cho biet.
Cac thiet bi dien tu duoc giam sat se cap cho tu nhan quyen truy cap vao cac sach dien tu (ebook), cong thong tin de hoc tap truc tuyen va tham chi cho phep ho gui email cho gia dinh, ban be, luat su va cac quan chuc trong thoi gian giai tri. Noi dung se duoc kiem duyet truoc khi gui di.
Tra loi SCMP, co quan chuc nang cho biet viec cap may tinh bang cho nguoi bi giam giu se tao dieu kien thuan loi hon de ho tu hoc tap, tu phuc vu nhu cau ban than va giai tri, voi muc dich cuoi cung la de ket noi ho voi cuoc song hien dai sau khi ra tu. Du lieu tu hoat dong cua pham nhan tren may tinh bang cung se duoc thu thap de phuc vu cong tac phan tich.
Co quan Dich vu Chinh huan Hong Kong cung dang xem xet mo rong cac chuc nang cua mot day vong deo tay thong minh ma ho dang thu nghiem. Ngoai viec theo doi tinh trang suc khoe cua pham nhan theo thoi gian thuc, vong tay thong minh co the duoc su dung de mua ban cac vat pham trong cang-tin nha tu hoac dang ky lam viec.
Du an "nha tu thong minh" la mot trong nhung sang kien ma truong dac khu hanh chinh Hong Kong, ba Carrie Lam de xuat hoi thang 10 nam ngoai. Ke tu do, chinh quyen da thu nghiem cac thiet bi thong minh, bao gom he thong theo doi, phan tich hinh anh, vong deo tay thong minh de theo doi su khoe pham nhan o mot so nha tu nhat dinh.
Hien tai dac khu hanh chinh Hong Kong co tong cong hon 8.100 pham nhan. Ty le pham nhan bi tai giam giu sau 2 nam la 24,8%, theo thong ke nam 2016.

Ban vo via he nghe cua sinh vien mua khai giang
Tags: Nguyen Van Cu, Vinh Tien, DH Kinh, TP HCM, chu yeu la, sinh vien, via he, khai giang, kinh te, tren duong, ban, vo, nghe, mua, hang,
"Viet bang vo Vinh Tien - hoc gioi hon, thong minh hon, mai do, mai do!", nhung cau rao hang di dom nay la cua doi quan sinh vien ban vo tren duong Nguyen Van Cu, TP HCM. 1-2 nam nay, ban vo via he da tro thanh nghe "tay trai" cua ho vao mua khai giang.
Sinh vien dang ban vo tren duong Nguyen Van Cu. Anh: Hai Minh
Cuong (sinh vien nam thu tu DH Kinh te), nguoi co tham nien 3 nam nghe, cho biet, dan ban vo chu yeu la sinh vien cac DH nhu: Kinh Te, Luat, Nhan Van, dong nhat la sinh vien Kinh Te. Ban dau doi ngu ban vo chi la mot nhom nho, ve sau thay cong viec an nen lam ra the la cac ban tre ru re nhau cung "nhao vo". Cu vao mua khai giang, khi nhu cau vo nhieu, la Cuong va cac ban lai den cac cong ty, chu yeu la Vinh Tien va Chau Long lay hang ban. "The roi cung thanh nghe lam them cho hang tram sinh vien thanh pho!", Cuong noi.
Khong du suc thue mot doan mat tien de lam cho mua ban, cac co cau cu tuong lai tran ra via he de rao ban tap vo. Cac con duong o gan truong hoc, ky tuc xa nhu: Tran Hung Dao, Cach Mang Thang 8, Le Thi Rieng... thuong duoc sinh vien chon de lam dia ban hoat dong. Trong do, con duong duoc sinh vien ua chuong nhat la Nguyen Van Cu vi noi day tap trung cum 3 truong Le Hong Phong, DH Tu nhien, DH Su pham. Chi mot doan khoang 200 met tu bung binh Cong Hoa den nha sach Nguyen Van Cu co den 20 diem ban le, chu yeu la sinh vien cua DH Kinh te.
Hue, sinh vien DH Kinh te, noi: "Dung tuong ban tap la nhan nha! Cuc lam chu chang phai choi dau!". Hue ke, 6h sang la phai day de tro hang ra ban. Co nhieu hom, met qua khong day noi, mat cu dip ca lai, nhung cung phai rang di ban. Ca ngay, phai dung ban tu sang den trua, tu trua den toi, bat ke nang mua, khong duoc nghi ngoi. "Met thi ngoi xuong nghi chu cung chang biet lam sao cho do met. Nam thi con do, cac ban nu ban tap thi dung mong gi den chuyen... giu gin sac dep", Hue than tho.
Mot "dong nghiep" cua Hue noi chen vao: "Ban tap ma riet roi nhin minh cu nhu la bui doi! Boi an thi an bui, ma cung chang co ban ghe gi ca, cu ngoi phet xuong dat roi ca bon cung ngoi an. Ban hang thi luc nao cung phai dung rao. Thay minh ngoi nghi, khach hang cung khong muon vao mua". Cac sinh vien xac dinh nghe nay chu yeu la lay cong lam lai, chu loi khong duoc bao nhieu. Trung binh, ban mot cuon vo lai 250-300 dong. Moi mua ban cung chi thu duoc tu 2 den 3 trieu moi nhom. Vi the, canh sinh vien phai tranh thu ban cang nhieu tap cang tot de do phi cong dam mua dai nang ca ngay.
Vat va, cuc nhoc, song nhieu ban tre rat say voi nghe. Hong An, sinh vien DH Khoa hoc Xa hoi Nhan van, cho biet, nhung ngay ban tap vua qua, ban da danh dum duoc mot so von de tau mot chiec dien thoai di dong. Nho do, ban co the lien lac voi nhung khach hang moi den dat hang si de mang ve cac tinh tieu thu. An noi: "Nghe nay giup minh yen tam ve kinh te de hoc tiep nam cuoi DH ma khong phai nho va den gia dinh. Tuy chi la diem ban nho, nhung day chinh la noi uom mam cho nhung uoc mo cua tui minh".

Su ket hop hoan hao giua dau hu non va nam mang lai mon an thanh dam, thom ngon cho ngay Ram thang 7.
Nguyen lieu can chuan bi
- 6 mieng dau hu trang
- 80 gram moc nhi (nam meo)
- Mot it hanh la
- Nuoc da
- Gia vi: bot ngot, muoi, tieu, nuoc tuong, duong, dau hao chay
So che nguyen lieu
- Dau hu mua ve rua sach, xat lam doi roi de cho that rao nuoc.
- Hanh la rua sach roi xat nho.
- Ca chua rua sach, got vo, xat hat luu.
- Moc nhi ngam trong nuoc am cho no ra. Sau do cat goc, rua sach se roi xat soi vua an.
Cach lam dau hu nhoi nam sot ca chua
- Buoc 1: Cho dau vao chao sao cho vua ngap mat roi bac len bep, van lua lon. Doi dau nong gia thi ha lua, cho dau hu vao chien chin vang deu cac mat roi ngam trong to nuoc da lanh.
- Buoc 2: Dung dao rach 4 duong hinh chu nhat tren mieng dau. Sau do, lay muong muc ruot trong mieng dau ra. Luon muong can than de khong bi rach lop vo dau.
- Buoc 3: Tron nam voi phan ruot dau hu vua lay ra va mot phan hanh la bam nho, them 1 it tieu, bot ngot, muoi, duong roi tron deu de lam nhan. Sau do, nhoi phan nhan vao tung mieng dau rong ruot.
- Buoc 4: Mang di chien cho mieng dau chac lai.
- Buoc 5: Dung ngay chao chien dau, phi thom hanh la roi cho ca chua vao. Day nap nau trong vong 3-5 phut, dung muong nghien ca chua nhuyen ra lam nuoc sot. Nem vao mot it nuoc tuong, dau hao, duong, muoi, bot ngot, nua chen nuoc roi khuay deu cho gia vi tan ra.
Sau do, cho dau hu vao, van lua nho liu riu, kho den khi nuoc trong chao set lai la duoc.

Bao nhieu nam nay, mot su lua chon "co dien" van duoc nu gioi van phong coi la so 1, do la dam lien mot mau! Don gian vi trong khong gian cong so, loai trang phuc nay van tao duoc su hap dan ben canh ve nghiem tuc va manh me cua "quyen luc nu"!
Vay bo chen
Khong ai co the phu nhan duoc ve lich lam va tinh te cua mot chiec vay bo chen co dien. Voi nhung mau khong qua tre nhu xam, xanh bien hoac den, ket hop voi mot chiec vong co, khi dien chiec vay nay den cong so ban trong se chang phu phiem chut nao dau! Vao mua dong, ban co the them su am ap cho chiec vay dai toi dau goi cua minh bang mot cai ao khoac dai co duong vien. Loai vai thich hop voi kieu vay nay: len, soi, lua...
Vay tay ngan

8 dau hieu chung to tre co chi so EQ cao rat de thanh cong sau nay
Tags: Emotional Quotient, Tri tue xuc cam, tri thong minh, quan trong hon, nhung thay doi, anh minh hoa, cam xuc, dau hieu, bo me, co the, chi so, ky nang, tre, biet, giup,
Khi tri tue xuc cam (Emotional Quotient) dang dan duoc coi la quan trong hon tri thong minh, cac chuyen gia cung da chi ra nhung dau hieu nay o tre de bo me co the de dang nhan biet.
Bat ki nguoi me nao cung biet rang tre em giong nhu bot bien va lien tuc bat chuoc theo nhung gi chung thay va nghe duoc trong qua trinh lon len.
Neu da phan chung ta van thuong nghi rang tre phat trien tot la dat duoc nhung dau moc nhat dinh, nhan biet mau sac hay dem duoc den 10... thi cac nha nghien cuu da phat hien ra rang tri thong minh ve mat cam xuc cung rat quan trong, tham chi la quan trong hon tri thong minh binh thuong doi voi su thanh cong trong tuong lai cua tre.
Tri tue xuc cam hay EQ (viet tat cua cum tu "Emotional Quotient" – chi so cam xuc) la kha nang nhan thuc, hieu, truyen dat va kiem soat cam xuc.
EQ cao giup tre phat trien ky nang giao tiep, hoa dong voi ban be va cac ky nang xa hoi khac nhu ky nang ung xu, lanh dao, lam viec trong nhom... EQ la nen tang cho su thanh dat cua be sau nay.
Vay chi so nay o be nha ban co cao khong, lam sao de biet va do luong duoc? Sau day la 8 dau hieu ma cac chuyen gia den tu Vien Gottman da chi ra:
1. Tre khoc
Cha me nen khuyen khich tre boc lo het moi cam xuc boi no giup tre cam thay duoc an toan va duoc lang nghe (Anh minh hoa).
Kha nang boc lo cam xuc la mot trong nhung dieu dau tien ma chung ta hoc duoc tu khi con nho. Tuy nhien, khi lon len kha nang nay co the bi kim nen, boi moi nguoi luon bao chung ta phai ngung khoc - day la dieu phai dung lai ngay.
Thay vao do, chung ta nen khuyen khich tre boc lo het moi cam xuc, boi nhu the khong chi giup tre cam thay duoc an toan, duoc lang nghe, ma thuc chat con la mot dau hieu cua tri tue cam xuc.
2. Tre biet thong cam
Nhan biet tinh trang cam xuc cua nguoi khac va the hien su thau hieu, cam thong khong phai la mot ky nang de dang hoc duoc o nguoi lon, chu chua noi gi den tre em.
Neu tre biet om ban khi thay ban buon, hay muon giup do nhung dua tre khac o san choi, thi do chinh la dau hieu cua su thong cam.
3. Tre co the ke ten cam xuc
Cac chuyen gia khuyen rang bo me nen khuyen khich tre ke ra ten cam xuc cua chung. Viec xac dinh duoc cam xuc hay su kien cu the khien tre thay buon, tuc gian, so hai... se giup ich rat nhieu trong viec ngan nhung dieu nay tai dien trong tuong lai, va giup giai quyet van de mot cach de dang. Day la mot trong nhung yeu to mau chot cua tri tue xuc cam.
4. Tre noi chuyen voi bo me
Tro chuyen voi bo me cung la 1 cach giup tre tro nen thong minh hon ve mat cam xuc (Anh minh hoa).
Boc lo cam xuc va tu do tao lien ket voi nhung nguoi khac la cach de tro nen thong minh hon ve mat cam xuc.
Bo me nen khich le tre noi chuyen, tam su khi con gap bat ki van de gi va ket noi voi tre ve mat cam xuc de giup con giai quyet cac van de ma con dang gap phai.
5. Tre to mo
Coi mo va luon muon hoc hoi them ve the gioi xung quanh la mot dau hieu cua tri tue xuc cam. Neu con ban lien tuc hoi "vi sao" hay bi cuon hut boi nhung cau chuyen ve cach moi nguoi vuot qua kho khan, thu thach thi ban hoan toan nen khuyen khich tre tiep tuc lam nhu vay.
6. Tre biet lang nghe
Nhung dua tre co chi so thong minh cam xuc cao thuong la nhung tre biet lang nghe nhung cau chuyen cua nguoi khac. Bo me cung hoan toan co the day tre cach lang nghe moi nguoi.
7. Tre thich nghi tot voi nhung thay doi
Neu be nha ban cam thay de dang voi nhung thay doi trong thoi quen, ne nep thi nghia la chung da hoc duoc mot yeu to then chot cua tri tue xuc cam roi day (Anh minh hoa).
Day cung la dieu kho khan voi nguoi lon, dac biet la nhung thay doi khong duoc suon se nhu du dinh. Neu be nha ban cam thay de dang voi nhung thay doi trong thoi quen hay co the kiem soat duoc nhung tin khong mong doi hay dang that vong, thi tin vui la chung da hoc duoc mot yeu to then chot cua tri tue xuc cam roi day.
Bo me cung co the giup tre phat trien kha nang nay bang cach lam mau cho tre cach ung xu khi gap nhung tinh huong khong mong doi hay khung hoang.
8. Tre co the giu binh tinh
Da so moi dua tre khi con nho khong hoc duoc ky nang kiem soat cam xuc va xu ly chuyen ngoai y muon. Bo me nen vo tay khen ngoi tre khi chung phat trien duoc ky nang nhu biet hit tho sau, dem, biet cach de binh tinh... Day la nhung ky nang kho nhung vo cung quan trong.

Co hay khong chung teo duong vat o nguoi tre - Hoi dap suc khoe
Tags: Vo Sang, lam tang kich thuoc, co hay khong, lap gia dinh, duong vat to, chua ket hon, co the, cuong cung, tinh duc, khong co, kha nang, xuat tinh, thuoc, cm, den,
- BS DAO XUAN DUNG (Chuyen khoa II, San phu khoa): Theo cac thay thuoc, chi co the co hien tuong teo duong vat bat dau tu tuoi 40 tro di. Cac te bao tinh hoan bat dau thoai hoa va duoc thay the bang cac soi tao keo (collagen), luong hormon testosterone cung giam dan keo theo giam ham muon tinh duc, tan suat giao hop cung thua ra, duong vat nho va ngan lai.
Kich thuoc duong vat nhu da neu o tren van nam trong gioi han binh thuong vi nhieu y van cho thay duong vat luc khong cuong cung co chieu dai tu 5,5-9 cm, khi cuong co the tang len tu 7-12 cm. Nhieu khao cuu cho thay duong vat nho se tang gap doi kich thuoc vao luc cuong cung, con duong vat to chi tang 80% (o nuoc ta hinh nhu chua co cong trinh dieu tra nao ve khia canh nay cua doi song tinh duc). Mong tinh va xuat tinh ve dem hay sang cung la nhung dien bien thong thuong o moi nguoi tre.
Su tu tin cua nam gioi ve kha nang tinh duc cung co the bi anh huong do cam nhan ve kich thuoc duong vat. Mot so nguoi tin rang kich thuoc duong vat co lien quan den nam tinh, den tam voc co the, den kha nang sinh san va ca su huong thu cam xuc tinh duc cho minh va cho ban tinh. That ra mot duong vat co ve nho khi chua cuong co the co kich thuoc lon khi dat toi su cuong cung, con hon ca mot duong vat da to san.
Kha nang sinh san cung khong phu thuoc vao kich thuoc duong vat ma chi phu thuoc vao so luong va chat luong tinh trung (lam tinh dich do de xac dinh).
Neu nhu co truong hop duong vat nho thuc su trong khi cau truc van binh thuong thi can hoi y kien cac thay thuoc chuyen khoa noi hoac noi tiet de kham pha nhung nguyen nhan phuc tap hon: do bat thuong ve su bai tiet cua tinh hoan, do roi loan noi tiet hay do sai lac nhiem sac the gay kem phat trien co quan sinh duc...
Truoc day, nguoi ta tuong rang khong co cach nao lam cho duong vat cua nguoi lon to len, ke ca bang phuong phap ngoai khoa hoac noi tiet. Tiem xilicon vao duong vat nhu nguoi ta van thuong tiem vao vu cua phu nu vi muc dich tham my co the pha hong hoan toan kha nang cuong cung. Gan day nguoi ta con thay rang dua xilicon vao co the co the gay ung thu.
...Nhung da co tia sang cuoi duong ham
Gan day, tren mang Internet co quang cao ve mot loai thuoc co ten la VP-RX nham lam tang kich thuoc duong vat va la thuoc duy nhat trong so cac phuong phap lam tang kich thuoc duong vat (bom, ngoai khoa…) duoc FDA (co quan quan ly thuoc va thuc pham My) ung ho. Theo quang cao, thuoc khong chi lam tang kich thuoc duong vat ma con tang kha nang cuong cung, keo dai thoi gian quan he tinh duc (do khong bi xuat tinh som) va luong tinh dich cung nhieu hon, an toan 100%, khong co tac dung phu nao.
Thuoc duoc coi nhu la buoc dot pha cua y hoc vi xua nay tao hinh lai duong vat de to len van la kho khan chua vuot qua duoc. Khi da dat kich thuoc mong muon thi ngung thuoc nhung VP-RX dem lai ket qua mot cach an toan va vinh vien. Hien nay hon 1 trieu ruoi lo thuoc da duoc ban ra, moi lo dung du cho 1 thang.
Khac voi cac loai co khac cua co the, duong vat co cau truc de co the to hon nua; nhung nghien cuu ve duoc thao gan day cung xac nhan kha nang ay nghia la duong vat con co the phat trien to hon nua so voi khi da cuong cung hoan toan. Lam cho duong vat to len dan dan la dieu chu yeu de co ket qua lau dai, so di nhung phuong phap truoc day khong dem lai ket qua ben vung va khong an toan vi da di nguoc lai quy luat sinh ly cua co the. Co the bao gio cung phat trien dan dan, khong the chi qua mot dem.
Co che de lam cho duong vat to ra dua tren tac dong toi cau truc cua duong vat, co quan nay gom 3 buong, 2 buong o phia tren nam canh nhau la mo de cuong cung (con goi la the hang) va 1 buong nho phia duoi co nieu dao de nuoc tieu ra va de xuat tinh (the xop). Khi bi kich thich tinh duc, nao giai phong ra mot hooc-mon lam cho mau di toi duong vat va lam day cac the hang; khi nhung khoang o the hang chua day mau la luc duong vat cuong cung hoan toan. Thuoc VP-RX lam tang gioi han gian no cua the hang nen mau di toi the hang nhieu hon, lam cho muc do cuong cung tang them.
Ket qua thu duoc: sau thang dau dung thuoc, kich thuoc duong vat tang len 1 inch (2,5 cm) va tang ca duc nang, ca cuong do cuong cung, cam thay co khoai cam hon trong quan he tinh duc. Sau thang thu 2, duong vat tang len den 2 inch (5 cm) ve chieu dai va chieu rong cung tang den 5%. Sau 3 thang, kich thuoc duong vat dai them den 3 inch (7,5cm), to them 10%. Sau 4-5 thang, tang them 4 inch (10 cm) va van co nhung tac dung tich cuc nhu thang thu 1.
Mot khao sat gan day cho thay 67% phu nu thua nhan khong co hanh phuc do kich thuoc duong vat cua chong, dieu do chung to kich thuoc duong vat thuc su co vai tro trong khoai cam tinh duc voi ca 2 phia. Tuy nhien, cung nhu Viagra, thuoc VP-RX chua co o thi truong nuoc ta va con phai cho them nhieu thong nua cua y van the gioi de co du do tin cay hoan toan.

Tap the duc phong va tri dau lung
Xem bản tiếng việt đầy đủ tại đây : http://thethao60s.com/index/372084/22092007.aspxTap the duc phong va tri dau lung
Dau lung (DL) do nhieu nguyen nhan. Bai nay chi ban den benh DL do co bi lao ton va cach tap de phong chua. Tuy la benh phuc tap nhung neu nam duoc hieu biet can thiet, biet ro nguyen nhan va phuong phap tap dung thi se dat duoc ket qua kha quan.
Xuong song con nguoi gom 33 dot xuong song (7 dot song (DS) co, 12 DS nguc, 5 DS that lung, 5 DS cung dinh lien voi nhau tao thanh xuong cung va cac DS cut dinh vao nhau tao nen xuong cut). Moi DS deu co than dot, cung dot va mom dot. Cac DS duoc lien ket voi nhau bang cac dia sun giua chung. Suot doc theo chieu dai cua cot song, o mat truoc va mat sau cac dot song deu co cac day chang doc truoc va sau bam vao. Khop giua cac mom khop (tren va duoi cac dot ke nhau) la cac khop dong loai phang, co bao khop boc quanh. Tai cac cung dot giua cac mom ngang va mom gai cung cac dau mom gai deu co cac day chang. Xuong song duoc tao boi cac DS, phan thanh 5 doan tren, khong thang ma co 2 doan cong vong nen co dan tinh nhat dinh.
Nho cac khop DS va cac co bao boc co duoi ma con nguoi co the lam cac dong tac cui gap, ngua ra sau, nghieng sang hai ben va quay van nguoi. Xet theo ket cau, doan DS that lung roi den doan DS co co bien do cu dong, cong nang va chiu tai da dang, nang hon ca. Ngoai phu tai than minh, con phai chiu dung ca ganh nang, cac xung chan do hoat dong lao dong, sinh hoat, tap luyen hang ngay gay nen. Suc manh o cac co eo, lung ma kem, lai them su khong thich ung voi cac cu dong quay, gap duoi voi luong van dong qua muc la nguyen nhan chinh lam cho khoang 10-20%nguoi trung cao tuoi bi benh nay.
Muon phong chong DL loai tren, can tap luyen thich hop de nang cao suc manh cua cac co eo, bung. Uong thuoc gi, dan cao nao, dung bat cu phuong phap tri lieu khac deu khong the lam cho nhung co noi tren manh len. Co nguoi lai dai bung de phong chong DL. Nhu the cang tai hai. Thoi gian dai, cac co o do se bi suy theo, bung eo kem suc di nen cang de DL.
Tap luyen tang suc manh cho cac co eo lung khong phuc tap. Co may dong tac chinh sau: Dung thang roi cui than tren cho den sat mat truoc cua chan hay nam ngua gap chan cho den sat than tren (bung nguc). Ke den lam theo cac dong tac: hinh 1- nam ngua gap han chan len gan bung, hinh 2- ngoi gap dong thoi ca chan lan than tren vuong goc voi nhau, hinh 3- nam ngua gap than tren, hinh 4 - hai tay doc theo than, gap thang chan len thanh vuong goc... Khi suc manh co da kha hon, co the nam hai tay om sau gay hoac treo vat nang vua phai vao chan hoac than tren de tap gap lai. Nang do kho len, suc manh cua co cung tang theo. Cac yeu cau ve bien do dong tac tren co the gia giam theo suc luc tung nguoi. Nhieu dong tac co the tap tren giuong va khong nen quen khoi dong, nhat la o vung eo lung. PGS. Nguyen Toan

Doctor Ka Zawhna (Sept. 30, 2018)
Zawhna: Ka pu, kum 21 ka ni a, pasal ka nei tawh a, kan inneih hmain sex kan hmang a, thla 3 vel ka period lo a, kan inneih hnuah thla 5 vel a liam leh tawh a, ka period hi a mumal lo em em a, nau ka pai bawk si lo a. Engvang nge ni ang? Ka mang a ang takzet. Min puih theih chuan ka lawm ngawt ang.
Chhanna: Thi neih chungchang hi kan ziak fo tawh a. Hmeichhe tan chuan a pawimawh em em mai a, thi neiha taksaa hormones chi hrang hrang in-play kual vel hian organs pawimawh tak tak a enkawl a, rilru lam kalphung “mood” thlengin a effect thei a ni. Hormones dang pawimawh tak tak a inrawlh bawk a, a bikin thyroid hormones hi a pawimawh hle. Thi neih that leh that lohah hian vun dinhmunte hi a innghat viau mai bawk.
Thi neih buai kan tih hian a neih hunbi a nei lo, hunbi inthlak sek te, nei tlem lutuk emaw tam lutuk te a ni thei a; tin, i rawn insawiselna ang a hmaa nei pangngai si, nei thei ta lo angte hi a awm fo bawk. Taksa emaw, rilru hah (stress) emaw hian thi neih a tibuai hma khawp mai bawk a. Chuvang tak chuan mihring nunphung a kan ngaih pawimawh – chaw ei hunbi te, zan mut hun leh zing thawh hunbi mumal tak neihte hi a pawimawh em em a ni. Ei leh in chungchang pawh hi a pawimawh khawp mai. Ei tlem lutuk emaw ei tam lutuk hi a tha lo va, mawm lam ei nasat lutukte hian thi neih a tibuai duh hle. Tin, thau lutuk (obesity) hian thi neihah nghawng a nei duh hle. Chutiang bawkin thau hlauh lutuk vanga ei in insum vakte hian thi neih a tibuai leh fo bawk.
Pasal i neih hmain sex i hman thu i sawi a, chumi hnuah chuan thi i neih loh thu i sawi a, hemi tum hian nau i pai leh pai loh i sawi hranpa lo va. I hriat lohin nau i lo pai a ni thei ang em? Naupai thenkhat chu hriat mang lem lohin an naupai a tla thei a, chutiang chu Missed Abortion kan ti a, an thi neih pangngai aia tam an nei tih loh chu insawiselna an nei lo fo thin. Hemi hnu hian pasal i nei a, i thi neih a mumal loh thu i sawi leh a, chuti a nih chuan thi i nei lo tawp ni lovin mumal lo takin i nei zeuh zeuh tihna a nih hmel. Nau i pai loh thu i sawi hian pregnancy test i ti niah lo ngai ta ila, ultrasound hmanga enchian a tha hle mai. I chhul leh chi bawm te enchian theih nise, fel lo a awm nge awm lote chian hmasa phawt ta la. Tha berah chuan hmeichhe doctor lo inentir thei la a tha hle mai.
Hmeichhiain nau an pai hian thi an nei lo tlangpui a, a thenah chuan hriat mang lohin thi put zeuh zeuh a awm thei a, chutiangah chuan thi la nei anga inngai a awm theih. Pasal neiha active sex hman bawk si chuan Pregnancy test hmanga in-check zauh zauh hi a tha hle. A thenah chuan hnute a tang a, luak chhuakte a awm thin bawk. Kum naupang lam hian nau an pai leh pai loh an hre lo fo mai. Nute mawhphurhna a ni a, nau paia hmeichhe taksa awm dante inhrilhhriat chian a pawimawh hle.
A tawp nana ka han sawi belh duh chu invenna tel lova sex hman atang hian natna inkai theih a tam khawp mai a, HIV phei chu chutianga kai chu kan tam ta hle. Nupui pasal neih hmaa sex kan hmang dawn anih si chuan invenna hman tluk a awm lo. HIV phei chu kan tam tawh em avangin kan thisen kan test anih loh phei chuan inrin mai hi a chi tawh lo. Mipa hian condom an lo pai remchang lo fo mai a, laklawh dinhmun a lo thlen tawh phei chuan nuai liam mai an awlsam. Chuvangin, hmeichhiate pawhin condom pai ve mai hi a him a ni tih kan hriat a tha hle. I fimkhur tlang teh ang u.

Comparative analysis of genetic diversity in landraces of maize (Zea mays L.) from Sichuan and Chongqing
YAO Qi-lun1,2,XU Jiang2,XU Dong-mei2,CHEN Xiu-juan2(1.Department of Life Science,Yangtze Normal College,Fuling,Chongqing 408003,China;2.Maize Research Institute,Sichuan Agricultural University,Yaan,Sichuan 625014,China)
The genetic diversity in landraces of 30 maize 15 from Sichuan and 15 from Chongqing,was tested by using 42 microsatellite(SSR) loci.256 and 248 polymorphic alleles were detected,and the average number of alleles were 6.1 and 5.9,respectively,and the average polymorphism information content(PIC) were 0.76 and 0.73,respectively.Clustering analysis separated the landraces from Sichuan and Chongqing into 4 and 3 groups,respecively.In addition,the genetic diversity was greater in Sichuan than that in Chongqing.The results based on the gentic diversity and the genetic structure showed that there was an obvious genetic differentiation from Hardy-Weinberg expectation in the landraces from both Sichuan and Chongqing and a considerable genetic variation was revealed within rather than among landraces.The genetic diversity on the basis of SSRs provides a guide for maize breeders to conserve and utilize the germplasm.

Lam the nao de Viet Nam co truong DH dang cap quoc te Tags: Viet Nam, GS Dao Trong Thi, DHQG Ha Noi, DH quoc gia Ha Noi, lam the nao de, quan ly giao duc, truong dai hoc, nhu the nao, ve van de, nha quan ly, chung ta, quoc te, dang cap, nuoc
GS Dao Trong Thi.
Do la cau hoi lon dat ra hien nay voi cac nha quan ly giao duc. Phai co nhung bien phap, cach di nhu the nao cho phu hop voi dieu kien cua VN?... Phong vien da co cuoc phong van GS Dao Trong Thi - Giam doc DHQG Ha Noi ve van de nay.
Chu truong cua nha nuoc xay dung mot truong dai hoc dang cap quoc te. Nhu vay chung ta phai xay dung tu mot truong dai hoc moi hoan toan hay xay dung tu nhung truong dai hoc da co?
Mot truong dai hoc khong phai vai nam la co the tro thanh truong dai hoc dang cap quoc te. Ma phai la mot truong dai hoc co uy tin, ben canh viec dat nhung muc tieu, chuan muc cao ve chat luong thi phai co truyen thong. Truyen thong do gan lien voi viec xay dung nhung the he giang vien giau kinh nghiem, nhung nganh hoc mui nhon, xay dung nhung truong phai khoa hoc khong phai la chuyen ngay mot ngay hai, ma phai co su tich luy trong mot thoi gian, mot qua trinh lich su lau dai.
Mot trong nhung yeu to rat quan trong khi thanh lap truong dai hoc dang cap quoc te la tinh tu chu va tinh chiu trach nhiem, van de nay o Viet Nam nhu the nao?
Do la dieu kien quan trong cho cac truong dai hoc o Viet Nam co the tiep can duoc trinh do quoc te. Lo trinh de ta den do van khong the tach roi khoi Viet Nam. Cai tu chu cua Viet Nam cung phai tung buoc di dan dan, chu khong hoan toan cach ly voi xa hoi.
Hien co hai truong dai hoc, DH Quoc gia Ha Noi va DH Quoc gia TPHCM co tinh tu chu rat cao trong cac truong dai hoc o Viet Nam.
Muc tu chu ay cua cac truong do o Viet Nam trong hoan canh nay thoa dang. Nguyen vong cua chung ta muon co mot ngoi truong dai hoc dat tieu chuan dang cap quoc te nhung nam trong nen kinh te Viet Nam thi chua phu hop.
Vi du noi ta uu tien cho cac truong dai hoc quoc gia va cac truong dai hoc trong diem cua Viet Nam. Nhung muc dau tu tuyet doi cua cac truong dai hoc Viet Nam chi bang mot phan nho so voi cac truong dai hoc tren the gioi. Chung ta hy vong tim duoc con duong, de khong phai mai mai co khoang cach voi ho. Den mot thoi diem nao do, chung ta co the duoi kip ho.
Vay bot khoang cach giua cac truong dai hoc Viet Nam voi cac truong the gioi thi chung ta phai lam the nao?
Chung ta muon chat luong dai tra cung luc duoi kip ho cung rat la kho. Voi kha nang dau tu hep, nen uu tien dau tu vao mot bo phan sinh vien, mot trong nhung nganh trong diem duoc chon loc ma ta co the manh. Khi do, cac bo phan con lai noi guong, theo mo hinh do di len. Nhu vay, phai biet lua chon con duong phu hop de co huong phat trien.
Chung ta mong muon la mot chuyen, nhung nhung nguoi thuc hien phai tim ra duoc cac giai phap kha thi, thich hop, lam sao sau mot thoi gian hop ly, ta co the duoi kip cac nuoc tien tien.
Neu chi dung ma doi hoi co ngay thi khong the, ai cung muon nhung ai se la nguoi thuc hien? Neu chi muon nhung nghi tu nhien no co thi khong bao gio dat duoc dieu do. Chung ta chi bang suc luc, tri tue, bang quyet tam, bang cach nghi thi moi co the dat duoc mong muon.
Dai hoc Quoc gia Ha Noi da co ke hoach chuan bi nhu the nao de co truong dai hoc dat dang cap quoc te?
Hien nay truong dai hoc trong DH QG Ha Noi co cac truong dai hoc, don vi thanh vien cung vuon len va dat dinh cao chat luong. Nhung chung toi se chon trong do mot so truong dai hoc co du dieu kien. Vi du vua roi thanh lap truong DH Cong nghe (DH Quoc gia Ha Noi), day la truong co quy mo khong lon, nhung trong do co nhung nganh cong nghe cao.
Chung toi su dung mot the manh cua Viet Nam la phoi hop tren quy mo to chuc giua DH Quoc gia Ha Noi va Vien Khoa hoc & Cong nghe Viet Nam...
Viet Nam muon co truong dai hoc quoc te nhung doi ngu giang vien hien nay lieu co dap ung duoc ?
Chung ta cu ky vong cac giao su nuoc ngoai, cac giao su Viet kieu ve day, nhung chung ta khong biet rang, chung ta co rat nhieu giao su gioi day o cac truong dai hoc trong nuoc. Chung ta khong nhin thay nhung tiem luc ay. Trong dau chung ta nghi den "cau ngoai" ma khong biet den "hang noi xin" cung co rat nhieu.
Trong nuoc chung ta khong phat huy duoc ho nhung chinh ho lai duoc nuoc ngoai su dung tot. Tai sao chung ta khong nghi den do la luc luong nen hut ve dau tien. Ho van la nguoi Viet Nam, vi vay phai co co che hop ly, chinh sach tao dieu kien lam viec thuan loi la co the thu hut duoc ho ve.
Van de dat ra, neu ho tro ve, chung ta phai doi xu the nao, co uu tien gi? Do cung la mot dieu kien de thu hut ho tro ve khi ho dang o trong mot moi truong tot, phat trien tot chuyen mon. Khi ve, ho se gap kho khan. Vay chung ta phai biet can xung co che, chinh sach chung thu hut nguoi tai, ma day lai la nguoi tai cua chung ta chu chua noi den doi ngu nhung Viet kieu, nhung nguoi chung ta dao tao trong nuoc, cho tien di hoc o nuoc ngoai. Truoc mat, ta chi can khai thac doi ngu do cung du dat duoc mot hieu qua nao do trong viec nang cao chat luong giang day.

䷆师:
师：贞，丈人，吉无咎。
Shi indicates how, in the case which it supposes, with firmness and correctness, and (a leader of) age and experience, there will be good fortune and no error.
彖传:
师，众也，贞正也，能以众正，可以王矣。刚中而应，行险而顺，以此毒天下，而民从之，吉又何咎矣。
(The name) Shi describes the multitude (of the host). The 'firmness and correctness' (which the hexagram indicates) refer to (moral) correctness (of aim). When (the mover) is able to use the multitude with such correctness, he may attain to the royal sway. There is (the symbol of) strength in the centre (of the trigram below), and it is responded to (by its proper correlate above). The action gives rise to perils, but is in accordance (with the best sentiments of men). (Its mover) may by such action distress all the country, but the people will follow him; - there will be good fortune, and what error should there be?
象传:
地中有水，师；君子以容民畜众。
(The trigram representing) the earth and in the midst of it that representing water, form Shi. The superior man, in accordance with this, nourishes and educates the people, and collects (from among them) the multitudes (of the hosts).
初六：师出以律，否臧凶。
The first SIX, divided, shows the host going forth according to the rules (for such a movement). If these be not good, there will be evil.
师出以律，失律凶也。
'The host goes forth according to the rules (for) such a movement:' - if those rules be not observed, there will be evil.
九二：在师中吉，无咎，王三锡命。
The second NINE, undivided, shows (the leader) in the midst of the host. There will be good fortune and no error. The king has thrice conveyed to him the orders (of his favour).
在师中吉，承天宠也。王三锡命，怀万邦也。
'He is in the midst of the host, and there will be good fortune:' - he has received the favour of Heaven. 'The king has thrice conveyed to him the orders (of) his favour:' - (the king) cherishes the myriad regions in his heart.
六三：师或舆尸，凶。
The third SIX, divided, shows how the host may, possibly, have many inefficient leaders. There will be evil.
师或舆尸，大无功也。
'The host with the possibility of its having many idle leaders:' - great will be its want of success.
六四：师左次，无咎。
The fourth SIX, divided, shows the host in retreat. There is no error.
左次无咎，未失常也。
'The host is in retreat; but there is no error:' - there has been no failure in the regular course.
六五：田有禽，利执言，无咎。长子帅师，弟子舆尸，贞凶。
The fifth SIX, divided, shows birds in the fields, which it will be advantageous to seize (and destroy). In that case there will be no error. If the oldest son leads the host, and younger men (idly occupy offices assigned to them), however firm and correct he may be, there will be evil.
长子帅师，以中行也。弟子舆尸，使不当也。
'The oldest son leads the host:' - its movements are directed by him in accordance with his position in the centre. 'Younger men idly occupy their positions:' - the employment of such men is improper.
上六：大君有命，开国承家，小人勿用。
The topmost SIX, divided, shows the great ruler delivering his charges, (appointing some) to be rulers of states, and others to undertake the headship of clans; but small men should not be employed (in such positions).
大君有命，以正功也。小人勿用，必乱邦也。
'The great ruler delivers his charges:' - thereby he rightly apportions merit. 'Small men should not be employed:' - they are sure to throw the states into confusion.

8. Nganh Vo tuyen va thong tin lien lac (Chuyen nganh Ky thuat vien thong)
Thoi gian dao tao la 5 nam. Ngoai khoi kien thuc giao duc dai cuong, SV con duoc trang bi cac mon hoc co so va chuyen mon thuoc linh vuc thong tin va vien thong. Trong qua trinh hoc, SV duoc di thuc tap ve co so va tay nghe, thuc tap ve chuyen mon thuoc linh vuc Thong tin va Vien thong.
Sau khi tot nghiep, cac ky su Thong tin va Vien thong co the lam viec tai cac co quan nghien cuu, thiet ke, cac co so dao tao, cac cong ty hoac cac co so thong tin - vien thong.
9. Nganh Ky thuat dien - dien tu (Chuyen nganh Trang thiet bi dien - dien tu trong cong nghiep va giao thong van tai)
Thoi gian dao tao la 5 nam. Ngoai khoi kien thuc giao duc dai cuong, SV con duoc trang bi cac mon hoc co so va chuyen mon thuoc linh may dien, thiet bi dien - dien tu, nang luong... Trong qua trinh hoc, SV duoc di thuc tap ve nhan thuc va tay nghe, thuc tap ve chuyen mon thuoc linh vuc trang thiet bi dien - dien tu.
Sau khi tot nghiep, cac ky su Trang thiet bi dien - dien tu co the lam viec tai cac nha may va xi nghiep cong nghiep, cac vien nghien cuu, cac cong ty ve linh vuc ung dung - thiet ke - van hanh cac he thong va thiet bi dien - dien tu, co - nhiet - dien tu.
10. Nganh Tin hoc
Ngoai khoi kien thuc giao duc dai cuong, SV con duoc hoc cac mon co so va chuyen mon thuoc linh vuc tin hoc nhu: Cong nghe phan mem, ky thuat lap trinh (quan tri co so du lieu, thiet ke cac he thong thong tin, khai thac cac phan mem ung dung, to chuc ung dung tin hoc)
Trong thoi gian hoc, SV duoc di thuc tap co so, thuc tap chuyen mon, va thuc tap tot nghiep ve linh vuc tin hoc.
Sau khi tot nghiep, cac ky su Tin hoc co the lam viec tai cac co so tin hoc cua cac co quan, cac doanh nghiep, cac cong ty tin hoc kinh doanh pham mem ung dung, lam cong tac giang day tin hoc tai cac co so dao tao hoac lam viec tai cac vien nghien cuu cong nghe tin hoc va ung dung tin hoc.
11. Nganh Xay dung cong trinh
+ Chuyen nganh Cau ham
Thoi gian dao tao la 5 nam (10 hoc ky). Cau truc chuong trinh bao gom phan dai cuong (2 hoc ky) voi cac mon hoc trang bi cac kien thuc co ban; phan cac mon hoc chung cua nganh xay dung cau duong (5 hoc ky, tu hoc ky 3 den hoc ky 7). Phan kien thuc chuyen nganh gom 59 don vi hoc trinh duoc trang bi chu yeu trong 2 hoc ky 8, 9 va cuoi cung la hoc phan tot nghiep o hoc ky 10.
Cac ky su Cau ham co the dam nhiem cac cong viec nghien cuu, thiet ke, tu van giam sat, quan ly du an, thi cong xay dung cac cong trinh Cau, Duong tai cac co quan dao tao. Nghien cuu khoa hoc, cac co quan quan ly nha nuoc, cac don vi tu van thiet ke (ke ca cac hang nuoc ngoai); cac doanh nghiep xay dung cong trinh giao thong, cac So Giao thong cong chinh va cac nganh kinh te khac.
+ Chuyen nganh Xay dung duong bo
Dao tao ky su Xay dung Cau - Duong co kha nang nghien cuu, tu van thiet ke, to chuc xay dung va khai thac cac cong trinh: duong o to, duong do thi cac cap; cac cong trinh cau, cong, cong trinh phong ho dam bao an toan va cac cong trinh phuc vu tren duong.
Sau khi tot nghiep SV co the lam viec duoc o cac cong ty tu van thiet ke, xay dung va khai thac cau duong; co the lam viec o cac co quan quan ly, cac vien nghien cuu va cac truong dai hoc, cao dang, trung hoc chuyen nghiep ... thuoc linh vuc xay dung cau duong.
+ Chuyen nganh Duong sat
Dao tao Ky su Xay dung Cau - Duong co kha nang nghien cuu, tu van thiet ke, to chuc xay dung va khai thac cac cong trinh: duong sat cac cap; duong o to; cac cong trinh cau, cong, cong trinh phong ho dam bao an toan va cac cong trinh phuc vu tren duong.
Sau khi tot nghiep SV co the lam viec duoc o cac cong ty tu van thiet ke, xay dung va khai thac cau duong; co the lam viec o cac co quan quan ly, cac vien nghien cuu va cac truong dai hoc, cao dang, trung hoc chuyen nghiep... thuoc linh vuc xay dung cau duong.
+ Chuyen nganh Cau - duong bo
Dao tao ky su Xay dung Cau - Duong cac kien thuc chung bao gom cac mon hoc co ban va co so chuyen mon theo chuong trinh cac mon hoc chung cua nganh xay dung cau duong va kien thuc chuyen sau trong linh vuc xay dung cau duong (thiet ke, thi cong va to chuc thi cong, kiem dinh, khai thac cong trinh cau duong).
+ Chuyen nganh Cau - duong sat
+ Chuyen nganh Cong trinh giao thong cong chinh
Dao tao Ky su Xay dung Cau - Duong co kha nang nghien cuu, tu van thiet ke, to chuc xay dung va khai thac cac cong trinh: duong o to va duong do thi; duong o to cac cap, cac cong trinh cau, cong, cong trinh phong ho dam bao an toan va cac cong trinh phuc vu tren duong.
+ Chuyen nganh Cong trinh giao thong thanh pho
Dao tao cac ky su phuc vu cac du an chuyen sau cho mang xay dung giao thong thanh pho nhu: giao thong thanh pho can co su phoi hop lien thong da phuong tien; cau duong oto va cau duong sat trong cac thanh pho va tren cac tuyen giao thong (cau thanh pho, cau can, cau vuot, cau dan, cau cong va re nhanh...); ham giao thong trong thanh pho va tren cac tuyen duong giao thong; duong oto thanh pho cac cap va duong oto cac cap.
Cac ky su Xay dung Cau - Duong chuyen nganh Cong trinh Giao thong Thanh pho co the dam nhiem cong tac nghien cuu, thiet ke, tu van giam sat, quan ly du an, thi cong xay dung cac cong trinh cac cong trinh cau, duong, ham giao thong tai cac co quan dao tao, nghien cuu khoa hoc, cac co quan quan ly nha nuoc, cac don vi tu van thiet ke, cac doanh nghiep xay dung cong trinh giao thong (gom cac cong ty trong nuoc, cac to chuc lien doanh va hang nuoc ngoai), cac don vi thuoc nganh Giao thong van tai, cac So Giao thong cong chinh va cac nganh kinh te co lien quan khac.
+ Chuyen nganh Xay dung cong trinh thuy
Dao tao ky su Xay dung cong trinh giao thong chuyen nganh Cong trinh Giao thong thuy chuyen sau co kha nang nghien cuu, thiet ke, to chuc xay dung, quan ly, khai thac cac cong trinh giao thong thuy phuc vu cho su nghiep cong nghiep hoa, hien dai hoa nganh giao thong van tai: ben cang phuc vu giao thong tren song, tren bien; de bien, cong trinh bao ve bo bien, hai dao; de chan song, cong trinh ngan cat chan cat - giam song; xay dung nha may sua chua va dong moi tau thuy; xong trinh chinh tri dong song va cua song ven bien; xac cong trinh giao thong khu vuc cang nhu cau dan, duong trong cang.
Cac ky su Cong trinh giao thong thuy co the dam nhiem cong tac nghien cuu, thiet ke, tu van giam sat, quan ly du an, thi cong xay dung cac cong trinh cac cong trinh ben cang, giao thong tren song, tren bien, cong trinh thuy, cong trinh chinh tri dong song, cong trinh bao ve bo bien va hai dao, cong trinh giao thong trong cang va cac cong trinh giao thong khac tai cac co quan dao tao, nghien cuu khoa hoc, cac co quan quan ly nha nuoc, cac don vi tu van thiet ke, cac ben cang, cac doanh nghiep xay dung cong trinh giao thong (gom cac cong ty trong nuoc, cac to chuc lien doanh va hang nuoc ngoai), cac don vi thuoc nganh Giao thong van tai, cac So Giao thong cong chinh va cac nganh kinh te lien quan khac.
