Tai buoi le trong the nay toi cho minh co mot trach nhiem de chiu la them lan nua bay to long biet on doi voi Vien Han lam Thuy Dien da trao tang toi Giai Nobel.
Toi cung da co dip bay to truoc cong chung rang dieu nay goi len trong toi niem thoa man khong chi boi do la su cong nhan quoc te doi voi nhung thanh tuu nghe nghiep va nhung dac diem cua rieng toi nhu mot nha van. Toi tu hao boi giai thuong nay duoc trao tang cho mot nha van Nga, mot nha van Xo Viet. o day toi dai dien cho doi ngu dong dao cac nha van cua To quoc toi.
Toi cung da bay to niem thoa man boi giai thuong nay con gian tiep them mot lan khang dinh the loai tieu thuyet. Trong thoi gian gan day chung ta thuong phai nghe va doc nhung y kien, thu thuc ma noi khien toi rat ngac nhien, tuyen bo rang hinh thuc tieu thuyet da tro nen gia cu, khong con dap ung nhung yeu cau cua hien dai. Trong luc do, chinh tieu thuyet tao ra kha nang nam bat the gioi hien thuc mot cach tron ven nhat va the hien thai do cua minh doi voi nhung van de nong bong cua no.
Tieu thuyet, co the noi, huong den su nhan thuc sau sac cuoc song rong lon bao quanh ta hon la den nhung toan tinh pho bay cai toi nho be cua minh nhu mot trung tam cua vu tru. The loai tieu thuyet, voi dac tinh cua minh, la can cu dia rong lon nhat cua nha nghe si hien thuc.
Nhieu truong phai thoi thuong trong nghe thuat tu bo chu nghia hien thuc vi cho rang no da song het thoi cua minh. Khong so bi quo trach la bao thu, toi tuyen bo rang toi dung ve phia nhung quan diem doi lap, toi ung ho nhiet thanh nghe thuat hien thuc chu nghia.
Hien nay nguoi ta hay noi ve cai goi la chu nghia tien phong trong van hoc - ham chi nhung thu nghiem moi me nhat chu yeu la trong linh vuc hinh thuc. Theo quan niem cua toi, nguoi tien phong chan chinh la nguoi nghe si trong cac tac pham cua minh kham pha ra noi dung moi xac dinh nhung dac diem cua cuoc song thoi dai chung ta.
Ca chu nghia hien thuc noi chung, lan tieu thuyet hien thuc deu dua tren nhung kinh nghiem nghe thuat cua cac nghe si vi dai cua qua khu. Nhung trong su phat trien cua minh, no da tich luy them nhung dac diem moi mot cach can ban, hien dai mot cach sau sac.
Toi dang noi ve chu nghia hien thuc mang trong minh y tuong lam moi cuoc song, cai tao cuoc song vi loi ich cua con nguoi. Hien nhien, toi dang noi ve chu nghia hien thuc ma chung toi goi la hien thuc xa hoi chu nghia. Diem dac trung cua no o cho, no the hien mot the gioi quan khong chap nhan ca thai do quan sat bang quan lan thai do tron chay hien thuc, ma no keu goi dau tranh vi su tien bo cua nhan loai, tao ra kha nang dat den nhung muc tieu gan gui voi hang trieu con nguoi, soi sang con duong dau tranh cua ho.
Nhan loai khong phan chia ra thanh vo so nhung ca the, ca nhan troi noi trong trang thai khong trong luong nhu nhung nha du hanh vu tru nam ngoai gioi han suc hut trai dat. Chung ta song tren mat dat, chung ta tuan theo nhung quy luat cua trai dat, va, nhu trong kinh Phuc Am noi, ngay nao cua chung ta cung co du nhung van de thuong nhat cua no, nhung lo toan va doi hoi cua no, nhung hi vong cua no vao mot ngay mai tot dep hon. Dai da so dan chung tren trai dat bi thoi thuc boi mot dong co duy nhat, song bang nhung quyen loi chung, nhung moi quan tam hoa ket voi nhau hon la chia re.
Do la nhung con nguoi cua lao dong, nhung nguoi bang ban tay va khoi oc cua minh sang tao ra tat ca. Toi thuoc ve doi ngu nhung nha van coi vinh du toi cao cua minh, tu do lon nhat cua minh la kha nang duoc phuc vu nhan dan lao dong bang ngoi but cua minh khong bi han che boi bat cu dieu gi.
Do la xuat phat diem cua tat ca. Tu do dan den ket luan ve viec toi, voi tu cach nha van Xo Viet, suy nghi nhu the nao ve cho dung cua nguoi nghe si trong the gioi hien dai.
Chung ta dang song trong nhung nam thang day lo au, nhung tren mat dat nay khong co mot dan toc nao mong muon chien tranh. Co nhung the luc nem ca nhung dan toc vao bien lua chien tranh. Chang le tro than tu nhung dam chay khong lo cua The chien II khong bam nhiem vao trai tim nha van? Chang le mot nha van trung thuc khong len tieng chong lai nhung ke muon dua nhan loai den cho tu huy diet?
Dau la thien chuc, la nghia vu cua nguoi nghe si coi minh khong phai la mot vi than vo cam truoc nhung dau kho cua con nguoi, ngu cao tren dinh Olympe nhin xuong cac the luc tranh xe nhau, ma la mot dua con cua dan toc minh, mot vi phan cua nhan loai?
Can phai noi voi nguoi doc mot cach trung thuc, can phai noi voi moi nguoi su that - su that nhieu khi la khac nghiet nhung luon ngoan cuong. Can cung co noi trai tim con nguoi niem tin vao tuong lai, vao suc manh cua minh ve kha nang xay dung cai tuong lai do. Phai la nguoi chien si vi hoa binh o khap the gioi va bang loi noi cua minh dao tao nen nhung chien si do o moi noi nao ma loi noi do vang den duoc. Phai doan ket con nguoi trong nhung no luc hien nhien va cao ca vi su tien bo.
Nghe thuat co suc tac dong manh me den trai tim va khoi oc con nguoi. Toi nghi, co quyen duoc goi ten la nghe si nhung ai huong suc manh do den viec kien tao cai dep trong tam hon moi nguoi vi loi ich cua nhan loai.
Dan toc than yeu cua toi tien len phia truoc tren nhung nga duong lich su khong phai theo cac loi di mon phang. Do la con duong cua nhung nguoi kham pha, nhung ke tien phong cua cuoc song moi. Toi nhin thay trach nhiem cua minh trong tu cach mot nha van o cho: bang tat ca nhung gi toi da va se viet ton vinh dan toc toi - mot dan toc lao dong, dan toc xay dung, dan toc anh hung, dan toc khong tan cong ai nhung bao gio cung tu trong bao ve thanh qua cua minh, bao ve danh du va tu do cua minh, bao ve quyen xay dung tuong lai theo lua chon cua chinh minh.
Toi muon nhung cuon sach cua toi giup con nguoi song tot hon, tam hon trong sach hon, danh thuc tinh yeu voi con nguoi, no luc dau tranh vi nhung li tuong nhan dao va su tien bo cua loai nguoi. Neu toi phan nao lam duoc dieu do, toi hanh phuc.
Toi cam on tat ca nhung ai co mat trong hoi truong nay, cam on tat ca nhung ai da gui loi tham hoi, chuc mung nhan dip toi duoc nhan Giai Nobel.

Joshua Aizenman | David W. Galenson | Roger H. Gordon
NBER Profile: Joshua Aizenman
Joshua Aizenman is a Research Associate in the NBERs Program on International Trade and Investment and a Professor of Economics at the University of California, Santa Cruz (UCSC). He received his B.A. in Mathematics and Philosophy and M.A. in Economics from Hebrew University, Jerusalem, and his Ph. D. in Economics from the University of Chicago.
Aizenman joined the faculty at UCSC in 2001 following eleven years at Dartmouth College, where he had served as the Champion Professor of International Economics. His research covers a range of issues in open economy, including commercial and financial policies, crises in emerging markets, foreign direct investment, capital controls, and exchange rate regimes. His other affiliations have included teaching and research positions at the University of Pennsylvania, the University of Chicago Graduate School of Business, and the Hebrew University in Jerusalem. He has also served as a consultant to the World Bank, the Federal Reserve Bank of San Francisco, the International Monetary Fund, and the Inter-American Development Bank.
Aizenman was born in Poland and has joint U.S./Israeli citizenship. He is married and has four children.
NBER Profile: David W. Galenson
David W. Galenson is a Research Associate in the NBERs Program on Labor Studies and a Professor of Economics at the University of Chicago. He received both his undergraduate and his graduate degrees in economics from Harvard University.
Galenson joined the University of Chicagos economics faculty in 1978 and was promoted to full professor in 1986. He has also been a visiting professor at l'Ecole des Hautes Etudes en Sciences Sociales, the University of Texas at Austin, MIT, California Institute of Technology, and the American University of Paris.
Galensons work, earlier in his career in economic history and more recently on the economics of the art world, is widely published in economic journals. He also has authored a number of books, including Painting Outside the Lines: Patterns of Creativity in Modern Art, which was published in 2001, and Mesurer lArt, which will be published in 2004.
Galenson lives in Chicago with Lynn Olson, a sociologist who works at the American Academy of Pediatrics. When he is not working, he enjoys playing tennis and collecting modern art.
NBER Profile: Roger H. Gordon
Roger H. Gordon is a Research Associate in the NBERs Program in Public Economics and a Professor of Economics at the University of California, San Diego (UCSD). His current research interests include positive and normative issues in the taxation of financial and real investments, and tax issues in transition and developing countries. Gordon received his B.A. from Harvard and his Ph.D. at MIT. Before moving to UCSD, he was the Reuben Kempf Professor at the University of Michigan, and earlier was on the technical staff at Bell Laboratories. He is a Fellow of the Econometrics Society, a past editor and current co-editor of the Journal of Public Economics, and a past co-editor of the American Economic Review.
Gordon lives in La Jolla with his wife, NBER Research Associate Michelle J. White. When they are not working, they like to hike and bike in the hills around San Diego. Ak masa khuan in Chingnu leng a lupna a kipan in thoukhia hi. A lukham zul a umta a tuibuk kamkhat hiam a muamzoh in, meitoh diing in kisa ngal hi. Vutlak a mei-am tamlou om likliakte thaikhawm in, singthem bangzah hiam toh tua mei-am mutlong zang in mutkuang hi. Huchia mei tohkhin thuktung a zing ann bel a suanzoh in, tuithei bangzah hiam seng a pua in tuitawi ding in luilam ah kuanpah vengveng hi. Tuitawi a tun kiik chiang in thuktung a, a ann bel suan ana chiak bilhbilhta ahihman in antang nou bangzah hiam kha a, khintung a vaidoh a ann hum a hakgamte loh ah sungkhia hi. A ann huan atui a kantak in meipang ah vutdul lak a hei diing in a ann bel tungkhia a, huchi'n a lawipa Siampu va phawng hi.
Siampu leng thoukhia in meikiang ah hongtu a, a tutkawm in a dumbawm a dum leh laithem lakhia in lehkha zialpah ngal hi. Tua lehkhazial a tepkhut laihlaih kawm in khinpi tung a kok lianlou sung a ankamhou lakhia in meh ding in huan hi. Ann leh meh a huan kawm in senggan a, a vangkim in buhbel heikual zel hi. Aman ann leh meh a huansung in sumtawng ah a lawinu Chingnu in sum ah suk zang in ann suging dupdup hi. A annsukte hong taisim chiang in lohpi zang in a vaite sepkhia a, tua a vaite vaidohna in doh hi. Ann hum leh anntak te hoitel in buai petmah hi. Akgil a akte a khah leh a ann hawi va subuai mahmah ahihman un tua akte akchiang toh kipat in hawl nilouh hi. Tua kawmkal ah, buhbuk tung a ak bubah a akpi oplai hong lengkhia a, a vai nelte bang khu phulphul zozen hi.
Siampu in leng ann leh meh a huan zoh in belpuansia tui a diah suk a, huai bel puansia vut ah toih in belte nawt hi. Belte a nawt khit in pangkhang a belvalh tung ah belte tunggaih a, khindang a sahou bangzah hiam vutkawm a phual in malta meh di'n bawl hi. Tua zoh in a khedap sete uh vuttem zang in thuap a, tua teng banah bangkhang ah suangtat zang in tempawngte tat ngiatngiat in ama khom in buai veve hi. Huchi'n Chingte leh Thangboi ngeileng zingkal hongthou ta uhi. Chingte in a nu nnasep, annsuk va panpih hi. Thangboi in leng khindang a phazah a a sailim hakte a keuna hiam chih a etzoh in vok ann pe ding in konglam ah vok ann bel dompawt pah kuihkuih hi. Kongtual ah vok ann kuang khenging kauhkauh ahihman in a vokte uh leng ann ne ding in hong taipah latlat uhi. Thangboi in vok ann a piakkawm in a vokte uh a zualna ding in chiangkang zang in khuat muatmuat hi. Huchia amau' nna chiat ahon zohtak un ann nek hun hita hi.
Ann anekma deuh un Chingte in a innsakte uh meh va khol hi. Kuangpi ah ann hon thuk ua, alai ah mehpok hon sung uhi. Ann a nekkawm un Chingnu in nahtangteh zang in sunchia loulam a a sun ann d’uh tun a, gawlawng lianlou ah mehleng thun ngal hi. Ann ahon nekzoh chiang un sumtawng a a nnasep vante uh anitluat ziak a vot dekduk zozente, amau a chiat la in hon silhpah siausiau uhi. Chingte' nu Chingnu ahihleh dum, pat leh malta zut di a om ziak in loutul lam ah kuan a, Thangboi leh apa Siampu bel lou vatna di lam enkhe diing in betang thang leh sakuh thang tamlou sakhaupi a kuah in leh, tupi thau toh kuankhia uhi. Chingte ngeileng dainawl a singkang zong ding in sengvang sung a heipi khat pua in kuankhia a, inn kongkhak a ana kihong louhna di’n singbong khat in a kongkhak uh delhkhum maimai hi.
Chingte bel singpo maimai ahihman in tungkik pah a, a singpuakte singhon a a lepzoh in inn hahsiang pah vitvit nawn hi. Khintung a hakvang a malta a hakte uh leh sumtawng a dum omte innkong a malta tau tung, nisa lak ah phoukhia hi. Tua banah buhbuk sung a annhum bangzah hiam leng phoukhe lai hi. Tua teng ahihzoh in phaitam, nisa nuai ah helhhawt zang in pat hon hek a, a helhhawt a ging chuakchuak man in meisak a sathu-um sung a sathu tamlou helhhawt' bil a ahon tatleh tua a helhhawt pen zatnop tuan mahmah hi.
Nitaklam ninem tak in ann huan di'n kisa pah hehu nawn hi. Chiang sung a loutul meh tamlou hon mal in, ann leh meh hon huan hi. Ann a huanzohma deuh in a nau Thangboi leh apa vai hongtung ua, suaklu tamlou leh thang a awk vagik hon pua uhi. Thangboi leh apa'n tua vagik a sem sung un Chingte a nu dawn ding in khomual lam ah kuan a, huaituh vaidawn kichi hi. Saulou a pai nung in lampi ah anu chiangsiat zen a van pua toh hong kituak ua, anu vanpuak bangzah hiam ama seng ah khenkhia in huchi'n zangkhaitak in inn hongtung uhi.
Nitak hong hi a, meivak gina lah omlou ahihman in taptung a, a meichih vak uh leh phutuan zang in amau nna chiat ahon sem nawn uhi. Chingte in bel tangval lengla nei a, Thangboi ahihleh 'haam' ah giak hi. Papi lengla le bangzah hiam nei ahihman un tuate toh Thangboi' pa Siampu, louvatna dimun kikum in buai mahmah ua, tua kawmkal ah Thangboi' nu'n bel tuanglai ah buk tepkawm in leh mui zang in khaukhek daldal hi. Sun a Chingte in balke leh kawlkai ahuante banah miim leh kanpuak khawng kang in a lenglate uh toh nekhawm nainai uhi. Zoudawn ah bel nitak ihmut kal chihlouh hun-awl om mahmah lou hi.
Sunchiang in Thangboi leh apa lounuai vat in kuanden ua, louvat ahong pai chiang un singlukham di hon pukawm zel uhi. Chingte leh anu bel singpua banah a vangkim a loutul hoh in buai den uhi. Pata te'n lounuai vat ahon zoh chiang un loutung phuknawn ua, huchi'n lou vat ahon zoukhong uhi. Louvat zou chihman a awltheih hituanlou ahihman in, inn van di khol in buai veve uhi. Vuahzuk lah kipan nailou ahihman in tapphou nisa khauh mahmah a, luidung a tuiluangte kang dekdek ahihman in ngaden di khawng in kuanzel uhi. Meh bangle ahak laitak ahihman in sihzoupok, bal, maisan, maipuang ah mehhou khawng meh gige mai uhi.
Hunte hongpai zel in louhal honghun a, huaini in tuh louhal a kuanlou peumah inn om khipkhep uhi. Mei-ek leng in inntung a peh khak di veng in inntung ah tuibel toh kigingsa in om ua, tua mei-ek lengte tui in buakmit tawmtawm uhi. Pasal hatlai te louhal ziak a gamkang phelh ding in kuan ua, khenkhat leuleu sa kanglum zong in buai mahmah uhi. Hiai louhal zohlak vel in naupangte'n nitak khomui zul chiang in innkiim ah meisem in matthe samsek ua, tualou in mautawn zang in bak vai veuhveuh sek uhi.
Louhal zou, Zoudawn a nnasep kipan taktak di hita ahihman in lou nnasepna a zat ding tuzat-heizatte seek in papite buaithei mahmah uhi. Hiai tuzat-heizatte a seekna mun uh 'Pumbuk' kichi hi. Sunchiang in papite pumbuk ah sikseek in khotang leh gam-le-nam vai khawng houlim kawm in nuamsa thei mahmah uhi. Pumbuk kichi pasalte omna deuh ahihman in numei sikseek dia a pai khakleh pasal neinawnlou, meithai chihna hi a, ama a seeksak masa uhi. Tuamah bangin, lui a pasal a va paikhak leh zi nei nawnlou, pagong chihna ahihziak in amah tui pe masa uhi. Huaiziak in, ipu-pate'n "Pumbuk ah numei vualzou; luimun ah pasal vualzou" chih paunak a nanei hial uhi. Khosung ah pumbuk nih leh thum bang om thei a, tua pumbuk neitu pen 'siik supa' kichi a, pawltak hun chiang in siik supa kiang ah pumkai teng in 'pum ann' pekhawm zel uhi.
Lou nnasep, mangtom kipanta ahihman in zingkal baih taktak in mangtom di'n kuan ua, loulai a sing kanglou te munkhat a sekhawm in tuate 'mang' kichi hi. Tua mangte a khonung in hal nawn ua, tua a mang halna mun uh alei kanghoihse ahihman in huaimun ah bal khawng tuh uhi. Mangtom kawmkawm in Thangboi leh apa bel bukbawl in buai mahmah ua, lounawl a gova te khawng bukvan dia pua in, buk bawl uhi. Siikkilh chihkhawng omlou ahihman in tuate tang in naang zang uhi.
Mangtom zou buhtuh ahon panpah tiptip uhi. Buhchi lak ah tangmai, mazel, dawnpawl chihleh haichi tang tuamtuam hel in, ‘bawmta’ sung ah thunkhawm ua, tua bawmta pen a kawnglak ua khih in buhtuh uhi. Vaimin, taang, chihleh haichi khenkhat bel atuam in tuh thoh ua, malta ahihleh pawithoh uhi. Maulak leh govalak, banah gamtak lak khawng ah malta hoih nuamse chi uhi. Belawi, mehnal, tangkha, begul chihte tungtun leh bukgei khawng ah tuh tangpi uhi. Huchi kawmkal ah inntung di bi-att hunta ahihman in Thangboi leh apa'n bi-att ua, Chingte leh anu'n lou nna sem uhi.
Buhtuh zohnung sawtlou in louham khoh kipan ngal hi. Vuah bangleng zu panpan ta ahihman in haichi tuamtuam leh loupa tuamtuam khawng pouta a, haichite hawi in loupa te khoukhia uhi. Louham khouzou louthual khounawn ua, louthual bel nihvei-thumvei bang khohtuan ngai a, buh leh haichite in loupa dangte a dep zohma khohkhoh ngai hi. Louthual bangzah veihiam khohzoh chiang in lou-phuai chih om lai hi. Lou nnasep bel sunkhua a nnasep ahihman in gilkial mahmah a, huaiziak in anntun posek uhi. Sunchiang in buk a sawnkhiat tung ah sun ann nezel ua, a niinte uh nindawl ah paizel uhi.
Khenkhat lou khohzohlouh khak di lau in lougiak zen in pang uhi. Khenkhat in bel ak pum khat-le-nih khawng gou in ‘thachial’ ua, huchilou lawmta bangzah hiam leng 'kilawm' in kuankhawm naihnaih uhi. Hiai loukhoh hunlai in bel louma a piang haichi tuamtuam nek di tam a, kuapeuhmah taichiat uhi. Tangvalte bang tangmai tawkha lawn khawng in kidem sek uhi. Lawmta hiam ahihkeileh nungak-tangval kingaizawng khenkhat te'n alou lampi kathuamte uah tangmai khawng a min gelh in kikoihsak zel ua, huaituh 'sawlseh' kichi hi. Huchilou in, lam kathuam ah sawlbawk khawng in kisawl seh ua, huaipen 'ka na paikhinta uh' chihna ahi hi.
Khosung a naupang te'n le amau khom in nuamsa thei mahmah uhi. Sunchiang in zawiboh, kelkum tou, kibukteih siakneih, kangtalai tuan chihkhawng in hun zang uhi. Sun ann nek hun chiang in ann tawikhawm in ne nainai zel ua, huaipen 'annkum' kichi hi. Nitak lam vailamthe khawng a ham chiaichiai chiang in vaidawn diing in kuan naihnaih sek ua, khomual ah anute uh toh kituak in anute un tangmai, dawnpawl, mazel chihte khawng apuak chiang un kipak mahmah uhi. Khenkhat te'n lampi a pai kawmkawm un lamnawl a bigai leh sialluai gai khawng atate uh a di'n doksak sek uhi. A tangpi in vaipai chiang in nupite masa ua, anung ah papite'n zui uhi. Naupangte’n a nu/pate uh gamkuanna khawng zuih a sawm chiang un “tawlnou k’on puakna di” chi’n kikhemkhe zel uhi.
Loukhou zou 'phavang awllen' kichi om sam mahleh awl taktak chih om theilou hi. Thangpu te'n bel phavang lai, hun-awl neihsun chi'n inn bawl kisiak mahmah uhi. Huchi kawmkal ah khenkhat in a kumnawn lou d’uh phavang vat uhi. Phavang louvat te a leikol in baihdeuh chi ua, ngaina uhi. Chingte leh anu'n bel a vangkim in loulam va pha zel ua, huaipen 'phavang louveh' chi leuleu uhi. Huailou in, puanpi bawlsawm in apat heksate uh Chingte' nu'n a lawm nupi bangzah hiam zawnkhawm in innsung ah patthal in pat kapzan ua, tua kuante buhman nekpih nainai hi.
Phavang lai in papi leh upa lamdeuh khenkhatte khuaibu, a diak a khuaingal bu zong in vaksek uhi. Khilpi naine khuaingal-te sa vatah zel ua, tua khuaingal te'n sa ava nekchiang in akmulkang in khihzel uhi. Tua khuaingal te'n akmulkang a lenpih chiang un gamla pipi khawng ah le kimu ban a, huchi in khuaingal kua muzel uhi. Khuaibu khawng amuh chiang un chiang/sing khat khawng in kawk veuhvauh ua, huaituh 'hawisa, aneitu om' chihna hita a, midang in hawithei nawnlou hi. Zoudawn ah bel diktatna mah a thupipen hi gige hi.
Phavang hongbei a, buhlaak hun hi nawn leuleu hi. Buhlak hun in bel gamsa leh vasa tuamtuam buh nese thei tamlua ahihman in kuapeuh in awlmoh chiat hi. Loulian deuh nei khenkhat te'n buhlak chiang in vokgou in 'thathot' lazel uhi. Thathot lak ahihchiang in akuanteng in inntekte buh ding puaksak ua, nitaklam chiang in inntekte' inn ah ann nekhawm uhi. Atangpi in lou nnasep chiang in a tawlam akipat a khunglam man-oh in nna kisem mahleh buhlak chiang in akhunglam akipat loutaw lam man-oh in nna kisem daih hi. Kawite zang in buh ki-att a, lom lian loulou a kikoih tiltel in huaite 'buhphal' kichi hi. Huai buhphalte loulai ah bangtan hiam nisa ah kihai keu hi.
Thangpu' pa Siampu bel sabeng-ngabeng chihkhawng lunglut a, alunglut ziakmah in mat leng manthei viau hi. Loulai a buhne ngalte khawng tang a, tua ngalte thau in kaplum zel hi. Huaibanah, gumthang, pial, mankhawng leh vasa thang tuamtuam khawng kamsek hi. Huan ah, sazawi khawng ah le 'thau-kal' kamzel hi. Thangpu' pa bel a unau ua alianpen hilou ahihman in, sa, kheli nei, a liandeuh a mat chiang in a mau inn tunlou in, a u pa' inn (inn pi) tun a, hiai pen ute zahtak etsakna ahi hi.
Buh-at zoh chiang in buhkhet kipan nawn a, buhphalte sengzing sung ah buhtangte a kiatna ding in khen ek-ek uhi. Tua buhte buk innka maupek liantak kigan tung ah koihkhawm uhi. Tua a koihna mun uh 'phual' kichi hi. Huanah, buhsi te huih in a mutmang theihna ding in 'paallam' kibawl a, tua pallam a kipan in buh kikhisiang hi.
Buhpuak hun ahihchiang in lou gamla neite'n lamkal ah sekbuk mun khat-le-nih khawng ah bawl ua, huaite ah buh sekzel uhi. Thangboi-te' lou bel a gamlat luatlouh man in sekbuk bawl ngailou a, tangtak in inn tan potung ziauziau thei ahihman un kizen sa mahmah uhi. Huchi'n a kumkhat nnasep uh lohchingtak in zou uhi.
Thangpu' pa Siampu ahihleh a khosung ua tang-au ahi hi. Zoudawn ah bel hausa' gam leh hausa' vaihawmna nuai khosa uh aman un hausa thu kuaman sellou uhi. Khosung mi kuahiam in sa, kheli nei amat leh hausapa aliang pia ua, pawltak hun chiang inleng ‘Buhsun/Tangseu’ chi'n kho mipite'n buh pekhawm zel uhi. Khosung mi kua hiam om dan hoihlou omleh hausa in gam thei a, huanah, khosungmi khenkhat kitheisiamlou om leh hausa' mai ah kihek zel uhi. Hausapa leh a khawnbawl upate'n khosung hahsiang di, zin lampi vat di chih leh thil tuamtuam khosung mipite hih dia poimohte tang-au kikousak zel hi. Hiai tang-au te bel lou telhun a telbaih leh nnatang khawng awl uhi.
Zoudawn ah bel insak-inkhang leh khosungmi ki-itna leh kinek ngaihna om a, meh chituam deuh neihni khua in kikhol chipchip sek uhi. Phavang ahihkeileh awllen hun deuh khawng chiang in huangvulh-gantate khawng gou in insak-inkhang leh tanau-laina teng khawng in nekhawm nainai ua, huai in ki-itna leh kingaih natna pungsak hi. Huanah, sihni-manni tuahhun a khopi dan kithuzakna baihlam lou ahihman in, khokim-khopamte hilh diing in mi sawlzel ua, tuate 'khualtai' kichi hi. Sihna khawng ah tanau-laina kia mai hilou in, khosung a nungak-le-tangvalte'n khamuanna in inntekte giahpih khipkhep uhi. Hichidan a kigiahpih ahihchiang in sisuun inkuante a di'n khamuan huai in, tawldam huai mahmah hi.

Thu ngay Windows 95 phien ban 2.0 tren Linux, macOS va Windows voi nhieu ung dung, tua game moi
Ung dung trai nghiem Windows 95 phien ban 2.0 dem den nhieu thay doi lon ve trai nghiem nguoi dung.
Nha phat trien Felix Rieseberg, nguoi noi tieng voi viec lan dau cho ra mat ung dung trai nghiem Windows 95 phien ban 1.0 vao thang 8/2018 vua cho ra mat phien ban 2.0 moi nhat.
Nhu da tung gioi thieu trong mot bai viet truoc day ve ung dung Windows 95 phien ban 1.0 danh cho nguoi dung Windows va macOS. Gio day nguoi dung se co co hoi trai nghiem he dieu hanh Windows 95 xua cu voi nhieu tinh nang hap dan hon tren Linux, macOS va Windows.
Ban cap nhat 2.0 moi ho tro am thanh, man hinh 4K va mat do diem anh cao hon. Dac biet, ung dung se co them tinh nang reset.
Ngoai ra, ban cap nhat Windows 95 con tich hop them mot so tua game thu vi de ban khong cam thay buon chan khi trai nghiem he dieu hanh xua cu nay. Vi du co the ke den nhu A-10 Tank Killer, Doom, Wolfenstein 3D va Grand Prix Circuit.
Mot so ung dung cu nhu Microsoft FrontPage WYSIWYG HTML, Microsoft FrontPage Server va trinh duyet web Netscape 2.0 se xuat hien tren phien ban 2.0 nay. Hien tai cac ung dung va tro choi nay deu dang duoc cai dat mac dinh.
Voi viec bo sung them nhieu tinh nang va ho tro moi, kich thuoc ung dung da tang tu khoang 100MB truoc day len gan 300MB.
Tuy nhien dieu nay khong han la moi ban tam lon doi voi nguoi dung khi dung luong bo nho trong va toc do Internet ngay nay da nhanh gap chuc lan so voi thoi xua. Ung dung cung danh khoang 500MB dung luong trong trong o dia ao cho nguoi dung luu tru.
Ban doc quan tam co the tai ve va su dung ngay ung dung Windows 95 phien ban 2.0 qua GitHub tai day. Ban se co kha nhieu lua chon gom cac goi macOS, Windows 10 32-bit, 64-bit hay ban danh cho Linux.

Cuoc thi viet "Phong su - Ky su" :
Trong mot chat room - Anh: Minh Tien
Chat room (phong tan gau chung) dang la thu mot duoc nhung chatter (nguoi tan gau) chuyen nghiep ua chuong. O do ho co the tha ho tan “thoai con ga mai” ve du thu tren troi duoi dat ma chang so ai lam gi. Nhung dang sau do la nhung an hoa ma cac chatter khong the luong truoc.
Tu nhung phong tan gau
Tan hoc, toi duoc anh ban cung lop ru vao quan Internet de chat. Sau khi vao Yahoo messenger khong thay nguoi ban nao online (dang tren mang), toi dinh ra ve thi anh ban keo lai, cuoi voi ve che gieu:
- May gio roi ma con chat kieu nay! Phai vao chat room moi la “sanh dieu”.
Anh ta kich chuot... mot day danh sach chat room hien ra. Anh kich tiep... Tren man hinh hien len mot chat room voi hon 30 nickname (ten dung khi chat) dang ban tan soi noi ve mot van de. Anh ban toi lien nhay vao, chat say me den noi khong con quan tam toi toi dang ngoi ben.
Bat chuoc anh, toi cung vao mot phong khac va bat dau chat voi nhung nguoi trong phong. Mot chat room thuong co nhieu phong nho. Vi du nhu trong phong Hanoi co toi 70 phong nho danh so tu 1 - 70. Phong Vietfun co 48 phong nho, Saigon co 128 phong... Moi phong nho nay co the chua toi da 50 nguoi.
Sau nhieu lan vao chat room, toi nhan ra rang co rat nhieu nguoi vao phong chat nghiem tuc, nhung mot so khac la nhung nguoi roi hoi vao “buon dua le”. Ho “buon” du thu chuyen. Tu chuyen thoi su, chinh tri qua bao chi toi nhung chuyen luom lat tren Internet; tu chuyen rieng tu cua cac ca si, nguoi mau thoi trang toi chuyen cua cac bau so, ho deu “binh loan” mot cach vo tu.
Nao la: “Lao N.V.K. o tinh tao an hoi lo nhieu den noi gio phai vao nha da…” hay: “Hom qua tao vua bi mot “anh hung Nup” (cong an) tom, phai xi ra mot lit (100.000 dong) moi tha cho di day!”. Lai co chang bao: “Hom no tao di qua New Century, thay co con ca ve mac cai ao hai day trong “phe” loi mat”. Chang kia dap: “The thi bay gio tao cung phai sam cho con nguoi yeu mot cai nhu the. He he…”.
Roi toi chuyen cac ca si, nghe si cung bi ho boi tung len. Ho khao nhau: “Chung may biet tin gi chua, ca si L. la “gay” (nguoi dong tinh luyen ai) mot tram phan tram day!”. Mot chatter khac tra loi: “Thao nao tao thay dao nay han mac toan do loe loet nhu con gai ay”. Hay nhu: “Thang cha D. (dien vien dien anh D.) vua phai ra hau toa bon may biet chua?”; “Con be M.T. an mac ngay cang sexy (goi tinh) chung may a”...
Khong nhung the, chat room con la noi de ho thoa ma, chui boi lan nhau vi nhung ly do rat ngo ngan. Chatter vua dong den ca si M. lien bi mot fan (nguoi ham mo) cua ca si nay chui lai voi thu ngon ngu cho bua ma toi khong dam nhac ra o day. Roi mot fan cua David Beckham vua khen chang cau thu nay la nguoi dan ong dep nhat the gioi lien bi mot chatter khac thoa ma lai: “Beckham cai gi? Bec-gie thi co!”...
Khong chi chat tren mang, nhieu chatter con chat ngay bang… mom. Toi tung chung kien mot chatter khi thay than tuong cua minh bi nguoi khac si nhuc lien nhay dung len ngay trong phong. Chang nghien rang ken ket, mieng lien tuc phun ra nhung cau chui tuc tiu: “Me kiep!, D.me...”. Lan khac, ca phong chat dang yen lang thi bong giat minh boi mot chang pha len cuoi ro to. Thi ra han vua chui duoc ca phong!?
Phai cong nhan cac chatter deu co trinh do go chu sieu dang. Chi thay nhung ngon tay luot nhu bay tren ban phim con tren man hinh hien len nhung dong chu khong he mac loi chinh ta. Nhung that dang buon vi do khong phai la nhung ngon tu hay ho ma phan lon la nhung cau thoc mach, si nhuc lan nhau.
Phai noi rang phan dong chatter deu la nhung nguoi rat tre va co hoc thuc. Toi 90% trong so nhung nguoi ngoi trong cac phong chat la hoc sinh, sinh vien. Vay ma khong hieu sao ho co the trao doi voi nhau bang thu ngon ngu kho nghe nhu vay! Ben canh do, biet bao thoi gian va tien bac ma cac chatter bo ra de tan gau da troi qua vo ich.
… Den nhung an hoa kho luong
Mot diem chat room - Anh: Minh Tien
Khong dung lai o chuyen ban tan binh thuong, cac chatter con dua nhau post (dua) len mang du thu van hoa pham doc hai. Ho chi muon khoe voi nhau cai tai suu tap hay chi don gian la tai thoc mach cua minh.
Dau tien la nhung bai hat bi xuyen tac mot cach vo toi va. Bai dan ca Di cay hay la the da bi xuyen tac thanh:
“Len chua be mot thang…
Dem ninh that nhu
Bo vao nau canh
Ba bon co tum tum lai an, tum tum lai an…”.
Dang len an hon la nhieu bai hat oai hung, thieng lieng cua dan toc cung bi ho xuyen tac mot cach “vo tu”. Khi doc nhung dong do, khong chi toi ma chac chan nhieu nguoi tren dat nuoc nay se phan no vi mot su xuc pham vo y thuc cua ho...
Khong nhung the, nhung chatter con gioi thieu cho nhau nhieu trang web co noi dung xau ma hau het la cac trang websex nhu: S....com; T....com; Q....com hay ca Ch....com... Chi can kich vao mot trong nhung trang web tren lap tuc hien ra nhung hinh anh loa lo khien nguoi dung dan phai nguong ngung.
Trong nhung trang web kieu ay con co ca mot kho chuyen ma nguoi ta goi la “chuyen nguoi lon” thuc chat deu la nhung chuyen dam o, doi bai, kieu nhu: “Co giao Thao”, “Co giao Thuy”, “Chu Kim” hay “Tinh trung truyen”, “Than den”...
Tham chi co trang web con mo ca mot cuoc thi ram ro viet ve “chuyen nguoi lon”. Cac chatter thuong vao cac trang nay doc roi ke cho nhau nghe voi ve rat thich thu. Ngoai ra, co khong it chatter con chep lai tranh anh, truyen o cac trang web nay tiep tuc phat tan di nhieu noi khac.
Do la o cac phong chat cua VN. Con khi toi thu vao mot so phong cua nuoc ngoai nhu: Singapore, Brunei... thi lien tuc xuat hien nhung cau tuc tiu viet bang tieng Anh… Toi thu kich vao thi tu nhien nhan duoc mot dong anh “nuy” (khoa than)... Sau do la mot loat loi moi, kieu nhu: “Sure, you can see my webcam here!” (Ban co the xem webcam cua toi o day!), hay “Do you want... now?” (Anh co muon... ngay bay gio khong?).
Toi co co ban than ten P.A.. Co thuong xuyen vao cac chat room cua nuoc ngoai de hoan thien trinh do ngoai ngu cua minh. Co da ket than voi mot anh ban nguoi Malaysia co nickname la Dimasacty. Co da tin tuong han den muc cho ca dia chi nha cung so dien thoai o VN.
Mot hom dang noi chuyen thi han bao muon ban ve “sex” (gioi tinh). Tuong cung nhu nhung lan noi chuyen truoc, P.A. van thang than trao doi van de nay. Roi dot nhien han hoi: “Do you know...?” (Co co biet... khong?). P.A. so qua lien “log off” (ra khoi mang). Sau do co phai doi ca nickname va password (mat khau khi vao chat room). Nhung han van chua tha. Han thuong xuyen goi dien thoai toi nha, quay nhieu khien co mat an mat ngu.
Khong hieu nhung chatter nay roi se di ve dau?

Chi phi ban dau cho nguoi di Han Quoc chi 699 USD. Luong binh quan 640 USD/thang, lam viec toi da khong qua 3 nam
Thuc hien thoa thuan da ky giua Bo LD-TB-XH Viet Nam va Bo Lao dong Han Quoc ve viec dua lao dong sang lam viec tai Han Quoc, nam 2005 Bo LD-TB-XH thi diem tuyen chon hoc sinh dang hoc nghe tai cac truong cua mot so tinh tham gia du tuyen di lam viec tai Han Quoc. Ba Nguyen Thi Thanh Mai, Truong Phong Quan ly lao dong nuoc ngoai So LD-TB-XH TP.HCM da trao doi ve chuong trinh nay.
* Khac voi cac chuong trinh xuat khau lao dong, hinh thuc tuyen chon lao dong lan nay khong thong qua giai doan trung gian. Xin ba cho biet doi tuong tuyen chon cu the?
- Theo van ban 1765 cua Bo LD-TB-XH, TPHCM nam trong danh sach cac dia phuong duoc phan bo chi tieu ve viec tuyen chon lao dong di lam viec tai Han Quoc. Trong dot nay, TP duoc giao tuyen 120 hoc sinh chuyen nganh xay dung. Dieu kien: Hoc vien dang hoc nghe dai han tai nhung truong nghe, co ho khau TP, tuoi tu 18-39, da duoc kiem tra va ket luan du suc khoe.
Chuong trinh uu tien hoc vien la con liet si, thuong binh, gia dinh chinh sach, bo doi xuat ngu va nhung nguoi co thanh tich tot trong hoc tap. Khi ho so duoc hoan chinh, bo se goi sang Han Quoc de gioi thieu cho nguoi su dung lao dong. Chi nhung nguoi duoc phia doi tac tuyen chon moi duoc di lam viec tai Han Quoc.
* Nhung truong nao tai TP.HCM duoc so giao chi tieu tuyen chon? Hoc vien phai ton chi phi ra sao?
- Hien nay, TP.HCM chon 4 truong giao tuyen so lao dong nay: Truong Ky thuat Nghiep vu Xay dung, Truong Cong nhan Ky thuat (CNKT) Cu Chi, Truong CNKT TP va Truong Ky thuat Cong nghe Hung Vuong. Cach su dung SendHub de chuyen du lieu tu may tinh sang iPhone
Ban dang can chuyen du lieu tu may tinh sang iPhone ma khong co cap ket noi ke ben? Hay thu qua SendHub.
Ngay nay, viec chuyen du lieu tu may tinh sang iPhone khong con qua kho khan nhu truoc nua, tham chi ban cung khong can den cap ket noi hay iTunes. Tuy nhien, dieu kien can thiet de co the thuc hien viec chuyen du lieu nay la ban phai cai dat phan mem ho tro chuyen du lieu tren may tinh va trai qua nhieu buoc lam viec moi co the hoan thanh viec chuyen du lieu. Nhung voi SendHub thi moi chuyen dien ra don gian hon.
Bai viet nay se huong dan ban doc cach su dung SendHub de chuyen du lieu tu may tinh sang iPhone, moi ban doc cung tham khao.
Truoc tien, ban hay tien hanh tim va cai dat ung dung SendHub tu App Store vao iPhone.
Sau khi tai xong, ban hay khoi dong SendHub len va tien hanh cap phep cho ung dung duoc hien thi Thong bao.
Tiep theo, hay mo trinh duyet web tren may tinh va truy cap vao dia chi "sendhub.me".
Nhap vao lua chon "Scan QR code" trong ung dung tren iPhone va huong camera vao man hinh may tinh de tien hanh quet ma QR. Day la buoc ket noi iPhone voi may tinh.
Khi ket noi thanh cong, SendHub se hien thi thong bao cho ban.
Va giao dien SendHub tren iPhone se duoc chuyen sang muc quan ly du lieu.
Quay lai giao dien SendHub tren trinh duyet web o may tinh, ban hay keo va tha tap tin tu may tinh vao o "Paste URL or Drag local files (max 100MB) to this area to send".
Du lieu se duoc tai len may chu cua SendHub. Sau khi tai len hoan tat, ban hay nhap vao tuy chon "Send to phone".
Lap tuc du lieu se duoc gui den ung dung SendHub tren iPhone, va SendHub se hien thi thong bao cho ban.
Du lieu se duoc hien thi o tab Downloads, va qua trinh tai ve se dien ra tu dong.
Danh sach cac tap tin tai ve se hien thi o tab Files.
De thuc hien viec luu du lieu tu SendHub vao iPhone, ban hay nhap vao bieu tuong 03 cham va chon "Share".
Ban co the lua chon cac hinh thuc chia se du lieu ma SendHub ho tro hoac nhap tiep vao tuy chon "Luu vao Tep".
Va lua chon vi tri luu tap tin la xong.
Khi muon ngat ket noi giua iPhone va may tinh, ban hay nhap vao tuy chon "Change device", roi nhan "OK" o trang web SendHub tren may tinh.
Rat don gian va khong he rom ra phai khong? Hi vong giai phap nay se co ich cho ban.

Tags: phun nuoc muoi, viem xoang, con dau, co the, trong mui, lam diu, cach lam, am, giam,
Phun nuoc muoi, u am va mot so lieu phap co the tu lam khac o nha se giup ban giam bot nhung con dau do viem xoang
Tren to Women's Health, cac bac sy o BV Mayo Clinic da cong bo chi tiet ve mot so buoc co ban de nhung nguoi bi viem xoang biet cach tu lam giam kho chiu cho minh khi mac phai can benh nay.
Do la nho hoac dung dang nuoc muoi phun suong de rua sach, loai bo chat nhay, lam thong cac duong dan khi trong mui va cac xoang.
Uong nhieu nuoc cung la cach giup lam loang chat nhay trong xoang, do do lam thong xoang.
U am mui cung se co tac dung chong dau xoang. Co the lam am xoang bang cach xong voi mot bat nuoc nong hoac phu mot chiec khan am va am len mat, trum len cac hoc xoang.
Va cuoi cung, ban can kieng uong ruou va hut thuoc khi bi viem xoang. Vi ruou co the lam nhung cho sung trong xoang toi te hon. Rieng thuoc la, chi can hit phai khoi thuoc do nguoi khac hut cung gay kich thich khong tot cho cac duong luu thong khi trong mui.
Viem xoang la tinh trang sung viem trong xoang (la cac khoang chua khong khi xung quanh mui va cac duong dan ben trong mui). Trieu chung cua viem xoang la dau va co cam giac bi nen o tran, hai ma va vung quanh mat; sung huyet va chay mu trong mui; dau tai va giam kha nang vi giac va khuu giac.
Viem xoang thuong phat sinh khi thoi tiet lanh, can benh nay do vi rut gay ra, lam viem nhiem phan ben trong xoang, co the keo dai tu 10 - 14 ngay. Nhung nguyen nhan khac gay viem xoang nhu di ung, co khoi u nho trong mui...
Viem da xoang la mot loai benh rat thuong gap o moi lua tuoi, nhat la o phu nu.

Sau hai lan quay so, Yokohama da tim ra duoc chu nhan cua 4 tam ve di Nhat xem Chelsea thi dau cung 4 giai nhat (trung dien thoai iPhone X), 10 giai nhi (TV Sony 55 inch)...
Khi duoc ban to chuc Yokohama lien he thong bao trung thuong qua dien thoai, chi Thuy - khach hang trung giai dac biet lan 2 da reo len vui suong: “Oi that the a? Oi gioi oi vui qua… sung suong qua”. Chi Thuy cho biet chi mua lop xe may co gia khoang 200 ngan dong ma nhan duoc qua qua to nen khong khoi bat ngo.
Co the noi, day la tam trang cua hau het cac khach hang khi nhan duoc thong bao trung thuong tu cong ty. Chi Hoai Thuong, mot trong hai khach hang may man dau tien cua chuong trinh da xuc dong cho hay: “Lan dau nhan cuoc goi, toi cu nghi la ban be treu choc chu lam sao ma may man nhu the duoc. The nhung, den cuoc goi thu hai tu cong ty thi toi tin. Va cam xuc that su dang trao”
Gan 2/3 chang duong di qua, Yokohama da tim duoc nhung chu nhan may man cua cac phan qua cua chuong trinh
Khi nhan giai thuong, khach hang trung thuong hao hung cho hay “Den day nhan giai toi cam thay vui suong hon gap 100 lan so voi khi duoc thong bao trung thuong qua dien thoai”.
Cung trong tam trang hao hung va phan khoi, anh Kim Duc Ngoc (Go Vap, TP.HCM) la khach hang trung giai Nhat cua lan 1 chia se: “Toi xin cam on Yokohama rat nhieu, truoc gio toi chua tung thay hang lop xe nao co chuong trinh quay so voi nhieu giai thuong gia tri nhu Yokohama”.
Khi duoc hoi ve viec su dung giai thuong lan nay, anh Duc Ngoc cho biet se dung chiec iPhone X lam qua tang vo nhan ngay sinh nhat sap den. Dieu do duong nhu khien gia tri cua giai thuong cang them y nghia!
Ong Pham Thanh Tu - Truong phong Marketing Cong ty TNHH Yokohama Tyre Viet Nam cho biet: “Day la nam dau tien Yokohama to chuc chuong trinh trung thuong tri an den khach hang tren toan quoc voi nhieu giai thuong hap dan. Dac biet, tam ve di Nhat xem Chelsea thi dau trong nam nay rat hiem boi so luong ve gioi han”.
Chuong trinh “Di Nhat xem Chelsea cung Yokohama” se keo dai tu nay den het 31/5. Ngoai nhung giai thuong xac dinh tai buoi quay so con co hang ngan giai the cao dien thoai 50.000 dong ma khach hang duoc nhan ngay sau khi quet ma QR.
Qua 2 lan quay so, chuong trinh se chi con duy nhat dot quay so vao ngay 3/6 de tim ra cac chu nhan cua 4 giai di Nhat xem Chelsea thi dau, 3 giai iPhone X va 6 giai Tivi Sony 4K. Khach hang nao chua tham gia hay mua ngay lop xe (xe may, xe oto, xe tai…) de nhan the cao may man. Xem them chi tiet chuong trinh tai day hoac goi hotline 0908651041.

Kinh nguyet va roi loan kinh nguyet
Kinh nguyet va roi loan kinh nguyet Tags: Roi Loan Kinh Nguyet, chu ky kinh, co the, sinh hoat, anh huong, qua nhieu, phu nu, suc khoe, ngay, benh, mau, luong, gay
Roi loan kinh nguyet (RLKN) hay kinh nguyet (KN) khong deu la chung benh thuong gap o phu nu trong do tuoi sinh san. Benh anh huong khong nho toi sinh hoat cung nhu suc khoe, nang hon co the gay vo sinh.
The nao la RLKN
Chu ky KN thuong keo dai tu 21 - 35 ngay, trong do 3 - 5 ngay co kinh. Luong mau trung binh mat di sau moi lan hanh kinh la tu 50 - 150ml. Chu ky KN khong deu va khong on dinh, luong mau mat di sau nhung ngay hanh kinh qua it hoac qua nhieu, muc do huyet sac to sau chu ky kinh thap hon muc kinh thuong (120g/l) la nhung bieu hien thuong thay o nhung phu nu bi RLKN.
Nhung nguyen nhan cua RLKN la gi?
Co the do nhieu nguyen nhan, thuong gap nhat la: stress (nghia la trong cuoc song co nhieu yeu to gay cang thang, lo phien, dau kho…), roi loan tieu hoa (an qua nhieu), nhiem khuan (vi du bi viem co tu cung), lao dong hoac luyen tap the thao qua nhieu, tut can (co the mat nhieu mo), thai ngoai tu cung. Mot so nguyen nhan khac it gap hon can duoc thay thuoc xem xet nhu: benh ly o tuyen noi tiet, benh ve mau, benh giam tieu cau.
Nhung RLKN thuong gap
Chu ky kinh ngan, nhieu, keo dai: chu ky KN it hon 21 ngay goi la “chu ky kinh ngan”, ngay hanh kinh keo dai 7 ngay goi la “ky kinh keo dai”. Con ve luong kinh thi thong thuong chi co the dua vao so bang ve sinh dung de phan doan. Ha Noi oi cho ta Tags: Ha Noi, Sai Gon, nguoi khuyet tat, co gai, con nguoi, chi co, anh, em, dau, cho, den
Trua nay, cai nang Sai Gon nhu bot hung hang di, em a? Vi sao u? Vi mot co gai Ha Noi.
Ca phe chieu thu bay
Khi anh va cac ban dong nghiep dang ban mat cho may tinh, ban lung cho vach tuong (anh lam van phong ma) thi co gai ay buoc vao. Cai lanh Ha Noi, hoi hom cua Ha Noi, tat tat thu cua Ha Noi theo giong noi de thuong dac Ha Thanh ua vao phong.
Khong ban phim nao co the dien ta su ngo ngang cua anh luc ay!
Phai, em. Phai, Ha Noi. Co ay la Ha Noi hay Ha Noi la co ay? De anh dem nay tran troc chong den nghi mai ve thu do cua anh, ve cai noi ma anh muon den mot lan. Phai, it ra la mot lan trong doi. Nhu tin do Hoi Giao, suot doi nguoi neu co kha nang phai di hanh huong den thanh dia Caaba mot lan.
Ha Noi, du chua mot lan anh den, nhung nhac nho anh ve nhieu ky niem. Nguoi ta khong can phai den mot noi roi moi co ky niem ve noi do. Chi can gap tiep xuc voi nguoi Ha Noi la anh da thay gan bo voi Ha Noi roi!
Khong phai co gai tren dau. Dung nghi oan cho nguoi ta. Co ta khong phai la nguoi dau tien o Ha Noi ma anh biet de roi anh phai phat sot len the nay.
Ha Noi trong anh gom nhieu thu lam chu khong don gian chi la mot co gai!
Va neu em muon nghe, anh se noi! Ha Noi trong anh la nhung nguoi ban khuyet tat, nhung nguoi ban ma anh quen qua dien dan Nguoi khuyet tat Viet Nam, de roi sau nay gap tai Dai hoi the thao toan quoc danh cho Nguoi khuyet tat. Ho, da day anh rat nhieu dieu. Rang con nguoi than the khuyet tat khong dang so, chi dang so la con nguoi khuyet tat tam hon. Rang nguoi khac so hai dang ve be ngoai cua anh cung khong sao, chi dang so la chinh anh so dang ve cua anh.
Ha Noi trong anh la anh chang thu sinh ngheo trong xom tro. 6 nam rong van thuong nho bong hinh mot nguoi con gai Ha Noi. Moi tinh cua ho dep vo cung. Anh biet rang, voi tinh yeu chan chinh, nguoi ta co the vuot qua bao giong, co the cho doi nhau suot kiep.
Anh biet rang, tinh yeu co mot suc manh rieng cua no ma khong luc luong sieu nhien nao co ngoai con nguoi. Phai, chi co con nguoi moi co tinh yeu em a!
The thi, vung dat ay phai the nao moi co nhung con nguoi manh me duong ay, dep de duong ay?
Chi co dia linh moi sinh nhan kiet!
Em se cuoi va bao rang anh ngay tho den muc cuong tin ve Ha Noi, rang Ha Noi khong tot dep nhu anh tuong dau. Co he gi? O dau chang co tot xau, o dau chang co thien ac, o dau chang co the nay the khac ho em? Thien dang. Phai. Chi co thien dang. Ma em hay anh, hay bat cu ai cung khong thich o tren thien dang dau. Chung ta deu thich cuoc song nay, thich tran gian nay voi bao nhieu dieu tran the.
Ha Noi voi bao dieu cua Ha Noi va chi co vay no moi la Ha Noi. The thoi, anh chua den muc ngay tho va cuong tin dau, em a!
Vay thi, xin hay de Ha Noi ven nguyen trong anh. Hay cu de anh mo ve mot Ha Noi trong mo. Co he gi khi ta nuoi cho minh mot giac mo?
Ha Noi oi, cho ta!
Sai Gon, 09/01/2008

Neu chua biet di dau de doi gio dip le 304 nhat dinh khong duoc bo qua nhung thanh dia checkin nay dau nhe
Tags: Hang Mua, Chua Tam Chuc, Ninh Binh, Tam Diep, ngoi bo goi, dia diem, nhat dinh, chinh la, Dinh Khong, doi gio, Di dau, 30/4, le, dip, ban,
Dip le 30/4 nam nay, thay vi ngoi bo goi buon chan o nha, sao ban khong len lich checkin ngay 3 dia diem "song ao quoc dan" dang lam say long gioi tre nay nhi?Su kien:
Cai ten dau tien can duoc nhac den trong danh sach nay khong dau khac chinh la Hang Mua - dia diem checkin hot nhat Ninh Binh suot tu nua cuoi nam 2018 toi nay.
Hang Mua nam o huyen Hoa Lu, duoc menh danh la "Van ly truong thanh Viet Nam" hay "nang tho cua Tam Coc" khien bat cu ai cung muon toi de so huu nhung buc hinh "song ao" khong the dep hon.
Diem nhan cua Hang Mua chinh la gan 500 bac thang voi kien truc an tuong dan len dinh nui. Doc duong la nhung buc tuong kien truc, gian hoa giay moc tu nhien tren vach nui hay thi thoang la nhung chu de duoc tha tu do.
Von noi tieng voi dinh nui Mua co the ngam toan canh vung dat Tam Coc thi bay gio Hang Mua sau khi hai ngon thap song ao moi duoc hoan thien, dan mang ran ran keo nhau toi day de tham quan, chup anh. Hien gio, Hang Mua van la dia diem hut gioi tre nhat mien Bac.
Khung canh hoang so, hung vi cung mot mau xanh trai dai cua Hang Mua nhat dinh se mang den cho ban nhung trai nghiem vo cung thu vi trong dip le 30/4 nay
Doi dua Tam Diep
Sau Hang Mua thi doi dua Tam Diep dang noi len la dia diem checkin hut gioi tre nhat nhi khong chi o Ninh Binh ma con o ca mien Bac.
Nong trai dua Tam Diep thuoc nong truong Dong Dao toa lac tai thanh pho Tam Diep, Ninh Binh. Tu Ha Noi, ban de dang di chuyen den dia diem nay bang xe may trong hon 2 tieng.
Toan nong truong Dong Giao rong khoang 5.500 ha va cac bui dua chiem den 60% dien tich cay trong an qua.
Du khach khong phai tra phi khi tham quan, chup anh tai trang trai, nhung nen xin phep nhung nguoi quan ly truoc khi vao.
Dieu moi nguoi can chu y khi toi tham doi dua la khong tu y hai qua, be la hay giam len bui dua. Thoi diem hop ly nhat de check-in tai day la dau he, tu thang 4-7, khi nong trai dang trong vu mua thu hoach dua.
Chua Tam Chuc, Ha Nam
Chua Tam Chuc chinh la ngoi chua duoc nhac ten nhieu nhat thoi gian qua, day cung chinh la mot trong nhung ngoi chua lon nhat the gioi voi phong cach duoc mo phong giong nhu Vinh Ha Long.
Chua Tam Chuc o thi tran Ba Sao, Kim Bang, Ha Nam, chi cach thanh pho Phu Ly khoang 10km chinh vi vay viec di chuyen den day cung kha de dang.
Ngoi chua so huu mot vi tri vo cung dac dia khi phia sau chua la nui That Tinh, phia truoc la ho Luc Nhac. Trong ho co 6 hon dao nho theo tuong truyen chinh la 6 chiec chuong ma ong troi da ban cho noi day.
Chua Tam Chuc la quan the gom chua Ngoc hay con goi la Dan Te Troi, dien Tam Bao, dien tho Phap chu Thich Ca Mau Ni, vuon Kinh, dinh Tam Chuc,...
Ve uy nguy, co kinh cua chua Tam Chuc chac chan se giup ban luu giu nhung buc anh thuc su "de doi".
Gio thi ban da san sang de chuan bi ke hoach cho chuyen vi vu nhan dip nghi le 30/4 sap toi chua nao?

Chi phi cung khong con la gi neu goc nho mang lai nhieu niem vui cho cuoc song cua gia dinh.Thiet ke san vuon tieu canh nha pho ben canh thuc hien viec don thuan con la nhung chau hoa, nhung cay kieng dep duoc bai tri phu hop trong nha ma can nhieu den kha nang to chuc va bai tri cua ban de dem lai nhieu chat thien nhien vao nha. Do co the con la nhung khuc go, nhung vien soi, nhung hon da cuoi va anh den nhe nhang cho khong khi trong ngoi nha them em diu va thoai mai.Thiet ke san vuon tieu canh nha pho – 01 Nhung chau cay, ngon co cung nhung vien soi trang tron se con lam bung sang 1 goc khuat nao do trong ngoi nha ban. Tao tieu canh khong phai qua kho do con lang cung khong phai don gian. De sac xanh luon chan hoa trong tung mot noi, ban nen lua chon nhung loai cay co de song, xen vao do con la nhung canh hoa, canh cay kho, cay nhua de tieu canh nha ban them duyen dang va cuon hut hon.O bat cu vi tri nao trong nha, khi co su gop mat du con la nho nhat cua thien nhien, hoa la cung dem lai cho ban cam giac thu thai va de chiu.Thiet ke san vuon tieu canh nha pho – 02Khi dien tich tro thanh bai toan kho giai cho nhung nguoi song trong do thi thuc hien viec “tranh thu” dua tung ngon co, nhanh hoa vao mot noi song nho hep do con la vay cang tro nen kho hon. Nhung du luon doi mat voi su gioi han dien tich do con lang nguoi ta van co gang “uu tien” 1 phan nao do cho mau xanh cua cay co do con la them vao nha suc song va su tuoi hoan toan moi tu thien nhien.Muon co 1 thiet ke san vuon tieu canh nha pho dep, ban can biet ket hop nhung vat lieu tu nhien do con la soi, da, canh cay kho… va cay co sao cho phu hop. Tuy vao dien tich cung do con la dac thu cua tung mot noi kien truc va tri sang tao ra cua ban de lua chon duoc thuc hien viec chuan bi dat tieu canh phu hop nhat. Neu con la mot noi nho, ban co the lua chon kich co vua phai cho cay cung do con la cac vat trang tri khac. Neu con la mot noi lon, nhung loai cay canh co lon hoac bonsai co the thich hop dat o tieu canh, vua de dieu hoa khong khi vua tao ra an tuong doc dao cho can nha cua ban.Thiet ke san vuon tieu canh nha pho – 03Nhung mau thiet ke san vuon tieu canh cho nha dep tren ben canh thuc hien viec gop phan tao ra diem nhan cho mot noi ma con che bot nhung khiem khuyet con ton tai trong nha ban. Co the con la o goc tuong, gam cau thang, khoang dien tich khiem ton canh cua so… voi toan bo nhung hinh dang khac nhau deu co the tao ra nen nhung tieu canh dep va lang man cho ngoi nha noi pho xa tap nap.Cong ty Kien Truc giup gia dinh ban co nhung mau thiet ke san vuon tieu canh cho nha dep ung y nhat, du con la nha pho, du phia ngoai con la su tap nap va nao nhiet cua duong pho thi ban Ban co the giu cho ngoi nha cua minh chut binh yen va hien hoa chat loc tu thien nhien khien cuoc song cua ban de chiu va y nghia hon.Dich vu thiet ke Kien Truchttp://chuyenkientruc.com Comments comments NHA DEP

Bao Su that va bao Nuoc Nga Xo Viet ngay 21/11 dua tin ve chuyen tham chinh thuc Viet Nam cua Tong thong Vladimir Putin nhan manh trong thanh phan Doan co Chu tich Ban chap hanh Trung uong Dang Cong san Lien bang Nga (KPRF), Lanh dao phai Dang Cong san trong Duma quoc gia G. Ziuganov.
Sau cuoc gap go tai tru so Trung uong Dang Cong san Viet Nam, ong Ziuganov tuyen bo: "Dang Cong san Viet Nam da neu mot tam guong ve quan ly che do (XHCN) dat hieu qua cao". Ong noi: "Duoi su lanh dao cua Dang Cong san, nuoc Viet Nam XHCN dat duoc nhip do phat trien kinh te cao nhat, giai quyet thang loi nhiem vu nang cao phuc loi cho nhan dan, nang dong nam bat cac cong nghe va phuong phap quan ly tien tien. Viet Nam dang gianh duoc uy tin to lon nhu mot trong nhung nuoc phat trien nang dong nhat o khu vuc chau A - Thai Binh Duong".
Bao Su that cho rang viec Doan dai bieu cap cao cua Lien bang Nga voi day du thanh phan tham gia chung to viec cung co moi quan he huu nghi Nga-Viet nhan duoc su ung ho cua toan dan.
Bao Nuoc Nga Xo Viet nhan xet viec tien hanh cuoc gap go thuong dinh APEC tai Ha Noi la su thua nhan nhung thanh cong kinh te to lon cua "nhung nguoi anh em Viet Nam cua chung ta". Thuc te dat nuoc XHCN nay dang phat trien mot cach vung chac voi nhip do tang truong cao. Quan he kinh te voi Viet Nam can phai duoc chan chinh lai.

+ Cac nhac si nghi gi khi ma ca khuc VN den tan hom nay van khong len chan vao thi truong am nhac khu vuc? Mac du thinh thoang chung ta van dua no di toi cho nay cho no, nham gioi thieu, quang ba va sau do thi... tat ngum. (dung, 27 tuoi, dung27dk@)
- NS Thanh Tung: mot phan thi cac ca khuc cua VN qua that con kho chon lua duoc thi hieu cua nguoi nghe. Mot phan la do su tuyen truyen, co xat va hoi nhap co qua it co hoi. Con viec chung ta cho rang gioi thieu cho no cho kia ma sau do bi tat ngum la do gioi thieu qua it va khong lua chon dung nhung tac pham tieu bieu cua VN.
- NS Nguyen Cuong: Toi xin hoi ban mot cau nay nhe: the thi cac bai hat cua khu vuc co den VN khong, den voi tac dung gi, den nhu the nao? Khong phai khong! Cho nen am nhac VN co den voi khu vuc cung cha co y nghia gi! Dung danh gia no quan trong qua. Mot ca khuc den voi the gioi thi do la ca mot van de, la mot cong nghe lang xe... o cac nuoc phat trien.
Am nhac VN phuc vu cho 80 trieu dan la qua hanh phuc. Neu dem am nhac di giao luu thi nhac tre la duoc roi. Con neu nhac VN den duoc voi the gioi, voi khu vuc thi chung ta chi tu hao, chi ngang dau khi dan ca cua chung ta ra ngoai. Dieu quan trong nhat trong am nhac la minh thoa man duoc cam xuc cua minh, the thoi.
- NS Quoc Trung: Truoc tien viec chua chen chan duoc vao thi truong am nhac khu vuc la vi chung ta chua co mot thi truong am nhac theo dung nghia cua no. Mot mat khac, cung khong the phu nhan la am nhac cua chung ta chua du dang cap de thuyet phuc hay hap dan doi voi thi truong do. Viec di day di do nhu hien nay van mang nhieu tinh giao luu, huu nghi chu chua phai la nhu cau thuong thuc am nhac VN tu nhung thi truong do .
- NS Duong Thu: O nuoc ngoai, no khong co thu goi la "am nhac bao cap", tat ca deu phai tro thanh hang hoa va duoc san xuat ra de ban nen no co cai goi la "thi truong am nhac". Va da goi la thi truong thi no co nhung qui luat cua no va nhung qui luat nay khong phu thuoc vao chuyen nhac hay, nhac do.
Chung ta moi hinh thanh "thi truong am nhac" trong mot vai nam nay theo kieu cua chung ta, tuc la chang giong ai. Vi vay, mot san pham o VN dau chat luong den may no cung khong the mang ra de ban dung nghia. Cho nen thi truong that su trong nuoc khong co lam sao ma mo den chuyen ban hang ra nuoc ngoai.
Cuoi cung chi la chuyen giao luu van hoa de phuc vu cong tac ngoai giao, tuyen truyen chinh tri chu chua phai la am nhac. Nhung hien nay co ve nhu chung ta bang long o cai muc do nay, khong co nhung tam nhin chien luoc, khong co nhung hoach dinh chinh sach, khong co nhung dau tu thich dang cho viec hoi nhap am nhac theo nghia cua ban la "len chan vao thi truong am nhac". Ban buon, toi cung buon.

Truong ban VHVN bao TT Luu Dinh Trieu (giua) tang hoa cho N Thanh Tung (phai) va NS Vu Quoc Viet - Anh: N.C.T.
- NS Vu Quoc Viet: Cung co the la co mot ti noi loan. Nhung phai noi la da dang thi thuan tai hon. Giong nhu cac chuong trinh tren kenh truyen hinh, chung ta thay hop chuong trinh nao thi nen chon kenh do de xem. Neu chon nham kenh thi se rat buc minh khong nhu so thich cua minh vay thoi. Thi thoi, cung co lam dieu quanh cuoc song lam cho ta doi luc buc doc, nhung nghi cho cung thi do moi la chan dung cuoc song chu. Hay cu ghet cu thuong nhu lan dau tap yeu tap nho nhe!!!
- NS Quoc Trung: Toi lai nghi nguoc lai, la cac nhac sy tre chung toi qua hien hoac doi khi qua "gia" so voi toc do cua cuoc song hien dai. Nhac vang, trong suy nghi cua nguoi Viet thoi diem no ra doi va phat trien, chi thich hop vao thoi diem do va khong con phu hop voi toc do cua cuoc song hom nay
- NS Nguyen Cuong: Toi khong nghi nhac tre noi loan. Do la cuoc choi cua thanh nien. O cac nuoc khac tren the gioi cung the, am nhac la cuoc choi cua TT, rat hay, co ban sac, co van hoa… Trong cuoc choi ay co hang ngan, hang van nhom, co nhom de toc dai, nhom de dau dinh, nhom cao troc... Va du hinh thuc co nhu the nao thi trong cuoc choi nay se noi len mot tai nang. Am nhac cung the, cho nen dung qua lo lang.
- NS Thanh Tung: neu noi tu "noi loan" thi oan cho nhac tre. Nhac tre can phai soi noi, song dong. Dung nghi rang su soi noi ve hinh thuc la su noi loan. Van de la hien nay no chua hay tham chi co nhung bieu hien lac duong. Tu tu cac NS tre se tien bo hon ve ky thuat, se hieu biet hon ve tinh cam, tri tue cua doi song noi tam con nguoi. Toi hoan toan tin rang trong cuoc doi nguoi ta, nhung dien bien nhu vay hoan toan co the xay ra. Ban than toi cung da tung trai qua mot qua trinh nhu vay.
+ Khong biet la cac nhac si co cam nhan nhu the nao ve xu huong am nhac Viet Nam trong thoi gian toi? (truong vinh nghi, 26 tuoi, Địa chỉ email này đang được bảo vệ khỏi chương trình thư rác, bạn cần bật Javascript để xem nó
-NS Thanh Tung: khong biet cac NS khac thi nhu the nao nhung rieng ca nhan toi thi toi biet rang nhung loai nhac theo mot thi se bien doi vi khi mot bien doi thi nhac cung bien mat. Cac gia tri can ban cua am nhac cang ham chua nhieu tac pham thi tac pham cang ton tai lau dai.
- NS Quoc Trung: Se co 2 xu huong ro net: Mot la se huong toi mot mau so chung , xu huong hoi nhap voi am nhac the gioi cua mot so nhac sy co dang cap va tay nghe cao. Xu huong nay se nang cao chat luong am nhac va mo rong thi truong am nhac trong nuoc, dong nghia voi viec dao thai nhung bai hat hay nhung dong nhac kem chat luong
Mot xu huong khac la thoa man nhung yeu to truyen thong va ca thoi quen thuong thuc cua khan gia VN . Dieu nay se dan toi viec mau thuan va phan cuc trong thi hieu am nhac
+ Thinh thoang nguoi nghe van hay trach bay gio chang co gi de nghe cho ra tro, nhung bai hat hay thi da cu, tham chi qua cu, nghe cung khong con hay nua, nhung bai moi thi chang hay. Cac nhac si nghi sao ve dieu tren? Toi cung muon biet them, thinh thoang gioi nhac si trach gi, trach nguoi nghe hay tu trach minh? Hay chang trach gi ca? (Anhnghi, 30 tuoi, nghianhdung@)
- NS Thanh Tung: Ket luan cua ban cho rang nhac hay thi da cu va nhac moi thi khong hay, toi e rang cung hoi cuc doan. Doi khi chung ta cung phai biet nghe lai nhung danh khuc cua nhieu thoi ky phat trien trong am nhac VN va doi khi cung phai kien nhan cho doi nhung tac pham moi.
- Ns Vu Quoc Viet: Chung ta dang buoc den nguong cua cai tuoi thuong thuc chu that su qua roi cai thoi giai tri rong choi chang? VQV cung rat nhieu dem nam suy ngam nhu the. Vay ma troi cung cho gap may de hom nay gap cau hoi nhu minh tung hoi.
Co nhung cai goi la hay thi suot doi no van cu con hay. Dau biet rang qua thoi gian no co bi cu hay co tinh moi. Va tat nhien thoi nao cung co cai hay va cai chua duoc hay. Co the hien tai co nhieu cai giai tri vay quanh qua va nhung cai thuong thuc thi nam an dau do thi sao! Hay co gang tim lai lan nua chang! Biet dau cung co chut dang nghe va moi that su day. Dung lang thinh o tuoi 30 nhu toi cach day chi vai thang thoi.
- NS Do Bao: Am nhac toan cau dang be tac, bay gio kiem duoc mot dia nhac hay "ra tro" cua nuoc ngoai cung kho chu khong noi gi den dia nhac trong nuoc von van hoc tap theo nuoc ngoai tu khau co ban den khau nang cao. Nhung ma ban dung bi quan qua, toi tin la neu chiu kho tim kiem, the nao ban cung thay nhac Viet co nhieu ca khuc tuyet voi cua hom nay du no co dang lan trong qua nhieu ca khuc binh thuong va khong hay.
Thinh thoang nhac si trach minh, trach khan gia, trach thoi gian hom qua va thoi gian hom nay cua doi song, nhung khach quan ma khong de goi ten. Xin cam on ban!

Gui loi cam on den cac co quan bao chi noi chung va cac phong vien theo doi giao duc noi rieng, Thu truong Le Hai An nhan manh, thoi gian qua, giao duc luon nhan duoc su quan tam cua cac co quan bao chi.
Phong vien, bao chi da tro thanh cau noi quan trong giua giao duc voi xa hoi va quan chung nhan dan. Qua do, giup xa hoi hieu va chia se nhieu hon voi nganh Giao duc.

Theo do, tren cac trang bao da co nhieu bai viet, nhieu tam guong dien hinh va nhung diem sang ve giao duc. Ben canh do, bao chi da kip thoi phan hoi nhung kho khan, han che cua nganh Giao duc, de tu do Bo co nhung dieu chinh, quyet sach phu hop hon.

The Three Steps East: Yunyan Tansheng [W-G: Yun-yen T’an-sheng / J: Ungan Donsho]
Yunyan Tansheng [W-G: Yun-yen T’an-sheng / J: Ungan Donsho]
Yunyan Tansheng once told this parable: “Three travelers noticed a man standing on a small hill looking out over the landscape. The first traveler said, ‘Look at that man. I suppose he’s searching the country round for an animal that has wandered from his herd.’
“‘Not at all,’ the second said, ‘he’s simply watching out for a friend who’s coming to visit him.’
“‘Nonsense,’ said the third. ‘He’s just enjoying the refreshing breeze.’
“The travelers argued among themselves but weren’t able to come to agreement about why the man was standing there. When they came nearer to him, the first traveler called out to the man, ‘Are you looking for a goat or sheep which has wandered from your flock?’
“‘I don’t have any flocks,’ the man replied.
“‘Then are you waiting for a friend?’ the second asked.
“‘No. I’m not waiting for a friend.’
“‘Ah,’ said the third. ‘It must be as I expected that you’re just enjoying the refreshing breeze.’
“‘Not particularly,’ the man said.
“‘Then what are you doing?’ the three travelers demanded.
“‘I’m just standing here.’”
[Yunyan Tansheng – Zen Masters of China : 116-18, 129]

Den luot Facebook bi phat hien su dung nhan vien con nguoi de nghe doan ghi am cua nguoi dung
Tuy nhien, Facebook nhan manh rang viec su dung con nguoi de danh gia doan ghi am chi danh cho nhung ai lua chon su dung tinh nang Voice to Text cua ho.
Theo bao cao moi tu Bloomberg, Facebook da thue cac nha thau ben ngoai de danh gia va bien dich cac doan ghi am cua nguoi dung. Facebook cho biet ho da dung viec dung nhan vien con nguoi de danh gia cac doan ghi am nay "tu hon mot tuan truoc," va nhan manh rang cac nha thau ben ngoai da duoc thue chi de kiem tra xem cac doan hoi thoai an danh co duoc bien dich chinh xac trong ung dung Messenger hay khong.
Tu nam 2015, Messenger da cung cap tinh nang de bien dich cac doan ghi am thanh van ban – Voice to Text, cho du mac dinh no duoc tat. Facebook tuyen bo rang chi nhung nguoi chon bat tinh nang nay moi co cac doan hoi thoai ghi am duoc cac nha thau ben thu ba danh gia.
Tuy nhien, tren trang ho tro cua minh, chi can mot nguoi trong nhom chat cua ban dong y cho Facebook bien dich doan hoi thoai cua minh, bat ky doan am thanh nao trong luong chat do cung se duoc bien dich, cho du ai la nguoi gui chung len di nua.
Dang ngai hon, Facebook lai khong he de cap den viec dung cac nhan vien con nguoi de danh gia va bien dich nhung doan ghi am nay, cho du trong trang ho tro hay dieu khoan dich vu cua Facebook. Trong khi do trang ho tro chi ghi rang: "Tinh nang Voice to Text su dung may hoc. Ban cang su dung nhieu tinh nang nay, Voice to Text cang giup do ban nhieu hon."
Bao cao cua Bloomberg cho biet: "Facebook noi rang cac he thong cua ho tu dong xu ly noi dung va cac doan lien lac giua ban va nguoi khac de phan tich boi canh va nhung gi ben trong no. Ho khong he de cap den viec co nguoi khac dang quet noi dung nay."
Trong trang dieu khoan dich vu, Facebook chi noi ve nhung nha thau ben thu ba nhu nhung nguoi "ho tro cho viec kinh doanh cua chung toi" bang cach "phan tich cac san pham cua chung toi da duoc su dung nhu the nao," nhung ho khong noi ro dieu nay co the bao gom ca viec dung con nguoi de danh gia cac doan hoi thoai ghi am.
Trong khi co nhung thuyet am muu noi rang Facebook dang bi mat nghe len cac doan hoi thoai cua nguoi dung trong nhieu nam nay, bao cao cua Bloomberg lai cho rang Facebook khong thuc su lam nhu vay. Cac nha thau ben thu ba duoc phep nghe cac doan ghi am cua nhung nguoi dung cho phep ho lam vay – ve ly thuyet la nhu vay. Facebook chi khong noi ro voi nguoi dung ve viec anh dang tao ra cac doan bien dich do.
Bao cao nay den vao thoi diem hang loat ong lon trong lang cong nghe nhu Google, Apple, Microsoft va Amazon deu bi phat hien su dung cac nhan vien con nguoi de nghe cac doan ghi am thu duoc thong qua cac san pham tro ly ao ma khong noi ro voi nguoi dung. Sau khi bi phat hien, cac hang cong nghe deu cho biet da dung viec nay, hoac cho phep nguoi dung lua chon co su dung tinh nang do hay khong.

Bat them ke chu muu vu hanh ha tra tan thai phu dan toi sinh non
Tags: Nguyen Ngoc Huyen, Binh Tan, Nguyen Minh Dung, Ho Nhu Y, Huyen Binh Chanh, gay thuong tich, Cong an huyen, trai phap luat, tra tan, sinh non, bat giu, hanh ha, chu muu, thai phu, vu,
Cong an huyen Binh Chanh (TP.HCM) da bat giu Nguyen Ngoc Huyen (28 tuoi, ngu huyen Binh Chanh) de dieu tra, xu ly ve cac hanh vi “bat giu nguoi trai phap luat” va “co y gay thuong tich”. Huyen la doi tuong chu muu vu hanh ha, tra tan thai phu 18 tuoi toi sinh non gay phan no du luan.Su kien:
Nguyen Ngoc Huyen va Nguyen Minh Dung, hai ke chu muu vu hanh ha, tra tan thai phu dan toi sinh non.
Truoc do, Huyen cung voi Nguyen Minh Dung (anh trai Huyen, 37 tuoi) va Tran Nhat Khang (19 tuoi, cung ngu huyen Binh Chanh) da thuc hien vu tra tan chi Ho Nhu Y (18 tuoi, que quan tinh Long An, ngu quan 11, TP.HCM) khien chi nay say thai, thai nhi tu vong.
Vao cuoc dieu tra, Cong an bat giu Khang, con 2 anh em Dung va Huyen bo tron khoi dia phuong.
Qua truy xet, dem 22/4, trinh sat cong an phat hien Dung dang tron tai 1 khach san o quan Binh Tan (TP.HCM) nen bao vay bat giu.
2 ngay sau do, Cong an bat giu Huyen khi dang lan tron o mot khu nha tro tren duong 55, phuong Binh Tri Dong A, quan Binh Tan.
Doi tuong Dung, Khang da bi Cong an khoi to ve hanh vi “bat giu nguoi trai phap luat” va “co y gay thuong tich”.
Buoc dau dieu tra, Cong an xac dinh, chi Ho Nhu Y tung lam an chung voi anh em Dung, Huyen. Thoi gian gay day, Dung cho rang Y qua mat minh nen xay ra mau thuan. Them vao do, anh trai cua Y co no Dung 1,6 trieu dong nhung chua tra. Mau thuan dinh diem khi Dung cho rang anh trai cua Y da co tinh pha hoai chiec xe may cua y.
Nhu da dua tin, luc 9h ngay 11/4, ong Ho Van Ha (SN 1972, ngu tinh Long An) den Cong an xa Vinh Loc B, huyen Binh Chanh) trinh bao viec con gai minh la Ho Nhu Y (SN 2001) bi danh gay thuong tich toan than va sinh non (dua be duoc khoang 6 thang tuoi da chet sau khi sinh).
Nan nhan bi anh em Huyen, Dung tra tan toi say thai.
Vu viec duoc Cong an xa lap ho so, ban giao cho Cong an huyen Binh Chanh xac minh, lam ro. Qua truy xet, Cong an moi Khang va Tran Thi Suong (SN 1963, me de cua Dung va Huyen) len tru so de lam viec.
Khang thua nhan cung Dung va Huyen thuc hien hanh vi danh dap chi Nhu Y, roi cung ba Suong mang thi the thai nhi bo tai mot con hem o phuong Tan Tao, quan Binh Tan.
Tai co quan cong an, Khang khai nhan su dung ma tuy truoc khi danh dap Y theo chi dao tu Nguyen Minh Dung (SN 1982, ngu quan 6) va Nguyen Thi Ngoc Huyen (SN 1991).
Kham nghiem hien truong tai nha Dung, Cong an thu giu 16 goi nylon chua tinh the ran (nghi van la ma tuy da), mot goi nylon chua la cay kho (nghi van la co My), 3 bo dung cu su dung ma tuy da, 45 vien phao dang tron, 10 xe gan may cac loai, 2 can tieu li.
Cong an con thu giu 2 vien dan chi, mot binh gas mini co gan dau kho, 3 dao tu che, 2 sung tu che, mot khuc go dai 60cm, mot luoi dao roc giay dai 8cm, mot doan day xich co gan o khoa, mot doan cay tam vong dau gan ban chai dai 100cm, mot cuon bang keo, mot day nit, mot day du dai 173cm, mot doan kim loai mau den dai 45cm, mot cong so tam, mot mieng vai thun den.

“Toi cung ban gai deu la nguoi Han Quoc, sang lam viec tai khu cong nghiep Bien Hoa. Nay chung toi muon ket hon tai Viet Nam thi lam the nao?” (ban doc Jan Dong Gook). Tra loi: Viec dang ky ket hon giua nguoi nuoc ngoai voi nhau tai Viet Nam duoc thuc hien tai UBND cap tinh noi nguoi nuoc ngoai cu tru. Trong truong hop cac ben cu tru o hai tinh khac nhau thi ho co the chon UBND tinh, thanh pho noi mot ben cu tru de xin dang ky ket hon. Viec dang ky ket hon nhu tren chi tien hanh khi duong su co yeu cau chu khong mang tinh bat buoc. Thu tuc: - Nguoi nuoc ngoai xin dang ky ket hon voi nhau tai Viet Nam phai tuan thu theo quy dinh cua phap luat nuoc ho ve dieu kien ket hon va co giay xac nhan cua co quan co tham quyen cua nuoc ma nguoi nuoc ngoai la cong dan ve viec cho phep duoc dang ky ket hon tai co quan co tham quyen cua Viet Nam. Giay nay phai duoc hop phap hoa lanh su theo quy dinh cua phap luat Viet Nam va phai duoc dich ra tieng Viet, co chung nhan cua cong chung nha nuoc. - Trong thoi han 7 ngay ke tu ngay nhan du ho so hop le, chu tich UBND cap tinh ky giay chung nhan ket hon. Trong thoi han 7 ngay tiep theo, so tu phap tien hanh viec trao cho moi ben mot ban chinh giay chung nhan ket hon va ghi vao so dang ky ket hon. - Khi trao giay chung nhan ket hon, ca hai ben nam, nu phai co mat de cung ky vao giay chung nhan ket hon va so dang ky ket hon. Ban sao va so luong ban sao giay chung nhan ket hon duoc cap theo yeu cau cua hai ben nam, nu. Ban co the tham khao thu tuc tren de giai quyet viec tram nam cua minh. Jay Chou Rulz! Listen to Mama's Words. ^^ - BabelBabel
Jay Chou Rulz! Listen to Mama's Words. ^^
Posted by Sonia Andras on Saturday, April 9th 2011
曲: 周杰倫
詞: 周杰倫
Ci: Zhou Jie Lun
Lyrics: Jay Chou
Translation: eminemjamesuk & Ling – www.jay-chou.net
小朋友　你是否有很多問號　為什麼
Xiao peng you, ni shi fou you hen duo wen hao, wei shen me
Little children, do you have a lot of questions, why
別人在那看漫畫　我卻在學畫畫　對著鋼琴說話
Bie ren zai na kan man hua, wo que zai xue hua hua, dui zhe gang qin shuo hua
When other kids are reading manga, I am learning to draw and learning to communicate with the piano
別人在玩遊戲　我卻靠在牆壁背我的ABC
Bie ren zai wan you xi, wo que kao zai qiang bi bei wo de ABC
When other kids are playing games, I am leaning on the wall memorizing my ABCs
我說我要一台大大的飛機　我卻得到一台舊舊錄音機
Wo shuo wo yao yi tai da da de fei ji, wo jue de dao yi tai jiu jiu lu yin ji
I said that I wanted a large airplane, but I got an old recorder
為什麼　要聽媽媽的話　長大後你就會開始懂得這種話
Wei shen me, yao ting ma ma de hua, zhang da hou ni jiu hui kai shi dong de zhe zhong hua
Why should I listen to mother’s words? When you grow up you will understand what I am saying
長大後我開始明白　為什麼我跑的比別人快　飛的比別人高
Zhang da hou wo kai shi ming bai, wei shen me wo pao de bi bie ren kuai, fei de bi bie ren gao
After I got older I started to realize why I run faster than others and fly further than other people
將來大家看的都是我畫的漫畫　大家唱的都是　我寫的歌
Jiang lai da jia kan de dou shi wo hua de man hua, da jia chang de dou shi wo xie de ge
In the future, people will be reading my mangas and all the songs they sing will be written by me
媽媽的辛苦　不讓你看見　溫暖的食譜在她心裡面
Ma ma de xin ku bu rang ni kan jian, wen nuan de shi pu zai ta xin li mian
Mother’s hard work isn’t seen by others. She knows the warm recipe by heart
有空就多多握握她的手　把手牽著一起夢遊
You kong jiu duo duo wo wo ta de shou, ba shou qian zhe yi qi meng you
When you have time, hold her hand and sleep dream together
聽媽媽的話　別讓她受傷　想快快長大　才能保護她
Ting ma ma de hua, bie rang ta shou shang, xiang kuai kuai zhang da cai neng bao hu ta
Listen to mother’s words, don’t let her get hurt. You want to grow up quickly so you can take care of her
美麗的白髮　幸福中發芽　天使的魔法　溫暖中慈祥
Mei li de bai fa, xing fu zhong fa ya tian shi de mo fa, wen nuan zhong ci xiang
Beautiful white hair, growing inside happiness. Angel’s magic benevolence within (her) gentleness
在你的未來　音樂是你的王牌　拿王牌談個戀愛
Zai ni de wei lai, yin yue shi ni de wang pai na wang pai tan ge lian ai
In your future, music is your key to success, use it to get into a relationship
唉　我不想把你教壞　還是聽媽媽的話吧　晚點在戀愛吧
Ai wo bu xiang ba ni jiao huai hai shi ting ma ma de hua ba, wan dian zai lian ai ba
Sigh, I don’t want to teach you to be a bad kid. Why don’t you listen to what your mother says and get in a relationship later
我知道你未來的路　當媽比我更清楚
Wo zhi dao ni wei lai de lu, dang ma bi wo geng qing chu
I know your future path, but your mother knows it even better
你會開始學其他同學在書包寫東寫西
Ni hui kai shi xue qi ta tong xue zai shu bao xie dong xie xi
You will start imitating friends and write things on your backpack
但我建議你最好寫　媽媽我會用功讀書
Dan shi wo jian yi ni zui hao xie, ma ma wo hui yong gong du shu
But I suggest you better write: Mom I will put in my best effort to learn
用功讀書　怎麼會從我嘴巴說出
Yong gong du shu, zhe me hui cong wo zui ba shuo chu
I will study hard, how does that come from my mouth?
不想你輸所以要教你　用功讀書
Bu xiang ni shu suo yi yao jiao ni, yong gong du shu
I need to teach you because I don’t want you to lose. Study hard
媽媽織給你的毛衣　你要好好收著
Ma ma zhi gei ni de mao yi, ni yao hao hao shou zhe
The sweater mother gave you, you have to keep it safe
因為母親節到時我要告訴她　我還留著
Ying wei mu qin jie dao shi wo hui gao shu ta, wo hai liu zhe
Because on Mother’s Day, I want to tell her, I still have it
對了　我會遇到了周潤發
Dui le, wo hui yu dao le zou ren fa
Oh yea, I will meet Zhou Run Fa*
*Zhou Run Fa is a famous actor (Yes…He is Chow Yun Fat)
所以你可以跟同學炫耀　賭神未來是你爸爸
suo yi ni ke yi geng tong xue xuan yao du shen wei lai shi ni ba ba
So you can show off to your friends, “The God of Gambling will be your father”
我找不到童年寫的情書　你寫完不要送人
Wo zhao bu dao tong nian xie de qing shu, ni xie wan bu yao song ren
I can’t find the childhood love letter. Don’t give it away after you write it
因為過兩天你會在操場上撿到
yin wei guo liang tian ni hui zai cao chang shang jian dao
你會開始喜歡上流行歌　因為張學友開始準備唱吻別
Ni hui kai shi xi huan shang liu xing ge yin wei zhang xue you kai shi zhun bei chang wen bie
You will start to like pop music because Jacky Cheung is about to sing Kiss Goodbye*
*(Kiss Goodbye is a famous song that was a hit in the 90s)
Listen to mother’s words, don’t let her get hurt. You want to grow up quickly so you can take care of her and protect her

Thonau's diary: Wednesday, February 09, 2005
Vua ngoi gap lai quyen sach Ochem, trong dau cac thu cu nhay nhot lung tung hon loan ca len. Bay gio o nha da la trua mung 2 Tet. Dau xuan ba van thuong bao phai la nhung ngay yen binh, tinh lang, thanh than, khong vuong no nhung lo toan bon be, nhung cai va cau gat thuong nhat de don chao mot nam moi hanh phuc. Nhung o cai xu lanh nay thi kiem dau ra cai su thanh than day. Bon cai exams, qua nhieu cho mot nam se ban ron la lai day lo toan.
Lau lam roi khong con duoc cai cam giac the nao la Tet. Troi Delaware hai hom vua roi cung hoi lat phat mua, va chang lanh lam. O nha bo me bao troi Ha Noi cung the. Cai tiet troi mua xuan tuy co hoi am uot nhung lai am ap , day moi la niem mong moi moi khi tet ve. Chu cai lanh cat da cat thit cua gio mua dong bac thi chi bo chan nguoi ta o nha voi thit dong va banh chung ma thoi.
Khi Thao con nho nam nao bo cung goi banh chung. Bo da lam thi phai lam nhieu co, it ra cung co 30 cai. Con phai chia cho cac nha nua chu, goi it qua thi mat cong. The la tu may bua truoc do ba da phai chon duoc loai nep cai hoa vang that trang va ngon, roi thi dau xanh o que gui len con nguyen ca vo, ngam qua dem cho no mem ra. La dong ba cung chon that ky, de tau la xanh va to vua phai, khong bi ua nhieu ca, cung khong qua gia xo va cung se kho goi. Ngay hom truoc Thao voi di se ngoi rua tung tau la mot, xep ra phoi cho kho, roi ba voi me thi ngam gao va dau xanh vao hai cai chau Lien Xo cu to dung. Ca nha se day tu sang som de phu giup bo goi banh chung. Thao cat la va gap nep lai de bo xep vao nhau va goi banh. Me voi ba thi lien tuc thay nhau uop thit, do dau xanh va nam thanh tung nam to hon ngon tay. Bo chang can khuon ma goi nhanh va chac chan, vua vuong van lai vua dep. Nhung banh chung cua bo thi nhieu dau lam ma Thao lai ghet an dau cho nen bao gio cung tu goi cho minh vet noi mot cai banh nho nho, va hi hung ghe lam. Noi banh chung to dung cao den lung tuong dat ngay ngan tren cai ke gach, chat day cui kho. Den chieu toi yen tinh la nghe tieng no lop bop vui tai ghe lam. Bo bao gio cung ru moi nguoi den choi bai tam cuc de canh chung noi banh chung quy gia. Bay gio thi bo cung ban nhieu viec roi, ma nha cung chang may ai hao huc mon banh chung ngay Tet nhu xua nua, nen moi khi Tet den me chi dat dam ba chiec o may hang gio cha. U cung la thit, la dau, la gao sao ma khong ngon khong thom nhu cai banh cua nha.
Nam nay me bao Tet con ga, lai dang co cum ga nen chang ai dam mua ve an. Mam com phai cung thit lon va cac mon cung chang thay dau bong dang con ga. Neu ma o nha thi Thao se thich lam, vi binh thuong moi dip Tet nhat hay gio chap gi ma co mon ga la lai nhan nho. Me co lam mam com chac cung nho con gai o phuong xa dang chang biet Tet la cai gi.
Khi nho Thao van mong Tet den de co tien mung tuoi. Nhung lon len roi lai cam nhan ve Tet khac di mot chut. Thao thich nhung ngay giap Tet duoc di vong quanh Ha noi, nhat la tren khu pho co, de ngam nhin cai ve dep trong su nao nhiet cua Thu do, va de sam Tet. Mon khoai khau cua may co nang hoc sinh la mut va o mai Tet, the nen nam nao cung tranh voi me di mua do cho khay mut Tet de trang trong tren ban khach. Co nam chen nhau ca tieng dong ho den toat mo hoi hot moi mua duoc may can o mai, nhung nhin nhung tui mut o mai ngay Tet lai thay vui vui, chang co cam giac met moi gi nua. Ve den nha la da thay bo mua canh dao va cay quat canh de trang tri trong phong khach hay ngoai sanh. Con di Chau voi me lai thich that nhieu cay hoa ruc ro mau sac de trong trong san cho do trong. The la nha cua cu tu tu duoc don dep, trang tri, bay bien cho that dep de don xuan. Nam moi, troi dat moi, pho phuong va ngoi nha than yeu cung moi, long minh cung moi hon len mot chut.
Ke ra "an Tet" cung la mot tu hop ly, vi Tet la de an ma. Nha nao cung vay, co khi ngheo lam cung tranh thu danh dum ca nam de den Tet mua vai can thit lam co. Vi dau nam la phai no du, thi ca nam moi no du duoc. Cai tu lanh nam nao den 30 Tet la cung chat day cac loai tom cua ca thi, rau co de du tru cho may ngay Tet. Thao thi chang may man ma voi nhung mon an ngay Tet, vi thuong thi toan la thit ga. Banh chung, gio cha va cao luong my vi an mai cung ngay, nguoi ta thich doi qua nhung mon binh dan nhe nhang hon. The la ngay Tet thi nhau moc len nhung quan bun cua bun oc. Toan nhung mon khoai khau cua Thao ma, trong tui luc do lai rung rinh tien nen chang bao gio nghi xem no dat hay no re. Troi xuan ngoi an bat bun that la thu vi, cai cam giac nhu duoc thoat li ra khoi mot cai gi nang ne de huong thu lay cai trong mat, cai tinh tuy cua dat troi.
Tet, co nhieu cai de viet de noi lam, nhung cung chi de suong vay thoi. Delaware khong phai la Ha Noi, va exams se chang cancelled. Thoi thi cu tu cho phep minh roi xa khoi hien thuc may phut dong ho de duoc lay cai cam giac xuan ve nhu nam nao. Nhung cau chuc Tet ngan ngui, nhung tam thiep dien tu gui voi va, sao lam diu duoc noi long cua nguoi xa xu. Ha Noi van don Tet, vui ve va dam am, dau co hieu noi long nguoi tha huong ben nua kia qua dia cau. Nho lam, Ha Noi oi.
