Kha nang tra dua cua Iran neu bi My tan cong - Tim hieu
Tags: Vung Vinh, Vinh Persia, cuoc tan cong, nuoc dong minh, the tien hanh, Quan doi My, cua My, tra dua, kha nang, ten lua, khu vuc, co the, Iran, doi, co,
Ten lua dat doi bien cua Iran.
Iran se khong de bi danh do va hoan toan co the tien hanh cac cuoc tan cong tra dua nham vao quan doi My tai Vinh Persia cung nhu nhung nuoc dong minh cua My tai khu vuc Vung Vinh chi trong vong mot gio sau khi My phat dong cuoc tan cong vao Iran - mot quan chuc Iran cho hay.
Moi quan he giua Iran va My da khong duoc cai thien la bao sau cuoc doi thoai truc tiep lan dau tien trong vong 27 nam tro lai day. Nguoc lai, sau nhung nhan dinh cua Co quan Nang luong Nguyen tu quoc te (IAEA) cho rang, Iran dang mo rong hoat dong lam giau uranium, thi moi quan he giua hai nuoc ngay cang cang thang.
Gan day, mot quan chuc thuoc Uy ban An ninh quoc gia Iran cho biet, cac nha lanh dao cua Iran da du cam duoc nguy co ve mot cuoc tan cong quan su cua My. The nhung, Iran se khong de bi danh do va hoan toan co the tien hanh cac cuoc tan cong tra dua nham vao quan doi My tai Vinh Persia cung nhu nhung nuoc dong minh cua My tai khu vuc Vung Vinh chi trong vong mot gio sau khi My phat dong cuoc tan cong vao Iran.
Iran tung tuyen bo rang, neu My tan cong quan su vao Iran, thi Iran se mo cua tat ca cac duong tu Afghanistan toi Li-bang, tao dieu kien hoat dong cho to chuc cuc doan Islam, von da coi My va tat ca nhung quoc gia A-rap than My la “ke thu khong doi troi chung”, de cho ho tan cong tat ca cac muc tieu quan su va dan su tai cac quoc gia A-rap va Israel, tham chi la ngay tai chau Au va lanh tho nuoc My.
Hien nay, Iran dang tien hanh kiem soat nghiem ngat khu vuc bien gioi Iran va Afghanistan , nghiem cam cac phan tu vu trang vuot bien.
Chinh sach nay cua Iran buoc hoat dong cua cac to chuc Hoi giao cuc doan hoac bi bo hep trong lanh tho Afghanistan , hoac chap nhan mao hiem bi quan My bat khi tim cach tham nhap bat hop phap tu con duong khac.
Iran canh cao My rang, neu My tan cong Iran, thi chinh sach co loi cho My se bi ro bo, dieu nay cung dong nghia voi viec buc tuong bao ve cua My tu xa khong con.
Ngoai ra, neu My tan cong Iran, khong chi co cac co so trong yeu cua cac nuoc Vung Vinh lien quan toi My se bi Iran tan cong ma nhieu thanh pho lon cua ho cung se phai dung truoc nguy co bi tan cong khung bo.
Nhu vay, quoc gia dong minh quan trong nhat cua My tai khu vuc Trung Dong la Israel cung se phai hung chiu nhung cuoc tan cong khung bo chua tung co. Tat ca nhung to chuc nhu dang Alla o Li-bang, Hamas hay to chuc thanh chien Hoi giao cuc doan Islam, tham chi la nhieu to chuc vu trang bi mat khac ma den nay van chua “lo dien” se cung luc xuat hien.
Trong cuoc chien voi Hezbollah nam 2006, quan doi Israel da de lo mot diem yeu chet nguoi khi phai doi mat voi cuoc chien tranh du kich. Doi voi nguoi Israel , luu dan cam tay con nguy hiem hon ca ten lua. Ten lua phong khong co ban khong co tac dung truoc luu dan, boi luu dan cam tay khong co duong bay co dinh.
Dac diem cua cac cuoc tan cong khung bo la cac thanh vien tham gia deu rat phan tan, nen rat kho chong tra. Neu gio day Iran ra lenh cho nhung to chuc vu trang trung thanh voi ho bat dau chuan bi, thi chi can My co dong thai tan cong Iran, nhung to chuc vu trang nay se tien hanh tan cong o at vao cac muc tieu cua My va cac nuoc dong minh cua My, va cuoc tan cong khung bo dau tien se dien ra trong thoi gian chua den 1 gio.
Neu My tan cong Iran , ho se rat sung sot truoc suc manh quan su lon manh cua nuoc nay. Hau het nguoi dan Iran deu tin rang, Iran co the danh bai duoc cac cuoc tan cong cua My, su tu tin nay lai chu yeu den tu long tin doi voi kho vu khi lon manh cua Iran.
Trong nhung thang vua qua, luc luong phong khong va luc luong cach mang Hoi giao cua Iran da thay doi phuong thuc hoat dong cua minh. Song song voi viec lien tuc cho cong chung va bao chi biet ve nhung loai vu khi moi, ho con nhieu lan tien hanh dien tap bang dan that voi su tham gia cua cac trang thiet bi quan su moi nhu ten lua dat doi dat Meteor-3, ten lua chong tau ngam “Silkworm”, ngu loi cao toc va may bay trinh sat khong nguoi lai.
Dung nhu mot quan chuc cua Iran da noi: “Chung toi biet nguoi My dang o dau, lam gi, chung toi co the tan cong ho bat cu luc nao!”.
Ngoai ra, trong thoi gian gan day, Iran lai dua ra tuyen bo da co duoc loai ten lua phong khong tien tien nhat cua Nga la S-300, loai ten lua nay co kha nang truy tim va pha huy may bay cua doi phuong nho tia hong ngoai va laser.

bian cheng xue yuan —Delphi zhuan ti jiang zuo cong ben qi kai shi le ， xin ling zai ci xian tan tan zi ji de yi xie xiang fa 。 cong nian chu jie dao ze ren bian ji de yue gao zhi hou ， xin ling yi zhi zai zhuo mo ru he xie hao ben ci Delphi zhuan ti jiang zuo ， tong shi ye shen kao 、 xue xi yi qian ji wei xin ling de zhuan ti jiang zuo de feng ge 。 cong zhuan ti de xuan ze lai shuo ， xin ling zui zhong xuan ze le “ shu ju ku ” zhe ge zhuan ti ， yi shi xin ling ye yu shi jian zhu yao shi xie shu ju ku cheng xu de ， xie shu ju ku zhuan ti bi jiao shu xi ； er shi shu ju ku de ying yong shi mu qian zui guang fan de ， ju tong ji yue 60% yi shang de ying yong ruan jian dou shi yu shu ju ku you guan de 。 xin ling xi wang zhe ci Delphi shu ju ku zhuan ti jiang zuo neng qi dao pao zhuan yin yu de zuo yong ， shi de du zhe neng tong guo ben ci jiang zuo xue xi dao ru he bian zhi yi ge wan zheng de shu ju ku ying yong cheng xu ， bing zai zi ji de gong zuo 、 xue xi zhong de dao ying yong 。
xian zai you guan Delphi shu ju ku bian cheng de shu ji 、 zi liao ye hen duo ， xin ling bu xiang dong pin xi cou di chao 、 ban yi xie zi liao lai hu nong du zhe ， bu xiang an zhao ta men de ru xian jiang shu ju ku zu jian zui hou yi yi ge li zi lai jie shu deng feng ge lai xie ben ci jiang zuo ， ye bu neng mian mian ju dao di jiang jie mei ge shu ju ku zu jian de shu xing 、 fang fa he shi jian ， yin wei zhe xie zhi shi da bu fen dou shi chong fu bang zhu wen jian de nei rong ， zai zhe you xie jiang le ye mei duo da yong tu ， du zhe ke gen ju xu yao sui shi cong bang zhu wen jian zhong huo qu ， xin ling bu xiang lang fei bao gui de ban mian 。 ben ci jiang zuo jiang yi yi ge shao wei fu duo yi dian de shu ju ku ying yong cheng xu wei zhu xian ， jiang yong dao de shu ju ku zu jian ji you guan zhi shi chuan cha jiang jie ， jin liang zuo dao fu gai mian guang yi xie ， tong shi zai jiang zuo zhong jian ke neng cha ru yi xie xiao li zi huo ji qiao lai jiang jie yi xie zu jian chong yao de shu xing 、 shi jian he fang fa deng 。 suo yi ， ru guo nin xi guan le yi xie shu ji de bian xie feng ge ， ke neng hui gan dao ben ci jiang zuo zai zu zhi xing shi shang you dian luan ， dan ru guo nin neng gen zhe jiang zuo jian chi xue xi ， xiang xin nin hui you suo shou huo 。
ben ci jiang zuo ji hua she ji de zhu yao nei rong shi ： yi ben di shu ju ku wei zhu ， jie shao tong guo BDE cun qu shu ju ku ； tong guo ODBC、ADO cao zuo shu ju ku ；SQL zai shu ju ku zhong de ying yong ； shu ju ku cheng xu de an zhuang zhi zuo ； ru guo shi jian 、 ban mian yuan xu hui jie shao yi xia SQL SERVER。 zhe zhi shi yi ge ji hua ， jiang gen ju du zhe fan kui yi jian 、 bian ji yao qiu 、 shi jian huo ban mian de qing kuang jin xing shi dang tiao zheng 。 ben jiang zuo yi mu qian shi yong guang fan de Delphi 5.0 qi ye ban wei bian cheng huan jing ， sui ran Delphi6.0 yi fa xing ， xin ling de dian nao zhong ye an zhuang le ， dan ke neng mu qian yong de du zhe huan bu shi tai duo ， ru guo nin yong de shi 6.0 ban huo 4.0 ban ， ying gai dou shi ke yi de ， zhi bu guo you xie shu ju ku zu jian suo zai zu jian mian ban de wei zhi bu yi yang 。 shun bian shuo yi xia ， xie ben ci jiang zuo de xin ling zhi shi yi ge ye yu Delphi ai hao zhe ， fei zhuan zhi cheng xu yuan ， dui Delphi de xue xi bu shi mian mian mian ju dao ， dui bi jiao shu xi de nei rong ye da bu dao fei chang jing tong de shui ping ， suo yi ben jiang zuo bu shi he gao shui ping de du zhe ， shi yu chu ji he zhong ji shui ping de du zhe yue du ， zai jiang zuo zhong ke neng hui you yi xie cuo wu zhi chu ， xi wang guang da du zhe neng ji shi zhi chu ， xin ling zai de dao ti gao de tong shi ye neng shi qi ta du zhe de dao zheng que de xin xi 。
xin ling jin liang jiang yi xie guan jian zhi chu jiang jie xiang xi ， shi du zhe neng li jie he ming bai ， xi wang du zhe neng ji shi ti chu jian yi 、 yi jian ， jiang ben ci jiang zuo ban hao ， bu gu fu bian ji de xin ren he du zhe de qi wang 。 xin ling xin xiang ：xinling@sweek.com， sui shi zhun bei jie shou nin de yi jian 、 jian yi huo qi ta wen ti 。 yue du ben jiang zuo de du zhe ying yi ju bei shu ju ku de ji ben zhi shi ， ru shu ju biao 、 zi duan 、 zi duan lei xing 、 suo yin deng gai nian ， dui delphi ben shen ying gai ju bei chu ji shui ping 。

er 、 ru he xie yi ge shu ju ku cheng xu
xin ling fei ji suan ji zhuan ye ke ban chu shen ， mei xue guo ruan jian gong cheng deng zhi lei de ke cheng ， zhe li zhi neng cong jing yan lai tan tan ru he bian xie yi ge shu ju ku cheng xu 。 dang ran zhe li de you xie jing yan ye shi yong xie qi ta de cheng xu 。
di yi 、 shou xian ying zuo yi ge fang an 。 ye ke yi shuo shi yi ge ji hua 、 da gang zhi lei de dong xi ba ， zai fang an zhong shou xian yao gen ju zi ji huo ke hu de de xu yao ba zhu yao ying ju bei de gong neng xie qing chu 、 xie xiang xi ， zhe shi hen zui guan jian de ， fou ze zai she ji wan cheng hou fa xian you xie gong neng you yu shi xian mei you kao lv zhou dao zai chong xin she ji jiang hui hen ma fan de ， ke neng you xie xu zeng jia de gong neng rong yi bu chong ， er you xie ke neng you yu mei you liu xia jie kou deng deng hui zao cheng jiang yuan lai de dai ma yao zuo da liang xiu gai 。 qi ci ， lie chu xu yao de fu zhu gong neng he qi ta yi xie tong yong gong neng 。 bi ru ， dui dian nao he shu ju ku bu shu xi de ke hu yi ban bu hui ti chu shu ju ku ya suo 、 zheng li zhi lei de gong neng ， dan wo men zai cheng xu she ji zhong ying gai kao lv zhe xie gong neng ， huan you ru shu ju ku bei fen 、 hui fu gong neng deng ； tong yong de yi xie gong neng ru bang zhu wen jian 、 guan yu ben cheng xu deng deng ， zhe xie yi ban shi ren he ruan jian dou ying gai you de 。 zui hou ， jiang shu ju ku jie gou gou jian chu lai 。 gen ju xu yao wan cheng de gong neng ， xuan ze shen me yang de shu ju ku ， shu ju ku ying you ji ge shu ju biao ， mei ge shu ju biao ying gai ju bei duo shao zi duan ， zi duan de lei xing 、 chang du 、 shi fou yuan xu kong zhi ， shi fou jian li suo yin deng dou yao xie qing chu 。
di er 、 she ji chu bu cheng xu liu cheng 。 gen ju yao wan cheng de gong neng ， jiang da zhi de cheng xu liu cheng xie chu lai ， mei ge gong neng dou yao xie chu ji ben liu cheng ， zhu yao shi wei yi hou de cheng xu bian xie qi dao yi ge zhi dao zuo yong ， dang ran ， zai shi ji xie cheng xu de guo cheng zhong ke neng hui you hen duo gai dong ， dan yi ge ji ben de liu cheng hui zhi dao ni zai xie cheng xu shi bu hui chu xian da de pian cha 。

san 、Delphi shi ru he cao zuo shu ju ku de ？
wo men xian lai jian dan le jie yi xia Delphi shi ru he cun qu shu ju ku de 。Delphi cao zuo shu ju ku zhu yao shi li yong BDE（ shu ju ku yin qing ） lai jin xing ， dang ran tong guo qi ta fang shi rao guo BDE zhi jie fang wen shu ju ku zai Delphi zhong ye dou ke yi shi xian ， bu guo ， dui yu ben di shu ju ku lai shuo ， tong guo BDE cun qu shu ju xiao lv huan shi hen gao de 。 ben di shu ju ku ru guo neng shu lian cao zuo de hua ， bian xie wang luo shu ju ku ye hen rong yi shang shou le ， dui pu tong du zhe lai shuo ， xie wang luo shu ju ku de ji hui huan shi bu ru dan ji ben di shu ju ku duo ， suo yi ， ben ci jiang zuo de chong dian huan shi yi ben di shu ju ku wei zhu 。
BDE shi Borland Database Engine de suo xie ， ta shi fu ze yong hu he shu ju ku da jiao dao de zhong jian mei jie 。 shi shi shang ， ying yong cheng xu shi tong guo shu ju fang wen zu jian he BDE lian jie ， zai you BDE qu fang wen shu ju ku lai wan cheng dui shu ju ku de cao zuo de ， bing fei zhi jie cao zuo BDE。 zhe yang yong hu zhi xu guan xin shu ju zu jian ji ke ， bu yong qu zhi jie he BDE da jiao dao 。 shu ju ku zu jian zhu yao you shu ju fang wen zu jian he shu ju kong zhi zu jian ， ta men he shu ju ku de guan xi ke yong xia mian de shi yi tu lai biao shi ：
yong hu ←→ shu ju kong zhi zu jian ←→ shu ju fang wen zu jian ←→BDE←→ shu ju ku
tong guo BDE ji hu ke yi cao zuo mu qian suo you lei xing de shu ju ku 。 wo men lai jian dan le jie yi xia chang yong de shu ju ku zu jian 。
（ yi ） shu ju fang wen zu jian （Data Access Component）
shu ju fang wen zu jian zai zu jian mian ban de Data Access zu jian ye shang ， zai zhe li wo men jian dan jie shao yi xia ，Table、Query he Storedproc san ge zu jian ye cheng wei shu ju ji zu jian ， yong yu he shu ju ku lian jie ， du zhe ke jiang zhe xie zu jian shi wei shu ju ku ， dui ta men de cao zuo jiu ke ren wei shi dui shu ju ku de cao zuo 。
DataSource zu jian shi shu ju ji zu jian he shu ju kong zhi zu jian de lian jie mei jie 。 shu ju kong zhi zu jian shi yong hu cao zuo shu ju ku zhong shu ju de jie mian ， zhi you tong guo DataSource cai neng he shu ju ji zu jian lian jie ， cong er huo de shu ju yong lai jin xing xian shi 、 xiu gai deng cao zuo 。
Table zu jian shi tong guo shu ju ku yin qing BDE lai cun qu shu ju ku zhong de shu ju de ， bing tong guo BDE jiang yong hu dui shu ju ku de cao zuo ru tian jia 、 shan chu 、 xiu gai deng chuan di hui shu ju ku ， zhe shi fei chang chong yao de yi ge zu jian 。
Query zu jian shi li yong jie gou hua cha xun yu yan （Structured Query Language） tong guo BDE lai cao zuo shu ju ku de ， he Table zu jian wan cheng de gong neng ji ben yi yang ， zhi shi cai yong le SQL lai shi xian ， shi chong yao de zu jian zhi yi 。
Storedproc zu jian shi tong guo BDE dui fu wu qi shu ju ku jin xing cao zuo de ， chang yong yu ke hu / fu wu qi jie gou de shu ju ku ying yong cheng xu 。
DataBase zu jian yi ban yong yu jian li yuan cheng de shu ju ku fu wu qi -- ke hu / fu wu qi jie gou de shu ju ku ying yong cheng xu he shu ju ku zhi jian de lian jie 。
Session zu jian shi yong yu kong zhi shu ju ku ying yong cheng xu he shu ju ku lian jie de ， zhu yao yong yu fu duo de gong neng ， bi ru duo xian cheng shu ju ku cheng xu bian cheng 。
BatchMove zu jian yong yu da pi shu ju de zhuan yi 、 fu zhi deng 。
UpdateSQL zu jian zhuan yong yu zhi du shu ju ku ， yong yu huan cun shu ju ku de geng xin 。
NestedTable zu jian tong guo BDE cao zuo qian tao shu ju ku （ yi ge shu ju ku zuo wei yi ge zi duan bao cun zai ling yi ge shu ju ku zhong ）， he Table zu jian lei si ， xin ling mei yong guo qian tao shu ju ku ， suo yi dui ci zu jian mei you ren he shi yong jing yan 。
（ er ） shu ju kong zhi zu jian （Data Control Component）
shu ju kong zhi zu jian ye ke cheng wei shu ju xian shi zu jian huo shu ju liu lan zu jian 。 ta men de zhu yao gong neng shi he shu ju fang wen zu jian pei he gong yong hu dui shu ju jin xing liu lan 、 bian ji deng cao zuo 。 shu ju kong zhi zu jian zai zu jian ban shang de DataControl ye shang ， gong you 15 ge zu jian 。 ta men fen bie shi : DBGrid zu jian 、DBNavigator zu jian 、DBText zu jian 、DBEdit zu jian 、DBMemo zu jian 、DBImage zu jian 、DBListbox zu jian 、DBComboBox zu jian 、DBCheckBox zu jian 、DBRadioGroup zu jian 、DBLookupListBox zu jian 、DBLookupComboBox zu jian 、DBRichEdit zu jian 、DBCtrlGrid zu jian 、DBChart zu jian 。 zhe xie zu jian shi yong qi lai dou bu fu duo ， you ji ge shao fu duo yi dian de yi hou jiang hui jiang jie 。 zhe li jiu bu zai zhu ge jie shi le 。
ling wai huan you yi xie zu jian yu shu ju ku you guan 。Decision Cube shi yi zu zhu yao yong yu tong ji de zu jian ， ke yi biao ge huo tu xing deng zhi guan de fang shi biao da tong ji jie guo ， bu guo ， si hu ying yong de bu shi hen guang fan 。QReport zu jian shi yong lai zui hou shu chu bao biao de zu jian ， cong hen duo yong hu de fan ying qing kuang lai kan ， ci zu jian bu tai shi he zhong guo ren bao biao de xi guan ， ci zu jian shi Borland cong bie de gong si gou mai de ， xing neng shang bu shi tai hao ， suo yi xian zai yong de bu shi tai duo ， ling you yi xie di san ti gong de bao biao zu jian hen hao yong ， ye you yi xie guo ren zuo de bao biao zu jian ， hen shi he zhong guo ren de xi guan ， suo yi ru guo zui hou ban mian yuan xu de hua ， jiang jian dan jie shao yi xia zhe xie zu jian de shi yong 。

Chang ghen nhu the nao Tags: nhu the nao, nguoi dan ong, ngoai tinh, nguoi vo, co nguoi, co the, tham chi, tha thu, lam, minh, biet, anh
Khong ai choi cai rang phai nam ngoai tinh nhieu hon phai nu. Tuy nhien, trong khi khong it nguoi vo tha thu cho nguoi chong "lam duong lac loi", thi van cuc hiem dan ong "moc sung" bo qua loi lam cua nguoi vo. Tai sao co hien tuong do?
Truoc het, can phai thay rang qua trinh "an vung" cua dan ong dien ra chop nhoang hon phu nu. Ngay ca khi dong long "thuong" nguoi, ho co "cho" ai mot dua con co khi chi can 5 phut dong ho. Dan ong ngau hung rat nhanh va neu co co hoi, lai duoc ben kia bat den xanh, ho thuong san sang "trao than" chang may dan do. Dan ong co the nhanh chong leo toi tot cung duc vong ca voi nguoi dan ba ho khong he yeu, tham chi thua kem vo ve nhieu phuong dien, mien la cua la. Trong khi do, phan lon phu nu khong lam nhu vay. Ho chi dat khoai cam voi nguoi ma ho yeu. Cho nen qua trinh ngoai tinh cua dan ba thuong nhieu khe va lam cong phu hon, do do co nhieu dau hieu de bi phat hien hon.
Mat khac, trong khi da so dan ong ngoai tinh vi ly do tinh duc, ngay ca khi ho dang song hanh phuc trong hon nhan, thi hau het dan ba chi ngoai tinh khi khong co tinh yeu trong hon nhan. Vi the, mot khi phu nu da phan boi la ho bi cuon hut ca ve tinh than lan the xac. Khi da yeu nguoi dan ong khac, ho tim co xa lanh chong hoac thoai thac quan he chan goi voi chong. Co khi vi so bi nghi ngo ma ho danh guong gao dap ung qua loa cho xong chuyen, khien dan ong co the nhan thay thai do do ngay tren giuong. Trong khi do, dan ong "an vung" de chui mep hon. Co nguoi di ngoai tinh ve con cu xu voi vo con tu te hon, au yem co ve nong nan hon. Tham chi co ong chong cap bo suot may nam, da co con voi bo ma vo khong he hay biet. Boi vi muoi toi ong ta ngoi nha xem tivi ca muoi, hai ngay nghi cuoi tuan con xung phong vao bep lam noi tro. Hoa ra ong ta hoan toan hoat dong bi mat vao buoi trua.
Doi khi dan ong biet vo "di ngang ve tat", nhung neu chua len giuong voi ke kia, ho co the tha thu duoc, vi chua den muc chang con gi de mat. Dieu dau don voi dan ong co vo ngoai tinh la ho hay tuong tuong ra nhieu cai, nhat la hinh anh vo minh dang nong nan voi ke kia. Cach day may nam, trong mot canh rung ben bai bien Trouville, nuoc Phap xay ra mot vu an mang khung khiep. Nguoi vo ngoai tinh bi chong mai phuc bat qua tang khi dang an ai voi tinh nhan trong bui cay. Ke tinh dich kip tau thoat, chi con nguoi vo hung chiu 26 nhat dam cua nguoi chong. Khi quan toa hoi: "Ket qua kham nghiem tu thi cho thay vo anh da chet ngay sau 3 nhat dam dau tien. Tai sao anh con da man dam them 23 nhat nua?". Me chong toi Tags: gia dinh hanh phuc, nguoi phu nu, su phan biet, nguoi hay noi, mot gia dinh, me chong, sao cho, moi nguoi, khong co, co cong, sinh ra, ba, con, hoc, bao
Thong thuong moi nguoi hay noi den me chong - me de voi su phan biet kha ro rang. Nhung voi toi, ranh gioi giua hai khai niem do gan nhu khong co, boi me chong, du khong co cong sinh thanh, nuoi duong toi tu tam be nhung ba la nguoi co cong sinh ra va nuoi day chong toi, la nguoi tao dung va mang lai cho toi mot gia dinh hanh phuc nhu hom nay.
Bay nam truoc, me chong toi da di xa nhung toi luon nho ve ba va mong muon nhung dong cam nghi toi viet ra day nhu mot nen huong thom danh cho me - nguoi ma toi muon goi bang hai tieng: "me toi"!
Me toi la mot nguoi phu nu sinh ra va lon len giua long Ha Noi, trong khu pho co voi 36 pho phuong doc ngang. Ba tung la nu sinh Dong Khanh - Trung Vuong va sau nay la hoa khoi cua khoa Sinh, Dai hoc Tong hop. Ba la hinh mau cua nguoi phu nu dat Ha thanh: co hoc thuc, thanh tao, tinh te, trong le nghia, tinh thong nu cong gia chanh.
Toi nho khi ve lam con dau ba, toi vo cung long ngong, vung ve. Ba da tan tinh chi bao cho toi tu cach rua rau sao cho sach ma khong bi nat, cach mo con ga sao cho kheo, danh tiet canh vit sao cho dong, tia hoa qua sao cho dep, goi banh chung sao cho vuong van ma khong can khuon, van van va van van. Ba con chi bao cho toi cach an mac, di dung khi ra duong sao cho trang nha, cach noi nang, cu xu voi moi nguoi o cac cung bac khac nhau sao cho lich thiep...
Toi nho me toi vi nho ba ma toi co duoc gia dinh yen am nhu hien nay. Ba da chi bao cho mot dua con dau ngu ngo la toi tu loi an, tieng noi den cach ung xu voi ho hang noi ngoai nha chong, cach thu ven cuoc song gia dinh sao cho khoa hoc va tao cam giac dam am. Ba van day toi “Hoi am gia dinh tuy thuoc vao nguoi phu nu”. Toi khong sao quen duoc nhung toi ba go cua phong de mang cho vo chong toi bat che do chinh tay ba nau, nhung lan thay toi giat quan ao cho chong la ba lai bao “De me bao chong con giat cho chu quan ao no day, suc con yeu lam sao giat duoc”... Roi khi chung toi co con dau long, ba la nguoi thuc bao dem trong chau “de me no tranh thu ngu mot luc cho lai suc con co sua cho con...”. Khi toi phan van giua viec di hoc va thu xep nuoi con nho, chinh ba da dong vien toi “con cu di hoc, con tre la phai hoc, de chau me trong cho”... Nhung loi noi va su quan tam cua ba khien toi nghen ngao, cho den tan bay gio, boi toi hieu ba thuc su yeu thuong toi nhu con gai. Toi luon nho lai

Nhung bi an hinh xam cua nguoi Nhat Ban	Chủ nhật, 30 Tháng một 2011, 09:40 GMT+7	Nhung bieu tuong vo si dao va su phan khang trong long dan. Nghe thuat xam minh horimono cua Nhat ban co be day lich su rat lau doi. Moi hinh xam truyen thong deu mang mot y nghia rieng, gan lien voi van hoa, lich su va doi song cua nguoi dan dat nuoc mat troi moc.
Nghien cuu ve nghe thuat xam minh, khi giai nghia thuat ngu co nguon goc xuat phat tu Polynesia nay (tu tattoo la tu muon cua tu tatau trong tieng Polynesia), mot so nha nghien cuu di theo moi lien he giua ngu nguyen cua no voi cac tu “ta” – nghia la buc tranh va “atu” – nghia la linh hon. Con mot so khac lai di theo moi lien he voi ten cua vi than Tiki, la vi than trong truyen thuyet, nguoi da day cho nguoi dan Polynesia cach trang diem co the ho.
The nhung, lich su cua tattoo lai khong phai bat dau tren nhung hon dao cua Thai Binh Duong. Cac nha khao co da tim thay nhung pho tuong nho thoi ky do da moi tai Hungary co nien dai 5 nghin nam truoc cong nguyen. Tren nguc va phan mong cua nhung khoi hinh nguoi co dai nay co cac trang tri hoa van.
Du cho rang khu vuc chau A Thai Binh Duong khong phai la noi khoi nguon cua nghe thuat xam, nhung day chinh la noi ma loai hinh nghe thuat nay dat duoc su phat trien dinh cao. Va minh chung khong the tranh cai do chinh la nghe thuat xam cua Nhat Ban. Tu the ky thu VI, nhung ke pham toi o dat nuoc mat troi moc bi danh dau bang thich chu hoac hinh anh. Cong viec nay trong tieng Nhat goi la “nesaku”. Tren co the nhung ke vi pham phap luat thoi do, nguoi ta tham chi co the doc duoc toan bo tieu su pham toi cua anh ta. Cung voi thoi gian, cong viec xam minh cua Nhat Ban da phat trien va dan tro thanh mot mon nghe thuat dich thuc – horimono phat trien ruc ro vao nua sau cua the ky XVIII.
Sau day la nhung ly giai can ke ve nhung hinh xam cua dat nuoc Nhat Ban:
1. Jurōjin - (Tho Lao Nhan) vi than thong thai va truong tho. Cay truong thieng cua ngai cuon tron o phia tren dau, tuong truyen trong do chua dung bi mat ve muon loai, cung voi nhung bi quyet truong sinh bat tu. Trong cac hinh xam, Jurōjin duoc the hien bang hinh anh mot cu gia thong thai doi chiec mu hien triet.
2. Hotei – (Bo Dai, hien than cua phat Di Lac) vi than day long tu bi mang lai hanh phuc. Ong co chiec bung lon map tron tuong trung cho tam long rong luong bao dung.
3. Khuon mat - bieu tuong cho tieng noi cua chinh quyen Samurai, la hinh anh cua nguoi dan thanh thi dung manh va du ton.
4. Chim hac – mot bieu tuong khac cua su truong tho, nguoi ban dong hanh thuy chung cua Jurōjin. Mot so noi tin rang nhung nguoi giac ngo dao ly se duoc chim hac dua len thien dinh, tro thanh bat tu.
Su phat trien rong rai cua hiromono co duoc khong chi boi ve dep tham my ma con nho vao anh huong cua cac nhan to xa hoi. Nam 1603, Tokugawa Ieyasu sau khi gay suc ep buoc hoang de Nhat Ban phong cho minh tuoc hieu Shōgun (“Tuong quan”), da gianh lay chinh quyen. Va nhu vay, mot trieu dai thong tri moi duoc thanh lap, thu do cua Nhat Ban duoc dat tai thanh pho Edo (Giang Ho) – danh dau su bat dau thoi ky Edo.
Trong thoi gian Tokugawa Ieyasu tri vi, nhung tranh chap giua cac phe phai da no ra, va duoc ghi dau bang khong it xuong mau cua nguoi Nhat. Tuy nhien, chinh quyen cuoi cung da gianh duoc muc dich cua minh – thanh lap mot dat nuoc Nhat Ban thong nhat. Tren tu tuong cua vi tuong quan day nhiet huyet, mang mong muon thiet lap ky cuong quan su cho khap moi noi, bo luat cua Samurai (Bo luat Vo si dao) da duoc thanh lap.
Bo luat nay dua tren nen tang tu tuong triet hoc cua dao Khong ve “chinh nhan quan tu”, nguoi tuan theo cac chuan muc dao duc va danh tron cuoc doi phuc vu cho quan vuong. Tuy nhien, ve sau nay, tuong quan Tokugawa Ieyasu khong bat buoc gioi quan su phai song theo cac quy tac cua dao Khong, va tuong tu ca voi tang lop dan chung.

Ve mien gai xinh thanh nan nhan cua tuc cuop vo
Tags: nu sinh nghi hoc, tuc cuop vo, mien gai xinh, nan nhan tuc cuop vo, hu tuc cuop vo,
Nhung nu sinh dang tuoi an hoc bong dung nghi hoc vi bi “cuop” ve lam vo roi hau het deu cam chiu, pho mac cho so phan day dua. Co nhung em gai dang di tren duong bong dung bi “cuop” mac du la het, van xin nhung nguoi con trai khong chiu buong tha… Mot ngay dau Xuan Dinh Dau, chung toi lac ve mien que “nong” voi hu tuc nay sau vu “cuop vo” gay xon xao du luan tai dia ban xa Chau Loc, huyen Quy Hop (Nghe An) vao ngay 2/2 vua qua.
Co gai bi bat ep tren duong ngay 2/2. Anh cat tu clip.
Chuyen sau vu "cuop vo" bat thanh
Tu nga ba xa Chau Loc noi xay ra vu "cuop vo", chung toi phai di xe om hon 20km nua moi vao den ban Quen thuoc xa Lien Hop de den nha Truong Van Bien (25 tuoi)- chu muu vu cuop vo neu tren.
Chung toi tim gap truong ban Luong Van Binh. Nhap ngum nuoc che xanh chat xit, truong ban Luong Van Binh ke ve vu viec khien ban lang cua ong noi nhu con tren ca nuoc: “Bien nhat qua nen khong dam to tinh voi Hien (co gai bi cuop) mac du ca hai da co tinh y voi nhau tu truoc. Vi khong dam to tinh nen ngay 2/2, khi biet Hien dang dung ben duong don xe vao Nam lam an thi Bien moi cuong cuong nho 3 nguoi ban trai den ngan va khuyen Hien quay tro ve de Bien noi chuyen. Nhung 3 nguoi ban nay tuc toc, hung ho ep Hien len xe may de cho ve giua thanh hien bach nhat khien moi nguoi dan chung kien deu hoang so. Hon nua Hien cung khong biet 3 nguoi nay la ai nen cu nghi minh bi “cuop” ve lam vo nguoi khac nen la het va chong cu quyet liet”.
Theo ong Binh, cuoc song bay gio khac xua roi, va cang khac xua chuyen hon nhan gia dinh cho nen can bai bo hu tuc ma nhieu nguoi goi la “cuop vo”. Truoc day, co nhung truong hop bat vo ve thi dem moi hoi vo ten gi, bao nhieu tuoi. Truong ban Luong Van Binh cho rang, neu cac co quan co trach nhiem khong co bien phap ngan ngua va xa hoi khong len tieng phan doi thi chuyen “cuop vo” cua nguoi Thai, nguoi Mong se lan truyen nhu mot hu tuc nguy hai.
Ba Vi Thi Lan (me Bien) ke ve su viec bat vo vua xay ra. Anh: V.Dong.
Khi chung toi tim den nha thi Bien di vang, chi co ba Vi Thi Lan (me Bien) dang ngoi tro chuyen voi nhung nguoi dan trong ban ve su viec dang am ao khap noi nay. Ba Lan bien bach: “Hai dua no yeu nhau roi day. Luc truoc cai Hien co qua nha toi an com, don dep va da cung Bien di choi trong ban. Gia dinh toi cung da qua gia dinh nha cai Hien noi chuyen, hai ben da thong nhat cho cac chau di lai voi nhau”.
Trao doi voi PV, ong Lo Thanh Dong, Chu tich UBND xa Lien Hop cho hay: "Vu “bat vo” vua xay ra, hien Cong an huyen Quy Hop da co ket luan. Con huong xu ly the nao cho thau tinh dat ly chung toi van phai cho. Tren dia ban van co "cuop vo" nhung tren co so hai ben da ngam co tinh y voi nhau. Tuc cua dong bao Thai o day la vay. Chung toi van thuong xuyen cu Bi thu Doan xa va can bo tu phap xa den tan xom, ban pho bien kien thuc phap luat hon nhan gia dinh, binh dang gioi cung nhu khuyen khich nhung doi nam nu yeu nhau nen cong khai cho gia dinh, ban be va nguoi trong ban, trong xa biet. Neu gia dinh khong dong y thi bao len chinh quyen dia phuong de co huong giai quyet. Neu khong, de xay chuyen ma nguoi ta cho la “cuop vo” thi gay du luan khong tot trong xa hoi”.
Nu sinh trung hoc cung bi “cuop” ve lam vo
Thay Nguyen Minh Dat - Hieu truong THPT Quy Hop 3 xot xa ke ve nhung truong hop cac em hoc sinh bi bat trom ve lam vo. Anh: V.Dong.
Cau chuyen “cuop vo” duong nhu chua dung lai o truong hop noi tren. Thay Nguyen Minh Dat, Hieu truong Truong THPT Quy Hop 3 da tung cuu thanh cong mot nu hoc sinh cua truong bi “cuop” ve lam vo. Hien thay Dat dang lam bao cao gui cac cap ban nganh ve nhieu truong hop la nu hoc sinh cua truong nghi hoc vi nghi… bi cuop ve lam vo.
Vu cuu em hoc sinh bi bat truoc cong truong da xay ra cach day 10 nam nhung thay Dat van nho nhu in. Thay ke: “Hoi do toi dang la Bi thu doan truong. Dem 8/1/2007, toi dang nghi trong phong thi bong mot ban hoc sinh chay vao bao voi toi voi ve mat hoang loan: “Ban Lo Thi Thuy, hoc sinh 11C bi 6 thanh nien di tren 3 xe may vay roi cuop ngay truoc day nha tro canh cong truong. Top thanh nien da cho ban Thuy di ve huong xa Chau Hong”. Nghe vay, toi nhay day lay xe may duoi theo”.
Hom do, mot minh thay Dat vong veo tren duong rung duoi theo nhom cuop hoc sinh cua minh. Khi den ban Nhang, xa Chau Cuong (Quy Hop) thay em Thuy dang la het, thay Dat lieu phong xe len roi ep vao xe dang cho Thuy. “Luc do vua mung lai vua so, toi lien cam lay tay em Thuy giu lai nhung dam thanh nien ben kia cung hung hang gianh giat lai. Bi qua toi het to len thi vua luc cac thay trong truong cung duoi kip toi. Luc nay nhom nguoi kia danh bo Thuy lai va vu xe may di. Toi chi kip giu lai mot thanh nien” - thay Dat nho lai.
Sau do moi biet, chu muu vu bat vo nay la Sam Van Duc. Duc tung thu nhan “do uong ruou say, hung len thi di bat gai dep ve lam vo”. Ngay do, gia dinh em Thuy da phat Duc. Ngoai ra, UBND xa Chau Hong cung phat Duc 300 ngan dong. Nhung thanh nien dong pham con lai moi nguoi bi phat 200 ngan dong.
Nhac ve hu tuc “cuop vo” nay, thay Dat dua cho chung toi xem danh sach nhung hoc sinh cua truong bi “cuop” ve lam vo khi chua du tuoi ket hon theo luat dinh. Tram ngam nhin vao ban danh sach, thay Dat xot xa: “Nam hoc 2015 - 2016 co cac em Luong Thi Ly, Ha Thi Nam nghi bi “cuop” ve lam vo. Cac em deu moi 16 tuoi, dang hoc lop 10C4. Tiep do la hai em Lo Thi Vui lop 11A4, Sam Thi Tuoi, hoc sinh lop 12C4. Nam 2016- 2017 vua qua co them ba em nua cung bi trai ban rinh cuop. Theo tim hieu cua toi thi hau het cac em nay deu bi “cuop” khi hai ben co tinh cam. Nhung tuoi cac em con nho ma da lam vo, lam me voi bao nhieu lo toan la chuyen khong the chap nhan duoc. Qua nguy hai den tuong lai, tuoi tre va cuoc song ve sau cho cac em”.
Theo thay Dat, khi bi bat ve nha trai va lam thu tuc cung bai roi thi cac em gai coi nhu da co mot doi chong nen thuong co tam ly cam chiu, buong xuoi. Vi khong muon co them truong hop hoc sinh nu dang tuoi an hoc bi cuop ve lam vo, thay Dat va ban giam hieu nha truong da to chuc tuyen truyen, pho bien luat hon nhan va gia dinh, binh dang gioi… thong qua gio chao co va cac hoat dong ngoai gio. Ngoai ra, nha truong thanh lap CLB ban gai tuyen truyen, Hop thu giup ban va phan cong cac em hoc sinh cam chot nha tro…de ngan chan hu tuc khong dang co nay.
“Hien tai, nha truong da co bao cao gui len cac cap ban nganh ve truong hop cac em hoc sinh cua truong bi bat ve lam vo. Ngoai ra, chung toi cung se nho den phap luat de xu ly nhung truong hop “cuop vo” khi nu hoc sinh chua den tuoi ket hon”, thay Dat cho biet.
Tu my tuc den hu tuc
Theo van hoa nguoi Thai o mien Tay Nghe An thi khoi thuy cua viec “trom vo” la mot my tuc ve hon nhan. Do la khi nguoi con trai, con gai yeu thuong nhau, mong muon ket duyen vo chong. Tu do, nguoi con gai di theo nguoi con trai ve nha roi chiu mot so tuc le thong thuong de thanh “dau nha nguoi” ma bo qua cac buoc tinh tu chung cua cong dong. Kieu hon nhan “di tat” nhu the lau dan duoc nguoi Thai goi la tuc “trom vo”.
So di tuc “trom vo” ngay xua duoc xem la mot my tuc la boi duoi thoi phong kien, trong xa hoi nguoi Thai van con nang ne chuyen “phep me, quyen cha” vo cung chat chat che, quyen uy. Vi the tuc “trom vo” duoc xem nhu mot cach “vuot rao”, su phan khang truoc nhung ha khac phong kien de co duoc hanh phuc lua doi.

Ban co that su bi benh khong Tags: co the la, nguoi mac benh, benh nguy hiem, ben canh do, trieu chung, dieu tri, bi benh, xac dinh, that su, nhung nguoi, viem, lo, viec, ung, ban
Tu nhung dieu doc duoc, xem duoc, khong it nguoi luon bi am anh, thay minh co nhung trieu chung giong nguoi mac benh roi lo au, chan nan... Ben canh do lai co nhung nguoi luon coi thuong nhung trieu chung tiem an can benh nguy hiem. Ca 2 thai do nay deu co nhung bat cap doi voi viec tu cham soc suc khoe cua moi nguoi.
Benh tuong nhieu nhat cua chi em la cu thay dau ngua duong sinh duc la nghi ngay den... ung thu co tu cung. De giai toa noi lo nay, tot nhat van la di kham phu khoa de duoc lam mot xet nghiem. Viec phat hien som nhung thay doi o co tu cung truoc khi benh ung thu phat trien se giup cho viec dieu tri chan dung su tien trien cua khoi ung thu.
Tuy nhien ngua duong sinh duc, hay ra huyet trang thi rat thuong gap o phu nu, do nhieu nguyen nhan gay ra: nam, ky sinh trung, vi khuan... Do do co di kham phu khoa, lam cac xet nghiem chan doan thi moi chon dung thuoc dieu tri...
Voi nhung nguoi co the trang gay om, hay hung hang ho thi chac mam hay la minh bi ho lao. Va benh “lo”, benh “tuong” nhu vay, cang lam cho ho om yeu, sau nao. Trong truong hop nay, tuy theo tinh trang tham kham lam sang, bac si se cho chup phim va thu dam hoac cac xet nghiem bo sung khac de xac dinh nguyen nhan gay ra ho.
Neu chan doan xac dinh la benh lao thi can phai tuan thu phac do dieu tri, khong bo nua chung de vi trung lao khoi khang thuoc. Con co the gay om co the do tang nguoi, do an uong khong du chat dinh duong hoac do mac mot benh tiem an chua phat hien. Co nhieu chung ho do nhieu nguyen nhan gay ra, vi the khong co nghia cu ho dai dang, nguoi gay om la ho lao.
Bat cu benh gi gay kich ung duong ho hap cung deu co the gay ra ho nhu viem hong, viem phe quan, viem phoi, viem mang phoi... Nguoc lai co nhung nguoi to lon, map map khi kham suc khoe dinh ky chup hinh phoi, moi phat hien nam phoi hoac bi benh lao.
Loi khuyen cua bac si: De giai toa nhung au lo khong dang co hoac de phat hien som benh nang, viec den cac co so dieu tri dung chuyen khoa de kham xac dinh benh rat can thiet. Khong nen vi qua au lo voi benh tuong roi vo benh vao nguoi khien an khong ngon, ngu khong yen, kho tho, tim dap nhanh, hoi hop, roi loan tieu hoa dan den cac trieu chung thuc the cua benh lo au.
Benh... tho o
Nguoc lai voi “benh tuong” lai la benh... tho o voi nhung dau hieu tuong nhe nhung that ra co the la trieu chung benh tram trong.
- Moi va phia trong mi mat nhot nhat: co the la dau hieu cua benh thieu mau.
- Da tim tai, dac biet moi va mong tay tim hoac sam lai: co the co van de ve ho hap (do tho khong du nen mong tay va moi tim lai, tinh mach co noi len) hoac tim, nhat la voi nguoi cao tuoi.
- Da, mat va mat co mau vang co the la hau qua cua benh gan (viem gan, xo gan, ap xe do amib) hoac tui mat…
- Tieu kho: co the la viem tuyen tien liet hoac benh duong sinh duc, viem duong tiet nieu.
- Dau bung du doi: co the la dau bung cap do tac ruot hoac viem ruot thua, viem mang bung. Tuy theo cac trieu chung di kem hoac cac xet nghiem bo sung ma nguyen nhan benh duoc xac dinh va co huong dieu tri thich hop tai cac co so y te.
Loi khuyen cua bac si: Con rat nhieu trieu chung tuong la binh thuong nhung lai bao hieu mot benh nang, khong the neu ra het vi co nhieu trieu chung giong nhau cua nhieu benh khac nhau, do do can phai co chan doaßn xac dinh hoac hoi chan de dinh benh.
Theo BS Pho Duc Man, chuyen khoa 2 Ung buou hoc, Pho giam doc BV Ung buou TP.HCM qua kinh nghiem dieu tri nhieu nam thi ho va dau nguc la 2 trieu chung thuong gap cua ung thu phoi cung cac trieu chung khac la hoi tho ngan, kho tho, sut can khong ro nguyen nhan, met moi bat thuong, khac dam nhieu co lan mau... nhung nhieu nguoi khong de y vi nghi rang benh do thay doi thoi tiet.

Cac trung tam dao tao ca si: Van la an soi o thi
Xem bản tiếng việt đầy đủ tại đây : http://60s.com.vn/index/2318476/08092009.aspxCac trung tam dao tao ca si: Van la an soi o thi	Ca si Dan Truong va ong bau Hoang Tuan.
De noi tieng va nhanh kiem tien, nhieu ban tre om mong tro thanh ca si. Khong can phai co giong ca noi bat hay mat nhieu thoi gian cho viec hoc tap tai cac truong chuyen nghiep, cac lo dao tao ca si cua cac ca si, nhac si hay ong bau dang duoc coi nhu mot huong di hieu qua de cho nhung nguoi do tien mong mot buoc thanh "sao". Am nhac Viet <?xml:namespace prefix = st1 />Nam se di toi dau khi ngay cang co nhieu nguoi thay vi cham chi luyen tap da chon cong nghe lang xe ay? Tai nang dau chua thay nhung su lon xon thi da nhin thay ro.
Khi nghe ca si dang duoc gioi tre coi la nghe hot nhat hien nay thi cung dong nghia voi viec cac truong chuyen nghiep se khong du suc de dap ung nhu cau hoc hat cua dong dao ban tre. Theo do, cac trung tam dao tao ca si cua nhung ca si, nhac si (hay ong bau) moc len nhu nam sau mua. Soi dong nhat cho trao luu nay phai ke toi TP HCM khi co toi vai chuc don vi hoat dong trong linh vuc nay, tieu bieu nhu: HT Production, The gioi giai tri, Music Box, The gioi am nhac, Music Faces, Thien Thi, Tai nang moi, Kim Loi, Nhac xanh, Ba con meo, Khong gian xanh, Minh Nhien… ay la chua tinh toi mot so ca nhan nhac si, nghe si lam an nho le theo kieu khong chinh thuc mo cong ty hay trung tam dao tao nhung cung thuong xuyen nhan va lang xe cho "ga" cua minh. Ca si Thanh Thao cung hoc tro Tu Minh Hy (thu 2 tu trai sang) thuo con hop tac.
Muc dich ban dau cua cac cong ty hay trung tam nay chi la giup do nhung giong hat hay, nhung ca si (tuc la nhung nguoi da co kien thuc va duoc dao tao day du ve thanh nhac) co them co hoi tiep xuc khan gia cung nhu chuyen nghiep hon trong nghe nghiep tu giong hat den hinh thuc. Cong ty se dung ra dau tu ve tai chinh va duong huong phat trien cho ca si ay. Tuy nhien, mot hien tuong kha pho bien hien nay o cac trung tam dao tao ca si cua Viet Nam la ho san sang lang xe cho nhung hoc vien moi toanh, tu khi chua biet mot not nhac den khi tro thanh ca si chi trong vong... vai thang. Phep mau nhiem duoc quang cao tu cac trung tam dao tao ca si da khien cho giao trinh dao tao am nhac tai cac truong chuyen nghiep tro nen... lac hau cung nhu thoi gian 3- 4 nam hoc thanh nhac voi cac ban tre la dieu khong chap nhan duoc. Va do cung la ly do khien khong it cac bac phu huynh giau co, nhung ban tre ham noi tieng do tien vao cac trung tam dao tao, lang xe do cac bau so mo. Ho duoc hoc thanh nhac cap toc theo kieu ghi am bai nao hoc bai do, vu dao cung theo tung bai. Ngay sau do, ho se xuat hien lien tuc tren cac bao, tap chi nhu mot ngoi sao moi noi. Khi ho duoc tham du vao mot chuong trinh ca nhac hoanh trang nao do, co the do chinh cong ty to chuc hay cua don vi khac nhung co moi quan he tot voi ong bau coi nhu la da thanh cong buoc dau. The nen co chuyen chung ta thuong xuyen bat gap nhieu nguoi dep chan dai, hom nay con tung tang dong phim hay la luot tren san catwalk thi mot ngay dep troi, noi hung muon lam ca si, nang se ket hop voi mot trung tam am nhac nao do, hat 1 - 2 lan tren san khau ca nhac, bo tien ra lam album, the la ngay sau do, moi khi nang xuat hien se kem them danh xung "ca si" ma khong phai vat va gi. Tinh trang ay khien nhieu nguoi than rang, chua bao gio tro thanh ca si lai de nhu hien nay.
Muon van he luy
Dua nhau lam ca si nhung phai nhin nhan mot cach khach quan rang, truong hop thanh cong dung nghia tu cach lang xe ay chi dem tren dau ngon tay, nhu truong hop ca si Dan Truong khi ket hop voi ong bau Hoang Tuan, Cam Ly va Kim Loi, gan day nhat la truong hop cua Ho Ngoc Ha qua cong ty Music Faces cua nhac si Duc Tri... Ngay ca nhung ong bau duoc tieng mat tay nay cung chiu canh that bai nhu ong bau Hoang Tuan da bo tay khong day duoc vi tri cua Cao Thai Son len. Truong hop Anh Khoa, Ha Anh Tuan... du la nhung giong hat da duoc kiem dinh tu cuoc thi Sao Mai diem hen nhung nhac si tai hoa Duc Tri cung khong khien ho bat len nhu ky vong. Noi gi toi nhung hoc vien bat dau di len tu con so 0.--PageBreak--
Khong chi co nhung nhac si mo trung tam, ngay nay, ca si cung dua nhau lam... thay. Co mot thuc te la nhung ca si lua chon cong viec nay hau het la nhung ca si da di qua giai doan dinh cao cua su nghiep. Va ho cho rang, lap cong ty de "truyen dat lai nhung kinh nghiem bieu dien" cho cac dan em di sau. Ca si Thanh Thao - ba chu cua Music Box la mot vi du. Khi Thanh Thao khong con giu duoc do hot tren san khau nua cung la luc co tung ra chieu cuoi cung: chuyen sang lam "bau". Tuong tu nhu vay, "ca si cua 1 bai" Ung Hoang Phuc sau mot thoi gian met moi ma khong chinh phuc duoc khan gia cung chuyen huong lap cong ty dao tao ca si, Ky Phuong (cuu thanh vien nhom Techno) bat dau cuong vi giam doc dieu hanh cua cong ty Tai nang moi...
Hoc vien de dai, giang vien cung trinh do... vua vua khien san pham cua nhung vu lam an nay luon cho chat luong thap. Khong don gian la viec that bai trong viec lang xe ma con nhieu chuyen lum xum, dut ganh giua duong cua moi quan he nay. Vu kien tung giua cong ty Thien Thi va ca si Tim, rac roi giua ca si tre Truong Quynh Anh va cong ty Music Box vi tranh chap bai doc quyen, su ra di khong sui tam cua ca si Tu Minh Hy tu ngoi nha Music Box… la minh chung cho viec chia tay giua cong ty quan ly va ca si ngay cang nhieu. Ben nao cung bien minh cho minh. Tuy nhien, khong ben nao noi thang ra rang tat ca den voi nhau chi vi muc tieu vat chat. Cac ong bau thi muon thu loi nhieu nhat tu nhung chu "ga" cua minh, con cac ca si om mong thanh sao thi lai muon noi tieng nhanh va thoat khoi su quan ly cua ong bau. Lau nay chung ta cho rang, lop ca si tre mong noi tieng bang moi gia, ngoai tai nang co mot phan nguyen nhan vi ho duoc dao tao boi cach thuc "an xoi" nhu the. Ben canh mot so trung tam lam viec chuyen nghiep thi con mot so khac mo ra voi muc dich kiem loi. Hau het cac giang vien dung lop deu chua duoc khan gia danh gia cao ve chuyen mon. Va co le cung hiem khi ho day nhung hoc tro cua minh cach de tro thanh mot nghe si dung nghia (vi thuc ra ho cung co duoc dao tao bai ban dau) ma chi day cach de "noi tieng" nhanh nhat nen sau do, khi duong ai nay di, thay tro noi nhau tren bao khong ra gi cung la dieu de hieu.
Khac voi cong nghe lang xe bai ban va dung thuc chat dang thinh hanh tren the gioi (la tim kiem nhung tai nang tiem an de dao tao va dung nhung thu phap lang xe tao dieu kien cho tai nang ay tiep can tot nhat voi cong chung), o Viet Nam, dieu can co o mot ngoi sao la tai nang thi cac ong bau it quan tam. Dieu do khien cho nhung nguoi duoc hoc hanh bai ban va co tai nang it co co hoi toa sang. Tai sao nhung nghe si nhu My Linh, Hong Nhung, Thanh Lam... khong mo lop dao tao ca si. Cu chieu theo bai toan thi truong thi voi nhung ten tuoi ay se co khong it hoc vien tham gia va loi nhuan se khong he nho. Nhung cac nghe si ay luon biet rang, trong nghe thuat, co khi hoc ca doi cung chua du noi gi toi viec hoc vai 3 thang. Nhieu ca si dang lam nghe mot cach nghiem tuc tung duoc cac nghe si tai danh nhu NSND Trung Kien, NSND Tran Hieu giang day deu cho rang, ho khong chi hoc duoc o cac nguoi thay cua minh ky thuat thanh nhac ma quan trong hon, ban than moi thay co ay da la mot tam guong de ho soi minh. Va ho la nhung nghe si dich thuc dang dong gop cho su phat trien cua nen nghe thuat nuoc nha. Noi vay de thay, cong chung kho co the dat ky vong vao cach dao tao mang dam tinh loi nhuan cua mot so trung tam dao tao ca si hien nay...

7 loai nuoc uong cho lan da mua lanh
7 loai nuoc uong cho lan da mua lanh Tags: de bo sung, lan da, loai nuoc, mua lanh, nuoc uong, co the, hoa qua, ban, lam, chat, 7
Mua lanh lan da bi mat nuoc, kho va rat de xau di. Vay chung ta nen uong loai nuoc nao de bo sung duong chat cho lan da?
Duoi day la 7 loai nuoc uong ban nen dung thuong xuyen de co lan da min mang, tuoi tre trong mua lanh.
Nuoc loc am pha mot chut chanh vao buoi sang se rat co loi cho suc khoe, giup ban loai tru cac chat doc khoi co the. Nuoc loc pha chut chanh co chua vitamin C lam sang da, giup co the co them suc de khang va chong lao hoa. Ngoai ra, chanh con duoc dung lam mat na cho da nhon; lam mem da noi khuyu tay, dau goi va mat ca chan...
Nuoc hoa qua nhu cam, tao, nho, le, dau tay... rat co loi cho co the, cung cap nhieu vatiam A, C, E... va muoi khoang lam min mang lan da cua ban trong mua dong. Ben canh do, nuoc ep nuoc hoa qua con co tac dung lam giam cac nep nhan khong mong muon. Ban co the uong nuoc ep hoa qua hay che bien mat na tu hoa qua thay vi di mua cac loai my pham dat tien.
Nuoc ep thuc pham duoc che bien tu cac loai rau cu: Ca rot, ca chua, dua chuot... cung la nhung giai phap rat tot cho lan da cua ban trong mua dong cung nhu cho qua trinh chuyen hoa va tai tao da.
Sua tuoi la thu do uong khong the thieu khi ban muon co lan da dep, min mang. Sua cung cap nang luong, vitamin va chat khoang cho co the. Dung quen rang, chi khi co the khoe moi co duoc lan da khoe.
Nuoc tra xanh: Tra xanh chua nhieu chat chong oxy hoa cung la giai phap cho lan da cua ban mua hanh kho. Mua dong den, ban hay uong moi ngay 1-2 coc tra xanh.
Nuoc am co pha chut mat ong: Ban co biet mat ong la than duoc cho lan da? Vi the, mot thia ca phe mat ong pha voi nuoc am se giup tre hoa lan da cua ban.
Ngoai ra, ban cung co the uong nuoc tu cac loai rau gia vi nhu: Ngai cuu, tia to, rau diep ca... de tay sach cac te bao chet va lam lan da them min mang. Co the ham moi loai gia vi nay trong nuoc soi, de 10 phut roi uong hang ngay.

Wrath of the Lich King - Huyen thoai Arthas
Xem bản tiếng việt đầy đủ tại đây : http://thethao60s.com/index/1105232/27012008.aspxWrath of the Lich King - Huyen thoai Arthas
Arthas con duoc biet den nhu la nguoi da danh bai Illidan.
Do la ngay thu 2 trong su kien BlizzCon o Los Angeles, nhung nhan vat cosplay warlock, elf va quai vat dang rao buoc xung quanh trung tam hoi nghi ke ben la khu Disneyland, voi tu the san sang chup anh. Xa xa la dan chuyen nghiep Han Quoc dang dam minh trong game StarCraft voi hon 300 thao tac moi phut.
Trong dai sanh chinh, ban nang cap thu 2 cua World Of Warcraft la Warth of The Lich King sap duoc gioi thieu, va hang ngan nguoi dang hao huc cho doi, trong ngong nhung tin tuc moi nhat. Su to mo nay bat nguon tu nhung thong tin ro ri tren mang 2 ngay truoc khi dien ra su kien. Dieu nay chung to BlizzCon co tac dong den nguoi choi, World Of Warcraft co anh huong den nguoi choi, va trong pham vi nao do nhan vat Arthas Menethil cung co anh huong den nguoi choi.
Nhung ai da tan man va say dam trong the gioi chien thuat co dien Warcraft III cua Blizzard chac han se biet Arthas, vi hoang tu sa nga truoc phep thuat cua chung undead Scourge, va tro thanh mot trong nhung Death Knight. Cuoi cung anh ta da gia nhap cung Kel’Thuzad de tro thanh nguoi tri vi cua Scourge duoc biet den voi ten goi Lich King.
Arthas Menethil duong nhu giong cau be Anakin SkyWalker trong StarWar, nhung nhan vat phe ac nhung bao gio cung duoc ham mo cuong nhiet. Chac han Arthas la mot trong nhung cau chuyen duoc theu det hap dan nhat trong the gioi Warcraft va la dua con cung cua Blizzard. Trong ban nang cap vua roi ten Burning Crusade, nguoi choi da co dip chung kien suc manh cua Illidan - Ke Phan Boi. Arthas con duoc biet den nhu la nguoi da danh bai Illidan.
Trong Wrath of The Lich King, nguoi choi se thuong thuc nhieu hon cam giac chinh phuc duoc end boss, Lich King se tran ngap tam tri cua nguoi choi, ngay tu giay phut ho dat chan vao lanh dia cua anh ta, Northrend. Ban se co the cam nhan sau hon hinh anh cua Arthas thong qua viec theo buoc anh ta de tro thanh mot Death Knight. Nhung quan trong hon het, ban phai dat duoc 10 level moi, chuan level duoc nang len thanh 80, va phai chien dau ngang doc luc dia Northrend truoc khi ban muon tro thanh Death Knight.
Northrend, mot vung dat bi dong bang toa lac o phia Bac cua Azeroth. De vao duoc lanh dia Northrend nguoi choi se phai chon 2 cong khac nhau: Howling Fjord o phia dong va Borean Tundra o phia Tay. Blizzard phan chia thanh 2 vung nham giam tai cho server, va chac la da rut kinh nghiem tu Burning Crusade khi chi co mot cong qua Outland o Badland.
Howling Fjord la mot vung cao nguyen, bao boc boi nhung day nui cao ngut troi, va toa lac trong Utgarde Keep instance. Utgarde Keep la mot thanh tri hung vi cua Vrykul, mot chung loai Viking khong lo tan bao. Borean Tundra voi nhung nguoi Tuskarr dang yeu, nhung khu rung Gizzly Hills, ngoi nha cua cac chu gau Furbolgs va Dragonblight mot vung bang gia cai tri boi ke thu Blue Dragonflight.
Nhu nhung mong doi tu phia Blizzard, nhung hinh anh that su dep den kinh ngac va hoanh trang. Blizzard da tao nen mot Northrend ky dieu voi nhung quai vat la ki, nhung chu linh duong voi kich thuoc khong lo mang ve mang u buon cua con nguoi khien ban cam long khong no giet chung. Trong Wrath of The Lich King, nguoi choi se duoc gan chat vao trong vung chien tuyen hon nua so voi ban Burning Crusade. Ngay khi vua dat chan den, nguoi choi ngay lap tuc se duoc nho giup chiem lay ben cang boi luc luong chong doi Vrykul. Mot nhiem vu khac buoc nguoi choi phai pha huy nhung chien thuyen bang cach dot nhap tu mot phi thuyen, mot canh co diem tuong dong voi cac tac pham khoa hoc vien tuong cua Jules Verne hon la so voi the gioi tuong tuong Tolkien. Northrend qua that dua ban tu kinh ngac nay den kinh ngac khac.
Illidan - Ke phan boi (Betrayer)
Northrend di theo huong truyen thong hon so voi vung dat xa la Outland cua Burning Crusade. Nhung cam giac dam chat than thoai se khien ban nho lai cam giac phieu luu cua nhung nam dau kham pha Azeroth. Nhung vung dat long lay, chua dung nhieu bi an va rat nhieu chung loai moi se duoc gioi thieu, do la loi phat bieu cua Kaplan, chu nhiem thiet ke cua Wrath of The Lich King. Khong chi bo hep trong nhung vung dat bang gia, Northrend chac chan se rong hon nhieu so voi Outland. Mot dieu nguoi choi nen cam on nhom phat trien la lan nay ho da khong tao ra nhung khu vuc bat dau rieng cho moi chung loai moi, vi tinh so so tai BlizzCon cung da co 10 ban do khac nhau.
Mot trong nhung vung dat duoc quan tam nhat chac han la Ho Wintergrasp, mot vung dat theo phong cach moi danh cho nhung tran chien doi khang so dong giua 2 phe Horde va Alliance. Ket hop voi nhung tran danh battleground moi, nguoi choi duoc hua hen se thoa thich thuong thuc nhung vu khi PvP moi va kha nang pha huy nhung cong trinh. Kaplan thua nhan Ho Wintergrasp nay la co gang cua nhom de dua PvP cua World Of Warcraft len mot tam cao moi, thoat khoi su rang buoc trong nhung chiec hop.
Burning Crusade co rat nhieu cuoc thu nghiem doi khang trong moi truong rong mo, tuy nhien no van chua duoc thanh cong lam. Rut kinh nghiem xuong mau tu bai hoc tren, nhom phat trien da dat het tam huyet vao Northrend, tao nen nhung tran danh lon ngay giua them luc dia. Ho Wintergrasp se nam sat ben thanh chinh moi, Dalaran, thien duong dich chuyen cua mage tu vung dat Eastern Kingdoms va bay len tren Northrend.
Blizzard hai long voi che do instance o Burning Crusade, vi vay trong ban Lich King cung se duoc ap dung tuong tu, voi nhom 5, 10 va 25 nguoi ben canh che do normal va heroic.
Huyen thoai Arthas
Ben canh nhung cong trinh, kien truc hung vi, Blizzard con gioi thieu tinh nang nghe moi trong Wrath of The Lich King. Inscription, la ten goi cua nghe moi cho phep nang cap vinh vien spell va ability. Vi du them vao tinh nang Knock-on cho chuong Fireball cua Mage hay giam thoi gian cooldown cua spell do, nghe co ve giong cai tien cua talent-tree trong World Of Warcrft nhieu hon. Chi nang cap thuong thoi da ton ca gia tai trong game, loi khuyen cho ban nen chuan bi tim hieu ve nghe nay, hoac chuan bi mot so gold kha kha de "thue" nguoi lam duoc no.
Nhung neu hoi mot nguoi ham mo WoW dieu gi lam ban quan tam ve Warth of The Lich King, thi nhung van de tren khong phai la trong tam, ma do la class nhan vat moi dau tien trong lich su World Of Warcraft, class hero dau tien: Death Knight.
Bat cu chung loai nao cung co the dat danh hieu Death Knight (ke ca Gnome). Death Knight duoc hieu la mot "magical undead warrior": su dung plate armoured, dual-wielding, army-of-skeletons-summoning. Nguoi choi chi co the tao mot Death Knight sau khi hoan thanh mot nhiem vu o level 80, tuy nhien nhan vat hero se bat dau lai tu level khoang tu 55-70. Death Knight chac chan se khong manh hon nhung class khac, ban se cam nhan dieu khac biet theo huong khac ma thoi.
Mot khi ban dat duoc cap Death Knight, he thong se mo khoa nhieu nhiem vu bam sat theo cot truyen cua nhan vat. Anh ta con co mot he thong moi, rune, cho phep thiet lap nhung chieu ma anh ta co the su dung bat cu luc nao va co 6 slot rune tren vu khi cua Death Knight.
Trong ban nang cap moi, ban con co the thay doi kieu toc moi, sau khi gan bo hon 2 nam ruoi voi guong mat "moc" cu xi cua minh, chac ban cung muon thay doi mot chut gi do. Ben canh do ban con co the thiet lap cac kieu dance khac nhau.
Tat ca nhung mong doi gio chi con la thoi gian, khi nao? Do la cau hoi cua hon 9 trieu nguoi dang hanh trinh trong the gioi World Of Warcraft.

Meo xu ly bot mi khi lam banh
Bot my la nguyen lieu cua nhieu loai banh khac nhau. Tuy nhien, neu khong co nhung ky thuat kheo leo, doi khi mon banh cua ban chang nhu y muon. Hay “thu” san vai bi quyet nho nho sau de san pham luon hoan hao ban nhe.
Nhao bot that min
- Cac xu ly bot my khong qua kho. Voi cong doan nhao, neu don thuan chi nhao bot bang nuoc am thi bot my truoc sau se von cuc, “oc trau” lon con, khien mon banh khong ngon. Do do, de khac phuc, hay cho vao bot kho it muoi roi tron deu truoc, sau do moi do nuoc vao nhao, bot se min mang.
Khi lam banh, bot my phai duoc nhao that min (Anh minh hoa)
Rut ngan thoi gian u bot
- Thong thuong, nhao bot xong, muon lam banh ngon, phai u bot cho len men. Qua trinh nay co the mat tu vai gio cho den nua ngay. Ban co the rut ngan cong doan nay bang cach cho vao giua cuc bot mot it ruou roi dung khan uot u lai, bot se mau len men, xop va mem hon.
Xu ly khi bot chua
- Neu thoi gian u bot len men qua lau, bot se bi chua. De khac phuc, hay cho it muoi vao bot de tron theo ti le 500g bot can 5g muoi. Nhu the, bot se het chua, mau bot cung khong bi nga vang sam.
Hay cho it muoi vao bot de tron theo ti le 500g bot can 5g muoi de khac phuc bot chua (Anh minh hoa)
- Ngoai dung lam banh, bot my con co nhieu tac dung doi voi cac mon an. Vi du, khi lam mon nem, ban nen cho mot it bot mi vao tron chung, nem se khong bi chay nuoc, khi chien hay nuong, nem it bi khet va vang deu hon. Ngoai ra, khi chien ca, nguoi ta cung phu mot lop bot mi mong len ca, ca se vang gion va khong bi ban dau ra ngoai.

Vi sao rat nhieu tre bi tai dien viem duong ho hap, di vien nhu com bua?
Trong truong hop be bi rom say nhat thiet phai duoc bac si chuyen khoa nhi hay bac si chuyen da lieu chi dinh dieu tri thich hop; ben canh do ban co the tham khao ung dung phuong phap dan gian de tam cho be, co rat nhieu loai la co chua chat khang sinh, giup sat trung, khang khuan co the dung dun nuoc cho be tam tri mot so benh ngoai da. Ban co the dung mot trong so loai la duoi day:
La tia to: voi la tia to, sau khi rua sach chi can gia lay nuoc cot, cham len vung da bi ham cua be 3 - 4 lan/ ngay. Luu lai tren da 15 phut truoc khi tam hoac lau sach bang nuoc am.
La kinh gioi: neu la la tuoi, ban dun soi va tam tuong tu nhu nhung loai la ben tren. Neu khong co la tuoi, ban co the su dung la kinh gioi da phoi kho. Moi lan tam bo mot nam vao dun soi, pha nuoc tam cho be.
La che xanh: hai mot nam la che xanh rua sach, dun soi 30 phut tren lua nho sau do chat lay nuoc, pha cho be tam. Co the cho them vai hat muoi.
La trau khong: hai 10 la trau gia, rua sach, dun soi roi pha voi nuoc tam cho be. La trau khong dac biet thich hop tam khi troi lanh, vi chung giup giu cho co the be nong am.
Muop dang: chon 2 trai muop dang gia, rua sach, thai mong sau do xay hoac gia nat, loc lay nuoc. Pha them nuoc am tam cho be, moi lan tam 2 qua la vua.
Gung tuoi: lay mot nhanh gung tuoi rua sach, gia nho roi dun soi voi nuoc. Cho nuoc nguoi thi tam cho be. Voi gung tuoi, tam buoi sang cho be se tot hon tam buoi chieu.
La ngai cuu: hai mot nam la ngai cuu rua sach, dun soi 30 phut tren lua nho sau do chat lay nuoc, pha cho be tam. Co the cho them vai hat muoi.
La khe: sau khi rua sach, loai bo phan gan cung o giua la. Dem xay hoac gia nat mot nam la khe voi vai hat muoi, loc nuoc la khe roi pha them nuoc am tam cho be.

MYANMAR: Nihin zinglei ahkhan Myanmar President U Htin Kyaw cu a rian in dinh a duh cang caah a dirhmun cu a chuahtaak cang tiah theih a si.
State Counsellor Aung San Suu Kyi hruaimi Committee nih President thar thimnak cu na tuah lai than lai tiah NLD lei in chimrel khotu Monywa Aung Shin nih a chim.
“Zei bantukin dah President kan thim lai ti cu kan i ceihhmai than lai. Aung San Suu Kyi hruaimi committee (phu) nih President thar thimnak kong ceihhmainak cu an tuah lai ka zumh. NLD party nih direct in thanhnak a chuah lai lo. Hi kong hi cu cozah le parliament deuh nih an tawlrel ko lai”, tiah Monywa Aung Shin nih a chim.
Phunghrampi Dal 73 (b) ning in cun ni 7 chungah President thar hi thim ding ti a si tiah President Zung in cathanh tawite an chuahmi ah an tial.
Cun, Phunghrampi ning in cun Vice President 1 Myint Swe hi ni 7 chung cu Acting President a tuan chung ding a si.
Phunghrampi Dal 73 (a) ah ‘Vice President pahnih chungah President thimnak ah thimfung tambik, a pahnihnak a hmutu nih, rian in ngol/dinh, thihloh le adangdang ruangah zungzal chamhbaunak/tlamtlinlonak a um i President rian/dirhmun a lawn ahcun, Acting President tuan ding’ tiah a um.
Phunghrampi Dal 73 (b) ah ‘Union Parliament nih ceihhmainak an ngeih chungah President rian a lawn ahcun Acting President nih ni 7 chungah President thar thim dingin Union Parliament Lutlai sinah thawng a thanh zawkzawk lai’ ti a si.
Atu bantukin U Htin Kyaw aa dinhnak a ruang cu tling le fiang in President Zung nih an langhter lo nain, ‘a ngandam lo ruang bik ahhin aa dinhnak a si ko tiah NLD lei chimrel khotu Monywa Aung Shin nih a chim.
Kum 2 chung cu President dirhmun in rian a tuan ko nain U Htin Kyaw a riantuannak hi a lang kho lem lo, Aung San Suu Kyi i a mi hmanmi menmen khi a si ko.
Kan hnu kum te khan, mipi nih cun cheukhat ni/caan sunglawi hmannak ah a baunak ruangah le a derthawmnak mithmai ruangah kum 71, U Htin Kyaw a ngandam lonak cu an rak theih ngai cang. Cun, ramleng zong ah aa thlop len cang.

Co ky su lam nghiep can dam
Tags: Ngoc Ha, lam nghiep, chuong trinh, ba con, nhu the, ky su, can dam, minh, co, em, lam, nguoi,
Khi vua hoan thanh xuat sac luan van tot nghiep chuyen nganh Nong - Lam ket hop trong khoa Lam nghiep - Ðai hoc Lam nghiep Ha Noi, Ngoc Ha duoc Vien nghien cuu Khoa hoc nong nghiep Viet Nam moi ve lam viec. Tuy nhien, co da tu choi va nop ho so xin viec vao VTC16. Ay la vao nam 2010. Khi ay, VTC16 ra doi chua duoc bao lau.
Thoi sinh vien soi noi
Ngoc Ha sinh nam 1987. Sau khi tot nghiep PTTH, Ha quyet dinh thi vao Ðai hoc Ngan hang nhung thieu diem, nghe loi me khuyen: “Thoi, khong theo nghiep dem tien thi dem… la cay rung cung duoc”. Ha chon hoc Ðai hoc Lam nghiep. “Que nha o Phu Tho, dat dai rong, co trang trai trong che, lai la con doc nen chac bo me cho con di hoc lam nghiep de sau ve cai quan dat dai chang?”, toi treu. Ha cuoi, mieng cuoi, mat cung cuoi sau cap kinh can lap loa.
Dang nguoi manh mai lai duoc bo me chieu chuong nhung khi noi chuyen, Ha luon to ra la mot co gai manh me va doc lap. Co le mot phan do tinh cach, mot phan do thoi gian ren luyen o Ðai hoc Lam nghiep da day cho Ha phai nhu the. Nhung ngay con la sinh vien, Ha ke, o truong phai thuc hanh rat nhieu: Ði rung thuc nghiem, cuoc xoi dat trong cay, van dong ba con bao ve rung, hoc tieng dan toc, hay di vao trai cai nghien huong dan cac benh nhan o day trong va cham soc cay… Nhung ky hoc dau tien, di theo cac thay co len nhung vung rung dang bi got trui dan, Ha tu nhu: “Troi oi, sao di hoc dai hoc lai kho the nay?”.
Ay la khi den huyen Lang Chanh, Thanh Hoa la rung dau nguon, sat bien gioi Lao. O do, ba con khong co nuoc sach dung. Ðam sinh vien bon Ha phai di vao vung sau, xa van dong ba con quy hoach trong lai rung. Ði moi thay co nhung noi tren dat nuoc minh con kho cuc va thieu thon den the. Moi chuyen di hon nua thang ren cho Ha ban linh cung nhu day cho co nhieu kinh nghiem di rung, kinh nghiem ton tai trong nhung dieu kien thieu thon va khac nghiet.
Ha ke: “Thoi sinh vien em di rung nhieu, an, o, sinh hoat cung ba con va hang ngay cung ba con len rung huong dan ho trong cay. Cuoc song o nhung vung nay con hoang da, ban nang lam. O day ho chi co ranh nho lay nuoc tu tren nui xuong, nuoc chay qua chuong trau, chuong bo xuong cho trung de nguoi dung. Buoi sang danh rang chiu khong noi cac loai mui. Vay ma nguoi dan van an uong, sinh hoat bang thu nuoc day thi minh cung danh phai chap nhan. Cuoc song cua ho vat va kho khan lam, ho khong co gi ngoai tai nguyen thien nhien nen phai song dua vao no. Cho nen van dong ho khong pha rung bua bai rat kho khan, vat va”.
Ha so vai, rung minh: “So nhat luc vao rung la vat va ran. Nhieu vo ke. Co dieu, khi bi nem vao trong moi truong ay roi thi danh phai thich nghi, phai hoc cac ky nang chong vat, gap ran phai lam sao, di voi ba con dan toc thi phai an noi, cu xu the nao, tap tuc cua ho ra sao… Va trong 4 nam hoc, thuong xuyen song cung ba con nhu the moi thay minh qua hanh phuc va may man mac du minh cung o mien nui, cung sinh ra lon len o nong thon”.
Cung nho kinh nghiem dan day nhu vay ngay tu thua sinh vien ma sau nay, khi ve kenh VTC16, Ngoc Ha khong ngai voi nhung chuyen cong tac vung sau xa. Tham chi, co con day tu tin voi nhung ky nang song ma minh da co. Va nho co nhung ngay an cung o cung ba con ma ve sau khi da lam viec o VTC16, Ha tiep can voi nhung nguoi nong dan de dang hon va tham chi con giu duoc nhung moi quan he than thiet, duoc coi nhu con chau, nguoi than trong gia dinh, duoc bieu trung ga, hoa qua, gao moi dip cac co bac len tham thanh pho. Ha bao, co duoc nhung chuong trinh nhu hom nay em da lam duoc, em phai cam on ho rat nhieu, nhung co bac nong dan da cung cap thong tin cho em bat cu khi nao em can. Nho vay em moi thuong xuyen co de tai hay de len song.
Bai hoc di rung
Cuoc tro chuyen voi Ha khong qua lau nhung chi trong dam ba cau chuyen da co the cam nhan rat ro tinh cach buong binh va quyet tam cua co BTV manh mai, nhe nhang nay. Ha chia se: “Khi moi vao day em cam thay rat buon vi nhung kien thuc nong sot trong dau minh khong co dat dung. Vao lam truyen hinh, minh nhu to giay trang, phai hoc tu cach viet kich ban, cach dung hinh. 6 thang dau, em cu dau tranh tu tuong, o lai hay nen di.
Ðau cu luan quan suy nghi, ngay xua di hoc minh dau co cam giac minh dot, bi thut lui nhu the nay? Hay minh khong co nang luc? Minh khong hop voi nghe nay… Gia minh cong tac o vien hay mot cong ty nao do, co the minh da duoc danh gia cao hon, duoc nhin bang con mat khac. Roi, lai tu van, minh ma lai bo cuoc de dang the sao? Khong the bo cuoc de dang nhu the! Va vi the em o lai lam, co gang bang hai, bang ba nguoi khac de khong bi coi thuong. Gio cung duoc 2 nam em lam o day roi”.
Su buong binh va quyet tam nay cua Ha con the hien rat ro trong lan di lam ve ky thuat trong cay Sa Nhan o Hoanh Bo, Quang Ninh. “Ði moi biet Quang Ninh co nhung vung con sau, xa hon ca Phu Tho. Ðuong khong dang goi la duong ma toan doc da tron truot. Hom ay leo met qua, em bi ngat. Nho loi thay day ngay xua hoi con di rung thuc nghiem: Co nhung thu nhu hieu ung Domino ay, neu minh keu met thi nguoi khac cung se cam thay nhu the. Vi vay, du doi, met cung dung keu, hay luon to ra vui ve”. Ay the ma sau chuyen di ay, Ha lam duoc 2 so hay ra tro.
Hien nay Ngoc Ha dang la BTV cua chuong trinh Trang chan nuoi. Ðay la mot tap chi khoa giao khoang 30 phut canh bao dich benh, chia se kinh nghiem hay, tra loi thac mac cua nong dan… Truoc do, Ha da lam nhieu chuong trinh khac nhu Internet ve lang, Khuyen nong, Huong nghiep nha nong, Sao than nong, Trang thuy san… Trong do, chuong trinh Huong nghiep nha nong de lai cho Ha nhieu ky niem den bay gio van con “seo”.
Ðo la lan di quay chuong trinh phong chua benh cho nhim o Vinh Phuc, theo format chuong trinh do, Ha la nhan vat trai nghiem. Trong yeu cau cua mot canh quay, Ha phai giu mot con nhim bi benh de anh chu trai boi thuoc vao vet thuong cua no. Nhung Ha bi con nhim can xuyen qua ngon tay, mat rat nhieu mau. Ha xoe ban tay chi vao vet seo o ngon tay ut, den gio no van chua binh thuong tro lai. Tuy vay, niem vui doi lai la sau khi chuong trinh phat song da nhan duoc hieu ung tot tu phia khan gia. Anh chu trai tham chi da xay duoc nha moi nho tien ban nhim.
“Ky niem vui nhat la chuong trinh quay trang trai nuoi ran o Tam Ðao, Ba Vi. O day nguoi ta nuoi ran khong nhot, ran o khap moi noi, bo duoi chan, vat veo tren cay. Hom ay nhin vao khuon hinh cua ban quay phim cu thay rung rung, ngo vao mat ban, em moi thay mat ban ay do bung, mo hoi la cha mac du khi ay dang la mua dong, nguoi run ban bat. Hoa ra la do ban ay so ran qua. Luc ay moi biet quy kinh nghiem di rung va gap ran cua minh 4 nam dai hoc”, Ngoc Ha vua ke vua cuoi.
Vua roi nhac den Ngoc Ha, anh Nguyen Trung Ðai, Pho Giam doc VTC16 co khen loat phong su ve duong day buon ban trai phep chon nhung den dang manh nha o 40 tinh thanh tren ca nuoc. Ngoc Ha da chu dong keu goi cac bao dai khac dong hanh cung minh va tu minh mang DVD phim do minh lam den Cuc Chan nuoi va keu goi Cuc Chan nuoi vao cuoc. Ngay sau do, chuong trinh da nhan duoc nhieu su ung ho va danh gia tot.
Ban than Ngoc Ha cung cam thay rat vui vi duong nhu nhung co gang de “bang ban bang be” cua minh truoc day da duoc den dap. Chot nho toi cau Ha noi ve hieu ung Domino cung kinh nghiem di rung cua co va cam nhan thay rang, Ha khong chi co su can dam ma con co kha nang truyen su can dam ay cho nguoi doi dien nua.

Tran Chi Cong cui dau nhan toi.
Hom nay 4/5, TAND TP Ha Noi da tuyen muc an cao nhat danh cho Tran Chi Cong - nguoi da giet mot nu ho sinh, dot xac phi tang o ngo chua Lien Phai dip ap Tet vua qua.
Sau khi bi bat (ngay 9/3/2007), thu pham van kien quyet khong khai nhan cho den khi nhan duoc buc thu dong vien cua hai dua con da mo coi me. Vu an bi tham duoc lam sang to.
Toi 7/2/2007, Tran Chi Cong (SN 1954, tru tai nha 9/15 Luong Khanh Thien, Tuong Mai, Ha Noi) den nha chi Nguyen Thi Minh Ngan o ngo chua Lien Phai, phuong Cau Den, Hai Ba Trung, Ha Noi (chi Ngan song mot minh) choi. Khi chu nha quay lung, mo tu dinh lay khoe chiec dien thoai Nokia 7370 moi mua, Cong lap tuc dung bua dap nhieu nhat vao dau nan nhan.
Chi Ngan bat tinh. Thay mau chay nhieu, Cong keo nan nhan vao phong ve sinh, xa nuoc rua. Nuoc lanh lam nan nhan tinh lai, vua keu u o thi lai bi Cong dap bua chet han.
Bi cao loi nan nhan len giuong, dap kin chan nem roi luc tim tai san. Khong tim duoc nhieu tien mat, Cong “nhat tam” 900.000d va 2 chiec dien thoai di dong roi tinh cach xoa dau vet. Thu pham luc tim quan ao chat len nguoi nan nhan va rai khap nha, sau do xa nuoc cho sach dau vet trong phong ve sinh, xoa dau van tay o hien truong roi bat lua dot 2 dong quan ao quanh giuong. Lay chum chia khoa, mo san cua, cho cho ngon lua bat kha cao, vi bac si tinh quai moi chay xuong, thoat ra ngoai.
Tran Chi Cong bi truy to voi 3 toi danh: giet nguoi, cuop tai san, huy hoai tai san.
Bi cao cui dau khai nhan hanh vi pham toi da man cua minh. Tuy nhien, ngay khi bat dau phien toa, bi cao da phu nhan cao buoc cua VKS ve dong co gay an la do tung tien vi co bac, no nan nen nay sinh y dinh giet nguoi, cuop tai san.
Cong ke lai cau chuyen khac han. Sau khi vo mat (nam 2002), Cong duoc ban gioi thieu voi chi Ngan vao thang 6/2004 va hai nguoi da co y dinh “ga nghia”. Nhung sau 2-3 lan gap go, quan he rat “than mat”, Cong moi biet chi Ngan sinh nam 1959, bang tuoi nguoi vo da mat cua minh. Me tin “ky tuoi”, Cong chu dong “lang dan”. Khi do, Cong da cho chi Ngan vay 20 trieu dong (khong giay to, khong nguoi lam chung).
Mon no do Cong da hoi doi nhieu lan ma chi Ngan van chua tra. Thoi gian gan day, can tien, cong no nhieu, bi cao da den nha tim chi Ngan

Nghi dinh 181 ve thi hanh Luat Dat dai Khong hoi to dat nen du an da duoc duyet
Nghi dinh 181 ve thi hanh Luat Dat dai Khong hoi to dat nen du an da duoc duyet Tags: TP Ho Chi Minh, Luat Dat, Thanh Nien, Bo Tai, Dang Hung Vo, van de thoi su, het suc quan tam, nhung du an, su dung dat, dat nong nghiep, nhu the nao, nguoi dan, thi phai, chuyen nhuong, quy dinh, 181
Da co rat nhieu du an duoc duyet theo co che chi xay dung ha tang va ban nen. Anh D.D.Minh
* Khong cam sang nhuong dat nong nghiep
Trong chuyen cong tac tai TP Ho Chi Minh de trien khai Nghi dinh (ND) 181, Thu truong Bo Tai nguyen - Moi truong Dang Hung Vo da danh cho Thanh Nien mot cuoc phong van lien quan den nhung van de thoi su dang duoc du luan het suc quan tam xung quanh ND nay.
* Thua thu truong, hien nay van de khuc mac chinh ma cac doanh nghiep (DN) kinh doanh dia oc va nguoi dan dac biet quan tam la gi?
- Hien nay, rat nhieu y kien ma toi nghe duoc, tu bao chi cung nhu du luan xa hoi chinh la van de khong cho chuyen nhuong nen dat tai cac du an; con cac y kien khac, sau khi nghien cuu kha ky ND, cac so Tai nguyen - Moi truong da phan hoi cho Bo tren tinh than dong thuan voi ND 181. Ve Dieu 101 trong ND quy dinh khong cho chuyen nhuong nen dat, toi xin khang dinh la khong hoi to. Truoc day, Nha nuoc co nhung co che cho cac DN xay dung ha tang va ban nen, sau do, de nguoi dan tu xay dung theo kien truc quy hoach da duoc duyet; day la van de luat phap da cho phep va theo toi duoc biet thi so luong du an dang nay cung rat nhieu, cho nen nhung du an nao da duoc phe duyet nhu vay thi cac DN va nguoi dan van cu tiep tuc thuc hien.
* Voi cac khach hang da mua nen dat trong cac du an truoc day thi ho co duoc tiep tuc chuyen nhuong nen dat khi khong co du dieu kien xay nha hoac khong co nhu cau xay nha nua, hay ho phai xay nha tren nen dat do roi moi duoc chuyen nhuong?
- Doi voi nhung truong hop nhu vay thi nguoi dan van duoc quyen chuyen nhuong nen dat minh da mua, tren nguyen tac nhung gi thuoc ve qua khu truoc khi van ban phap luat ban hanh thi nguoi dan van cu the thuc hien. Co rat nhieu du an duoc duyet theo co che chi xay dung ha tang va ban nen. Doi voi nhung du an nay, nguoi dan van cu tiep tuc thuc hien theo nhung gi da duoc duyet. Voi nhung nguoi da mua nen nhung chua nhan duoc so do thi van tiep tuc cho duoc cap so do.
* Thuc te tai TP Ho Chi Minh thoi gian qua, co nhieu du an dang trong qua trinh tien hanh cac thu tuc phap ly thi cac DN da phan nen dem ban. Nguoi dan da lo mua nhung nen dat nay thi bay gio phai giai quyet ra sao?
- Voi nhung du an trong qua trinh thuc hien co vi pham phap luat thi phai xu ly theo tung hoan canh cu the, doi tuong cu the. Neu nhung du an khong duoc phep ban nen ma van phan nen ban thi nhat dinh phai xu ly. Doi voi cac du an dang o giai doan trinh UBND tinh, thanh pho truc thuoc trung uong ky giao dat thi phai duoc xem xet lai cho phu hop voi boi canh ND 181 vua duoc ban hanh. Nhung du sao di nua thi chung ta cung phai khang dinh voi nhau co che chia nen rao ban la co che khong hay, ma TP Ho Chi Minh cung da tung co quy dinh cam cach day vai nam.
Neu du an phe duyet mot dang ma DN lam mot neo hoac neu DN noi khong dung ve du an nham tap trung tien cua dan de lam du an thi phai xu ly. Nhung cung tuy tung truong hop ma xu ly khac nhau. Vi du, nguoi dan da co nhieu nha roi thi phai xu ly khac, con nguoi dan ca doi chi mua duoc nen dat do thi phai cu xu khac.
* Hien tai, nhieu nguoi dan chua du kha nang de mua mot luc ca nha lan dat, tai sao khong cho ho mua dat roi xay nha theo kien truc quy hoach da duoc duyet de tao dieu kien cho ho co nha o?
- Viec de nguoi dan tu xay nha thi phai tap trung o cac khu dan cu nong thon, trong ND van co quy dinh ve co che cho nguoi dan duoc tu xay dung o cac khu vuc nong thon co ma! Dang nha o xay dung theo du an chi quy dinh doi voi khu do thi, ma o do thi thi phai xay dung xong nha o tai cac du an moi duoc ban. Lam nhu vay moi co the hinh thanh duoc dien mao cac do thi hien dai. Doi voi nhung nguoi o do thi ma khong du tien mua nha va dat mot luc thi lai thuoc vao van de khac la co che nha cho nguoi thu nhap thap va cho nguoi ngheo. Tuc la Nha nuoc phai ho tro, chang han nhu cho ho mua tra cham, tra gop. Co che do nhu the nao thi trong chinh sach nha chung ta se ban sau. Toi cung xin noi ro la neu trong truong hop can cat nen ra ban thi Nha nuoc phai truc tiep giao nen cho dan, chu khong the qua mot cong ty roi cong ty su dung dat cua Nha nuoc de kinh doanh, ma kinh doanh voi loi nhuan rat lon de Nha nuoc va nguoi dan cung bi thiet.
Thuc ra, vua roi co du luan cho rang neu de cac DN xay nha roi ban thi nguoi mua khong yen tam ve chat luong nen co lap luan nen de nguoi dan mua dat roi tu xay nha. Theo toi, tat ca lap luan do la nguy bien. Quy dinh nhu trong ND 181 la nham de nha dau tu phai thuc chat la nha dau tu, neu khong co von thi nha dau tu phai di vay ngan hang va dong thoi phai chung to tiem luc cua minh; con tien tiet kiem cua dan muon tham gia dau tu thi phai thong qua thi truong chung khoan, co the la thi truong chung khoan bat dong san, chu khong nen lam theo kieu "du kich". Toi cho rang lam theo cach hien nay van la theo kieu "du kich".
* Vay viec quy dinh khong cho nguoi dan tu xay nha trong cac du an co trai gi voi Luat Dat dai?
- Toi khang dinh la khong trai voi Luat Dat dai, nhung neu Nha nuoc giao nen dat cho nguoi dan thi nguoi dan co quyen xay dung, con Nha nuoc giao du an cho DN thi van de lai khac. Truong hop thanh pho co chu truong thi hay tao ra mot so khu vuc danh cho nguoi thu nhap thap va truc tiep giao nen dat cho dan chu dung giao cho DN, dung cho DN co co hoi lam an tren moi quan he giua Nha nuoc voi nguoi ngheo, nguoi thu nhap thap.
* Vua roi, TP Ho Chi Minh co mot chu truong gay tranh cai khi quy dinh xay nha phai cach bo song 50m, hoi to doi voi nhung du an da trien khai. Khi bao chi len tieng, UBND TP sau do da dong y khong hoi to voi nhung du an da duoc trien khai truoc do. The nhung den nay, co mot so nguoi dan trong truong hop nay van chua nhan duoc so do de co the xay nha. Nay ND 181 ra doi lieu co anh huong gi den nhung truong hop noi tren?
- Theo toi nhung du an da xet duyet roi, da thuc hien roi, da xay nha roi thi chac chan khong the hoi to. Nhung xet thay do an toan chua cao thi phai co ke hoach gia co nen mong cua cong trinh de khoi bi anh huong ngay cho chinh ngoi nha cua minh, gia co bo song bang viec xay ke; truong hop co the kip thoi thay doi duoc de bao dam an toan trong tuong lai thi chung ta van nen thay doi. Neu viec phe duyet truoc day cua UBND TP chua hoan chinh lam, chua can nhac can than ma nay con dieu chinh duoc thi nen dieu chinh. Con nhung truong hop da xay dung xong roi thi chi con cach chon giai phap gia co de dam bao an toan cho nguoi dan ma thoi.
* Truong hop tren chi la mot vi du cho thay cac chinh sach dat dai - anh huong den xa hoi - lai lien tuc thay doi, khong nhat quan, gay lo lang rat nhieu cho nguoi dan va gay kho khan cho DN. Khi xay dung nhung chinh sach nhu the nay, cac co quan chuc nang co tinh den quyen loi cua hai doi tuong noi tren hay khong?
- Dung la chinh sach dat dai co nhung thay doi luc nay, luc khac nhung tinh than cua Luat Dat dai 2003 va ND 181 la bao ve quyen loi chinh dang cua nguoi dan va DN. Chung toi cung da can nhac nhieu mat va luon dat quyen loi cua nguoi dan len hang dau, sau do la quyen loi cua DN. Nhung khi bao ve quyen loi cua nguoi dan thi cung co luc anh huong nhat dinh den quyen loi cua DN. DN lam dung thi phai duoc ung ho, phai duoc bao ve, con lam sai thi phai xu ly theo dung phap luat chu khong the noi chung chung duoc.
* Trong ND 181 cung co quy dinh dat nong nghiep chi duoc chuyen doi trong pham vi phuong, xa, thi tran de thuan tien canh tac, dieu do co the dung voi cac vung nong thon. Con o nhung thanh pho lon dang do thi hoa nhanh nhu Ha Noi, Da Nang, TP Ho Chi Minh... thi quy dinh nay lieu co phu hop, co kiem ham qua trinh do thi hoa?
- Chuyen nhuong thi khong co gi han che, chi han che doi voi dat lua thoi. Con viec han che chuyen doi la vi sao: chuyen doi la co che hang doi hang, chuyen nhuong la co che hang doi qua tien. Mot xa hoi hien dai la hang doi qua tien, con hang doi hang la hinh thuc cua mot xa hoi no hoi cu roi. Trong truong hop cung mot phuong, xa ma nguoi ta don dien doi thua co loi cho viec hien dai hoa nong nghiep thi phai tao dieu kien. Con khi khong co nhu cau canh tac nua thi van duoc chuyen nhuong.
* Nhung hien TP Ho Chi Minh co Chi thi 08 khong cho chuyen nhuong dat nong nghiep ra khoi phuong, xa?
- Neu nguoi chuyen nhuong ma van tiep tuc san xuat nong nghiep thi khong viec gi, nhung neu su dung dat do de chuyen thanh dat phi nong nghiep thi phai dong tien su dung dat, voi dieu kien la phai phu hop quy hoach. Con neu cam han chuyen nhuong la khong dung. Neu TP Ho Chi Minh cam o diem nay thi phai sua cho phu hop voi ND moi ban hanh.
* Trong ND 181 co quy dinh ve viec xu ly dat o co vuon, ao khi den bu giai toa deu duoc xem la dat o, vay con quy dinh han muc dat o do thi co con hieu luc?
- Dieu 87 cua Luat Dat dai va trong ND 181 deu co quy dinh ro: truoc nam 1980, giay to co ranh gioi thua dat ro rang thi deu duoc tinh toan bo la dat o. Sau nam 1980 den 2004, tuy theo truong hop giay to su dung dat co ghi nhu the nao, neu da ghi ro dien tich roi thi cong nhan dien tich da ghi tren giay, chu khong tinh han muc cu the nua. Day la diem moi rat thoang, de bao dam quyen loi cho nguoi dan khi ap dung chinh sach den bu giai toa.
* Trong may ngay qua, thi truong dat nen du an o TP Ho Chi Minh dong bang, nhieu nguoi cho rang la do tac dong cua ND 181. Ong co y kien gi ve dong thai nay?
- Toi xin khang dinh thi truong bat dong san khong chi chiu tac dong cua ND 181 ma con chiu su tac dong cua nhieu co che chinh sach khac, nhieu luat khac; phu thuoc vao quy hoach thi truong bat dong san nhu the nao; linh vuc hanh chinh trong thu tuc chuyen nhuong; cac loai thue thu nhap tu chuyen nhuong quyen su dung dat cung nhu chuyen nhuong bat dong san...
Con ve viec dat nen du an TP Ho Chi Minh bi dong bang, theo toi khong phai do ND 181 tac dong vao, ma do chung ta chua xu ly rot rao cac van de lien quan, chua dua ra duoc cac giai phap xu ly cu the doi voi truong hop cua TP Ho Chi Minh. Van de nay, thanh pho phai co chu truong thao go nhu the nao do de phu hop voi khung phap luat chung. Con du luan tu nguoi dan thi do thong tin qua moi, chua biet xu ly nhu the nao nen nguoi dan phai dung lai de cho doi, nghe ngong. Dang le thanh pho phai co chu truong som hoac lam viec voi Bo de thong nhat chu truong xu ly.
