zai hen duo ren de bing bu jiu yuan de ji yi zhong ， da ge chang tu dian hua shou xian yao gan dao you dian ju pai dui ， pai shang dui hou cai neng zai ying ye tai tian gua hao dan ， ran hou zai you chang tu hua wu yuan zhuan dao xiang guan you dian ju ， zai you xiang guan you dian ju zhuan dao ju ti dian hua shang 。 na shi hou ， gu ding dian hua huan shi ren men ri chang sheng huo de xi han wu ， jin tian ren shou yi bu shou ji shen zhi shi ji bu shou ji de jing xiang ， zai na ge shi dai de ren men xin zhong jian zhi wu fa xiang xiang 。
1978 nian ， wo guo quan guo dian hua yong hu bu guo 214 wan ， dian hua pu ji lv zhi you 0.38%， bi mei guo luo hou 75 nian ！ bing qie quan guo shi hua yue you san fen zhi yi kao ren gong zhuan jie ， jue da duo shu chang tu dian hua kao chang tu jie xian yuan zhuan jie 。 da bu fen xian cheng he nong cun ting liu zai “ yao ba zi ” zhuang tai 。
zhi dao 1987 nian wo guo kai shi yin ru yi dong tong xin ji shu shi ， wo guo de dian xin wang ji chu reng ran fei chang bo ruo 。1987 nian yi qian ， quan guo dian hua dian lu jin wei 2.2 wan tiao ， chang tu chuan shu yi ming xian wei zhu ， gong zhong dian hua wang zong rong liang jin wei 435.5 wan men ， mei bai ren yong you dian hua ji shu huan bu dao ban bu ， zhe zhong shui ping bu jin yu fa da guo jia xiang ju shen yuan ， shen zhi huan bu ru yi xie fa zhan zhong guo jia ， quan guo dian hua zong shu bi dang shi xiang gang di qu de shu liang huan yao shao 。
bu ru 20 shi ji 80 nian dai zhong hou qi ， sui zhe gai ge kai fang de shen ru ， ren men dui yu tong xin de xu qiu ri yi zeng jia ， zai cheng kong dian hua zhu jian zou jin qian jia wan hu de tong shi ， ren men dui yu tong xin de xu qiu ye zai geng jin yi bu ， ban sui zhe she hui zhu yi shi chang jing ji ti xi de jian li ， zhong guo de tong xin shi chang ye zai yun niang zhe yi chang ju bian 。
shen zhou di yi bo da ge da shen fen yu di wei de xiang zheng
1983 nian ， mei guo bei er shi yan shi yan zhi de xian jin yi dong dian hua xi tong (AMPS) zai zhi jia ge tou ru shang yong ， jian cheng le feng wo yi dong tong xin wang 。 zhi hou ， fu wu qu yu zai mei guo zhu jian kuo da 。 qi ta fa da guo jia ye xiang ji kai fa chu feng wo gong yong yi dong tong xin wang 。
zhe ge shi hou ， chu yu gai ge kai fang de zui qian yan de guang dong ， xu duo tou zi guang dong ke shang shou zhong de “ da ge da ” yin wei nei di mei you yi dong tong xin wang luo er chu yu xian zhi zhuang tai 。 er yu zhi pi lin de gang ao di qu mo ni yi dong dian hua wang yi jing qi bu 。 wei le geng hao di shi ying gai ge kai fang de xu yao ， dang shi de guang dong you dian guan li ju jue ding ji shi yin ru mo ni yi dong tong xin wang luo 。 zhe yi qie zhu ding le guang zhou yao bei fu qi da zao shen zhou di yi bo de shi ming 。
zai yi wu zi jin 、 er wu ji shu 、 san wu she bei 、 si que ren cai ， zai yi ge you san jian ce suo gai zao de ban gong shi nei ， zao qi de jian she zhe men kai shi le jian xin de yan jiu gong zuo 。 liu yun hui qian xi ， guang dong sheng zhu jiang san jiao zhou yi dong dian hua wang shou qi gong cheng kai tong 。 tong shi ， guang zhou ye kai tong le wo guo di yi ge yi dong dian hua ju ， hao ma chang du wei 6 wei ， shou pi yong hu wei 700 ge ， shi xian le wo guo yi dong dian hua yong hu “ ling ” de tu po ， zhe ye biao zhi zhe wo guo kai shi jin ru da rong liang feng wo shi gong yong yi dong tong xin jie duan 。
zhe ge shi qi ， zai jing ji fa zhan yuan yuan luo hou yu fa da guo jia de da bei jing xia ， wo men dui yi dong tong xin chan ye de shi chang xu qiu huan wei bei huan xing ， dui ji shu de zhang wo 、 li jie 、 ying yong yu fa da guo jia xiang bi cun zai zhe ju da de cha ju 。 cong yi dong tong xin de she bei 、 ji shu dao yi dong tong xin de yun ying fang shi ， dou shi cong xi fang yin jin de 。 wo guo yong wei kai ken de guang kuo shi chang ， huan lai le xi fang xian jin de yi dong tong xin ji shu ， bing bu duan ji qu ying yang 。
GSM shou ji ge ming fei ru xun chang bai xing jia
da ge da dai lai le dui yi dong tong xin xu qiu de ci ji ， dan you yu rong liang xiao wu fa xing cheng gui mo xiao yi ， xi tong he zhong duan de cheng ben gao ， shi yong shou ji de fei yong shi shi fen ang gui de 。 na shi hou mai yi bu “ da ge da ” yao yi liang wan kuai qian ， suo yi huan zhi shi yi xiao bu fen ren de zhuan li 。 mo ni feng wo yi dong tong xin xi tong zai zhong guo du guo le yi duan shi jian fa zhan zhi hou ， qi ju xian he que dian ye zhu jian bao lu ， bi ru bao mi xiao guo bu hao ， chuan xian xian xiang shi you fa sheng ， ji xu yi zhong xin de yi dong tong xin ji shu lai qu dai 。
yuan you dian bu zai ci min rui di gen zong shu zi yi dong tong xin ji shu fa zhan ， duo ci zu tuan dao ou zhou kao cha GSM ji shu de fa zhan zhuang kuang 。 zai 1994 nian de quan guo you dian guan li ju chang hui yi shang ， yuan you dian bu zui zhong que ding he xuan bu le zhong guo jiang yin jin GSM ji shu biao zhun ，1994 nian 10 yue ， wo guo di yi ge sheng ji shu zi yi dong tong xin wang zai guang dong sheng kai tong ， rong liang wei 5 wan men 。 zheng shi zhe xiang ji shu cheng jiu le zhong guo yi dong tong xin da guo de di wei 。
liang hao de shi ji 、 zheng que de ji shu xuan ze yi ji ju da de qian zai shi chang ， rang ci hou ji nian de zhong guo yi dong tong xin chan ye yi ling ren chi jing de su du fa zhan ， yong hu shu lian nian fan fan ， wang luo kuo rong su du kuai de jing ren ， shou ji jia ge he tong xin zi fei ye cheng xian bu duan xia jiang de qu shi ， guo qu bei shi wei she chi pin de shou ji zhu jian zou ru le xun chang bai xing jia 。
1997 nian ， wo guo shou ji yong hu xun su pan sheng dao 1000 wan hu ，2001 nian zhe ge shu zi wei 1 yi hu ， zhe ge fei yue zhi yong le bu dao 4 nian de shi jian 。 ci hou ，2002 nian 11 yue ， yi dong dian hua yong hu zong shu da dao 2 yi ；2004 nian 5 yue ，3 yi ；2006 nian 2 yue ，4 yi ；2008 nian 7 yue yi jing gao ju 6 yi ！ wo guo yi dong tong xin de fa zhan su du chuang zao le shi jie tong xin shi shang de qi ji ， cheng wei quan qiu yi dong dian hua yong hu zui duo de guo jia 。
zai zhe yi shi qi ， sui ran ye shi yi ji shu yin jin wei zhu ， dan shi tong guo xi shou he xue xi ， wo guo yi dong yun ying shang jing guo bu duan nu li he tan suo ， zhong guo yi dong tong xin ye ye qu de le bu shao zi zhu chuang xin 。 li ru wang guan 、 zhi neng wang 、 bian ji wang deng deng 。 zhong guo yi dong ti chu le fen bu shi xiang ji zhong shi fa zhan de liang ji wang guan jian she fang an ， you xiao jie jue le dui bu tong chang shang she bei zhi jian de guan li ， jiang di le wei hu cheng ben ， ti gao le lao dong sheng chan lv 。 zhong guo lian tong ye ti chu le ji zhong tong yi guan li 。 zai yi dong zhi neng wang jian she fang mian ， wo guo ye zou zai le shi jie qian lie 。1999 nian 8 yue ， zai yuan you dian bu yi dong tong xin zong ju yu hua wei de gong tong nu li xia ， wo guo di yi ge ye shi shi jie di yi ge yi dong zhi neng wang tou ru yun xing 。 sui hou ， zhong guo yi dong de GSM zhi neng wang you quan wang sheng ji dao CAMEL2， zhe shi shi jie zui zao cai yong zhe yi yi dong zhi neng wang guo ji gui fan de shang yong xi tong ， wang luo ji shu ju shi jie ling xian shui ping 。GSM yi dong zhi neng wang de jian she ， man zu le zhong di duan yu fu fei yong hu de xu yao ， cu jin le ge zhong zhi neng ye wu de kai zhan ， dui ti gao yi dong tong xin pu ji lv he zeng jia ye wu shou ru fa hui le chong yao zuo yong 。 zai bian ji wang fang mian ， gen ju wo guo shan qu duo 、 di yu guang kuo 、 pian yuan nong cun jiao duo de te dian ， wo guo de yi dong yun ying shang yin ru le da gong lv 、 di cheng ben ji zhan ， man zu le bian ji wang kuo chong de xu qiu ， da da ti gao le wang luo de fu gai neng li 。
ji shu de jin bu dai dong le yi dong tong xin ye wu de chuang xin 、 feng fu 。 ru hou lai bei cheng wei “ mu zhi ge ming ” duan xin ye wu ， jiu shi zai 1997 nian you zhong guo yi dong bei jing gong si lv xian kai tong de ， dao 2000 nian ， duan xin ye wu de ji shu tiao jian xiang dui qu yu cheng shu ， wang luo zhi chi ye ke yi ru ying sui xing ， zhe jiu ying lai le duan xin shi chang ji he ji shu de zeng chang tai shi 。 zai yi dong tong xin ji shu de zhi cheng zhi xia ， zhong guo yi dong tong xin kai shi le cong ji chu de yi dong tong hua ye wu xiang shu ju zeng zhi ye wu guo du de fa zhan xu mu 。 zai zhong guo yi dong da zao chu de “ quan qiu tong ”、“ dong gan di dai ”、“ shen zhou xing ” deng ye wu pin pai shen shang jiu ke jian yi ban ， duan xin 、 cai xin 、WAP、 bai bao xiang 、 shou ji qian bao ， dao ao yun qi jian de ao yun shou ji bao 、 shou ji dian shi deng yi dong ye wu de bu duan kai fa ， ji da di feng fu he bian li le ren men de sheng huo ， bing zai xu duo ceng mian shang ， gai bian le ren men de sheng huo fang shi 。 shu ju shi qi wan zhuan yi dong hu lian wang
hu lian wang de chu xian he fei su fa zhan dui quan qiu xin xi ye 、 tong xin ye chan sheng ju da de ying xiang ， yi dong tong xin he hu lian wang zheng zai zou xiang rong he 。 wei shun ying zhe yi qu shi ， zhong guo yi dong yu 2000 nian 9 yue quan mian qi dong le GPRS jian she gong zuo ，GPRS yu chuan tong de GSM ji shu xiang bi you gao shu ju chuan shu 、 yong yuan zai xian 、 jin an shu ju liu liang ji fei deng te dian 。2002 nian 5 yue 17 ri ， zhong guo yi dong zai quan guo zheng shi tou ru GPRS xi tong shang yong 。
zhe yi wei zhe ， xian jie duan shi jie fan wei nei zui xian jin 、 ying yong zui cheng shu de yi dong tong xin ji shu ——GPRS zai zhong guo shi xian da gui mo ying yong ， zhong guo zhen zheng mai ru 2.5G shi dai 。 tong shi ， zhong guo lian tong ye ji ji qi dong CDMA1X wang luo de jian she gong zuo ， bing yu 2003 nian 3 yue zheng shi kai tong ， zhong guo de CDMA wang luo ye jin ru 2.5G shi dai 。

Quy tu hau het nhung ten tuoi co tieng trong nganh san xuat dien thoai di dong nhu Nokia, Samsung, Motorola, LG Mobile, BenQ-Siemen, Welcome cung nhung mat hang cao cap nhat tren thi truong nhu Vertu, Mobiado, O2, Hanoi Mobile Plaza thu 2 tai Ha Noi duoc dau tu voi quy mo lon nhat Viet Nam tren khuon vien co dien tich len toi 1000m2.
Chuoi sieu thi Hanoi Mobile Plaza voi hai sieu thi lon, mot o 308 Ba Trieu va mot tai so 2 Ly Thuong Kiet, la mot trong so it nhung sieu thi tren ca nuoc chuyen kinh doanh dien thoai di dong chinh hang voi chat luong va gia ca hop ly, xuat xu bao dam cung cac dich vu gia tang, tu van su dung mien phi va cac loai linh, phu kien dien thoai di dong phong phu. Mot tien ich khac trong chuoi dich vu hoan hao va khep kin cua sieu thi la khach hang con co the su dung nhung dich vu truc tuyen thong qua trang web rieng cua sieu thi www.hnmobile.com.vn hoac co the den sieu thi de download truc tiep nhac chuong, hinh anh va cac phan mem cho tat ca cac loai dien thoai di dong. Ong Le Tung, Giam doc dieu hanh Hanoi Mobile Plaza cho biet: Thi truong dien thoai di dong luon soi dong va cung rat kho kiem soat ve chat luong. Voi dai sieu thi thu hai tai So 2 Ly Thuong Kiet, chung toi hi vong se mang toi cho khach hang nhieu lua chon hon ve thuong hieu, mau ma va gia ca cua cac loai dien thoai chinh hang, dong thoi tao dieu kien cho khach hang co the tiep can thuong xuyen hon voi nhung san pham dien thoai moi nhat cua cac hang cung nhu cong nghe moi xuat hien tren the gioi.
Cung trong buoi sang khai truong, Hanoi Mobile Plaza da to chuc ban dau gia chiec dien thoai Nokia 8800 Sirocco nam kim cuong. Nguoi gianh duoc quyen so huu chiec dien thoai doc dao nay la anh Nguyen Van Chinh (Quang Ninh) voi muc tra gia la 29,2 trieu dong. Toan bo so tien nay se duoc chuyen cho Quy Vi nguoi ngheo Trung uong. Cung nhan dip khai truong dong thoi chao don nam moi 2007, dai sieu thi cung se to chuc mot chuong trinh ban hang khuyen mai lon voi tong gia tri len toi hon 12 ty dong. Tu 26/12/2006 den 26/2/2007, moi khach hang mua bat ky 01 dien thoai di dong chinh hang deu nhan duoc 02 phan qua la 01 the ATM cua ngan hang Habubank va 01 suat hoc bong tri gia 500.000VND cua tap doan giao duc lon nhat the gioi EF (English First). Dac biet hon, khi den mua hang tai Hanoi Mobile Plaza, khach hang con co co hoi tham gia chuong trinh boc tham trung thuong voi 02 giai dac biet la 02 xe Piaggio Zip 100 va hang chuc giai thuong co gia tri khac. Trong tuan le khai truong tu ngay 2  7/1/2007, moi khach hang den tham quan va mua hang deu co the tham gia nhieu tro choi hap dan voi nhieu phan qua xinh xan va thuong thuc chuong trinh ca nhac dac biet voi su gop mat cua cac ca sy noi tieng va cac nhom nhay tre trung, soi dong.

Cam canh lang rau ngay can Tet - Dien Dan
Cam canh lang rau ngay can Tet
Cam canh lang rau ngay can Tet Tags: Bang A, Duy Tuan, Tet Canh Dan, Ha Noi, Hoang Liet, Hoang Mai, nguoi nong dan, co thu nhap, su sung suong, khu do thi, nhung nguoi, nguoi dan, khong co, gia dinh, chung toi, ngay
Tro lai cum dan cu Bang A (phuong Hoang Liet, Hoang Mai, Ha Noi) trong cai ret te tai cua nhung ngay can Tet Canh Dan moi thay het noi phien muon cua nguoi dan noi day. Chi sau mot thang, khong khi trong lang da thay doi han. Truoc do, nhung nguoi nong dan cham chi luon ban mat tren nhung ruong rau nay thi ho rat nhan. Tuy vay, nhan nhung khong dong nghia voi su sung suong. Ho dang that nghiep. Ngay bi cuong che ho khong dam ra vi “so”, chi biet ngoi o nha nghi toi nhung ngay toi se song bang gi, lay tien dau cho con hoc, nhat la khi Tet Canh Dan sap den. Co nguoi dung cam ra dong thi chi biet gat di nhung giot nuoc mat khi nhin thay canh nhung ruong rau can xanh tot qua dau goi bi may moc cao di.
Nhung giot nuoc mat, nguoi dan o day da kim nen bao lau, nay thay co nguoi ve hoi tham, duong nhu ho trut het nhung chac khong the het noi niem vi giong nguoi nao cung nghen lai.
Mat het ruong, chi biet… di choi! Ngay den lang Bang A cach day do 1 thang, an tuong dau tien la nhung canh dong rau xanh ngat dap vao mat. Theo nhung nguoi dan noi day cho biet thi ngay truoc nguoi dan o day co trong rau nhung khong nhieu. Truoc nam 1997 thi moi nam ho trong 2 vu lua, 1 vu mau. Nhung tu khi khu do thi moc len ben canh, chuot pha hoai mua mang nhieu qua nen nguoi dan da chuyen sang chuyen trong rau. Va su chuyen doi do da mang lai hieu qua cao, nhieu gia dinh lam duoc ca nha nho trong rau.
Chi sau 1 thang, moi thu o Bang A da thay doi han. Nhung ruong rau xanh ngat "trang diem" canh khu do thi nay da bien mat. Hinh anh nhung nguoi nong dan nay bien mat, thay vao do la hinh anh cua may moc dang ngay ngay hoat dong. Anh: Duy Tuan
The ma, chi sau mot thang tro lai day, canh tuong da thay doi han. Ruong dong da bi rao kin khi luc luong chuc nang tien hanh cuong che de phuc vu cho du an Khu do thi moi Tay Nam ho Linh Dam. Tren nhung dong ruong (hon 44 hec ta) khong con hinh anh nhung nguoi nong dan nua ma thay vao do la nhung may xuc, may dao, xe tai dang ngay ngay hoat dong. Nhung dong rau nay chi con lai trong ky uc cua moi nguoi dan noi day.
Thay nhieu nguoi cu di lai tren cac con duong lang, lan la hoi chuyen thi mot cu ong cho biet: "Ruong dong bay gio cua HUD roi, lam gi co nua ma ra dong. Ngay truoc lam gi co viec nhan roi nhu the nay. Lam lua con co ngay nong nhan chu lam rau thi thang 30 ngay deu ra ruong. Nhung nguoi nong dan nay khong co ruong cung dong nghia voi viec that nghiep. Lam gi ma khong di choi ha chu?".
Nghe xong cau tra loi cua cu, toi cam thay khong la nua. Ho thuc su dang that nghiep! Boi truoc do, toi da tung nghi den tinh canh nay khi nghe chi Luu Thi Son, nguyen dai bieu HDND phuong Hoang Liet canh bao “Lay dat cua chung toi ma chi ap gia 252000/m2 dat, thu hoi hang nghin lao dong cua thon Bang A chung toi di ve dau? Chac phai ra dung duong thoi. Lam gi de an, lam gi de sinh song? Cong an viec lam thi khong hua hen”.
Hinh anh ngay cuong che (5/1). Nhung buoc chan hoi ha cua so it nguoi nong dan tranh thu thu hoach it rau ve ban khong the theo kip su hoat dong nhu vu bao cua may moc hien dai. Anh: Duy Tuan
Nay thi ho rat roi viec. Roi nhung khong dong nghia voi cuoc song sung suong len, ho di khap lang, ke cho nhau nghe nhung kho khan cua gia dinh minh. Tuy vay, den dau thi ho cung gap hoan canh nhu nha minh. Boi day la canh tinh chung cua hon 1500 nhan khau cua gan 250 ho bi cuong che vi khong giao dat chu khong rieng gia dinh ai.
“Con bam vao dau duoc nua, con ruong thi con co thu nhap chu mat ruong thi con gi. Ca lang cu di choi thoi”, cu Luu Bich Thuat nam nay da 79 tuoi cuoi trong nuoc mat noi.
Nhung nguoi nhu cu Thuat o lang Bang A rat nhieu. Du da gia nhung ngay ngay cu deu ra ruong nho co, tuoi rau cung con chau. Rau rat tot, cu cat lua nay lua khac lai len nen gia dinh cu ngay nao cung co thu nhap tren 500 nghin dong, phuc vu cho cuoc song cua 7 nguoi.
Nay that nghiep, cu Thuat va hang tram lao dong o ngoi lang nay khong biet lam gi de kiem ke sinh nhai. Dung duong kiem viec cung khong duoc vi tuoi cao, khong the lam thue. Con nhung nguoi khac, du co khoe manh nhung khong biet viec hay duoc hoc hanh gi ngoai cong viec dong ang nen ho cung khong the tu minh kiem viec.
Khong con mot… cong rau an
Dang di mot vong den nhung gia dinh ngay truoc chuyen trong rau “co tieng” trong lang thi toi gap lai chi Luu Thi Son, tay cam mot mo rau. Truoc day, tren ruong dong lang Bang A khong thieu thu rau gi, ban than gia dinh chi Son cung trong nhieu loai rau nhung nay chi phai di cho de mua mo rau ram ve an. Gap lai toi, chi lien noi: "Em thay day, dan chung toi ca doi lam gi co ai di mua rau, gio muoi nha mua ca muoi ma tien khong co thi cung khong the mua duoc. Bay gio that nghiep het ca roi, cha con gi ma trong mong vao nua".
Chi Son cho biet, hang loat gia dinh trong lang dang dieu dung ke tu sau ngay cac ruong rau bi cuong che.
Nhung canh dong rau can tot bang bo bi may xuc ui di ngay cuong che. (Anh chup ngay 5/1). Anh: Duy Tuan
Di mot vong qua nha chi Ngo Thi Trang, nguoi chuyen trong rau diep ca va ngai cuu. Moi ngay chi va con dau cat rau di nhap cho cac cho dau moi cung duoc 1 trieu dong ngay dat hang, con re hon thi cung duoc 6-7 tram nghin. “Tu lam nha cho den nuoi con an hoc, trang trai cuoc song deu trong cho vao dong tien ban rau hang ngay”, chi ke.
May man hon nhieu gia dinh trong lang, ho anh Nguyen Phu Binh du cung dang lao dao khi mat het ruong canh tac nhung van con dong luong moi thang duoc hon 1 trieu cua anh. The nhung voi chung do tien, anh cung khong the du trang trai cuoc song.
Dau xot nhat co the ke den ho cua chi Nguyen Thi Thinh, 43 tuoi. Hai vo chong da tao bao thue them ruong lam toi mot mau rau (khoang 3600 m2), lam khong het viec ho bo ra ngay 200 nghin de thue nguoi lam. Moi ngay chi thu hoach duoc khoang 500 mo rau can, ban voi gia re la 4000 dong 1 mo chi cung da thu ve 2 trieu dong. Hom nao khong duoc gia chi cung thu duoc 7-8 tram.
Hinh anh nhung nguoi nong dan Bang A. Ben trai la chi Thoan, mot nguoi trong rau nuoi song ca gia dinh. Truoc ngay cuong che, chi chi kip cat duoc 200 mo rau diep ca. So do ban ra cho cung duoc 400 nghin dong. Ben phai la hinh anh nhung nguoi nong dan Bang A hien nay, ho dau xot vi nhung canh dong rau bien mat, ho lo lang hon cho cuoc song ma ho dang trai qua, khong co thu nhap, that nghiep. Den mo rau ram ho cung phai bo tien ra mua. Ma cung phai co tien thi moi mua duoc. Viec lam khong co, ho khong co tien. Anh: Duy Tuan
Dui tay vao con mat do hoe vi khoc, chi Thinh ke: “Hai vo chong tan tao som hom, ngay nao cung thu hoach. Vay muon them toi lam duoc cai nha ngot 1 ty, nuoi 3 chau an hoc cung nhin vao rau het. Cu nghi la cu thuan buom xuoi gio the nay thi se lam ma tra no thoi.
Ai ngo, tu khi bi cuong che bong dung bon toi trang tay. Hom ay toi than tho het ca nguoi. Truoc lam mot mau ruong rau gio den mot cong rau an cung khong co. Cac chau cung buon rau lam, toi noi cac con oi, gio bo me trang tay roi, chang con gi nua, cu tinh trang nay keo dai thi bo me khong the co tien dong cho cac con an hoc”.
Nghe tin co phong vien ve hoi tham, hang loat nguoi dan trong lang da tim den de gap va trinh bay cho duoc noi buc xuc, hoan canh kho khan “chua tung co” ma ho dang gap phai. Ho cho biet, nhung luc kho khan nhat khi lu lut ho con duoc chinh quyen cac cap ho tro von va giong de on dinh cuoc song, tiep tuc san xuat. The ma nay ho dang lam vao tinh canh “chang biet nhin vao dau”.
Trong noi am uc nhu da nghen tu lau, chi Ngo Thi Huong lai meu mao noi: “Nuoi hai dua con an hoc, gia dinh ton bao nhieu cong suc cham sao rau can, nay da tot den dau goi. Tu hom bi den gio khong trong nom vao dau duoc. Bay gio nha em thuc su doi. Ba con trong lang cu nghi rang ho chi cho rao lai con rau thi cho thu hoach, den khi den bu roi thi moi lay dat. The ma khong ngo… Dau xot qua!”.
… Noi gi den Tet
Thong thuong moi nam, cu vao nhung ngay can Tet Nguyen dan the nay la thoi diem vao mua thu nhap lon cua dan lang Bang A. Moi nha deu tranh thu thoi gian cham bon va thu hoach rau di ban. Do vi tri thuan loi cho viec buon ban, lai gan trung tam Ha Noi nen nguoi dan khong mat nhieu thoi gian de dua rau di nhap. Nhung khoan thu nhap luc nay ho co the sam sua cho gia dinh mot cai Tet dam am.
The ma bay gio ho lang nguoi di khi toi hoi den Tet!
Co nguoi hoi tham ve hoan canh hien tai, nhung nguoi nong dan bi mat ruong do khong dong thuan voi du an nhu duoc trut het tam tu. Ho da khoc. Nhung giot nuoc mat cua nong dan Bang A cang lam cho khong khi buoi tro chuyen tro nen tram lang va buon ba hon trong nhung ngay can Tet. Ho lo vi so khong mua duoc manh ao moi cho con, lo vi cai an, cuoc song ngay mai se ra sao va nhat la viec hoc hanh cua con cai ho. Anh: Duy Tuan
Chi Nguyen Thi Vinh, mot ho dan Bang A bay to: “Bay gio khong co thu nhap, con cai xin tien nop hoc cung khong co ma cho chu chua noi lam cai gi. Hoan canh dan chung toi, gan 2000 nhan khau trong cho vao rau gio khong con gi nua. Tu gio den Tet khong biet song bang cai gi, khong biet co tien mua do ma goi banh chung cho con an khong. Cuoc song cua lang Bang A tu khi cuong che den gio qua kho, ba con ai cung ngao ngan, khoc meu”.

Nhuc thung dung: “Than duoc” cua dang may rau?
Xem bản tiếng việt đầy đủ tại đây : http://thethao60s.com/index/1099492/25012008.aspxNhuc thung dung: “Than duoc” cua dang may rau?Tu nhieu nam nay, vi thuoc nhuc thung dung duoc mot so nguoi ban thuoc dan gian va khong it "thuong de" ton vinh nhu mot loai "than duoc" cua dang may rau, va con duoc theu det boi mot truyen thuyet het suc ly ky - lan truyen rong o nhung khu du lich mien nui phia Bac nhu Sa Pa, Ha Giang... va o ca mot so cua hieu ban thuoc tang cuong sinh ly. Tuong truyen: Nhuc thung dung la mot loai "than duoc", co tac dung cuc tot, giup cac quy ong tang suc manh trong chuyen phong the. Do la mot loai nam dac biet, rat quy hiem, vi chi moc len tu nhung cho ma tinh dich cua con ngua bach duc rot xuong, trong khi giao phoi voi ngua cai... Loai thuc vat ky la
Cay nhuc thung dung.
Truyen thuyet noi tren, tuy phan anh mot phan su that, do la tac dung bo ich cua nhuc thung dung, doi voi chuc nang sinh san cua con nguoi, nhung co nhung lam lan ve mat thuc vat. Truoc het, nhuc thung dung khong phai la mot loai nam, ma la mot loai "thao ban" (cay thao, co). Nhuc thung dung khong phai la mot loai thuc vat thong thuong, ma la loai ky sinh, phai song nho (ky sinh) vao cay khac. Mua xuan den, mam cay nhuc thung dung dam thung mat dat, moc nho len tren, nhin giong nhu mot cai chay voi dau hoi nhon, ben ngoai phu kin lop la vay mau vang, long lanh duoi anh nang mat troi, nhu ngon thap vang, rat hoanh trang. Cay thuong cao khoang tu 15-30cm, co khi toi hang met. Vao cac thang 5, thang 6 cay ra hoa day dac; hoa moc ra tu chop (phan ngon), mau vang nhat, hinh chuong, xe 5 canh, canh hoa mau xanh hoac tim nhat; toi cac thang 6, thang 7 ket qua, nho li ti, mau xam. Nho co lop la vay phu kin toan bo be mat ben ngoai, nen tranh bi mat nuoc va co the chiu dung duoc dieu kien khi hau khac nghiet o vung hoang mac, va duoc menh danh la "cay dung si tren hoang mac". Nhu vay, nhuc thung dung khong sinh ra tu nhung giot tinh cua ngua bach, nhung van la mot loai thuc vat het suc dac biet. Duoc lieu tu nhuc thung dung
Tren thuc te, duoc lieu - vi thuoc nhuc thung dung duoc khai thac tu 3 loai cay cung ho nhuc thung dung (Orobranchaceae): Thong dung nhat la cay nhuc thung dung - co ten khoa hoc Cistanche salsa (C. A. Mey.) G. Bek; Thu den la cay thung dung - co ten khoa hoc la Cistanche deserticola Y. G. Ma. Thu ba la cay me nhuc thung dung - co ten khoa hoc Cistanche ambigua G. Beck (Bge).
Vi thuoc nhuc thung dung, hien tai o nuoc ta con hoan toan phai nhap khau. Tai nhung noi co cay moc, nguoi ta thu hoach vao hai mua xuan va thu. Loai thu hoach vao mua xuan, goi la diem thung dung (thung dung ngot) hay dam thung dung (thung dung nhat). Duoc lieu co hinh gan tru tron, hoi det, mot dau hoi nho, hoi cong, dai khoang 10-30cm, duong kinh 3-6mm, cay chua phan nhanh. Be mat mau xam hoac mau nau, phu kin lop la vay day dac, nung nuc nhu thit, xep theo hinh mai ngoi, chat thuoc chac, hoi dai, kho be gay, co chut chat dau. Mat cat mau nau nhat, co nhung dom trang hoac khe nut, nem thay vi hoi ngot. Diem thung dung la loai duoc lieu chat luong cao, vi co chua nhieu loai hoat chat. Bo ich voi ca nam va nu
Nhuc thung dung la vi thuoc da duoc su dung trong Dong y tu 2000 nam truoc va da duoc dua vao trong sach Than Nong ban thao kinh, bo sach thuoc co nhat cua Dong y hoc. Vi thuoc con co nhung ten khac, nhu nhuc tung dung, thung dung, dia tinh (nghia la tinh chat cua dat), kim duan (la cay mang vang), dai van, hac tu lenh (vi co tac dung bo than manh).
Theo Dong y, nhuc thung dung co vi ngot, man, tinh am; vao 2 kinh than, dai trang; Co tac dung bo than, ich tinh, nhuan tao, hoat trang. Chu tri nam gioi liet duong (duong nuy), nu gioi khong co thai, doi ha (nhieu khi hu), bang lau, lung goi lanh dau, co bap khong co suc, huyet kho tien bi (tao bon do huyet kho). Cac ket qua nghien cuu hien dai cho thay, ham luong hoat chat sinh hoc trong nhuc thung dung rat phong phu. Theo Hien dai duong sinh bao kien trung duoc tu dien, nhuc thung dung co chua cac chat nhu boschnaloside, orobanin, 8- epilogahic acid, betaine,... Con chua nhieu loai acid huu co va tren 10 acid amin. Theo cac nghien cuu duoc ly, nhuc thung dung la loai thuoc co tac dung kiem che qua trinh lao suy va keo dai tuoi tho, tang the luc, tang cuong kha nang mien dich, co tac dung ha huyet ap o muc do nhat dinh va co tac dung nhu mot loai hormon sinh duc, co kha nang kich thich va dieu tiet hoat dong cua tuyen thuong than, khac phuc tinh trang chuc nang tuyen thuong than bi suy giam va dan toi cac benh lien quan. Nhu vay co the thay, nhuc thung dung la vi thuoc bo, voi nhieu tac dung quy, va co ich doi voi ca nam gioi va nu gioi.
Mot so phuong thuoc co su dung vi nhuc thung dung:
- Chua duong nuy (liet duong, roi loan cuong): (1). Nhuc thung dung 30g, dam duong hoac 50g, ruou trang nua lit. Ngam it nhat 1 tuan, hang ngay lac binh. Moi ngay uong 3 lan, moi lan 15-20ml.
(2). Nhuc thung dung 25g, gao te 50 -100g; them nuoc, cho vao noi gom, nau to lua cho soi, sau nau nho lua cho den khi chao chin nhu, them muoi, mi chinh, chia ra an 2 lan, sang som va buoi toi. Nguoi am hu hoac bi dai tien do thuc nhiet kieng dung.
- Chua di tinh: Nhuc thung dung (thai nho) 30g, tho ty tu 10g, xuong song de 500g, gao te 50-100g, nau chao an trong ngay.
- Chua tao tiet (xuat tinh som): Nhuc thung dung 100g, toa duong 100g, long cot 50g, tang phieu tieu 50g, phuc linh 25g, ruou trang 3 lit. Ngam it nhat 15 ngay, thinh thoang lac binh. Moi ngay uong 2 lan, moi lan 20-30ml.
- Chua vo sinh o nam gioi: Nhuc thung dung (thai nho) 30g, nhan sam (thai nho) 15g, thuc dia hoang 15g, hai ma 10g, loc nhung (thai nho) 10g, ruou trang 1 lit. Ngam it nhat 1 thang; sau do moi ngay uong 2 lan, moi lan 15-20ml; khi bi cam phat sot kieng dung.
- Chua nu gioi vo sinh, tinh duc lanh nhat: + Nhuc thung dung 50g, ich mau thao 30g, duong quy 30g, xuyen khung 30g, xich thuoc 25g, tien linh ty 50g, ruou trang 2 lit. Ngam it nhat trong 1 thang. Moi lan dung 15-20ml, hoa voi mat ong; ngay uong 2 lan. + Nhuc thung dung 25g, tho ty tu 15g, son duoc 30g, thit de nac 500g, gao te 50 - 100g, mam muoi gia vi luong thich hop. Thit de thai nho, cac vi thuoc cho vao tui vai buoc kin, cung voi gao nau chao. Them gia vi, chia ra an trong ngay. - Chua suy nhuoc than kinh: Nhuc thung dung 10g, son thu du 5g, thach xuong bo 4g, phuc linh 6g, tho ty tu 8g, nuoc 600ml, sac con 200ml. Chia 3 lan uong trong ngay. Ham nong thuoc khi uong.
- Chua tieu tien nhieu lan: Nhuc thung dung 500g, thuc dia 200g, son duoc 200g, tho ty tu 200g, ngu vi tu 50g. Tat ca say kho, tan thanh bot min, tron voi mat lam vien to co hat do. Ngay uong 2 lan, sang va chieu, moi lan 5g, chieu thuoc bang nuoc muoi loang.
- Chua dai tien tao bon: Nhuc thung dung 15g, thao quyet minh (hat muong ngu) 10g, mat ong luong thich hop. Nhuc thung dung, thao quyet minh tan tho; sac nuoc hoac ham nuoc soi, che them mat ong, uong thay nuoc trong ngay. - Chua toc bac som: Nhuc thung dung 50g, ky tu 100g, cam cuc hoa 50g, thuc dia hoang 50g, than khuc 50g, nhuc que 30g, ruou trang 2.500ml. Cac vi thuoc gia nho, boc vao tui vai, ngam trong ruou trang, it nhat mot thang, chat lay ruou su dung. Ngay uong 3 lan, moi lan 10ml. Luong y Hu Dan

Bai 1: Chu tich VFF dang lam roi bong da
Bai 2: Hong chan vi sep “Tong”
Ong Vien tung bi dot ghe nhu the nao?
Cuoi nhiem ky III, dung vao luc chuan bi bau ban chap hanh moi, ong tong thu ky (TTK) Pham Ngoc Vien bi cap pho cua minh to an hoi lo va doi trung bang ghi am. Chuyen cua hai thanh vien trong ngoi nha VFF cach nhau mot buc tuong cuoi cung bi phanh phui la ke to cao da dung vo ban bang thu doan nhung doan cat ghep tung doan bang lam sai su that de ha uy tin ong Vien. Day la ly do ong TTK Vien sau do van tai dac cu, con ong pho thi bi tay chay.
Nhiem ky IV dang em a thi sau vu boi thuong Letard, ong Vien bi quay “danh”. Ong Vien hoi day bi mot suc ep ngoai VFF nhung o tren doi xuong rat manh, trong do co co “cap tren” cua ong Vien lai cung la dong nghiep cua ong ngay nao buoc tu chuc.
Day la ly do vi sao khi AFF va AFC hay tin ong Vien tu chuc, cac to chuc bong da
nay lien tuc hoi vi sao va co bi suc ep gi ve mat nha nuoc khong. Tat nhien ong Vien phai tra loi khong boi chi can ong noi co la bong da Viet Nam bi “cam van” ngay het nhu FIFA tung trung phat nhieu quoc gia lay “quyen luc” ngoai bong da gay suc ep len LDBD.
Cai ghe cua ong Vien bi dot, rat nhieu nguoi ham he nhay vao va lap tuc co mot cuoc “dau ghe” va ca... “mua ghe”.
Va cuoc “dau” sau nay dai gia dinh VFF da “chap nhan” lam lo di nhieu tieu chi de co mot cuoc dang quang tre nhat trong lich su nhung cung co nhieu dau hoi nhat trong lich su ve “ly lich” mot ong tong.
Ghe Pho Chu tich chuyen mon sau khi bi dot la vo hieu hoa
Trong khi ong tong moi tuoi cuoi khi cau thu than met nhung hop mo xe thi vang mat.
Nhiem ky V, chuc danh Pho Chu tich chuyen mon thuoc ve ong Le The Tho. Ong Tho tung lam tro ly bo truong chu nhiem Uy ban TDTT nen khi ngoi vao day bi nghi ngo la nguoi cua bo truong cai vao. Trong khi do thi ong Tho lai cao ngao: “Toi khong ngoi vao ghe chuyen mon thi ai ngoi vao day duoc”.
Cuoi cung thi ong Tho “chet” boi y minh la nguoi co chuyen mon trong khi hau het cac quan chuc VFF deu khong co chuyen mon lai khong phai la nguoi cua bong da.
Khi ong Tho ngoi vao ghe truong doan bong da, ong Riedl rat ngai boi ong Tho san sang ly luan bang co so khoa hoc va bang chuyen mon cua mot giang vien bong da co bang cap FIFA. Ong Tho san sang “dau” neu nhin ra su bat hop ly trong giao an hoac nhung van de chuyen mon voi tu cach cua mot pho chu tich chuyen mon va mot truong doan bong da.
Sau SEA Games 23, ong Tho bi quy trach nhiem trong vu cac cau thu ban do va chan nan tu chuc, the khong bao gio quay lai bong da nua.
Mot nam sau cai ghe trong ong Tho de lai da co mot cuoc bau ban va lai dau. Ong Ngo Tu Ha - tro ly bo truong xin quay lai nhung bi ban chap hanh danh bat ra va the la ong Duong Vu Lam bat chien tu nhien thanh.
Ong Lam ngoi vao cai ghe day nhung lai khong co quyen hanh nhu ong Tho ngay nao vi bi bop het vao viec phan cong chuyen trach, chuyen quyen. Dung vao chuyen mon ong Lam bi ong Tuan (TTK) lan, sang den mang thi dau thi ong pho tong om het. Ong Lam o SEA Games 24 mang tieng di theo doi nhung thuc chat ong chang co cai quyen gi ngoai tru viec hoi han cau thu.
Va khong kho de moi nguoi nhin ra rang sau cuoc dot ghe, dau ghe la nhung cuoc chuyen trach, chuyen quyen tren chiec ghe de vo hieu hoa rat nhieu nguoi va nhieu bo phan.
Mo xe khong co truong doan va TTK
Cuoc mo xe cua VFF sau that bai cua bong da Viet Nam da khong co ong TTK Tran Quoc Tuan va ong pho TTK Duong Nghiep Khoi du hai nhan vat nay chiu trach nhiem rat lon ve nhieu van de lien quan den doi tuyen. Ong Khoi nam toan bo mang thi dau va lich thi dau bi xem la qua day khien cau thu qua tai va khong co thoi gian hoi phuc, trong khi ong Tuan la nguoi gan gui ong Riedl cung cac cau thu nhat. Ong Tuan cung la nguoi khang dinh SEA Games 24, doi U-23 Viet Nam duoc chuan bi tot nhat va tinh than cao nhat de doat cup vang.

Lam gi voi gai lau xanh tu nguyen o Chiang Mai - Do day
Tags: Chiang Mai, dan toc thieu so, gai mai dam, o thanh pho, Tieng Thai Lan, phu nu, lau xanh, tu nguyen, bi bat, lam gi, tuy nhien, nguoi, cuu, Shan,
Mot gai mai dam tuoi thieu nien o Chiang mai.
Coi ho la toi pham va truc xuat ve ban quan; doi xu voi ho nhu la nhung nan nhan cua te buon nguoi hay lao dong tu nguyen cua cong nghiep tinh duc dang la nhung van de tranh cai giua co quan chinh phu voi cac nhom hoat dong vi nu quyen.
Cac to chuc vi nguoi nhap cu o thanh pho gan bien gioi voi Myanmar nay cho rang bo rap nhu vay gay kho khan cho nhung phu nu nuoc lang gieng tu chon con duong lam gai mai dam, boi sau khi duoc dua khoi lau xanh, cuoc song cua ho tham chi con te hon nua.
Ho cho rang luc luong dac biet cua chinh phu chuyen chong nan buon nguoi da vi pham quyen cua phu nu, va doi xu voi tat ca nhung nguoi ban hoa nhu la nan nhan. "Ho (gai mai dam) khong cam thay minh duoc cuu thoat, boi ho bi mat nguon song", Hseng Noung, thanh vien to chuc hanh dong vi phu nu thieu so Shan (SWAN) noi. "Bi bat buoc lam viec la mot chuyen, nhung nhung phu nu nay phai chon con duong do vi hoan canh xo day".
Mot nghien cuu moi day do My tien hanh chi ra rang co khoang 8-900 nghin nguoi bi buon ban qua cac bien gioi moi nam. Bao cao cua Quy Nhi dong LHQ cho hay mot phan ba so nan nhan cua te buon phu nu va tre em la nguoi Dong Nam A.
Phong ngu cua mot gai lau xanh 15 tuoi nguoi Hoa o Chiang Mai.
Tai Thai Lan, viec doi xu voi phu nu nhap cu bi bat trong nhung cuoc bo rap nha chua da duoc cai thien trong nhung nam gan day. Gai mai dam den tu Myanmar, Lao, Campuchia, nam Trung Quoc... khong con bi coi nhu toi pham va dan giai ve nuoc theo duong chinh thuc nua. by khoadang561 on Mon Jul 06, 2015 2:19 pm
Nhung vong eo banh mi nhe nan ni sau dam hoan rat giau dang lay lai ve xinh xeo cang co, giam mo bung sau sinh san chac, non na nho va nhung phuong phap dieu tri thich hop.
buoi hoang thai, chiec long ki ngu nguoi dan ba den tron cang len nhu don qua thong phong tot chua chap dung va bao ve hinh hai thai nhi. toi ta dua con cat tieng khoc chao doi, chiec da bong nhien chap xep xuong nhu mot trai bong bi rut truong cho khi, xue lai nhung tang da xap le thoi, nhung dau ran doc ngang va nhung ngan mo thua nhe nan ni bao noi quanh noi quan chiec khom tron. Nhung “tam ban hat tuong da nguoi” nay loi tua nhu mot huy tiem tang tien danh trang dai nong cua nguoi me ma lai ban tinh lai khien chang mong chi em kho tam, giam mo dencos lo lang.
Tram nga kho khan choc giam mo, cang da long
thuong nhat, co ba be den rong chon loc cach de nhat la viec len ke hoach thang tim kiem sau buoi bang nhom nong cung nhu cham chi van he the chong thang nhanh chong tieu hao hut mo thua. Tren thuc tai, da nhieu kha lam nguoi vach lam dong cac phuong phap giam mo mang lan truyen thong nao, giam mo bung sau sinh tuy rang nhien day la don hanh ta de goi hoi su co gang cao kieng ki trong mot thoi ki lau truong hoc. Hon nua, phuong phap hoc tim va tap tanh the chat nhe den rong cho thang khuyen thuc boi vi nghi hinh huong den viec hoi phuc suc khoe va viec dieu huyet sua cho con bu.
phia ria day, viec dop lung va tap luyen trang thai chat dung cach dau co dang trai quyet van de boc nang, giam mo bung sau sinh xai giam bot mo du nhung lai gan nhu choi nhieu tac dung cung viec tai tao xu da vang sau khi hoa. Tham chay viec giam mo chot ngop cung khien tang vung vang bi chay xe nhe nai ni them, song song nhung dau ran ngang doc sau de cung khong the cai thien duoc.
Phuong an ne dat nhat duoc giam mo, cang da tim?
nham giam le mo doi, ban giau dang su dung phuong phap giam mo mang khong phau thuat bang Cavi-Deluxe. cong nghe ne su dung nang cay nhiet va song am giau tiem so menh 25 KHz, tac ruou con da may co hoc len thanh da tam nham ban vo vac nhung te bao mo dit tru duoi da, giam mo sau sinh thang tinh truong nhung te bao o long sau nhat va vung bi nang nhat cung se de pha huy hoan toan, dan tieu xai bien va chuyen hoa vach dang xit long dang loai bo ra ngoai co the.
Chi trong suot cu 7 ngay, 95% chong xich mo nay se noi loai vut hoan tuyen vao khoi than the, giup nhung vong eo banh san giam tu 8-20cm vach nhung vong eo con kien dong dong gon ghe nhanh chong, dam bao khong trung tang tru mo tro lai.
binh dien khac, sau lat giam mo, vung da long den rong bi ra xe, chung nhao va bien trang thai rat ton tham my. tuy nhien, nhung tac dong hay cay nhiet hang may Cavi-Deluxe trong qua trinh giam mo hay phan nao khoi phuc, tien danh san chac va cai thien tinh trang ria da.
nhung ma xue lay lai hoan tra rat ve xinh ngam my hang vung da tam ca, gon, ban can den don su tro giup toan dien va lau truong hoc hon ca cach xe sung collagen. dong tien danh nghe na, nhung soi collagen am nho giau hoat tinh toan sinh hoc an ranh lot dat bo sung ra duoi da tam se dan ap dieu deu len thanh da ra xe nang bi ran vo phanh tao vach khung luoi sinh vat hoc nang nang, kich thuc san sinh collagen va danh chon bam ngu he thong collagen tot sinh moi. Su binh phuc muc he thong collagen giup nuoi duong, nang do veo truc da, cai thien triet duoc tinh trang tan xe, giam mo sau sinh chung nhao, da mo nhung vet ria, giup mien tam dat nham dao mem deo mai, san han, tay dang uoc mo.

na rui xiang yi yuan de jiao qiao ， zhang she qi le bin fen yi cai de miao di ， zai qing xin niao yuan de xiang cheng zhong xuan yi ， bian zhi chu le wu jin zui ren de you ran 。 er na han yun chu chu ， zhi lian de shen sui ， jiang ta de qing chun sheng ming zhang xian de na me de liao rao 。 zai tian di xia 、 tao sheng li 、 hong chen zhong 、 meng xuan nei ， wei you ta na qing chun de jiao li 、 shen ai de mian gen 、 zhen qing de cheng ken cai shi ni sheng ming de yong heng 。 na xie yu xiang “ yong wan guan jia si ， mai ge tai yang bu xia shan ” de ren ， shi bing hun de zhan wang ， ye shi dui nian hua shi qu de wu nai yu bei ai 。
fang fei de shi jie ， ying zhe wei fu de feng ， yan zhe tian jian de qian mo 。 man bu zai sheng ji ang ran de kuang ye ， hua de hai 、 lv de ye ， ying fei cao chang ， bu gu sheng sheng ， rong rong ang ran de yi pai sheng ji ， ai de qing su jiu hui zai xin zhong qian zi an chang 。 ye yu jiao sa ， na xi xi li li de yin yun ， wan ru qin zheng tan zou de xuan lv ， na qing you mian chang 。 si si ru er de le yin ， bian hui dang qi you yuan de qing gan ， rang zou guo de na xie mei miao de shi guang qiao ran ru fu ， liao bo qi yi mu mu mei hao wang shi de ji yi ， ba wo dai jin yi ge xuan li de jing di ， xian qi dui mei hao guang yin de hui yi 。
shao guang sui zhe feng yu yao zhuai ， si nian de ji yi wu fa bai tuo sheng ming li shen shen de hen ji 。 zi se de lang man he zhe bie yang de you xiang ， ye xu ， shi ta de te zhi huan zai wen wan zhe wo de qing gan ， liu xia le nong nong de xin xiang he wu qiong hui wei 。 wang xi fan qi de yin ge ， xiao sa yu wo yue dong zhe de bi jian ， qing su zhe dui si shui liu nian de qian quan yu chan mian 。 wen shun de shen chen rong jin le mei miao de xin xian ， jie kai le sheng ming yi ci you yi ci de lun hui 。 na shi jie ， ji bian yu duo kai qing si de ji ban ， dan zhui qiu mei hao de xian xin yi bei ta wen ruan ， gou zhu de fang xian yi hong ran tan ta ， wen rou de ai lai le ， bu you de bu qu yu kuai di shun cong 。
zou zai ren sheng bu zhi jin tou de xiao lu ， xiang qian de nian hua wei bei ge zhi ， yi wei de chan mian you zou zai bi ci de ai lian zhi zhong 。 shi guang suo zhu le cong cong ， ji yi kuai le zhe qi mi de wen wan ， ba ai qing de qian quan yi xie cheng le xin de xuan lv 。 zai yue hua ru shui de ming mei yue ye ， jing yi zai xing fu de fu bao ， pin wei zhe ai de tian mei 。 zhe zhong tian mei neng xuan chu ai de tian chang di jiu ， shi ren xiao sa 。 shi guang suo zhu cong cong ， ji yi kuai le yong yuan ！ zong shi shan chang shui kuo ， ye hui xu yi ge di lao tian huang de xin yuan 、 dao chu hai jiao tian ya de zhong cheng 。
shan chuan ling xiu de ren jian ， fu yu le ta wan yue de ling hun ， bai hua de rou mei ning ju le ta qiao wan de qing jie 。 na lv lv qing si diao ke zhe ni xin zhong zui mei li de rong yan ， zai man man de zhan zhuan zhong su chu zhi zhi hua lei ， zai chun nuan hua kai zhi ji zhan fang ， san fa chu mi ren de xiang qi ， cheng xian chu zui guang hui can lan de jiao jie 。 fang hua nong yu zhong ， liu guang yi cai 。 na du te qie tian jing de mei ， lin mo chu fen se de lang man 。 san fei liao rao de you xiang ， wen wan zhe wo de qing gan ， liu xia le ta yong yuan de gao gui he mei li 。 na yi mo mo de shui fen se de xuan li ， qing nian guang yin ， yan zhe sui yue chan liu de lian yi 。 chen dian zai yong heng de ji yi zhong ， chen mian zai ri ye gua nian de xin wo li 。 chang chang zhen zhe ta na kong ling you ya de wen zi ， tian tian di man ru xi ji de mi ren de meng xiang 。 xi wang yong jiu gei ta yi pian mei man de tian di ， rang ta xie zhe wo de shou huan huan di bu jin sheng ming de jin tou ！ xi ji zhe jiang ta liang li de rong mao 、 lian rui si de qiong xin 、 yi ni ru yun de cai qing ， xi xin shi gu de miao man 、 gou hun nie po de qing su 、 huan you ta yi xiang gu you de jie ya ， rong ru zhe ai de chan chan xiao xi ， zi run zhe qu ti he ling hun ， rang zhi ai ru tong sheng ming ， zhu yuan ai de xin xiang yong cun bu shi 。
xiang ai shi yi shou ge 。 jiu xiang shen gu de qing you ， bi shui de ti tou ， qing sa zhe yi xi xi de nong qing mi yi 。 zhe shou ge jiao rou le lv ye ， cheng che le yun kong ， ning cheng le qian gu bu shuai de zan ge 。 zhui ru le ai de qing wang ， jiu yuan yi jiang tian ya wei zhi chi ， le jie zi ji nei xin de na zhong ke gu de si lian ， rang shen chen de ai zai shen bian liao rao ， bu jian duan di zai bi ci de xin zhong yang yi 。 rang ta na can lan de xiao rong sa man sheng ming lu guo de quan cheng ， rang nei xin yong yuan ji dang zhe tian mi 。 hui jiao de ， zong shi lao dao hua bai de tou fa xia suo zhe man lian de cang sang ， dan neng yi qi zuo zai wen nuan de yang xia ， yi qi shai tai yang ， yi qi wang lan tian ， yi qi shu xing xing ， yi qi kan yue liang ， yong yi sheng lai he hu 、 shou hou zhe liang ge ren de ai ， shou hu zhe liang ke xiang ai xin 。 yong zi ji de xin bao guo zhe ai ren de xin ， pei ta zou dao sheng ming de jin tou ， zhen shi zhi de ， ye shi xin gan qing yuan ！
xiang ai shi yi zhong yuan 。 mang mang ren hai zhong ， bai yi qian qian de ren ， lai lai qu qu 。 jiu suan ni neng ren shi hao duo ， dan shi chong qi liang ye bu guo ji wan ren 。 you de ca jian er guo ， you de liu xia le yi si wei xiao 。 er neng zai zi ji de ling hun li ke xia bi ci ming zi de zhi you ni wo 。 zai mei ge fan xing dian dian de ye kong xia ， xu yi shi de xin yuan ， yu ta an jing di xiang shou ， zhen chong zhe bi ci sheng ming li de chun tian ， zhi zhe di gu shou yi shi de chun zhen ， jing shou hong chen ， shou zhe yi fen du te de wen xin ， shou zhe yue ding ， shou zhe yue guang ， si zhen zhu ban di ba ai zai xin zhong zhen cang ， na shi duo me di xing yun 、 duo me di mei hao 。
xiang ai shi yi shou shi 。 shi yi zhong gan shou ， ji shi tong ku ye hui jiao de xing fu ； shi yi zhong ti hui ， ji shi xin sui ye hui jiao de tian mi ； shi yi zhong jing li ， ji shi po sui ye hui jiao de yuan man 。 ta shi gu wang jin lai shao you de 、 na me you ya de nv zi ， you ru qing liang de li ming 。 ta yong zhi hui feng ying le ren sheng de man miao ， yong lei luo su zao le mei hao de hun ling ， yong you ya zhu cheng le miao man de qiong xin ， yong jie li ning cheng le zi ji de ti fu ， zhen shi shao you de ling long ti tou 。 you ya de ju zhi ， zi ran er you ge xing ， jian jie er ming kuai ， gao jie er you pin wei ， xiu wai hui zhong ， ling ren zan xian 。 ta zhen jiu xiang jiao nen de hua rui yi yang 。
zong shi xi huan chen jing zhong zhan zai chuang qian ， liao wang zhe you ta de fang xiang ， xiang xiang zhe ta shen bian de yi qie 。 liang ye tiao tiao ， nian hua sa sa ， zai na yao yuan de di fang ， ta ye zai ji liao shi guang zhong si nian zhe wo 。 wan jian kan zhe yue liang wen rou de lian ， yin yue zhong gan jiao ta zai yu wo fu er qing ge ， fang fo ting dao le yuan fang chui chu de you you xiao qu 。 zai qing wan de xiao yin zhong ， na xiang si chan mian qu he wo de xin qing si si ru kou 。 si xu zhong ， shi jian cong wo men de mian jia bian qiao ran er guo 。 shao hua zheng rong ， tian xing shan shuo ， ji jing de tian mu xia yue liang yao tiao de ying zi zhong ， wo men liang ren cun bu bu li 。 yue liang wang zhe ta ， ye wang zhe wo 。 na chang ran de xin xu cheng zhe yun xu piao fei 。 dui zhe zhuang man qian ying de yue lun he ta mian mian xi yu ……
de cheng bi mu he ci si ， yuan zuo fan ren bu xian xian 。 xiang lian shi qing de ji zhi 。 bu zhi cong he shi ， xi huan zhe yang de qian gua zhe ni de gan jiao 。 feng yu lai lin ， wo men lin zhe yu jian bing jian ， lou zhe ni de qiong yao man bu zai yu zhong 。 ni long yi xi dai shui de yi xiu ， rang qing yun meng long di piao qi ， yi ren jing jing de yu si ru shi zi ji xin fu ， yong nuan nuan de xi yu ， fu mo zhe wo xin zhong de xi lian ， xian hua ru hai ， xi que pian pian 。 wo men ， liang mei xiang dui ， shi zhi xiang kou ， qiao yin nen yu ， wo men yi qi tan qiu zhe ……

yuan zuo yuan yang bi yi fei ， tian chang di jiu you shi jue ， ci qing mian mian wu jue qi 。 na shi de wo ， zhen zheng ti wei dao le ： ai shi yi pian chi re kuang mi de chi xin ， yi tuan wu fa xi mie de lie huo ， yi zhong yong bu man zu de zhui qiu ； shi ru chi ru zui de feng kuang ， shi xin ling niang chu de ji qing 。 zai ta de yan zhong ， wei xiao shi xin shang he man zu ， zai wo de yan zhong ， qian lei shi ta xin zhong yong qi de bo tao 。 ai shi zhi hui de feng kuang ， shi bi ci xin ling de mo qi ， shi gong tong ke wang de jie ju ； ai shi zui ju mo li de fa shu ， shi dong ren er chi qing de shi jian ， shi sa man le zheng rong sui yue de hua yu ， shi dian liang xi wang de huo yuan 。 fan hua de jiao mei ， hua duo de fang xiang ， zheng jiu wu shu de sheng ming ， zheng jiu zhe yi qie de jue wang 。 na shi ， wo jiao de ji shi neng gou zou chu ta de shi ye ， que yong yuan zou bu chu dui ta yin yin de si nian ； ta ji shi neng gou yuan li wo de shen ying que yong yuan bu neng yuan li wo dui ta de nong nong juan lian ……
hua er wei shen me na yang xian ？ yin wei ni ai ta 、 zhong qing yu ta ， suo yi tian tian wei ta jiao shui ji fei ， rang yu lu zi run zhe ta ， huan you tian guang di qi de hui shi ， hua de mi ren zhi zi cai zhan hui yu di ， cai shu lei san rui ， hui fa chu qin ren de qing xiang 。 cai hui zai wan feng yin chang ta de piao yi zhi tai shi ， zhan xian gei shi ren wu xian yang wang de qiong zi ， er ta que zai shi guang liu shi zhong jiu jiu bu hui xiao yuan ， na mi ren jiao jie de rong yan ， zai shi guang wei rui zhong ， bin fen liao rao 。 meng long de wen rou yin re qing er zhan fang ， yin nian qing de mei li ， yin dian ya er dong ren 。 yin rou ruan bi jian ying geng you li liang ， rang ren wu chu zhe li 。 nian qing ， xiang mei li xian hua yi ban de qing xin ling wo ge wai di teng ai ， jiao nen shi xian hua zui mei zhi rou ， ta de liang li yu wen rou ， shi ni jiao de bu gai dui ta you yi si yi hao de xie du ， bu jin xi huan ta de sheng yin ， ta de ju zhi ， ta de pin xiao ， huan you ta de wen rou 。 ta ye ji qi zhen chong wo de xin ren 、 shen chen 、 ni ai …… zai xin ling zhong ， ta de yao tiao 、 wu mei 、 liang li 、 qing rou 、 jiao xiang 、 jiao jie 、 mei miao shi shen me dou bu ke ti dai de 。
zhen ai yi ge ren shi yong yuan dou bu hui gan dao gu dan de ， xiang yi ge ren geng shi yi zhong xing fu ， jing jing de si nian ， gu du di xiang shou ni ， na shi yi zhong wu bi de mei miao 。 duo shao ci wei feng ba ta de rou qing shao lai ， rang wo ming bai “ xi huan yi ge ren jiu man man de shi qu le zi wo ， diu diao zi ji ling hun zhong de sui yi ， na jiu shi ai dao le ji zhi ”。 shi de ， ai qing ru tong shi ge zhong suo zan song de gui li yi yang ， shuang shuang li shi hua die fei wu ， tan ta le ye ke yi wan gu liu chuan ， mian gen qian qiu ……

Thieu chat o tre an dam Cac chuyen gia dinh duong khuyen cao khong nen cho tre an dam qua som vi he tieu hoa cua tre truoc 5 thang tuoi chua hoan chinh, kha nang hap thu con kem, tre chua co du men Amylase de tieu hoa tinh bot nen rat de roi loan tieu hoa. Tron 37 tuan – Hipp Hurra, bat dau nghi de – Hen mother
Tron 37 tuan – Hipp Hurra, bat dau nghi de
Posted on December 17, 2010 by PA
Hom nay me Nhim di thi not bai thi cuoi cung cua hoc ky nay. That ra co 3 mon can hoc, nhung chi co 1 mon se fai thi, nguoi ta lua chon ngau nhien sinh vien nao se thi mon nao, nhung chi dang ten mon thi 2 ngay truoc ngay thi. The nen truoc do thi minh fai doc ca 3 mon, moi mon mot ti. Khi biet duoc minh se thi mon Fys Fos, minh thay dung la troi thuong ba bau. Minh thay hoc on mon nay la de nhat, vi tat ca thong tin chinh nam trong dung 1 quyen sach, cho nen chi can doc xong quyen nay la du. Ma noi chung trong qua trinh hoc minh cung kha hieu mon nay, va mon nay cung ko can fai hoc thuoc long nhieu nhu mon nature, tai lieu cung khong kho tong hop nhu mon toan. Tom lai minh rat hai long voi su lua chon nay.
Tuy da doc so so quyen sach nay truoc do, nhung 2 ngay cuoi minh van fai bo ra ma doc not nhung phan con lai. Toi hom qua thuc den 4 gio sang doc va tong hop cac y cho xong. Nhim met qua, fan doi mot hoi roi lan ra kho kho. Me Nhim cung met lam, nhung ma ko doc thi mai nho boc fai cau hoi ve phan chua doc thi biet lam sao. 1 gio ruoi chieu moi fai vao phong chuan bi nhan cau hoi nhung minh nham tinh rang toi nay da thuc khuya hoc bai the nay thi ngay mai khong the nao day du som de lam gi duoc. Nen tom lai la hom nay fai hoc cho xong, mai chi ngoi nham lai thoi.
Hom nay, minh den som gan 1 tieng dong ho ngoi an banh my va uong sua. Tren duong minh da ngoi nham bai tren xe bus, ko hieu sao minh biet truoc minh se den truong bang xe bus chu ko fai di tau, va se ngoi doc bai tren xe bus. May dua Nauy ngoi cho vao phong nhan cau hoi ben canh minh cu noi chuyen liu lo lam minh co muon hoc bai cung ko vao. Den khi nhan cau hoi, may la cau hoi vao phan minh da doc, va cung nho kha nhieu chi tiet. The nen minh di vao phong thi rat hung dung, ko run so ti nao.
Vao phong thi minh bat dau mo may, noi lien thoang nhu so nguoi ta noi tranh mat cua minh. Cac co giao ghi chep lia lia, va cac co chi co thoi gian de hoi minh 2, 3 cau hoi nho thoi, con lai minh noi het ca thoi gian nen cac co phai duoi minh ra vi ngoi qua 3 phut. Tom lai minh thay rat hai long, va co ve phan ung cua cac co khi nghe tra loi cung kha tot. Tuy mai moi biet ket qua nhung minh tin chac la minh it nhat la ko bi truot. The la minh thay sung suong vo cung vi cuoi cung thi minh cung hoan thanh xong hoc ky nay nhu du dinh va ke tu bay gio la minh duoc nghi de.
May ngay nay minh se tha ho ma lam banh nay banh kia, nau mon nay mon kia, xem Iron chef tren Youtube, doc sach bau bi, dan not chan len cho Nhim, di tham nha ban be, xem phim voi bac beo vi bac nay cung dang nghi vacation o nha. Hom qua do dac tu IKEA da den day du nen bay gio minh co the bat tay vao chuan bi cho Nhim. Hom truoc nguoi ta chuyen do IKEA den co 1 nua, nua kia bao mai se giao, minh ko de y lai ky nhan luon, ve bac beo bao nho no ko giao hang thi bat den ai duoc, vi no moi giao co hai cai dem va mot cai ghe banh, con lai tat ca do cho Nhim chua giao thu gi. Lam minh lo dung lo ngoi, tu chui rua minh ngu si suot ca buoi toi. May ma nguoi ta cung tu te, hom sau nguoi ta den giao hang dung hen, ma that ra cung cha ai di an cap may thu chau tam, khan bong, ban thay ta cua baby lam gi, ban cha duoc may tien. Minh nhan duoc may thu day thi thich me, the la bay gio co the mang ao quan cua Nhim ra cat labels di va giat giu xep sap lai duoc roi.
Ban thay ta se dat trong phong tam, ngan tren de mieng thay ta, ngan duoi de cac gio dung khan lau, bong gon, lotion, baby oil, giay tham, bim, v.v.. tom lai cac do dung can thiet. Tang duoi cung de chau tam cho Nhim, vi minh du tinh la ban thay ta cung lam gia de chau tam cho Nhim luon, de khi tam do fai ngoi xom xuong dat. Ban thay ta dat canh bon rua mat de tien lay nuoc non tam tap, lau chui cho Nhim.
Con giuong cui cua Nhim thi se dat trong phong ngu cung voi bo me, the nen minh moi dat mua mot cai ghe banh de ban dem ngoi day cho Nhim bu ti. Ban dem neu thay ta uot thi thay luon tren giuong cui, con neu thay ta ban thi moi mang em ra ban thay ta, the nen ben canh giuong chi can de mot cai gio nho de mot it khan lau, bim va khan sua khi bu ti la du. Con ban ngay thi Nhim co the ngu va vat tren phong khach, ko can thiet luc nao cung phai nam trong giuong cui.
Tuy mua trong IKEA da tiet kiem nhieu tien roi, nhung vi ong ba Nhim sang nen lai ton them tien mua dem cho ong ba nam. The nhung me Nhim ky bo nen da tinh toan luon la hai cai dem nay, sau khi ong ba ve thi co the giu lai, sau nay se dung cho phong tre con, vi phong tre con se mua mot cai giuong 2 tang. The nen bo Nhim di mua luon hai cai dem rat dat. Bo Nhim ma mua thi cai gi fai that tot, nhung ma the nen gia bao gio cung dat gap doi voi chi phi ma me Nhim du dinh ban dau.
Tom lai cho den nay thi moi viec deu suon se theo dung du dinh. Bay gio me Nhim moi co thoi gian post may cai anh di an Julebord len day. Tuy bay gio ko co PS trong may de edit, edit tam bang PhotoScape nhung may la may cai anh nay nhin cung tam duoc. Anh sang yeu, may rom nen chat luong chi duoc bay nhieu thoi.
Nha hang Venner o Grønnland, noi chung la sau khi di an hai lan julebord thi rut ra ket luan la di an nha hang Nauy chi ton tien chu chang duoc cai gi.
Sau khi di an julebord ve, biet la bac beo ko bao gio du kien nhan va ‘cam hung nghe thuat’ de chup anh cho vo nen minh biet than biet fan tu chup lay vay.
Anh chup trong nha tam, vi co cai guong to hon.
Truoc tu quan ao, vay nay la vay mua o children section day chu ko fai vay bau dau, nhung may la no bang chat lieu thun gian tot nen mac van vua bung bau. Ao hai day nay mua SIDA o VN, truoc den nay van rong thung thinh the ma bay gio thi vua nhu in.
Quyet tam khoe cai bung bau 8 thang, bay gio bung co khi con to hon the nay mot ti roi ay chu.
Banh nay la lai tap giua banh troi va banh chay. Bac beo an xong thi bao banh … xu xe ngon lam, vi bac nay chi biet co moi cai banh xu xe. Tu nhien minh noi cam hung loe loet nen loi may em banh ra nhuon. Luc nhuom thi no chi hoi phon phot nhu kieu baby blue, baby pink thoi, ko ngo cho vao luoc no moi do choet, xanh let ra the nay. Lan sau rut kinh nghiem cho that it mau thoi.
Ma cong nhan la nhan banh an giong nhan xuxe, vi dau xanh minh nau chin chu ko hap, roi cho vao may xay nhuyen ra, sen voi duong nau va mot it dau an, roi tron voi it dua nao. A, co cho mot it duong vani nua nhung cho ti teo nen ko thay mui gi may, nhung ma cung ko muon no at mat mui dua. Vo banh thi cung tron mot it bot cot dua Chao Thai, va mot hai giot nuoc hoa cam, nhung cung cho it qua nen ko ngui thay mui gi, lan sau cho nhieu hon de vo banh thom thom giong vo banh deo.
Nghi den day minh lai nay ra y tuong ‘sang tao’ lam banh deo cai bien di, ko can gi cu fai dung y nhu kieu binh thuong. Rut cuc thi minh thich nhat o banh deo la cai nhan va cai texture va mui thom thom cua no, con hinh dang, cach lam ra sao ko can phai theo dung kieu truyen thong. May hom nay dang nghi dinh nho bo me mua ho khuon banh o Vn nhung ngai ong ba fai lo mo di tim. Nen neu cai bien di duoc thi cung cha can khuon lam gi cho rac roi.
May may tam anh nay cung de edit nen minh dung Photoscape nhung thay chat luong cung on, dung la anh de edit thi chinh sua de dang hon nhieu, va hieu qua cung ro ret. Minh cung phat hien them mot so chuc nang cua Photoscape, tuy nhung chuc nang nay van o dang kha crude, ko the so voi PS duoc. Lan dau tap up anh len fb thay kho qua, thoi, minh trung thanh voi blog vay, chi can mot goc nho binh yen thoi, ko can fai on ao dong duc qua.
Bay gio nghi den chuyen bat dau nghi de thay that la sung suong. Chang may khi minh thuc hien duoc dung nhung thu minh du dinh, nen hoc ky nay ket thuc nhu mong muon, va ket qua lai tot nua, minh thay hai long lam. Do dac cua Nhim the la cung san sang roi, bay gio chi can sap xep thoi. Bac beo lai con nay ra y dinh bat minh … hoc tieng Balan, ma lai bat hoc ngay tap lu co. Ca ngay bac ay cu nheo nheo, nghe diec het ca tai. Oi, mong sao Nhim ra doi dung hen, dung co ra som, de me nhim con duoc enjoy may tuan cuoi nay mot ti.

Review: Escape Route (2016)
Sat, 24 Dec 2016 ReviewsBa Lifen, Bak Ha-seon, Drama, He Yunwei, Martial arts, Shi Zhaoqi, Tsui Siu-keung, Wei Ping'ao, Wu Lin, Xie Yuan, Xu Shaoqiang, Zhang Yishansinocinema
Making her debut in a Chinese film, South Korea’s Bak Ha-seon 박하선 | 朴河宣 (I Came from Busan 영도 다리 위, 2010) fits in seamlessly, if rather blandly, as an ancient princess-cum-love interest, and her re-voicing is not too obvious. The real acting meat is largely given to others, including stand-up comedian He Yunwei 何云伟 as the hero’s dumbo pal, Shi Zhaoqi 石兆琪 as a snarling barbarian general, Xu Shaoqiang 徐少强 [Tsui Siu-keung] as an evil high priest, and Xie Yuan 谢园 as a white-haired, martial-arts sage. Only in the final few minutes, where there’s an unlikely twist and the film hammers home its layabout-grows-up message, does Escape Route lose its sure footing. The Chinese title roughly means “Hit the Road and Run”.

Nguoi vo mien Nam cua co Tong Bi thu Le Duan - Việt Báo Việt Nam Mobile
Nguoi vo mien Nam cua co Tong Bi thu Le Duan	Chủ nhật, 25 Tháng sáu 2006, 10:56 GMT+7	TPCN - Gian phong khach gian di cua mot can ho trong khu chung cu Phu My Hung. Tam chan dung cua mot nguoi dan ong chup vao do dung tuoi, anh mat dang toa xuong cai nhin nghiem nghi va am ap...
Vo chong Co Tong Bi thu Le Duan (Rung U Minh, nam 1950)
Mot thuo mot thoi toi da tung thay duoc treo o vi tri trang trong tai rat nhieu noi. Nhung luc nay, toi co cam giac tam chan dung ay da duoc treo dung cho nhat.
Don gian vi ong la chong cua nu chu nhan day! Nhanh nhen xoi loi, o tuoi tam muoi may ma ba con khoe.
Toi gan nhu la mot nguoi gap may boi moi luc cu dan dan xuat hien roi thuong truc cung cach xoi loi man chuyen cua ba...
Phai noi vay vi buoi dau gap, ba cu lac dau roi cuoi nhe ve khiem nhuong: “Chuyen toi dau co chi ma may chu ban tam!”.
Ba la ca mot kho tu lieu. Chuyen bat dau tu mot co gai mien Dong manh de dam ra bung hoat dong cach mang...
Roi mot cuoc hon nhan, noi theo cung cach cua ba la do anh Sau Tho (dong chi Le Duc Tho) lam mai va anh Hai Hung (dong chi Pham Hung) la chu hon, dam cuoi o chien khu. Chu re la anh Ba, nguoi Quang Tri ma sau nay la Tong Bi thu cua Dang ta...
I. Moi tinh dau
Ba dang ngoi truoc toi. Chat giong khe khang tram am. Ba tam su, tanh ba ngang thang, tu be da giong y chang cha minh. Ong noi, ba noi deu la nhung nguoi tinh cach manh, tiet thao.
Phap chat dau ong noi vi toi tham gia Can Vuong. Ba noi phai cong cha ba khi ay con be ti tu Dong Nai len Binh Tay de tranh hoa tru di tam toc.
Ba kiem song bang cach di quet don cho may nha may xay xat o Binh Tay vua co tien cong vua thu gom gao do, dem ve sang say lai de nuoi song ca nha.
Ong gia len sau tuoi da duoc di hoc truong Tay la ca mot su kien. Dau phai hoc cho minh ma la hoc thue! Tay bat con cai tong con dia chu phai di hoc tieng Tay.
Gui con gai Vu Anh 3 thang tuoi cho me o Sai Gon
Thong minh lanh le nen ong duoc mot chu dat muon di hoc cho con ong ta. Di hoc thue vua co tien nuoi ba noi vua boi bo kien thuc. Dan da ong dau hang nhat diplome truong Petrus Ky( nay la truong Le Hong Phong).
Ong hoc gioi nen duoc chon ve lam tho ky 3 nam trong Phu Toan quyen. Sau 3 nam Phap bo ong gia di lam tri huyen. Ong khong ung. Mac du ben ngoai noi, he di lam tri huyen thi ga con gai cho.
Trai y ong ngoai, nhung vo ong mot co gai dep con nha giau, da bo ca dam cuoi le ra se duoc to chuc rinh rang ma theo khong ong gia.
Ong gia theo nghe viet bao. Ong viet bao gioi. Chang bao lau ong lam chu but to Tribune Indigene (Dien dan ban xu) nen ca vung goi ong la Ong chu nhut trinh.
Tinh ong ngang, thang. Ngoai viec benh vuc quyen loi cua dan ngheo bang ngoi but, trong doi song he thay Tay di xe ngua cua dan khong tra tien, ong thop nguc danh lien.
Ong kich liet phan doi chinh sach thuoc dia cu the la suu cao thue nang bang ca viet bao lan dang dan dien thuyet. Toan quyen Phap phai than chinh gap ong mua chuoc bang cach hua cap 500 ha dat cho vay von de trong cao su.
Khi do nhieu nguoi phat len bang nghe nay. Nhung ong noi thang tha toi cap dat ma an cho khong khi nao ngua tay xin tien!
Ong gia song nghia khi. Mot ban giat sung cung mot top trai trang len tan bien gioi Campuchia bat mot bon chuyen chom trom bo cua ta dien trong vung.
Ong noc ten trum truong quat cho mot tran nen than bat phai tra lai bo bat trom va hua khong bao gio quay nhieu dan lanh. Tiec ong mat som khi moi 46 tuoi. Khi ong gia mat, nha cua sa sut dan.
Tuy vay ba cung duoc theo hoc het so hoc. Nha tranh vach dat nhung danh tieng nghia khi cua ong gia van nhu truoc. Ba con rat kinh ne. Linh khong bao gio dam xet nha.
Vay nen dau nhung nam bon muoi, cuoc khoi nghia Nam Ky that bai, nhieu can bo hoat dong o Nam Ky bi keu an tu hinh vang mat da ve nha ba tron tranh...
Dan da co be Nguyen Thuy Nga (ten khai sinh cua ba) duoc may anh may chu giac ngo cach mang.Duoi su diu dat cua dong chi Nguyen Van Tiep, Bi thu Tinh uy My Tho (ten cua nha cach mang nay da duoc dat cho mot con kenh lon trong vung) co be Nga tham gia lam lien lac van chuyen tai lieu mat, vu khi tu Sai Gon di My Tho, Tan An va nguoc lai.
Nhieu ban suyt bi bat nhung may nho lanh le thong minh, lai biet dung tieng Phap (nhieu lan sam vai con nha giau an mac banh di tren xe lua toa hang nhat hoac xe nha binh voi si quan Phap) nen thoat.
Nam 16 tuoi, co be Thuy Nga da tro ma con gai duoc nhieu dam de mat toi. Ma va nguoi nha nham nhe cho may dam kha gia nhung co deu tu choi.
Nhung nhip dap trai tim tuoi hoa nien ay da bao phen khong binh thuong vi mot nguoi! Do la mot can bo hoat dong bi mat tung bi keu an tu hinh dang bi mat o ngay trong nha Nga, thuong xuyen duoc Nga dan duong cung nhu trao cac tai lieu mat.
Chat giong ba duom chut boi hoi khi nhac den cai thuo voi xa ay. Cu hang dem Nga cho nguoi ay ve de mo cua dong cua vi cong tac bi mat.Mot dem, loi 2 gio sang,Nga vua mo cua, nguoi ay buoc qua nguong da quang tay om sat Nga. Nguoi Nga run ban len.
Lan dau tien Nga biet the nao la yeu. Roi sau do nguoi ay chuyen vung hoat dong len Vung Tau, Da Lat nhung thuong xuyen thu tu cho Nga. Nguoi ay viet mot chu nguyet va bao Nga dung nhung chu dau lam thanh mot bai tho tang nguoi ay. Co be 17 tuoi do da viet 6 dong nhu the nay:
Nay anh cat buoc ra diGiang ho rang mat khach tu myU uan noi long khong dam toYeu ma lang le tien nhau diEm dem dung buoc anh ngoanh laiThoi dung bin rin phut chia ly
Nghe chat giong hoi run run khi ba nham lai, toi hoi sung sot chua han vi ba van ranh re ky niem moi tinh dau hon sau muoi nam truoc ma nhu ba binh than cho hay rang nguoi ay khi ay da co vo co con. Ba biet het nhung van yeu!
Moi tinh dau ay roi chang di den dau... Nhung la niem dong vien khich le ba trong nhung thang ngay hoat dong co cuc gian nan.Ky niem dep cung lam. Ky niem thuong tam lai cang nhieu...
Trong to diep bao cua ba nhung ngay dau khoi nghia nam 1945, co mot co nu sinh trung hoc rat dep thong thao tieng Phap. Co co nhiem vu moc noi voi mot ten don truong nguoi Phap de du kich ta diet don.
Nhiem vu gan hoan thanh cung la luc co yeu vien don truong nguoi Phap dep trai. Nhiem vu sau chot cua co la phai dung khau sung luc vien don truong de duoi goi de ban no.
Co gai khoc rong ra tin hieu cho bo doi vo diet don thi duoc cho co khong bao gio cam khau sung ay len! Tran cong don thang loi. Vien don truong bi diet.
Co diep bao ay cung bo di biet xu! Mot co khac trong to ten Thao. Cung xinh xan cung thao tieng Tay nhu co no. Cung giao nhiem vu y chang. Nhung Thao khac. Co khoc rong khi cho ban hay, mot ban ten don truong da om lay co ma hon.
Khi Thao bat ngo bi bat, ca to diep bao ta hoa boi y nghi moi bi no hon con suy sup co do thi lam sao Thao chiu duoc nhung don tra te hai cua ke thu?
Vay nen anh em voi va so tan het. Nhung Thao da chiu du cuc hinh va quyet khong khai roi cuoi cung bi bon giac tam dau dot den thanh mu mat tay chan cong queo!
Moi tinh dau cua Thuy Nga voi nguoi ay chi dat dau cham het cho den nam nam muoi, khi co ve Can Tho cong tac va gap Anh Ba.
II. Dam cuoi giua Rung U Minh
Lai nhung ngay gian nan voi trach nhiem tinh uy vien, Doan truong phu nu Cuu Quoc tinh Bac Lieu roi Can Tho.
Nghe chat giong deu deu binh than cua ba ma toi hoi gai gai boi tuong tuong ra cai canh nhung can bo phu nu Nam Bo phai buon chai trong dieu kien nha dap nha da (nhung can nha dung tam bo bang la bang manh nilon khi di chuyen di khong o thi dap thi da di).
Gap dich can gap giac lung nhin doi da danh. Muoi dia nhung nhuc nam nop quanh nam thi kho biet chung nao. Thu tuong tuong co gai Thuy Nga khi ay moi hon hai muoi, da phai dam nuoc man roi nam phoi nang dai dai cho da do trang de ra cho hoat dong cong khai.
Con o chien khu thi co thoi gian suot nam troi chi doc mot cai quan den. Muon giat phoi thi phai ra cho vang ma giat roi phoi. Trong luc doi kho, phai quan cai khan ran khong dam gap ai het.
Do la nhung ngay nang rao. Troi mua dam de suot thang con cuc toi co nao! Khi Thuy Nga ve mien Tay cong tac thi da xay ra mot su kien: Chuyen yeu duong cua Thuy Nga voi nguoi can bo hoat dong bi mat ay da bi lo.
Tinh uy hop yeu cau co bao cao va sau do quyet dinh chuyen co ve Sai Gon cong tac de cat dut moi quan he do!
Cung chinh vao thoi diem nay, dong chi Le Duan voi danh nghia la Bi thu Xu uy Nam Ky tu Dong Thap Muoi xuong du Hoi nghi Tinh uy da nghe duoc cau chuyen tinh eo le cua Thuy Nga.
Nhung nhu ba da boc bach trong nhung dong nhat ky (toi tham mong rang day se la nhung tu lieu quy de manh nha cho mot cuon hoi ky day dan va gia tri sau nay cua ba):
La la anh Ba hong noi chi rao troi... Sang hom sau, Tinh uy to chuc cho dong chi an sang co mot minh, co chao ga va hai hot ga luoc. Luc do an vay la sang lam roi.
Toi den voi nhiem vu la kiem tra bua an cua dong chi xem co thieu gi khong? Dong chi dang an thay toi buoc vao thi keu nguoi phuc vu lay them chen dua va keu toi cung an. Co hai trung ga dong chi cung chia toi mot cai.
Trong khi ngoi an, dong chi hoi toi ve viec xu ly cua Tinh uy va hoi toi nghi sao?
Toi thang than “ Duoc phan cong cong tac o Sai Gon doi voi toi la cong tac moi va kho nguy hiem nua nhung toi vui ve chap nhan, khong ban khoan gi. Nhung bao toi thoi nguoi yeu ma minh da yeu thi toi kho lam duoc. Xa nhau cung duoc nhung yeu la do trai tim, dung bat buoc nhu vay...’’.
Anh Ba nghe toi noi vay khong noi gi... Nhung hom sau nghe dong chi Le Duc Tho noi lai la anh Ba co noi may chi Nam Bo co gioi thieu cho anh ay may nguoi nhung anh khong ung. Neu co lay vo thi thi anh thich nguoi co tinh nghia thuy chung nhu chi Nga...
Mot thoi gian sau, anh Sau Tho xuong Can Tho cong tac, anh gap toi noi: “ Anh Ba muon hoi chi lam vo. Chi nen ung anh ay di. Anh xa nha da 20 nam khong co tin tuc gi cua gia dinh. Gia dinh anh ay con o vung dich.
Neu chi lam vo anh ay, chi cham soc anh ay de anh co suc khoe lam viec do cung la mot nhiem vu. Anh ay hien nay trong lanh dao, anh rat thong minh va sang suot.
Anh em thuong goi anh la 200 Bougies (200 nen). Khi co nguoi ke can cham soc thi anh se tro thanh 400 Bougies... Su sang suot cua anh ay co loi cho cach mang toi chung nao”.
Nghe anh Sau Tho noi toi chung hung. Vi trong long toi luc nao anh cung la mot lanh tu ma moi nguoi kinh yeu. Toi cung vay. Luc nao toi cung ghi chep dong chi Le Duan noi the nay, dong chi Le Duan noi the kia...’’ vv... Thu hai la chuyen tinh cam cua toi voi mot nguoi, anh ay da biet rat ro qua Hoi nghi cua Tinh uy.
Tai sao anh lai dat van de voi toi? Toi suy nghi mai va quyet dinh gap lai anh va muon tho lo het ban khoan cua minh... Nhung toi ngai gap qua. Mot lan toi lay het can dam hoi anh “ Neu bay gio anh lay vo, sau nay ve gap lai gia dinh, phai giai quyet ra sao day?”. Anh thang than “ Anh cuoi vo truoc kia la do cha me cuoi cho…
Toi suy nghi rat du, boi vi tinh yeu cua toi tu nam 16 tuoi voi mot dong chi co vo co con nen chung toi da kho qua roi. Neu bay gio con ung nguoi co vo co con nua thi se ra sao day?
Va lai moi tinh dau con nhuc nhoi trong tim toi lam sao go ra duoc de tim tinh yeu cua nguoi khac? Nhung nhung loi cua anh Sau Tho noi lam toi phai suy nghi mai.
Toi lai gap anh hai lan nua. Moi lan nhu vay lai gay cho toi nhung an tuong moi. Anh mac quan rach dit, ao rach cui cho. Nguoi anh luc nao cung 47 ky nhung vi cao nen anh kho quat kho queo. ao quan nhuom mau phen Dong Thap Muoi.
Sinh hoat cua anh lam toi xuc dong. Nhung nguoi nhu ong Pham Van Bach, Pham Ngoc Thuan. Le Thanh Vinh... trong uy ban khang chien hanh chanh Nam Bo nguoi nao cung co nha cua, co nguoi bao ve, nguoi nau bep tuy o nha la nhung cung dang hoang.
Con anh chi co chiec tam ban bon cheo di voi hai dong chi thu ky va bao ve. Den co quan nao, den nha ba ma nao thi anh em len nha ngu, con anh thi ngu duoi ghe.
Anh nhuong nhin moi dieu kien tot cho moi nguoi. Con nguoi anh bao gio cung thoai mai vi tha... Co lan toi di ghe nuoc nguoc, vua bi can vua troi nang chang chang.
Anh cung anh em nguoi di hai ben bo keo, nguoi loi duoi bun day ghe, toi ngoi trong ghe ma mo hoi con va nhu tam. Ghe nhich tung chut, tung chut mot. Trong anh em that toi nghiep. Toi nghi, nhung nguoi nay an o co tinh nghia voi nhau dam hy sinh cho nhau...
Co nhung lan anh noi chuyen voi toi ve phu nu ve ba me cua anh. Toi nhan thay ve be ngoai cua anh nhu ong do nho, nhung tinh cam cua anh thi rat dac biet.
Anh nhac nhieu den me anh. Toi hinh dung me anh la nguoi nhan hau hay giup do moi nguoi, thuong nau cao dan mun nhot theo toa gia truyen. Ca lang deu nho ba.
Ba duoc moi nguoi thuong yeu kinh trong. Khi anh lam cach mang, nha rat ngheo. Cu ong lam nghe tho moc. Me anh de danh tung cu khoai lang, cho anh ve luoc cho ma an. Khi anh ra di, bo anh khoc nhung me anh lai ran roi dong vien anh, tuy ba chi co minh anh la con trai.
Anh chi con mot nguoi chi va mot co em gai. Luc anh bi giac bat cam tu, thu anh gui ve me anh nho hang xom doc cho nghe nhieu lan, xong ba may cai tui nho xep thu vao tui khau lai va mang tren can co nhu nguoi mang bua vay.
Khi me anh chet, anh khong ve duoc nhung nguoi nha noi lai la thu anh van deo tren co me. Nhung chuyen anh ke lam toi vo cung xuc dong. Tinh cam cua anh sao ma sau dam lam vay.
Long toi da quyet. Sau do toi gap lai nguoi yeu cu. Toi noi voi anh “Chung ta yeu nhau hon 11 nam roi. Nhung vi anh con ganh nang gia dinh, chung ta kho ket hop duoc. Nay cac anh lam mai cho anh Ba, anh nghi sao?’’
Anh noi anh rat buon nhung danh chia tay nhau vay thoi...
Dam cuoi to chuc vao sau dip phu nu Nam Bo mo Hoi nghi toan Nam Bo tai Van phong Trung uong Cuc dong o mien Tay. Dong chi Le Duc Tho lam ong mai. Dong chi Pham Hung lam chu hon.
Co le la lan dau, toi nghe mot nguoi noi, dong chi Le Duan co lam tho. Nguoi ay chinh la ba. Tho dong chi Le Duan doc tang ba trong dam cuoi nam 1948 ay nhu the nay:
Hoi co con gai Dong Nai
Hom qua gio lanh diu hiu
Long co man mac tram chieu nho
Hom nay troi tanh may quang
Gio xuan dam am mui huong dam
Tu tinh ta lai voi ta
Say sua bao xiet la ta voi minh
Cho hay la giong huu tinh
Do ai cat duoc to manh lam doi
Ba cung cat nghia toi hay rang, bai tho do tac gia co nhac lai moi tinh cu cua ba ma nhung nguoi du dam cuoi ai cung biet va khong quen khang dinh tinh yeu cua hai nguoi trong tuong lai!
Giong ba khe khang mo ho nhu vong ve tu nhung nam thang xa xam ay rang hai nguoi da gap nhau tu hai thai cuc rat khac nhau nhung song voi nhau rat hoa thuan dam am.
Nguoi vo moi mien Nam cham lo cho anh Ba tung mieng an mieng uong. May quan ao cho anh Ba vua van bang to tam den. Cha biet khi nao thi anh Ba tro thanh 400 Bougies nhung trong anh tuoi tan khoe manh an mac dang hoang.
Nguoi vo tre xet thay ung anh la dung vi cang o voi nhau lau cang biet gia tri tinh cam cua nguoi chong. Co vo so nhung cu chi lam chi kho quen. Khi anh di hop o dau ve, anh om cham lay chi, doi mat anh sang ra cuoi het co voi ham rang deu tap co cai rang khenh ben phai.
Co lan hai vo chong cung tam, cu nhau cuoi ram ran ca mot quang suoi. Mat anh co lan tai xanh vi lo cho vo khi nghe vo noi cho hay may dem anh di hop vang, co cop rinh ngoai cua...
Khi co mang con gai dau long Vu Anh, chi chi moi nhac trong giac mo them xoai ma ban ngay anh di lung cho bang duoc... Nguoi vo moi ngoan hien diu dang nhung cai gi chua chiu la cai.
Nhung moi cuoc tranh luan deu thu xep em tham boi long vi tha nhan ai va tri tue man tiep cua anh. Vua la dong chi vua la vo chong nen nhung thang nam do that ngot ngao, phong phu...

Tinh duc lam tang su thong minh - Hoi dap suc khoe
Tags: quan he tinh duc, su thong minh, co hieu qua, cam giac, lam tang, cam xuc, hang hai, anh huong, vui ve, hormon, nguoi, nang, tiet, khoai,
Sau quan he tinh duc, thuong thay phan chan, vui ve, lam viec hang hai va co hieu qua hon, nhu vay co phai la thong minh hon khong? (Mot ban doc khong neu ten)
- BS DAO XUAN DUNG (Chuyen khoa II, San phu khoa): Khoa hoc da chung minh dien bien tam ly va khi chat con nguoi chiu anh huong nhay ben cua cac tuyen noi tiet giai phong ra cac hormon. Trang thai tam ly tich cuc sau quan he tinh duc tu nguyen va thoa man cung vay, do la ket qua cua ca mot day chuyen cac phan ung hoa hoc dien ra trong co the, ke tu cam giac rao ruc ham muon luc khoi dau cho den khi dat den dinh diem khoai cam.
Truoc het can biet rang vung duoi doi (trong nao) la nga tu ma tat ca nhung xung dong than kinh ve cam giac doi khat, dau don, vui buon, khoai lac deu di qua, no kiem soat cac hormon chi phoi chuc nang sinh san va hanh vi tinh duc nguoi. Truoc day nguoi ta tuong rang tuyen yen la tuyen co anh huong quan trong hang dau nhung nay nguoi ta biet rang chinh trung tam duoi doi cua nao cung dong vai tro quan trong khong kem, dieu hoa cac chuc nang co ban cua con nguoi.
Tuyen yen bai tiet ra hormon LH va FSH co anh huong den hoat dong cua tuyen sinh duc nam nu, tiet ra hormon chi phoi nhung bien doi sinh ly trong co the: cam giac ham muon tinh duc (duc nang), su xung huyet vung co quan sinh duc dan den cuong duong (nam) va tiet ra dich nhon (o nu).
Con nhieu hormon khac tham gia vao tien trinh gay hung khoi, cam giac dinh diem va cuoi cung la bien doi tam ly va cam xuc rat duong tinh sau quan he tinh duc:
DHEA (dehydroepiandrosteron) do vo thuong than bai tiet ra va duoc giai phong nhieu hon khi dat den cuc khoai, tang tu 3 den 5 lan so voi truoc do. Nhung ket qua nghien cuu cho biet DHEA co the lam cho tu duy sac sao hon, chong ca trang thai tram cam...
Oxytocine: do thuy sau tuyen yen tiet ra, co vai tro trong su phat sinh hung khoi tinh duc va khoai cuc cho ca nam va nu. O nam, oxytocine giup cho su van chuyen tinh trung khi xuat tinh. Ban nang ket doi cua con nguoi co vai tro cua oxtocin.
Nong do oxytocine cao hon o nhung nguoi dang yeu. Oxytocine cung chi phoi ca nhieu hinh thai ket doi khac nhu tinh ban va moi quan he trong gia dinh. Nong do ocytocin tang rat cao trong cuc khoai con lam tang su gan bo giua doi ban tinh vi hormon nay duoc menh danh la “hormon cua su gan bo”, lam phat sinh cam xuc yeu thuong va mong muon duoc gan ben nhau.
Phenylethylamine: chat dan truyen than kinh, mot hoa chat cua nao co cau truc giong nhu amphetamin, chi phoi cam xuc sang khoai va hung khoi, duoc biet den nhu la thuoc cua tinh yeu co trong socola va co tac dung tang ham muon tinh duc.
Dopamin duoc nao tiet ra mot cach tu nhien khi an, hoat dong tinh duc… khi giam dopamin thi cung giam su hang hai lam viec va khong con kha nang trai nghiem khoai cam. Dopamin thuong phoi hop voi he thong gay cam giac de chiu cua nao, tao ra nhung cam giac vui ve va tang cuong dong luc hang hai de lam mot so viec nao do.
Ngoai ra, serotonin, norepinephrine, vasopressine… cung la nhung hormon co vai tro quan trong trong tinh duc va tinh yeu. Nhu vay trang thai cam xuc va khi chat tro nen rat duong tinh sau quan he tinh duc la he qua cua hoat dong hormon, la tien de thuan loi de tri thong minh phat huy tiem nang cua no chu khong lam tang.
Su thong minh la tong cong cac kha nang tam tri cua mot ca nhan do nhieu yeu to tao nen (di truyen, tu chat, lao dong tri tue kien nhan) chi chiu anh huong gian tiep do nhung cam xuc ma hoat dong tinh duc dem lai. Hon nua, co nhieu tip thong minh khac nhau, cau thu bong ro co su thong minh hon nguoi ve cam giac khong gian, neu quan he tinh duc truoc khi thi dau thi co nguy co nem bong…ra ngoai ro.

- Thua ong, con nhung ly do gi khien nhieu dia ban trong diem ve ma tuy chua duoc xoa so?
- Viec tuyen truyen van dong nguoi dan tham gia phong chong te nan xa hoi tai dia ban dan cu thoi gian qua lam chua tot, chua co chieu sau. Cac co quan chuc nang dia phuong chua gan voi nhan dan. - Nhung chang le khong ai chiu trach nhiem?
- Dia phuong phai chiu trach nhiem, ma truc tiep la nguoi lanh dao. Theo toi, mot so lanh dao chua nhan thuc sau sac, nghi rang phong chong te nan chi la cong viec nhat thoi, mang tinh thoi diem, phong trao nen chua ho tro, chi dao thuc hien mot cach triet de. Te nan xa hoi xay ra tren dia ban anh, anh khong the noi la khong biet. Neu khong biet thi anh phai xem lai minh da hoan thanh cong viec nhan dan giao hay chua. Con biet ma khong lam tron nhiem vu thi anh phai chiu kiem diem xu ly.
Tung luc, tung noi van xay ra tinh trang nguoi dan bao len co quan cong an viec doi tuong mua ban, tiem chich ma tuy thi cong an vien nhieu ly do khong thoa dang de thoai thac nhiem vu. Nhung su viec nhu vay khong the tiep tuc xay ra. Tuy nhien, toi nay van chua co quy dinh cu the ve viec xu ly don vi, lanh dao dia phuong khong lam tron trach nhiem trong cong tac phong chong te nan xa hoi.
- Theo ong lam the nao de tang cuong trach nhiem dia phuong?
- Can thiet phai co su phan cong trach nhiem, nhiem vu cu the doi voi tung co quan, to chuc doan the cung nhu lanh dao chinh quyen dia phuong. SQL statements will be written in different forms in the hands of different people, such as the SQL slow queries that are often encountered. At this time, it is often necessary to optimize for SQL.
In order to ensure that SQL statements can be run efficiently, Mysql provides an Explain command for semantic analysis of SQL statements for developers to optimize for SQL.
In order to facilitate the execution of the entire process, first create test data.
Execution in SQL involves the joint execution of a single table and multiple tables. This time two tables are created to simulate this situation. More joint execution of multiple tables is the same as the execution plan of the two tables.
`name` varchar(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT '' COMMENT 'user name',
`sex` tinyint(4) NOT NULL DEFAULT '1' COMMENT 'Gender',
`phone` varchar(11) NOT NULL COMMENT 'Mobile number',
`desc` varchar(200) NOT NULL DEFAULT '' COMMENT 'Introduction',
) ENGINE = InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET = utf8 COMMENT 'User Table';
CREATE TABLE `order`(
`name` varchar(20) NOT NULL COMMENT 'user name',
) ENGINE = InnoDB default CHARSET = utf8 COMMENT 'Order';
In order to facilitate this time, instead of using SQL statements, but using stored procedures to create data, it is simple, fast and convenient.
